title: Apprenticeship
description:
**Overview**
This role is for an Apprenticeship – Ecology (Desk-Based, Global Technology Centre – India)
  
  
**Your role**

* Project Support: Work as part of the AtkinsRéalis Environment team from GTC India, supporting a range of UK ecology and environmental planning projects across various sectors. Collaborate closely with UK colleagues to integrate ecological expertise into multidisciplinary project deliverables.
* Ecological Desk Studies & Data Analysis: Conduct desk-based ecological assessments by analysing site survey data for habitats and species. Support ecological desk studies, helping establish baseline ecological conditions and inform project planning and design.
* Environmental Planning & EIA Support: Contribute to Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and planning consent processes by preparing ecological input sections, baseline descriptions, and technical reports. Assist in evaluating project impacts on biodiversity, and incorporate biodiversity and nature recovery considerations into planning documents and ecological impact assessments.
* GIS Mapping & Spatial Analysis: Use Geographical Information Systems (GIS) (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) to perform spatial analysis and create high-quality maps of ecological features such as habitats, protected species locations, and designated sites. Provide clear visualisations to support environmental reports and decision-making.
* Data Management & Quality Assurance: Manage and interpret ecological data sets with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and right-first-time delivery. Adhere to high quality standards in data handling, documentation, and reporting.
* Team Collaboration: Work in a virtual team environment, engaging in technical discussions and knowledge-sharing sessions. Take ownership of your work and proactively communicate progress and findings. Contribute positively to team meetings and coordinate effectively with UK-based ecologists, planners, and other specialists.

**About You**

* Education & Skills: Completed Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant field with hands-on knowledge of ecological data analysis and technical report writing.
* Adaptability: Willingness to learn and adapt to UK-specific ecology standards, tools, and data sources, with training and mentoring provided as needed.
* Understanding: Clear and demonstrable understanding of ecological and biodiversity principles, and how they relate to environmental planning and impact assessment processes.
* Communication: Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, along with good written and spoken English for effective communication and report writing.
* Enthusiasm: A genuine passion for ecology and environment, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and professional development.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Education: Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant life science or environmental discipline from a recognised university, such as Zoology, Botany, Wildlife Biology, Ecology & Biodiversity, Environmental Science (ecology-focused), Forestry, or a related field.
* Graduation Year: Recent postgraduates who completed their M.Sc in 2025 or 2026 (fresh graduates or those with limited experience are welcome to apply).
* GIS Proficiency: Strong interest and hands-on experience with GIS tools (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar) applied to ecological or environmental data sets (through academic projects or coursework).
* Language: Good technical report writing skills and fluency in English.

**Desired Qualifications**

* UK Ecology Awareness: Awareness of or eagerness to learn about UK ecology and environmental regulations (e.g., protected species, Biodiversity Net Gain principles, habitat classifications, nature recovery initiatives) and relevant industry guidance (CIEEM, etc.).
* Data & Analysis: Experience with ecological data analysis methods or software (e.g., basic statistics in R/Python, species distribution or biodiversity data tools) is an advantage.
* Innovation & Tools: Interest in digital innovation and automation in ecological work (e.g., using scripting for data processing, advanced GIS analysis, or visualization techniques) to add value in project delivery.
* Professional Development: Enthusiasm for pursuing further certifications or training in ecology, environmental management, or related technical skills, demonstrating commitment to continuous improvement.

**Rewards & benefit**
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
  
  
**About AtkinsRéalis**
We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
  
  
Find out more.

title: Security Testing Engineer
description:
* 3+ years of experience in Application Security Testing, Vulnerability Assessment, and Security Validation.
* Strong hands-on experience with DAST tools such as Burp Suite Pro, HCL AppScan, Acunetix, Netsparker, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of Web, API, and Cloud Security concepts.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CVSS, CWE, and Secure SDLC practices.
* Experience in vulnerability reporting, risk analysis, remediation validation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of authentication protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, JWT, and MFA.
* Experience with Cloud Security (Azure/AWS/GCP) and container security assessments.
* Exposure to SAST, SCA/OSS Security Testing, API Security Testing, and Threat Modeling methodologies.

Key Responsibilities Automation Testing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java or C#.
* Develop and execute automated test scripts for Web, API, and Enterprise applications.
* Build reusable automation libraries and utilities.
* Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform regression, smoke, sanity, and functional testing using automated frameworks.
* Analyze test results and provide detailed defect reports.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to ensure quality deliverables.
* Participate in test planning, estimation, and test strategy discussions. Security Testing
* Perform comprehensive Security Testing and Assessment activities across applications, APIs, cloud environments, and supporting infrastructure.
* Execute Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Validation activities using industry-standard tools and methodologies.
* Conduct manual and automated security testing to identify vulnerabilities related to authentication, authorization, session management, encryption, access controls, and business logic flaws.
* Assess applications against industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CWE, NIST, and SANS.
* Identify, analyze, prioritize, and document security vulnerabilities with detailed risk ratings, business impact analysis, and remediation guidance.
* Perform false-positive analysis, vulnerability validation, and retesting to verify remediation effectiveness.
* Collaborate closely with Development, Architecture, QA, and DevSecOps teams to promote secure coding practices and integrate security into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Perform security reviews, threat assessments, and risk-based security evaluations for new and existing applications.
* Participate in vulnerability management activities including triage, tracking, risk acceptance reviews, and remediation validation.
* Prepare detailed security assessment reports and effectively communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Conduct false-positive analysis and provide remediation recommendations.
* Validate authentication, authorization, session management, encryption, and access control mechanisms.
* Support compliance initiatives and security governance requirements Preferred Skills
* Experience in IAM Security Testing (Saviynt, SailPoint, Access Governance testing).
* Exposure to Performance Testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Experience working in DevSecOps environments.
* Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Scripting knowledge in Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting.

title: Travel Operations & Visa Support Executive
description:
📍 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

🏢 Company: Just Travel

💼 Job Type: Full-time | Work from Office

🎯 Experience: 1–3 Years

💰 Salary: ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month (Based on Experience)

**About the Role**

Passionate about travel? Great at organising details and coordinating with people?

Just Travel is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Travel Operations & Visa Support Executive to join our growing team in Bengaluru.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating domestic and international travel arrangements, working with hotels and Destination Management Companies (DMCs), preparing customised itineraries, supporting visa documentation, and ensuring seamless travel experiences for our customers.

We are looking for someone who enjoys planning, problem-solving, and managing multiple travel-related activities with accuracy and professionalism.

**Key Responsibilities**

✈️ Travel Operations & Booking Coordination

Coordinate with hotels, airlines, transport providers, tour operators, and domestic/international DMCs.

Obtain supplier quotations, compare rates, and coordinate booking confirmations.

Prepare customised holiday packages, day-wise itineraries, and travel quotations.

Manage hotel bookings, airport transfers, sightseeing tours, and travel activities.

Verify package pricing, availability, inclusions, exclusions, and cancellation policies.

Prepare booking vouchers, travel confirmations, and final travel documents.

Work closely with the sales team to ensure accurate execution of customer travel requirements.

🛂
**Visa Documentation & Application Support**

Assist customers with tourist visa documentation for international destinations.

Prepare and share destination-specific visa document checklists.

Review passports, application forms, financial documents, and supporting paperwork for completeness.

Assist with visa application forms, appointment scheduling, and document preparation.

Coordinate with authorised visa application centres and relevant service providers.

Track visa application status and provide timely customer updates.

Stay informed about changing visa requirements and application procedures.

Visa approval and processing timelines are subject to the respective immigration authorities.

🤝
**Customer Support & Communication**

Respond to customer queries regarding travel bookings, itineraries, visas, and travel documentation.

Share booking confirmations, travel vouchers, and pre-departure information.

Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to resolve operational concerns.

Maintain professional communication through phone calls, email, and WhatsApp.

Ensure customer information and personal documents are handled confidentially.

🌍
**Supplier & DMC Coordination**

Build and maintain professional relationships with travel suppliers, hotels, and DMCs.

Request competitive B2B quotations for domestic and international packages.

Compare supplier pricing, services, availability, and payment conditions.

Follow up on pending confirmations, invoices, and supplier payment deadlines.

Maintain accurate supplier and booking records.

📊
**Documentation & Operations Reporting**

Maintain booking trackers, visa application records, and travel documentation.

Monitor upcoming departures, payment schedules, and pending confirmations.

Update operational records using MS Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM systems.

Prepare regular booking and operational status reports for management.

**Skills & Qualifications**

✅ 1–3 years of experience in travel operations, tour coordination, travel agencies, DMC operations, or visa documentation.

✅ Basic understanding of domestic and international holiday packages.

✅ Familiarity with hotel bookings, supplier coordination, itineraries, and travel quotations.

✅ Knowledge of tourist visa documentation procedures is an added advantage.

✅ Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

✅ Kannada and Hindi communication skills are an advantage.

✅ Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and WhatsApp Business.

✅ Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks.

✅ Ability to coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal teams efficiently.

✅ Graduate in any discipline. Travel & Tourism or Hospitality qualifications are preferred.

**What We Offer**

💰 Monthly Salary: ₹15,000–₹20,000, depending on experience and skills.

🌍 International Travel Exposure: Work with domestic and international destinations, DMCs, and travel suppliers.

📚 Training & Learning: Hands-on training in travel operations, visa documentation, and supplier coordination.

🤝 Collaborative Environment: Work with a growing travel company and supportive team.

📈 Career Growth: Opportunities to develop into senior travel operations and destination management roles.

**Who Should Apply?**

We welcome applications from candidates working as:

Travel Operations Executives

Visa Documentation Executives

Tour Operations Coordinators

Travel Consultants

Holiday Package Operations Executives

Travel Booking Executives

DMC Coordination Executives

Candidates with relevant customer coordination experience and a strong interest in the travel industry are also encouraged to apply.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply with their updated resume.

Please include:

Current Monthly Salary

Expected Monthly Salary

Notice Period / Earliest Joining Date

Relevant Travel Operations or Visa Documentation Experience

Join Just Travel and help us create seamless, reliable, and memorable travel experiences!

title: DevSecOps Architect
description:
**Job Role: DevSecOps Architect**

**Job Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune**

**Work Mode: (Hybrid)**

**Experience: 10+ Years**

**Job description:**

* 10 Years of experience
* Design and implement enterprise-wide DevSecOps architectures across cloud-native, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
* Architect secure CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or equivalent automation platforms.
* Integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy enforcement.
* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
* Develop automated deployment strategies including blue-green, canary, rolling, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Architect containerization and orchestration platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Build secure software supply chain frameworks, artifact repositories, image registries, and dependency management solutions.
* Design cloud-native security architectures across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud environments.
* Implement policy-as-code and governance frameworks using tools such as Azure Policy, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Gatekeeper, and HashiCorp Sentinel.
* Architect centralized logging, monitoring, observability, and incident response solutions using Azure Monitor, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vulnerability management programs and security remediation initiatives across applications, containers, cloud platforms, and infrastructure.
* Design identity and access management architectures leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, RBAC, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Implement secrets and certificate management solutions using Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud-native security services.
* Ensure CI/CD platforms adhere to enterprise security, compliance, and regulatory requirements including SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, NIST, and CIS benchmarks.
* Define and enforce DevSecOps governance standards, architecture patterns, security baselines, and operational best practices.
* Lead cloud migration, modernization, and platform engineering initiatives with a security-first approach.
* Conduct architecture reviews, threat modelling exercises, and security risk assessments for applications and infrastructure.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment automation, release quality, and developer experience.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to DevOps engineers, developers, security engineers, and platform teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, scalability, cost optimization, and security posture enhancement.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root cause analysis for critical incidents.
* Stay current with evolving DevSecOps technologies, security threats, cloud innovations, and industry best practices.

title: Arrive - Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform.
  
  
Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide.
  
  
Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable : from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space.
  
  
It is about more than function, it is about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone.
  
  
Travel is more than a journey; it is how you Arrive.
  
  
As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more liveable cities. It isn't a challenge just anyone could take on.
  
  
Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen : our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together.
  
  
Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travellers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best.
  
  
For our customers. For the cities and communities, we serve.
  
  
For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let's grow better together.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a lead data platform engineer to combine platform thinking and DevOps practices to improve how data is produced, managed, and consumed across Arrive.
  
  
In this role, you will lead through standards implementation and adoption, influencing the data platform's architecture and evolving our systems through code.
  
  
In this role, you will build platform capabilities that make data more reliable, discoverable, and self-serve for internal teams.
  
  
You will work on the infrastructure, tooling, and operational practices that help data users move faster with confidence.
  
  
You will help us drive further a global multi-region platform that supports 700 annual users on Snowflake, across 100+ teams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and manage Snowflake infrastructure using Terraform, including access control, resources management, features addition and cost optimization
* Improve the developer experience for data teams through self-service tooling and documentation-as-code
* Apply DevOps practices to data platforms, including CI/CD for dbt projects, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and reproducible environments
* Design, deploy, and optimize Airflow infrastructure to support reliable data workflows at scale
* Measure platform adoption, gather feedback from internal users, and continuously reduce friction
* Explore and apply AI-assisted workflows to improve data platform operations, developer productivity, documentation, and support for internal data users.

**Required Skills Experience**

* Have 9+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps, with a strong focus on reliable, scalable data platforms
* Have practical experience with tools and practices such as Terraform, dbt, Snowflake, and CI/CD, and care deeply about reproducibility, reliability, and team enablement

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience running platform services on Kubernetes
* Experience using Helm to manage deployments
* Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

**Why Join Arrive? :**

* Work on global-scale payment systems impacting millions of users.
* Be part of a growing India engineering team with strong ownership.
* Collaborate with diverse, international teams.
* Opportunity to influence architecture, strategy and team growth.
* Build technology that directly improves urban mobility and sustainability

description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking a skilled
**Identity & Access Management (IAM) Lead \_Lead Technology Specialist to**
join
**Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division**
The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Lead is responsible for leading the daily execution of Identity and Access Management operations while providing technical guidance and operational oversight to a team of IAM analysts and engineers. This role serves as a subject matter expert across identity governance, access administration, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle processes.
  
  
The IAM Lead works closely with the IAM Manager, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient delivery of IAM services. The position combines technical expertise, team leadership, process governance, and continuous improvement responsibilities to support enterprise cybersecurity objectives
  
  
The preference for this role is to be based out of
**Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore -KA**
****What You Will Do****
**IAM Operations & Service Delivery**
**Lead Day-to-day IAM Operational Activities Including:**

* User provisioning and deprovisioning
* Joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) processes
* Access requests and approvals
* Access certifications and periodic reviews
* Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Identity lifecycle management
* Authentication and authorization services

+ Monitor IAM service queues and ensure timely processing of requests in accordance with SLAs.
+ Manage escalation and resolution of IAM-related incidents and service issues.
+ Partner with application and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot access-related challenges.
+ Ensure compliance with established access management procedures and controls.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the technical lead and subject matter expert for IAM technologies, processes, and controls.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to IAM analysts and engineers.
* Review and validate complex access requests, role assignments, and privileged access activities.
* Support IAM platform administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting activities.
* Assist in evaluating and implementing IAM enhancements, upgrades, and new technologies.
* Drive standardization of IAM processes and operational procedures.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Support access governance activities including certification campaigns, segregation of duties reviews, and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and audit teams to address findings and remediation activities.
* Ensure execution of IAM controls in accordance with security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in maintaining IAM documentation, procedures, standards, and control evidence.
* Identify control gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen access governance.

**Continuous Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual IAM processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Support IAM modernization initiatives and strategic projects.
* Assist in developing workflows, role models, access governance processes, and reporting capabilities.
* Participate in defining IAM operational metrics, dashboards, and service performance indicators.
* Recommend process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a primary point of contact for IAM operational activities and escalations.
* Collaborate with business units, application owners, HR, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
* Communicate issues, risks, and operational status to IAM leadership.
* Support stakeholder education and adoption of IAM policies, standards, and best practices.

****Leadership Responsibilities****

* Provide day-to-day direction and work prioritization for IAM analysts and engineers.
* Assist the IAM Manager with workload planning and resource allocation.
* Support onboarding, training, and development of team members.
* Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and promote technical skill development.
* Act as a backup to the IAM Manager when required.

****What You Will Have****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Information Security.
* 6+ years of experience leading technical teams, projects, or IAM operational functions.

****Strong Understanding Of:****- Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
- User Lifecycle Management
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Access Certifications and Reviews
- Privileged Access Management (PAM)
- Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID
- Single Sign-On (SSO)
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
- Federation Services
- Directory Services and Authentication Technologies

* Experience supporting IAM operations in large enterprise environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
* Shift Timing:01:00-10:00PM IST

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Industry certifications such as Security+, SC-300, CISSP, CISM, CIAM, or other IAM-related certifications.

****Hands-on Experience With:****

* SailPoint
* Saviynt
* CyberArk
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Okta
* Ping Identity
* BeyondTrust or other PAM solutions
* Experience with IAM automation, workflow development, and integration technologies.
* Experience supporting audit and regulatory compliance initiatives.
* Experience working within Agile and product-oriented operating models.
* Experience supporting global enterprises and geographically distributed teams.

****Skills Desired:****
**Technical Excellence:**
Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions.
* Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues.
* Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions.
* Coaches others in promoting, defining, analyzing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems.
* Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs.

**Technology Advising:**
Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Collaborates with an extended professional technology network to help clients effectively identify, plan for and accomplish technology objectives.
* Supervises others in advising a range of clients across a myriad of products, technologies, services and solutions in a relevant technology domain.
* Identifies and evaluates emerging technologies and advises clients regarding their potential business impacts.
* Effectively consults with and conveys technology concepts, business impacts and other advice to senior client levels.
* Trains others in developing technology business, channel management and client coaching.
* Leverages formal certifications in mastery of multiple areas of technology in demonstrating credibility for client consulting.

**Emerging Technologies:**
Knowledge of emerging technologies; ability to design, apply and evaluate new information technologies for business environments.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Assists in comparing business performance before and after the implementation of new information technologies.
* Participates in the integration of new information technologies with an organization's existing system.
* Decides on short-term, daily business needs for the design of information technologies.
* Coordinates the design, application and evaluation process for new information technologies.
* Adheres to organizational policies related to information technology usage.

**Hardware Infrastructure:**
Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization.
  
  
**Level Expert:**

* Leads in the design of IT hardware to meet organizational needs.
* Develops policies and processes associated with the implementation of IT hardware.
* Leads in the integration of IT hardware for other platforms within the organization.
* Elaborates on key issues and solutions during the hardware design, implementation and integration process.
* Improves the functionality of an organization's IT hardware.
* Monitors new IT hardware technologies provided by vendors.

**Requirements Analysis:**
Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

**Systems Software Infrastructure:**
Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and implements software infrastructure and core technologies.
* Develops software architecture and data management policies and procedures.
* Resolves issues regarding the implementation of heterogeneous open systems.
* Evaluates the management of software configuration facilities and practices.
* Coaches on the essential elements of software architecture, platforms and products.
* Facilitates internal and external cooperative and distributed alignment and processing of systems software infrastructure.

**Technical Troubleshooting:**
Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
* Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
* Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments.
* Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
* Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems.
* Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.

**Technical Writing/Documentation:**
Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications.
  
  
**Level Expert:**

* Directs the design and production of a full spectrum of written technical materials.
* Provides insight into multiple documentation tools, techniques and delivery mechanisms.
* Plays a leadership role in supporting the analysis, design and development of a documentation solution.
* Leads the design and development of high-impact, wide-audience documentation systems.
* Predicts industry and marketplace trends regarding documentation tools and techniques.
* Monitors the effectiveness of existing tools and techniques and implements improvements.

****What You Will Get:****

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.
* Relocation assistance

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
* Career developments opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

****Additional Information:****
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Associate Deployment Engineer - Galaxy Graduate Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team**
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the
**Celonis Services**
organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:
  
  

* Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.
* Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.
* Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.
* Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.

We deliver production-ready
**Celonis Platform**
implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a
**Discover-and-Build**
approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.
  
  
In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy
**operational, AI-enriched solutions**
on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.
  
  
We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by
**state-of-the-art AI augmentation**
, allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the eyes and ears in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.
  
  
**The Role**
As an
**Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program**
, you will support the end-to-end Discover-and-Build journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a Business-Critical Mindset and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers.
  
  
**The Work You’ll Do**
  
  

* Support Strategic Implementations: Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.
* Execute Discover-and-Build: As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.
* AI-Forward Solutioning: Leverage your technical background to build and deploy AI-forward solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.
* Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring Built-in Quality Control in every line of code or analysis produced.
* Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to:

+ Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs
+ Business Apps & Product and Engineering
+ Solution Architecture & Celonis Support

**The Qualifications You Need**

* Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Technical Foundation: Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.
* Business-Critical Mindset: A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.
* Consulting DNA: You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.
* Analytical Rigor: The ability to not only focus on What is the data saying? and also to recommend What should the business do, based on the findings?
* Communication: Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.
* You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
**Demand Generation Manager**

**About Wisemonk**

Wisemonk is an India-focused Employer of Record and global hiring platform. We help companies, mostly headquartered in the US, hire, pay and manage talent in India without setting up an entity. We work with 300+ global companies, are bootstrapped and profitable, and are building AI-native products across recruiting, HR and payments.

Today, almost all of our new business comes from inbound search. That works, but it brings us small, founder-led deals. We now want to reach larger US companies building teams of 10 to 50 people in India. That needs a demand engine we do not have yet. You will build it.

**The role**

You will own the number of qualified meetings our sales team takes with US buyers. You will decide where they come from, build the programs that produce them, and report on them every week. This is an individual contributor role. You will work directly with the founder and the sales team, and you will do the work yourself.

**What you will own**

- Outbound and account-based programs: define target accounts (US companies hiring in India, recently funded, scaling headcount, or using a competitor), build lists and signals, and run multi-touch campaigns across email, LinkedIn and calls with sales.

- Partnerships and referrals: build a repeatable referral channel with US startup law firms, VCs and accelerators, accounting and incorporation advisors, and B2B marketplaces. Turn one-off introductions into a steady source of meetings.

- Events and webinars: plan and run US-facing webinars, co-hosted sessions with partners, and targeted event presence. Measured on meetings, not attendance.

- Measurement: own the funnel from target account to qualified meeting. Track source, conversion and cost per meeting in the CRM, and cut what does not work.

- Messaging with sales and product marketing: sharpen the story for HR, finance and founder buyers at US mid-market companies.

**What we are looking for**

- 5 to 8 years in demand generation or growth marketing at a SaaS or AI-native company selling to US buyers.

- A record of generating pipeline you can show in numbers: meetings, pipeline value, conversion rates, and what you personally built to get there.

- Hands-on experience running outbound or ABM programs, not only managing agencies or tools.

- Comfort with data. You can build a target list, run your own reports, and explain why a channel is or is not working.

- Strong written English. Your emails and landing pages are read by US HR leaders and founders.

- Experience with B2B services, HR tech, payroll or EOR is a plus, not a requirement.

- You use AI tools in your daily work to research, write and run campaigns faster.

**What this role is not**

- Not a brand or content role. Content and SEO have their own team.

- Not a paid-ads-only role.

- Not a team-management role from day one. If the engine works, the team grows around it.

**Work setup**

Full-time, in office at our Bengaluru office in Seshadripuram. Some calls will be in US hours.

title: Technical Lead – Mechanical Prototyping
company: Centre of Excellence in Design, DM, IISc
description:
Hiring: Technical Lead – Mechanical Prototyping

**Location:**
IISc Campus, Bangalore, Karnataka, India

**Organization:**
Centre of Excellence in Design (D-CoE), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore

**Reporting To:**
CEO, D-CoE

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time Contract (1-year initial, renewable annually up to 5 Years)

**Compensation:**
INR 70,000 to INR 1,20,000 / month (consolidated, based on experience & performance)

**About D-CoE @ IISc Bangalore**

The
**Centre of Excellence in Design (D-CoE)**
at the
**Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore**
—established in association with the
**Government of Karnataka (IT/BT Department)**
—is dedicated to driving world-class innovation, design thinking, and entrepreneurship. Operating at the vibrant intersection of academia, government, and deep-tech startup ecosystems, D-CoE provides state-of-the-art digital fabrication and prototyping facilities. We run immersive, practical training programmes designed to empower students, researchers, founders, and industry professionals to translate bold concepts into market-ready products.

**The Role at a Glance**

Are you someone who can run an energetic CAD and 3D printing workshop in the morning, debug a startup’s failing mechanical prototype at noon, guide a student team through their third design iteration by afternoon, and sketch out a smart fixture by evening—and enjoy every single minute of it?

**We are seeking a Technical Lead - Mechanical Prototyping**
to lead hands-on training, manage rapid prototyping activities, and mentor innovators at D-CoE. You will bridge classical mechanical engineering with modern digital fabrication, smart manufacturing, and AI-enabled design workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Teaching, Training & Curriculum Design**

* Design and deliver structured, project-based workshops on mechanical prototyping, CAD modelling, and hardware product development.
* Guide learners through the complete product development lifecycle: concept creation, 3D modelling, fabrication, assembly, testing, and rapid iteration.
* Create practical learning modules, exercises, lab demonstrations, and assessments across in-person, hybrid, and online formats.
* Update training content continuously to align with evolving digital manufacturing standards and industry trends.

**2. Mechanical Prototyping & Digital Fabrication**

* Lead hands-on sessions covering 3D printing (additive manufacturing), CAD design modification, rapid fabrication, and prototype validation.
* Provide expert guidance on Design for Manufacturability & Assembly (DFMA), material selection, tolerances, and assembly techniques.
* Oversee the safe and efficient operation of D-CoE’s prototyping lab equipment.
* Solve complex mechanical challenges, integrating mechanical hardware with sensors, electronics, microcontrollers, and IoT modules when needed.

**3. Startup & Student Project Mentorship**

* Supervise student teams, interns, and startup founders building physical hardware products and proofs-of-concept (PoCs).
* Define technical scope, project milestones, testing protocols, and final deliverable criteria.
* Evaluate prototype performance, technical documentation, and final project demonstrations.
* Foster a rigorous, iterative engineering problem-solving environment.

**4. Emerging Technologies & AI Integration**

* Introduce AI and Generative AI design tools into mechanical engineering, CAD modeling, and product design workflows.
* Support interdisciplinary smart manufacturing and automation projects involving IoT, sensor integration, and smart hardware.
* Stay ahead of technological advancements in generative engineering, automation, and digital manufacturing.

**5. Lab Operations & Industry Outreach**

* Manage equipment, tools, raw materials, and consumables for smooth prototyping lab operations.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, equipment usage logs, and project records.
* Engage with startups, corporate partners, and academic institutions to understand evolving prototyping requirements.
* Conduct facility demonstrations, awareness sessions, and outreach workshops to strengthen the regional innovation ecosystem.

**Eligibility Criteria & Skill RequirementsQualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Design, or Mechatronics.
* **Experience:**
  3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in mechanical prototyping, product development, digital fabrication, or CAD engineering.
* **Age Limit:**
  Upper age limit of 45 years (relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PH as per government norms).

**Technical Skills & Tools**

* **Core:**
  Mechanical Product Development, CAD Modelling, Rapid Prototyping, DFMA, Material Selection, Prototype Validation.
* **Fabrication:**
  3D Printing / Additive Manufacturing, Mechanical Assembly, Machining, Laser Cutting, 3D Scanning (desirable).
* **Emerging Tech:**
  Exposure to Sensors, IoT, Embedded Systems, Automation, and AI/Generative AI design tools (highly valued).

**Professional & Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong facilitation, teaching, and presentation abilities.
* **Ability to break down complex technical engineering concepts for diverse audiences.**
* **Mentorship-driven mindset with strong project management skills.**
* **High ownership, proactive problem-solving attitude, and adaptability in a fast-paced lab environment.**

**What We Offer**

* **Prestige:**
  Direct association with the
  **Indian Institute of Science (IISc)**
  , India’s top research institution.
* **Ecosystem Access:**
  A front-row seat to Karnataka’s vibrant startup, deep-tech, and innovation ecosystem.
* **World-Class Infrastructure:**
  Access to cutting-edge digital fabrication labs and state-of-the-art design studios.
* **Impact & Networking:**
  High autonomy to shape curriculum, mentor top talent, and interact with academic leaders, founders, and government stakeholders.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should send their application package to
**dcoe@fsid-iisc.in**
and
**hr.dcoe@fsid-iisc.in**
with the subject line:

**Application | Technical Lead - Mechanical Prototyping | D-COE IISc**

**Application Package Requirements:**

1. Updated Resume / CV
2. Cover Letter (max 300 words) highlighting why this role excites you and key career achievements
3. LinkedIn Profile Link

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial screening call, followed by a practical task-based assessment and leadership interview.

**D-CoE @ IISc is an equal opportunity employer. Applications from women and diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged.**

title: SOC Analyst — Security Operations
description:
**Essential Job Duties**

* Alert Monitoring & Initial Triage
* Monitor the security alert queue continuously across shift, ensuring no alerts are missed, delayed, or left without an initial disposition.
* Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: review alert context, classify by type and potential severity, and determine whether the alert warrants escalation or closure as a false positive.
* Apply documented playbooks and runbooks to guide triage decisions; escalate promptly to L2 when an alert exceeds L1 scope or confidence threshold.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation of all triage actions: alert details, initial findings, disposition rationale, and escalation notes.
* Support shift handoff quality by ensuring all open items are clearly documented and communicated to the incoming analyst.
* ReliaQuest GreyMatter
* Use GreyMatter as the primary platform for alert review, case management, and initial investigation workflows.
* Navigate GreyMatter case queues, apply filters, and use built-in enrichment and AI-assisted features to support triage decisions — always validating outputs before acting.
* Document findings, disposition notes, and escalation rationale within GreyMatter case records in accordance with SOC documentation standards.
* Develop proficiency with GreyMatter investigation workflows through structured on-the-job learning and guidance from L2 analysts and the SOC Manager.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Review MDE alerts surfaced through GreyMatter or the MDE portal; understand alert categories, severity levels, and associated device context.
* Perform basic endpoint investigation tasks: review device timelines for obvious indicators, check process trees, and identify key artifacts to include in escalation notes.
* Understand and apply MDE alert triage criteria to support accurate initial severity classification.
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Review Sentinel incidents and alerts as part of the monitoring queue; understand alert sources and the log types that feed detections.
* Run basic KQL queries using provided templates to retrieve log evidence and support initial triage findings.
* Develop foundational KQL proficiency over time, progressing toward independent query construction for common triage scenarios.
* SSE/SWG Platforms — Zscaler & Netskope
* Develop working familiarity with Zscaler and Netskope alert types, log sources, and basic policy constructs.
* Review web security alerts and support L2 analysts with initial context gathering for Zscaler and Netskope-related investigations.
* Follow documented workflows for reporting and escalating SSE/SWG events that exceed L1 triage capability.
* ServiceNow Ticket Handling
* Manage ServiceNow tickets assigned to the InfoSec/SOC queue: acknowledge, classify, document, and escalate or resolve within SLA.
* Handle routine, low-complexity security tickets: user-reported suspicious emails, access queries, and basic security tool questions — following documented resolution procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records: classification, evidence summary, actions taken, and resolution notes aligned to SOC documentation standards.
* Flag repeat patterns or unresolved issues for L2 review and knowledge article creation.
* Email Security
* Perform initial triage of user-reported phishing and suspicious email submissions using Mimecast and/or Abnormal.ai.
* Apply documented phishing triage criteria: assess sender, links, attachments, and headers; classify and escalate confirmed or suspected malicious emails to L2.
* Support quarantine and release workflows under L2 direction; document findings and outcomes in the relevant ticket or case record.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1+ years of experience in a SOC, IT operations, helpdesk, or security monitoring role.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common ports and protocols.
* Familiarity with Windows operating system concepts: processes, services, event logs, and common file system paths.
* Awareness of common attack types and indicators: phishing, malware, credential abuse, and suspicious scripting.
* Ability to follow structured procedures, playbooks, and escalation paths with precision and consistency.
* ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tool experience: ticket creation, classification, and documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and clear written communication for ticket notes, case documentation, and shift handoffs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior exposure to a SIEM platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar) for alert review or basic log analysis.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR tooling.
* Exposure to phishing analysis and email security tools (Mimecast, Abnormal.ai, or similar).
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework at a foundational level.
* Experience working in a 24×7 shift environment.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* CompTIA Security+ — preferred or actively pursuing.
* Microsoft SC-900 (Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) — a plus.
* CompTIA CySA+ or equivalent — desirable as a development target.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* SLA compliance and accurate, complete documentation for all assigned ServiceNow tickets.
* Alert triage accuracy: low false-positive closure rate and appropriate, timely escalations to L2.
* Shift handoff quality: all open items documented and communicated clearly with no gaps.
* Demonstrated progression in GreyMatter proficiency and foundational tool knowledge over the first 90 days.
* Positive contribution to team knowledge through flagging repeat patterns and supporting runbook updates.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* 24×7 rotational shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* On-call support may be required for high-severity incidents.
* Role demands sustained alertness, consistent process adherence, and composed, methodical work under pressure.

title: Prenatal yoga instructor
description:
**Company Description**
Begin9 is a wellness-focused organization dedicated to supporting individuals and families through all stages of life, with a particular focus on prenatal and postnatal well-being. The company combines evidence-informed practices with traditional wellness approaches to create safe, inclusive, and accessible programs. Begin9 emphasizes personalized care, mindful movement, and community support to help clients navigate pregnancy with confidence. Team members collaborate across disciplines to offer holistic services that prioritize physical, emotional, and mental health. The work environment values respect, continuous learning, and a compassionate approach to client care.

**Role Description**
The Prenatal Yoga Instructor at Begin9 will lead safe, supportive, and inclusive prenatal yoga classes for clients at various stages of pregnancy. This full-time hybrid role is based in Bengaluru, with a combination of in-studio sessions and some work-from-home responsibilities such as class planning, virtual sessions, and client follow-ups. Day-to-day tasks include designing class sequences tailored to prenatal needs, demonstrating and cueing poses, guiding breathwork and relaxation techniques, and modifying practices for different levels and health conditions. The instructor will educate clients on safe movement during pregnancy, maintain accurate class records, and collaborate with other wellness professionals to support integrated care. Additional responsibilities include communicating with clients about schedules and progress, participating in team meetings and trainings, and upholding Begin9’s safety and quality standards.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Yoga Instruction skills, with the ability to tailor practices specifically for prenatal clients.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in styles such as Ashtanga and Vinyasa, and the ability to adapt these methods to safe prenatal sequences.
* Candidates should possess solid Teaching skills, including clear demonstration, structured class planning, and inclusive guidance for diverse participants.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to explain modifications, provide reassurance, and maintain professional interactions with clients and team members.
* Relevant certifications in yoga instruction, preferably with specialized prenatal yoga training or equivalent experience.
* Understanding of basic prenatal anatomy, common pregnancy-related conditions, and safety guidelines for physical activity during pregnancy.
* Ability to create a calm, respectful, and non-judgmental environment for clients of varied backgrounds and body types.
* Experience delivering both in-person and online classes, with comfort using common virtual meeting platforms and digital tools.
* Strong time management, reliability, and willingness to work a flexible schedule aligned with client needs.
* Prior experience in a wellness, fitness, or healthcare-adjacent setting is beneficial.

title: ServiceNow Administrator & Platform Analyst
description:
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Administrator & Platform Analyst to manage, maintain, and enhance the ServiceNow platform. This role is primarily focused on platform administration, governance, user support, system configuration, and operational excellence, with limited development responsibilities to support workflow automation, integrations, and minor customizations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong experience administering ServiceNow ITSM modules, managing platform upgrades, user access, CMDB, knowledge management, and service catalog administration while possessing sufficient development skills to perform scripting, workflow customization, and integrations when required.
  
  
This role requires close coordination with various business, Corporate IT, and other multiple teams within the organization.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
Primary Responsibilities
  
  

* Administer and maintain the ServiceNow platform across production and non-production environments.
* Manage users, groups, roles, ACLs, and security configurations.
* Configure and maintain Service Catalogs, Knowledge Base, Service Portals, and Employee Center.
* Monitor system health, platform performance, and instance utilization.
* Perform routine maintenance, housekeeping, and platform optimization.
* Manage update sets, cloning activities, and release deployments.
* Administer Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, and Asset Management modules.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL best practices.
* Configure forms, notifications, approvals, SLAs, and assignment rules.
* Support service owners in process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Review and optimize workflows for operational efficiency.
* Maintain CMDB structure, data quality, and governance.
* Coordinate discovery and data reconciliation activities.
* Support Asset Management lifecycle processes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure teams to improve asset visibility and data accuracy.
* Enforce platform standards, naming conventions, and governance practices.
* Ensure compliance with internal IT policies and audit requirements.
* Maintain documentation of configurations, customizations, and processes.
* Participate in platform roadmap planning and governance reviews.

Secondary Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop solutions using ServiceNow platform capabilities such as Catalog Items, Workflows, UI Policies, Business Rules, Script Includes, and Integration Hub.
* Customize and enhance modules like Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Asset, and CMDB.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts, scheduled jobs, and custom applications to meet business requirements.
* Configure Business Rules, UI Policies, Client Scripts, Notifications, and Catalog Items.
* Develop and maintain workflows and Flow Designer solutions.
* Create and support Service Catalog automation.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate them into actionable solutions.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 8-10 year of proven experience in both ServiceNow development and administration.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Glide API, and ServiceNow scripting concepts.
* Experience in implementing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs.Familiarity with ITIL processes and their implementation in ServiceNow.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues across the platform and recommend best practices.
* Good understanding of data models, ACLs, roles, and ServiceNow security layers.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Good analytical skills and exposure to ERP systems
* Team Management
* Vendor management

Currency: INR
  
  
Salary Minimum: Market

title: Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking a skilled Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with expertise in Cloud Hosting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to design, secure and automate our cloud platforms as well as supporting our developer community. The role is critical in reducing time to deploy while providing secure boundaries and guardrails for AtkinsRealis developers in Azure and other cloud deployments
  
  
The role involves working with service owners to deploy solutions in a global Hub and Spoke Azure environment deployed under Microsoft's Cloud Architecture Framework using Enterprise Scale Architecture which has been deployed via Infrastructure as Code.
  
  
Your role
  
  

* Hybrid Cloud
* Understand of Azure IaaS, including but not limited to.
* Understanding of hosting virtual machines on the Azure platform, including deployment, connectivity, patching, monitoring and images.
* Understanding of networking on the Azure platform including Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, Network Security Groups and connectivity via S2S VPNs and ExpressRoute.
* Understanding of Storage service on the Azure platform including Blob, File, Recovery Vaults and Site recovery.
* Experience of IaaS in another global Hyperscaler (AWS, OCI, GCP) in addition to Microsoft Azure.
* Define and maintain reference architectures for Cloud and Hybrid environments, platform standards and user guides.
* Improve observability, detection and alerting using built in services to the cloud platform.
* Enforce governance using Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging standards.
* Experience of on-premises infrastructure technologies, servers, storage and networking.
* Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives (on premises to Cloud, hybrid models).
* Infrastructure as Code/DevSecOps
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code, why it's'used and common deployment techniques.
* Using Azure DevOps to deploy and update Cloud services via Infrastructure as Code.
* Create new Azure DevOps pipelines and troubleshoot when pipelines fail.
* Mentor and upskill team members in the use of Azure DevOps and Infrastructure as Code.
* Promote automation first, least privilege, and zero trust principles across cloud operations.
* Work closely with security team and application teams to remediate support incidents.
* Provide guidance on best practices including optimizing environments for cost, performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Continuously improve processes, automation, delivery and reporting capabilities.
* Contribute to platform roadmaps, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor and mentor to infrastructure and application teams.
* Ensure environments meet internal security standards and regulatory obligations.

**About You**

* 5+ years of experience in Azure infrastructure, with at least 2 years involved with Infrastructure as code.
* Demonstrated experience with Cloud Architecture Framework/Azure Enterprise Scale/Landing zones.
* 2+ years of Azure DevOps experience, working with versioning, code control and deployment pipelines.
* Proficiency with PowerShell Azure Cmdlets and/or Azure CLI.
* Experience of on-premises technologies, virtual machines, storage solutions
* Experience of Microsoft Server Operating Systems (2019+)
* Experience of other Global HyperScalers in addition to Microsoft Azure
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Microsoft Azure certifications: Azure Fundamentals
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with ITIL, security frameworks, or enterprise service delivery models.
* Microsoft Azure Bicep/AWS CloudFormation deployments
* Cloud based Virtual WAN knowledge beneficial
* Cloud Application Gateway and Web Application Firewall including OWASP rules
* Experience of PaaS solutions in addition to IaaS
* Experience of working in a Macro/Micro segmentation environment
* Relevant certifications or suitable demonstrable experience is highly desirable.
* Experience of Linux operating systems (Redhat, Oracle)
* Experience of High-Performance Computing
* Cloud based qualifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience of Azure Power Platform and integration with Azure Hosting
* Experience to container platforms

Rewards & benefits
  
  
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
  
  
**This Includes**

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

The team fosters continuous learning and knowledge sharing to deliver high customer satisfaction. This hire will resolve customer service requests (CSRs), troubleshoot complex virtualized infrastructure and container issues, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and maintain high network availability.
  
  
**What you will do:**
To investigate, troubleshoot, deliver remedy & restorations, and produce solutions to customer support tickets, CSRs (Customer Service Requests).
  
  
To work within well-defined system support guidelines.
  
  
To participate in software upgrades and updates.
  
  
Should be able to use support tools for ticket handling.
  
  
To ensure customer satisfaction with the performance of installed systems by successfully handling all reported technical problems.
  
  
Provide regular progress updates in the support system for each assigned support issue.
  
  
Through contact with external customers and internal support functions, gather data and information about any specific problem that has been reported.
  
  
Actively engage in communication with other engineers for the purpose of knowledge sharing etc.
  
  
Escalation of support tickets to next level of competence units if the CSR cannot be answered/solved within the time limit.
  
  
Evaluation of answers and solutions received from higher competence units to verify that the answer/solution will clear the problem reported by the customer.
  
  
In the line of supporting our products, identify possible improvements that make them more maintainable and user-friendly. Document these as Requirement Specifications as input to the design of new generations of the products.
  
  
Registration of new known solutions and updating of existing known solutions based on answers/solutions developed within own line organization or received from elsewhere.
  
  
Providing suggestions in developing Operation & Maintenance instructions.
  
  
Isolate product faults and raise them to Product Design. Support design unit to reproduce the fault and evaluate the final fix provided.
  
  
May need to work in shifts and Emergency Support rota.
  
  
To lead and execute the implementation of new software releases on test labs.
  
  
Writing documents for fault analysis/RCA along with required preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Strong analytical skills.
  
  
24×7 availability as per support guidelines.
  
  
**The skills you bring :**
Relevant experience of 2-8 years .
  
  
Deep knowledge of Linux (SUSE/SLES, Red Hat/RHEL or Ubuntu) including extensive hands-on administration and troubleshooting (systemd, journald, networking, storage, performance).
  
  
Virtualization technologies (KVM/QEMU, libvirt).
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash/Shell).
  
  
OpenStack knowledge and hands-on experience, OpenStack distribution (core services: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Heat).
  
  
Understanding of NFV/NFVI architecture and ETSI MANO concepts; VNF/CNF onboarding and VIM integration (e.g. with orchestrators such as EVNFM).
  
  
High-availability clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing and virtual IP management (HAProxy, keepalived/VRRP).
  
  
Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting (control plane, kubelet, scheduling, RBAC, workloads) with hands-on operational experience.
  
  
Container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and image/registry handling.
  
  
Cluster lifecycle management on bare metal using Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3, and cluster lifecycle tooling (e.g. ccdadm).
  
  
etcd operation, backup/restore and recovery fundamentals.
  
  
Kubernetes networking (Calico/CNI, Multus, kube-proxy) and policy enforcement (e.g. Kyverno).
  
  
Solid IP networking fundamentals (L2/L3, routing, VLANs, static routes, MTU, TLS/PKI troubleshooting).
  
  
Virtual machine and container internetworking concepts.
  
  
Open vSwitch (OVS) and OVS-DPDK.
  
  
SR-IOV functionality and DPDK-based high-performance networking.
  
  
Host network configuration tooling (NetworkManager/nmstate).
  
  
CEE: software-defined and cloud storage – OpenStack Cinder, Ceph, Nexenta, Dell Powerflex.
  
  
ECCD: Ceph and NetApp (CNIS deployments); ScaleIO/PowerFlex and Nexenta (NFVI-based deployments).
  
  
General block/object/file storage concepts.
  
  
Configuration management and automation (Ansible).
  
  
Orchestration templating (Heat/TOSCA).
  
  
Monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana; log aggregation such as Fluentd/Fluent Bit).
