title: Senior Voice Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Purpose
  
The Senior Voice Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the reliable day-to-day operation, support and administration of enterprise voice, unified communications, contact centre and call-recording services. Based at MGN Bengaluru, the role provides timely support to onsite and remote-working users and contact centre agents, maintains platform availability and capacity, ensures complete call-recording compliance, and works closely with the Group Voice Team to resolve incidents and deliver controlled changes.
  
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
  
Operational Support: Provide L2/L3 support for voice-related issues affecting office users, remote-working users and contact centre agents. Perform advanced remote and onsite troubleshooting across IP telephony, softphones, endpoints, gateways, trunks, voicemail, conferencing and recording services. Own assigned tickets through diagnosis, restoration, user validation and closure within agreed service levels.
  
Monitoring, Health and Capacity: Complete documented daily, weekly and monthly health checks for voice, contact centre and recording platforms. Monitor service availability, alarms, trunk/channel usage, licences, storage, system capacity, endpoint status and resilience. Publish accurate health and capacity reports, highlight risks and exceptions, and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
  
Call-Recording Compliance: Maintain 100% adherence to applicable call-recording requirements for in-scope contact centre agents and regulated voice services. Conduct scheduled recording validation, identify recording gaps promptly, coordinate remediation and maintain clear evidence for audit and compliance reviews. Escalate any recording failure or coverage risk immediately.
  
Incident and Problem Management: Participate actively in major incident, incident and problem-management processes. Troubleshoot service degradation and outages, provide timely technical updates, restore service with urgency, perform root-cause analysis and track permanent corrective actions to closure.
  
Change and Release Management: Raise, assess, plan, test, implement and validate voice-related changes in accordance with the approved change-management process. Prepare implementation, risk, rollback and validation plans; support maintenance activities; and ensure post-change monitoring and documentation.
  
Collaboration and Escalation: Work closely with the Group Voice Team, contact centre operations, Service Desk, infrastructure and security teams, telecom carriers and technology vendors. Provide local coordination at MGN Bengaluru, manage technical escalations and support regional or group initiatives.
  
Administration and Documentation: Administer user extensions, contact centre profiles, features, routing, licences and approved configuration changes. Maintain current architecture diagrams, configuration records, support procedures, inventory, vendor details, knowledge articles and shift handover records.
  
Continuous Improvement and Project Support: Analyse recurring issues and operational trends, recommend reliability and efficiency improvements, and support voice-platform upgrades, migrations, office initiatives, disaster-recovery tests and technology refresh programmes.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
Essential
  
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  
  
- Typically 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise voice, unified communications or contact centre infrastructure in a large, business-critical environment.
  
  
- Strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Avaya and/or Cisco voice and contact centre technologies.
  
  
- Practical experience supporting call-recording platforms and executing recording-compliance validation.
  
  
- Sound understanding of SIP, H.323, MGCP, RTP, QoS, ISDN, analogue signalling, dial plans, gateways, trunks and voice-routing concepts.
  
  
- Experience with incident, problem and change management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
  
  
- Ability to interpret monitoring data, analyse capacity and service trends, perform root-cause analysis and produce clear operational reports.
  
  
- Excellent written and spoken English, customer orientation, structured troubleshooting and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
- Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, geographically distributed team and provide rostered on-call or out-of-hours support when required.
  
  
  
Preferred
  
- Relevant Avaya, Cisco Collaboration or contact centre certification.
  
  
- ITIL Foundation certification.
  
  
- Experience in banking, financial services or another regulated environment.
  
  
- Experience with high-availability design, disaster recovery, carrier services and vendor management.

title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
  
  
As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.
* Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.
* Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.
* Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.
* Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.
* Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through pairing sessions and stable counterpart relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.
* Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.
* Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.
* Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.
* Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.

**About The Team**
The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s Transparency value, you can see what we are working on in our Support Team page. Additionally, you can see our company roadmap and meetings to see what we are working on at any time.

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: User Researcher
description:
**Role Purpose**
At Quest Alliance, we are advancing the future of learning through digital platforms, blended learning solutions, and innovations rooted in the everyday realities of learners and educators. We are seeking a Product User Researcher to own and lead our user research practice end-to-end.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who thrives at the intersection of research, strategy, and product thinking—a professional who can uncover deep user insights, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure those insights directly shape Quest’s digital learning products, including the MyQuest platform (Learner & Educator), AskAbhi, and blended learning solutions.
  
  
As a Product User Researcher, you will champion the voice of learners and educators, driving research-led decision-making to influence product design, roadmaps, and long-term strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end product user research strategy across Quest’s learning platforms.
* Design and implement structured research plans including objectives, participant recruitment, methods, and timelines.
* Establish and evolve research frameworks, methodologies, and processes aligned with product goals.
* Map user journeys (learners, educators, program teams) to identify experience gaps and opportunities.
* Conduct usability studies, interviews, and surveys to generate actionable insights.
* Translate findings into product strategies that directly inform roadmaps, design priorities, and feature enhancements.
* Ensure research outcomes move beyond reports and drive tangible product improvements.
* Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and program teams to embed user-centered decision-making across the product lifecycle.
* Facilitate co-creation workshops and cross-functional sessions to integrate user insights into product solutions.
* Represent product user research in leadership discussions, contributing to platform strategy and vision.
* Foster a culture of user-centricity by inspiring and mentoring cross-functional teams in research practices.
* Develop and maintain research deliverables such as personas, journey maps, insights reports, and experience strategy decks.
* Create toolkits, templates, and best practices to standardize research across teams.
* Build dashboards to track the impact of user research on adoption, product improvements, and learner outcomes.
* Stay updated on user research methods, product innovations, and learning technology trends to keep Quest’s platforms future-ready.

**Required Attributes**
We are looking for someone who is not just skilled, but also deeply passionate about putting the user at the center of product design and development. If you’re curious, driven, and eager to make an impact in the learning and EdTech space, this role is for you.
  
  

* Expert in product user research with a strong command of both qualitative and quantitative methodologies.
* Insight translator – able to turn complex user research into clear, actionable insights that shape product strategy and design.
* Impact creator with a proven track record of influencing product roadmaps and design priorities through user research.
* Dynamic facilitator who can lead engaging workshops and co-creation sessions, inspiring collaboration across teams.
* Compelling storyteller who brings the voices of learners and educators to life and ensures they’re heard in every product conversation.
* Strategic yet hands-on – able to balance big-picture thinking with detailed execution.
* Curious and adaptive , with an openness to explore new methods, tools, and ideas in the ever-evolving UX/product space.
* Collaborative partner who can build trust and influence across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Organized knowledge-sharer , with strong documentation skills and the ability to build reusable research assets.
* User-first mindset , constantly seeking to uncover needs, motivations, and pain points to shape better experiences.

**Required Experiences & Skills**

* Experience: 2–4 years of relevant experience in product or user research.
* Background: Degree in Design, Social Sciences, or specializations/courses in UX Research or Product/UX Design preferred.

**Salary**
The pay band for the position starts at Rs. 66,000 /- per month (cost to company) ( The salary offered will be commensurate with the experience and expertise of the candidate)
  
  
**Benefits**
At Quest Alliance, we believe that our investment in people extends well beyond compensation. Alongside your salary, the organisation continues to invest in your wellbeing, learning, and long-term growth through a range of benefits, including :
  
  

* Comprehensive Personal Accident Insurance covering up to ₹10,00,000 annually.
* Mediclaim Insurance covers up to ₹3,00,000 annually through our insurance partner, Anand Rathi, together with additional wellness benefits.
* Reach for the Stars (RFS) support of up to ₹5,000 each year to encourage your self-learning and professional development.
* Internet reimbursement of up to ₹750 per month, based on actual usage, to support our flexible and hybrid ways of working.
* Childcare support of up to ₹3,000 per month for employees with children below six years of age, through a matching contribution towards childcare or daycare expenses.
* Access to Quest Alliance's emotional health and wellbeing programmes, including:
* Group sessions valued at approximately ₹8,000 per session, fully sponsored by the organisation.
* One-to-one counselling sessions, valued at approximately ₹2,000 per session, fully sponsored by the organisation.
* Gratuity Allowance, reflecting Quest Alliance's long-term commitment to your financial security and social security. This amount is specifically earmarked by the organisation and becomes payable upon retirement or separation in accordance with applicable laws.

**To Apply**
Interested candidates are requested to apply for the role by filling up the application form via the ATS (Zoho Recruit) platform:
  
  
APPLY NOW
  
  
\_\_\_
  
  
**About Quest Alliance**
Quest Alliance prepares young learners in India with the skills, mindsets, and support systems they need to thrive in life, learning, and work.
  
  
A social impact organization with close to two decades of experience, Quest Alliance works at the intersection of technology and future skills to make learning more equitable and relevant, especially for socially and economically vulnerable learners.
  
  
The organization influences systems to empower young learners in government high schools and trade and vocational institutes to holistically navigate their education to career transitions.
  
  
Quest Alliance works across 12 Indian states and is partnered with nine state governments, over 80 CSOs, national ministries, and funders. It has impacted 1.8 million young lives to date.

title: Senior Product Analyst - Periscope
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will be responsible for shaping and driving product plans, ensuring alignment with business strategy, user needs, and market trends.
  
  
You will define and execute comprehensive product strategies that align with client goals across brands, markets, and products, while continually improving existing offerings. Leveraging insights from customer and competitor research, you will prioritize and guide the development of innovative solutions, translating business needs into functional requirements. Your work will involve close collaboration with technology, support, and client service teams to manage product updates and deployments, as well as defining and tracking KPIs to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. Additionally, you will lead workshops and training sessions to showcase product features, ensuring both internal teams and customer users are equipped to maximize value.
  
  
You will play a pivotal part in steering cross-functional teams, including product owners and engineering delivery teams, to design and deliver impactful solutions that address business challenges. You will build and maintain key relationships across the organization to deliver prioritized product roadmaps and partner with marketing, sales, and partner organizations to develop effective go-to-market strategies. Accountability for the growth and success of the products will be central to your responsibilities, as will fostering innovation and creativity.
  
  
Based in McKinsey’s Periscope team in Gurgaon or Bangalore, India, you will contribute to the technology backbone of McKinsey’s Growth, Marketing & Sales Practice. Periscope combines world-class intellectual property, prescriptive analytics, and cloud-based tools to drive revenue growth and sustain commercial transformation for businesses globally.
  
  
The Growth, Marketing & Sales Practice strives to help clients in both consumer and business-to-business environments on a wide variety of marketing and sales topics. Our clients benefit from our experience in core areas of sales and marketing topics such as sales and channel management, branding, customer insights, marketing ROI, digital marketing, CLM, and pricing. Our practice offers an exceptional opportunity to work at the intersection of sales, marketing, and consulting. Focusing on issues like redefining sales and marketing operations and commercial transformation, our people help clients build capabilities and transform how companies go to market-moving them to customer-centric organizations.
  
  
Periscope leverages its world-leading IP (largely from McKinsey but also other partners) and best-in-class technology to enable transparency into Big Data, create actionable insights, and new ways of working that drive lasting performance improvement, and typically sustain a 2-7% increase in return on sales (ROS). With a truly global reach, the portfolio of solutions is comprised of: Marketing Solutions, Customer Experience Solutions, Category Solutions, B2C Pricing Solutions, B2B Pricing Solutions, and Sales Solutions. These are complemented by ongoing client service and custom capability building programs.
  
  
Periscope has a presence in 27 locations across 16 countries with a team of 800+ IT and business professionals and a network of 300+ experts. To learn more about how Periscope’s solutions and experts are helping businesses continually drive better performance, visit www.mckinsey.com/periscope.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Mandatory Master's degree; business administration, computer science or STEM related field is preferred
* 5+ year of working/internship experience in a startup’s product function, technology and/or consulting with a focus on product management
* Experience delivering products throughout the product life cycle and knowledge of software lifecycle tools such as JIRA, Git etc.
* Strong product intuition, user empathy analytics, structured, data-driven and have good interpersonal skills
* Strong experience in digital product development in B2C or B2B products
* Experience working in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment and can meet deadlines under tight time constraints
* Experience with designing creative, quality consumer products, as well as enabling business capability and objectives through technology
* Experience in leading cross-functional teams, demonstrate thought leadership, and able to influence at all levels in the organization
* Strong knowledge of Lean and Agile software development processes

title: Researcher, Consumer Insights
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.
  
  

* Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
We are at a critical time in the insights industry, with so much “data” at our fingertips. It’s imperative that we sift through the noise to uncover the true insights that will drive our business forward. At HARMAN, we have been investing in understanding our brands across the world to accelerate our cultural relevance and growth.
  
  
Reporting to the Manager, Consumer Insights, the Senior Researcher, Consumer Insights will be responsible for leading Asia insights projects from start to finish to help guide brand and marketing strategy, all in service of increasing our competitiveness.
  
  
We are looking for a talented Senior Researcher, Consumer Insights who is passionate about working with data to uncover the insights needed to drive strategic decision-making.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* As a key member of the Consumer Insights team, you will represent the Insights function for the Asia region and become a strategic partner to the local marketing teams.
* Translate Asia business and marketing challenges into insights projects to address key business issues.
* Core responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

+ Shopper Insights
+ Creative Evaluation
+ Foundational / Category Insights
+ AI Application
+ Product Concept / Innovation Insights
+ Cultural Insights
+ Lead campaign measurement across Asia markets

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Ability to turn insights into a POV-driven narrative to guide marketing decision-making.
* Experience managing primary/custom research projects (quantitative and qualitative) from the research design phase through final stakeholder deliverables.
* Qualitative and quantitative experience evaluating creative assets from the early stages through finished copy, with the ability to translate insights into creative direction.
* Ability to translate product concept and shopper insight results into marketing implications that inform strategy and marketing tactics.
* Ability to design and execute foundational category research and identify key business implications.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, along with strong creative thinking and the ability to use data, inputs, and intuition to inform decisions.
* Experience working in a highly matrixed organization and across different regions, ideally in a global role.
* 5+ years of experience with a proven track record of success in a global insights function.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Someone who is results-driven and has a proactive, goal-oriented approach to decision-making.
* Experience integrating AI for insights generation or data manipulation.
* Capable of handling multiple projects/initiatives simultaneously and executing them to completion.
* Self-starter with superior organizational skills who thrives in a deadline-driven environment and will do what it takes to get the job done.
* Curious mindset, with enthusiasm for working with data, strong attention to detail, and a sense of accountability.
* Multicultural awareness and the ability to adjust communication accordingly.
* Experience working with large brands and/or major retail clients.
* Experience at a media agency and/or market research agency (e.g., Ipsos, Kantar, Nielsen, etc.).

**Things To Know**

* Due to the nature of our global operations, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required..
* This role is hybrid, with a flexible requirement to work three days per week from the Bangalore, India, office.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
* Tuition reimbursement support.
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

title: PPC Specialist
description:
**Role: PPC Specialist**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Job type: Full time, Permanent**

*This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home and our office. Employees are expected to work 2 days in the office per week.*

**Why QS?**

At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our commitment to people development is recognised globally: QS is a Gold-accredited Investors in People organisation, placing us among the top 28% of workplaces worldwide. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.

It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.

Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.

At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real change in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.

We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023), recognising the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day.

**The role:**

As a PPC Specialist, you will manage, execute, and optimise Paid Search and Paid Social PPC marketing campaigns for our student recruitment products and services. The goal is to deliver the most efficient results across conversions, traffic, and other key performance indicators.

Within this role, you will devise and execute the PPC strategy agreed with the Head of Performance Marketing, whilst managing all aspects of planning, implementation, reporting, campaign administration, auction bid management, and optimisation.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of digital marketing trends, AI and analytics tools, with a proven track record of optimising PPC campaigns to drive measurable results.

This role is critical to the success of our student recruitment strategy, helping the business reach the right audiences at the right time and maximise the return on our digital marketing investment. Through effective campaign management, testing, optimisation, and data-driven decision-making, the PPC Specialist will directly contribute to student enrolment growth and the achievement of our global recruitment objectives.

**Role responsibilities:**

**Campaign Strategy & Planning**

* Plan, develop, and implement PPC campaigns and new PPC activities worldwide for all QS student enrolment activities.
* Build and maintain campaigns, ad groups, audiences, keywords, ads, and targeting on a daily basis.
* Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to identify optimal targeting opportunities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align PPC strategies with overall business goals and objectives.

**Campaign Execution**

* Create, manage, and optimise PPC campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, OpenAI, and other relevant channels.
* Develops and runs A/B tests on ads, audiences, landing pages, messaging,
* Monitors campaign performance and identifies optimisation opportunities

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Utilise analytics tools to track and analyse campaign performance.
* Implement tracking, conversion actions, feeds, audiences, and other campaign requirements.
* Analyse performance and optimise campaigns based on established KPIs.
* Set up conversion tracking aligned with GA4 goals and platform objectives.
* Report on PPC performance to the line manager, senior management, and relevant regional QS student enrolment teams.

**Creativity & Optimisation**

* Take responsibility for improving PPC ad creative, impression share, Quality Scores, cost per click, and cost per conversion.
* Test and develop new creative approaches to improve campaign performance and engagement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through structured testing and data analysis.

**Adherence to Best Practice**

* Keep up to date with the latest PPC and digital marketing trends through industry articles, podcasts, events, and other relevant sources.
* Share relevant best practices, insights, and recommendations with the wider team.
* Ensure campaigns follow platform best practices and internal PPC standards.

**Key skills and experience**

* Positive and forward-thinking, with a genuine ‘can-do’ attitude.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Demonstrable understanding of PPC metrics and performance indicators.
* Experience managing multiple PPC accounts and establishing Business Manager accounts from scratch.
* Proven experience in online search, social, display, and native advertising.
* Very good knowledge of web analytics tools, including GA4.
* Proven ability to utilise website analytics and search data to shape an enhanced and profitable acquisition strategy.
* Educated to degree level or equivalent professional experience.
* Familiarity with SEO/AEO principles and their impact on PPC campaigns.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle objections and resolve challenges effectively.
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment.
* Strong ability to prioritise tasks, with a high level of attention to detail and a focus on information accuracy.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Ability to identify critical issues and bring appropriate resolution to complex problems.

**So, who are we and what do we do?**

QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.

We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.

Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.

Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11 international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.

With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?

**We take investing in our people very seriously.**

**As standard you will have**

* Competitive base salary
* Access to an annual bonus scheme (for qualifying roles only)
* 21 days annual leave – increasing to 23 days after 5 years’ service + 8 days casual leave
* 15 days holiday for the year 2026
* Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
* Access to Provident Fund and Pension Fund Scheme
* Group Medical Insurance
* A vibrant social environment and multicultural and multinational culture

But that’s not all. Outside of these standard benefits we also offer resources to allow professional growth and wellness initiatives to nurture a healthy mindset:

* Free subscription to the Calm App – the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* A focus on welfare which is led by our global wellness team, with mental health first aiders globally
* Access to a variety of diversity and inclusion initiatives and groups
* Strong recognition and reward programs – including a peer-to-peer recognition platform, quarterly and annual QS Applaud Awards, Connect with your Career annual personal development event
* Support for volunteering and study leave
* Free subscription to LinkedIn learning – with over 5,000 courses and programmes at your fingertips
* Options to join our outstanding global Mentorship programme

**Like what you’ve heard? Great, apply now!**

As a candidate, we know the application and interview process can be daunting and so it’s important that you have a great experience with us. Our dedicated Talent Team will work hard to ensure you are fully informed at all stages, and you are really excited by this opportunity to do meaningful work in the education space.

**Equal opportunities**

QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive. title: Brand Marketeer
description:
**MISSION**

Retail Investors across the world are ready to build wealth, but lack research & advice they can trust. StockGro is fixing that.

As India's leading stock market advisory and research platform, StockGro connect 35M+ users with 150+ SEBI-registered experts and our proprietary Stoxo AI. On our platform, users access research-backed trade ideas and turn complex stock market data into simple, actionable insights; facilitating research, backtesting and trade execution on one platform. We are also expanding our intelligent investing infrastructure across GCC, starting with the UAE.

We were featured among CB Insights Top 100 Fintechs globally (2023) and highlighted by the World Economic Forum (2026) for driving financial inclusion through AI (2026).

**ABOUT STOCKGRO**

Founded in 2020 by Ajay Lakhotia (former VC and seasoned entrepreneur), StockGro set out to solve a fundamental gap: making trusted, high-quality investment advice accessible to everyone. Today, we are India's largest stock market advisory and research platform, empowering over 35 million users to invest smartly.

*Backed by Global Leaders*

We have raised ~$110M from marquee investors including BITKRAFT Ventures, General Catalyst, SBI Investments (Japan), and Roots Ventures, with early backing from angels like Kunal Shah, Vivekananda Hallekere, and Rahul Garg.

*Driven by High-Density Talent*

Our team includes senior leaders from Sequoia, Swiggy, Glance, Airtel, and Uber, alongside alumni from ISB, the IIMs, and the NITs. Together, we are building an AI-powered investment intelligence stack and scaling our footprint across the GCC to make smart investments universally accessible.

*Why Join Us?*

You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors.

**Your role in our vison :**

Our Team is lean, fast and believes in solving real use cases.
**Today, most of the execution happens through creators, writers, designers, and video teams. What we now need is a strategic Brand marketer who can refine our presence across platforms, push our product features with the right narratives, and ensure that all communication stays consistent and data-backed.**

We’re looking for a Full- Stack Marketeer that sits between brand, product, growth, and performance.

**Who are You?**

* You have experience driving Marketing Initiatives end to end from concept to launch in Fintech domains
* **You have Multi-platform copywriting chops with at least one project shipped on OOH, TV/CTV, or radio**
* Strong understanding of product positioning, feature-led marketing, and funnel thinking.
* You have the ability to craft narratives and maintain tone consistency across platforms
* **Prior experience designing full-funnel marketing campaigns for Brokerages, AMCs, Wealth-tech startups is a plus.**
* You excel at connecting the dots between data and strategy. In a metrics-driven environment, you can sift through high-volume user data to identify meaningful patterns and build campaigns that deliver real business impact.
* You will be required showcase excellent problem-solving & critical thinking skills; break down problems and structure solutions; work by influence, humility and honesty rather than by authority
* You have experience collaborating with performance teams and are hands-on with tools like Meta / Google ad manager and CX / analytics platforms like WebEngage, PostHog and AppsFlyer.

**What will you do?**

* **Build creative adaptations for OOH, radio, print, CTV, and digital**
* Build strategic narratives around every new product feature and release to ensure feature adoption through campaigns
* Continuously refine StockGro’s brand presence across all digital and offline touchpoints while collaborating with the Head of Marketing to drive and execute key branding initiatives.
* Work closely with the performance marketing vertical to align campaign strategies with acquisition and retention goals.
* Develop deep understanding of the target consumer & product, and leverage marketing / social media strategies to drive improvement across all important business metrics

title: GTM Excellence and Innovation Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GTM Excellence & Innovation Specialist (Assistant Director)**
**GDS (India, Argentina locations)**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Within EY’s Clients & Industries function, the Demand Generation team is responsible for driving dynamic pipeline growth and customer acquisition. This is achieved through meticulously curated experiences, events, content, and activation strategies tailored to our strategic relationships and channels. Our approach is aligned with EY’s brand, market insights, priority initiatives, and client purchasing behaviors—ensuring we foster meaningful customer growth from an industry perspective.
  
  
The Go-to-Market Content Center of Excellence (CoE) plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality assets, curated experiences, and activation programs that showcase EY’s capabilities and enable impactful client interactions. The CoE also fuels sales experiences through frictionless, AI-powered content management.
  
  
As an Excellence & Innovation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing projects and initiatives that enhance the quality, accessibility and impact of our go to market assets and supporting processes in alignment with client growth priorities. This role blends project management with innovation to deliver frictionless, AI-powered content experiences\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage medium-complexity, concurrent GTM content projects from initiation through to delivery
* Contribute to delivery of high-complexity projects as part of core project teams
* Apply structured project management methodologies to scope, plan, execute, and close projects, including risk mitigation and stakeholder alignment.
* Design and develop reporting frameworks and KPIs to track impact on pipeline and ensure consistent quality and measurable outcomes across all GTM content initiatives
* Contribute to shaping CoE products and services, elevating ideas for improvement, optimization and growth of capabilities
* Collaborate across Clients & Industries and partner functions (e.g., Industries, Accounts, Regions, SLs, G&I, BMC, Technology) to refine ideas and progress solutions.
* Use GenAI and analytics tools enhance quality and optimize delivery.
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive team culture that supports growth and development for all members.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Proven experience in successfully managing medium-complexity projects and initiatives. Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently with strong attention to detail and deadlines.
* Demonstrable knowledge of project management methodologies and their application.
* Solid understanding of EY’s GTM strategy and the role of Demand Generation in driving business growth.
* Strong executive presence and consultative approach, with a track record of building and maintaining senior-level relationships.
* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to produce polished, stakeholder-ready deliverables.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, GenAI tools (EYQ skills, Copilot etc) and EY’s content management tools (Adobe CMS, Workfront etc)
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and geographies.
* Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

**What we look for:**

* Hands-on experience delivering content that drives measurable business outcomes.
* Expertise across the content lifecycle, including:
* Planning and gap analysis
* Sourcing, creation and co-creation
* Storytelling, storyboarding and editorial review
* Curation and performance tracking
* Adept at working with stakeholders to align content initiatives with business priorities and client issues
* Keep current with advancements in GenAI and emerging technologies to proactively identify opportunities to enhance go to market impact.
* Skilled using analytics and performance metrics to assess content effectiveness and inform improvements.
* Strong collaboration skills to engage stakeholders and teams across Clients & Industries to refine opportunities and approaches
* Adaptability and a growth mindset to evolve practices for better results.

**Ideally you will also**
Bring substantial experience operating in a fast-paced, complex environment, where you’ve project managed cross-functional initiatives, executed strategic content planning, and championed process and quality improvements. Ideally you will also have hands-on experience leveraging GenAI tools and other emerging technologies to enhance deliverable and processes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**

* At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
* Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
* To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Content & Creative Strategy
description:
**About Subtle**

Subtle is not just a clothing brand; it is a philosophy of restraint and substance. We are building a new-age, accessible luxury brand for men who understand that presence doesn’t need volume. We engineer heavy tees (240-260 GSM) that breathe, drape, and define the wearer. What we sell is substance: the weight of the cotton, the way the shoulder holds, the way the tee still looks right after its fiftieth wash.

**Website:**
subtlestore.com

**Instagram:**
https://www.instagram.com/subtle.hq

**Location: Bangalore. Hybrid, with weekly in-person days with the team.**

**About You**

**Vibe Check**

This isn’t for everyone. If you lean towards loud aesthetics, flashy designs, or the ordinary, we’re probably not the right fit. And that’s okay. But if you get it, if you understand
**understated luxury, refined taste, and the power of restraint**

, keep reading.

**Why You Shouldn’t Apply**

We’re building something differently compared to how things are generally done, and we only want people who care enough to make it exceptional.

1. If this is just another job for you.
2. If you don’t obsess over details.
3. If you don’t take pride in your craft.
4. You need a playbook or an SOP to get started.
5. You think "marketing" is just running Meta ads and forgetting them.
6. You lean towards loud, flashy aesthetics or "hype-beast" culture.
7. You settle for "good enough." At Subtle, quality is non-negotiable.

**Why You Should Apply**

1. **Great taste.**

   You understand what makes a product great, not just good.
2. **Ownership & speed.**

   You move fast, take initiative, and don’t need follow-ups.
3. **Quality is non-negotiable.**

   We expect speed
   *and*

   excellence. No trade-offs.
4. **Your craft is who you are.**

   This isn’t just work for you, it’s what you live for.

**Responsibilities**

**What you will do**

You will create content and drive the visual and creative strategy of the brand. 

1. **Social media.**

   Plan, shoot, write and publish Subtle's Instagram. Content that teaches, not just shows: fabric tests, the fine print, the people who wear it.
2. **Ads.**

   Concepts, scripts, shoots and edits for Meta. Decide what to test with the founders, read the results, make the next round better.
3. **Website.**

   How subtlestore.com looks and reads: home page, product pages, launch and campaign pages.
4. **Email, WhatsApp, packaging and member communication.**

   Launch emails, Club Subtle, WhatsApp, packaging inserts. Every touchpoint after the purchase.
5. **Offline events.**

   Pop-ups, member evenings and trunk shows. The space, the invite and the content that comes out of it.

**What you will own**

* **The brand system**

  . Typography, photography direction, colour and voice. You are its keeper. Nothing goes out that doesn't feel like Subtle.
* **The content calendar.**

  What goes out, when and where. Planned weeks ahead, not scrambled the night before.
* The creative pipeline for paid. A steady flow of new ad creatives every week, and the learning loop on which concepts win and why.
* **Launches, end to end.**

  Every product and colour launch, from the first teaser to the launch-day email.
* **Shoots.**

  Briefs, casting, locations, styling, and the photographers and videographers who make them happen. On budget.
* **Creators and UGC.**

  Finding creators who fit, briefing them well and getting content we actually use.
* **Agencies and freelancers.**

  You decide what's made in-house and what's outsourced, and you hold everyone to the bar.

**Requirements**

**Must have:**

* 1 to 3 years in content, creative strategy or brand roles, ideally at a D2C, fashion or lifestyle brand.
* A portfolio. We hire on work, not CVs. Show us what you made and tell us why you made it that way.
* Hands-on range. You can write the copy, shoot on a phone, cut a reel and lay out a page in Figma. You don't need to be the best at all of them. You need to be able to make it yourself when it matters.
* Strong writing in English. Short sentences. Exact words.
* A working understanding of performance creative. Hooks, formats, how Meta judges an ad. You've made ads that sold, and you can say why.
* Taste you can explain. You can tell us why something works, not just that it does.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read Meta Ads Manager, Shopify and email reports, and you let the data change your mind.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to move, with weekly in-person days.

**Good to have:**

* A background in photography or art direction.
* Experience with Shopify themes or email platforms.
* Experience running events or pop-ups.
* An interest in textiles, craft or India's cotton heritage.
* Experience managing freelancers or a small team.

**What you get**

1. **Compensation:**

   If you are the right fit, we will make the numbers work.
2. **Autonomy:**

   You report directly to the founders, Nikhil & Rahul. No middle management. Direct impact.
3. **Growth:**

   You are joining at the ground floor. As Subtle scales, your role scales.

title: Senior Manager - Account Management
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and proactive professional for the role of Senior Manager – Integrated Media Planning to develop and manage integrated media strategies across ATL, digital, social, content, influencer, and performance marketing platforms, with a strong focus on the Tamil-speaking market.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of media planning, regional consumer behavior, and integrated communication strategies, along with strong client servicing and campaign management capabilities. The candidate must be proficient in reading and writing Tamil to evaluate regional content, review communication materials, ensure linguistic accuracy, and develop media recommendations relevant to Tamil-speaking audiences.
  
  
The role involves working closely with internal teams, clients, media partners, and regional stakeholders to deliver effective, insight-led media solutions aligned with brand and business objectives.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Integrated Media Planning & Strategy
* Develop integrated media plans across ATL, digital, social media, content, influencer, and performance marketing channels.
* Translate client marketing objectives into effective media strategies and communication plans for relevant target audiences.
* Understand Tamil-speaking consumer behavior, regional media consumption patterns, cultural nuances, and market trends to develop relevant media recommendations.
* Plan channel mix, audience targeting, budget allocation, campaign scheduling, and reach and frequency objectives.
* Identify opportunities to integrate traditional and digital media for stronger campaign effectiveness.
* Conduct competitor analysis, category research, and media landscape assessments to support strategic recommendations.
* Collaborate with media buying teams, publishers, digital platforms, and vendors to ensure effective campaign planning and execution.
* Client Servicing & Account Management
* Manage day-to-day client relationships and serve as a key point of contact for media planning and campaign-related requirements.
* Understand client business objectives and recommend integrated media solutions aligned with brand priorities.
* Prepare and present media plans, campaign proposals, performance reviews, and strategic recommendations.
* Coordinate with internal teams to manage campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, budgets, and status updates.
* Proactively address client requirements, resolve challenges, and ensure timely delivery of campaign commitments.
* Identify opportunities to improve client satisfaction, strengthen account relationships, and expand integrated media services.
* Campaign Execution & Performance Monitoring
* Oversee the execution of integrated media campaigns across relevant traditional and digital channels.
* Track campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including reach, impressions, engagement, CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversions, and ROAS, as applicable.
* Coordinate with analytics and performance teams to evaluate results and identify optimization opportunities.
* Prepare campaign reports, post-campaign analyses, and actionable recommendations for clients.
* Monitor media budgets, campaign spends, schedules, and deliverables to ensure efficient utilization of resources.
* Ensure quality, consistency, and timely execution across all campaign touchpoints.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with strategy, creative, content, digital, performance, media buying, analytics, production, and external agency teams.
* Ensure alignment across media recommendations, creative messaging, regional content, and campaign execution.
* Coordinate with regional media partners, publishers, vendors, and platform representatives as required.
* Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining planning quality and delivery standards.
* Contribute to process improvements, campaign documentation, and effective reporting practices.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Media, Mass Communication, Business, or a related field.
* 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in integrated media planning, media strategy, account management, or client servicing within an advertising or media agency.
* Fluency in reading and writing Tamil is mandatory. Candidates must be able to review Tamil-language campaign communication and assess linguistic and contextual accuracy.
* Strong understanding of ATL, digital media, social media, content, influencer marketing, and performance marketing.
* Experience in integrated media planning, audience targeting, media budget allocation, campaign execution, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of Tamil Nadu's regional media landscape, consumer behavior, and cultural nuances is highly desirable.
* Strong client management, presentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and relevant media planning and reporting tools.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Key Success Criteria**

* Effective delivery of integrated media plans aligned with client objectives.
* Accurate and culturally relevant Tamil-language campaign communication.
* Strong client relationships and timely campaign delivery.
* Efficient media budget management and performance optimization.
* Seamless coordination across internal teams and regional media partners.

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Brand:**
Carat
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: Senior Copy & Brand Strategist

  **copywriting, storytelling, and brand/creative strategy**

* Craft differentiated narratives around
  **agentic marketing, AI-powered customer engagement, and outcome-based partnerships**

**2. Copywriting, Messaging & Storytelling**

* Develop compelling
  **brand narratives, taglines, manifestos, messaging frameworks, campaign copy, and thought-provoking storytelling**

* Translate complex technology propositions into clear, accessible, and differentiated messaging that resonates with enterprise audiences.

* Partner with Product Marketing and subject matter experts to translate product capabilities and customer outcomes into compelling stories.

**3. Creative Strategy & Campaigns**

* Lead
  **big-idea development**
  for integrated brand campaigns, product launches, AI agent launches, and flagship events.
* Develop insight-led creative briefs that provide clear strategic and creative direction to designers, writers, video teams, and agencies.
* Partner with Design and Content teams to bring concepts to life across
  **digital, social, video, OOH, events, and sales enablement**
  .
* Balance creative ambition with business objectives, audience relevance, and measurable outcomes.
* Review and refine creative work to ensure it reflects the brand’s positioning, voice, and strategic intent.

**4. Brand Governance & Collaboration**

* Maintain and evolve
  **brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, tone-of-voice principles, and creative toolkits**
  across global and regional teams.
* Act as a brand guardian across Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Customer Success, PR, and Employer Branding.
* Manage external creative and branding agencies from briefing through concept development, copy review, and final delivery.
* Collaborate with Growth, PR, Design, Content, and leadership to align brand storytelling with GTM priorities.
* Present brand strategies, messaging directions, and creative concepts confidently to senior leadership and founders.

**5. Measurement & Optimisation**

* Define and track relevant brand and campaign metrics, including
  **awareness, consideration, share of voice, engagement, and sentiment**
  .
* Use customer insights, campaign performance, and market feedback to refine messaging and creative direction.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness against marketing objectives and broader business outcomes.
* Champion experimentation and continuous improvement in brand communication and creative effectiveness.

**Good to Have**

* Experience contributing to a
  **rebrand or major repositioning**
  at a technology company.
* Experience in
  **MarTech, customer engagement, B2B SaaS, or AI**
  .
* Familiarity with
  **generative AI tools**
  for copywriting, ideation, and creative workflows.
* Experience developing brand and campaign narratives for
  **India, SEA, the Middle East, North America, and Europe**
  .

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear, compelling, and differentiated
  **Netcore.ai brand narrative**
  that resonates with enterprise marketing leaders.
* Distinctive messaging and storytelling that simplify complex technology and reinforce the brand’s positioning.
* Creative campaigns that translate brand strategy into
  **memorable ideas and measurable business outcomes**
  .
* Consistent brand voice and expression across global markets and customer touchpoints.
* Stronger awareness, consideration, and differentiation within the AI/MarTech category.
* Continuous improvement in messaging and creative effectiveness through insights, data, and experimentation.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
A Senior Growth Manager drives revenue growth and client retention of strategic accounts by identifying and executing the highest-impact opportunities across the assigned portfolio, through growth and product adoption. This includes creating a strategic growth plan and driving operational excellence through forecasting and pipeline management.
  
  
They leverage data-driven insights to build consultative, strategic partnerships across client organizations, prioritize initiatives, and measure what truly moves the business through QBRs and ongoing performance reviews. Internally, they cultivate strong cross-functional relationships to align teams, remove blockers, and ensure growth strategies are executed with precision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue Retention & Growth: Drive sustainable revenue by growing accounts, preventing churn, and uncovering opportunities that result in long-term growth for each assigned account.
* Client Ownership & Strategy: Own end-to-end account strategy, setting clear growth plans, and serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders at all levels, including senior and C-level leadership.
* Campaign Management & Performance Insights: Ensure campaigns operate seamlessly and optimize effectively through collaboration with the Analyst and Product teams, delivering insights tied to business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to resolve issues, execute seamlessly, and deliver a consistent, high-value client experience.
* Operational Excellence: Maintain forecast discipline, accurate reporting, and financial rigor to ensure smooth execution and reliable account management.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Must-Have**

* 10+ years of experience in digital advertising or mobile ad tech, in account management, customer success, or growth roles.
* Currently at, or has worked at, a larger company proven experience.
* Proven track record in revenue ownership, forecasting, and scaling accounts, not just client servicing.
* Comfortable managing relationships with senior and C-level client stakeholders.
* Familiarity with data and dashboard tools such as Holistics, Looker, or Tableau.

**Travel Expectations:**
Travel as needed.
  
  
**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**
RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.
  
  
RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Senior Global Campaigns Specialist
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.
  
  
**About The Position**
**Position Overview and Objective**
The Sr. Campaigns Specialist supports end-to-end execution of integrated marketing campaigns that drive pipeline and revenue across assigned segments, products, and programs. Acting as the operational backbone for campaign delivery, this role owns the full campaign operational lifecycle — from intake, scoping, and build through QA, launch, tracking setup, and post-program support — ensuring programs are delivered on time, follow best practices, and produce measurable results.
  
  
This role partners closely with Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and other Go-To-Market stakeholders, combining strong hands-on execution with the judgment to advise on campaign structure, segmentation, and channel approach. It is ideal for a detail-oriented, systems-savvy campaign marketer who enjoys turning campaign requests into well-built, well-tracked programs, and who wants to grow into broader campaign strategy and cross-functional leadership over time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as the primary Campaign Operations point of contact for assigned marketing teams; intake, prioritize, and scope campaign requests in line with SLAs.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, SDR, Channel, Acquisition, and Customer teams to ensure campaigns operationally are aligned, resourced, and to execute effectively
* Campaign Execution: Support and own parts of end-to-end build and execution across Campaign Ops-supported channels, including email, webinars, direct mail, content syndication, meeting setting, list imports, and SPIFFs.
* Campaign Building: Build and configure programs in Marketo and Salesforce, including emails, landing pages, forms, smart campaigns, and Salesforce campaigns; leverage templates, tokens, and standardized structures to scale execution.
* Program Management: Manage campaign operational work and calendars through Wrike (or equivalent project management tooling), ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery aligned to product launches, sales plays, and market opportunities.
* Audience & Data Management: Own segmentation, list builds, and targeting for assigned campaigns; ensure proper use of suppression logic, consent, and targeting accuracy, partnering with MarTech on data quality and availability gaps.
* Tracking & Attribution: Configure campaign tracking, statuses, and attribution setup; maintain data integrity across Marketo and Salesforce and ensure alignment with global naming conventions and reporting frameworks.
* Reporting & Optimization: Enable accurate performance reporting, support stakeholders with post-campaign insights, and continuously improve efficiency through standardization and automation.
* Process Improvement: Act as liaison between marketing teams and MarTech/Admin on tooling issues and enhancements; identify opportunities to standardize and streamline recurring campaign work.

**Experience & Requirements**

* Hands-on experience building and executing campaigns in Marketo (or comparable marketing automation platform) and Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of campaign project management tools (e.g., Wrike) and webinar platforms (e.g., ON24).
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple campaign requests and deadlines simultaneously.
* Solid analytical skills with the ability to track campaign performance, maintain data integrity, and surface actionable insights.
* Clear, professional communication skills; able to advise stakeholders on campaign structure, segmentation, and channel approach.
* Detail-oriented approach to segmentation, list management, suppression logic, and data hygiene.
* Collaborative team player comfortable partnering across marketing, MarTech, and GTM stakeholders.
* Ability to identify efficiencies and standardize recurring campaign work.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in campaign operations, marketing operations, demand generation, or a combination of relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce).
* Prior experience in SaaS.

**Benefits**
All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
  
  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

**Security Requirements**
At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.
  
  
**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

title: Assistant Manager, Paid Social
description:
**About Us**
Stagwell Media is a global media agency that delivers performance built to unlock ambition on every platform. As part of Stagwell, the challenger network transforming marketing through AI, Stagwell Media is transforming media through an agile, integrated model that powers growth and helps brands navigate an evolving marketplace. Powered by next-generation agentic technology, including The Media Machine, its AI-native operating system, the agency accelerates optimization, maximizes media investment efficiency and drives higher-quality audience engagement. With more than 2,300 experts across 50+ markets, Stagwell Media delivers transformative results for leading global brands including Lenovo, DP World, and P&G.
  
  
**Overview**
The  Assistant Manager, P aid Social would be responsible for managing advertising campaigns for clients in US/UK markets, on various Paid Social platforms like, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Twitter and Pinterest to name a few. The individual will be responsible for planning, building, optimizing campaigns, and analyze performance based on client objectives. He/she may eventually also manage a team based on his/her capabilities and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking to bring in an experienced resource to support our paid social media. The primary responsibility of this role will be to strengthen the capabilities of our Bangalore office as it relates to managing Paid Social Advertising campaigns.
  
  
**Primary Duties**

* Demonstrate an in-depth practical knowledge of Paid Social best practice, Optimisation Framework, Account Structure, Bidding Strategy, Targeting types, and their application to campaigns to generate a high standard of delivery
* Build paid social campaigns & strategies that are structured into clear frameworks focused on clients business objectives & are built upon solid insight
* Manage paid social campaigns based on the agreed-upon strategic direction provided by the Onshore team members.
* Ensure campaign setup and delivery is aligned with the tactical plan and offer strategic and tactical recommendations to help shape future planning.
* Optimize media campaigns towards the target KPIs within various advertising platforms, including but not limited to:
* Facebook Ads Manager
* Instagram Ads
* LinkedIn Advertising Products
* Twitter
* Pinterest
* Snap

**Required Skills**

* Desired Experience - 5+ years of experience in managing Paid Social campaigns
* Experience in setting up and optimizing campaigns on social media platforms like Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and Twitter
* Strong data analysis skills (including advanced Microsoft Excel skills)
* Team Management skills.

**Benefits**

* Annual Leave in number of 15 allotted to all employees beginning of every calendar year.
* Sick Leave in number of 12 is allotted effective DOJ and beginning of ever calendar year.
* Other Leaves-Maternity Leave & Paternity Leaves, Birthday Leave Entitlement
* Dedicated L&D Budget for all Teams to upskill & get certified
* All employees are entitled for Group Personal Accident Cover & Life Cover Insurance.
* Insurance coverage for the entire family (Employee + up to 7 dependents - Self, Spouse, up to 4 children, and Parents)
* Monthly Cross Team Lunch
* Rewards and Recognition program-Employee of the month, Star Performer, Tenure Celebration & many more
