We are an advocate for equal opportunity in the workplace. We are committed to ensuring equal opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability and gender identity. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
  
  
**Social and Environmental Responsibility**
We have a responsibility to bring impact into our every day. This means we must always look for ways in which to be conscious citizens in our roles to support society and environmental sustainability. We encourage employees to; be a conscious citizen by actively participating in our organisation's sustainability efforts, help us promote environmentally friendly practices within the workplace, collaborate with community organisations and stakeholders to support initiatives aligned with our company's values, participate in volunteer activities that benefit the community. Employees are also encouraged to make suggestions and evaluate our business practices to identify areas for improvement in social and environmental performance. title: Google Ads Specialist (eCommerce)
description:
We are Folqs, a fast-growing DTC supplement brand specializing in premium health and wellness products across the United States.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to take full ownership of scaling our core Google Ads ecosystem - including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max - while expanding our cold-traffic acquisition on YouTube. You will work closely with our marketing team to test angles, optimize funnels, and scale profitable ad spend.
  
  
This role goes far beyond simple set-and-forget campaign management. Primary focus is placed on driving core Google Ads performance, with YouTube Ads serving as our critical secondary scaling engine. If you specialize in high-scale Google Ads, DR video funnels, VSL testing, and landing page optimization, this role is built for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Drive full-funnel Google ads (#1 priority): Architect, manage, and optimize high-converting Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Demand Gen, maintaining strict brand defense and retargeting logic.
* Scale YouTube video campaigns: Build and scale cold-traffic YouTube campaigns using VSLs - optimizing campaign structure, placement strategy, creative hooks, and view-through vs. click attribution.
* Optimize Merchant Center & tracking: Oversee Google Merchant Center feeds, policy compliance, and server-side/conversion tracking setups (GTM, GA4, and multi-touch attribution tools).
* Collaborate on creative strategy: Brief and collaborate with copywriters and video editors on high-performing ad copy, fresh VSL concepts, visual hooks, script angles, and landing page messaging.
* Test & analyze continuously: Execute systematic A/B tests across keywords, bidding strategies, ad copy, video angles, and landing page flows. Monitor CAC, ROAS, and overall spend efficiency daily.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of hands-on media buying experience with Google ads in eCommerce.
* Proven track record managing $50k+/month in profitable ad spend across Google Ads.
* Google Ads & GMC mastery: Deep expertise with Performance Max, Google Shopping, keyword strategy, and Merchant Center feed management.
* Strong YouTube Ads capability: Solid hands-on experience running cold traffic on YouTube using VSLs and long-form video creatives.
* Funnel & DR expertise: Strong working knowledge of VSLs, long-form landing pages, quiz funnels, and direct-to-checkout flows.
* Time zone overlap: Minimum 6-hour daily overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET).
* Language skills: Proficient in English (written and verbal) for clear team collaboration.
* AI & data fluency: Daily use of AI tools for research, ideation, and rapid workflow execution, combined with strong data analysis capabilities.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Experience navigating policy restrictions in the supplement, health, or beauty niches.
* Hands-on experience with attribution platforms (Triple Whale, Northbeam, etc.).
* Experience with native ads.
* Proven experience scaling DTC brands from six to seven figures per month.

We are looking for a Content Strategist with 1-3 years of experience to oversee the coordination of our content creation process. Responsibilities

title: Head Branded Content and Education
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented marketer to head branded content and education for PhonePe. As the Head you will be the brand champion of PhonePe’s content channels across social media platforms (Youtube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms), responsible for shaping and executing strategies that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and overall business growth.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that requires a blend of strategic thinking, P&L understanding, creative flair, and analytical prowess to build and scale PhonePe’s content playbook. You will work cross-functionally, collaborating with teams across Product, Business, Finance, Analytics, and Marketing to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
**Craft & Taste Supremacy**
: You possess an uncompromising eye for design, copy, storytelling, and brand nuance. You know the difference between a high-converting, humanly crafted campaign and generic noise. You have the experience of running long form content strategy and channels on Youtube.
  
  
**Thoughtful Tool Integration**
: You embrace modern creative technology and AI, but you evaluate tools through the lens of human enablement. You champion productivity and efficiency through automation, without compromising the creative soul of the content.
  
  
**High Execution Rigour & Governance**
: You establish rigorous editorial and operational standards, brand content guardrails, and human-in-the loop review processes to ensure every piece of work meets the highest standards of brand safety and quality.
  
  
**Executive Influence:**
You confidently articulate content strategy to senior leadership. You frame creative and content choices around business impact, brand equity, and emotional connection rather than vanity metrics or technological trends.
  
  
**Culture & Mentorship:**
You mentor brand marketers, social media teams and creative talent both inhouse and external, to elevate the story-telling craft. You build a collaborative culture where human curiosity and creative experimentation thrive alongside operational speed and business impact.
  
  
**Cultural Relevance & Trend intelligence:**
You have a deep connection to Indian consumer behavior. You spot subtle cultural shifts and turn them into brand campaigns that genuinely connect with our diverse user base. You have strong experience in enabling rapid-response and real-time content workflows that keep the brand embedded in daily national and regional conversations.
  
  
**Content Distribution:**
You have a deep understanding and experience of partnering with or working on media planning and distribution from your past experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Story-telling on Social Media Platforms:**
You will define and maintain the overarching content and narrative standards across PhonePe’s social media platforms. Establish clear guidelines for human editorial oversight, brand safety, and content quality, ensuring that the content and its distribution is able to meet business objectives.
  
  
You will translate complex financial and consumer tech products into clear, emotionally compelling brand campaigns. Present creative strategies, campaign concepts, and brand performance updates to executive leadership.
  
  
**Business Impact through Content:**
You will define the impact of our content on the business P&L and long term brand building. You will build and deliver on annual operating plans working closely with Business and finance teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Craft Mentorship:**
You will lead, mentor, and grow a team of social media, content and brand marketers. You will foster a culture of craft excellence, encouraging the team and agencies to push creative boundaries on content creation and distribution while maintaining strategic discipline.
  
  
**Campaign Execution & Performance Balance**
You will oversee key brand launches and high-stakes campaigns to ensure speed does not compromise quality.
  
  
You will collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Brand teams to protect brand integrity while meeting aggressive timeline demands.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Creative Mastery & Craft**
Deep experience in brand storytelling, content strategy or creation, high stakes execution at scale. across multi-channel environments (digital, visual, social, video).
  
  
A strong, proven portfolio that reflects deep attention to detail, diversity, narratives and formats. Clear editorial judgment with a track record of upholding brand integrity against low-quality, generic asset production.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Description**
Req ID: 27-0493
  
  
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading global cybersecurity company delivering complete resilience made easy to buy, deploy and use through a partner-first model. Our intelligent BarracudaONE™ platform provides cyber resilience across email, data, applications, networks, and managed XDR within an open ecosystem. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of organizations and partners worldwide, Barracuda delivers industry-leading solutions and support, powered by people and enhanced by AI, for all size business.
  
  
We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
  
  
**Envision Yourself At Barracuda**
Help turn customer needs into useful email-security capabilities. As a Product Analyst, you will own a clearly bounded feature or administrator workflow, working directly with engineering and a senior product manager from discovery through delivery and measurement. The role combines hands-on product decisions, customer exposure and structured mentorship, with opportunities to develop toward broader product responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**
Investigate customer and administrator needs through interviews, support feedback, usage data and market or competitor research. Translate findings into a clear problem statement and practical options for an assigned feature. Explore how phishing, malware and everyday email-management challenges affect the people using the product.
  
  
Define user stories and testable acceptance criteria with senior PM guidance. Partner with engineering and design to evaluate feasibility, refine the backlog and recommend priorities within the agreed scope. Own requirements clarity and follow-through, resolve straightforward product questions collaboratively, and escalate security-sensitive or higher-complexity decisions.
  
  
Track feature milestones, dependencies and delivery risks against the agreed roadmap. Support validation and release readiness, prepare internal product briefings or training, and gather customer feedback after launch. Agree relevant indicators with your mentor, analyse adoption and workflow outcomes, and propose evidence-based improvements.
  
  
You are accountable for the quality and outcomes of your assigned feature or workflow, not only meeting coordination. A senior product manager retains portfolio strategy, overall roadmap ownership and major prioritisation decisions. You will contribute research and recommendations to those decisions and may support a broader strategic initiative under their direction.
  
  
**What You Bring To The Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; and 2–5 years of experience in product management, project management, software engineering or a comparable role.
* Adjacent experience is welcome when it demonstrates customer problem-solving and delivery of software outcomes.
* Working knowledge of agile delivery and cybersecurity fundamentals, together with the ability to interpret customer feedback and product data.
* You can communicate requirements clearly, discuss trade-offs with technical colleagues, collaborate across functions and adapt as evidence or priorities change.
* Preferred, not required: familiarity with email administration, Microsoft 365, phishing and malware protection, and basic email authentication concepts such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Product-management certification, including CPM, is also welcome.
* Deep email-security expertise is not expected at entry to this role.

**How You Will Grow And Succeed**
Regular senior PM coaching, engineering partnership and customer conversations will help you strengthen discovery, prioritisation and analytical judgement. You will collaborate with colleagues across locations on shared product goals. Success means well-defined requirements, transparent delivery risks, useful customer insights and measurable improvement in your assigned area, with progressively greater independence as your skills develop.
  
  
**What You’ll Get From Us**
A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non-qualifying options.

title: Growth Intern - Gold
description:

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. title: Solutions Design Analyst, Specialty Solutions
description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific. Join us in making clinical trials easier, faster, more engaging, and accessible to all. We are transforming the future of clinical trials. Our Specialty Solutions & Clinical Adjudication team supports some of the world’s most complex and meaningful studies, helping sponsors bring life‑changing therapies to patients faster.

We're looking for passionate Solutions Design Analysts to join our growing team in India. This role is ideal for professionals with a Business Analyst mindset who enjoy analyzing complex clinical trial requirements, engaging with stakeholders, and translating business needs into effective technology solutions.

If you have a background in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Healthcare Technology, or Business Analysis, along with experience in eCOA, ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, or other clinical technologies, you'll play a critical role in bridging the gap between clinical study requirements and system design. Your work will directly contribute to improving patient, site, and sponsor experiences while helping bring innovative therapies to market faster.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and incentives
* Comprehensive benefits supporting security, flexibility, wellbeing, and work–life balance
* Engaging employee programs and learning opportunities
* Hybrid working technology and excellent onsite facilities

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as the primary liaison between sponsors, project teams, and technical stakeholders to analyze, document, and translate clinical trial requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Lead requirements gathering workshops and discovery sessions to understand protocol objectives, study workflows, and operational needs.
* Manage and coordinate the end-to-end Solutions Design process, ensuring clinical protocols are accurately translated into system specifications and configurations.
* Produce clear business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and design documentation to support study implementations.
* Provide business analysis expertise during client-facing meetings, helping stakeholders understand solution capabilities, constraints, and recommendations.
* Create and maintain study-specific configuration and design specifications for Clario products and services.
* Analyze system, workflow, and data requirements to ensure consistency between clinical data capture, reporting, delivery, and database structures.
* Partner with Clinical Systems Translation & Licensing to ensure appropriate questionnaire versions and content are implemented.
* Support validation and quality review activities by investigating and resolving design-related issues and defects.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze study issues, identify root causes, and recommend process or system improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, documentation standards, and solution delivery practices.
* Work closely with Clinical Project Managers to ensure sponsor requirements and business objectives are effectively translated into system solutions.
* Lead or participate in internal and external design reviews, solution workshops, and milestone meetings.
* Represent Solutions Design during client audits by explaining solution methodologies, business processes, standards, and best practices.
* Support Business Development and Project Management teams by reviewing study protocols, assessing feasibility, and providing solution recommendations for new opportunities.
* Configure clinical technology platforms in alignment with approved business requirements and configuration specifications.

**What We Look For**

* BSc, MSc, or PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience as a Business Analyst, Clinical Business Analyst, Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Clinical Research Manager, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Solutions Analyst, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, documenting, and managing business and system requirements across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of clinical research processes, clinical trial operations, and eClinical technologies.
* Experience with eCOA/ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, Clinical Adjudication, or other healthcare technology platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to analyze complex workflows and translate business requirements into functional system solutions.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, requirement workshops, and client-facing meetings.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, process-mapping, and documentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Experience working in global, cross-functional environments with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Passion for leveraging technology to improve clinical trial execution, patient engagement, and healthcare outcomes.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace and defense solutions.
  
  
With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, Collins Aerospace helps customers address some of the most demanding challenges in the global aerospace industry.
  
  
Join us and be part of a team that is redefining aerospace through technology, innovation, and engineering excellence.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. This role supports key business functions, including finance, order management, inventory, procurement, shipping, and engineering.
  
  
You will collaborate with global SAP, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams to maintain a stable SAP landscape, drive continuous improvement, identify automation opportunities, and support strategic technology initiatives. The role offers opportunities to make independent technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the company’s SAP infrastructure and digital strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* SAP Landscape Management: Execute SAP infrastructure and architecture roadmaps, ensuring system stability, availability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* System Administration: Install, configure, patch, maintain, and refresh SAP applications and database systems.

* High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Support SAP infrastructure design and initiatives involving high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Automation and Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate routine activities, improve operational efficiency, and enhance existing processes.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, design documents, requirements, and test scripts.
* Business-Critical Support: Support SAP Digital Technology (DT) teams during critical system outages, planned maintenance, and operational activities.
* Global Support: Participate in on-call rotations, work in US hours as required, and provide weekend support when necessary.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to a large, global SAP landscape supporting critical enterprise business functions.
* Develop deeper expertise in SAP infrastructure architecture, system performance, and landscape management.
* Understand high-availability solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
* Explore automation opportunities and continuous improvement initiatives across SAP operations.
* Collaborate with global technical teams and business stakeholders on strategic SAP initiatives.
* Contribute to SAP modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* 9+ years of experience working in an SAP Basis administration role.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, databases, and application architecture.
* Hands-on experience administering SAP ECC, BW, PI, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA systems.
* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organizational levels, including leadership.
* Ability to work in a global support environment, including US working hours, on-call rotations, and occasional weekend support.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience working in a large, complex, global SAP environment.
* Knowledge of SAP technologies, architecture, interfaces, and batch processing.
* Experience with Oracle databases, SAP HANA, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and/or Lean methodologies.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, CRM, SNC, SLT, Hybris, and SAP Web Dispatcher.
* Knowledge of web technologies, firewalls, proxy servers, and Single Sign-On (SSO) frameworks.
* Experience supporting SAP system upgrades, migrations, integrations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage projects, and drive process improvements within a technical domain.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree: Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), or a related field, along with relevant experience.
* Advanced degree: A master’s or other advanced degree in a related field may be considered with the applicable level of relevant experience.
* Experience in lieu of education: Candidates without a degree may qualify with equivalent relevant professional experience, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

**Digital Technology**
Do you want to be part of a new, exciting initiative to combine foundational IT with new digital technologies?  Our Digital Technology team is driving business efficiencies and a better customer experience by connecting technologies, people, information and processes. From making aircraft more electric, intelligent and integrated to building new software platforms such as Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, there’s no better place to be right now than in digital. If you’re an agile thinker who enjoys utilizing modern technology to make big improvements, then you’re a perfect fit for this team. Join Collins Aerospace to help us revolutionize the aerospace industry today!
  
  
WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE.

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
  
  
Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

title: Senior Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
**The Company Behind the Products**

Every business talks about “better customer conversations.” SaaS Labs builds products that actually make them happen.

From JustCall to CallPage to ServiceAgent.ai, we help thousands of businesses communicate better.

Here's where we are: With 300+ people across India, the US, and beyond, we’re at an inflection point as AI reshapes business communication.

What it's like to work here? Total ownership. We’re a team that moves with purpose, builds with ambition, and loves seeing our work make real impact.

And, if you're already nodding along, let's start the conversation.

**The Flagship Product**

With JustCall we’re leading the innovation on how sales and service teams connect with their customers— using AI — across calls, texts, emails, WhatsApp, and whatever comes next!It’s a multichannel communication system that helps 7000+ of our customers serve theirs better- with 24/7 AI Agents, on-point integrations, and other forward-looking features.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Sr. IT Support Engineer to own and deliver end-to-end technical support across access management, user onboarding and offboarding, application support, and infrastructure and network management.

Your goal is reliable IT operations: resolving network, system, and software issues, managing licenses and access permissions, and provisioning laptops for new joiners. That means minimal downtime, a productive workforce, and business continuity.

As a senior member of the IT team, you will be the go-to person for complex issues, set the standard for support quality, and drive improvements in processes, security, and automation. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and vendors in a fast-paced environment.

**Location:**
Bangalore (in-office 5 days a week, as collaboration and quick problem-solving are best enabled through close teamwork)

**What you'll do**

* **Technical Support:**
  Provide end-to-end troubleshooting for desktop systems, applications, and network connectivity; resolve hardware, software, and OS-related issues.
* **Monitoring & Troubleshooting:**
  Proactively monitor and troubleshoot network, internet, hardware, and system issues to keep IT operations running smoothly and minimise downtime.
* **Hardware & Software Maintenance:**
  Install, configure, and maintain computers, peripherals, and mobile devices; ensure timely updates across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* **Laptop Provisioning & Allocation:**
  Manage laptop allocation, configuration, and handover for new joiners and existing employees, ensuring every device is ready and compliant on Day 1.
* **Network Management:**
  Support and troubleshoot LAN/WAN/VPN connectivity; manage routers, switches, and wireless networks to maintain secure and stable operations.
* **Access & Onboarding/Offboarding:**
  Manage user accounts, access permissions, and role assignments (JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian). Own the onboarding and offboarding lifecycle, including account setup and asset recovery.
* **License & IT Asset Management:**
  Manage software licenses, track IT hardware and inventory, and maintain software compliance. Ensure license usage is optimised and audit-ready.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for procurement, repairs, replacements, and IT infrastructure maintenance and issue resolution.
* **Security & Compliance:**
  Implement and monitor IT security policies; assist with SOC/ISO/HIPAA audits and ensure compliance with organisational standards.
* **Documentation & Training:**
  Maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. Create user guides and conduct training sessions on common tools and workflows.
* **Process Improvement & Automation:**
  Identify recurring issues and automate repetitive tasks (PowerShell/Bash) to improve turnaround time and the employee experience.
* **Mentorship:**
  Guide junior team members, review their work, and help raise the overall support standard.

**What we're looking for**

* **Education**
  : Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:**
  5–6 years as an IT Support, Desktop Support, or Systems Support Engineer, with hands-on expertise in access management, user onboarding/offboarding, laptop provisioning, and application management.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Strong working knowledge of macOS, Windows, and Linux, along with experience in Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other productivity tools.
* **Systems & Cloud:**
  Hands-on experience with identity and access management and device management platforms (JumpCloud, JAMF, Active Directory, LDAP). Exposure to cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* **Networking & Troubleshooting:**
  Solid understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi), diagnostics, and root-cause resolution of hardware and software issues.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Experience maintaining IT inventory, tracking licenses, and keeping documentation audit-ready.
* **Security Awareness:**
  Working knowledge of endpoint security, access controls, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA).
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with a customer-first approach. Able to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate across teams.

**Edges that help**

* Certifications such as CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, ITIL Foundation, CCNA, or MCSE
* Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell/Bash)
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Experience with endpoint management solutions (MDM, SCCM, Intune)
* Prior experience mentoring or leading junior IT staff

**How we work**

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to taking hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Denoda Administrator
description:

**Bangalore / Hyderabad**

Experience:
**8 years**

Role Name:
**Dendo Administrator**

**Key Job Responsibilities**

**1. Denodo Platform Administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain the Denodo Data Virtualization platform.
* Manage Denodo servers, environments, clusters, and platform availability.
* Monitor system health, performance, and capacity utilization.

**2. Platform Support & Operations**

* Provide L2/L3 production support for Denodo environments.
* Troubleshoot performance issues, query bottlenecks, connectivity failures, and platform incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.

**3. Security & Governance**

* Configure authentication and authorization mechanisms (LDAP, Active Directory, SSO, Kerberos).
* Manage user roles, permissions, and data access controls.
* Ensure compliance with banking security standards and audit requirements.

**4. Performance Optimization**

* Tune virtual views, caches, and query execution plans.
* Optimize data federation and virtualization performance.
* Implement caching strategies to improve response times.

**5. Environment Management**

* Support Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments.
* Handle deployments, migrations, and release activities.
* Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.

**6. Data Source Integration**

* Configure and manage connectivity to databases, data warehouses, cloud platforms, APIs, and files.
* Support integration with Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Snowflake, Hadoop, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise systems.

**7. Automation & DevOps**

* Automate deployment and administrative tasks using scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell).
* Support CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code initiatives.
* Manage version control and promotion processes.

**8. Monitoring & Reporting**

* Configure monitoring tools and alerts.
* Track platform KPIs, SLAs, utilization metrics, and incident trends.
* Provide operational reports to stakeholders.

**9. Collaboration**

* Work closely with Data Engineers, Architects, Application Teams, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administrators.
* Assist development teams in designing and implementing optimized virtual data models.

**Typical Skills Required**

**Primary Skills**

* Denodo Administration
* Data Virtualization
* Linux/Unix Administration
* SQL Performance Tuning

**Secondary Skills**

* Oracle, SQL Server, DB2
* LDAP/AD, Kerberos, SSO
* Shell Scripting, Python

title: Linux Administrator
description:

Remote

Contract-to-Hire (C2H)

**Role:**
Linux Administrator

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced
**Linux Administrator**
to manage, maintain, patch, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux server infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with
**Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Oracle Linux, Linux patching, and Red Hat Satellite/Katello**
.

The role involves ensuring server availability, security, stability, and performance while supporting enterprise infrastructure. Experience with automation, monitoring tools, Linux hardening, and enterprise environments will be an added advantage.

  .

* Monitor server health, availability, performance, and capacity; troubleshoot system-level issues.
* Perform Linux security hardening, access management, and compliance-related activities.
* Develop and maintain shell scripts using Bash or other scripting languages to automate routine administrative tasks.
* Troubleshoot operating system, hardware, networking, and application-related issues.
* Manage system logs, investigate incidents, and support root-cause analysis.
* Perform system performance tuning and support backup and restoration activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational records.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams to ensure reliable IT operations.

Required Skills — Priority 1 (Mandatory)

* Strong hands-on experience in
  **Linux system administration**
  .
* Expertise in
  **Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and/or Oracle Linux**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **Linux patching and patch management**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Red Hat Satellite or Katello**
  .
* Experience in Linux server monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
* Proficiency in
  **Bash/Shell scripting**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, system services, user permissions, storage, and package management.

Preferred Skills — Priority 2

* Experience with
  **Zabbix**
  or similar monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of
  **Ansible**
  for configuration management and automation.
* Experience in Linux security hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Knowledge of log management, system performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise backup and restore solutions.

Specialized Skills — Priority 3 (Added Advantage)

* Experience with
  **Oracle Exadata**
  infrastructure.
* Knowledge of
  **RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet)**
  and
  **InfiniBand**
  networking.
* Exposure to
  **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
  or hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms such as
  **NetBackup and Cohesity**
  .
* Experience managing Linux virtual machines on VMware ESXi.
* Knowledge of Linux integration with Active Directory using LDAP, Kerberos, or Quest/One Identity Safeguard Authentication Services.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server administration and hybrid infrastructure environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Linux Administrator with strong expertise in enterprise Linux operations, patch management, and troubleshooting. Candidates with the mandatory Linux skills should be prioritized; specialized experience in Exadata, RoCE, InfiniBand, and OCI will be considered a significant advantage.

+ Security & Compliance
+ Print Management
+ Transport Management

title: Lead Engineer - Windows Patch Management
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Windows Server vulnerability findings from identification and prioritization through remediation, validation, evidence capture, and closure.
* Assess CVEs, CVSS ratings, vulnerability scan results, Microsoft security updates, and security advisories to determine appropriate remediation and priority.
* Plan and execute monthly Patch Tuesday deployments, emergency/out-of-band updates, and zero-day remediation across test, development, and production environments.
* Coordinate maintenance windows, change records, incidents, dependencies, approvals, and stakeholder communications in ServiceNow.
* Troubleshoot patching and update failures using Windows Update, WSUS, SCCM or Tanium, DISM/SFC, CBS and Windows Update logs, registry, disk-space, and reboot diagnostics.
* Verify patch installation and server health after deployment; track pending reboots, failed patches, and remediation actions through closure.
* Monitor critical and high-severity findings, SLA adherence, aging items, exceptions, and recurring patch failures; escalate blockers and maintain accurate status.
* Support vulnerability assessments, PCI requirements, audits, and security reviews by preparing remediation evidence, compliance reports, and management updates.
* Coordinate documented risk exceptions, compensating controls, and remediation plans when findings cannot be resolved within the required SLA.
* Help address legacy and end-of-life Windows Server systems through upgrades, migration, Extended Security Updates (ESU), replacement, or decommissioning plans.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to support vulnerability checks, patch compliance, remediation workflows, and reporting.
* Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to assess impact, resolve dependencies, and deliver remediation with minimal service disruption.
* Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and engage Microsoft or other vendors when escalation is required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience administering and patching Windows Server in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019, and/or 2022, including support for legacy systems.
* Practical experience with enterprise vulnerability management and patch remediation, including remediation SLAs and prioritization of CVEs/CVSS findings.
* Experience deploying Microsoft security updates using one or more of WSUS, SCCM, or Tanium.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for administration, automation, validation, or reporting.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows Update, Event Viewer, DISM, SFC, CBS, Windows Update logs, registry, disk space, and reboot-related issues.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, RDP/RDS, WinRM, SMB, and TLS/SSL.
* Experience with change, incident, and remediation tracking, and with producing clear technical evidence and status reports.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with security, compliance, application, infrastructure, and operations stakeholders.

title: Senior Endpoint Engineer – Windows & Intune (EUC Engineer III)
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
  
  
**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
Bengaluru, KA
  
  
**About The Role**
The End User Compute (EUC) team delivers the endpoint platforms, tools and services that enable our colleagues to work securely and effectively.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver improvements across device management, provisioning, automation and hardware lifecycles. Your primary expertise will be Windows endpoint management, particularly Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and PowerShell. Experience administering both Windows and macOS is highly valued. Strong Windows engineers who are willing to learn and take increasing responsibility for Mac administration are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and enhance our Microsoft Intune environments, including device enrolment, configuration, compliance and application management, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and scalable.
* Develop and improve light-touch provisioning using Windows Autopilot, with minimal manual IT intervention and a robust setup experience.
* Configure and troubleshoot the interactions between Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Okta, working with identity teams to support reliable device provisioning, authentication and access.
* Plan and deliver endpoint migrations between Microsoft Entra ID tenants, managing dependencies, device transitions, user access, testing and communications while minimising disruption.
* Manage Windows update policies, deployment rings and operating system upgrades, including compatibility testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, compliance monitoring and remediation of failed updates.
* Package, test, deploy and maintain Windows applications, including installation and detection logic, dependencies, upgrades and removal. Use WinGet and other appropriate tools to improve application management and employee self-service.
* Develop reusable PowerShell scripts and automation to detect and remediate recurring endpoint issues, reduce manual administration and improve reporting. Apply appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
* Collaborate with Security teams to manage endpoint vulnerabilities, maintain endpoint security tools and implement controls such as encryption, security baselines and local administrator restrictions.
* Provide L3 support for complex issues involving device enrolment, policy conflicts, application deployment, updates, authentication and device trust. Investigate root causes, coordinate vendor escalations and implement lasting fixes through established incident, problem and change management processes.
* Monitor and report on device health, patch and device compliance, provisioning success and application deployment outcomes. Use findings to prioritise improvements and reduce recurring incidents.
* Contribute to the EUC roadmap and own assigned improvements from investigation and design through testing, implementation and operational handover, with clear rollout and recovery plans.
* Maintain technical documentation and runbooks, share knowledge, and provide training for technical teams and end users.

**Essential Skills & Requirements**

* Proven experience in a senior endpoint engineering or L3 EUC role, with strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting of enterprise Windows environments.
* Strong Microsoft Intune expertise across device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update management and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing and supporting Windows Autopilot and automated device provisioning.
* Experience migrating Windows endpoints from one Microsoft Entra ID tenant to another, including planning, dependency assessment, execution and validation, with consideration for device enrolment, user profiles and data, authentication and application access.
* Experience managing Windows updates and operating system upgrades through controlled testing, deployment rings, compliance monitoring and remediation.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills, with experience developing and maintaining scripts for endpoint administration, detection, remediation and reporting.
* Experience packaging and deploying Win32 applications, including installation contexts, detection rules, dependencies, upgrades and deployment failure investigation. Practical familiarity with WinGet.
* Experience managing endpoint hardware lifecycles, including asset records, warranty and support status, refresh planning, redeployment and secure decommissioning.
* A strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID device identities, join types, groups and the relationship between device compliance and Conditional Access.
* A strong understanding of Okta or an equivalent identity provider (IdP), including single sign-on, multifactor authentication and user lifecycle management, with the ability to investigate endpoint-related authentication issues.
* Familiarity with Google Chrome browser management.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, using logs, testing and evidence to identify root causes, recognise recurring problems and verify solutions.
* A practical, service-focused approach, with a willingness to learn macOS administration and actively contribute to both Windows and Mac endpoint services.
* Strong communication skills in spoken and written English, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, provide timely updates on progress and risks, produce useful documentation and share knowledge effectively across global teams.

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Enterprise macOS administration using Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, application deployment, patching and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrolment.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph and REST APIs to automate endpoint administration, reporting and integrations.
* Experience with version control and maintaining shared scripts and technical documentation.
* Experience with endpoint detection and response, secure remote access or privileged access management tools.
* Experience implementing endpoint monitoring and telemetry tools to improve device reliability and employee experience.
* Familiarity with collaboration and service delivery platforms such as Jira, Slack and Zoom.
* Bash or shell scripting experience for macOS.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or relevant Jamf certifications.

**What happens next?**
If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
  
  
***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.

* Proficiency with network monitoring and management platforms including SolarWinds NPM/NCM, ExtraHop, NetBrain, Panorama, and AlgoSec.
* Experience supporting cloud networking services including DNS, load balancers, CDNs, VPCs, subnets, security groups, and cloud connectivity solutions.
* Experience using Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies including Terraform, Ansible, Python, or similar automation frameworks.
* Good communication skills with the ability to document troubleshooting procedures, operational standards, and technical solutions effectively.
* Good understanding of security frameworks and regulations including ISO 27001, NIST, and PCI DSS.

**Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent**

title: Senior Lead - QC System - Empower
description:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Lead - QC System - Empower will deliver and support Empower (CDS) solutions for Quality Control (QC) laboratories. The role includes project work and BAU support, platform delivery, upgrades, automation, L2/L3 support, version upgrades and practical exposure to automation capabilities.
  
  
The role diagnoses complex issues using logs, metrics, interfaces, data flows and system behaviour and implements approved corrective actions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Empower solution delivery and configuration**

* Configure and support Empower projects, methods, processing methods, reports and user security for QC labs.
* Translate QC and analytical requirements into Empower configurations following defined standards.
* Maintain Empower master data, templates and configuration items in line with global governance.
* Configuration and scripts held under version control, peer review before release, scripted or automated regression tests, and test evidence kept with the change.

**Projects and modernization**

* Contribute to the design and execution of Empower Citrix to Azure migration (environment build, cutover planning, testing and rollout).
* Support Empower version upgrades (assessment, remediation, regression testing, deployment).
* Work with infrastructure and platform teams to optimise performance, scalability and resilience in Azure.
* Participate in integration work (e.g. LIMS, instruments, archival solutions) as part of modernisation projects.

**Automation and optimisation**

* Use Empower automation capabilities (e.g. custom calculations, processing workflows, scheduling, scripts/macros where applicable) to streamline QC operations.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and standardise analytical workflows.
* Document and share reusable automation patterns and best practices within the team.
* Uses approved AI assistants to build and test Empower configuration and scripts and checks the output before submitting it for review.

**BAU support and operations**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for incidents, problems and service requests related to Empower.
* Perform root cause analysis for complex issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Deliver small enhancements and configuration changes through formal change management.
* Support periodic maintenance activities, including patching, housekeeping and performance tuning.
* Follow GxP, data integrity and quality procedures in all Empower changes and support activities.

**Key Relationships / Customers**

* Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders
* Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users

**Digital & Technology Stakeholders**

* Product Managers and Product Owners
* Solution and Enterprise Architects
* Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams
* Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams
* Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams

**Other**

* Technology vendors
* System integrators and specialist engineering partners
* Managed service and support providers

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences or a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Empower CDS administration and configuration in QC / GMP environments.
* Experience supporting or implementing QC/analytical lab systems (preferably Empower) under GxP.
* Practical exposure to at least one of:
* Empower environment migrations (Citrix, virtualised or cloud-hosted setups).
* Empower version upgrades, including testing and validation.
* Empower automations (processing workflows, custom calculations, scripts, or scheduling tools).
* Good understanding of QC lab processes, chromatographic workflows and data integrity principles.
* Knowledge of CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+) in the context of CDS systems.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management and working with global support models.

title: Subject Matter Expert
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
IT Services and Support is seeking an experienced Subject Matter Expert to support IT Service Desk Operations and Transition teams. The expert drives end-to-end intelligent automation in IT service desks, designing RPA bots, multi-agent systems, and MLOps pipelines that handle incident routing, predictive maintenance, and remediation autonomously. By integrating LLMs with tools like ServiceNow and Azure, this role transforms reactive support into proactive, It fosters a hybrid human-AI environment, enhancing global scalability and compliance in high-volume environments.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Design and prototype Agentic AI workflows (LLM-based agents, optionally combined with RPA) for intelligent ticket classification, routing, and first-line resolution across incident, request, and change management.
* Architect secure integration points between AI agents and enterprise systems -ServiceNow, Active Directory/Windows Server, VMware, Power BI, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) -ensuring agents operate within existing identity, access, and network controls.
* Apply infrastructure and threat/vulnerability management expertise to assess and mitigate security risks introduced by AI agents with system- or API-level access.
* Build and maintain RAG-based knowledge retrieval so agent responses are grounded in verified enterprise knowledge bases, reducing hallucination risk.
* Develop PowerShell and/or Python automation to bridge AI agent actions with Windows Server, VMware, and cloud environments.
* Partner with delivery partners, vendors and internal ITSM stakeholders to translate business requirements into agent architecture and working prototypes.
* Monitor agent performance and reliability as part of the broader service desk platform, contributing to team-level uptime and SLA targets; lead root-cause analysis for automation or infrastructure failures.
* Conduct testing and validation, including A/B testing, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and ROI in production service desk scenarios.
* Contribute positively for HLD/LLD architecture – understand – all components and effectively contribute towards refining the same
* Document architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures; train service desk staff on AI tool usage and troubleshooting.
* Support cost-effective scaling of cloud resources for AI inference during high-volume periods.
* Evaluate emerging capabilities, such as multimodal AI for tickets containing screenshots, logs, or voice input, for future roadmap

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering discipline.
* 3+ years in IT infrastructure/systems administration (Windows Server, MECM, VMware, Active Directory), including hands-on exposure to LLM or agentic AI tooling (e.g., LangChain or equivalent) is a must
* Working knowledge of Python and/or PowerShell for scripting and automation is a must
* Experience in Admin or developer with AWS cloud services; Azure exposure is a must
* ServiceNow platform experience strongly preferred is a must
* ITIL certification preferred.
* Background in threat and vulnerability management, particularly as it relates to securing AI-integrated systems is a plus
* Ability to bridge infrastructure knowledge with agentic AI design -understanding how automation decisions affect the real IT estate (Active Directory, Windows Server, VMware) the agent acts on is must have

**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.
  
  
That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.
  
  
Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.
  
  
Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together
  
  
**Already Working @Teva?**
Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development.
  
  
**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. title: MS Engineer - Network
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
  
  
You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
  
  
You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
  
  
Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
