title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
description:
**Lead WLAN Test Engineer**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
8–12 years

**About the Company**

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company’s business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company’s activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves.

**About the Role**

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802.11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards.
* Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution.
* Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior.
* Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802.11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior.
* Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution.
* Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders.
* Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802.11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage.
* Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation.
* Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution.
* Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior.
* Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution.
* Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation.
* Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes.
* A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization.
* Practical strength in Python automation, 802.11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis.
* Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

**Why Join Us**

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices.

**What We Offer**

* A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation.
* Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams.
* The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz’s broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
**Company Description**
Walk Again Rehab is a specialized neurorehabilitation center focused on helping individuals regain movement and the ability to walk after stroke, spinal cord injury, or traumatic brain injury. Drawing on the proven principle of neuroplasticity, the team leverages the brain’s capacity to reorganize and compensate for damaged areas. The center uses advanced neuromodulation technologies and evidence-based therapies to deliver intensive, goal-oriented rehabilitation programs. Walk Again Rehab’s approach is patient-centered, aiming for meaningful functional recovery in a focused period of therapy. Professionals joining the team contribute to a mission of restoring independence and quality of life for each patient.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Physiotherapist role based in Bengaluru South. The Physiotherapist will assess patients with neurological conditions, develop individualized treatment plans, and deliver hands-on therapy sessions focused on improving mobility, balance, gait, and functional independence. Daily responsibilities include conducting detailed physical and functional evaluations, setting measurable rehabilitation goals, and implementing neurorehabilitation techniques in coordination with neuromodulation technologies. The role involves documenting patient progress, adjusting treatment plans based on outcomes, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to ensure integrated, high-quality care. The Physiotherapist will also educate patients and caregivers on exercises, safety, and home programs to support continued recovery.
  
**Qualifications**

* Professional qualification in Physiotherapy (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Physiotherapy or equivalent) with valid registration as required by local regulations.
* Strong knowledge of neurorehabilitation principles, including assessment and treatment of stroke, spinal cord injury, and traumatic brain injury.
* Experience applying therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, gait training, balance training, and functional mobility techniques in clinical practice.
* Ability to work with advanced rehabilitation and neuromodulation technologies, or willingness to learn and adapt to new clinical tools.
* Solid clinical reasoning, treatment planning, and outcome measurement skills, with attention to patient safety and evidence-based practice.
* Effective communication skills for interacting with patients, families, and multidisciplinary team members, including clear documentation and reporting.
* Capacity to work in a fast-paced, patient-centered environment, demonstrating empathy, professionalism, and cultural sensitivity.
* Prior experience in neurological or rehabilitation settings is preferred; additional certifications in neurophysiotherapy or related specialties are an advantage.

title: TICKET ANALYST
description:
**TICKET ANALYST**

SUPPORT OPERATIONS  ·  A4I (IIIT-B × Microsoft)

**Organization:**

A4I (IIIT-B × Microsoft)

**Location:**

IIIT Bangalore

**Type:**

Contract (through March 2027)

**Experience:**

3 to 5 years

**About A4I**

AI Innovation and Inclusion Initiative (A4I) is a partnership between Microsoft and IIIT-B, collaborating with non-profit partners to harness AI for solving real-world challenges in education, healthcare, accessibility, and agriculture. A4I evolves innovations into open-source Digital Public Goods (DPGs) that are deployable at scale, fostering a strong AI innovation ecosystem for social impact.

**The Opportunity**

A4I applications are used every day by teachers, frontline health workers and field staff across India. When something breaks for them, they cannot wait. This year's expanded programme has grown both our user base and the volume of tickets from the field, and the need for a dedicated person to be the first line between the people using our products and the team building them comes directly from that.

As Ticket Analyst, you will own the ticket queue across our partner applications. You will understand what the user is actually experiencing, talk to them, reproduce the problem, do the first round of investigation, and hand the team a clean, evidence-backed issue. When the fix ships, you close the loop with the user and confirm it works for them.

**What You Will Be Doing**

**Triaging Tickets**

* Monitor incoming tickets across partner applications and from domain partners; classify each by application, type and user impact, assign a severity using agreed definitions, and work to response and resolution targets, flagging at-risk tickets early.
* Spot duplicates and patterns, and flag recurring issues or sudden spikes to the team before they become outages.

**Reproducing and Investigating Issues**

* Work with users and domain partners to gather detail (device, app version, steps taken, screenshots, time of the issue) and reproduce the problem in staging or production-like environments.
* Do first-level log and data investigation using guided tools such as Log Analytics queries, dashboards and database viewers, following runbooks, to confirm whether an issue is user-specific, data-specific or systemic.
* Raise well-structured GitHub issues from validated tickets: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual behaviour, evidence, app version, severity and suggested owner, linked to the original ticket and kept updated with findings.

**Communicating and Escalating**

* Acknowledge every ticket promptly and keep users and domain partners updated in plain language, and in regional languages where needed. Share fix timelines once Product and Engineering have confirmed them.
* Escalate to the Product and Engineering team, with evidence, when an issue is critical or cannot be resolved with runbook steps. Critical means an outage, data loss or incorrect data shown to users, many users affected, a partner-visible or deadline-critical impact, or a security or privacy concern.
* Refer priority conflicts and blockers to the Product Leads for a decision.

**Verifying Fixes and Closing the Loop**

* Verify shipped fixes against the original steps to reproduce, in staging and then in production.
* Confirm resolution with the end user, capture a brief satisfaction rating or feedback, and close the ticket at that point. Reopen and re-escalate with fresh evidence if the fix does not hold.

**Improving How Support Runs**

* Create and maintain runbooks, triage playbooks and a knowledge base of known issues, workarounds and FAQs.
* Report weekly on ticket volume, top issues by application, resolution times, reopen rates, user satisfaction and ticket quality; contribute to post-incident reviews for significant issues.



**Must-Have Skills**

* **Customer-facing communication:**

  Proven ability to handle frustrated or non-technical users with patience and clarity. Strong written English; working fluency in at least one of Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Bengali.
* **Ticket triage and ownership:**

  Hands-on experience running a support queue in a tool such as GitHub Issues, Jira, Freshdesk or Zendesk: prioritising, tracking and following through.
* **Structured bug reproduction:**

  Ability to turn a vague complaint into precise steps, expected versus actual behaviour, and supporting evidence.
* **Investigative curiosity:**

  Comfort reading logs, dashboards and simple database records to answer "what happened to this user?" Willingness to learn basic queries; a software development background is not required.
* **Clear written documentation:**

  Ability to write precise GitHub issues, runbooks and knowledge-base articles that others can act on.
* **Follow-through:**

  Reliability in closing the loop: confirming fixes with users and documenting outcomes proactively.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 3 to 5 years in technical support, customer success, support operations, or a similar user-facing role for a software product.
* Comfort using spreadsheets and basic data lookups; clear, structured written documentation.
* Ability to work with distributed field users and partner teams across time zones and connectivity constraints.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting mobile or WhatsApp-based applications used by low-literacy or low-connectivity user groups.
* Familiarity with basic SQL, MongoDB queries, Azure Log Analytics (KQL) or similar query tools.
* Prior work with NGOs, public-sector programmes, education or healthcare field operations.
* Experience writing knowledge-base articles, user guides or support runbooks.
* Familiarity with AI-powered products and the types of failure they produce, such as wrong or missing responses, transcription errors or language issues.

Job Description  L2 Network Engineer

Job Title

L2 Network Engineer

Experience

3-4 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled L2 Network Engineer with 34 years of experience in enterprise network operations, troubleshooting, and infrastructure support. The candidate should have a strong understanding of industry-standard networking technologies, protocols, and best practices, with hands-on experience in managing LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, and network security devices.

The candidate will be responsible for handling Level 1 and 2 network incidents, performing root cause analysis, implementing network changes, monitoring network performance, and ensuring high availability and reliability of the organization's network infrastructure in accordance with established operational and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

Network Operations and Troubleshooting

Provide L1 and 2 support for enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, and internet connectivity issues.

Troubleshoot network incidents involving connectivity, latency, packet loss, routing, switching, and wireless performance.

Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Support network incident, problem, and change management in accordance with ITIL best practices.

Monitor network availability, performance, and capacity, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.

Escalate critical or unresolved issues to L3 teams, OEMs, and service providers as required.

Routing and Switching

Possess a strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI layers, subnetting, VLANs, and inter-VLAN routing.

Hands-on experience with routing protocols.

Working knowledge of static routing, default routing, route redistribution, and troubleshooting routing issues.

Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 switching, trunking, EtherChannel/LACP, STP/RSTP, and port security.

Understand ARP, DHCP, DNS, ICMP, NAT, ACLs, and network segmentation.

Support switch port configuration, VLAN assignments, MAC address analysis, and network access issues.

Wireless Networking

title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:
**The team**

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

**Your work profile**

We are migrating a portfolio of on-premise Java Spring Boot applications — many of which depend on on-prem Apache Kafka clusters for event streaming, and inter-service messaging — to Amazon Web Services. We need an experienced engineer who has done this end-to-end before: assessing applications, untangling on-prem dependencies, re-platforming to AWS-managed services where it makes sense (and lifting-and-shifting where it doesn't), cutting over with zero data loss, and leaving behind a clean, observable, cost-efficient footprint. You will own technical migration of multiple Spring Boot services from discovery through stabilization, partnering with the application teams who built them and the platform team that runs AWS.

**Key skills required:**

• 8+ years of experience developing production-grade backend applications using Java

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data, and Spring Security

• 5+ years of production experience with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic design, partitioning, consumer groups, schema evolution, and Kafka operations

• 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering production workloads on AWS

• Proven experience owning end-to-end migration of multiple on-premise applications and Kafka workloads to AWS

• Strong experience with Java 17 / 21 and modern Java features, including records, pattern matching, virtual threads, and JVM performance tuning

• Strong experience with Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6, including Jakarta EE migration and modernization of deprecated APIs

• Hands-on experience with Spring for Apache Kafka and/or Spring Cloud Stream, including Kafka listeners, error handling, retries, transactions, and transactional producers

• Experience with Kafka migration tools and strategies such as MirrorMaker 2, MSK Replicator, or Confluent Replicator

• Strong knowledge of AWS services including EKS, ECS / Fargate, RDS / Aurora, S3, IAM, MSK, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, KMS, Route 53, ALB / NLB, VPC, API Gateway, and related services

• Hands-on experience with Docker and containerization, including multi-stage builds and production-ready container images

• Experience deploying containerized Java applications on Amazon EKS, ECS Fargate, App Runner, or Lambda based on workload requirements

• Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using AWS CDK and/or Terraform

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and/or GitHub Actions

• Experience with relational and NoSQL data migration using AWS DMS, RDS / Aurora, DocumentDB, or MongoDB Atlas

• Strong understanding of AWS security, IAM, encryption, secrets management, TLS, security groups, VPC Endpoints, PrivateLink, WAF, and GuardDuty

• Experience implementing observability using Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, AWS X-Ray, Datadog, or Dynatrace

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot application, JVM, Kafka, network, and cloud performance issues

**Preferred Qualifications**

• CKA, CKAD, or CKS certification

• Experience with hybrid cloud networking, including AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN, PrivateLink, and on-premise-to-AWS routing

**Key Skills & Competencies**

• Java 17 / 21 and Spring Boot 3

• Spring Framework 6, Spring Data, and Spring Security

• Apache Kafka 3.x and Spring for Apache Kafka

• Amazon MSK / MSK Serverless / MSK Connect

• Kafka migration, replication, partitioning, consumer groups, and zero-data-loss cutover

• AWS EKS, ECS Fargate, Lambda, and containerized workloads

• AWS IAM, VPC, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and security services

Bambinos.live is an EdTech company offering live, small-group online classes for children aged 4–15. Our programs span leadership and life skills, Chess, Mathematics, English, Science, AI, and more. We serve families across India, the Middle East, and North America, supported by technology that helps parents track their child's learning progress.

Role Overview

We are looking for a results-driven
**Growth Manager**
to lead customer acquisition and drive business growth across multiple channels. This role involves building and optimizing marketing funnels, managing campaign budgets, experimenting with new acquisition channels, and improving conversion rates from lead generation to paid enrolment.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in WhatsApp and email marketing, programmatic advertising, performance marketing, and data-driven growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities

1. WhatsApp & Email Marketing

* Build and optimize WhatsApp journeys for lead nurturing, demo reminders, follow-ups, re-engagement, and conversion.
* Manage broadcast campaigns, audience segmentation, and opt-in compliance.
* Develop email lifecycle campaigns, including welcome sequences, lead nurturing, win-back, and referral campaigns.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, and conversion metrics while conducting A/B tests.

2. Paid Acquisition & Performance Marketing

* Plan, test, and scale programmatic advertising through Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) and owned-and-operated (O&O) networks.
* Explore new paid acquisition channels across publisher, OTT, and app networks.
* Manage and scale Google Ads campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen.
* Optimize campaign budgets, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and landing pages.
* Collaborate across Meta and Google Ads to improve overall acquisition performance.

3. Growth Funnels & Conversion Optimization

* Own the complete customer journey:
  **Lead Generation → Demo Booking → Demo Attendance → Paid Enrolment.**
* Identify conversion gaps and implement strategies to improve funnel performance.
* Design and experiment with new acquisition funnels, including webinars, workshops, assessments, and lead magnets.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking across advertising platforms and GA4.

4. Content & Organic Growth

* Identify opportunities to use short-form videos, parent testimonials, teacher-led content, and SEO to generate demand.
* Work with creative teams to develop high-performing marketing content.
* Use campaign insights and performance data to guide content strategy.

5. Referral, Influencer & Partnership Marketing

* Build referral and ambassador programs to drive customer acquisition.
* Develop influencer and creator partnerships within the parenting and education space.
* Establish partnerships with schools, parent communities, and complementary brands.
* Explore community-led growth opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency.

6. Analytics, Reporting & Budget Management

* Track key metrics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), cost per demo, demo attendance rate, conversion rate, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
* Analyse campaign performance by channel, course, and geography.
* Build dashboards and reports connecting marketing spend to revenue.
* Allocate budgets based on performance insights and growth opportunities.
* Present weekly performance updates and recommendations to leadership.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in growth marketing or performance marketing, preferably in B2C, EdTech, or subscription-based businesses.
* Hands-on experience building WhatsApp marketing journeys using platforms such as WATI, Interakt, Gupshup, or AiSensy.
* Experience managing email lifecycle campaigns using tools such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Klaviyo, or Mailchimp.
* Practical experience running and scaling Google Ads campaigns.
* Hands-on experience with DSPs or O&O advertising networks, with a focus on conversions and revenue.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, conversion optimization, and lifecycle marketing.
* Proficiency in GA4, Google Sheets/Excel, and marketing dashboards.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret attribution data and connect marketing performance to business outcomes.
* Ability to independently manage budgets, run experiments, identify growth opportunities, and take ownership of results.
* Good understanding of how paid, owned, earned, referral, and influencer channels work together.

Good to Have

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads.
* Experience in EdTech, children's learning, or parent-focused B2C businesses.
* Experience marketing across India, the Middle East, and North America.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Metabase, or Looker.
* Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), server-side tracking, or offline conversion uploads.
* Experience building referral or affiliate programs from scratch.

Why Join Bambinos?

* Be part of a growing EdTech company serving families across multiple markets.
* Take ownership of growth strategy, experimentation, and customer acquisition.
* Work in a fast-paced environment where ideas can be tested and implemented quickly.
* Make a measurable impact on business growth and customer acquisition.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with a brief note describing one growth funnel they have managed, the improvements they implemented, and the measurable results achieved.

title: Brand Communication Manager
description:
**About us**

  
  

CLO Virtual Fashion is the industry-leading provider of innovative 3D products and ecosystem solutions used in fashion, film, and gaming. With over two decades of research and development in true-to-life 3D garment simulation, CLO Virtual Fashion's mission is to empower users at every step of the garment journey, from concept to design, manufacturing to marketing, and fitting to styling. In addition to 3D garment design software (CLO & Marvelous Designer), CLO Virtual Fashion is the creator of CLO-SET (a digital asset management and collaboration platform), CONNECT (a digital fashion hub and marketplace), and consumer-facing solutions such as e-commerce virtual fittings.

  
  

Founded in 2009, CLO's interconnected and ever-growing product ecosystem is built to power the future of everything related to garments. We currently have 13 offices located in 11 countries across North America, Asia, Europe, and South America, and are continuing to expand to serve users around the globe.

  
  

**Position Overview**

  
  

We are looking for an individual contributor who can effectively communicate our brand message and create engaging content. As a member of the brand communications team in Bangalore, this role will be crucial in shaping our brand communication and content creation efforts. We are a small, tight-knit team and the environment will be close to that of a start-up; we wear a lot of hats, brainstorm a lot of ideas, and are filled with passion for all things fashion & 3D. As Brand Communications Manager, you will serve as an integral member of the team by coordinating and developing marketing policies, programs, and campaigns.

  
  

The Brand Communications Manager will implement a comprehensive plan inclusive of client and industry partnerships, event executions and content creation for platforms such as social media, company blog and our website. Our team has grand visions of how to reach our users and clients, but it will be your job to bring these dreams to life.

**Responsibilities**

  
* Implementing an integrated strategic cross-platform communications plan & marketing calendar in alignment with CLO’s communication priorities to advance our brand identity and increase awareness and visibility in the South Asia Region and GCC
  
* Analyzing industry trends and activity to best reach key markets
  
* Developing relationships with publications in tech, fashion, and relevant industries
  
* Collaborating with the global Brand Communications and local India BizDev/Design team to plan and execute branding strategy and content creation
  
* Producing engaging content across multiple digital platforms, including CLO’s website and social media channels relevant to our geography & market
  
* Outreaching to our large group of existing clients to promote cross-branding and story-telling through communications including video content, trade show participation, and company blog posts
  
* Distributing press releases to announce major updates to the software or landmark items through BusinessWire and other services
  
* Strategically implementing software updates and major company announcements into the brand communications plan
  
* Tracking and measuring the success of campaigns with the ability to course-correct and recommend alternative solutions as needed and share the insights with the business team periodically
  
* Spearheading the planning of regional trade shows and events, and working in tandem with the global Brand Communications team & the India Team to plan and execute events that are on a global scale
  
* Receiving and processing all requests related to branding and marketing
  
* Exercising judgment in assessing and prioritizing potential marketing opportunities
  
* Planning asset and content production needs, fully understanding daily communication plans and also being able to create artwork as an individual contributor
  
* Ensuring adherence to the company’s global channel strategy, brand identity, tone of voice, formats, and templates
  
  

**Requirements**

  
* Fluent in verbal and written English
  
* Bachelor’s degree in fashion communication, marketing, PR, communications, or related field
  
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in marketing, communications, or related fields
  
* Familiarity with PR and marketing tools like Google Analytics, Mailchimp, BusinessWire
  
* Ability to track and analyze marketing metrics to assess campaign success and recommend improvements based on data
  
* Strong knowledge of media content and formats, especially in the digital area
  
* Experience in working with client-side or in media/creative agencies, and able to contribute individually as needed
  
* Expertise in formats and assets for owned media (website, email, push, SMS) with a strong visual and creative eye for content aligned with brand guidelines
  
* Familiarity with relevant production management software and communication tools like PSD, CD, AI, and InDesign
  
* Experience with content planning and production for multiple channels in a fast-paced, flexible environment
  
  

**Plus if you have**

  
* Fluency in Hindi and/or Bangla
  
* Knowledge of SEO
  
* Experience in managing social media channels for tech/ software companies

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer, OnePACS**
**Position Overview**
The Forward Deployed Engineer is a senior technical individual contributor who works at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, reliability, and customer operations.
  
  
This role is built for an engineer who can enter complex production and customer situations, understand the full system, restore stability, and convert operational demand into lasting improvements.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer title reflects the longer-term direction of the role: an engineer positioned close to real-world problems and capable of applying broad technical judgment across the product, platform, infrastructure, data, and customer workflow.
  
  
Within OnePACS, the role is currently focused primarily on site reliability, platform engineering, systems diagnosis, and operational improvement. It is not a customer-embedded custom development role, a traditional application developer position, or a ticket-processing support function.
  
  
Development may be required to automate operational work, improve diagnostic or administrative tooling, integrate systems, or implement targeted fixes within the OnePACS platform. This may include work in C# and .NET for Windows-based OnePACS applications and services, as well as Python, PowerShell, Bash, and SQL for automation, data operations, troubleshooting, and cloud or platform tooling. The role is not expected to own broad feature development, but candidates should be comfortable reading, modifying, and safely deploying code when a durable solution requires it.
  
  
The role will generally spend approximately 70 percent of its capacity on proactive reliability and platform improvement and 30 percent responding to escalations, production issues, migrations, data requests, integrations, and other high-value operational needs.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate and resolve complex Tier 2 and Tier 3 issues across applications, infrastructure, integrations, databases, and customer configurations.
* Assist with migrations, data requests, technical escalations, and production-originated needs.
* Diagnose issues using logs, metrics, alerts, database analysis, infrastructure signals, and customer workflow context.
* Restore service safely while identifying the conditions that caused or contributed to the issue.
* Develop durable fixes, scripts, automation, operational tooling, and technical guardrails.
* Identify patterns across incidents, requests, and customer dissatisfiers, then translate them into reliability and platform improvements.
* Improve observability, alerting, runbooks, recovery procedures, and operational readiness.
* Reduce recurring manual work and dependence on undocumented institutional knowledge.
* Partner with Engineering, DevOps, Product, technical support, and customer-facing teams to prioritize work based on customer impact, risk, frequency, and long-term value.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Critical customer and production issues are resolved with speed and sound technical judgment.
* Recurring issues and manual requests are reduced through automation and durable engineering improvements.
* Migrations and operational changes become safer and more repeatable.
* Systems become easier to observe, diagnose, operate, recover, and scale.
* Operational knowledge is captured in tooling, documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Customer and production insights are converted into improvements in product quality, stability, and resilience.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, production engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong diagnostic and root cause analysis skills across complex or distributed systems.
* Experience supporting business-critical or highly available software environments.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-hosted systems, preferably AWS.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and production observability.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL-based investigation.
* Ability to automate repetitive work using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, or comparable tools.
* Familiarity with Linux-based systems and a willingness to troubleshoot Windows-based applications and services when needed.
* Ability to balance immediate operational needs with longer-term engineering priorities.
* Clear written and verbal communication during incidents, escalations, and cross-functional problem solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS and containerized workloads, including ECS, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with PostgreSQL.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with healthcare technology, PACS, medical imaging, DICOM, HL7, or clinical integrations.
* Experience supporting migrations, data movement, or customer-specific technical workflows.
* Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience in regulated software environments, including FDA, SaMD, or medical device quality systems.

**The Person We Are Looking For**
You are comfortable working where software, infrastructure, data, and real-world customer workflows meet.
  
  
You can respond to an urgent need without allowing urgency to become the permanent operating model. You distinguish symptoms from root causes, isolated requests from broader patterns, and short-term repairs from durable solutions.
  
  
You bring calm judgment to ambiguous technical situations, learn unfamiliar systems quickly, communicate clearly, and leave systems stronger than you found them.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

title: Platform Engineer I
description:
**About Blackhawk Network:**
Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.
  
  
**Overview:**
Our Operations Command Centre (OCC) is looking for a Platform Engineer with strong technical foundations, exceptional problem-solving ability, and a passion for building reliable systems.
  
  
This is not a traditional Platform Engineering or NOC role.
  
  
You'll split your time between engineering solutions and operating our production platforms—maintaining the health of BHN's production services while building the automation, observability, and AI-driven capabilities that make incidents less frequent, easier to diagnose, and faster to resolve.
  
  
As part of the OCC, you'll play an active role in Major Incident Management, partnering with engineering teams to diagnose and restore production services during critical incidents. Outside of incident response, you'll build dashboards, improve monitoring, develop automation, analyse operational data, and engineer intelligent tooling that continuously improves platform reliability.
  
  
This role provides exceptional exposure to large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability platforms, automation, AI-assisted software development, and production engineering.
  
  
If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex technical problems, and want to accelerate your engineering career, we'd love to hear from you
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
Major Incident Response & Production Operations
  
  

* Participate in the 24×7 on-call rotation supporting BHN's production platforms.
* Monitor pro health using modern observability platforms.
* Lead or support Majo duction r Incident bridges, coordinating technical teams during high-severity production incidents.
* Perform technical triage, identify probable causes, and drive rapid service restoration.
* Communicate clearly with engineers, leadership, and business stakeholders throughout incidents.
* Lead post-incident reviews focused on learning and continuous improvement.
* Identify recurring operational pain points and engineer permanent solutions.

Platform Engineering & Automation
  
  

* Develop automation that reduces manual operational effort.
* Build internal engineering tools that improve developer productivity and platform reliability.
* Create dashboards, alerts, health scores, and operational insights.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment safety.
* Automate operational workflows and repetitive tasks.
* Build self-service capabilities for engineering teams.
* Develop auto-remediation and self-healing capabilities.
* Continuously improve platform reliability through engineering rather than manual intervention.

Observability & Reliability Engineering
  
  

* Design alerts that detect customer-impacting issues early while minimising alert fatigue.
* Improve platform visibility through metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Analyse production behaviour to identify reliability improvements.
* Develop operational KPIs and engineering health metrics.
* Define and measure Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Use operational data to drive engineering decisions and improve platform resilience.

AI Engineering & Intelligent Operations
  
  

* Use AI-assisted software development tools to improve engineering productivity.
* Develop AI-powered incident summarisation and communication capabilities.
* Build intelligent root cause analysis and diagnostic tooling.
* Create operational copilots and engineering assistants.
* Enhance alerts with contextual intelligence.
* Automate diagnostics and operational workflows.
* Build AI-driven orchestration and auto-remediation capabilities.
* Develop engineering knowledge systems that improve troubleshooting and accelerate learning.

You'll Gain Experience Across
  
  

* Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD Engineering
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability & Monitoring
* Major Incident Management
* Production Operations
* Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Automation Engineering

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**About Aindra Systems**

Aindra Systems (
www.aindra.in
) is an early-stage deep-tech startup based in Bengaluru. We build AI-powered diagnostic systems that help detect life-threatening diseases like cancer faster and more accurately. Our products combine optics, mechatronics, computer vision and artificial intelligence. We’re proud to be one of the few deep-tech healthcare companies in India building hardware and AI together, from the ground up.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to design and develop the physical side of our diagnostic devices. This is a hands-on design role. You’ll take parts and assemblies from concept to prototype to production, and make sure they work well, can be manufactured and are easy to use.

You’ll work closely with our optics, electronics and software teams, and with vendors and manufacturers. If you enjoy solving real engineering problems and want your designs to reach hospitals and labs, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design mechanical parts, enclosures and multi-module assemblies for medical devices
* Integrate optical components, electronics and moving mechanisms into compact, reliable designs
* Prepare detailed engineering drawings with GD&T, and perform tolerance analysis
* Build and test prototypes, including 3D-printed parts, mock-ups and early engineering models
* Apply DFM, DFA and DFS principles in every design
* Work with vendors on part development, sampling and quality checks
* Support design validation, FMEA and design documentation in line with ISO 13485 requirements
* Make design improvements based on testing and field feedback

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
* 3–4 years of hands-on experience in mechanical product design, preferably in MedTech, electronics or precision equipment
* Strong 3D CAD skills (Fusion 360 preferred), including assemblies, exploded views and motion studies
* Good command of GD&T, engineering drawings and tolerance stack-up
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, including:
* Injection moulding, vacuum casting and silicone moulding
* CNC machining, milling and turning
* Sheet metal fabrication, thermoforming and 3D printing
* Practical prototyping experience
* Experience working with cross-functional teams (electronics, optics, software)
* Awareness of ISO 13485 or other regulated product development processes

**Good to Have**

* Experience designing of diagnostic, imaging or lab equipment
* Knowledge of medical-grade materials
* Exposure to FMEA and design validation activities

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Care about both form and function
* Take ownership of your work and enjoy seeing designs through to production
* Solve problems with creativity and engineering discipline
* Communicate clearly and work well across teams
* Are comfortable with the pace, constraints and multiple roles of a startup

**What We Offer**

* Access to leading academic researchers in mechatronics, biomedical engineering and AI
* The chance to design medical products that directly impact cancer diagnosis

**Location:**

Bengaluru, with local travel to vendors and suppliers

title: Associate Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an Associate Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team and support reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient production platforms across a multi-cloud, multi-region environment.

The Associate Cloud Operations Engineer is a
*hands-on, database-focused role*
responsible for executing well-defined operational and database administration activities, handling routine service requests, following established procedures, and assisting with production support for SaaS services and cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have foundational knowledge of databases and cloud technologies, with a strong interest in developing their skills in Cloud Operations and Database Administration.

The Associate Cloud Operations Engineer will work alongside experienced Cloud Operations engineers and collaborate with other teams to support day-to-day operations, database activities, production monitoring, incident resolution, automation, and continuous improvement. The role provides an opportunity to progressively develop the technical expertise and operational experience required to independently support the team’s platforms.

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in our Bangalore office.

**Job Requirements:**

* 0–2 years of experience in database administration, cloud operations, infrastructure support, DevOps, or a related technical role.
* Foundational knowledge of Oracle RDBMS.
* Basic understanding of relational database concepts, SQL, backup and recovery, and database performance fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Basic understanding of Linux and command-line operations.
* Exposure to shell scripting, Python, or similar scripting languages is preferred.
* Ability to follow documented operational procedures and work effectively within established processes.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to participate in maintenance activities and, after appropriate training, an on-call rotation.
* AWS, Azure, or any database-related certifications are a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Follow documented processes and procedures to support Oracle, PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
* Handle service requests and operational tickets in accordance with established processes and SLA requirements.
* Perform routine database administration and maintenance activities according to established operational standards and runbooks.
* Monitor production and non-production environments, respond to alerts, and follow documented troubleshooting and escalation procedures.
* Perform database schema maintenance and migrations using documented procedures and change-management processes.
* Execute database backup, restore, and recovery activities by following established runbooks and validation procedures.
* Use SQL and basic shell/Python scripting to perform routine operational, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Support database performance troubleshooting by gathering required information, performing documented checks, and escalating complex issues to senior engineers when needed.
* Perform tenant rebalancing and other scheduled maintenance activities by following established procedures and change controls.
* Follow security, access management, change management, incident management, and other Cloud Operations processes.
* Maintain accurate documentation and update operational runbooks when processes or procedures change.
* Work with experienced engineers to troubleshoot issues that fall outside established procedures or require deeper technical expertise.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge across the databases, cloud platforms, and operational tools supported by the team.
* Participate in the team's 24x7 on-call rotation after completing the required training, demonstrating readiness, and becoming familiar with the applicable operational runbooks.

title: SAP BASIS
description:
* Perform day-to-day SAP Basis administration and operational support across ECC, S/4HANA and related SAP systems.
* Support RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition environments and coordinate activities with SAP ECS/RISE teams.
* Manage and monitor SAP system availability, performance, background jobs, work processes, dumps, locks, RFCs and interfaces.
* Perform system start/stop, client administration, transport management and system refresh/copy activities.
* Support SAP kernel upgrades, Support Package/Stack upgrades, SPS updates and SAP Notes implementation.
* Perform SAP HANA administration activities, including monitoring, performance analysis, backup coordination and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate infrastructure-level activities such as OS, database, backup, restore, patching and maintenance with SAP RISE/ECS teams.
* Raise and manage SAP support cases/service requests, including follow-up with SAP until resolution.
* Support planned maintenance, upgrades, migrations and Production cutover activities.
* Perform proactive system monitoring, capacity/performance analysis and issue resolution.
* Support High Availability, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity activities.
* Work with functional, development, security, integration and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot SAP issues.
* Follow change, incident and problem management processes and maintain operational documentation/SOPs.
* Provide support for critical Production incidents and participate in on-call/weekend activities where required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Basis Administration.
* Experience supporting SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
* Hands-on knowledge of RISE with SAP / SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition.
* Good understanding of the shared responsibility model between customer/partner and SAP ECS in a RISE landscape.
* Strong knowledge of SAP HANA Database administration and monitoring.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager and/or SAP Cloud ALM.
* Experience with SAP system upgrades, kernel upgrades, patching, migrations and system refreshes.
* Strong understanding of TMS, RFC, SAP Notes, background jobs, spool, dumps, locks and performance monitoring.
* Experience in coordinating SAP-managed cloud activities through SAP for Me / service requests and support cases.
* Good understanding of HA/DR, backup/recovery, security, SSL certificates and connectivity.
* Knowledge of hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud would be an advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* SAP Basis/S/4HANA or RISE-related certification.
* Experience with SAP BTP connectivity and Cloud Connector.
* Experience in SAP migrations from on-premise environments to RISE with SAP.
* Knowledge of ITIL-based Incident, Problem and Change Management processes.
* Experience working in large global SAP landscapes and Production support environments.

description:

**SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward - we’re proud to be recognized as a

by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
The
**Lead Engineer (LE)**
serves as a principal technical leader within customer projects, overseeing the deployment and transition of technical solutions to address client requirements. Acting as a bridge between high-level architectural design and hands-on delivery, the LE ensures that solutions are practical, scalable, cost-efficient, and aligned with both organizational objectives and specific customer demands.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own all infrastructure and technical activities across the project lifecycle, ensuring consistent delivery.
* Act as the main contact for customer technical teams and, with the Project Manager, present the full solution architecture to the customer.
* Support the Bid team on technical designs: review Target Design Documents, anticipate on-premises and central provisioning, and contribute to Technical Impact Analysis (TIA).
* Work with Implementation Engineers to produce accurate delivery effort estimates.
* Define and run release management, including deployment readiness, environment validation, rollback planning and post-deployment checks.
* Lead capacity planning and performance tuning across platforms and infrastructure for scalability, stability and efficient resource use.
* Replace repetitive manual work with scripting, workflow automation and standard engineering practices, and define requirements for automating provisioning.
* Act as liaison to Engineering Managers on custom developments and product issues, raising and qualifying Requests for Action (RFAs).
* Run the Change Request process with clear business justification and technical scoping.
* Lead structured troubleshooting and coach the team through technical plans, knowledge sharing and cross-training.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* 8+ years deploying or supporting application software, with several full-lifecycle implementations.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech or B.E.) in Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or equivalent; a professional qualification is a plus.
* Strong Linux system administration.
* Hands-on experience with load balancers and DNS.
* Experience with application web servers.
* Scripting and automation skills for deployment and provisioning.
* Solid release, change and risk management practices.
* Systems thinking, with the ability to see how complex architectures fit together.
* Clear technical writing and the ability to explain complex topics to customers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer focus, coaching and conflict management skills, and willingness to travel.

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. - Serve as the primary administrator for the Intelex platform, managing user access, security roles, permissions, and system configurations.
- Design, build, and maintain workflows, forms, dashboards, reports, scorecards, and business intelligence elements.
- Manage data integrity, including imports/exports, data quality audits, and synchronization with other enterprise systems.
- Oversee platform upgrades, patches, and new module implementations.
- Maintain system documentation, including configuration guides, process manuals, and security matrices.
- Develop and customize Intelex applications using the platform’s configuration tools, scripting, and APIs.
- Create automated workflows and advanced reporting solutions to meet evolving business requirements.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to translate EHSQ needs into technical solutions.
- Provide Level 2/Level 3 technical support, troubleshooting complex issues, and resolving incidents efficiently.
- Monitor system performance, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
- Deliver training sessions, webinars, and user guides for administrators and end-users.
- Act as a liaison between business units, vendors (Intelex), and internal IT teams.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform usability, compliance, and value delivery.
- This role is for a client into construction platform for oil and gas.
- The role reports to an Internal project manager and a tech manager from client side.
- This is the very first role with such requirements in the team.
- Full-time role with usual morning hours.
- Outstation candidates are acceptable; open to Indian candidates from other countries who can work remotely due to urgency.
Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Intelex EHSQ Platform Specialist Profile with combined administration, development and support depth
* Mandatory (Experience 1) – Must have 5+ years hands-on on the Intelex EHSQ platform in an enterprise environment, covering all three of administration, development and support
* Mandatory (Experience 2) – Must have administered Intelex as primary admin: user access/security roles/permissions/configuration, workflows/forms/dashboards/reports/scorecards, upgrades/patches/module rollouts, and data imports-exports/quality audits
* Mandatory (Experience 3) – Must have developed and customized Intelex using the platform’s configuration tools, scripting and APIs, including automated workflows and advanced reporting
* Mandatory (Experience 4) – Must have delivered L2/L3 Intelex support: complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, incident resolution and user training
* Mandatory (Experience 5) – Must have supported large enterprise user bases and managed enterprise software implementations
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1) – Must have solid hands-on grounding in SQL/databases, JavaScript, REST APIs and integration technologies
* Mandatory (Tech skill 2) – Must have strong understanding of EHSQ processes (incident management/audits/risk assessment/compliance/training)
* Mandatory (Communication) – Must have excellent spoken and written English and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users
* Mandatory (Note): Must be willing to work in a hybrid model (2 days office) and be available to join within 15 days
* Preferred (Certification) – Intelex certification or advanced Intelex training
* Preferred (Education) – Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Information Systems/Environmental Health & Safety or a related field
* Preferred (Standards) – Knowledge of ISO 14001/ISO 45001/ISO 9001 or similar standards
* Preferred (Tools) – Experience with Power BI/Power Automate or advanced analytics tools

Experience: 5–8 years · Hybrid, 2 days in office · 5 days a week · Notice period less than 15 days · Also in: Pune, Noida, Chennai

title: Collaboration Platforms Administrator
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And Role**
We’re excited to bring on a Collaboration Platforms Administrator based in Bangalore, India. As part of eBay’s Global Collaboration Services organization, this support-focused role will provide day-to-day operational support for our enterprise collaboration ecosystem, with primary responsibility for email services, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack, in addition to other services managed by the Collaboration Platforms team. The position will work as part of a global team of 10 direct peers supporting collaboration services at enterprise scale. We rely on this person to help keep these platforms operating securely, reliably, and efficiently, serving as a key point of ownership for L3 requests, troubleshooting, and escalations. This role will partner closely with IAM, Helpdesk Support, Security, Procurement, Collaboration Platforms Engineering, and business stakeholders to support service reliability, user needs, and ongoing platform operations.
  
  
Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
  
  
Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment. Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools. Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.
  
  
The ITSS Collaboration Platforms team enables eBay employees to communicate, collaborate, and work securely across the globe.
  
  
We administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration technologies including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and a portfolio of SaaS collaboration applications. Our team focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable messaging and collaboration services while driving operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Collaboration Platform Administrator, you will provide operational support and administration for our collaboration ecosystem. You'll work closely with engineers, security teams, service owners, business partners, and vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement platform improvements, support integrations, and ensure our messaging and collaboration services remain highly available, secure, and scalable.
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and other SaaS collaboration services.
* Manage and troubleshoot enterprise email services, including mail flow, message hygiene, transport rules, mail routing, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and email authentication technologies such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Support enterprise email security by administering Cisco Cloud Email Security policies, investigating phishing and spoofing incidents, analyzing message traces, and partnering with Information Security on email-related threats and escalations.
* Perform day-to-day platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, incident response, and service restoration while meeting established service level objectives.
* Support platform security through identity management, access controls, data protection policies, and security best practices. Configure and support collaboration applications such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, and related productivity platforms.
* Implement and maintain integrations between collaboration platforms using APIs, automation tools, and third-party applications.
* Support AI-enabled capabilities across collaboration platforms, including AI assistants, workflow automation, MCP servers, approved third-party AI integrations, and emerging AI technologies.
* Create and maintain automation using PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop operational reporting, dashboards, and metrics to improve service health, platform adoption, email deliverability, and operational efficiency.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in change management activities, platform upgrades, testing, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Compliance, Legal, Vendor Support, and business stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues.
* Partner with service owners and vendors to evaluate new features, validate platform changes, and support the rollout of enhancements that improve security, reliability, and the employee collaboration experience.
* Participate in a global follow-the-sun weekday operational support rotation, providing on-call coverage during assigned regional business hours and ensuring seamless support through coordinated handoffs across global teams.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience administering enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms in large-scale environments.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, and enterprise email infrastructure.
* Experience administering enterprise email security platforms such as Cisco Cloud Email Security (IronPort), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of enterprise mail flow, SMTP, message routing, connectors, transport rules, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and email security best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex email delivery issues, message trace analysis, phishing investigations, and mail routing problems.
* Experience supporting SaaS collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting identity and access management technologies, including SSO, SAML, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, and enterprise authentication.
* Experience working with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, Slack APIs, automation platforms, or scripting languages such as PowerShell or Google Apps Script.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, AI agents, MCP servers, workflow automation, and enterprise governance of AI capabilities.
* Experience using monitoring, reporting, or log analysis tools such as Splunk or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple cloud platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment while maintaining a strong customer service focus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
* Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About The Team**
Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.
  
  
The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.
  
  
**About The Role**
You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.
  
  
We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.
  
  
As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.
  
  
**Products you may work on**
Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
* Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
* Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
* Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
* Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
* Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
* Take part in on-call

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
* Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
* Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
* Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
* Basic Git and CI/CD experience
* Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
* Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
* Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
* Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
* Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

title: Senior IOC Specialist
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
**Why Join Q2?**
Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.
  
  
**What Makes Q2 Special?**
Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.
  
  
**Senior IOC Specialist Position Description**
We are seeking Senior IOC Specialist to join our IT team to assist and provide first escalation support in the monitoring, troubleshooting and support of various Linux and Windows operating systems, databases, utilities, system tools on cloud or the hardware on which they reside. As a Senior IOC Specialist, you will respond to monitoring alerts and cases, drive investigations and provide triage during incidents and outages for services that the IOC supports across Q2. You will join a passionate and collaborative team of people who are focused on providing exceptional support to our customers and internal teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Proactively respond to alerts generated by monitoring systems to maintain environment health and stability.
* Resolve issues by following documented processes and pre-defined standard operating procedures.
* Monitor and analyze logs and alerts from a variety of different technologies across multiple platforms in order to identify and mitigate security incidents and maintain the integrity of corporate information.
* Leverage network security tools and capabilities to analyze potential cyber threats from a variety of intakes taking appropriate response actions to include threat containment and/or escalation.
* Document troubleshooting results and remediation actions, provide regular status updates to impacted customers.
* Identify and escalate critical impact to on-call teams
* Create and maintain operational runbooks in support new and changing infrastructure
