title: Cyber Defense Engineering II - Endpoint Protection
description:
**Role Overview**
You will become a key member of Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection team and will support senior colleagues in configuring and maintaining security controls across the endpoint security domain. Your primary goal is to ensure 100% endpoint security agent deployment, visibility and control enforcement compliance across the enterprise.
  
  
This will primarily involve: managing endpoint security agent health, deploying and troubleshooting agent version upgrades and security content updates, refining AV / EDR policy configurations and exclusions to reduce "noise" while maintaining high security posture.
  
  
Additionally, you will play a hands-on role in ensuring seamless, secure, and performant enterprise-wide AV / EDR control migrations between industry-leading platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Endpoint Security Agent Management: Work with your Cyber Defense colleagues as well as Desktop, Server, Cloud Compute engineering and other technology teams as required to deploy, update, and troubleshoot endpoint security agents across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoint environments.
* Platform Management: Assist in driving enterprise-wide deployments and migrations of next-generation AV / EDR controls, ensuring consistent coverage during transition periods.
* Policy Administration: Assist with the configuration and maintenance of all policies in the endpoint security control domain, primarily including: prevention, detection and response, device control, security content updates, exclusions, network containment and host-based firewall rules management.
* Health Monitoring: Proactively identify and resolve incidents of non-compliant compute endpoints with unhealthy endpoint security agent states.
* Issue Resolution (Tier 1/2 ticket management): Monitor the Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection ticket queue, taking ownership of tier 1/2 operational support requests and incidents.
* Exclusion Tuning: Work with system owners as required to configure and maintain narrowly defined AV / EDR exclusions to prevent false positives without creating security gaps, while also ensuring system performance.
* Documentation: Upkeep of the team’s internal knowledgebase including all documentation pages and standard operating procedures (SOPs) relating to endpoint security agent and platform management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills & Work Experience**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or 2-4 years of equivalent hands-on experience in IT security, systems support, or engineering related roles).
* OS Fundamentals: Strong grasp of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating system internals, command-line usage and log analysis.
* Scripting: Basic proficiency in at least two common scripting languages (e.g. PowerShell for Windows environments, Bash for Linux/macOS environments, Python for cross-platform support).
* Networking: Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP and DNS (e.g. how endpoints communicate across enterprise networks, how endpoint security agents communicate with cloud-based cybersecurity platforms).
* Industry Certifications:

○ Foundational IT security certifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+)
  
  
○ Endpoint security administration oriented certifications are highly preferred / desirable.
  
  
**Professional & Soft Skills**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong communication skills with the ability to navigate complex enterprise IT ecosystems and work effectively with other teams and system owners to enforce endpoint security control compliance.
* Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically during issue / incident triage and perform root-cause analysis (For example: when troubleshooting endpoint security agent health issues).
* Adaptability & Time Management: Capable of balancing day-to-day operational support and incident ticket queues with long-term, enterprise-wide platform maturity efforts.

**What Makes a Candidate Stand Out?**

* Enterprise Platform Experience: Hands-on experience supporting enterprise-grade cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platforms and controls at scale.
* Familiarity with SIEM Query Languages: Working knowledge of one or more SIEM query language for querying endpoint telemetry data (e.g. SPL, KQL, CQL, or UDM Search/YARA-L).
* API Knowledge: Practical experience of using cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platform APIs for script development (e.g. for report generation and workflow automation).b

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:

**Job Title:**

**Overview:**
Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining & Metals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals & Petrochemicals with the state-of-the-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues.
  
  
The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles. You will be key in managing multiple installations of the platform across Cloud and on-premise environments, fixing security vulnerabilities on a monthly basis, conducting audits, and contributing to automation of installations. * Apply security best practices and enforce compliance standards across cloud and deployment pipelines
* Be the operations contact point for multiple product teams

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure
* 3+ years of experience working with Linux systems
* 4+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
* 2+ years of experience working with Docker
* 4+ years of experience setting up CICD pipelines (AzureDevOps or similar)
* 2+ years of experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
* 2+ years of experience with Cloud such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* Good knowledge of best security practices, vulnerability management, and testing tools such as Acunetix, Snyk, CheckMarx or Trivy
* Troubleshooting problems in Production and comfortable doing root cause analysis
* Able to work in an Agile environment

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications:**

* Good working or operational knowledge of databases (Postgres, Elastic search, Redis or similar)
* Exposure to configuring web servers such as Nginx
* Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus
* Working knowledge of a messaging framework such as Event Hub, Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Flexible hybrid working model
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment
* Access to the latest technologies and tools
* Opportunity to make a tangible impact on cutting-edge Retail/CPG AI solutions

**Diversity & Inclusion Statement:**
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Backed by leading investors, we're building the future of food delivery by continuously launching new products, expanding into new markets, and creating innovative operating models.

We are looking for an AP Analyst to handle invoice processing and vendor reconciliations, and to be the reliable finance contact for vendors and internal teams. The role suits someone who is detail-oriented, communicates clearly and takes ownership of solving problems.

**Invoice Processing**

* Vendor accounts reconciled regularly, with minimal open and disputed items.
* Vendor and internal queries resolved quickly, with positive stakeholder feedback.
* Clean audit outcomes and steady improvement in AP process efficiency.

title: threat detection engineer
description:

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

title: Senior Engineer - QA
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Description**
We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, API testing, and performance and load testing to help us build reliable, scalable, and high-quality software.
  
  
In this role, you will take ownership of automation and performance testing for assigned product areas. You will design and maintain automated test suites, develop performance test scenarios, analyse system behaviour under different workloads, and work closely with developers to identify bottlenecks and improve application reliability.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong programming skills with practical performance engineering experience. You should be comfortable working independently, investigating complex failures, and translating test results into actionable insights.
  
  
The role also requires regular collaboration with our US-based counterparts. Candidates should be comfortable attending meetings during evening hours in India to support cross-functional planning, technical discussions, and project execution.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Test Automation:**
  Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test suites using Python and frameworks such as Robot Framework, PyTest, and Playwright.
* **API Testing:**
  Own automation for REST APIs, including functional, integration, contract, negative, authentication, and end-to-end scenarios.
* **Performance and Load Testing:**
  Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests to evaluate application behaviour under varying workloads.
* **Performance Test Scripting:**
  Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts using tools such as Locust, JMeter, or k6, with a strong emphasis on code-driven performance testing.
* **Performance Analysis:**
  Analyse response times, throughput, error rates, resource utilisation, and latency percentiles to identify bottlenecks and performance degradation.
* **Root Cause Investigation:**
  Collaborate with developers and infrastructure teams to investigate performance issues across APIs, services, databases, and distributed systems.
* **Performance Benchmarking:**
  Establish performance baselines, define measurable acceptance criteria, compare results across releases, and identify regressions before production deployment.
* **CI/CD Integration:**
  Integrate functional automation and performance smoke tests into CI/CD pipelines, enabling early detection of regressions and faster feedback.
* **Framework Engineering:**
  Improve automation framework architecture, reusable libraries, test data management, parallel execution, reporting, and test reliability.
* **Test Strategy and Planning:**
  Define test coverage and approaches for new features, identify quality risks early, and determine appropriate functional and non-functional testing requirements.
* **Troubleshooting and Debugging:**
  Investigate complex failures using application logs, API traces, monitoring dashboards, and performance test reports.
* **Code Reviews and Mentoring:**
  Review automation code, promote coding standards, share technical knowledge, and support the development of junior engineers.
* **Quality Reporting:**
  Communicate test coverage, automation health, performance trends, bottlenecks, and release risks through clear, actionable reports.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with developers, product managers, DevOps, and US-based engineering counterparts to align on quality goals and delivery priorities.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation, including substantial experience with API automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python or Java, with the ability to develop clean, reusable, and maintainable test code.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one automation framework, such as Robot Framework, PyTest, or Playwright.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP protocols, authentication, schema validation, and integration testing.
* **Strong practical experience in performance and load testing**
  , including designing workloads, executing tests, interpreting results, and investigating performance bottlenecks.
* Hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool such as Locust, Apache JMeter, or k6.
* Understanding of key performance metrics, including response time, throughput, requests per second, error rate, concurrent users, and p90/p95/p99 latency.
* Experience analysing performance test results and correlating application behaviour with logs, monitoring metrics, database activity, or infrastructure resource utilisation.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Proficiency with Git, including branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

**Role: FMS Engineer – Storage & Linux**

**Openings: 2**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Location: Bangalore, Gurugram**

**Education: Minimum 15 years of full-time education**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a certified and experienced Windows, Linux & Storage Administrator to manage, maintain, configure, and enhance our IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise across Windows and Linux operating systems, enterprise storage, backup, and virtualization environments, with responsibility for ensuring system availability, performance, security, and data protection across diverse platforms. Certification in Windows/Linux and/or relevant storage technologies is preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

• Install, configure, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot HPE enterprise storage platforms, including HPE 3PAR, HPE Primera, and HPE Alletra.

• Perform day-to-day administration of storage arrays, including storage pools, disk groups, RAID levels, volumes, LUNs, host groups, initiators, and storage policies.

• Perform storage provisioning and de-provisioning for physical and virtual servers based on application and business requirements.

• Configure and manage SAN storage connectivity, including Fibre Channel (FC), SAN switches, zoning, host connectivity, and multipathing/MPIO.

• Configure and manage LUN masking, host mapping, VLUNs, initiator/target relationships, and access permissions.

• Manage RAID configurations, disk failures, spare disks, disk replacement, rebuild activities, and storage hardware health.

• Monitor storage infrastructure for capacity, IOPS, latency, throughput, disk utilization, controller health, cache utilization, and overall performance.

• Perform storage performance analysis and tuning to identify and resolve I/O bottlenecks, latency issues, and performance degradation.

• Manage snapshots, clones, remote copy/replication, and synchronous/asynchronous replication and other data-protection capabilities on HPE storage platforms.

• Support backup and recovery operations, including coordination with backup teams, storage-based backups, restores, replication, and recovery activities.

• Perform capacity planning and forecasting, monitor storage growth, identify capacity risks, and recommend expansion or optimization.

• Manage storage firmware, controller updates, disk firmware, patches, and lifecycle activities per vendor recommendations and change-management procedures.

• Troubleshoot and resolve storage, SAN, host connectivity, multipathing, disk, controller, and performance-related incidents.

• Analyze storage alerts and logs, and proactively identify hardware failures, degraded components, capacity issues, and performance anomalies.

• Coordinate with HPE/OEM support teams and vendors for hardware failures, replacement of faulty components, firmware issues, and critical technical escalations.

• Maintain accurate storage configuration documentation, SAN diagrams, LUN allocation records, capacity reports, asset information, and operational SOPs.

• Ensure storage configurations follow security, availability, redundancy, and businesscontinuity requirements.

• Participate in storage migration, data migration, technology refresh, storage expansion, and infrastructure upgrade projects.

• Support virtualization environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, and KVM from a storage perspective, including datastore/LUN provisioning and troubleshooting.

• Work closely with Windows, Linux, VMware, Network, Database, Backup, Application, and Security teams to resolve end-to-end infrastructure issues.

• Participate in incident, problem, change, and service-request management, including RCA for recurring or critical storage incidents.

• Ensure appropriate high availability, redundancy, replication, and disaster-recovery configurations are maintained and periodically validated.

• Conduct and support DR drills, failover/failback activities, storage replication testing, and recovery validation as required.

• Ensure compliance with defined storage operational standards, security policies, and backup/retention requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 3–7 years of experience as a Windows, Linux, Storage, or Infrastructure Administrator.

• Certification in Microsoft (e.g., MCSA, MCSE) and/or Linux (e.g., RHCSA, RHCE, LFCS) is preferred.

• Hands-on experience with HPE 3PAR / Primera / Alletra storage.

• Knowledge of HPE Smart Array controllers.

• Strong knowledge of SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, LUNs, RAID, storage pools, snapshots, replication, and multipathing.

• Strong knowledge of system internals, boot processes, file systems, and storage management.

• Experience with LVM, NFS, filesystem management, permissions, and Linux troubleshooting.

• Understanding of IT security practices and tools (antivirus, firewalls, patching). Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in 24x7 production / data-center environments.

• OEM/vendor certification in HPE Storage or equivalent is an advantage. Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and collaboration across teams.

• Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to system improvements.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to handle critical infrastructure incidents and coordinate with multiple technical teams.

**Additional Technical Expertise — NVIDIA GPU Virtualization**

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU virtualization technologies (vGPU) on both Windows and Linux platforms.

• Install and configure NVIDIA drivers and licensing for virtual GPU use.

• Manage GPU resources for virtual desktops (VDI) and high-performance workloads in VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM environments.

• Optimize performance and troubleshoot GPU passthrough or shared configurations in enterprise virtual environments.

• Ensure compliance with NVIDIA licensing and compatibility matrices.

description:

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode : In-Office**

**Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Job Profile:**

We are looking for a hands-on Platform Engineer to join our Core Platform team. Your core responsibility will be owning the operational health of our multi-cloud data platform — provisioning, automating, monitoring, and securing infrastructure across AWS and GCP environments. Familiarity with Databricks and ClickHouse is a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. INFRASTRUCTURE & WORKSPACE MANAGEMENT**

* Provision and maintain platform infrastructure across AWS and GCP following governance standards.
* Set up and manage workspaces, storage buckets, networking, and lifecycle configurations.
* Maintain consistent operational standards across multi-cloud environments.

**2. ACCESS CONTROL & IDENTITY MANAGEMENT**

* Administer permission sets, workspace roles, and access policies across all environments.
* Manage role assignments and keep IAM and SSO configurations in sync.
* Enforce least-privilege principles and audit permissions against compliance requirements.

**3. AUTOMATION & DEPLOYMENTS**

* Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines for provisioning and policy enforcement.
* Streamline deployment workflows for platform assets across environments.
* Maintain CI/CD pipelines for configuration changes — repeatable and auditable.

**4. MONITORING, ALERTING & RELIABILITY**

* Implement monitoring and alerting for cluster health, job status, and platform reliability.
* Proactively identify and resolve platform incidents and bottlenecks.
* Define SLOs and dashboards for observability into platform performance.

**5. FINANCIAL REPORTING & COST MANAGEMENT**

* Generate billing and cost reports, tracking consumption and cost allocation by team or project.
* Monitor cost impact of platform changes and communicate trends to stakeholders.
* Identify and implement cost optimisation opportunities.

**6. DATA INGESTION & CONSUMER SUPPORT**

* Manage data ingestion pipelines and permission configurations for source systems.
* Support and onboard internal data consumers and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to resolve access and workflow issues.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.
* Solid hands-on experience with AWS — S3, IAM, EC2, VPC, and CloudWatch.
* Good working knowledge of GCP — GCS, BigQuery, and GCP IAM.
* Experience with IAM concepts and SSO providers such as OneLogin, Okta, or Azure AD.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.
* Understanding of data governance — data classification, access policies, and audit logging.
* Ability to read cloud billing reports and communicate cost trends clearly.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.**
  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**
  We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.**
  We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.**
  We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
VergeCloud is looking for a hands-on System Engineer to work on the core of our CDN and edge infrastructure platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building high-performance, low-latency, secure systems close to the network, operating system, and runtime layer.

You will contribute directly to VergeCloud’s CDN core, including request processing, caching, reverse proxying, traffic routing, TLS handling, DNS integration, observability, WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection capabilities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing production-grade Rust code and working with distributed infrastructure that handles high-volume internet traffic across edge locations.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and maintain CDN core services using Rust.
* Build high-performance caching, proxying, routing, and traffic management components.
* Work on HTTP, HTTPS, TLS, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, and edge networking systems.
* Improve CDN performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Contribute to WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection features.
* Debug production issues across CDN edge nodes, origin connectivity, cache behavior, DNS, TLS, and network paths.
* Work closely with SRE, security, and platform teams to build reliable edge infrastructure.

Requirements
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or backend engineering.
* Strong production-level programming experience in
  **Rust or C**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, processes, memory, filesystems, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and DNS.
* Experience building high-performance, concurrent, asynchronous, or event-driven systems.
* Understanding of caching, reverse proxying, load balancing, request routing, and traffic management.
* Experience debugging complex production issues across application, network, operating system, and infrastructure layers.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable service design.
* Experience with logs, metrics, tracing, monitoring, and production observability.

Preferred skills:

* Experience with CDN, edge computing, WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, or DDoS protection platforms.
* Familiarity with Tokio or other async Rust runtimes.
* Knowledge of NGINX, Envoy, HAProxy, Varnish, OpenResty, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of BGP, Anycast, traffic engineering, and global routing.
* Experience with eBPF, XDP, DPDK, or kernel-level networking.
* Familiarity with Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, and large-scale log pipelines.
* Understanding of OWASP CRS, ModSecurity concepts, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and API security.
* Exposure to WebAssembly, V8, or edge function runtimes.

Benefits
  
  

* Opportunity to work on the core technology of a deep-tech edge cloud platform.
* Build CDN, DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, video delivery, and edge computing infrastructure from India for global customers.
* High ownership role with direct impact on platform architecture, performance, reliability, and security.
* Work on challenging systems engineering problems involving Rust, Linux, networking, distributed systems, and high-scale traffic.
* Collaborate with a strong technical team across platform engineering, SRE, security, and product.
* Exposure to production-scale internet infrastructure, edge networking, caching, traffic routing, and security systems.
* Opportunity to grow into senior engineering, platform architecture, or infrastructure leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
* On-site collaboration in Bangalore with a fast-moving engineering team.

title: Senior Atlassian Consultant
description:
**Senior Atlassian Consultant**

Role & Purpose

The Senior Atlassian Consultant is responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and governance of Teciem's enterprise Atlassian platform, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Bitbucket. The role serves as the technical subject matter expert, providing architectural guidance throughout migration and transformation initiatives, ensuring platform reliability, scalability, and compliance.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the role will drive platform adoption, resolve technical challenges, document platform standards and customizations, and establish a sustainable BAU support model through knowledge transfer, mentoring, and training.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and architect scalable, secure Atlassian platforms across global environments.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for Atlassian migration and transformation initiatives.
* Act as the SME for Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Bitbucket, resolving technical challenges and migration blockers.
* Configure and customize workflows, permissions, issue types, and project structures to support Agile, DevOps, and ITSM processes.
* Lead the consolidation and standardization of Atlassian instances into a centralized platform.
* Integrate Atlassian tools with CI/CD and DevOps platforms, including Jenkins, GitLab, and Azure DevOps.
* Build and maintain self-service portals, service catalogs, and automated workflows within Jira Service Management.
* Develop automation using ScriptRunner, JMWE, and Automation for Jira.
* Ensure all platform configurations, plugins, integrations, and customizations are fully documented in Confluence.
* Implement governance and controls aligned with SOC2, ISO 27001, and data privacy requirements.
* Monitor platform performance, availability, and health, driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support platform adoption through training, documentation, and Centre of Excellence best practices.
* Mentor and enable the BAU support team to ensure successful operational handover and ongoing support of the Atlassian platform.

Skills, Experience & Attributes

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Atlassian platforms in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience delivering Atlassian migration, consolidation, or transformation projects.
* Experience supporting Agile, DevOps, and ITSM methodologies.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Bitbucket.
* Strong experience with ScriptRunner, JMWE, and Automation for Jira.
* Experience integrating Atlassian tools with Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and other enterprise applications.
* Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, platform governance, and enterprise architecture.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Knowledge of SOC2, ISO 27001, security standards, and data privacy requirements.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and provide expert consultancy.
* Proven capability to mentor teams, transfer knowledge, and drive platform adoption.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and user experience.

The primary objective of this role is to ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions. The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L1) focuses on first-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests. This role focusses across two or more technology domains such as (but not limited to) Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration.

* Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.

* Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
* Schedules maintenance activity windows for patching and configuration changes.

* Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.

title: Digital Workplace Operations Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
As an Advisor, Operations Lead within the Digital Workplace team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for the operational health, governance, and continuous improvement of Cargill's endpoint and collaboration environment. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — you will translate roadmap priorities into operationally sound, day-to-day practices while acting as a trusted subject matter expert across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and global service partners.
  
  
You will bring structure to complexity, data to decisions, and clarity to a fast-moving transformation — all without direct reports, but with significant influence across the teams and leaders you partner with.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Operational Excellence

+ Own and improve Digital Workplace operations, covering device lifecycle, provisioning, depot management, endpoint governance, and collaboration platforms.
+ Track KPIs and SLAs, identify risks, and drive improvements with cross-functional teams.
+ Maintain standardized procedures and act as an escalation point, ensuring timely, accountable resolution of complex operational issues across stakeholders.

* Collaboration Platform Governance

+ Support governance of the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint permissions, OneDrive, Teams lifecycle, and security groups.
+ Collaborate with Security and IAM teams to ensure data protection and access control.
+ Drive attestation, automation, and audits, while aligning with Entra ID and HR systems to ensure accurate, compliant access governance.

* Governance & Compliance

+ Support the design and execution of governance frameworks for endpoint access, device compliance, collaboration platform policies, and Digital Workplace standards in alignment with Cargill's security and IT requirements.
+ Partner with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure operational practices meet internal policy and external regulatory requirements across a global footprint.

* Program & Stakeholder Support

+ Collaborate with program teams to ensure operational readiness and seamless transition to steady-state operations.
+ Advise leadership with data-driven insights on service health and transformation progress.
+ Engage stakeholders and end users to gather feedback, drive change, and promote adoption of modern workplace tools across a global workforce.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead operational improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving to enhance efficiency and service quality.
+ Identify and implement automation opportunities across workflows in partnership with engineering teams.
+ Stay updated on Microsoft 365, Nexthink, and PCaaS trends, translating emerging capabilities into actionable operational recommendations for leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field — or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, Digital Workplace, or endpoint management in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing device lifecycle, provisioning processes, and endpoint governance at scale (10,000+ devices preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 platform operations, including SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Exchange/mail governance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize operational data into actionable insights and executive-ready communications.
* Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed, global organizations and manage multiple priorities without direct authority.
* Experience with ITSM frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and operational reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Windows 365 (W365), Entra ID (Azure AD), and/or Nexthink.
* Familiarity with PCaaS (PC as a Service) operating models and global vendor management.
* Experience designing or operating SharePoint permissions governance programs, including oversharing remediation, attestation workflows, and automated access controls.
* Experience supporting large-scale technology transformation programs, particularly mid-flight rather than greenfield.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.
* Microsoft 365 certifications (e.g., MS-700, MS-900, or equivalent) a plus.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

**Competencies for Success**

* Operational Rigor — You bring discipline and structure to ambiguous environments, translating strategy into repeatable, scalable processes that hold up across a global, multi-industry organization.
* Stakeholder Influence — As a senior IC, you earn trust and drive alignment without formal authority, communicating clearly across engineering teams, business leaders, and end users alike.
* Breadth & Curiosity — You're comfortable owning both device operations and collaboration platform governance — and you actively seek to connect the dots between them.
* Ownership Mindset — You take accountability for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and proactively surface issues before they become problems.
* Data-Driven Thinking — You use metrics and evidence to drive decisions, tell compelling stories, and demonstrate operational value to leadership.

Magna IT is looking for a Senior System Engineer with a strong focus on building and operating a centralized Intune Data Warehouse and establishing reliable device compliance monitoring at scale. This role takes end-to-end ownership for the solution design, implementation, operational stability, and continuous improvement of the reporting and compliance monitoring service. Responsibilities include integrating multiple data sources (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM database, Nexthink) into a central database, defining data standards and quality controls, and enabling customized queries and Power BI dashboards for operational and management reporting. In close collaboration with MIT colleagues and Divisional IT, the position drives compliance governance, proactively identifies trends and risks, and leads remediation activities to restore and sustain device compliance.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation and operation of a centralized data platform for Modern Workplace reporting (Intune Data Warehouse as core, plus additional sources as required), including architecture decisions and long-term roadmap
* Design robust integration patterns and harmonize data from Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM DB, Nexthink and other relevant systems into a central database (ETL/ELT), ensuring scalability and maintainability
* Develop and maintain enterprise-grade data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (or comparable tooling) including scheduling, error handling, monitoring/alerting, and performance/cost optimization
* Own SQL-based data modeling (schema design, views, performance tuning/indexing) and deliver high-quality custom queries for operational reporting and analytics
* Build secure and reliable automation for data extraction and operations using Microsoft Graph API and Entra ID (app registrations, permissions, authentication patterns) with PowerShell/Python
* Build and govern Power BI semantic models, datasets and dashboards (KPI definitions, refresh strategy, access management/RLS, documentation) for different stakeholder groups
* Own device compliance monitoring and governance (e.g., free disk space, BitLocker status, anti-virus, M365 Apps versions, patch/health indicators) across all Intune managed devices; define thresholds, metrics, and reporting standards
* Lead cross-team remediation with MIT and Divisional IT to restore compliance (runbooks, escalation paths, root cause analysis, follow-up, and reporting), driving measurable improvements
* Establish data governance and quality management (data definitions, validation checks, documentation, lineage, and auditability of metrics)

* Preferably Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a relevant field.
* Completed education of a technical college.

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint management analytics / reporting and/or data integration in an enterprise environment (Intune strongly preferred)
* Expert-level SQL skills (data modeling, query optimization, indexing principles, troubleshooting performance issues; building views/stored procedures is a plus)
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Graph API and Entra ID (device/identity objects, permissions, app registrations, authentication flows, least-privilege design)
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (or equivalent) and operating ETL/ELT pipelines with monitoring/alerting and operational readiness (SLAs, runbooks)
* Strong Power BI skills (semantic data modeling, DAX, performance optimization, dashboard design, row-level security, and governance/lifecycle management)
* Strong scripting/automation skills in PowerShell and/or Python (APIs, scheduling, logging, error handling) with focus on maintainability (modular code, documentation, testing mindset)
* Experience with source control and deployment practices (e.g., Git, release/change management; CI/CD for data pipelines/reporting is a plus)
* Deep understanding of endpoint compliance concepts and telemetry and how to operationalize them (KPIs, alerting, remediation workflows; e.g., Intune compliance, BitLocker, AV/Defender signals, application versioning, device health indicators; Nexthink is a plus)

**Other Competencies**

* Positive attitude and a strong commitment to delivering quality work and operational excellence.
* Knowledge of client lifecycle management systems and current computing trends.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written and verbal) to translate complex technical topics into actionable insights for management, IT partners and end users
* Can work independently or part of a team.
* Conform with and abide by all Company codes, regulations, policies, values, work procedures and instructions.
* Must be an independent problem solver with troubleshooting, decision-making and analytical skills.
* Excellent customer service skills.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**

We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
  
  
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Owning the availability, latency, and efficiency of the production inferencing service, including change management, emergency response, and standing up AI infrastructure in new regions
* Building and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog covering service health, model latency and throughput, and RDU utilization
* Leading incident response, running blameless post-mortems, and automating the toil those incidents expose
* Finding and fixing performance bottlenecks, and designing auto-scaling policies that handle variable inference load without overspending
* Managing cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible, and building the CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role supporting a large-scale, customer-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, or Java
* Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK Stack
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD
* Strong Linux system administration fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a hybrid environment spanning cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure
* Experience supporting ML or AI inferencing services in production
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs, for purposes of mapping to RDUs
* Knowledge of model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or Ray
* Experience managing and tuning databases (SQL or NoSQL) and caching systems such as Redis or Memcached

Base Salary Range:
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
₹8,900,000—₹10,800,000 INR

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

title: Global Telecom Support
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services.
  
  
The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service.
  
  
The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Accountabilities**
**1. Global Telecom and Network Operations**

* Provide senior technical and operational leadership for global Mobility and E-Mobility telecom infrastructure.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of network connectivity and associated infrastructure across retail sites, backbone services, data centres, third-party networks and externally managed connectivity services.
* Monitor the health, availability, performance and security of the telecom environment using enterprise and vendor monitoring platforms.
* Analyse monitoring alerts, operational events and service degradation indicators to determine business impact and initiate the appropriate response.
* Ensure incidents affecting routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN tunnels and associated connectivity components are correctly triaged and assigned.
* Maintain ownership of complex operational issues until resolution or until a complete and formally accepted handover has been performed.
* Support a global, follow-the-sun operating model, including participation in on-call, weekend and public-holiday support arrangements.
* Provide technical guidance to operations teams handling site-level, multi-site and infrastructure-wide disruptions.

The contract identifies global telecom monitoring, real-time infrastructure visibility, incident notification and escalation as core components of the service. It also covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, load balancers, backbone infrastructure and vendor-managed telecom services.
  
  

* Incident and Major Incident Management
* Lead the technical response for high-impact single-site, multi-site and global service incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridges involving network suppliers, telecom providers, application teams, site-support teams, service managers and business stakeholders.
* Perform initial and advanced technical triage to establish incident scope, affected services, market impact, urgency and priority.
* Ensure incidents contain sufficient diagnostic and business-impact information before escalation.
* Coordinate the creation and progression of incident and major-incident records in the relevant service-management platform.
* Manage P3 and P4 major incidents and support the designated incident-command function during P1 and P2 major incidents.
* Establish clear ownership across resolver groups and ensure suppliers engage within their contractual responsibilities.
* Schedule and lead technical calls when required to accelerate investigation and recovery.
* Maintain an accurate incident chronology, including decisions, actions, ownership, dependencies and restoration progress.
* Confirm service restoration through monitoring tools, resolver-group evidence or confirmation from the reporting party before closure.
* Ensure incident, recovery and closure communications are distributed to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Support incident managers by translating complex technical findings into clear operational and business-impact statements.

The scope requires first-level incident management, major incident management, prioritisation, ticket creation, supplier escalation, technical-call coordination, service-restoration confirmation and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.
  
  

* Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation
* Lead technical investigation of complex, recurring or high-impact telecom and network issues.
* Perform full-stack troubleshooting across the network path, including routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, traffic flows, network security controls and dependent services.
* Use packet-capture and network-analysis tools to isolate faults at packet and protocol level.
* Analyse network traffic, device events, application logs, site-system logs and monitoring data to identify hard-to-detect issues.
* Develop and test technical hypotheses using available operational evidence.
* Coordinate cross-supplier troubleshooting where ownership or fault location is unclear.
* Determine whether failures originate within site infrastructure, telecom connectivity, network backbone, security services, vendor platforms, application services or third-party interfaces.
* Produce clear technical findings, recommended remediation actions and risk assessments.
* Provide technical direction to less-experienced engineers and operations analysts during critical incidents.

The contract specifically requires advanced troubleshooting, traffic analysis, packet-level investigation, knowledge of multiple routing protocols, network design expertise and analysis of site-system and application logs.
  
  

* Root-Cause and Problem Management
* Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant telecom, network and third-party incidents.
* Ensure root-cause documentation clearly describes the failure, contributing factors, business impact, recovery actions and preventive measures.
* Challenge incomplete or unsupported root-cause statements provided by suppliers.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to verified completion.
* Raise and coordinate problem records for recurring or systemic issues.
* Use incident trends, operational data and recurring alert patterns to identify candidates for problem management.
* Facilitate technical reviews involving internal teams and external service providers.
* Ensure RCA documentation is completed within applicable operational timelines.
* Maintain traceability between incidents, problems, known errors, changes and improvement activities.
* Share lessons learned and incorporate agreed improvements into support procedures, monitoring rules and operational documentation.

The SWAT scope assigns responsibility for RCA leadership, documentation completion, supplier engagement, root-cause validation and accountability. The administrative support scope also includes problem management for supported operational platforms.
  
  

* Change, Migration and Implementation Support
* Assess telecom and network changes for technical risk, operational impact and business impact.
* Coordinate network changes, migrations and implementations with suppliers and delivery teams.
* Evaluate third-party changes that may affect Mobility services.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders review and approve changes before implementation.
* Create and distribute change notifications to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor the implementation of high-risk or business-critical changes.
* Coordinate technical support during change implementation and post-change validation.
* Verify that changes achieve the intended outcome without creating unacceptable service degradation.
* Support recovery or rollback activities when a change is unsuccessful.
* Ensure network, firewall, configuration, support and operational documentation is updated following implementation.
* Review project implementation plans for operational readiness, supportability and alignment with the existing environment.

The contract includes change coordination, third-party change-impact assessment, stakeholder approval, Change Notification Letters, implementation monitoring and technical support for network changes and migrations.
  
  

* Network Architecture and Design Assurance
* Act as a senior technical authority for the end-to-end Mobility telecom and network architecture.
* Review solution and network designs for reliability, availability, security, scalability, operability and supportability.
* Provide technical recommendations to project and delivery teams.
* Assess proposed changes against the existing telecom environment and relevant service dependencies.
* Architect, review or approve network designs within the candidate’s delegated authority.
* Identify operational risks, integration gaps, monitoring requirements and support-model deficiencies before production deployment.
* Ensure designs include appropriate diagnostic, failover, security, documentation and operational-support provisions.
* Support implementation teams during deployment, transition and early-life support.
* Ensure integration requirements across multiple suppliers and business partners are understood and coordinated.
* Promote standardisation and reduction of unnecessary technical complexity across the network landscape.

The SWAT team is defined as responsible for end-to-end technical architecture, multi-supplier process integration, project-impact assessment, technical recommendations, design review or approval and implementation support.
  
  

* Firewall, Security and Access Governance
* Provide senior oversight of firewall rules supporting the Mobility environment.
* Review firewall-rule changes for technical validity, security risk, business justification and implementation impact.
* Ensure access and infrastructure requests follow the required approval and governance processes.
* Review and manage third-party access requests relating to infrastructure, data-centre or service-support activities.
* Support access-control processes and periodic access reviews for relevant operational platforms.
* Coordinate with security, risk, infrastructure and supplier teams to resolve security-related network issues.
* Support compliance activities associated with Information Risk Management and Payment Card Industry requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and technical documentation to support audit and compliance activities.
* Escalate non-compliance, uncontrolled access, unsupported connectivity or material security risks to the relevant stakeholders.
* Balance operational recovery requirements with security and access-control obligations during critical incidents.

The contract includes ownership of a significant portion of the firewall rule sets, third-party access management, infrastructure change requests and support for Information Risk Management and PCI compliance activities.
  
  

* Supplier and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the senior technical liaison between internal teams, business stakeholders, telecom providers, technology suppliers and third-party service providers.
* Establish clear technical and operational ownership across multi-supplier incidents.
* Hold suppliers accountable for investigation quality, contractual service obligations, recovery actions and root-cause deliverables.
* Escalate supplier-performance concerns through the appropriate operational and commercial channels.
* Obtain technical evidence from suppliers following incidents and changes.
* Challenge delays, unsupported conclusions and incomplete remediation plans.
* Coordinate dependencies between connectivity providers, managed-service suppliers, application teams and site-support teams.
* Provide concise updates to service management and business leadership.
* Maintain professional working relationships across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
* Represent the telecom and network operations function in service reviews, project meetings, change reviews, incident reviews and technical governance forums.

The role descriptions require working across international teams, leading meetings, coordinating internal and external support entities and ensuring suppliers and vendors perform as required under their contracts.
  
  

* Monitoring and Service Improvement
* Drive proactive monitoring and early identification of telecom and service degradation.
* Review alerts, dashboards, thresholds and escalation paths to improve incident detection and response quality.
* Identify monitoring gaps across network, site, application and third-party services.
* Work with monitoring-service owners and suppliers to implement actionable alerts.
* Reduce alert noise, duplicate notifications and non-actionable events.
* Use operational data to identify reliability, performance and service-improvement opportunities.
* Lead network optimisation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Recommend automation opportunities for repetitive triage, notification, reporting and evidence-gathering activities.
* Track the effectiveness of implemented improvements through operational measures and incident trends.
* Ensure monitoring procedures remain aligned with changes to technology, business services and supplier arrangements.

The scope references proactive monitoring through tools and vendors, operational-data analysis, corrective actions, network optimisation and continuous service improvement.
  
  

* Documentation and Operational Readiness
* Create, maintain and continuously improve end-to-end technical and operational documentation.
* Develop network diagrams, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, process flows and incident-response playbooks.
* Maintain accurate records of network circuits, racks, devices, configurations, inventory, contacts and service dependencies where applicable.
* Ensure documentation supports rapid triage within demanding incident-response timelines.
* Review project support models, support decks and operational-readiness documentation.
* Validate that new services have complete monitoring, ticketing, access, contact, escalation and Minimum Data Set information before operational handover.
* Establish documentation standards and quality controls for the support organisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify outdated business-critical information.
* Ensure changes to applications, infrastructure, suppliers and contacts are reflected promptly in operational documentation.
* Train team members in the effective use of documentation and service-management tools.

The contract requires standardised network and process documentation, project-onboarding documentation, escalation information, support-model review, and maintenance of network infrastructure and inventory records.
  
  

* Team Leadership and Capability Development
* Provide technical leadership, coaching and guidance to network engineers, incident analysts and operations personnel.
* Define expected quality standards for incident handling, communications, ticket updates, documentation and technical investigation.
* Review the quality of team deliverables and provide constructive feedback.
* Lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions and post-incident learning reviews.
* Develop team capability in troubleshooting, service management, network analysis and stakeholder communication.
* Support workload prioritisation during periods of high incident demand.
* Delegate activities based on risk, complexity, urgency and engineer capability.
* Encourage ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement across integrated support teams.
* Act as an escalation point for technical, process and supplier-related issues.
* Support service leadership with resource planning, operational reporting and resolution of day-to-day delivery concerns.

The contract’s supervisor and service-manager descriptions include team guidance, delivery standards, training, workload management, status reporting, process development and escalation of critical issues.
  
  

* Reporting and Executive Communication
* Prepare monthly service reports covering incidents, recurring issues, improvement activities, technical achievements, risks and upcoming changes.
* Communicate the value delivered by the telecom and network operations team.
* Provide clear updates during high-impact incidents without unnecessary technical jargon.
* Produce technical call summaries, incident recaps, change notices and stakeholder notifications.
* Translate technical events into business-impact statements suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Report material operational risks and unresolved supplier dependencies.
* Ensure reports are accurate, evidence-based and suitable for governance review.
* Maintain action logs and follow up outstanding commitments with internal teams and suppliers.

Monthly reporting of achievements, value-added contributions and upcoming Mobility activities is explicitly included in the SWAT responsibilities. Incident, major-incident and change communications are also included throughout the support scope
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Certifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.
* Equivalent significant professional experience may be considered where permitted by the organisation’s recruitment policy.

**Preferred**

* Cisco professional-level certification or comparable enterprise networking certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher mandatory.
* Network-security or firewall certification.
* Cloud networking certification.
* Project management or Agile delivery certification.

The source identifies professional certifications as advantageous but does not mandate a specific certification.

title: Designated Support Engineer III
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Designated Support Engineer III to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Global Focal Support within our Support department. You will function as the highest level of technical support within the TAC, responsible for resolving the most complex and critical issues escalated from Level I and Level II support engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Provide second line phone/email consultation to independently debug complex security/network problems
* Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting
* Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams
* Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base
* Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
* You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 5+ years of support and networking experience, including general firewalls and packet filtering troubleshooting

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Company:**

Blissclub is one of India’s fastest-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community-first D2C brand has expanded into experience-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.

Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.

Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.

**Job Location:**
HSR Layout, Bangalore (on-site).

**The role:**

You will own a key part of how BlissClub shows up wherever a customer meets it: in content, on social, and in our stores. All of that work points at one goal, which is growing the core of the brand.

You will write the plan and ship the work. This is a hands-on seat, not a role where you only direct agencies.

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Business Officer
* **Works with:**
  Category, Growth, Revenue teams (D2C, Marketplaces, Retail) and the in-house Creative team

**What you'll own**

**1. Grow the Core**

* Own the brand plan for our core franchises across Activewear and Citywear. These are the hero ranges the business is built on.
* Partner with Category to sharpen each franchise's story: who it is for, why it wins and what we say about it. Keep that story consistent across the website, marketplace listings and store shelves.
* Build always-on and seasonal plans for the core with Growth and the D2C, Marketplace and Retail teams.
* Turn sales, review, research and performance data into sharp creative briefs, then measure what they delivered.
* Keep the Core fresh, relevant and aspirational through content, community and collabs

**2. Content Excellence**

* Set the content strategy for key communication pillars: what we say, to whom, in which formats and how often.
* Work with the in-house creative team from brief to final cut. You are the quality bar on every asset, including copy, visuals and edits.
* Own execution across owned channels: the website, social and CRM (email, WhatsApp).
* Run a monthly test-and-learn loop. Double down on content that moves engagement, conversion and brand metrics, and cut what doesn't.

**3. Social Media**

* Own the social strategy for each platform - Instagram and LI being key.
* Run the content calendar, the brand voice and the community management standards.
* Plan creator and collaboration content that fits the brand and doesn't just borrow reach.
* Grow the quality of engagement (saves, shares, comments, follower quality), not only reach.

**4. Retail Marketing**

* Build the retail marketing playbook with the Retail team, covering store launches, local activations and catchment marketing that drives footfall.
* Own in-store and storefront assets that turn browsers into buyers: windows, facade screens, visual merchandising communication, POS and in-store content.
* Track footfall and conversion lift by store and by campaign, then roll out what works as new stores open.

**5. Community & Collabs**

Make the people who wear BlissClub the brand's most credible voice. You will build and run our community: run and workout meetups, store events, and a steady flow of customer content. You will also own collaborations, including co-created drops, partnerships with studios, run clubs and like-minded brands, and long-term creator relationships that build affinity rather than renting reach. The test is simple: a community that brings people back, and collaborations that open new audiences for the core.

**Who you are**

You combine taste with rigour. You can spot great content, and you can prove that it worked.

* 5–7 years in brand marketing, with at least 3 years at a digital-first consumer brand in D2C, fashion, beauty or lifestyle.
* A portfolio of campaigns and content you led yourself. Please bring it to the first conversation.
* Hands-on social experience: you have run brand handles and know what works on Instagram today.
* You can turn data into a creative brief, and then show the impact of the work that came from it.
* You have driven outcomes with Category, Growth and Sales or Retail teams without having direct authority over them.
* You are a strong writer, because copy is part of this job.
* You are comfortable with numbers: you set KPIs, read dashboards and report results honestly.

**Good to have**

* Omnichannel or retail marketing experience, such as store launches, visual merchandising or catchment activation.
* Experience managing PR or creative agencies.
* A background in apparel, activewear or another comfort-led category.
