title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

description:

**Technical Lead - D2C Home Fitness & Massage Chair Products**

Service Operations (D2C) | Cult.fit

**1. POSITION OVERVIEW**

**Job Title**

Technical Lead - D2C Home Fitness & Massage Chair Products

**Department**

Service Operations - Repair, Installation & Preventive Maintenance (D2C)

**Location**

Bengaluru

**Employment Type**

Full-time

**Product Scope**

Treadmills, ellipticals, exercise and spin bikes, rowers, home gyms, massage chairs, massagers and allied home-use wellness products

**2. ABOUT CULT.FIT**

Cult.fit is one of India's leading health and fitness platforms, offering gym and group workouts, at-home fitness, and fitness equipment for homes. Our Service Operations team keeps every product we sell, and every machine in our centres, performing reliably.

**3. ROLE SUMMARY**

The Technical Lead is the single technical authority for home-use fitness and massage products. The role is accountable for getting every installation, demo and repair right in the first visit, for reducing technician-led and product-led defects, and for lowering the overall cost of service.

**4. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**4.1 First-Visit Resolution & Field Troubleshooting**

* Design product-wise SOPs for installation, demo, repair, inspection and uninstallation
* Build symptom-to-spare fault trees for each SKU to standardise diagnosis
* Define visit-readiness checklists - tools, consumables, likely spares and customer pre-requisites (space, power point, flooring)
* Act as Level-2 escalation for field technicians and vendors, with live support by call or video, and personally attend complex or escalated cases
* Take repair-versus-replace decisions to avoid unnecessary full-unit or major-assembly replacement

**4.2 Technician Training & Certification**

* Build and run the training calendar - onboarding, product certification, refreshers and new-launch training
* Certify technicians SKU-wise; deploy only certified technicians on complex products
* Hold vendor technicians to the same standard as in-house technicians
* Run remedial training for low performers
* Create short training videos, job aids and quick-reference cards for field use

**4.3 Quality Assurance & Root Cause Analysis**

* Standardise job-closure requirements (checklist, photos, videos, customer sign-off) and audit jobs against them - physically and remotely
* Investigate every repeat visit, repeat spare dispatch and early-life failure; classify the root cause (product, technician, transit, customer usage)
* Drive Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to closure and ensure adherence on the ground

**4.4 Product Quality & OEM Collaboration**

* Act as the voice of the field to the Product team and manufacturers - share consolidated failure data and RCA reports by SKU and batch
* Drive OEM fixes - design changes, component upgrades, batch corrections, revised installation instructions and firmware updates
* Validate new products before launch - installation trial, serviceability review and spare-list readiness
* Support the Product team on warranty claims and cost recovery from manufacturers with technical evidence

**4.5 Service Cost & Vendor Management**

* Own cost per ticket - quantify the cost of repeat visits, avoidable spare dispatch and replacements, and drive it down
* Evaluate, select and onboard service vendors on rate card, first-time fix rate and quality, targeting lower cost with equal or better performance
* Run monthly vendor scorecard reviews (cost, FTFR, quality audit score, TAT) and phase out consistently underperforming vendors
* Expand the network of spare suppliers and component repairers (PCB, motor rewinding), and use it to refurbish defective spares
* Define the critical spare list and stock levels per city based on failure frequency
* Identify alternate and local sources for long-lead or high-cost spares
* Validate spare quality and compatibility; maintain the spare-part mapping by SKU

**4.6 Documentation, Reporting & Automation**

* Maintain a single, version-controlled technical library - installation guides, error-code lists, exploded views, wiring diagrams, service bulletins and a known-issues database
* Publish weekly and monthly reports on the KPIs in Section 5
* Work end-to-end on manual tracking systems where needed, and help design the processes and systems that improve and automate them - including diagnosis, spare prediction and quality tracking

**4.7 Safety & Compliance**

* Enforce electrical and installation safety - earthing, voltage and load checks, anchoring and floor-loading guidance for heavy equipment
* Ensure technicians follow PPE, safe-lifting and customer-home conduct guidelines

**6. CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**6.1 Education & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering (ITI with an exceptional hands-on record may be considered)
* Minimum 4 years in service of home fitness equipment, massage chairs or similar electro-mechanical consumer durables, including at least 1 year in a lead or senior technician role
* Proven track record of writing SOPs and training technicians
* An established network of spare suppliers, component repairers and service vendors
* **Desirable**
  OEM or brand service experience with fitness or massage chair brands; experience onboarding, negotiating with and managing a multi-city vendor network

**6.2 Technical Skills**

* **PCB repair**
  - component-level repair of motor controller, console/display and power boards; reading schematics, soldering and rework
* **Motors and drives**
  - DC/AC motors, incline motors, actuators, sensors and wiring harnesses
* **Mechanical systems**
  - belts, rollers, bearings, flywheels, magnetic and friction resistance, frame alignment
* **Massage chair systems**
  - airbag/pneumatic circuits, roller mechanisms and recliner actuators (preferred)
* **Diagnostics**
  - multimeter, clamp meter, wiring diagrams, error codes, firmware updates and app/Bluetooth-connected equipment

**6.3 Systems & Digital Skills**

* Service ticketing system/CRM
* Excel or Google Sheets - pivots, lookups and charts
* AI tools for documentation, data analysis and automating routine tasks

**6.4 Behavioural Competencies**

* **Ownership**
  - end-to-end accountability for outcomes, not just tasks
* **Data-driven thinking**
  - decides from data and trends, not anecdotes
* **Coaching mindset**
  - patient and structured in building capability in others
* **Customer-first conduct**
  - professional, courteous and trustworthy
* **Influence without authority**
  - moves external partners to act through evidence and persistence
* **Communication**
  - clear in English and Hindi, verbal and written; a regional language is an advantage
* **Composure**
  - calm under pressure

**7. SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS**

**Timeline**

**Expected Outcomes**

Days 1-30

Baseline the Section 5 KPIs by SKU and city; assess technician skill levels; identify the top 10 failure modes

Days 31-60

SOPs and fault trees live for the top 5 SKUs by volume; certification under way

Days 61-90

Top 3 product issues escalated to OEMs with RCA; vendor scorecard live; first monthly report published; measurable improvement in FTFR and cost per ticket

**8. WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Field-intensive role - customer homes, warehouses and vendor sites
* Travel across service cities - approx. 30-40% of working time
* 6-day working week, with occasional extended-hour support for critical escalations
* Work end-to-end on manual tracking systems, and help design the processes and systems that improve and automate them - including diagnosis, spare prediction and quality and speed tracking

* Engage senior stakeholders, clearly communicating complex technical trade-offs and recommendations in business-relevant terms.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product leaders to deliver high-impact solutions for institutional investors and private markets clients.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience building and operating scalable software systems for data processing workflows and platforms, with deep expertise in Python and SQL across databases such as Snowflake and Postgres.
* Hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Demonstrated ability to design production-grade systems that balance performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience enabling or supporting advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases in production environments.
* A rigorous, data-driven mindset – comfortable using analysis, benchmarking, and experimentation to guide technical decisions and architectural trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of data validation, testing strategies, and code quality practices, with confidence applying diverse code and data testing techniques across data and application layers.
* Ability to operate autonomously and drive technical solution design end-to-end, taking ownership of outcomes.
* Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, data science, product, and design teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant language.
* A proactive, curious, and resilient mindset — motivated to explore new technologies, tackle ambiguous problems, and continuously improve systems and ways of working.

**Desirable Skills Include**

* Experience with AI-related technologies and products; familiarity with using AI coding assistants.
* Experience working with financial market data, investment analytics, or private markets datasets.
* Experience designing and building data platformssoftware and/or data platforms in regulated or financial services environments.
* Experience supporting ML lifecycle management (model versioning, experiment tracking, model deployment pipelines); familiarity with tools such as MLflow, feature stores, or model serving frameworks.
* Experience productionising statistical or quantitative models.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**Position Summary**
Join the Cyber Incident Response & Forensics team at Deloitte as a Senior Consultant supporting organizations through complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders while helping lead rapid-response incident management, forensic analysis, and threat hunting activities. This position requires sound judgment, immediate responsiveness during active incidents, and the ability to work independently in high-pressure situations.

* Lead incident response activities for malware, ransomware, data breach, and insider threat investigations across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Perform triage, containment, and forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and identity infrastructure, including Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
* Conduct threat hunting, log analysis, malware analysis, and investigation activities across security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network security platforms
* Document incident timelines, indicators of compromise, attack methodologies, findings, and remediation actions, and prepare post-incident reports and reviews
* Serve as a technical advisor to client stakeholders during active incidents, support tabletop exercises and incident response planning, and contribute to internal playbooks and knowledge assets

**The team**
Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team helps organizations investigate, contain, and recover from complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. The team supports clients through forensic analysis, threat hunting, incident management, and recovery planning during high-impact events. Professionals in this practice work across industries to strengthen incident response readiness, improve detection and response capabilities, and reduce the impact of future attacks.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent experience

* Experience supporting enterprise clients in a consulting environment

title: Technical Director, Infrastructure SoC Software

* Extensive experience delivering complex system software and technical leadership of large, globally distributed engineering organizations within embedded or infrastructure SoC space.

* Excellent technical judgement, leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence senior collaborators and drive decisions across engineering organizations.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a*
*private, global, multi-cloud IP network*
*, to bringing*
*hyperlocal edge*
*technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*
*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*
*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Bangalore — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.
  
  
This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.
  
  
You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
  
  
*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE*
— owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
  
  
*Forward Deployed Engineer*
— owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
  
  
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
* Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
* Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like BharatGPT, OpenHathi, or other Indic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
* Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
* Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
* Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
* Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
* Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
* Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English and Indic language use cases (Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and other regional languages) and India-specific regulatory environments (DPDP Act, data localization, RBI cloud regulations)
* Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
* Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
* Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from India
* Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

**What We're Looking For**

* CS degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
* Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
* Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
* Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
* You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
* High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
* You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
* Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
* Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
* Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
* Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
* Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
* Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across India
* Legally authorized to work in India, or eligible for sponsorship

*Bonus Points For*

* Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
* Building eval sets for a specific domain
* Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
* Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including Indic-language models (BharatGPT, OpenHathi, Bhashini, Sarvam AI) and Indian sovereign AI initiatives
* Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
* SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
* ETL and data wrangling experience
* CI/CD pipeline design and automation
* Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
* Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and Indian regulatory frameworks (DPDP Act, data localization under IT Rules, RBI cloud and data residency requirements, MeitY AI governance guidelines)
* Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

title: AI Senior Engineer
description:
****Description****
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own client engagements end to end — technical discovery, solution architecture, hands-on build, and delivery — acting as the technical authority on feasibility.
* Translate ambiguous real-world problems into concrete perception and robotics ML architectures; lead demos and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Design and build CV and perception systems — detection, segmentation, pose estimation — on the 3D geometry underneath (SE(3), camera models, projection, coordinate frames).
* Own sensor calibration and fusion — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and LiDAR–camera — plus LiDAR processing (registration, ground segmentation, object detection).
* Design egocentric data collection pipelines using wrist/head-mounted cameras, depth sensors, and IMU for robot learning.
* Bridge simulation and deployment via domain randomisation, sim setup, and sim-to-real gap analysis.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate VLA models, and fine-tune large pretrained models under data and compute constraints.
* Build supporting services — agentic loops, REST/gRPC APIs, and PostgreSQL — to expose model inference and robotics services.
* Mentor engineers, drive principled decisions (diagnose before solving), and translate current research into practical client implications.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years in robotics ML, computer vision, or technical solutions engineering.
* Strong CV and perception — detection, segmentation, pose estimation, optical flow.
* Solid 3D geometry — SE(3) transformations, camera models, projection, coordinate frames.
* Sensor calibration — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and multi-modal alignment.
* LiDAR processing and sensor fusion, including LiDAR–camera calibration.
* Sim-to-real experience — domain randomisation and sim environments (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or Unity Robotics Hub).
* Conceptual grasp of VLA architectures and the current SOTA landscape.
* Strong Python (PyTorch); able to read and implement research papers.
* Prior client-facing or presales technical experience.
* Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Agentic systems and prompt engineering — tool-use agents and multi-step planners.
* API development (REST/gRPC, Docker, basic CI/CD) and PostgreSQL.
* ROS / ROS2 or equivalent robotics middleware.
* C# for Unity-based simulation and tooling.
* Fine-tuning large pretrained models under data/compute constraints.
* Edge/onboard optimisation — TensorRT, ONNX, quantisation.
* RL / RLHF, motion planning, kinematics, or URDF.
* Hands-on with robot hardware (Franka, UR, Unitree, or similar).
* Research orientation — tracks arXiv, forms opinions from first principles.
* Publications, open-source work, or notable projects in robot learning or Physical AI.

Technical Stack
  
  

* Languages: Python (PyTorch)
* Perception / 3D: OpenCV, Open3D, PCL, point cloud processing
* Simulation: Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Unity Robotics Hub
* Robotics Middleware: ROS / ROS2
* Models: VLA models (RT-2, OpenVLA, π₀, Octo), ViTs, multimodal, hosted and open-source
* Deployment: REST/gRPC, Docker, PostgreSQL; TensorRT / ONNX for edge
* Core Areas: CV and perception, 3D geometry, calibration, LiDAR, sensor fusion, sim-to-real, agentic systems

Success Measures
  
  

* Client engagements delivered with clear architecture, working perception/robotics systems, and evaluation coverage.
* Reusable solution patterns and accelerators created from recurring engagement needs.
* Robust calibration, data collection, and sim-to-real workflows that transfer reliably to real hardware.
* Sound VLA and model-selection/fine-tuning decisions, grounded in the current SOTA landscape.
* Effective mentorship and principled technical guidance across the Technical Solutions team.

title: Associate - Transaction Services
description:

Riveron’s full spectrum of M&A capabilities includes Buy-side Due Diligence, Sell-Side Due Diligence, Operational Due Diligence, Transaction Tax, Lender Services, Integration Services, opening Balance Sheet & Financial Reporting, and Distressed Transaction Services.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You perform well in fast-paced, dynamic environments and adapt quickly to change.

**What You’ll Do**

* Use financial acumen, including knowledge of accounting standards such as GAAP, to assist clients on a variety of financial, operational, and tax issues associated with M&A transactions.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Job Description We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Sr. Gen AI Engineer / Lead Gen AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade Generative AI applications. In this dual-impact role, you will act as a primary individual contributor architecting core AI engines while simultaneously leading engineers through task allocation, code reviews, and technical mentorship. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between state-of-the-art AI research (LLMs, Agentic frameworks, Advanced RAG, OCR) and production-grade full-stack engineering (Python, FastAPI, React).

Key Responsibilities

● Generative AI & Agentic Systems: Architect, build, and optimize LLM-powered applications, multi-agent workfl ows (e.g., CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph ), and autonomous AI agents.

● RAG & Document Intelligence: Design and deploy advanced RAG architectures and document processing pipelines utilizing OCR techniques (e.g., LayoutLM, PaddleOCR, Tesseract, Azure Document Intelligence ) and Vision LLMs to extract structured data.

● Backend Microservices: Build robust, asynchronous, high-throughput microservices and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI .

● Frontend Integration: Collaborate on or build modern web interfaces using React (e.g., Control Towers, operations dashboards, interactive chat interfaces).

● MLOps & Infrastructure: Oversee model deployment, prompt engineering, fi ne-tuning, vector database integration ( Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, PGVector ), and cloud infrastructure setup ( Azure/AWS ).

● Technical Oversight: Lead a team of AI, backend, and full-stack engineers; allocate tasks, establish sprint priorities, and ensure timely delivery.

● Conduct rigorous code reviews: To maintain high engineering standards, security, performance, and scalability across AI and full-stack codebases.

Required Skills & Qualifications

● Overall Experience: 6 to 9 years of professional software engineering experience.

● AI/ML Domain Experience: 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML,OCR, and Generative AI solutions in production.

● Core Technical Stack:

○ Generative AI & LLMs: Extensive experience with commercial and open-source LLMs

(OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama), Agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen,

CrewAI), and LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, TruLens, RAGAS).

○ RAG & Unstructured Data: Strong knowledge of hybrid search, re-ranking, chunking

strategies, vector databases, and document intelligence workflows.

○ OCR & Vision Techniques: Hands-on experience with OCR engines (Tesseract, PaddleOCR,

Azure Document Intelligence) and Multi-Modal/Vision LLMs.

○ Backend: Deep expertise in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI, AsyncIO).

○ Frontend: Working proficiency in React (TypeScript/JavaScript) for building interactive web UI

components.

○ Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS), Docker,

Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

**NOTE: Location is open to any Straive or Straive acquired firms in India.**

title: Senior Analyst/Lead Analyst/Principal Analyst – Private Credit (Asset Management)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for candidates to join the Asset Management function within our Private Credit team in the Financial Research group, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Gurugram. The Private Credit team underwrites investment opportunities across public and private corporate credit, commercial real estate, loan portfolios, and special situations in Europe and North America. The Asset Management function sits within this team, monitoring investment performance and dealing cash flows, and managing key commercial aspects of the portfolio including exit strategies, servicer effectiveness, and pricing.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:
  
  
On a day-to-day basis, you will oversee deal onboarding into proprietary platforms and develop comprehensive end-to-end reporting frameworks. You will review borrower business models, cash flow forecasts, debt capacity, and collateral, and perform detailed financial modeling, including ROI, IRR, and discounted cash flow analysis to support portfolio oversight and investment decisions. The role involves regular engagement with borrowers, lenders, and other stakeholders across calls and meetings. You will develop cash management strategies for future funding needs, oversee capital allocation and funding processes, and monitor company developments, competitor actions, and industry trends to inform strategic decisions. You will track covenant compliance, monitor portfolio investments, and contribute to the development of asset exit strategies. A critical function of this role is to identify and escalate early signs of asset distress or underperformance and lead restructuring, amendment, or workout processes for distressed assets. You will also support valuations, portfolio reviews, and business plan deviation analysis on monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles.
  
  
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* An MBA or equivalent in Finance, with 2 to 13 years of experience in corporate credit analysis and asset management, with a robust grounding in financial concepts and advanced quantitative modeling capabilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with trading desks and stakeholders
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with keen attention to detail
* Proven experience leading complex projects

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with structured finance asset classes

title: Operations Executive – Quality, Warehouse & Dispatch Morning Owl | Bangalore
description:
Morning Owl makes premium natural latex mattresses in Kerala and sells direct to customers across India. We’re looking for a hands-on operations person in Bangalore to make sure every mattress reaches the customer in perfect condition and on time.

**What you’ll do**

* Receive incoming stock from our Kerala factory and inspect every mattress before it goes into storage or dispatch (size, firmness, finish, cover, packaging, transit damage)
* Flag defects or damage to the factory with photos, and hold flawed pieces back
* Manage the Bangalore warehouse: stock counts, storage, and keeping inventory in sync with orders
* Plan daily dispatches for local Bangalore and outstation orders
* Coordinate with transporters, couriers and local delivery vendors
* Track every shipment until delivery, and proactively update customers on any delay
* Batch local deliveries, plan routes, and compare transport options to cut freight costs
* Help plan restock from Kerala based on what’s selling, so we don’t run short or overstock

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–5 years in warehouse, dispatch, logistics or QC (furniture, mattress, home goods or D2C preferred)
* Experience with transporters and courier partners, both local and outstation
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and WhatsApp coordination; Shopify familiarity is a plus
* Clear, polite communicator in English and Kannada/Hindi (Malayalam is a bonus for factory coordination)
* Detail-obsessed: you’d rather hold a shipment than send a flawed product
* Two-wheeler preferred

**Why join**

* Own the full journey from warehouse to customer’s doorstep
* Small, fast-moving team with direct access to the founder

title: Prosthetist and orthotist
description:
**Company Description**
NAYAPADA'S NSTRIDE is a patient-focused organization dedicated to improving mobility, independence, and quality of life through high-quality prosthetic and orthotic solutions. Based in Bengaluru, the team works closely with individuals of diverse ages and conditions to provide customized devices and comprehensive rehabilitation support. The company emphasizes evidence-based practice, compassionate care, and the integration of modern technologies in clinical decision-making. Professionals joining NAYAPADA'S NSTRIDE can expect a collaborative environment that values continuous learning, ethical practice, and measurable patient outcomes.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Prosthetist and Orthotist role located in Bengaluru. The Prosthetist and Orthotist will assess patients’ functional needs, perform detailed gait and postural evaluations, and develop individualized treatment plans. Daily responsibilities include designing, fabricating, fitting, and adjusting prosthetic and orthotic devices, as well as educating patients and caregivers on safe use, maintenance, and rehabilitation strategies. The role involves ongoing follow-up appointments to monitor outcomes, address concerns, and optimize device performance. The professional will collaborate with physicians, therapists, and other healthcare team members, maintain accurate clinical documentation, and adhere to relevant clinical and safety standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Clinical expertise in Prosthetics, including assessment, design, fabrication, fitting, and adjustment of prosthetic devices.
* Clinical expertise in Orthotics, including prescription, fabrication, fitting, and modification of orthotic supports and braces.
* Strong skills in Patient Care, emphasizing empathetic communication, informed consent, and individualized rehabilitation support.
* Knowledge of Gait Analysis techniques and the ability to interpret findings to guide prosthetic and orthotic interventions.
* Foundational understanding of Medicine related to musculoskeletal, neurological, and rehabilitative care.
* Recognized qualification in Prosthetics and Orthotics (Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent from an accredited institution).
* Registration or eligibility for registration with relevant professional or regulatory bodies, as applicable.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team and maintain detailed clinical records.
* Strong problem-solving, manual dexterity, and attention to detail in device design and fitting.
* Commitment to evidence-based practice, continuous professional development, and adherence to ethical and safety standards.

description:

*Why Join Us?***

At Tally, we are driven by a simple yet powerful philosophy — hire for attitude, train for skills, and develop for leadership. With over 40 years of excellence and a leadership position in the Business Management Software platform leader for SMBs, we continue to innovate at the core of technology.

• Build driver-based forecasting models and stress-test assumptions to keep plans realistic and defensible.

• Drive cost visibility and efficiency analytics across functions and spend categories.

• Partner with budget owners to track spend and leakage, and build the analytical backbone for margin improvement.

**5. Process, Systems & Data Rigour**

• Strengthen FP&A models, templates, dashboards and reporting cadence.

• Drive automation, standardisation and data integrity for a single source of truth.

• Partner with business and finance leaders to align numbers with strategy.

• Manage senior stakeholders with data-backed reasoning and presence.

title: Head of Partnerships - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**The Mission**
Instawork is building the data engine for the future of Physical AI.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Head of Partnerships**
to build and lead our India business partners. You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and onboarding thousands of small, medium and large businesses across India to help build the pipeline for Robotics data collection.
  
  
The opportunity is to connect Instawork's technology, labor marketplace, and operational scale with the world's leading robotics companies and turn real-world work into the high-quality data required to train and improve the next generation of physical AI.
  
  
This is a highly entrepreneurial role for a senior partnerships leader who wants to build something from the ground up and work directly with company leadership.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Build the Partnerships Engine for Small, Medium and Large businesses in India
  
  

* Own the partnerships strategy across hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, and other labor-intensive industries.
* Build and eventually lead the partnerships team, processes, systems, and operating cadence.
* Establish clear goals and metrics for pipeline generation and business acquisition
* Execute large business partnerships with industrial, co-operative and government bodies that work with multiple businesses
* Develop repeatable playbooks for partner identification, outreach, qualification, negotiation, and conversion.

**Work Directly with Leadership**

* Partner closely with the CEO and Head of Robotics on the company's partnership strategy.
* Bring market intelligence, partner feedback, and new opportunities directly to leadership.
* Move quickly from strategy to execution, with a strong bias toward action and measurable outcomes.

**Who You Are**

* 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or a similar commercial leadership role.
* Proven track record of managing fleet on street and also building and closing large B2B partnerships.
* Experience building a partnerships or business development function from the ground up is highly preferred.
* Strong network across hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, marketplaces, or other labor-intensive industries is a major plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—you enjoy building rather than inheriting an established playbook.
* Extremely strong bias for action and ownership. You see a problem and figure out how to solve it.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, limited structure, and rapidly changing priorities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Commercially sharp, highly driven, and comfortable being measured by outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Build a strong pipeline of businesses across India.
* Close and launch high-impact partnerships with multiple industrial, cooperative or government organizations
* Establish a repeatable partnership acquisition playbook.
* Create a scalable partnerships organization and operating model.
* Help position Instawork as a critical infrastructure partner for companies building the future of Physical AI.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. title: Dietitian
description:
**About Athleaders:**

Athleaders, voted Singapore's and Dubai’s #1 Fitness Company for 4 years in a row (2021-2024) by Expat Forums and Magazines, is seeking a highly skilled dietician to join our dynamic team. With our unique model, we have helped thousands of clients achieve their health and fitness goals at their preferred location - all while prioritising convenience. We have recently expanded to Dubai and we are currently seeking a devoted and enthusiastic dietician to become a valued member of our growing team. As an Athleaders in-house dietician, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive dietary assessments, developing customised nutrition plans, and offering ongoing support to clients remotely.

**About the role:**

This role offers a fantastic opportunity for those who seek to have a meaningful impact on the lives of individuals from all walks of life and enjoy working in an intercultural context.

Responsibilities:

**Nutritional Consultations:**

* Conduct one-on-one nutritional assessments tailored to the Sinagore / Dubai client base, taking into account cultural, lifestyle, and medical considerations.
* Design personalised, goal-oriented diet plans factoring in age, gender, activity level, preferences, and dietary restrictions.
* Evaluate clients' supplement intake and recommend safe and effective adjustments.

**Nutritional Education and Client Support**

* Educate clients on core principles of nutrition and the impact of diet on overall health and fitness.
* Provide empathetic, consistent, and motivational nutritional counselling to support long-term behavior change.

**Menu Planning and Meal Guidance**

* Curate balanced and practical meal plans aligned with clients’ goals, preferences, and local food availability.
* Recommend locally available, healthy meal options (especially in Singapore, Dubai and UAE contexts).
* Share simple and delicious recipes that promote sustainability and consistency in healthy eating habits

**Monitoring, Feedback & Iteration**

* Track client progress regularly and make data-informed modifications to their nutrition plans.
* Use tech tools (e.g., apps, trackers, food logs) to monitor adherence and identify areas of improvement.

**Collaboration and Integration**

* Collaborate with fitness coaches and personal trainers to align nutritional strategies with clients' fitness regimens.
* Offer support during team-wide wellness initiatives, challenges, or transformation programs.

**Continuous Learning & Adaptability**

* Stay updated with evolving nutrition science, trends, and culturally relevant dietary practices (particularly in the Middle East and Singapore).
* Demonstrate startup-friendly qualities - agility, initiative, time management, problem-solving, and resilience.
* Be flexible and open to supporting parallel projects beyond core responsibilities when needed.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, or related field.
* Minimum 6 months of experience working in a nutrition or wellness setting, preferably with exposure to fitness clients.
* Strong understanding of nutrition principles, dietary guidelines, and culturally relevant nutrition practices.
* Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written).
* Proficient in using digital tools to support virtual consultations and planning.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and maintain attention to detail in a dynamic environment.
* A growth mindset with the ability to thrive in a hybrid startup setting.
* (Preferred) Familiarity with Singapore, Middle Eastern cuisine and Dubai’s multicultural food landscape.

**Why Work With Athleaders :**

* We are Singapore’s top personal training and nutrition coaching company - we are growing at an extremely fast pace and now expanding our footing in Dubai
* Great company culture - work from home, collaborative approach, encourage professional development & have your voice heard right at top management
* Opportunity to grow your career at a fast pace in one of Singapore’s leading health coaching companies
* Opportunity to closely work with co-founders and the management team.
* We are entrepreneurs - therefore, we value and welcome new ideas!

title: Director - Private Markets Data Services
description:
**About This Role**
The eFront Insight business, a part of Aladdin, is a fast-growing part of BlackRock’s Private Markets technology strategy, focused on building a best-in-class Private Markets Data and Analytical platform. The Insight business is a front-office platform for alternative investment professionals, creating an ecosystem connecting Limited Partners (Asset Owners / Funds of Funds), General Partners (Asset Managers), and Asset Servicers.
  
  
The Private Data Services (PDS) team is the backbone of this business, providing world-class expertise in the collection and validation of investment data for investors in alternative assets.
  
  
The Aladdin Business brings together professionals responsible for implementing and supporting our Aladdin clients, sales and marketing, and ensuring the Aladdin Community maximizes Aladdin products through engagement and education.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
We are seeking an experienced leader to play a key role in the global leadership of Private Data Services. The role spans three core areas: global operations management, client management, and artificial intelligence (AI)-led transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality operations at scale, strengthening the client experience, managing complex service and operational escalations, and driving the evolution of the operating model. The role will also lead opportunities to apply AI, automation and process improvement to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, enhance productivity, and deliver better outcomes for clients and the business.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide global leadership for Private Data Services operations, with accountability for timely and high-quality delivery, effective workforce and capacity management, operational resilience and scalable operating practices.
* Lead client engagement and manage complex client escalations, partnering across client, product, technology and operations teams to drive timely resolution while identifying and addressing underlying systemic issues
* Establish strong operating discipline across service quality, productivity, controls and operational risk, using appropriate metrics and governance to continuously improve performance.
* Lead AI-enabled transformation and automation initiatives, identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve the quality, efficiency and scalability of service delivery.
* Drive end-to-end process improvement and operating model transformation, translating operational challenges and client needs into sustainable solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Build and develop a high-performing global organization by strengthening leadership capabilities, succession and talent pipelines, establishing clear accountability, and fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture.

**Your Experience**

* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
* MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 16–20 years of relevant experience in financial services, including significant leadership experience across operations, managed services, investment data, or related functions.
* Strong understanding of private markets, financial instruments, investment data and valuation concepts, with experience operating in complex, high-volume environments.
* Demonstrated experience in client management and complex escalations, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate competing priorities and drive issues through to resolution.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale transformation, AI and automation adoption, and process improvement, with a focus on delivering measurable improvements in quality, efficiency, scalability and client outcomes.
* Strong strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with experience in operational governance, change management, developing high-performing teams, and communicating effectively across functions and geographies.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Consultant, ServiceNow
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
  
  
We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
  
  
**Job Description: ServiceNow Consultant – CMDB and Platform Capabilities**
**Your role**
As Consultant, IT ServiceNow, you will help mature and scale Vantive’s ServiceNow platform capabilities during the spin-off program and ongoing post-separation operations. The initial focus of this role will be strengthening the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including data quality, governance, integrations, CSDM alignment, and service-aware mappings. Over time, this consultant should be able to broaden across ServiceNow technologies and related IT process domains, contributing to platform strategy, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and business value realization. This role requires strong technical depth, consultative problem solving, adaptive learning, leadership, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and third-party service providers.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Lead the maturation of ServiceNow CMDB capabilities, including configuration item data quality, class and relationship modeling, lifecycle governance, reconciliation, normalization, and alignment to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to improve discovery, service mapping, integrations, and dependency data that support incident, change, asset, risk, and operational processes.
* Provide tool-agnostic expertise across IT process domains, including IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, and IT Asset Management
* Contribute to the ServiceNow platform roadmap by identifying practical opportunities to improve governance, automation, usability, maintainability, compliance, and return on investment.
* Design, configure, test, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that improve service quality, security, compliance, speed, and operational efficiency.
* Mature development, testing, release, documentation, and support practices for the ServiceNow platform, including clear handoffs to operational support teams.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions by engaging stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting user stories, and recommending fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Support platform security and compliance by applying appropriate access controls, secure configuration practices, auditability, and data protection considerations.
* Lead and coordinate third-party solution providers, ensuring deliverables are clearly defined, aligned to Vantive standards, and completed with appropriate quality and accountability.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, management information systems, business, or a related field required.
* 7+ years of experience in technology, engineering, IT operations, or related roles, including hands-on experience administering, configuring, or implementing the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong ServiceNow CMDB experience, including CI class structures, relationship modeling, data quality, governance, reconciliation, normalization, and lifecycle processes.
* Experience with CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, MID Servers, integrations, or ITOM capabilities strongly preferred.
* Ability to learn and apply broader ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, HRSD, reporting, workflow automation, and platform governance.
* Experience delivering solutions in a highly regulated, global business environment.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business, technology, security, and vendor teams while holding service providers accountable for delivery.
* Strong analytical, technical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose complex platform, process, data, and integration issues.
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset, with a willingness to broaden skills across ServiceNow technologies and connected enterprise platforms.
* Previous large transformation, separation, merger, or platform modernization program experience desired.
* Experience mentoring platform engineers, administrators, analysts, or vendor resources desired.
* ServiceNow certifications desired, especially Certified System Administrator, CIS-CMDB, CIS-Discovery, CIS-Service Mapping, ITSM, ITOM, or related certifications.

title: Senior IT Administrator (IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kaël” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint, and security backbone as Inkers scales. This role goes beyond frontline support — you will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end-to-end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and bring structure to IT security and compliance practices. You will also mentor and support junior IT staff and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.

**Responsibilities**

* Own Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive — including licensing, mail flow, retention policies, and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Lead identity and access management across Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user provisioning/deprovisioning, security groups, MFA, and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro, or equivalent) across Windows, macOS, and iOS — device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment.
* Provide IT support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, and system-related issues, and set up/configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, and other equipment.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers, and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration, and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licenses, and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups, and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control systems, and other office/site IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software, AMC, and other IT services.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding, including system setup and access management.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for the IT function.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support, or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, plus computer hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple IT requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

title: AI Platform Administrator
description:
The AI Platform Administrator is responsible for the end-to-end administration, deployment, and governance of the organization's Large Language Model landscape, spanning both offline or self-hosted (on-premise or public/private cloud) models and paid or commercial LLM services such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other enterprise AI platforms.
  
  
This person is the primary point of contact for AI platform operations, user enablement, licensing, consumption monitoring, policy enforcement, risk management, and AI service optimization. The role works closely with IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to maximize business value from AI investments while minimizing operational and regulatory risks.
  
  
The role is platform-agnostic in scope and applicable across AMETEK’s broader AI ecosystem, including Generative AI, Machine Learning platforms, AI Assistants, AI Agents, Knowledge Systems, and AI-powered business applications, with current focus on Microsoft 365 Copilot and related commercial LLM services.
  
  
**Administration**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain offline/self-hosted or on-premises LLMs on local servers, private or public cloud, or air-gapped environments.
* Manage model installation, version upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management for all self-hosted AI models.
* Optimize infrastructure (GPU/CPU, memory, storage) for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency of locally hosted models.
* Configure and maintain model access controls, authentication, and integration with internal applications and APIs.
* Perform regular health checks, backups, and disaster recovery planning for offline AI environments.
* Manage subscriptions, accounts, and API access for paid/commercial LLMs (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and similar enterprise platforms).
* Provision and de-provision user access, API keys, and workspace permissions across all paid LLM platforms.
* Coordinate with vendors on contract renewals, tiered plans, feature rollouts, and support escalations.
* Ensure integration of paid LLM services with enterprise applications, chatbots, and internal tools via APIs and connectors.
* Stay current on new model releases, pricing changes, and feature updates from commercial LLM vendors.

**Tracking And Governance**

* Establish and maintain a centralized inventory & dashboard of all LLM licenses, subscriptions, and API keys (offline and paid) across the organization.
* Continuously monitor usage metrics (tokens consumed, API calls, active seats/users, compute hours) for each LLM platform.
* Track license utilization against entitlements to identify underused, overused, or idle licenses, and recommend right-sizing.
* Define and enforce governance policies for AI/LLM usage, including acceptable use, data handling, and access approval workflows.
* Set up automated alerts and periodic reports for usage thresholds, budget overruns, and anomalous consumption patterns.
* Conduct periodic license audits and reconciliation against vendor invoices and contracts.
* Maintain documentation of usage policies, entitlements, renewal dates, and compliance requirements for each LLM.
* Partner with Finance to forecast, budget, and optimize spend on paid LLM subscriptions.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, data protection regulations, and applicable AI governance standards.

User Enablement and Training
  
  

* Develop and maintain user onboarding materials, quick-start guides, and training content for AI platform adoption.
* Deliver training sessions and internal communications to drive awareness and responsible use of AI tools.
* Serve as the first point of contact for end-user questions on licensing, access, and platform capabilities.

**Reporting**

* Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards to IT leadership on LLM usage, license utilization, cost trends, and governance compliance.
* Recommend and drive process improvements, automation, and tooling to streamline LLM administration and governance.
* Evaluate emerging LLM platforms and tools and provide recommendations on adoption or migration.

**Experience**
**Candidate Requirements:**

* 10+ years of overall IT administration and systems/application administration experience, including at least 4 years focused on AI/ML platform management.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience managing self-hosted or offline LLM deployment and paid/commercial LLM platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).
* Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps for provisioning workflows.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for hosting offline models.
* Proficient scripting skills (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for automation of monitoring and reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or a closely related field.
* Any AI related certification or degree is an added advantage.
* Microsoft Platform certification or related Microsoft certifications are a plus.
