title: Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
  
  
**Title**
: Sr Systems Administrator, Billing Systems
  
  
**Reporting to**
: Sr Manager, Systems Engineering
  
  
**Location**
: Bangalore, India
  
  
**Department**
: Enterprise Business Systems
  
  
**Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems**
Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We're hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.
  
  
The Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems is the senior platform expert across Quickbase's billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role owns day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment, currently anchored on BillingPlatform and Stripe, with the platform landscape expected to evolve. As the senior-most administrator on the team, this role also carries a higher bar for platform strategy, complex problem-solving, and mentorship of other billing systems administrators.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
***Billing Systems Administration***

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our product-led self-serve motion and sales-led enterprise grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
* Serve as the primary Stripe and enterprise billing platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly
* Lead the evaluation, planning, and execution of billing platform changes and migrations, and serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for the most complex billing systems issues

***Quote-to-Cash Integrations***

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote-to-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
* Support CPQ-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract-to-subscription linkages
* Configure and test PLG self-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self-serve subscription management
* Proactively identify quote-to-cash risks and dependencies across billing, CPQ, and provisioning systems, and drive resolution ahead of launches and pricing changes

***Provisioning Connectivity***

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing-to-provisioning handoff across both PLG self-serve and SLG enterprise motions
* Maintain the billing-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and our enterprise billing platform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
* Monitor the billing-to-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side
* Lead root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact billing-to-provisioning failures and drive the resulting process or configuration improvements to closure

***Data Quality & Reconciliation***

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
* Support billing reconciliation across our enterprise billing platform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
* Support month-end and quarter-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other billing systems administrators, and contribute to team-wide best practices, standards, and documentation

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self-serve customers, including experience operating as the senior-most or lead administrator on a billing systems team
* Deep hands-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform (e.g., BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, Chargebee) — depth on any one of these matters more than tenure on a specific platform
* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote-to-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
* Familiarity with billing-to-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales-led and product-led revenue motions
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional billing initiatives and mentoring less experienced administrators

**Preferred**

* Stripe certification such as Stripe Associate
* Experience with usage-based pricing models, including metered billing, freemium conversion, and monthly self-serve
* Experience owning or co-owning tax configuration and integration layer in a SaaS billing environment, including tax rule management, product taxability, and billing platform integration
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or hands-on CPQ experience
* Experience evaluating or migrating between billing platforms a plus

**Important Notices**
**Recorded Interviews.**
Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  
  
**Interview Integrity.**
AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  
  
**How We Review Applications**
We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

GE Vernova baut Betriebsteams auf, die sich auf die Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der von allen Geschäftsbereichen genutzten Computing- und Netzwerkinfrastruktur konzentrieren. Diese Teams setzen sich aus hochtalentierten Mitarbeitern zusammen, für die Verfügbarkeit oberste Priorität hat. Der ideale Mitarbeiter hat eine Leidenschaft für die Automatisierung von Prozessen und ist absolut darum bemüht, den Kunden ein einzigartiges Erlebnis zu liefern.
  
  
**Job Description**
Rollen und VerantwortlichkeitenIm Rahmen dieser Rolle werden Sie:
  
  

* Verfügbar, um schnell zu reagieren und kritische Serviceausfälle zu beheben, die die Verbraucher stark beeinträchtigen
* Legt Leistungsbasis und Kapazitätsschwellen fest, korreliert Ereignisse und definiert Überwachungs- und Alarmierungskriterien
* Entwickelt automatisierte Lösungen, um potenzielle Probleme zu beheben, bevor sie zu einer Betriebsunterbrechung führen
* Stellt einen Plan zur Folgenabschätzung und Schadensbegrenzung für Änderungen in der Produktionsumgebung bereit
* Untersucht die Ursache schwerwiegender und systembedingter Ausfälle, ermittelt Korrekturmaßnahmen und wendet sie unternehmensweit an
* Entwickelt Verfügbarkeitsmaßnahmen, die auf die Kundenerfahrung abgestimmt sind, um die Verwendbarkeit wichtiger Dienste genau zu bewerten
* Erstellt Kapazitätsmodelle, um die Transaktionslast mit der Ressourcenleistung zu vergleichen, und nutzt Daten, um die Gesamtsystemkapazität vorherzusagen und die Lastplatzierung zu automatisieren, um Ausfälle zu vermeiden
* Ermittelt Schwellenwerte für alle kritischen Links im Datenpfad, um schnell zu ermitteln, wo Ungleichgewichte zu potenziellen Ausfällen führen können
* Analysiert Fehlerstellen in Diensten, um die Risikostufe und die Lösungsschritte zu modellieren, wenn ein Fehler auftritt.
* Unterstützung beim Einbringen von Architekturverbesserungen in das System, um mögliche Fehlerquellen zu minimieren
* Überwacht und behebt programmgesteuert Konfigurationsveränderungen kritischer Geräte
* Entwickelt Reaktionspläne für potenzielle Fehlerquellen und bewertet die Wirksamkeit bei geplanten Tests
* Führt umfassende Betriebsprüfungen der gesamten Services durch, um Problembereiche zu identifizieren und Aktivitäten zu verfolgen, um Verbesserungen auf allen Ebenen der Architektur voranzutreiben
* Bietet technisches Coaching und Anleitung für Junior-TeamkollegenGrundqualifikationenDiese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung im Enterprise Application Engineering. Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor-Studium in Informatik, den MINT-Hauptfächern (Mathematik, Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) oder vergleichbarer AbschlussGewünschte Eigenschaften
* Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Skripterstellung oder Entwicklung von Software und Diensten für die Cloud Ruby, Python, Go, Java, Node.js, .NET usw.
* Besessen von Verfügbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit, während Sie alles proaktiv angehen
* Fundiertes Verständnis von Cloud Computing, einschließlich Sicherheit, Nutzungsszenarien und Infrastrukturgrundlagen
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse gängiger Betriebssysteme (Unix/Linux, Windows)
* Umfassende Kenntnisse der Netzwerkprotokolle (TCP/IP, SNMP, FTP, Syslog, TFTP usw.)
* Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Versionskontrollsystemen wie Git
* Erfahrung in Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Infrastrukturen in öffentlichen Clouds wie AWS oder Azure
* Erfahrung mit einem automatisierten Konfigurationsmanagementsystem (Terraform, Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Salt usw.)
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse des Netzwerkmanagements (SNMP, MIB)
* Erfahren mit dem Konfigurieren, Anpassen und Erweitern von Überwachungstools (Datadog, Sensu, Grafana, Splunk)
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse in TCP/IP-Netzwerken und Inter-Networking-Technologien (Routing/Switching, Proxy, Firewall, Load Balancing usw.)
* Begeistert, Wege zu finden, um Kunden erfolgreich zu machen
* Fähig, innerhalb eines kleinen Teams gut zu arbeiten und sich auf die schnelle Bereitstellung von Ergebnissen zu konzentrieren
* Leidenschaft für kontinuierliches Lernen und die Fähigkeit, sich schnell anzupassen und in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu gewinnen
* Behaglich darin, Kollegen zu befähigen und andere zu inspirieren, ihr Bestes zu geben
* Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse in einem sich schnell ändernden dynamischen Umfeld zu liefern

title: Senior Analyst, System Administration
description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
****What We Offer:****
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
  
  
****Group Summary:****
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities:****
As a Senior Security Analyst – System Administration (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the secure and compliant operation of our enterprise-critical IT systems, including SAP, B2B integrations, MES, and Baan (Infor LN). You will serve as the central point of contact for IT audit-related activities, working closely with internal teams, external auditors, and system stakeholders to ensure adherence to security and compliance standards.
  
  
In this position, you will combine your deep technical knowledge of system administration with your expertise in IT compliance to monitor, document, and enhance the security posture of our interconnected system landscape. You will contribute to audit readiness, security operations, and the continuous improvement of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) – all within a dynamic, production-oriented environment with complex integration between IT and OT systems.
  
  
If you are looking for a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of IT security, compliance, and critical business systems, we invite you to join our international IT security team.
  
  
The System Admin SAP Security Analyst will work closely with the global ISOL (Industrial Solution) Team and their Manager to ensure the smooth operation and security of the SAP systems.
  
  
****Your Responsibilities****
**Audit & Compliance Support**

* Plan, coordinate, and support internal and external IT audits (e.g. ITGC, SOX, internal audit)
* Act as the interface between IT operations, application owners (SAP, B2B, MES, Baan), and auditors
* Track and implement audit findings and continuously improve audit readiness
* Create and maintain audit-relevant documentation, such as system overviews, role and authorization concepts

**System Administration with a Focus on Business-Critical Systems**

* Technical administration and security support of systems in the areas of SAP (ERP, S/4HANA, SAP Cloud ), B2B integrations, MES systems, and Baan (Infor LN)
* Support secure integration between shop floor systems (MES) and core ERP solutions
* Evaluate security risks in the existing system landscape and develop appropriate mitigation strategies
* Maintain and optimize technical logging, monitoring, and reporting solutions

**Security Operations & ISMS Support**

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of the ISMS (according to ISO 27001 or BSI standards)
* Analyze security incidents and vulnerabilities, and coordinate remediation activities
* Define and maintain security policies and operational documentation
* Conduct risk assessments and support security workshops and awareness training

****Collaboration And Communication:****

* Work closely with other IT and business teams to ensure system integrity.
* Communicate security policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders.
* Assist in the development and implementation of security strategies.
* Handle audits related to ISOL security, providing necessary documentation and evidence. Support internal and external audits.
* Project management for risk and compliance tasks, including Saviynt/GRC and authorization clean-up, as well as other MAGNA ISOL projects.
* Monitor and analyze security incidents, conducting audits and vulnerability assessments to identify and address potential risks and vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with IT teams and external partners to ensure compliance with security standards. Manage relationships with external vendors and consultants for security-related projects and services.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments and trends in ISOL Landscape, Azure, and SAP, B2B MES, Baan security.
* Provide technical guidance and support to other team members as needed.

****Who We Are Looking For****

* Degree in (Business) Informatics, IT Security, Computer Sciences or comparable education
* SAP Certification
* Several years of professional experience in IT security, system administration, or IT audit with a focus on compliance
* Strong knowledge in administration and security of SAP systems, MES environments, and ideally Baan (Infor LN)
* Experience with B2B interfaces and secure operations (e.g. EDI, API management)
* Excellent English language skills

****Your Preferred Qualifications****

* Familiarity with IT security standards such as ISO 27001, BSI, ITIL, or COBIT

****What We Offer****

As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. title: Technical Support Engineer (IT Infrastructure) - Bangalore (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Support Engineer at Flix, you'll be the first point of contact for IT infrastructure requests, helping employees across the globe stay productive through reliable service desk and on-site support. You'll be part of a globally distributed IT Infrastructure Support Team that owns and manages critical services — including the employee device lifecycle (Microsoft Intune/Autopilot), our Atlassian cloud environment, and technical event support.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Resolve employee IT requests efficiently via our ticketing system, providing a smooth and friendly support experience
* Manage the device lifecycle end-to-end — hardware procurement, provisioning, setup, asset tracking, and troubleshooting
* Support collaboration tools including Office 365, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and OneDrive
* Help employees get the most out of Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM
* Create and maintain knowledge-base articles and IT documentation to support self-service and team efficiency
* Build hands-on experience with device management platforms and IT infrastructure tooling
* Collaborate with colleagues across global offices, contributing to team ceremonies and cross-functional projects

**What You Bring**

* A degree, certification, or vocational training in an IT-related field (e.g. Information Technology, Computer Science, or Information Systems)
* 2–4 years of experience in IT support, service desk, or technical customer support
* Solid working knowledge of Office 365 and standard workplace collaboration tools
* Comfort communicating clearly and patiently with non-technical users
* Curiosity and a genuine eagerness to learn new technologies and workflows
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft cloud technologies (Intune, Entra ID, Autopilot)
* Experience administering Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, JSM)
* Experience supporting employees across multiple time zones or global offices (nice to have)

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Work from another location for up to 6 weeks per year, depending on your role
* Hybrid work model: Office-first with flexibility to balance work and life
* Life Cover: Insurance cover for employees
* Medical Cover: Hospitalisation and treatment cover for employees and eligible family members
* Accident Cover: Personal accident insurance for employee
* OPD Wallet: a fixed annual allowance for outpatient care — consultations, medicines, and more — for employee and eligible family members
* Wellness Allowance: a monthly wellness allowance credited to your Plum wallet, to spend on gym, yoga, fitness equipment, or any eligible wellness activity of your choice
* Meal Vouchers: Optional tax-exempt meal benefit under the Income Tax Act
* Wellbeing support: Access to confidential 1:1 counselling, stress management courses, and mental health resources
* Learning & Development: Language learning opportunities, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced Flix colleagues to accelerate your career

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:
**Locations - Flix Career**
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Engineer III, Systems Reliability Engineering
description:

* Guide knowledge management through the creation and maintenance of operational plans, support documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Provide daily technical leadership and mentoring to India-based scheduling engineers while supporting capability development and operational maturity.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, and business teams to manage scheduling calendars, dependencies, change windows, reliability improvements, and ITSM process maturity.

* 9+ years of experience in IT production support, application operations, infrastructure operations, batch processing, or Site Reliability Engineering, including leadership experience..
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience supporting enterprise workload automation and job scheduling platforms such as HCL Workload Automation, TWS, Control-M, or similar technologies.
* Experience with job dependency mapping, scheduling calendars, cross-application workload orchestration, and upstream and downstream impact analysis.
* Knowledge of ITSM practices, incident and problem management, observability tools, and the ability to communicate technical issues and business impacts effectively.

**Benefits**
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. **Job Description**
**Senior Hardware End User Analyst**
**3M Health Care is now Solventum**
At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.
  
  
We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role:**
We are seeking a highly skilled Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep technical expertise in end-user hardware and global asset management practices. This role requires hands-on experience with managing enterprise-level hardware environments and be a technical authority for end-user hardware, including laptops and desktops.
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge of PC and desktop hardware, current protocols, operating systems, and industry standards.

description:

2026-19390

08/09/2026
**Location**
Bengaluru, India
**Category**
IT
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Landscape & Cutover Lead to manage the coordination and governance of our SAP landscape across business-critical environments, ensuring systems are stable, secure and aligned with business and delivery needs.
  
  
Working across Basis, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Project Delivery, Service Management and business teams, you will lead landscape planning, environment usage, system availability, refresh cycles, release alignment and technical change control. You will also chair SAP landscape, release, change and environment governance forums.
  
  
This role is key to ensuring the SAP landscape supports both operational needs and strategic transformation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Own and maintain the SAP landscape strategy, including development, test, quality assurance, pre-production, training, sandbox, and production environments.
  
  
Lead SAP environment roadmap and ensures landscapes are available and fit for purpose for projects, releases, testing, upgrades, integrations, and business-as-usual support.
  
  
Coordinate landscape demand from projects, programmes, and operational teams, resolving conflicts around environment usage, system availability, freeze periods, and refresh schedules.
  
  
Maintain a clear view of SAP system dependencies, interfaces, data flows, and environment relationships. Ensure landscape decisions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, operational resilience, and business continuity requirements.
  
  
Oversee the operational health of the SAP landscape to ensure service stability. Govern system availability, performance, capacity, technical risks, and recurring operational issues. Orchestrate incident, problem, and change activities affecting the SAP landscape, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and communication.
  
  
Ensure operational documentation, system inventories, support models, ownership matrices, and critical issue paths are maintained.
  
  
Accountable for planning and coordination of system refreshes, client copies, environment rebuilds, system provisioning, and decommissioning activities. Coordinate technical readiness for SAP releases, upgrades, migrations, enhancement packages, support packs, kernel updates, and major project deployments.
  
  
Work with delivery teams to ensure development, test, and production environments are aligned to release and testing requirements. Lead environment freeze windows, transport routes, retrofit considerations, sequencing, and dependency impacts.
  
  
Support cutover planning and technical dress rehearsals for major SAP changes.
  
  
Ensure SAP landscape follows security, audit, regulatory, and internal control requirements. Work closely with SAP Security and GRC teams to ensure environment access, segregation of duties, privileged access, and sensitive data usage are appropriately governed.
  
  
Ensure non-production systems are in synch with data protection, masking, retention, and access control standards.
  
  
Act as the central point of coordination for SAP landscape matters across IT, business, project, and supplier teams. Provide clear communication on landscape availability, risks, constraints, dependencies, and planned changes.
  
  
Work with third-party vendors, service providers, and internal teams to ensure service levels are met.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4 to 8 years of solid experience working in complex SAP environments, ideally across multiple SAP products and integrated systems. Should have led landscape demand across projects, programmes, and business-as-usual operations.
* Good understanding of SAP landscape architecture across production and non-prod environments.
* Experience coordinating SAP Basis, infrastructure, database, cloud, security, and application teams.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management, release cycles, system refreshes, client copies, upgrades, patching, and technical change control.
* Good understanding of IT service management processes, including change, release, problem and configuration management.
* Strong risk management, governance, planning, and documentation skills.

**“Nice To Have” Skills And Experience**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP GRC, SAP BW/Datasphere or SAP Enterprise Portal.
* Experience with cloud-hosted SAP landscapes, for example AWS, Google Cloud, RISE with SAP, or private cloud environments!
* Understanding of SAP security concepts, privileged access, role governance, SoD, and non-production data protection.

* Provide support that includes mandatory weekend, holiday shift work and on-call support. Support includes a blend of as-needed and rotational coverage, which is subject to change.

* Strong understanding of security concepts such as NGFW, ZTNA, SWG, and CASB.

* AI Exposure & Operational Efficiency AI & Automation Familiarity: Experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI utilities and workflow automation platforms (such as coding assistants, low-code integration tools, or orchestration systems) to build helper scripts, streamline diagnostics, or automate repetitive support tasks. Future-Ready Mindset: A basic conceptual understanding of AI workflows (such as LLMs or automated task flows) with an interest in identifying how these technologies can be applied to optimize customer communication or accelerate knowledge sharing (like automated KB drafting)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Palo Alto Networks certifications (PCNSA, PCNSE, or PCSAE).
* Advanced industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE or CISSP.
* Experience with identity provider integrations (e.g., SAML 2.0, Okta, Azure AD).
* Basic scripting skills in Python or PowerShell to automate repetitive diagnostic tasks.

* Collect, validate, and document pre‑onboarding information from application owners and stakeholders.
* Support the assessment and selection of appropriate onboarding methods and connector types (e.g., AD, CSV, API/web services).
* Assist in deploying and configuring applications within SailPoint IdentityNow under the direction of senior analysts.
* Execute Post‑Implementation Testing (PIT) activities including data validation, entitlement verification, and lifecycle checks.
* Perform routine data quality reviews, cleansing, and maintenance to ensure accuracy and integrity of identity data.
* Create or enhance scripts and tools to automate onboarding or data preparation tasks.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify new connector requirements, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Provide operational support and knowledge transfer on onboarding processes and standards.
* Generate and analyse onboarding and operational reports to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
* Maintain process documentation, configuration notes, and audit evidence in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
* Stay current on IdentityNow capabilities, industry practices, and emerging Identity Governance technologies.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience in IAM/security operations.
* Hands‑on experience with SailPoint IdentityNow or similar IGA solutions.
* Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell, Java, or similar).
* Working knowledge of:

+ Active Directory and LDAP concepts
+ REST APIs, authentication methods, and data integrations
+ CSV‑based data ingestion

* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and IAM principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and data‑quality skills.
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding activities in a project‑driven environment.
* Clear communication skills, with confidence engaging both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to follow standards, learn new technologies, and grow within an IAM/IGA operating model.

**Technical Skills**

* Understanding of joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle processes.

* Awareness of access certifications and audit requirements.

title: Senior Business System Support Analyst
description:
**Senior Business Systems Support Analyst (Workday Specialist)**
Location: Bangalore
  
  
**About Mimecast**
Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
  
  
We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
  
  
**AI-First Engineering at Mimecast**
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
  
  
Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst with strong Workday expertise to own Workday administration and production support as the core of this role. You will be the go-to specialist for Workday functional and admin support, including business process configuration, security groups, reporting, and troubleshooting, while also extending that support to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi integrations, Partner Portal, and Docusign. This role is ideal for someone with deep hands-on Workday knowledge, strong application support experience, and the ability to manage support tickets, work with cross-functional teams, and support business operations across the wider systems landscape.
  
  
What You Will Work On
  
  
As a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst, you will support day-to-day business operations across key systems and processes, including:
  
  

* Workday Support (Primary Focus): user queries, access/security group requests, business process configuration, condition rules, calculated fields, HR data and reporting issues, workflow and approval errors, and process-related support across Workday.
* Workday Integrations Support: initial triage of Workday integration failures, data load issues, and coordination with technical/HRIS teams for resolution.
* Reporting & Dashboards: support users with Workday reports, dashboards, KPIs, saved views, and operational reporting requirements.
* Other Business Platforms: secondary support across connected platforms, including NetSuite (finance-related user requests, role/access issues, approval workflows, and transaction queries), Boomi integrations (initial investigation of failed syncs and data flow issues), Partner Portal (partner user access, login, and visibility support), and Docusign.
* Ticket & Incident Management: triage, prioritization, SLA-based resolution, escalation handling, documentation, and user communication.
* Process Improvement: identify recurring issues, support gaps, and opportunities to improve user experience and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary functional and administrative point of contact for Workday, supporting HR, Finance, Customer Experience, Partner Operations, and Go-To-Market teams.
* Investigate issues related to Workday business processes, security groups, condition rules, reports, calculated fields, workflows, approval steps, and data visibility.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve Workday-related support tickets within agreed SLA timelines, and support users with how-to queries, troubleshooting, and process guidance.
* Collaborate with Workday admins/HRIS teams, QA, business stakeholders, and technical teams to resolve complex or recurring Workday issues.
* Support Workday system enhancements, feature rollouts, process changes, testing activities, and business adoption.
* Extend support as needed across other business platforms, including NetSuite (access, approvals, finance workflows), Boomi integrations (initial issue analysis and coordination with technical teams), and Partner Portal (access and visibility support).
* Maintain SOPs, FAQs, resolution notes, knowledge articles, and support documentation, with a primary focus on Workday.
* Identify support trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across Workday and other platforms, and recommend improvements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in business systems support, application support, or IT support operations, with a strong focus on Workday.
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday (HCM, Core HR, or related modules) in a production environment — this is a core requirement for the role.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security groups, condition rules, calculated fields, and reporting.
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of incident management, SLA-based support, prioritization, and escalation handling.
* Ability to troubleshoot user issues, identify root causes, and provide clear resolutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Good to Have
  
  

* Familiarity with Workday integration tools such as EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, or reporting (RaaS) from a functional support perspective.
* Workday Pro certification (e.g., HCM, Core Compensation, Absence, or Security) or similar Workday certification.
* Experience supporting teams across HR, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partner Operations, Support, or Go-To-Market functions.
* Exposure to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi, Partner Portal, ERP systems, or other HRIS/finance platforms.
* General understanding of integrations from a functional support perspective.
* Experience creating SOPs, support documentation, knowledge articles, and user training material.
* Experience supporting UAT, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a Workday expert first — someone with strong Workday functional and admin knowledge who can own Workday support end-to-end, from business process configuration to security, reporting, and troubleshooting. They should also be comfortable extending that support to other business platforms as needed, understanding business impact, communicating clearly with users, coordinating with technical teams, and contributing to continuous improvement across support operations.
  
  
**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
  
  
*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.

* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are an experienced Platform Engineer who owns backend infrastructure end to end. You design multi-tenant, microservices-based systems that other engineering teams build on, and you make deliberate architectural tradeoffs around consistency, latency, scale, and cost. You are comfortable going deep — service mesh internals, database internals, distributed-systems failure modes — and equally comfortable defining the reliability and security contracts an enterprise AI platform depends on.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, own, and evolve scalable microservices architectures on Kubernetes across GCP, Azure, and AWS, including multi-tenant isolation (namespaces, network policies, per-tenant resource quotas and RBAC).
* Build core platform and data-plane components in Golang and Python — data ingestion, knowledge-base indexing and vector/graph search, application connectivity, workflow automation, and ML operations — against explicit latency and throughput SLOs.
* Own service-to-service communication: gRPC/protobuf API contracts, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), load balancing, retries, timeouts, and circuit breaking.
* Make and document architectural tradeoffs — partitioning/sharding strategy, consistency models (strong vs. eventual), caching tiers, and build-vs-buy decisions.
* Define the reliability contract: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/KEDA), and graceful degradation.
* Design and operate the observability stack — Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and real-time alerting — for full visibility into system health.
* Drive DevOps and platform-engineering practices: IaC (Terraform), Helm, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Optimize for performance and cost — profiling, load testing, latency budgets, and cost-per-request.
* Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response and root-cause analysis.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Platform, Infrastructure, or Backend Engineering.
* Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and networking.
* Proficiency in Golang and Python.
* Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (GCP, Azure, or AWS); multi-cloud a strong plus.
* Strong database expertise: query and read/write-path optimization, partitioning/sharding, replication and consistency models, with practical experience in NoSQL and graph stores. Solid grasp of the CAP theorem and database internals.
* Solid distributed-systems foundation: idempotency, backpressure, delivery semantics (at-least-once vs. exactly-once), and message queues (Kafka/Pulsar/NATS/PubSub).
* Track record of building platforms from the ground up that other engineering teams successfully build on.

title: Sr. Manager, End User Services & IT Automation (Hybrid, Bangalore)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
At Smartsheet, we're scaling our India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services in a Mac-first environment.
  
  
You'll sit at the center of our AI and automation strategy for the service desk, leading two teams: Security & Desktop Systems, who pair Service Desk support with first-line security triage, and IT Automation, who build the AI agents and workflows that make that work faster. You'll decide where agents, deterministic automation, and people each belong, and own your teams' performance against SLAs and quality targets.
  
  
You'll partner daily with our US IT leadership, aligning on standards and sharing what works. For the right candidate, there is a clear path to Director within 12-18 months as we continue to scale the India GCC.
  
  
**A note on the role:**
This is a hands-on leadership role, though not a hands-on-every-day one. You'll stay close enough to the technology to prototype, review, and debug alongside your engineers, and to step in when the team is stretched or something breaks. If you want to lead from a distance, this isn't the right fit. If you want to lead from credibility, it is.
  
  
You Will
  
  
**AI & Automation Strategy**

* Own the AI and automation strategy for the service desk, lead the IT Automation Engineers in delivering it, and decide which workflows suit AI agents, deterministic automation, or people
* Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
* Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting), and design and review agent-based workflows end to end, including the tools they call and where a human approves
* Set guardrails for automated actions, including identity verification, least-privilege access, permissions-aware data retrieval, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive requests
* Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help build, debug, and fix automations when they fail or stall

**Security & Desktop Systems**

* Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts and peer service desk managers in other regions to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
* Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
* Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
* Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
* Step in hands-on when volumes spike or critical issues arise, and coach people through the fix
* Keep knowledge base articles and process documentation current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

* Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
* Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
* Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
* Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
* Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**People Leadership**

* Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
* Partner with peer managers across regions to align service standards, share automation and best practices, and keep the global service desk experience consistent
* Design and lead onboarding for new team members
* Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

You Have
  
  
**Experience**

* 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
* 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations, including influencing peers and stakeholders across regions without direct authority
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to IT workflows, such as function/tool calling, MCP, or API-based orchestration, and the judgment to know when to use agents, deterministic automation, or humans
* Experience overseeing Tier 1 security operations, such as alert triage, escalation, and incident response, ideally including endpoint (EDR) alerts
* Experience leading engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical depth to review their work, set direction, and contribute when needed
* A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity, and of stepping into technical problems credibly when the team needs it

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on expertise in macOS endpoint management through Jamf (or a comparable Apple MDM such as Kandji or Mosyle), including zero-touch enrollment, policy and patch management, and Apple Business Manager. Our fleet is roughly 80% macOS.
* Working knowledge of Windows endpoint management through Intune, covering the remaining 20% of our fleet
* Solid understanding of identity and productivity platforms (Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory; M365)
* Working knowledge of an ITSM platform such as Freshservice, including workflow design, API integrations, and governance
* Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, PowerShell, or shell) sufficient to review and contribute to automation work
* Familiarity with EDR platforms (including macOS coverage), firewalls, and ITIL or equivalent frameworks

**Preferred**

* Experience building agents with LLM APIs/SDKs or agent frameworks, including retrieval (RAG) over IT knowledge
* Experience building and scaling a service desk or IT automation function

**Work Style**

* Excellent English communication, strong self-motivation, and reliable follow-through
* Comfortable moving between leading the team and rolling up your sleeves
* Willing to join a short early-morning call for US handover, and the occasional evening global meeting
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

If you meet most of this but not every bullet, we'd still like to hear from you.
  
  
**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

title: Generative Engine Optimization strategist
description:
**Company Description**
Connectify.global (Connectify Technologies) operates at the intersection of technology, intelligence, and execution, partnering with visionary organizations to build transformative digital experiences and AI-powered products. The company focuses on engineering enterprise solutions that aim to redefine industries rather than simply automate existing processes. Teams at Connectify.global work closely with clients to design, implement, and optimize advanced technology solutions that drive measurable business impact. The environment is fast-paced, innovation-driven, and highly collaborative, offering professionals the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects with global reach.

**About the Role**

* Looking for an experienced SEO & GEO Expert who combines strong SEO fundamentals with practical Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
* Grow organic visibility in traditional search while helping brands become more discoverable, accurately represented, and cited across AI-powered search experiences
* Ideal candidate is hands-on, analytical, and able to own strategy through execution, from technical audits and content planning to experimentation, reporting, and measurable business outcomes

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SEO Strategy & Technical Optimization**

* Develop SEO strategies to improve organic rankings, qualified traffic, leads, and conversions
* Audit crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, redirects, canonicals, XML sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and page speed
* Conduct keyword and search-intent research, competitor analysis, content-gap analysis, and topical-cluster planning
* Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, on-page content, and structured data/schema markup
* Identify ethical link-building and digital PR opportunities; collaborate with developers on technical fixes
* Monitor performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, and Screaming Frog

**2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search**

* Improve brand visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-search experiences
* Research target prompts and customer questions; monitor brand mentions, cited sources, source URLs, competitor visibility, and response sentiment
* Analyze why competitors are referenced and find practical ways to improve the brand’s eligibility for citations
* Create clear, accurate, evidence-backed content that is easy for users and AI systems to understand and retrieve
* Strengthen entity signals, topical authority, internal linking, source credibility, and consistency of brand information across trusted sources
* Build repeatable prompt-testing and GEO measurement frameworks; report changes without promising guaranteed AI rankings or citations

**3. Content, Authority & Reputation**

* Build content briefs for service pages, pillar pages, FAQs, comparisons, expert resources, and case studies aligned with search intent
* Work with writers and subject-matter experts to demonstrate E-E-A-T (experience, expertise, authority, trustworthiness)
* Identify credible third-party mentions, relevant directories, industry publications, community opportunities, and review-generation initiatives
* Audit existing content and recommend updates, consolidation, or removal based on quality, relevance, and performance

**4. Analytics, Experimentation & Collaboration**

* Define baselines and KPIs for organic performance and AI visibility; track rankings, clicks, impressions, qualified visits, leads, citations, and mentions where measurable
* Run experiments, interpret results, and turn data into prioritized recommendations and monthly reports
* Coordinate with developers, writers, designers, and marketing teams; manage multiple projects and prioritize by impact, effort, and business value

**5. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO, content strategy, and measurable organic growth
* Practical experience with GEO, AEO, or AI-search visibility optimization, backed by examples or a clear measurement methodology
* Strong understanding of crawling, indexing, search intent, ranking systems, information retrieval, and content discovery
* Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and at least one major SEO toolset (Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog)
* Experience with technical audits, schema markup, keyword research, content optimization, competitor analysis, and reporting
* Ability to work with developers, communicate recommendations clearly, and independently move from diagnosis to implementation
* Strong analytical thinking, research skills, communication, and an execution-oriented mindset

**6. Good to Have**

* Experience measuring AI citations and brand mentions across multiple AI platforms
* Knowledge of entities, knowledge graphs, semantic SEO, RAG, and modern search/retrieval concepts
* Python, SQL, APIs, or automation for SEO/GEO data collection and analysis
* Agency or multi-client experience, digital PR, reputation management, JavaScript SEO, or headless websites

**7. What Success Looks Like**

* Improved relevant organic rankings, qualified organic traffic, and conversions against agreed baselines
* Increased visibility, relevant citations, and accurate brand mentions across a defined set of target AI prompts, where measurable
* Resolved technical issues affecting crawling, indexing, and content discovery
* A repeatable SEO + GEO workflow with clear priorities, credible reporting, and evidence of what is working
* Performance evaluated against agreed baselines, realistic targets, and business outcomes, not rankings or AI mentions alone

**8. Ideal Candidate**

* A practitioner, not just a strategist
* Can audit a website, identify SEO and GEO opportunities, implement or guide changes, measure results, and explain what worked and why
* Candidates with only theoretical GEO knowledge and no practical SEO depth may not be the right fit

**9. Application Requirements**

* Share your resume, relevant project experience, and examples of measurable SEO and/or GEO results
* Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical website audit and present a 90-day action plan

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled, result-oriented SEO Specialist who can independently manage and scale our entire SEO project, improve organic visibility, drive qualified traffic, and establish HelloFi as a trusted brand across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

1. End-to-End SEO Ownership

Solely handle and manage the entire SEO project of HelloFi, from strategy development to execution, monitoring, and performance reporting.

Develop and implement a comprehensive SEO roadmap aligned with business objectives, organic traffic growth, and revenue generation.

Take complete ownership of SEO performance, identify growth opportunities, and deliver measurable results.

2. On-Page and Off-Page SEO

Demonstrate expert-level knowledge of on-page and off-page SEO techniques.

Optimise website architecture, URLs, metadata, headings, internal linking, schema markup, and page content.

Develop effective backlink acquisition strategies, digital PR initiatives, and authority-building campaigns.

Identify and resolve technical SEO issues, including crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, Core Web Vitals, and website performance.

3. AEO and GEO Implementation

Possess strong practical knowledge of Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

Implement strategies to improve HelloFi's visibility across AI-powered search experiences, answer engines, and generative search platforms.

Optimise content for AI-generated answers, featured snippets, People Also Ask, conversational queries, and entity-based search.

Demonstrate practical implementation and noticeable, measurable improvements in AEO and GEO performance.

4. AI Search Algorithms and Industry Updates

Stay updated with the latest Google algorithm updates, AI-driven search developments, ranking systems, and changes in search behaviour.

Understand how AI is transforming organic search and implement relevant strategies to maintain and improve visibility.

Adapt SEO strategies based on algorithm changes, competitor movements, search trends, and emerging best practices.

5. Keyword Research and Analysis

Conduct in-depth keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and keyword gap analysis.

Identify high-intent commercial and transactional keywords that can generate qualified traffic and conversions.

Build keyword clusters, topical maps, and content strategies to improve topical authority.

Identify opportunities for product pages, category pages, landing pages, and location-based searches.

6. Content Optimisation and SEO Strategy

Optimise existing website content and develop SEO-driven content strategies for product, category, landing, and informational pages.

Ensure content aligns with search intent, E-E-A-T principles, semantic relevance, and current search quality guidelines.

Collaborate with content writers and other team members to improve content quality, keyword targeting, and organic performance.

Avoid keyword stuffing and outdated SEO practices in favour of sustainable, user-focused optimisation.

7. Google Business Profile Optimisation

Manage and optimise HelloFi's Google Business Profile to improve local search visibility and Google Maps rankings.

Implement local SEO strategies, including category optimisation, business information accuracy, reviews, local citations, and location-based keywords.

Track local ranking performance and develop strategies to increase profile visibility, customer enquiries, and store visits.

8. SEO Tools and Analytics

Possess thorough practical knowledge of leading SEO tools, including:

Google Search Console

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Ahrefs / Semrush

Screaming Frog SEO Spider

Google Keyword Planner

Google Trends

PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals tools

Schema validation and technical SEO auditing tools

Use data-driven insights to monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, indexing, backlinks, conversions, and competitor performance.

Prepare regular SEO performance reports with actionable insights and clear growth metrics.

Required Skills and Qualifications

1) Proven experience in independently managing complete SEO projects with measurable results.

2) Strong expertise in technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, keyword research, and content optimisation.

3) Practical knowledge of AEO, GEO, and AI-driven search optimisation.

4) Good understanding of Google algorithm updates and their impact on search rankings.

5) Ability to independently identify SEO opportunities, execute strategies, troubleshoot issues, and measure outcomes.

6) Strong analytical skills with a focus on organic traffic growth, keyword visibility, qualified leads, and conversions.

7) Ability to work independently and take full accountability for SEO performance.

Preferred Qualifications

1) Experience working with a D2C startup, e-commerce business, or online marketplace will be an added advantage.

2) A proven track record of improving organic rankings, increasing non-branded traffic, and delivering measurable SEO growth.

3) Experience optimising large product catalogues, category pages, and transactional landing pages.

About HelloFi Recommerce

HelloFi Recommerce is a D2C recommerce brand focused on buying and selling premium pre-owned smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other electronic gadgets.

title: Head of Growth (B2B- SaaS)
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore – Work From Office

**Experience:**
4–8 Years

**Qualification:**
Graduation is mandatory.

**About Zylu**

Zylu is a fast-growing SaaS company helping salons and beauty businesses manage appointments, customer engagement, marketing, and business operations. We are expanding across India and international markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Head of Growth**
to own Zylu's growth across the complete funnel:

**Acquisition → Activation → Conversion → Retention → Expansion**

**Important: This is NOT a digital marketing role.**

This role is
**not limited to Google/Meta Ads, SEO, content, or lead generation**
.

You will own
**business growth and revenue outcomes**
, including conversion, activation, CAC, LTV, retention, ARR, and pipeline performance. The right candidate must identify and solve growth bottlenecks across
**marketing, sales, product, and customer success.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and optimise the complete customer growth funnel.
* Build and improve conversion across leads, demos, trials, and customers.
* Identify funnel gaps and implement high-impact growth initiatives.
* Run growth experiments across campaigns, landing pages, onboarding, product messaging, pricing, and sales processes.
* Drive customer acquisition through paid marketing, SEO, content, partnerships, referrals, webinars, and communities.
* Work with
  **Product & Engineering**
  to improve onboarding, activation, and product conversion.
* Work with
  **Sales**
  to improve lead quality, pipeline velocity, and lead-to-customer conversion.
* Work with
  **Customer Success**
  to improve retention, reduce churn, and drive expansion.
* Own key metrics, including
  **ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, conversion, activation, retention, churn, and NRR**
  .
* Build dashboards and provide actionable growth insights to leadership.
* Identify new market and GTM opportunities.
* Build scalable growth processes and support the hiring of the growth team.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–8 years of experience in
  **growth, growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue marketing,**
  preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience driving
  **measurable business outcomes**
  , not just marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and growth funnels.
* Experience running growth experiments and conversion optimisation.
* Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and attribution tools.
* Startup experience with high ownership and fast execution is preferred.
* Vertical SaaS, SMB SaaS, or multi-location business experience is a plus.

**Ideal Candidate**

We want a
**growth operator, not a channel specialist**
.

A strong candidate should be able to demonstrate outcomes such as:

**“Improved conversion from X% to Y%” | “Reduced CAC by X%” | “Increased ARR by X%” | “Improved retention by X%”**

If your experience is primarily
**Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, content, or lead generation without ownership of revenue/business outcomes, this role may not be the right fit.**

**What you’ll actually do**

* Diagnose the funnel end-to-end — sign-ups, activation, trial conversion, sales cycle,

retention/churn — and find where the biggest leak or biggest lever is

* Run growth experiments across acquisition, onboarding, pricing/packaging, and

retention, not just ad creative

* Work directly with product/eng to influence onboarding flow, activation triggers, and

In-product prompts — you don’t need to write code, but you need to be comfortable

Telling engineering what to build and why

* Work directly with sales on lead quality, pipeline stage definitions, and conversion

bottlenecks (not just lead volume)

* Own the metrics stack — CAC, LTV, activation rate, trial-to-paid %, NRR/churn — and report on them without being asked
* Manage/direct specialist execution (paid ads, SEO, content, automation) either via

freelancers/agencies or a small internal team, rather than doing 100% of it yourself

* Operate across two markets (India self-serve motion, UAE more sales-assisted) and

Understand why the playbooks differ between them

**What success looks like (first 2 quarters)**

* Own and move the number: contribution to Zylu’s path to $3M ARR
* Close the gap between contacts at the opportunity stage and active deals in the pipeline
* Improve trial → paid conversion (self-serve India, paid trial US/Canada)
* Establish a working experimentation cadence — hypothesis, test, measure, kill or scale — across acquisition and activation
* Build the reporting Zylu currently lacks: deal-level conversion and retention visibility, not just top-of-funnel traffic/lead counts

**Hiring Process**

1. Initial discussion
2. Growth strategy / case study
3. Leadership interview
4. Founder / leadership discussion

description:
