title: Social Producer-Editor
description:
About the role

*The Ken*
publishes a lot of original journalism: daily stories, newsletters, podcasts, visual stories, survey-based stories, and events. Most of it reaches the people who already subscribe. The people who should see it but don’t are on Linkedin, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

This role owns curation, production, and distribution, using an editor’s judgment: what goes out, in what shape, when, and whether it worked.

What you will do

**Curate.**
Every day, choose what from
*The Ken*
should go out on social: new stories, archive stories that matter again, writer takes, podcast episodes, newsletters, survey results, event moments.

**Package.**
Turn journalism into native formats: LinkedIn posts and carousels, X threads, Instagram posts and reels, short video and audio clips, quote cards, charts. You don’t write original analysis. You make the reporting easy to grasp and hard to scroll past, without misrepresenting it.

**Distribute.**
Own the publishing calendar across
*The Ken’s*
accounts. Decide what goes where and when, and how one story gets a week of life across platforms.

**Amplify.**
Get the journalism into the right hands. Work with reporters, hosts, and editors on their own accounts. Join relevant conversations. Build relationships with the people and communities who share good work.

**Measure and adjust.**
Track what works by platform and format, report weekly, change the mix. Watch whether social is sending people to
*The Ken*
, not just collecting likes.

**Protect the brand.**
Every post remains accurate, fair to the reporting, and sounding like
*The Ken*
. Know when
*not*
to post.

What we are looking for

2 to 4 years in social media, audience, digital production, or content, ideally at a media company, newsletter, or brand with a strong editorial voice. We care more about an account you grew than a title you held.

You will do well here if:

– You’ve grown an account or channel and can explain how, with numbers.

– You have news judgment and taste about what’s worth amplifying, and you can say no to a colleague’s request to post something that isn’t.

– You can write and package differently for Linkedin, X, Instagram, and YouTube, and you know what each rewards.

– You’re comfortable with design tools (Canva, Figma, or similar) and basic video and audio editing; your output looks professional and consistent.

– You work fast, run a busy calendar, and still catch the typo.

– You’re curious about business and can package complex stories without dumbing them down.

– You read your numbers daily and change the mix because of them.

– Bonus: short-form video, podcast clipping, or data visualisation.

What you get

The public face of a publication people respect even when it’s written about them. A calendar that’s yours. Material most social roles never get: original reporting, a daily take, podcasts with founders, survey results from thousands of subscribers, live events. And a scoreboard, so your work shows.

title: Group Head - Strategy
description:
The purpose of this role is to partner with communications planning teams and clients to create strategic outputs including insight generation, cultural narrative, media briefs, creative media solutions and go-to market activations.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**About The Role**
Group Head, Strategy (Media and Comms) for Automotive account. You will lead the thinking on how Client's motorcycles, scooters and EVs get advertised across India, and be the senior person the client turns to on media and communications.
  
  

* Account: Automotive (two-wheelers, scooters and EVs)
* Function: Strategy, Media and Communications
* Reports to: Business Head / VP Strategy
* Location: Bangalore
* Employment: Full time

What this role is for
  
  
The Automotive Client spends a lot on advertising, and that spend should rest on a proper understanding of buyers, the category and competitors. The Group Head makes sure it does. You own how media and communications strategy comes together for the account's brands, from national launches to regional and dealer level activity, and you represent the agency's strategic view with the client.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Strategy and planning**

* Build and own the yearly media and communications strategy for Client's brands, from commuter motorcycles to premium bikes, scooters and EVs.
* Turn consumer, category and competitor insight into clear choices on audience, channel and message, including regional and language specific plans.
* Lead strategy for launches, festive season campaigns and always-on brand work.
* Agree with the client's analytics and sales teams how effectiveness will be measured: reach, consideration, leads, test rides and sales.
* Guide the media mix across TV, digital, social, influencers, OOH, print, radio, retail and dealer activation, along with partnerships and sponsorships.

**Working with the client**

* Be the senior strategic contact for Client's marketing leadership. Present strategy, reviews and recommendations.
* Keep an eye on changes in the business and the category, and bring the client ideas before they ask.
* Work with creative, digital, data and production teams so the strategy shows up in the final work.

**Leading the team**

* Lead and mentor the strategy and media planning team, from senior planners to executives.
* Set the standard for plans, decks and reports, and review work before it goes to the client.
* Encourage testing and learning, and make sure good results get shared within the team.

**Business side**

* Work with the planning across media functions, buying and trading teams.
* Help grow the account and contribute to new business generation in the group.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* 9 to 12 years in media, communications or brand strategy, with at least 5 years leading teams, in an agency or on the marketing side of a large advertiser.
* Work on automotive, two-wheeler or similar high spend, high involvement categories. EV experience is a plus.
* Hands-on experience building integrated plans across traditional and digital media for national brands with strong regional reach.
* Comfortable presenting to CMO level and senior marketing stakeholders.
* Graduate degree needed. MBA or a postgraduate degree in marketing, communications or business is preferred.

Skills we are looking for
  
  

* Strategic thinking: can take messy data and consumer insight and turn it into a clear point of view and a plan people can act on.
* Strong command of TV, digital, OOH, print, radio and retail media, and how they work together in an automotive purchase journey.
* Good understanding of India's two-wheeler market, including differences between regions, and between rural and urban buyers.
* Comfortable with budgets, media economics and measuring effectiveness.
* Persuasive in the room, with clear writing and good storytelling.
* A people leader who develops talent, gives honest feedback and keeps a high bar.
* Works well with creative, digital, data and client teams without slowing things down.

What the first year should look like
  
  

* The yearly media and comms strategy is agreed with the client before the next planning cycle starts, with a measurement framework attached.
* At least two major launches or campaigns planned and run on a strategy the client credits for the results.
* A stable team, with a development plan for each senior member.
* Client feedback that shows the agency is involved early in their decisions.
* Media efficiency and effectiveness measures improved against the agreed baseline.

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Brand:**
Carat
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: General Manager/Category Lead
description:
We’re Hiring: General Manager / Category Lead | Bambinos.live

**Build a $10M Business. Own a Category. Think Like a Founder.**

At
**Bambinos.live**
, we’re looking for high-ownership, AI-first leaders to build and scale our business verticals into category-leading, profitable businesses.

This isn’t a traditional management role. You’ll own an entire business vertical end to end — from P&L and growth to product, customer experience, sales and educator operations — with a bold mission:
**scale your vertical to $10 million ARR within 24 months.**

If you’re a builder who loves solving problems, working with data, moving fast and using AI to multiply your impact, this could be your next big opportunity.

**About Bambinos.live**

Bambinos.live is a Shark Tank India Season 4-backed live learning platform for children 4–15.

We serve 8,000+ students across India, the Middle East, and the US, with approximately 40% of our buyers being NRI families.

Our vision is to become the
**“Disney of Education”**
by building story-driven, gamified and immersive learning experiences delivered live by expert educators.

The Opportunity

**Role:**
General Manager / Category Lead

**Openings:**
4 — one for each business vertical

**Location:**
Bengaluru, HSR Layout | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Competitive salary + ESOPs

Choose Your Vertical

We’re hiring one business owner for each of the following categories:

* **Languages:**
  Unbox English, Unbox Kannada, Hindi for NRI Kids
* **Spirituality:**
  Little Yogi, Bhagavad Geeta
* **Academics:**
  Unbox Math, Unbox Science, Olympiad Preparation
* **Extra-curricular:**
  Unbox Chess, AI for Kids

Each Category Lead will own the roadmap, economics and growth of their vertical, including launching new programs that address evolving customer needs.

What You’ll Own

**1. Business Strategy & P&L**

* Own revenue, gross margin and contribution margin for your vertical.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering targets, budgets, pricing and program mix.
* Track unit economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods and educator cost per class.
* Make data-backed decisions on where to scale, optimise or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth & Revenue**

* Drive enrolments across India, the Middle East, the US and other international markets.
* Own the complete funnel: leads → demos → conversions → renewals.
* Partner with marketing on campaigns, content, channels and strategic partnerships.
* Build new revenue streams through schools, B2B partnerships, camps, workshops and program bundles.

**3. Product & Curriculum**

* Own the product roadmap across your vertical's programs.
* Translate parent and child insights into better learning experiences, formats and pricing.
* Take new programs from concept to launch, targeting the first 100 paying students.
* Partner with curriculum and product teams to improve learning outcomes and make progress measurable.

**4. Customer Experience & Retention**

* Own the complete parent and child journey, from demo and onboarding to learning progress and renewal.
* Improve parent NPS, attendance, completion and renewal rates.
* Identify churn drivers and close the loop on escalations, refunds and customer feedback.

**5. Sales & Conversion**

* Work closely with inside sales to sharpen pitches, scripts, objection handling and pricing.
* Establish and review conversion targets for your vertical.
* Equip counsellors with strong program knowledge and effective sales enablement.

**6. Educator Operations & Team Building**

* Build a high-quality educator pipeline ahead of business demand.
* Own educator onboarding, training, quality standards and performance management.
* Optimise capacity, scheduling and utilisation to ensure a consistent learning experience.
* Build and lead a lean, high-performing core team as the vertical scales.

AI-First Is How We Work

At Bambinos.live, AI is not an add-on. It is our default operating system.

We expect our Category Leads to build lean, efficient businesses where AI handles repetitive work and people focus on judgement, creativity and execution.

You will be expected to:

* Use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools daily for research, analysis, planning and decision-making.
* Build AI-powered workflows for curriculum drafts, assessments, presentations and content quality checks.
* Automate reporting and dashboards, using tools such as Metabase, SQL and BI platforms.
* Apply AI to sales enablement, lead scoring, parent communication and churn prediction.
* Use AI to improve educator screening, training, feedback and quality assurance at scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to introduce AI learning experiences.

**Our default question: “Can AI do 80% of this?”**

We’re looking for people who demonstrate AI leverage through their work, not just those who list AI tools on their resumes.

How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be reviewed monthly, with quarterly goals aligned directly with the Founder & CEO.

Key measures include:

* **Business:**
  Progress towards $10M ARR, contribution margin and path to profitability.
* **Growth:**
  New enrolments, conversion rates and customer acquisition cost.
* **Retention:**
  Renewal rates, customer lifetime value and churn.
* **Customer experience:**
  Parent NPS, attendance and program completion.
* **Product:**
  New program launches and measurable learning outcomes.
* **Educator operations:**
  Quality, retention and utilisation.
* **AI leverage:**
  Revenue per team member, productivity and meaningful automation.

Your First 90 Days

In your first three months, you will:

* Develop a deep understanding of your vertical's customers, business metrics and unit economics.
* Present a clear 24-month roadmap towards $10M ARR.
* Deliver two measurable quick wins in conversion, retention or operational efficiency.
* Establish an AI-driven weekly business review and performance dashboard.

Who Should Apply?

**Must-have qualifications:**

* 2–5 years of experience in a high-ownership role, such as a founder's office, category or business management, growth, strategy or consulting.
* B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB.
* Demonstrated ownership of business outcomes such as revenue, growth, conversion or margins.
* Strong analytical skills, including Excel/Google Sheets modelling, funnel analysis and familiarity with SQL or BI tools.
* Practical, demonstrable experience using AI tools to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work across customers, educators and cross-functional teams.
* A strong bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, accountability and fast-paced execution.

**Good to have:**

* Experience in consumer internet, EdTech, D2C or subscription businesses.
* Exposure to international customers, particularly NRI markets.
* Personal interest or expertise in languages, spirituality, mathematics, chess or related learning categories.
* Experience managing freelancers, educators or other distributed workforces.

What You’ll Get

* **Real business ownership:**
  Take responsibility for a complete business vertical early in your career.
* **Founder access:**
  Work directly with the Founder & CEO on strategy and execution.
* **Meaningful upside:**
  Competitive compensation with ESOPs.
* **Career acceleration:**
  A potential pathway to Business Head or CXO roles as your vertical grows.
* **AI-first environment:**
  Access to AI tools and the opportunity to build AI-powered business operations.
* **A meaningful mission:**
  Help shape how children learn, grow and discover their potential.

Our Hiring Process

1. Application review — CV and a short note on your preferred vertical.
2. Introductory conversation with the CEO's office.
3. Take-home case — develop a 90-day plan for one vertical using AI.
4. Case presentation and deep dive with the Founder & CEO.
5. Culture and reference conversations.
6. Offer.

Ready to Build Something Big?

If you want to move beyond managing tasks and start owning business outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

title: GTM AI Operations - India
description:
**This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role.**

  

About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**What You'll Be Doing:**
  

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity.

  
**Core Objectives:**
**Build Agentic Outbound Systems**
  

  
* Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration
  
  

  

**Operationalize AI at Scale**

  

  
* Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools
  
  

  

**Improve Outbound Efficiency**

  

  
* Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability
  
  

  

**Accelerate Pipeline Generation**

  

  
* Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration
  
  

  

**Ship Fast and Iterate**

  

  
* Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact
  
  

**We're Looking For:**
  

A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals.

  

Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity.

  
**Required Qualifications:**
  

**GTM Systems & Operations**

  

  
* Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms.
  
* Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms.
  
* Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management.
  
* In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency.
  
  

  

**AI & Automation**

  

  
* Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation.
  
* Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems.
  
* Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes.
  
* Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus.
  
  

  

**Builder Mentality**

  

  
* Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration.
  
* Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly.
  
* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale.
  
  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  

  
* Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly.
  
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  

  

**Operating Style**

  

  
* Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action.
  
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve.
  
* Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact.
  
  

  
**Shift Availability:**

  
* This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST

  
**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
  
  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

  
  
  

**Language:**
  

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud®?**
  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  
  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  
  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  
  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**
  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: BDR Manager
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Most BDR manager jobs are a dead end if you care about marketing. You book meetings, you hit a number, you repeat.
  
  
This one is not that. This team sits inside Demand Generation, not Sales. You own the humans
**and**
the plays that turn demand into pipeline, and you work shoulder to shoulder with performance marketing, SEO, and lifecycle on the same funnel. If your goal is to grow into demand gen or growth marketing, this is the fastest seat in the building to do it from. We are specifically hiring someone who wants that path, not someone who wants to manage a dialer forever.
  
  
You run Sprinto's BDR function end to end: the entire inbound engine, and the net-new intent plays we are building from scratch. You own the number across SMB and mid-market, the team that hits it, and the systems (sequences, routing, reporting, AI) that make it repeatable.
  
  
This is a growth role by design. The intent funnel, the AI automation, the campaign-level conversion work, and the reporting are all demand gen muscles. As you prove them, the path opens toward owning a channel (lifecycle, paid, or intent/ABM) or a broader demand gen mandate.
  
  
We will invest in that deliberately: exposure to campaign planning, budget thinking, and the full funnel, not just the BDR slice. If you show up curious about why a campaign converts and not only how many dials it took, you will move fast here.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark**

* Hitting the number. Carry and hit the demo and pipeline number across both the SMB and the mid-market motion.
* Make the inbound engine efficient. Move the engine from volume to conversion. Lift conversion rates campaign by campaign and hold the gains, not just for a spike month.
* Build a net-new demos engine. Stand up an intent-based funnel that produces demos predictably, turn at least one intent signal into a repeatable documented playbook, and diversify pipeline beyond the top-priority campaigns so growth isn't riding on a couple of plays.
* Raise outreach quality. Improve response rates and the quality of the pitch on live calls, not just activity volume.
* Put AI to work inside the team. Automate the manual ops (lead assignment, reporting) end to end, build real-time reporting leadership can trust, and extend coverage with AI so inbound doesn't go dark on weekends.
* Build the talent engine. Turn the BDR team into a farm system for Associate AEs. The goal: a repeatable pipeline that brings BDRs in and graduates them into AAEs inside 12 months

**What You’ll Own Day To Day**

* Build and lead the team. Recruit, ramp, and train BDRs across inbound and outbound. Run recurring 1:1s, live call reviews, and feedback that changes what happens on the next call
* Run the operating rhythm. Weekly reviews against pipeline, activity, qualification, and conversion targets. Scorecards over vibes
* Forecast honestly. Own pipeline predictability on both volume and value, so leadership can actually plan on your number
* Own the playbook. SOPs, sequences, scripts, email pitches, and qualification criteria. Build them, keep them sharp, kill what stops working
* Watch ramp and productivity. Time to productivity for new hires, activity levels, meeting quality, and opportunity conversion. Know where every rep is and why
* Build the culture. Accountability, recognition, honest feedback, and a career path people can actually see. This is also what feeds the AAE bench
* Work across functions. With content marketing on webinars, messaging, campaign follow-up, and events. With AEs and Sales on target accounts, outbound execution, and handoff quality. With RevOps on the tooling and the tech stack

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 3-5+ years in BDR/SDR, with at least 1-2 years managing or leading a team (or a strong senior IC ready to step up)
* You have carried and hit a pipeline number, and you can explain exactly how you did it
* You think in funnels and conversion rates, not just activity counts
* You are genuinely curious about marketing: campaigns, positioning, channels, the whole funnel
* You are AI-forward: you have already used AI to make outreach or ops faster, or you are itching to
* You write well. Punchy, plain, no fluff. We care about this a lot
* Comfortable in HubSpot and modern outbound/sequencing tooling

**Nice to have**

* Experience selling compliance, security, or developer/infra tooling
* Built an outbound motion or intent play from scratch before
* Comfort with data: light SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Digital & eCommerce Localization Lead
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**
The Senior Digital & eCommerce Localization Lead is an expert practitioner responsible for the localization strategy, execution guidance, and cross-functional collaboration within one or more assigned pillars of the D&E Localization function. Pillars span Legal Compliance & Partnership, Digital Marketing, Customer Activation, Core Commerce, and Retention.
  
  
Operating as an embedded strategic advisor, this role ensures that localization investment is directed where it generates the greatest commercial return — prioritizing by impact rather than responding to individual market requests. Rather than owning every localization activity end-to-end, the Senior Lead guides, consults, and connects — ensuring the right accountability exists within the relevant functional teams while driving global consistency, quality, and measurable business impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Embedding & Planning**

* Actively participate in product roadmap, feature launch, and campaign planning cycles, representing localization requirements before decisions are finalized.
* Advocate for localization as a first-class input into D&E strategy, not a downstream production activity.
* Apply a commercial lens to localization decisions — prioritizing markets, channels, and features based on revenue impact, compliance risk, and strategic opportunity rather than volume of requests.
* Support the Head of Localization in maintaining and refining ROI-based prioritization criteria, ensuring localization investment is allocated to the highest-impact opportunities.

**Pillar Ownership & Delivery**

* Serve as the accountable lead for localization activity within assigned pillar(s), ensuring deliverables are clearly defined, prioritized, and executed to standard.
* Guide functional teams on how to implement localization requirements within their pillar — advising on approach, standards, and tooling rather than executing directly.
* Maintain a clear view of the localization backlog, pipeline, and in-flight activity within assigned pillars, surfacing risks or capacity issues proactively.
* Coordinate with other pillar leads to ensure cross-pillar dependencies are identified and managed effectively.

**Stakeholder & Market Partnership**

* Build and maintain effective working relationships with assigned Global D&E Stakeholders, Country Business Partners, and in-market commercial teams.
* Apply commercial and ROI judgement when translating market priorities into localization requirements — recommending investment where impact is evidenced, and deprioritizing where it is not.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, providing clear, evidence-based guidance on localization investment, scope, and sequencing.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across Commercial, Legal, RMTC, DDIT, and Customer functions as relevant to assigned pillar(s).

**Quality, Standards & Governance**

* Define and uphold localization quality standards, style guides, and terminology frameworks for assigned pillar(s).
* Advise on vendor selection, briefing, and review processes where third-party localization or translation services are engaged.
* Ensure that compliance, regulatory, and data privacy requirements are embedded in localization workflows within assigned pillar(s).
* Proactively escalate quality, capacity, or compliance risks to the Head of Localization before they impact the business.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track performance indicators for assigned pillar(s), contributing to the function’s overall KPI framework and reporting.
* Use customer feedback, market data, and performance insights to identify improvement opportunities and refine localization approaches.
* Contribute to the global Digital & eCommerce community, sharing expertise, market insights, and best practices across the teams.

**Required**
**Who You Are:**

* 7+ years of experience in localization, digital product management, eCommerce, digital marketing, or a closely related field within a global digital environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least one APAC or key commercial market language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bahasa Indonesia, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of digital and eCommerce ecosystems, including content management, search, transactional platforms, and/or digital marketing channels.
* Proven ability to operate as a senior advisor and influence stakeholders across commercial, product, legal, and technology functions without direct authority.
* Experience working in cross-functional, matrixed global organizations with multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.
* Strong communication skills; able to translate complex localization topics into clear business language for senior stakeholders.
* Fluent English, written and spoken, to business standard.

**Preferred**

* Background in life sciences, B2B eCommerce, or a regulated industry; understanding of compliance and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce CRM (SFDC), or Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* Knowledge of SEO, GEO, and SEM principles in multilingual and multi-market contexts.
* Experience with agile product development and cross-functional pod or scrum team working.
* Knowledge of data privacy regulations applicable to key markets (e.g., GDPR, PIPL, PIPA, LGPD, CCPA).

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: Product Localisation Lead - India
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**

* Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
* Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
* Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
* Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
* Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
* Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
* Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
* Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

**Qualifications**
What we're looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
* Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
* Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
* Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
* Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
* A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
* Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

**Additional Information**
**About the Group/Team**
Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.
  
  
In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.
  
  
**About The Role/Specialty**
As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.
  
  
This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

description: DescriptionThe Amazon Delivery and Shopping Experience Product Team is looking for a talented Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer who develop solutions to optimize customer experience by disproportionately improving discoverability and speed. As part of Amazon’s DEX product team, we have the opportunity to be at the forefront of DEX product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs. We need strong BIEs who enjoy and excel at diving into data, analyzing root causes, defining long-term solutions and driving their implementation with stakeholders.This position requires superior analytical thinkers, able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply your technical and engineering expertise to rapidly prototype and deliver solutions. This skill also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including software tech teams, operations, finance, category, search, and inventory platform (software) teams. We are looking for people with a flair for recognizing trends and patterns while correlating it to the business problem at hand. If you have an uncanny ability to decipher the exact policy/mechanism/solution to address the challenge and ability to influence people using hard data (and some tact) then we are looking for you!Key job responsibilitiesAs a Sr. BIE in the team, you will work closely with program managers, software developers, research scientists, and product managers to analyze massive data sets, identify areas to improve, define metrics to measure and monitor programs, and most importantly work with different stakeholders to drive improvements over time. You will not only develop insights but devise realistic plans and work with key stakeholders (software managers, product managers, retail business managers, sellers, transportation planners/managers, and warehouse managers ) to execute them. You will be responsible for adding YY million $ to top line or reducing XX million $ actual savings on the bottom line. You will not be responsible for only "recommendation" but actual improvements made to bottom or top line. You will engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy and outlook. You will be a subject matter expert in best in class customer experience policies at Amazon. You will understand intricate details of our promise and ordering systems along with their impact on ground-level operationsAbout The TeamAs Amazon International Emerging Stores’ DEX product team, we are at the forefront of the Customer Experience product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and translating these concepts into robust scalable products that deliver tangible value to our customers and to the A.in business.Basic Qualifications 8+ years of SQL experience Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets 7+ years of professional or military experience Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills. Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining Experience with AWS technologiesPreferred Qualifications Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc. Experience with statistical analytics and programming languages such as R, Python, Ruby, etc.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
The Rockit Rangers is shaping “sports entertainment 2.0” by combining physical experiences with advanced AI and safety systems. The company transforms extreme ride concepts into supervised, scored, and filmed attractions that can be offered safely to the public. Its first product, the Splash-Hover, is a flying jet ski that showcases the fusion of cutting-edge engineering, real-time control systems, and immersive entertainment. Team members collaborate at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI to build reliable, high-impact experiences for riders.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior System Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining complex systems that power Rockit Rangers’ entertainment platforms, including the Splash-Hover. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves overseeing end-to-end system architecture, integrating hardware and software components, and ensuring stability, performance, and safety. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Sr. Systems Associate- Security Systems Solutions Engineering, Physical Security Technology – The role is responsible for assisting with the planning, design, coordination, implementation, and maintenance of Electronic Security Systems (ESS) in compliance with logical security practices as defined by Visa’s Technology Divisions, including its Cyber Security, Network Engineering, Mobile Security, and Information Technology and their sub-groups. This role will report to and under the guidance of the Sr. Manager – Security Systems Solutions Engineering to prepare design / engineering documentation and other artifacts as needed to complete systems onboarding, Technical Security Assessments (TSAs), assist with life-cycle management of software and hardware, perform patching and version updates, perform programming, and performing scheduled and unscheduled maintenance for systems reliability and compliance.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Act as an Application Technology Contact (ATC) to support TSA(s), support compliance with Cyber Security controls, and assist with audit requirements (including but not limited to user validation and transfer report reviews, exception requests and closeout, keeping documentation of product changes when they arise, and risk remediation when identified)
* Assists with the coordination and facilitation of testing, configuration, deployment, and maintenance of GSS ESS and sub-system platforms, including software and hardware architecture review(s), risk remediation, and support of development to production environments.
* Assists in the remediation of compliance findings to address requirements for software code, script, and technology changes that meet desired outcomes and reduce risk profiles.
* Provide timely and effective triage of critical incidents that affect the ESS and its subsystems and integrations, such as patching failures, driver errors, or system errors and outages.
* Assist in identifying complex network issues related to connecting ESS hardware to primary and secondary ethernet infrastructure including routing, tunnels, bridges, proxies, NATs, and other networking skills, and implement solutions for network and system problems.
* Configure servers, services, and selected data feeds such as SSH, SFTP, HTTP, SMB, Certs, etc.
* Support the roll-out, testing, and maintenance of new or updated technology solutions as necessary to fulfill strategic changes in systems and operations.
* Perform other duties as required and directed by the Senior Manager and Manager of Security Systems Solution Engineering.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience and a Associate degree or Certificate in Computer Science or related field
* 1-3 years of experience in Systems analysis, Enterprise application support, Cross-functional IT operations, and Technical Business Analysis (TBA)
* Fundamental experience with program, project and release management and engineering
* Fundamental experience with Deployment management, both Production and Non-Production Systems in a multi-site global organization
* A Sr. Systems Associate should have proficiency in: Diagnosing recurring system issues, identifying process inefficiencies, evaluating competing solutions, and making recommendations backed by data
* Proactive, innovative, collaborative, and driven to achieve results
* Proficient understanding of high-availability networking load-balanced solutions, n-tier application environments and common application protocols
* Experience with Vulnerability Remediation processes (vulnerability assessment and patch management)
* Experience with release management particularly CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies and test automation.
* Familiarity with application monitoring techniques and Centralized Log Management tools.
* Experience with Service Now for Incident resolution and Change Management
* Ability to provide risk management decisions balancing a low tolerance for risk with the need to deliver complex business solutions
* Good interpersonal and language skills: Fluent in English (written and verbal) to a business level - written and oral, Active listening, seeking to understand other views, communicating at the appropriate level for the audience
* Self-motivated, objective and result oriented individual with the ability to handle numerous work streams concurrently. High levels of integrity and business ethics

Nice to Have
  
  

* Understanding of (applied) cryptography and exposure to HSM nCipher and/or payShield integrations
* Good knowledge and experience in using various database technologies like, but not limited to: MS-SQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Basic understanding REST APIs and utilizing tools like Postman or Bruno for API testing
* Basic understanding of Oauth, OIDC, SAML and 2FA/MFA solutions
* Familiarity with any of the following technologies and/or platforms: RedHat Enterprise Linux, Powershell, F5 Load Balancers, Nginx, Grafana, ClickHouse, Apache, Jira Confluence

title: Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations
  
  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration
  
  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching
  
  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

**Preferred**

* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

title: Principal Analyst - SOC | On-site, Bangalore
description:
*This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.*
The Principal Analyst will provide deep-level analysis for client investigations utilizing customer-provided data sources, audit, and monitoring tools at both the government and enterprise levels. The Principal Analyst will work closely with our Technology Engineers, Architects, and Threat Analysts to service customers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Operate independently in a geographically dispersed team, while maintaining situational awareness and keeping the team up to date
* Perform security monitoring and incident response activities across the networks, leveraging a variety of tools and techniques
* Detect incidents through proactive “hunting” across security-relevant data sets
* Thoroughly document incident response analysis activities
* Review investigations conducted by more junior analysts to ensure quality standards are met
* Develop new, repeatable methods for finding malicious activity across the networks
* Provide recommendations to enhance detection and protection capabilities
* Regularly present technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences
* Develop and follow detailed operational processes and procedures to appropriately analyze, escalate, and assist in the remediation of information security incidents
* Prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and formulate responses/recommendations to customers and team members in a fast-paced environment
* Provide assistance to other security teams
* Continually develop new technical skills and push overall team capabilities forward
* Engage with and mentor other team members
* Work with other teams on major engineering and architecture initiatives
* Be innovative with their understanding of attack methodologies, malware analysis, malicious toolkits, and how those may manifest within various security technologies
* Advanced proactive threat hunting
* Understands advanced adversary emulation concepts
* Advanced use case design for insider threat, operational, threat detection and response
* Review of defensive and detective controls to reduce client attack surface

**What We’re Looking For**

* 9+ years of hands-on cybersecurity operations experience across complex security investigations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and security control assessment in enterprise environments.
* Experience in Cortex XSOAR, Proofpoint, Egress, MS Azure, MS Defender, Azure ADX, Crowdstrike.
* Advanced understanding of the cyber threat landscape and adversary TTPs, with extensive experience applying MITRE ATT&CK to investigations, threat hunting, detection engineering, adversary behavior analysis, and detection coverage assessment.
* Lead complex, multi-source investigations using endpoint, network, identity, cloud, SaaS, memory, disk, and log evidence; preserve evidence, reconstruct attacker timelines, determine root cause and scope, and produce technically defensible findings.
* Investigate identity- and cloud-centric attacks involving privileged accounts, federation, OAuth applications, tokens, service identities, control-plane/API activity, cloud workloads, SaaS audit records, and cross-account or cross-tenant access.
* Demonstrated proficiency in SIEM, EDR/XDR, UEBA, and security data platforms, including developing and optimizing complex queries and correlating telemetry across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, and network environments.
* Use Python, PowerShell, or comparable scripting languages, REST APIs, and orchestration/SOAR platforms to automate enrichment, evidence collection, threat hunting, detection deployment, and repeatable response activities.
* Own the detection lifecycle end-to-end, including requirements, data validation, use-case and rule development, peer review, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, tuning, documentation, and retirement, with analysis of both false positives and false negatives.
* Design and execute hypothesis-driven and exploratory threat hunts based on adversary behavior, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, and incident learnings, converting validated findings into detections, analytics, or response content.
* Assess telemetry quality and detection visibility, identify logging, ingestion, normalization, retention, and coverage gaps, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to improve security monitoring and investigation capabilities.
* Serve as technical lead for significant security incidents, defining investigative priorities, evidence-preservation requirements, scoping decisions, containment strategies, remediation validation, and technical handoffs while considering operational and business impact.
* Demonstrate advanced endpoint and network investigation capabilities, including Windows/Linux security artifacts, EDR/XDR telemetry, packet captures, DNS, proxy, firewall, flow, and related data to identify command-and-control, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and attacker infrastructure.
* Operationalize threat intelligence by translating adversary TTPs, infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and campaign intelligence into prioritized hunts, behavioral analytics, detection logic, investigation guidance, and defensive-control improvements.
* Perform advanced phishing and malware analysis, including malicious URLs, attachments, sender infrastructure, authentication artifacts, behavioral/static malware analysis, persistence, execution, and communications; advanced reverse engineering is not required.
* Provide Principal-level technical leadership, including reviewing complex investigations and detections for quality and accuracy, mentoring analysts, developing repeatable investigation and response methodologies, and collaborating with Security Engineering, Architecture, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Cloud, and Identity teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a globally distributed environment and communicate complex technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent English fluency required. This role is Work from Office position
* This role demands to be flexible for rotational shifts 24/7.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Admission Counsellor to manage Montessoru to Grade XI admissions, student and parent counselling, lead conversion, outreach and admission operations. The role involves achieving enrolment targets, maintaining accurate admission records and coordinating effectively between NPS Vibhuthipura and the parents.**

**Minimum Educational Qualification**

1. Bachelor's Degree mandatory; Master's Degree preferred.
2. Background in education, admissions, counselling or educational sales preferred.
3. Knowledge of CBSE Senior Secondary curriculum, Grade XI subject combinations and career pathways will be an advantage.

**Experience & Skills**

1. **3–5 years of relevant experience**
   in school admissions, educational counselling or enrolment.
2. Experience in Grade XI–XII admissions and parent counselling preferred.
3. Strong communication, interpersonal, organisational and coordination skills.
4. Working knowledge of MS Office, CRM and school admission management systems.
5. Proactive, target-oriented approach with strong follow-up and problem-solving skills.
6. Female candidates preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Admissions & Lead Conversion:**
   Handle walk-in, telephone and digital enquiries; make 40–50 effective calls daily, maintain regular follow-ups and convert enquiries into confirmed admissions.
2. **Student & Parent Counselling:**
   Conduct counselling sessions, explain Grade XI programmes, subject combinations, admission procedures and career opportunities, and arrange campus tours.
3. **Entrance Tests & Interactions:**
   Schedule and coordinate entrance tests, student interactions and meetings with the Principal or academic team, including communicating schedules and outcomes to parents.
4. **Admission Processing:**
   Verify applications, eligibility and supporting documents; issue admission communications and ensure completion of enrolment formalities.
5. **CRM & Admission Reporting:**
   Maintain accurate enquiry trackers, digital leads, application status, follow-ups and conversion records. Prepare daily admission reports and periodic performance updates.
6. **Parent Communication & Follow-ups:**
   Respond to parent queries through calls, emails and in-person meetings; follow up on pending documents, admission confirmations and fee-related matters in coordination with Accounts.
7. **Admission Records & Systems:**
   Maintain student admission records, update admission management systems and coordinate student data verification and statutory documentation wherever applicable.
8. **Centre Operations:**
   Support smooth day-to-day admission operations, appointment scheduling, parent communication and coordination of admission-related activities.

**Work Location & Schedule**

* **Location:**
  NPS Vibhuthipura, Bengaluru
* **Work Schedule:**
  Full-time, Monday–Saturday (school campus)

title: Senior Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
  
  
At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
**our commitment to empowering our employees around the world**
.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
We are seeking an enthusiastic, personable, and qualified Senior Network Operation Center Engineer (Network Monitoring) to join our amazing team! In this role, you will be part of the Network Services Team (NOC) that provides 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services.
  
  
The Senior NOC Engineer – Network Monitoring will provide monitoring and troubleshooting of
**network infrastructure devices**
for global customers, supporting LAN/WAN/Firewalls /SD-WAN environments. While responding to Level 1 and 2 service tickets, you will work closely with the team to address complex network problems escalated by NOC engineers. You will be responsible for escalating issues to next-level support and engaging third-party vendors for any
**network or connectivity impairments**
.
  
  
This is an
**onsite**
role.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Resolve level 1 and 2 network support cases, incidents, and work orders associated with routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN and firewall environments following ECI defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring clear communication.
* Resolve incidents and requests from centralized monitoring systems related to, but not limited to the following:
* Alarm validation and alert correlation
* Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching issues (VLAN, STP)
* WAN/MPLS/VPLS/Express Route/Internet circuit issues
* SD-WAN related alerts (tunnel status, edge device health, policy issues)
* Connectivity issues, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization
* Firewall issues (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet — NAT, policies, sessions)
* Wireless network-related issues (controllers, AP connectivity)
* Perform troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control process for performing changes such as PAN-OS, IOS and Meraki upgrades, configuration changes, and SD-WAN updates during approved maintenance windows.
* Incident Management via ServiceNow tool.
* Follow client escalation procedures and handle customer calls for diagnosing network-related issues.
* Provide timely and accurate end-to-end support via phone, email, and ticketing documentation.
* Accurately document incidents, diagnostics, correlations, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage ISPs and vendors for circuit outages, latency, packet loss or bandwidth issues.
* Escalate outage events and network impairments to appropriate stakeholders when unresolved within SLA timelines.
* Monitor and track scheduled network maintenance activities, analyzing impact and ensuring alignment with approved windows.
* Coordinate with internal teams and respond to communications promptly.
* Act as an escalation point for NOC Engineers on network related issues.
* Produce reports such as RCA, investigation reports, and network health summaries.
* Provide training for new hires in lower roles on network troubleshooting and monitoring.
* Provide feedback for continuous improvement of NOC network operations.
* Ability to work on Major Incident Management (MIM) tickets (P1/P2) for Network related issues.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/computer science or related field.
* 5 years of relevant experience in network support & monitoring.
* Minimum 2 years as a NOC Engineer in network operations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical network issues clearly.
* Strong prioritization and customer centric mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting skills: ability to identify and analyze network issues, traffic behavior and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask in a high-volume NOC environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in high-pressure situations.
* Highly self-motivated and proactive.
* Willingness to work in 24x7x365 operational environment.
* Strong experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of:
* Routers and switches (Cisco or equivalent)
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet)
* Wireless LAN controllers and access networks
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
* Experience with routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* Experience with switching technologies: VLANs, STP, trunking
* Experience in WAN technologies: MPLS, Internet circuits, VPNs (IPSec, SSL)
* Hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies and Firewalls such as:
* Cisco SD-WAN (Viptela) / VMware (Velocloud) / Fortinet / Palo Alto
* Monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, or similar SNMP-based platforms
* Ticketing tools experience such as ServiceNow
* Basic packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark – preferred)
* Certifications/Training Recommendations: CCENT or CCNA or CCNP or PCNSE or training equivalent. Knowledge of TCP/IP, Cisco routing, switching technologies and ITIL Exposure

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience with Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM
* Experience with network monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ConnectWise Automate etc.)
* Knowledge of DNS and network-related services
* Relevant advanced network certifications

ECI’s culture is all about connection – connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and so much more! If you believe you would be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever,
**we would like to hear from you!**
**Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!**

description:
**Please note: Only candidates with experience in Building Services and Infrastructure projects are eligible to apply. (Not be considered from Auto / Aero Industry for this role)**

**Job Summary:**

As a Lead CFD Engineer will be responsible for delivering advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) solutions across HVAC, tunnel ventilation, fire life safety, water systems, and infrastructure projects. This role requires strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to guide teams while ensuring compliance with international standards and client expectations.

* **9 - 15 years of proven CFD experience across building, energy, water, and infrastructure sectors.**

* **Strong knowledge of HVAC, Fluid flow, Heat transfer, Fire dynamics, Turbulence, and multiphase flows.**

  **ANSYS (SpaceClaim, Fluent/CFX, CFD Post), OpenFOAM, PyroSim**
  **(FDS), Pathfinder, SimScale.**

* Manage and mentor junior CFD engineers, ensuring technical excellence and timely delivery.

* Perform advanced CFD simulations for airflow, heat transfer, and contaminant dispersion in complex building environments. (thermal comfort (indoor/outdoor), external flow analysis for chillers and cooling towers, and thermal performance of data canters).
* Emergency ventilation system design for car parks, atriums, and corridors using CFD for fire and smoke modeling.
* Evacuation Modeling for Fire/emergency scenarios, Crowd and event mode scenarios.
* Hydraulic behaviour and residence time analysis for water systems, storage tanks, reservoirs and pumping stations.
* Develop and validate CFD models using industry-standard tools (ANSYS Spaceclaim, CFX/Fluent, CFD-Post, OpenFOAM, Pyrosim, FDS & Pathfinder).
