title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Growth
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence – Growth to drive growth and business performance across a portfolio of consumer businesses. This role involves working directly with founders and senior stakeholders to understand business performance, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable plans.
  
  
The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, commercial understanding, data analysis, and hands-on execution. You will take ownership of growth priorities, evaluate business performance, improve unit economics, and work cross-functionally to deliver measurable outcomes across revenue, conversion, retention, and profitability.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Growth Strategy and Execution: Own the 90-day growth plan for assigned businesses, covering business diagnosis, opportunity identification, prioritisation, execution, and performance reviews.
* Business and P&L Analysis: Develop a strong understanding of business models, P&L, unit economics, customer funnels, and operational constraints to identify areas for improvement.
* Growth Opportunity Identification: Identify high-impact opportunities across revenue, conversion, average order value, customer acquisition efficiency, retention, and profitability. Translate these opportunities into clear priorities and action plans.
* Founder and Stakeholder Management: Work directly with founders and senior business stakeholders to align on business priorities, evaluate trade-offs, and drive key decisions.
* Data-Driven Decision-Making: Analyse business and performance data to understand results, identify root causes, evaluate hypotheses, and recommend corrective actions.
* Operating Reviews and Performance Tracking: Lead weekly business reviews, track key metrics and action items, identify performance gaps, and course-correct plans based on business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with relevant teams to resolve execution bottlenecks, align resources, and ensure growth initiatives are delivered effectively.
* Business Performance Improvement: Address challenges across the customer funnel, acquisition efficiency, conversion, repeat purchases, and profitability to improve overall business performance.
* AI and Automation: Use AI tools to accelerate research, data analysis, reporting, hypothesis generation, scenario planning, and business review preparation. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows.
* Playbook Development: Document successful growth initiatives, operating practices, and business interventions into repeatable playbooks that can be applied across the portfolio.
* Multiple Business Ownership: Manage multiple business priorities and problem statements while maintaining clarity on objectives, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 1–3 years of experience in growth, strategy, consulting, business operations, category management, P&L ownership, consumer internet, marketplaces, startups, or similar roles.
* Have strong commercial judgment and understand how businesses generate revenue, manage costs, and improve profitability.
* Are comfortable analysing P&Ls, unit economics, customer funnels, and key business metrics.
* Have demonstrated the ability to solve ambiguous business problems and drive cross-functional initiatives from planning to execution.
* Can independently identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, build action plans, and measure outcomes.
* Are comfortable working with founders and senior stakeholders, communicating insights clearly, and influencing decisions.
* Demonstrate strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to make decisions and take action despite incomplete information.
* Can manage multiple business priorities without losing focus on the most important growth opportunities.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to connect business data to practical recommendations.
* Are proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or similar platforms and can use them to improve productivity, analysis, and decision-making.
* Are hands-on and willing to work across strategy, analytics, stakeholder management, and execution based on business requirements.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on meaningful business challenges across consumer businesses, partnering directly with founders and senior stakeholders to drive measurable growth. The role offers exposure to business strategy, P&L management, analytics, customer growth, and AI-led execution. You will have the opportunity to take significant ownership early in your career, develop strong operator skills, and help build scalable approaches to business growth.

title: Senior Consultant, Manhattan Active WM
description:

Senior Consultant, Manhattan Active WMS

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations. We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution. Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk. If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview:**

You will own hands-on configuration, testing, and continuous improvement of a global Manhattan Active WM template in a large, multi-customer program rolling out across dozens of warehouse sites a year. Working from approved functional designs, you turn requirements into standardized, reusable configuration and keep customer-specific complexity out of the template. The role works hours aligned to US business hours (an evening and night shift in IST), with occasional international travel for go-lives, planned with 6 to 8 weeks' notice (a valid US B1/B2 visa is a plus).

**Mandate:**

* Configure Manhattan Active WM independently from approved functional designs and template requirements
* Build and maintain reusable configuration components that deploy consistently across customers, sites, and environments
* Keep the template clean: flag conflicts, performance risks, and deviations to the Functional Architect
* Test, package, and deploy configuration changes through a controlled release process
* Support regional implementation teams through SIT, UAT, go-live, and stabilization

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* Technical: 3+ years configuring and implementing WMS, including 2+ years of recent, hands-on Manhattan Active WM configuration
* Technical: practical experience with Manhattan Active Configuration Director, and configuration strategies and parameters, business rules, and workflows with an understanding of their dependencies
* Technical: documenting, testing, and deploying configuration changes, and resolving configuration defects
* Functional: strong command of warehouse processes: receiving, putaway, inventory, replenishment, picking, packing, and shipping
* Knowledge of functional and integration orchestration across WMS, WES, ASRS, AMR, GTP, WCS, Parcel Management systems, etc.
* Functional: configuring reusable functionality within a functional template, working from written functional specifications
* Language: professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Global Template Configuration**

* Configure inbound, inventory, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and other warehouse execution processes
* Configure MHE integration touchpoints for WES/WCS, ASRS, AMR, GTP, etc.
* Configure and maintain system parameters, business rules, workflows, and operational settings
* Build reports, documents, labels, dashboards, and implementation scripts to program standards
* Manage configuration changes through Configuration Director and approved tools

**Configuration Governance and Quality**

* Keep configuration consistent with approved designs and template standards
* Avoid duplication and customer-specific dependencies; escalate design ambiguities
* Maintain accurate configuration documentation, dependencies, and change history

**Template Enhancement**

* Recommend simplifications and template enhancements from recurring implementation needs
* Provide feasibility and impact input on functional change requests
* Evaluate new Manhattan Active capabilities that reduce the need for extensions

**Testing, Deployment, and Implementation Support**

* Unit and functional testing of new configuration; support automated regression testing
* Support configuration packaging, versioning, and deployment across environments
* Troubleshoot configuration issues during SIT, UAT, go-live, and stabilization
* Transfer knowledge to client super users, regional configurators, and support teams

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Configuration items delivered on time and first-time right
* Configuration defects found in SIT and UAT versus production
* Documentation completeness for delivered changes
* Go-live support issues resolved within agreed priority

**Why You Will Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we do not just build supply chain solutions, we build long-term careers. We give our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you are leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have visible impact. We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Compensation is a competitive annual CTC based on experience. We discuss compensation openly at the first screening call.

* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Additional Perks**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

* Ability to guide teams through instrumentation and telemetry onboarding.

description:

IVS and Associates is a Chartered Accountancy firm based in Bengaluru, offering professional services in accounting, auditing, taxation, and advisory. The firm supports a diverse portfolio of clients, including businesses and individuals, providing practical solutions to complex financial and regulatory matters. Team members gain exposure to a range of engagements, from statutory audits and tax filings to compliance and consultancy assignments. IVS and Associates emphasizes professional ethics, continuous learning, and mentoring to help aspiring chartered accountants develop strong technical and analytical skills. The firm provides a structured environment for articled assistants to build a solid foundation for their CA career.

**Role Description**
The Articled Assistant role at IVS and Associates is an on-site position based in Bengaluru. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with statutory and tax audits, maintaining books of accounts, preparing working papers and schedules, and supporting the preparation and filing of income tax, GST, and other regulatory returns. The role involves performing analytical reviews, helping with internal controls testing, and assisting with financial statement preparation and documentation. Articled Assistants will interact with clients under supervision, support compliance and advisory assignments, and participate in tax and audit research as required. The position offers structured exposure aligned with CA training requirements and opportunities for learning and mentorship from qualified professionals.

**Qualifications**

* Registered as an articled assistant under the Chartered Accountancy curriculum (or eligible to register) with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
* Strong understanding of basic accounting principles, financial statements, and bookkeeping practices.
* Interest in auditing, taxation (direct and indirect), and regulatory compliance, with willingness to learn and apply relevant standards and laws.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word) and ability to learn accounting and tax software.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to present information clearly and professionally.
* Attention to detail, strong analytical and numerical skills, and ability to meet deadlines in a structured environment.

title: Resident Account Supervisor
description:
We are seeking a
**Resident Account Supervisor**
to lead a Bengaluru-based team of Resident Account Specialists responsible for supporting the accuracy, collection and administration of applicant, resident and former-resident accounts across an assigned portfolio.

The Resident Account Supervisor leads the team in delivering accurate and timely account processing, effective delinquency management and resolution of resident-account exceptions, while ensuring strong service to property teams, residents and other stakeholders.

The Resident Account Supervisor serves as the primary day-to-day point of accountability for the offshore team, including workload management, escalation support, productivity monitoring, training and process execution. The role requires strong knowledge of resident account policies, lease requirements, collections processes and applicable operating procedures, while driving consistent and scalable practices across the portfolio.

**Primary Role**

* Lead the day-to-day execution of resident account activities across the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely processing of receivables, payments, refunds, credits, collections activity and related account transactions.
* Lead and develop the Bengaluru-based Resident Account Specialist team, establishing clear performance expectations, allocating workload, providing coaching and training, and ensuring consistent execution of established processes.
* Monitor team productivity, service levels and key operating metrics, including account reconciliations, collections activity, delinquency, refunds, unresolved exceptions and other measures of execution quality and timeliness.
* Provide escalation guidance and support to Resident Account Specialists, property teams, residents, guarantors and other stakeholders, helping resolve complex account issues in a timely and service-oriented manner.
* Oversee collection and delinquency processes for the assigned portfolio, including payment arrangements, required notices, third-party collection activity and coordination of eviction-related account support in accordance with established procedures.
* Oversee daily and recurring account reconciliation processes, ensuring payments, returns, refunds, charges and other resident-account transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately supported.
* Review and support execution of Final Statement and move-out account processes, ensuring refunds, charges and final balances are handled accurately and within applicable deadlines.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of lease requirements, resident account policies and applicable state and local requirements affecting payment timing, late fees, refunds, collections and eviction-related processes.
* Partner closely with US-based Operations and Finance leadership on portfolio performance, delinquency trends, escalated resident-account matters and other issues requiring coordinated resolution.
* Maintain and improve team procedures, training materials and process documentation, ensuring the team follows consistent practices across assigned properties.
* Identify opportunities to improve resident account workflows, collections effectiveness, system utilization and team productivity, and support systems enhancements, testing and deployments.
* Collaborate with Collections, Resident Management Systems, Accounting and other internal teams to maintain account integrity, resolve recurring issues, and oversee targeted account audits and reviews, including weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual audits. Coordinate documentation preparation, ensure records are reviewed for accuracy and completeness, evaluate discrepancies, and ensure timely follow-up and completion of corrective actions.
* Manage a limited portfolio of resident accounts directly as needed to maintain familiarity with processes, provide coverage and support team execution.
* Partner with US-based leadership and the India-based team on staffing, hiring, performance management and team development to ensure appropriate capacity and capability.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours. Flexibility is expected during turn, month-end closing, peak collections periods and other high-volume operating cycles.

Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, commerce or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 8 or more years of experience in accounts receivable, collections, resident accounting, property operations or another related transactional finance or customer-account role.
* Prior 4yrs of experience supervising, coaching or providing day-to-day direction to a team is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounts receivable and collections processes, including payment application, account reconciliation, delinquency management, refunds and exception resolution.
* Experience working in a high-volume, multi-property, shared-services or centralized operations environment is preferred.
* Experience using property management, resident accounting or financial systems is required; experience with MRI or similar property-management platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review account activity, identify exceptions and resolve or escalate issues appropriately.
* Working knowledge of internal controls, approval requirements and documentation standards applicable to resident-account and receivables processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple properties, team deliverables and competing deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to work effectively with US-based property teams, residents, guarantors and internal stakeholders across time zones.
* Demonstrated customer-service orientation while maintaining appropriate account, collection and policy discipline.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and other standard Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience in student housing, multifamily housing, property management or another high-volume residential environment is preferred.

description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
We're hiring a Senior Content Marketer to help Sprinto create content that stands out in a category full of sameness.
  
  
This role is much more than churning out blog posts from a brief or turning top-ranking articles into another version of the same thing.
  
  
We want someone who can think critically, research deeply, write exceptionally well, and
**find angles that make our content genuinely useful to the people**
buying compliance automation.
  
  
You'll work across blogs, guides, landing pages, comparison pages, and other content formats.
  
  
You'll collaborate with subject-matter experts, organic growth, product marketing, and demand generation to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling
**content that earns attention**
and builds trust.
  
  
AI has made content easier to produce. Your job is to
**make Sprinto's content worth reading**
.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
What you'll do
  
  
  

* Own content from initial research and ideation through writing, editing, and publication across blogs, in depth guides, landing pages, comparison pages, and other relevant formats.
* Make complex topics like security compliance, audit readiness, risk management, and compliance automation accessible and engaging without compromising technical accuracy or depth.
* Build compelling narratives and well reasoned arguments rather than relying on generic introductions, predictable structures, or recycled perspectives.
* Understand who you're writing for, what they already know, the problems they're trying to solve, and the decisions they're looking to make. Shape your content accordingly.
* Write with clarity, precision, and a distinct voice. Know when to explain, when to demonstrate, and when to get straight to the point.
* Go beyond surface level research. Work with subject matter experts, ask thoughtful questions, validate claims, and uncover insights that make the content genuinely valuable.
* Take ownership of editorial quality, ensuring every piece meets a high standard for accuracy, structure, readability, consistency, and attention to detail.
* Approach feedback with an open mind and independent judgment. Know when to incorporate it, when to challenge it constructively, and how to make every revision meaningfully better.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**
What we're looking for
  
  
  

* Typically 5 to 8 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or a related field.
* You're an exceptional writer and an even better editor. You know the difference between content that's technically accurate and content that's genuinely worth reading.
* You're intellectually curious. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and dig deeper to find insights and perspectives that others might miss.
* You understand the commercial purpose of content. Whether it's building category credibility, driving organic discovery, educating buyers, or supporting sales conversations, you know what good content needs to accomplish.
* You're comfortable navigating complexity. You can quickly understand unfamiliar or technical subjects and turn them into clear, engaging narratives without sacrificing accuracy or depth.
* You have strong research instincts. You know how to validate claims, interview subject matter experts, uncover original insights, and build arguments grounded in evidence.
* You bring independent editorial judgment. You can identify compelling angles, shape narratives, challenge briefs when needed, and take ownership of content from idea to publication.
* You use AI thoughtfully to improve your research and creative process, without compromising originality, accuracy, or editorial quality.

What you'll bring
  
  
  

* A strong portfolio that demonstrates exceptional writing, editorial judgment, original thinking, and the ability to make complex subjects accessible.
* Experience creating content for B2B SaaS audiences. Exposure to cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, or other technical categories is a plus.
* A track record of developing original content through research, expert conversations, and a strong understanding of the audience.
* A solid understanding of SEO fundamentals and how content contributes to organic discovery and business outcomes.
* Experience using AI

**Your portfolio matters more than your title. Show us the work you're proud of, explain the thinking behind it, and tell us what made it effective.**
**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Online Reputation Management Executive
description:
**About The Role**
Reviews, ratings, and online conversations can make or break a brand’s reputation. We’re looking for someone who knows how to turn feedback into opportunities, conversations into connections, and online sentiment into a positive brand experience!
  
  
If you enjoy understanding what people think about brands, know your way around online reviews, and have a knack for crafting the right response, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor online reviews, brand mentions, and customer sentiment across digital platforms.
* Manage Google reviews and customer feedback with thoughtful, timely, and brand-appropriate responses.
* Help brands build a positive online presence and tackle reputation challenges.
* Track sentiment trends, identify potential issues, and turn insights into actionable strategies.
* Prepare ORM reports, analyse performance, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams to keep reputation management activities on track.

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3 years of experience in ORM, digital marketing, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with Google Business Profile, review management, and customer feedback.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to strike the right tone in every response.
* An eye for detail, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to manage multiple clients.
* Someone who understands that behind every review is a customer and an opportunity to make things better.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Familiarity with ORM, social listening, and sentiment analysis tools.
* Experience using AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude.
* Previous experience in a digital marketing agency.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with diverse brands and help shape how they’re perceived online.
* Turn real-time feedback into meaningful brand impact.
* Collaborate with a team that values fresh ideas, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Get hands-on experience in a fast-paced digital marketing environment where no two days are the same.

**Job Description: Senior Manager Account Manager – TikTok Ads**
**Company:**
InMobi
  
  
**Function:**
Account Management / Client Services
  
  
As part of our TikTok business, we work with advertisers and ecosystem partners to help businesses scale their advertising investments on TikTok through effective campaign execution, performance optimization, and strategic account management.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced, performance-driven Account Manager with a strong understanding of digital advertising and hands-on familiarity with TikTok Ads. The ideal candidate will manage advertiser relationships, drive campaign performance, identify opportunities for account growth, and ensure a high standard of client service.
  
  
This role requires a combination of platform expertise, analytical thinking, client relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple accounts, solving problems independently, and translating client objectives into effective advertising strategies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account Management & Client Relationships
* Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of advertisers, ensuring strong engagement, timely communication, and high client satisfaction.
* Understand client business objectives, marketing priorities, target audiences, and performance expectations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic recommendations to improve campaign outcomes and grow advertising investments.
* Proactively identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through increased budgets, new campaign objectives, additional products, and new market opportunities.
* Manage client escalations effectively and ensure timely resolution of issues.
* TikTok Ads & Campaign Performance
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the TikTok Ads platform, including campaign setup, targeting, bidding, budgets, creatives, optimization, measurement, and reporting.
* Monitor campaign performance against KPIs such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, and other relevant business metrics.
* Analyse campaign data to identify performance trends, optimization opportunities, and potential risks.
* Recommend actionable improvements across campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative performance, and budget allocation.
* Stay updated on TikTok Ads features, product releases, platform policies, and best practices.
* Support advertisers in troubleshooting campaign delivery, tracking, attribution, and performance-related challenges.
* Business Growth & Revenue Ownership
* Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to increase advertiser investment and improve campaign effectiveness.
* Develop account plans aligned with client objectives, revenue targets, and business priorities.
* Maintain visibility into account-level performance, revenue forecasts, growth opportunities, and potential risks.
* Work closely with sales teams to support client acquisition, onboarding, account expansion, and retention.
* Contribute to business reviews, quarterly planning, and revenue-growth initiatives.
* Data, Insights & Reporting
* Prepare and present regular campaign performance reports, business reviews, and actionable insights.
* Translate complex campaign data into clear recommendations that clients and internal stakeholders can understand.
* Use data to identify trends, diagnose performance gaps, and make evidence-based decisions.
* Maintain accurate account documentation, campaign records, forecasts, and performance trackers.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Work closely with sales, campaign operations, product, engineering, analytics, finance, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless advertiser experience.
* Coordinate campaign launches, platform integrations, tracking requirements, billing queries, and operational dependencies.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve recurring issues and improve processes.
* Share client feedback, market intelligence, and platform-level insights to support product adoption and business strategy.
* Process Excellence & Ownership
* Manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.
* Take end-to-end ownership of client issues, following through until resolution rather than relying solely on escalations.
* Identify process gaps and recommend scalable improvements to increase operational efficiency and client satisfaction.
* Operate with accountability, urgency, and a solutions-oriented mindset in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in account management, client services, or campaign management within digital advertising, adtech, performance marketing, or a digital media platform.
* Hands-on experience with TikTok Ads Manager and a practical understanding of how the platform operates.
* Experience managing digital advertising campaigns and interpreting performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and CPM.
* Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, solve problems, and identify opportunities for account growth.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable recommendations.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience preparing client-facing reports and presentations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present insights confidently to clients and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities independently.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with performance-driven advertisers, particularly in e-commerce, mobile applications, gaming, lead generation, or other digital-first businesses.
* Experience with TikTok Pixel, Events API, conversion tracking, attribution, and measurement solutions.
* Familiarity with other major advertising platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, or Microsoft Advertising.
* Experience in an agency, adtech, media platform, or channel-partner environment.
* Exposure to international advertisers, multiple geographies, or cross-border digital advertising.
* Experience collaborating with sales teams to drive advertiser adoption, retention, and revenue growth.

**What Makes You Successful in This Role?**

* Client-first mindset: You build trust, understand business needs, and focus on delivering measurable value.
* Platform curiosity: You understand TikTok Ads beyond the basics and actively keep up with changes in the platform.
* Analytical thinking: You use data to diagnose problems and recommend practical solutions.
* Commercial orientation: You recognise opportunities to grow accounts while protecting client outcomes and long-term relationships.
* Ownership and accountability: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments.
* Collaboration: You work effectively across teams, communicate clearly, and help others succeed.
* Adaptability: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and working in a fast-moving environment.
* Integrity and professionalism: You communicate transparently, manage expectations responsibly, and build relationships based on trust.

**Why Join InMobi?**
Join a global adtech business at the intersection of digital advertising, performance marketing, and platform partnerships. You will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise in TikTok advertising, work with a diverse set of advertisers, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute directly to client success and business growth.
  
  
**The InMobi Culture**
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
  
  
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
  
  
InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
  
  
Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: Growth Manager - Admissions
description:
**About Mesa**

Mesa School of Business is India's first VC-backed business school focused on 0-to-1 venture building. It was founded by Harvard, IIT and Kellogg alumni and recently closed a ₹110 Cr Series A.

The undergraduate program trains students to build real companies, not just study them. Each cohort is small, selective and outcome-driven.

**The role in brief**

This role owns the UG admissions engine end to end. It runs from the first ad impression to the final interview, and it builds the systems that let a cohort of 200–400 students scale without breaking.

It sits where sales, marketing, growth and people meet. Half the job is running the funnel. The other half is redesigning it while it runs: new SOPs, new automation, a rebuilt interview process and a growing team.

Think of it as building Mesa's go-to-market function for admissions, not just executing a cycle.

**What you'll own**

**Funnel strategy and growth analytics**

The goal is not more students. It is better ones: high-quality, high-intent students who are a real fit for Mesa. Every number you track should serve that.

* Own the full admissions funnel, top to mid: lead → Info Session → MSAT → application → interview → offer.
* Run a daily lead-quality review across region, campaign and creative. Flag what drives intent, not just volume.
* Build and track unit economics: CPL, CSQL, CAC, LTV:CAC and ARPU for the cycle.
* Analyse past cohorts to find real conversion drivers, such as parent alignment and session attendance, and feed them back into targeting.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years in fast-moving startups, across growth, brand, marketing or community-led businesses.
* A track record of walking into ambiguity and leaving behind systems others can run.
* Comfort with numbers: funnel math, unit economics, and spreadsheets you build yourself.
* Sharp, plain writing for students, parents, investors and internal teams.
* Experience leading and hiring small, cross-functional teams.
* Ease switching between strategy, analysis, copy and on-ground execution in the same week.
* Bonus: event production, cold outreach and partnerships, or EdTech experience.

AMS (Amazon Marketing Services) Focus

title: Manager – Revenue (Bangalore)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Senior Associate Creative Design O&O Ecommerce
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**Position Summary:**
Own the design and creative execution for Puma.com, India's direct-to-consumer digital channel. This covers the website and app experience, sale and product-drop communication, CRM, and performance marketing creatives. The role turns business priorities (launches, exclusives, sale events, competitive responses) into fast, on-brand creatives that drive traffic, click-through and conversion, while staying within the global PUMA design language.
  
  
**Key Objectives**

* Design homepage, category and campaign banners, landing pages and PDP support assets for Puma.com and the Puma app, in line with global guidelines and localised for India.
* Deliver creatives at speed for sale events, product launches and competitive-response moments (e.g. limited-window sale plays and hero product drops) with quick turnarounds, without compromising quality.
* Create CRM assets (email, push, WhatsApp, in-app) and performance marketing creatives (static, carousel, short video/animation) for Meta, Google and other paid channels.
* Build reusable templates and a modular design system for banners and communication so recurring work scales faster.
* Support the case for Puma.com's differentiated positioning (exclusives, full-price and brand-heat products) with premium, product-first visual storytelling.
* Stay current on e-commerce UX and design trends, fashion and sneaker culture, and Instagram and short-form content trends, and apply them where they lift performance.
* Test and iterate: work with Growth and Performance teams on creative variants, and learn from results.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Creative performance: banner and campaign CTR, landing-page conversion, and ad-creative CTR / CVR / ROAS.
* Turnaround time and on-time delivery against the campaign calendar.
* Volume and range delivered across site, app, CRM and paid formats.
* Brand compliance and quality (minimal rework and revision cycles).
* Newness and creative testing: number of variants tested and learnings applied.

**Organizational Relationships**

* Internal: Puma.com Growth Managers (Performance and Lifestyle), Site Merchandisers, Content Deployment Manager, Performance Marketing, CRM, and the Marketing and Creative team.
* Global/India stakeholders: Global brand and digital teams for guidelines and asset approvals; India Marketing for campaign alignment.
* External: Agencies and freelancers for video, photography and overflow work (vendor management is a plus).

**YOUR TALENT:**
**Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies**

* 3–5 years of experience in graphic or digital design, preferably in e-commerce, D2C, fashion or a lifestyle brand.
* Strong portfolio showing web banners, campaign creatives and performance ad creatives (not only social or brand work).
* Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma; InDesign is good to have.
* Working knowledge of motion and animation (After Effects, Premiere Pro or similar) for ad cuts, animated banners and stories/reels.
* Understanding of e-commerce UX, including mobile-first layouts, hierarchy and PDP/PLP design, and how design affects conversion.
* Awareness of how creative is measured (CTR, CVR, A/B testing), with a data-informed approach to design.
* Knowledge of current fashion, sneaker and streetwear trends, and of Instagram and short-form video as platforms.
* Ability to multi-task and work in fast, deadline-driven cycles, including sale-event peaks.
* Vendor interaction and development skills are a plus.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to take feedback from business stakeholders.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.

title: Senior Associate, Business Analysis
description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
  
  
Senior Associate, Business Analysis
  
  
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting-edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.
  
  
As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.
  
  
**Team Description**
Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise-wide customer resolution, serving as the one-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).
  
  
We are not just improving processes; we are completely re-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.
  
  
**Role Description**
General responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Bridge Business and Data: Partner with cross-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* Data Translation: Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* Communication: Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* Execution Focus: Display an intense focus on achieving both short- and long-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About Eloelo Group**

Eloelo Group is one of India’s fastest-growing consumer technology companies, building category-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group’s flagship products, Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning, have together placed two Eloelo apps in India’s Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day.

Story TV is India’s leading micro-drama platform, with 10M+ users and 500+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment.

Master is India’s #1 micro-learning app, scaling to 5M+ users in 50 days with 1,000+ bite-sized courses across AI, finance, English, and life skills.

**Role: Product Analyst**

We are looking for a curious, data-driven Product Analyst to join our analytics team. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and marketing teams to track product performance, understand user behaviour, and turn data into insights that shape how millions of Indians watch and learn on our apps.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Write SQL queries to analyse user data on content consumption, feature usage, and engagement.
* Track and report key product metrics such as DAU, MAU, retention, churn, watch time, and conversion.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports in BI tools to give teams clear visibility into performance.
* Support A/B tests by setting up tracking, monitoring results, and sharing findings, working with senior analysts.
* Run deep dives into metric changes and funnel drop-offs to find root causes.
* Validate event tracking and data quality for new feature launches, working with engineering.
* Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business teams.
* Support competitor analysis and track trends in short-form content and app usage.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or Business Analyst, preferably at a consumer tech company.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, and window functions.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, and basic Python or R.
* Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar.
* Basic understanding of statistics and A/B testing.
* Clear communication, with the ability to explain data simply to non-technical teams.
* Interest in entertainment, media, or digital content apps.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with consumer apps such as streaming, gaming, social, or edtech.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or Google Analytics.
* Exposure to agile teams and tools like JIRA and Confluence.

title: Staff Analyst
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an ambitious, highly analytical self-starter to step into a high-visibility role within our Agent (Partnerships) business. Partnerships is our high-velocity business line that provides insurance agents with a digital-first platform, automated underwriting infrastructure, insurance products, and specialized services to help them sell more life insurance, faster.
  
  
Working as an elite individual contributor, you will sit squarely at the intersection of product mechanics, data science, and operational strategy. You will partner directly with our business leaders to solve unstructured data puzzles, proactively flag macro financial risks, and define the behavioral milestones that turn new agents into long-term platform advocates. If you are a big-picture thinker who loves digging into the data weeds to write the strategic story of enterprise growth, let's talk.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Strategic Partnerships Data Lead: Serve as an analytics thought partner and data expert for the Partnerships leadership team, spearheading strategic decisions around agent acquisition, growth, retention, persistency, and more.
* Core Product Analytics: Track, evaluate, and optimize the agent-facing platform experience. Define precision usability metrics for new product features to ensure engineering sprint cycles drive positive user actions.
* Operational Risk & Commission Debt Architecture: Build diagnostic data models to analyze, track, and mitigate backend financial exposure. Slice historical operational datasets to pinpoint risk concentration hotspots within external agencies and design targeted debt recovery frameworks.
* Strategic Input Modeling: Isolate critical growth levers across the agent journey to define the definitive onboarding metric (the "aha moment") that yields a positive snowball effect on platform retention and aggregate revenue generation.
* Funnel Optimization: Manage performance frameworks and monitor conversion steps for our emerging annuities business lines using a classic Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) funnel approach.
* Data Democratization & Infrastructure: Collaborate with data engineers and broader analytics teams to maintain scalable business logic, deploy clean tracking dashboards, and enable self-service analytics across the organization.
* Tooling Innovation: Actively build, test, and integrate advanced generative AI tools to automate internal analytics processes and maximize delivery speed.
* Team Mentorship: Provide ongoing guidance, peer code reviews, and tactical leadership training to distributed junior analytics resources across our global offices.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Experience Baseline: 5 to 8 years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, data science, or analytically intensive individual contributor roles at high-growth tech startups or well-established firms.
* Technical Mastery: Non-negotiable expert knowledge of SQL. Strong foundational knowledge of statistics and predictive data modeling is highly desired. Familiarity with scripting languages (Python or R) is a major plus.
* AI-Native Workflow Fluency: Proven history of actively leveraging modern Large Language Models (like ChatGPT or Claude) inside your day-to-day workflow to streamline writing, debug calculations, and automate personal efficiency. Must rank in the top 10% of AI-fluent analysts.
* Analytics Stack Exposure: Experience utilizing advanced visualization, dashboarding, and AI-enabled analytics environments (such as Hex, Tableau, Mode, or Excel).
* Unstructured Problem Solving: Exceptional talent for entering highly ambiguous situations, slicing past data records proactively to expose root causes, and organizing disparate facts into clear corporate narratives.
* Executive Presentation Agility: Superior written and verbal communication skills; comfortable defending high-stakes analytical summaries to the corporate C-suite and Board of Directors.
* Education: Advanced degree in a quantitative domain (Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math) or equivalent practical technical background.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Work collaboratively with our Product teams to deliver great UX that will revolutionize workplace collaboration and productivity for some of the largest companies in the world
* Directly lead and manage 8-10 designers and/or managers
* Change the way people work through design thinking and develop experiences using AI, Machine Learning and Mobile technology
* Oversee a portfolio of products, while acting as a mentor & manager to subordinates.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the Product Roadmaps
* Work with your peers to ensure a unified and cohesive experience across the ServiceNow ecosystem
* Lead user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others
* Rapidly iterate theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state-transition diagrams to document design decisions
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Ensure a consistent experience across the mobile and desktop platforms
* Participate in the development and maintenance of the company Design system to provide examples of core platform components and best practices
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years of enterprise product design experience
* An inspiring portfolio representing the process you follow to build insanely great experiences
* Demonstrated experience in defining and/or working with robust design systems
* Demonstration of any accessible projects you have built
* At least 8 years of visual and interaction design, with 5 years of Experience Design or equivalent.
* At least 3+ years of experience managing design teams
* Expert with Sketch, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions.
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem-solving skills to contribute within a multi-functional and multi-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Must be able to travel up to 20% of the year
* Expertise in one or more of the following product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance & Legal
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2.0/2.1 AA guidelines is a plus

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
