title: Senior Specialist - Technology
description:
**Role name: Senior Specialist - Technology, Bangalore**

**Experience: 4 to 7 years**

**Salary: 10 to 12 LPA**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**About the role**

Our technology initiatives serve micro-enterprises—small retail shop owners, local vendors, and home-based producers. These users operate on thin margins, in patchy network conditions, often with limited digital literacy, and almost exclusively in regional languages. Very little off-the-shelf software fits their unique context and operational realities.

We are looking for an individual to own that technology stack end-to-end:

* **Field Data Collection:**
  Supporting our frontline community partner network.
* **User Delivery:**
  WhatsApp-first interfaces and workflows built directly for micro-business owners.
* **Localization:**
  Voice-enabled and vernacular user interfaces.
* **Data Architecture:**
  The underlying data layer driving core impact measurement and analytics.
* **Production AI:**
  Deploying and scaling AI systems into active production workflows.

This is a hands-on technology role. You will work on setting the product and engineering roadmap alongside program leadership, help decide what to build, estimate technical scope, and deliver high-quality outcomes.

**What you'll own**

* Design and build web and mobile applications that hold up in low-bandwidth and intermittently connected areas — offline-first, low-data, low-end Android
* Build voice-first and vernacular interfaces for users with low digital literacy
* Identify where AI meaningfully improves field operations including evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost control
* Build the data layer that powers impact measurement and funder reporting: pipelines from Saathi field collection through to defined metrics, with data quality and lineage
* Do code reviews, testing, documentation & incident response

*Team and partners*

* Hire, mentor, and grow the engineering team
* Manage external technology partners, vendors, and other engineering collaborations
* Set engineering practice — review, testing, documentation, incident response — proportionate to a small team rather than ceremony for its own sake

*Data responsibility*

Own privacy and consent design for data, including obligations under India's DPDP Act and the data commitments we make in grant agreements

**Skills and experience**

*Essential*

* 4 - 7 years building software, with strong programming fundamentals and real problem-solving depth — able to go deep in at least one language and pick up others quickly
* Solid database work: schema design, query design and performance, and modelling for
* Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to ship quality code at high velocity
* Good grasp of web application design — APIs, authentication, state, caching, failure modes
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain a technical tradeoffs

*Nice to have*

* Built for low-bandwidth, rural, or offline-first contexts in India
* Production experience with AI-native applications — systems real users depend on
* WhatsApp Business API or comparable messaging platforms at scale
* Speech technology (ASR/TTS) or Indic-language NLP
* Data engineering and analytics pipeline ownership
* Cloud infrastructure ownership on AWS or GCP, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management

*Mindsets we're looking for*

* A genuine pull towards social impact — one that shows up in the tradeoffs you make, not only in your interest in the sector
* Comfort with ambiguous and shifting requirements, and a habit of helping set the requirements rather than waiting to receive them
* Appetite for field immersion. You will spend time in markets with Saathis and Vyapaaris. This is not optional color — it is how you will know what to build

**Tools required: AZURE, AWS, GCP.**

**Experience in Cloud and DevOps and languages required in website and platforms/products development.**

title: IT Administrator and Facilities Management
description:
**Company Description**
VISUKHI Innotech Private Limited is guided by the vision of “Vishwa SUKHI,” aiming to foster a healthier and better world through Vision Intelligence Technology and emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence. The company focuses on pioneering research and development in Computer Vision and Applied AI, while delivering advanced technology services to global clients. VISUKHI also develops innovative products for the global market and engages in transformative healthcare technology services. With an initial emphasis on medical technology and plans to expand into other impactful industries, the team is dedicated to solving real-world problems and contributing to human well-being.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru for an IT Administrator and Facilities Management professional. The role involves managing and maintaining the organization’s IT infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, user systems, and security configurations. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring system performance, providing technical support to team members, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and ensuring data backups and updates are performed regularly. In addition, the role includes overseeing facilities operations such as office equipment upkeep, coordinating with vendors and service providers, and ensuring a safe, reliable, and well-maintained work environment. title: NOC Engineer
description:
**Who we are**

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK.

**Purpose of the Role**
:

To ensure maximum possible service availability and performance. To maintain hardware and software in our production data centres. To provide support services across our technical teams.

**Role Dimensions**
: NOC Engineer. Member of the NOC team, reporting into the NOC Manager.

**Working Arrangements :**
Monday to Sunday Shifts 24x7 rotation (5 days on 2 days off)

1.30 PM to 9.30 PM IST, 09:30 PM to 05:30 AM IST, 05:30 AM to 1:30 PM IST

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Monitoring and initial response for all system and server related issues in our multi site infrastructure.
* Work closely with 2nd line engineers and designers.
* Troubleshooting and resolution of various system issues…
* Linux Servers (Ubuntu / Debian)
* Configuration management tools
* Monitoring solutions (Prometheus / Nagios)
* Kubernetes & Docker
* Cloud platforms
* Regular testing and patching of production systems.
* First responder for production outages/incidents.

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience:**

* Excellent Linux skills (3+ years)
* Has used some experience with automation tools; SaltStack, Terraform, Puppet, Chef or Ansible
* Experienced with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Nagios or Zabbix
* Version control systems, ideally git
* Any knowledge of container technology is a bonus, even if not in a professional capacity; docker, cri-o, kubernetes
* Ability to read and understand some scripting language; Bash, Python, Perl
* Solid knowledge of TCP/IP
* Basic understanding of routing and switching
* Virtualization tools; VmWare, Xen, Qemu

**Personality & Attitude:**

* Self-motivation, a sense of urgency and a good working ethic are a must to be successful in this environment.
* You have a positive approach and a great attitude - resilient and constructive approach to complex technical problem-solving.
* Excellent communicator, open, honest, transparent and inclusive in your communications.
* Commitment, you’re eager to learn, you never give up, and you find solutions where others see problems.
* You’re collaborative, both an active participant and listener. Respectful of others, communicate constructively and willingly lend a hand to help others when needed.

**What’s in it for you?**

* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually)
* 10 declared holidays (Annually)
* 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

**AI Usage during the recruitment process**

Please read our
AI Usage in Recruitment policy
to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

**We believe in equal opportunities**

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and

experiences.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible.

If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.

**Job Description**

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
Accountable for leading the delivery, engineering, and support of the macOS estate within the EUC Systems Management portfolio, operating in a diverse Agile Scrum team. Serves as the organisation’s deepest technical authority on Apple platform management — Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, Apple Push Notification Service, and macOS — with responsibility for endpoint security and compliance, macOS and third-party patching, application packaging and lifecycle management, zero-touch device provisioning, vulnerability management, automation and scripting, reporting, and end-user experience optimisation across the managed Mac fleet. While macOS is the primary focus of this role, the position also requires solid working knowledge of Windows workstations OS, contributing to Windows delivery and support alongside the wider team, ensuring endpoint standards, security policies, and user experience
  
  
**Managed Service Partner Governance**

* Lead engagement with Managed Service Partners (MSPs) to drive seamless operations, service excellence, and the successful delivery of technical initiatives, ensuring commitments, priorities, and business objectives are achieved.

**macOS Engineering & Delivery Management**

* Own configuration, management and continuous improvement of the Jamf Pro environment, including Prestage enrolments, Smart and Static Groups, Extension Attributes, policies, configuration profiles and Blueprints.
* Own zero-touch provisioning end to end through Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrolment, and administer platform dependencies including the APNS certificate, ABM tokens, Volume Purchase Program content, and Jamf Pro integrations with Okta / Entra ID for authentication, group targeting, and role-based access.
* Collaborate with the Global Hardware Procurement team to define, maintain, and govern Apple hardware standards, approved device models, and Apple warranty programs across the enterprise
* Configure and enforce macOS system settings and security baselines through Blueprints, covering SCEP certificates, Wi-Fi, File Vault, restrictions, Gatekeeper, and system extensions.
* Own macOS application packaging and delivery, building, signing, and deploying .pkg and .dmg packages through Jamf policies and Self Service in line with approved naming, bundle identifier, codesigning, and checksum standards, and curate the Self-Service catalogue.
* Lead the validation, testing, deployment, and operational readiness of new macOS software deployments and configuration changes, including pilot rings and rollback plans.
* Lead macOS and third-party application patching, ensuring remediation activities are completed within defined SLAs while maintaining high compliance and operational stability, and operate the macOS Update and update exception workflow to balance business continuity against security posture.
* Own Endpoint Vulnerability Management for the Mac estate, driving identification, prioritization, tracking, remediation, and reporting of endpoint security vulnerabilities in collaboration with Security Operations, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams.

**End User Experience & Automation**

* Lead initiatives to identify and eliminate recurring macOS operational issues, reducing manual overhead through shell/Bash, Python, and JamF Automation and improving service quality, IT process friction, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with the Service Desk and regional support teams to strengthen macOS enrolment guidance, self-help content, and first-contact resolution.

**Stakeholder Communication & Leadership Reporting**
Provide clear, concise, and timely updates with insightful reporting, compliance metrics, and actionable recommendations on macOS operational performance, project progress, risks, issues, and key metrics to the Leadership team and stakeholders.

title: Engineer, NOC
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio's consulting and services teams assist legal departments of multinational corporations and their outside counsel in responding to legal matters, reducing legal spend, minimizing risk, and operating more efficiently. Across eDiscovery, document review, and legal consulting services, Consilio is committed to delivering service excellence globally and applying proven knowledge and technology to help clients solve challenges with lower cost, lower risk, and improved speed.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The NOC Engineer provides first-line operational monitoring and incident response for Consilio's global technology environment. The role monitors infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, applications, and supporting services; validates and triages alerts; executes approved runbooks; and coordinates timely escalation and communication to minimize service disruption. The NOC Engineer contributes to reliable 24x7 operations through disciplined ticket documentation, shift handoffs, monitoring improvement, and collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, and service management teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure, network, server, storage, cloud, application, and environmental services using approved monitoring and observability platforms.
* Validate, correlate, prioritize, acknowledge, and triage alerts based on business impact, severity, service dependencies, and documented operating procedures.
* Perform first-level troubleshooting and approved remediation, including service or job restarts, basic connectivity checks, log review, health validation, and execution of established runbooks.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service tickets, including timestamps, affected services, troubleshooting performed, evidence collected, actions taken, escalation details, and final resolution.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact incidents to the correct technical team, vendor, incident commander, or management contact in accordance with defined SLAs and escalation paths.
* Initiate or support major incident bridges, maintain a clear incident timeline, provide concise stakeholder updates, and ensure ownership remains clear through service restoration.
* Complete structured shift handoffs that identify active incidents, degraded services, pending follow-ups, maintenance activities, and operational risks.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal support teams to resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues.
* Support planned maintenance and change windows by completing readiness checks, monitoring service health, documenting checkpoints, validating recovery, and communicating exceptions.
* Maintain and improve operational documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, monitoring inventories, and service ownership records.
* Assist with monitoring onboarding for new or changed services by validating dashboards, thresholds, routing, dependencies, ownership, and actionable alert content.
* Review false positives, duplicate alerts, missed detections, stale monitors, and recurring noise; recommend threshold, routing, suppression, or runbook improvements to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute incident data and timelines to problem management and post-incident reviews; track assigned corrective actions and knowledge updates to completion.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as service availability, alert volume, mean time to detect, mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolve, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents.
* Follow approved access control, data handling, change management, incident management, security, and audit requirements, and promptly escalate suspected security events to the appropriate response team.
* Participate in rotational shifts, weekend or holiday coverage, after-hours maintenance, and on-call support as required by business needs.

**Operational Tools and Technologies**

* Monitoring and observability: Grafana, Prometheus, and Uptime Kuma or comparable platforms.
* Incident alerting and coordination: JSM (Jira service management) or comparable on-call and incident management tools.
* IT service management and documentation: ServiceNow or another ITSM platform; SharePoint or Confluence for knowledge management.
* Operating systems and infrastructure: Windows and Linux fundamentals; server, virtualization, storage, network, and cloud concepts.
* Automation and configuration: Working knowledge of Windows PowerShell; familiarity with YAML syntax, PromQL (Prometheus Query Language) and API-based integrations is desirable.
* Core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, latency, packet loss, and common connectivity diagnostics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in NOC, infrastructure operations, Service Now, systems administration, network support, or another 24x7 technical support environment is preferred. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships, labs, or certifications may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management practices.
* Ability to interpret alerts, dashboards, logs, system events, and basic performance or capacity indicators.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow technical procedures, recognize operational risk, and escalate with complete and accurate context.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise technical updates to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time management in a high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
* Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, event management, or incident response tools.
* Experience supporting network, Windows, Linux, virtualization, storage, cloud, or enterprise application environments.
* Experience with ITSM ticketing platforms, CMDB concepts, service mapping, and operational knowledge management.
* Experience using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* ITIL Foundation and (or) relevant monitoring-tool certification.
* Experience in a regulated, audited, legal technology, eDiscovery, or globally distributed services environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational ownership and accountability
* Analytical troubleshooting and sound judgment
* Calm, structured response during high-impact incidents
* Customer and service orientation
* Clear communication and active listening
* Collaboration across technical teams
* Documentation discipline and attention to detail
* Continuous improvement and learning agility

Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  
  
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  
  
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
  
  
Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

JOB POSITION

JOB RESPONSIBILITY
  
  
Provide technical assistance to the applications by performing the following duties:
  
  
PC Vulnerability Remediation Support Services (Physical & Virtual Endpoints)
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking to engage focused exclusively on remediation of PC vulnerabilities across both physical and virtual Windows endpoints. The primary objective is to reduce the organization’s vulnerability exposure identified through Qualys vulnerability scanning by remediating vulnerable applications, configurations, and endpoint-related risks.
  
  
These resources will work closely with Endpoint Engineering, SCCM/MECM, Nexthink, Security, and application owners to identify, coordinate, remediate, and track vulnerabilities at scale.
  
  
Scope of Work
  
  

* Vulnerability Remediation Activities

The contractors will be responsible for identifying and remediating vulnerabilities affecting Windows-based PCs and virtual desktops.
  
  
**Activities Include:**

* Review and analyze Qualys vulnerability findings
* Identify vulnerable software, applications, browser plugins, and configurations
* Determine appropriate remediation methods including:
* Software removal
* Software patching/upgrading
* Configuration changes
* Registry modifications
* Application replacements where applicable
* Validate successful remediation after implementation
* Endpoint Remediation Execution

Small-Scale / Individual Remediation
  
  

* Remediate vulnerabilities directly on individual PCs when limited systems are impacted
* Troubleshoot application or remediation failures
* Coordinate directly with end users when required

Large-Scale / Enterprise Remediation
  
  
**When Vulnerabilities Impact Larger Groups Of Systems:**

* Partner with SCCM/MECM teams to deploy remediation packages
* Partner with Nexthink teams for targeting, visibility, automation, and remediation tracking
* Coordinate remediation campaigns across enterprise device populations
* Assist with deployment validation and remediation reporting
* Coordination & Communication

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Working directly with:
* Application owners
* Security teams
* Endpoint engineering teams
* Infrastructure support teams
* End users where needed
* Providing clear and professional communication via:
* Email
* Microsoft Teams
* Meetings/calls
* Coordinating remediation windows and validation activities
* Reporting & Progress Tracking

Will be expected to provide ongoing visibility into remediation progress.
  
  
**Deliverables Include:**

* Weekly status updates including:
* Vulnerabilities remediated
* Systems remediated
* Current blockers/issues
* Planned work for upcoming week
* Monthly remediation metrics and trending
* Forecasting/projections for:
* Weekly remediation capacity
* Monthly remediation completion estimates
* Documentation of recurring remediation procedures and lessons learned

Required Skill Sets
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**

* Strong Windows PC support and engineering experience
* Deep understanding of Windows Operating Systems:
* Windows 10
* Windows 11
* Virtual desktop environments
* Experience with enterprise endpoint remediation
* Experience interpreting vulnerability scan results (Qualys preferred)
* Strong knowledge of:
* PC software installation/removal
* Application patching/upgrading
* Software troubleshooting
* Windows configuration management
* Experience with SCCM/MECM deployments and remediation coordination
* Experience working with Nexthink or similar endpoint analytics/remediation platforms
* Ability to research vulnerabilities and determine remediation strategies independently

**Preferred**

* Experience with:
* PowerShell scripting

* Endpoint security tools
* Vulnerability management platforms
* VDI environments

Soft Skills & Professional Expectations

* Strong written communication skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical users
* Ability to coordinate with application owners and support teams professionally

Work Style

* Lead external support partners and internal stakeholders, including service delivery governance, escalations, performance management, and accountability

title: Designated Services Engineer
description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. NeuralMesh by WEKA sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.
  
  
WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
  
  
**Location: Hybrid**
(On-site Bangalore 3 days; Remote)
  
  
**Shift:**
This role operates on US business hours (third shift IST), covering either US West Coast (approximately 9:30 PM–6:30 AM IST) or US East Coast (approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST), and may shift based on client need.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
As a Senior Designated Services Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring WEKA's Customer Success, contributing to our five-star Gartner reviews. You will work with cutting-edge technologies and top-tier customers, providing technical expertise and strengthening customer relationships. Collaborating closely with Account Teams, you will gain deep insight into customers' business requirements, technical needs, and system environments. Your role involves resolving technical issues, bridging gaps between customers and Engineering, and ensuring the highest level of service.
  
  
**As a Senior Designated Services Engineer, You’ll**

* Serve as the primary technical liaison between customers and Engineering to address feature gaps, reliability concerns, and documentation improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, escalating to Engineering when necessary.
* Provide feedback to Engineering to enhance product supportability, usability, and serviceability.
* Support pre-sales engineers, partners, and resellers with technical expertise.
* Proactively monitor WEKA systems using remote monitoring tools to identify and address potential issues.
* Own, track, and document customer issues via the ticketing system.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing through internal and customer-facing documentation (FAQs, KB articles).
* Manage multiple projects and support cases concurrently.
* Advocate for customer concerns and represent WEKA externally.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WEKA and customer technologies.
* Participate in on-call, follow-the-sun support rotations as needed.
* Availability for alternative work hours (nights, weekends, holidays) and potential regional/international travel.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, solving complex enterprise infrastructure issues.
* Ability to diagnose hardware failures, network congestion, and performance bottlenecks.
* Enterprise infrastructure L3 or higher support experience (Linux-based storage, networking, virtualization, cloud, etc.).
* Strong technical troubleshooting in multi-platform, distributed environments.
* Strong understanding of distributed storage systems.
* Expertise in Linux/Unix administration.
* Deep understanding of networking (Infiniband, Ethernet, DPDK, UCX), cloud computing, and distributed storage.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, and experience with automation scripting for system monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of POSIX, NFS, S3 protocols, log management, and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

**It's Nice If You Have**

* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and other collaboration tools.
* Experience collaborating between customer support and product development teams.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Containers, LXC, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP).
* Prior experience managing large-scale HPC clusters.
* Strong technical writing skills and a creative approach to problem-solving.

**The WEKA Way**
**We are Accountable:**
We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility & ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  
  
**We are Brave:**
We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  
  
**We are Collaborative:**
True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
  
  
**We are Customer Centric:**
Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:
Joins us at PharmEasy:

Launched in 2015, PharmEasy is a consumer healthcare “super app.” Started with the sole purpose of making healthcare accessible C affordable to all, PharmEasy today is India's leading C most trusted onlinehealthcare aggregator in the country.

We provide on-demand, home-delivered access to a wide range of prescription pharmaceuticals,

Through our services, we ensure access to the best and most genuine health products, with the highest savings in the shortest time. We offer diagnostic test services across Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Pune,Ahmedabad, Gandhi Nagar, Surat, Vadodara, Lucknow, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Jaipur.

**Job Summary -**

The IAM / IDM Manager will own the organizations Identity and Access Management program end-to-end, including Identity Provider (IdP) administration, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, directory services, and the joiner-mover-leaver access lifecycle. The individual will work closely with IT infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure secure, compliant, and well-governed identity architecture, while supporting the organizations broader

Zero Trust and network security initiatives. The role also involves evaluating and managing IAM/IDM platforms and vendors to balance cost, security, and scalability.

1. Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

2. Proven experience (69 years) in Identity and Access Management

(IAM/IDM), access governance, or a related security role.

3. Hands-on experience administering cloud-based Identity Providers such as JumpCloud, Okta, or Azure AD; exposure to open-source identity platforms (Keycloak) preferred.

4. Strong understanding of SSO, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, MFA, and

LDAP/directory services.

5. Experience managing identity in cloud-first, directory-as-a-service environments (without traditional Active Directory) is an advantage.

6. Working knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles.

7. Experience with Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle automation and

periodic access certification/review processes.

8. Understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks.

9. Relevant certifications preferred: CISSP, CISA, CIAM, or vendor-specific IAM certifications.

10. Strong analytical and vendor evaluation skills, including experience running IAM tool POCs and RFPs.

11. Excellent stakeholder management, documentation, and communication skills

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Identity Provider (IdP) & SSO Management:

* Administer and manage the organizations Identity Provider platform(s) for endpoint and application authentication

across Windows and macOS environments.

* Own the roadmap for IdP evaluation, migration, and vendor management (e.g., JumpCloud, Zoho Directory,

Keycloak, OpenIDM).

* Configure and maintain SSO integrations across enterprise SaaS and business applications.

2. Access Lifecycle & Governance:

* Manage end-to-end Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes to ensure timely provisioning and de-provisioning of access.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and certifications to ensure least-privilege access across systems.
* Define and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models and access policies.

3. Authentication & Zero Trust Enablement:

* Drive enterprise-wide MFA adoption and enforcement.
* Collaborate with the network security team to align IAM architecture with the organizations Zero Trust Network

Access (ZTNA) initiatives.

* Support integration of IAM controls with endpoint and network security tooling.

4. Privileged Access Management:

* Implement and manage PAM controls for privileged/admin accounts across servers, network devices, and applications.
* Monitor and audit privileged session activity and enforce just-in-time access where applicable.

5. Compliance & Risk Management:

* Ensure IAM processes and controls align with ISO 27001, HIPAA, and Indias DPDP Act requirements.
* Support internal and external audits with IAM evidence, access logs, and compliance reports.
* Identify and remediate identity-related risks and control gaps.

6. Vendor Evaluation & Cost Optimization:

* Run POCs and RFPs for IAM/IDM tools and platforms, evaluating cost, security, and scalability tradeoffs.
* Manage vendor relationships and contract renewals for identity platforms.

7. Reporting and Analytics:

* Generate periodic reports on access compliance, identity risk posture, and IAM program metrics for leadership.
* Recommend process improvements based on identity analytics and audit findings.

title: Technical Financial Systems Lead
description:
**Make Your Mark**
BlackLine is looking for an experienced Technical Financial Systems Lead to join our Financial Systems team. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, enhancement, and support of the SAP Commissions platform, working closely with our Sales Compensation team to bring their plans, quotas, and crediting rules to life in the system. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in SAP Commissions, an understanding of incentive compensation frameworks, and the database and SQL skills this platform requires behind the scenes. Because commissions inputs originate in our sales tools and flow through the Quote-to-Revenue (Q2R) stack, this is a highly cross-functional role that partners with Sales Operations, Finance, Accounting, and the Q2R team to deliver solutions that meet business needs while driving operational efficiency.
  
  
The Financial Systems team is AI forward, and AI development tooling is part of how we build, test, and document. We are also extending commissions into more advanced analytics through our financial systems toolkit, Snowflake and Sigma, and this role will be part of that work. The ideal candidate will have experience improving system stability, defining migration procedures, and providing recommendations to the business based on best practices.
  
  
**You'll Get To**

* Develop, configure, and maintain the SAP Commissions platform to support compensation and incentive programs. Implement compensation logic, quota and credit assignments, workflows, and reports as defined by the Sales Compensation team.
* Manage integrations of SAP Commissions with Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Snowflake, and other business applications. Define integration processes, document requirements, and ensure accurate data flow across platforms.
* Perform the database work the platform depends on, including staging and validating inbound data, writing and tuning SQL, reconciling inputs, and tracing calculation or payout discrepancies back to source.
* Collaborate closely with the Q2R team on data definitions, upstream system changes, and testing, so bookings and revenue data tie cleanly to commissions inputs and downstream accrual reporting.
* Contribute to our advanced analytics roadmap by extending commissions reporting into Snowflake and Sigma, so plan performance, attainment, and accrual data sit alongside the rest of the finance data estate.
* Work with business stakeholders to review existing compensation processes and create a roadmap to leverage SAP Commissions' capabilities to increase efficiency and reduce manual interventions. Identify opportunities for process improvements and system optimizations.
* Architect and implement complex customizations, including commission calculation models, reporting, and performance dashboards within SAP Commissions. Ensure scalability and system stability with a focus on long-term performance.
* Lead SAP Commissions development projects through the full SDLC, using AI development tooling for code, tests, migration scripts, and documentation. Manage requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
* Coordinate and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users and business teams during the development and customization of new SAP Commissions functionality.
* Provide day-to-day support for SAP Commissions, identifying and resolving issues as they arise. Log and manage tickets, troubleshoot system errors, and ensure timely resolutions during payout cycles.
* Manage change control processes for responsible systems, ensuring compliance with SOX and ITGCs. Document changes, approvals, and appropriate signoff in JIRA.

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience with SAP Commissions, including system customization, development, and integrations.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Prior experience working with incentive compensation, commission rules, quotas, and payout structures.
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational or cloud data warehouse environments. Snowflake and Sigma experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with Quote-to-Revenue data across CRM, billing, and ERP systems, and how it feeds compensation.
* Experience using AI development tools as part of everyday coding, testing, and documentation work.
* Advanced understanding of SDLC processes, system deployment, and best practices for quality assurance.
* Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, with a proven ability to document technical specifications, system configurations, and customizations clearly for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

**Thrive At BlackLine Because You Are Joining**

* A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!
* A culture that is kind, open, and accepting. It's a place where people can embrace what makes them unique, and the mix of cultural backgrounds and varying interests cultivates diverse thought and perspectives.
* A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity.

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws.
  
  
BlackLine recognizes that the ways we work and the workplace itself has shifted. We innovate in a workplace that optimizes a combination of virtual and in-person interactions to maximize collaboration and nurture our culture. Candidates who live within a reasonable commute to one of our offices will work in the office at least 3 days a week.

title: Senior Manager - IGA Architect, Cyber Technology Consulting
description: The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.Key ResponsibilitiesLead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms. Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows. Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices. Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem. Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts. Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services). Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team. Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients. Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits. Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements. QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. 10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role. Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization. Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications. Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions. Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership. Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP. Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements. Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences. Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Our Team And What We’ll Accomplish Together**
Workplace Options is proud to support our parent organization, TELUS Health, in recruiting a Business Intelligence Analyst.
  
  
Our team at TELUS Health is on a mission to be the most trusted wellbeing company in the world. We support the total health and well-being of over 35 million lives globally through our clinical expertise, digital platform, and integrated health solutions.
  
  
The Business Insights & Sales Excellence team is the analytics and management-reporting function for TELUS Health, delivering a single trusted version of the truth to leaders. The team designs and runs the Central Business Insights Hub — a consolidated front door to the organization’s key reporting across Revenue Intelligence, Sales Performance, Operational Metrics, People & Culture, the Executive Scorecard, and an expanding roadmap. These roles add onshore capacity to build reporting, strengthen the team’s data pipelines, and accelerate delivery through AI.
  
  
**Current Opportunity: Business Intelligence Analyst**
**Term: 1 YEAR FIXED TERM CONTRACT
  
  
Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Years of experience:**
2-3 years
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
Monday - Friday 5pm to 2am IST
  
  
**Languages required:**
English
  
  
**What you will do:**
Mid-level individual contributor who builds and maintains reporting for the Central Business Insights Hub and the data that feeds it. The role combines strong data expertise — importing data from multiple source systems, building ETL and transformation pipelines, and validating and reconciling data for accuracy — with solid data-visualization skills, including a working knowledge of chart and graph types and how to visualize data effectively for a business audience. A core part of the role is using AI to accelerate delivery: generating and prototyping dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets, and applying AI tools to speed up data and visualization work. **Responsibilities:**

* Data visualization: Build clear, effective dashboards and reports, selecting the right chart and graph types for the data and audience and applying sound data-visualization and UX practice across the hub’s reporting domains.
* Reporting delivery: Build and maintain reporting in Tableau, Looker Studio, and Google Apps Script dashboards — using Apps Script for rapid build-and-publish reporting and Tableau or Looker Studio where larger data volumes require a more scalable engine.
* AI-assisted development: Use AI tools to generate and prototype dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets, and to accelerate data and visualization work, while meeting the team’s quality and governance standards.
* Automation: Build and maintain automation using Google Apps Script / JavaScript and Google Sheets — refresh, consolidation, and delivery workflows — and support pipelines in the GCP environment where applicable.
* Intake & iteration: Take on new reporting requests and re-cuts of existing reports, run and monitor scheduled refreshes, and fix broken views or data connections.
* Standards & documentation: Work to the architecture and specifications set by the senior team, follow visual/UX, naming, and governance standards, and document what you build.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data / reporting development.
* Hands-on data skills: importing data from multiple sources, building ETL and transformations, and validating and reconciling data for accuracy.
* Solid data-visualization ability, including a working knowledge of chart and graph types and how to present data clearly to a business audience.
* Practical experience using AI tools to generate or accelerate dashboards, visuals, or analysis.
* Comfortable working to specifications and standards set by a senior team, with strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
* Familiarity with the GCP infrastructure is an asset.

**Required Tools & Technical Proficiencies:**

* BI & visualization: Tableau, Looker Studio, and Google Apps Script dashboards; strong grasp of chart/graph selection and data-visualization practice.
* Data & ETL: SQL, ETL / data transformation, and data validation and reconciliation; Tableau Prep Builder.
* Automation: Google Apps Script / JavaScript and Google Sheets.
* Source systems: experience importing/integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, Workday, 6Sense, Finance systems, Symphoni, and SAP/HR.
* AI-assisted development: hands-on use of AI tools to generate dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets.
* Cloud (asset): familiarity with the GCP infrastructure.

**What we offer:**
At Workplace Options, we don’t just deliver wellbeing services to our clients, we champion wellbeing for our own employees as well. Examples of our benefits and commitment to employee wellbeing include:
  
  
Group Mediclaim Insurance for 6 lacs INR, Accident Insurance, Gym reimbursement, Tuition reimbursement, EAP Support Services, Mentorship program, WPO Cares, Employee exchange program, Comprehensive training provided for this position.
  
  
At Workplace Options, we are committed to and are accountable for building a workplace where individuals feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work, free from judgment or fear of discrimination. We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes.
  
  
We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth.
  
  
For further details about WPO please check out our website www.workplaceoptions.com and these short videos give a great overview of what we do Human-Powered Care and The WPO Global Experience

description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a dedicated content professional for our YouTube channels. You are the creative brain who determines what we actually build before a single camera rolls. Your job is to take complex financial topics, market trends, and platform data, then turn them into high-performing video concepts, hooks, and content formats. You operate with a channel specialist mindset, understanding YouTube packaging, audience retention mechanics, and narrative pacing better than anyone else.
  
  
Focus Area 1: Format Development & Strategy

* Hook & Packaging Strategy: Define the title, thumbnail concept, and first 30 seconds of every video before writing begins, ensuring high click-through rates and early retention.
* Feedback Loops: Analyze video retention graphs and engagement metrics alongside performance data to double down on winning concepts and drop what fails.

Focus Area 2: Narrative & Concept Frameworks
  
  

* Concept Outlining: Write core narrative structures, detailed concept briefs, and key story beats for scriptwriters and production teams.

* Speed to Execution: Identify breaking financial trends and translate them into ready-to-produce video concepts within hours.

What We Are Looking For
  
  

* YouTube Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of YouTube mechanics, retention dynamics, packaging, and thumbnail design principles.
* Analytical Creativity: Ability to look at audience retention drop-offs and CTR data, translating raw numbers into creative fixes.

* High Agency: You treat the channel like your own product, proactively finding content gaps and filling them without waiting for briefs.

title: Content Growth Marketer
description:
**Content Growth Marketer - Job Description**

**About the role:**

Astra is hiring a Content Growth Marketer to make our technical content travel: choose the channel and format each piece needs, run distribution experiments, and grow reach among security and engineering buyers.

Location: Bengaluru

**About Astra**

Astra runs continuous, offensive pentests across apps, APIs, and cloud for more than 1,200 engineering teams.

Our platform combines hacker-style manual pentesting with AI-powered automation: PTaaS, Autonomous Pentest, a DAST scanner, an API security platform, and a cloud vulnerability scanner. Astra has uncovered more than 2 million vulnerabilities, and customers rate us 4.6 on G2.

**Why this role exists**

We have deep security expertise in-house and a content team built for search, but nobody whose main job is getting that content in front of the right people.

Three gaps hold us back:

* **Distribution.**
  What we ship doesn't reach far enough. The standard SaaS checklist- blog, LinkedIn post, and newsletter- isn't enough anymore; distribution has to be experimental and keep evolving.
* **Speed.**
  By the time a piece ships, the moment has often passed. Security moves on news cycles, and we need to push a take while the topic is still live.
* **Video.**
  The channels our buyers use, LinkedIn included, are going video-first. Our video work today is opportunistic, not an engine.

The shift we want: make fewer, stronger pieces, distribute half of them hard across channels, and let the rest feed search. You'll own the distribution side of that shift.

**What you'll own**

Distribution of Astra's brand and technical content is your primary KPI: you decide how each piece travels, and you prove what works.

* **Distribution plans.**
  For every flagship piece, such as research, data reports like State of Continuous Pentesting, product launches, and customer stories, decide the channels, formats, and sequence that give it the most reach.
* **Experiments.**
  Run a steady cadence of distribution experiments across LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletters, podcasts, technical communities, partner channels, employee and founder voices, and our community, the 403 Circle. Turn what works into repeatable playbooks and drop what doesn't.
* **Repurposing.**
  Turn one strong piece into many channel-native ones: short posts, carousels, short video, newsletter features, and community posts. Write the hooks and copy yourself.
* **Video.**
  Work with freelance creators on per-piece budgets to turn research and product stories into short video for social. Shape scripts and help our experts get comfortable on camera.
* **Speed.**
  When a CVE, breach, or industry moment breaks, work with our researchers and writers to get a take out within days, and push it while it's live.
* **Input on what we make.**
  Tell the content team what travels and what doesn't, and pitch brand content ideas based on what the data shows.
* **Partners.**
  Brief and manage freelancers and agencies so content keeps shipping while the wider team grows.
* **Reporting.**
  Track reach and engagement by channel and by piece, and share a short weekly read on what to double down on.

**What this role is not**

This is a hands-on distribution and growth role, not a content leadership or SEO production job.

* **Not a content team lead.**
  You won't manage writers or own the editorial calendar. You'll shape what we make through what you learn about what travels.
* **Not SEO content production.**
  Writing to a keyword plan isn't your day job, though you'll distribute our strongest SEO pieces too.
* **Not just posting.**
  Scheduling posts is a small part of distribution. The job is figuring out what will travel and why.
* **Not a security researcher.**
  Our researchers bring the findings. You turn them into formats people want to read and watch.

**What success looks like**

Success means more of the right people see our technical content, and you can show which channels and formats got them there.

**First 90 days**

* Audit what we've published in the last year and where it actually traveled.
* Pick two or three channels and formats to bet on, with a clear hypothesis for each.
* Run a full distribution plan for at least one flagship piece, and push one fast-turn piece on a live security story.
* Ship a first short video series with freelance creators.
* Set baselines and a weekly experiment cadence.

**First 12 months**

* Reach of distributed content grows quarter on quarter.
* Every flagship asset launches with a tested distribution playbook.
* Video is a regular output, not a one-off.
* We know which channels and formats work for our buyers, backed by experiment results.
* Accounts that engage with our content are tracked through to pipeline.

**Who you are**

You've made B2B content travel; you can show the numbers, and you'd rather run an experiment than debate one.

* 3–6 years in content marketing, growth marketing, social, or media, including 2+ years in B2B tech or SaaS.
* A track record of making content spread. Bring examples with numbers: what you distributed, where, and what you changed to make it travel.
* You write sharp, channel-native copy and hooks, and you know how LinkedIn, YouTube, and online communities reward different formats.
* Hands-on with short-form video: you've scripted, edited, or produced clips that performed, or worked closely with creators to get them made.
* A news instinct: you spot a story early and move fast when something breaks.
* An experimenter's habits: clear hypotheses, honest measurement in platform and web analytics, and the discipline to kill what isn't working.
* Editorial taste. You can tell strong technical content from weak, including AI drafts, and fix it.
* You work without much hand-holding, and you've managed freelancers or agencies.
* You pick up technical subjects quickly and are comfortable working with engineers and researchers.
* You use AI tools for research, drafting, and repurposing, and you know where they fall short.

**Nice to have**

None of these are required, but each one will help you ramp up faster.

* Background in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or developer tools.
* A media or journalism background.
* Experience hosting a podcast or video series.
* You've built a newsletter, community, or creator-led channel from zero.
* Experience with technical communities such as Reddit, Hacker News, Discord, or security conferences.
* Experience launching data reports or research with PR.
* Experience reaching buyers in the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

description:

**Company Name:**

Sunday
  
  
**About The Role**
Knowfinity Academy LLP is seeking a dynamic
**Social Media & Video Content Strategist**
to drive high-impact, performance-oriented content across digital platforms. This role goes beyond traditional content creation — you’ll be responsible for end-to-end development of scroll-stopping, engagement-driven video content that supports brand growth, lead generation, and conversion goals.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with marketing and product teams to align content strategy with business KPIs, leveraging data insights, platform trends, and audience behavior to continuously optimize performance. If you thrive in a metrics-driven environment and excel at turning creative ideas into measurable results, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Content Strategy & Ideation: Conduct trend analysis, audience research, and competitor benchmarking to develop platform-specific content strategies for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Scriptwriting & Storytelling: Craft compelling, hook-first scripts for organic posts, UGC-style videos, founder-led content, and paid ad campaigns optimized for retention, CTR, and conversion.
* Production & Direction: Plan, shoot, and direct high-quality video content (talking heads, demos, testimonials, product highlights) using DSLR/mirrorless cameras or mobile setups.
* Editing & Post-Production: Edit videos using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut; integrate subtitles, motion graphics, sound design, and platform-specific formatting (aspect ratios, captions, pacing).
* Performance Marketing Creatives: Build A/B testable ad creatives for Meta, Google, and LinkedIn Ads aligned with campaign objectives (lead gen, app installs, course enrollments).
* Analytics & Optimization: Track engagement metrics (views, retention, CTR, conversions), run experiments (hooks, CTAs, formats), and iterate based on data-driven insights.
* Content Calendar & Workflow Management: Maintain and execute a weekly content roadmap, ensuring timely delivery and consistency across all channels.
* Collaboration: Partner with growth marketers, designers, and instructors to ensure brand consistency and strategic alignment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven experience creating scroll-stopping video content for Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn (portfolio required).
* Strong scriptwriting skills — especially for short-form, high-retention formats (0–3 sec hooks, clear CTAs).
* Hands-on proficiency in video shooting (lighting, framing, audio) and editing (cutting, color grading, motion graphics).
* Experience optimizing content for performance marketing (lead gen, conversions, ROAS).
* Familiarity with analytics tools (Meta Business Suite, YouTube Analytics, Google Analytics) to measure and improve performance.
* Ability to work independently, meet tight deadlines, and adapt quickly to feedback.
* Strong communication skills and openness to iterative feedback.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience creating UGC-style or founder-led video content for ed-tech or online learning brands.
* Basic graphic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or Figma) for social posts, overlays, and ad creatives.
* Familiarity with AI tools for script ideation, voiceovers, or automated editing (e.g., Pictory, InVideo, Runway).
* Understanding of funnel-based content strategy (awareness → consideration → conversion).
* Knowledge of SEO best practices for video titles, descriptions, and hashtags.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
You’re a hybrid creator part storyteller, part strategist, part data analyst. You don’t just make videos; you engineer them for performance. You’re obsessed with trends but grounded in results, and you treat every piece of content as a testable hypothesis. You’re comfortable iterating rapidly, owning outcomes (not just outputs), and working in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.
  
  
**Application Requirements**
Please submit your updated resume, along with a portfolio or links to 3–5 representative video projects (including metrics/results if available). Highlight any campaigns where your content directly contributed to lead generation, engagement lift, or conversion improvement.
