title: Corporate Alliances & Outreach Manager
description:
**Reports to:**
CEO

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years

**About Miror**

Miror is an integrated midlife women's health platform built for Indian women aged 35 to 65. In under two years we have built India's largest menopause-focused WhatsApp community, partnered with the National Health Mission and the Indian Menopause Society, launched a nutraceutical range, and built an app that brings together symptom tracking, personalised care pathways, diagnostic links, expert consultations and AI-supported guidance. We were recognised with the Innovation in Menopause Care award at the Global Women's Health Innovation Conference 2024.

Learn more at miror.in

**Why this role exists**

Menopause is the largest unaddressed gap in Indian corporate health benefits. Women in their forties and fifties are usually at the most senior point of their careers, and unmanaged symptoms show up on the employer's side as attrition, absenteeism and quiet withdrawal from leadership tracks. Very few Indian employers have anything in place for it.

Míror at Work is our answer, and this role owns it commercially. You will drive new business and build corporate alliances in a category with no established budget line. You will be creating one. That is the hard part and the interesting part.

**What you will own**

**New Business Development**

• Build and maintain a target account map across IT/ITES, GCCs, BFSI, consulting, retail and manufacturing employers with large or growing female workforces

• Open conversations with CHROs, HR business partners, Heads of Admin, D&I leads and wellness committee owners

• Run a structured outbound motion across LinkedIn, email, calls, HR industry forums and events

**Corporate Partnerships & Alliances**

• Build strategic alliances with benefits brokers, insurers, EAP providers and corporate wellness platforms to open new channels into employers

• Develop co-selling and referral partnerships that bring Míror at Work into existing benefits programmes

**Conversion**

• Run discovery and position Míror at Work against the client's actual retention, benefits and D&I objectives, not a generic wellness pitch

• Build proposals and commercials across annual programmes, employee seats, awareness sessions, screening camps, consultations and supplement programmes

• Bring senior leadership or medical experts into the cycle at the right moment

• Negotiate, close and hand over cleanly to the delivery team

• Carry and deliver an assigned monthly and quarterly revenue number

**Accounts & Delivery**

• Coordinate with content, clinical, product and events teams so that what was sold is what gets delivered

• Support execution of on-site health camps, awareness drives and wellness workshops

• Grow accounts past the first contract through renewals, additional sites and additional employee cohorts

**Reporting**

• Keep the CRM accurate on stage, value, owner and next action for every open opportunity

• Submit a weekly pipeline and performance report to management

• Feed field objections and pricing signals back to marketing and product

**What good looks like**

• First 30 days: target account and partner map built, messaging internalised, CRM structured and live

• First 90 days: qualified pipeline established, first pilot programmes and channel partnerships signed

• First 12 months: a repeatable playbook, named enterprise logos, active alliances and predictable month-on-month revenue

**Who we are looking for**

**Essential**

• Minimum 8 years in B2B sales, corporate partnerships or new business development, including at least 2 years selling into HR, People & Culture or Admin functions at Indian corporates

• Demonstrable track record of carrying and hitting a revenue target

• Experience building and managing corporate alliances or channel partnerships

• Comfort with a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale running across a 2–4 month cycle

• Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to hold a room with a CHRO

• Disciplined CRM, pipeline hygiene and reporting habits

• Graduate in any discipline

**Preferred**

• MBA in Marketing or HR

• Existing relationships across the employee benefits ecosystem: benefits brokers, insurers, EAP providers, corporate wellness vendors

• Background in healthcare, diagnostics, insurance, pharma or wellness services

• Genuine interest in women's health. You will be talking about menopause every working day, with people who may be uncomfortable discussing it

**What we offer**

• Ownership of a category with no incumbent in India, and the freedom to build the playbook

• Direct working access to the founder and our medical advisory board

• Full support from marketing and clinical teams: decks, case studies, expert speakers, session content and post-sale programme design

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Forecasting
description:
**About The Team**
The business forecasting group at Zillow shapes planning across Zillow’s businesses. We bring together forecasters, economists, applied scientists, data scientists, and data visualization engineers to build and maintain the forecasts that guide decision-making. We translate housing market and business signals into actionable outlooks with industry-leading data and rigorous statistical methods. We emphasize explainability with our forecasts so that leaders can have confidence and make informed decisions about the future of the company
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
Zillow is seeking an Applied Scientist based in India to focus full-time on developing and improving forecasting performance for Zillow’s business lines..
  
  
In this role, you will design, implement, and refine advanced statistical and machine learning approaches to generate accurate, scalable forecasts. You will partner with team members to expedite and improve the quality of modeling work. Further, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  
  
You Will Get To:
  
  

* Design and evaluate statistical, econometric, and machine learning methods for forecasting problems. Your work will play a central role in increasing forecast accuracy and accelerating delivery timelines
* Propose and evaluate novel methods to reasonably forecast asset level performance
* Build backtesting and validation frameworks to assess forecast accuracy, stability, and downstream forecast impact.
* Own the end‑to‑end modeling lifecycle, including scoping, feature engineering, model development, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and model explainability.
* Translate forecasts into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership, helping stakeholders understand drivers, uncertainty, and trade‑offs that guide Zillow’s strategy.
* Quantify uncertainty and clearly communicate model confidence, limitations, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Partner cross‑functionally with finance, product, engineering, marketing, and operations to scale and improve forecasting capabilities across Zillow.
* Improve and contribute to shared forecasting tools, data pipelines, and processes used across the company.
* Collaborate with other applied scientists and data scientists to develop novel solutions to real estate and business problems.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* Advanced degree (PhD or Masters) in Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or a related quantitative discipline with 5+ years of experiences in professional applied scientist roles
* Strong experience with time-series forecasting, econometrics, or related quantitative modeling techniques.
* Strength in data engineering principles to help envision efficient data solutions at scale.
* Experience explaining complex models and analytical concepts to stakeholders with non-technical backgrounds using clear takeaways and practical business framing.
* Experience building applied statistical or machine learning models that support real business decisions in production settings.
* Proficient in Python and SQL for data analysis, model development, validation, and deployment.
* Comfortable working with incomplete, delayed, or noisy real-world data and designing robust estimation strategies.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
  
  
As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
  
  
Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

description:
Project Details

* **Project:**
  Project SANJEEVANI (Healthcare Infrastructure Upgradation & Clinical Readiness)
* **Project Code:**
  PC.78.27046
* **Organisation:**
  Telerad Foundation
* **Location:**
  Chittapur Taluk, Kalaburagi District, Karnataka (Field-based across 4 facilities: CHC Hebbal, Nalwar PHC, Karwar PHC, and Tengli PHC)
* **Number of Positions:**
  One (1)
* **Duration:**
  12 Months (01 November 2026 to 31 October 2027)
* **Work Schedule:**
  Six Days per Week
* **Travel:**
  Extensive daily travel across project health facilities in Chittapur Taluk
* **Reporting To:**
  Programme Manager

About Telerad Foundation

Established in 2007, Telerad Foundation (TF) is a Bengaluru-based healthcare-focused not-for-profit organisation committed to improving access to quality healthcare for underserved communities across India. Working in partnership with governments, healthcare institutions, CSR programmes, and community organisations, TF delivers integrated healthcare solutions through telemedicine, mobile health services, diagnostics, specialist care, health education, community outreach, and the strengthening of Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and other public healthcare facilities through infrastructure improvements and enhanced clinical readiness.

Vision

A world where everyone can access affordable, high-quality healthcare, regardless of geography or socio-economic status.

About the Project

Project SANJEEVANI is a comprehensive public healthcare initiative designed to strengthen the physical infrastructure and clinical readiness of four selected government healthcare facilities in Chittapur Taluk, Kalaburagi District, Karnataka (Nalwar PHC, CHC Hebbal, Karwar PHC, and Tengli PHC).

The project follows a phased implementation framework across the four facilities, addressing critical gaps in civil infrastructure, electrical systems, plumbing, sanitation, medical gas and vacuum pipeline distribution, essential biomedical equipment, and pharmacy storage. Through these interventions, the project aims to upgrade maternal, newborn, and emergency healthcare delivery serving an estimated catchment population of over 1.7 lakh people across rural communities.

Role Summary

The Field Coordinator will be responsible for the day-to-day on-site implementation, monitoring, and operational coordination of Project SANJEEVANI across the four designated public healthcare facilities.

The role serves as the primary ground liaison between Telerad Foundation, facility Medical Officers, frontline healthcare teams (nurses, ASHAs, ANMs), engineering consultants, and executing contractors/vendors. The Field Coordinator ensures that scheduled civil and sanitation works, equipment deliveries, installations, testing, commissioning, and facility handovers are executed on schedule, with zero disruption to patient care, and in full adherence to project quality and CSR compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities1. On-Site Facility & Stakeholder Coordination

* Act as the daily primary point of contact at each public healthcare facility for Medical Officers, nursing staff, ASHAs, and ANMs.
* Coordinate daily access, work areas, and clearances with facility staff and vendors so that on-site execution proceeds without interruption.
* Sequence construction, repair, and installation activities in direct consultation with Medical Officers to avoid disruption to outpatient consultations, deliveries, or emergency care.
* Escalate on-ground operational bottlenecks, site constraints, or schedule deviations to the Programme Manager within 24 hours.

2. Civil, Electrical & Plumbing Execution Tracking

* Track daily execution against the approved Bills of Quantities (BoQs), technical drawings, and implementation schedules.
* Support the Civil Engineer during site visits by recording measurements, monitoring labour deployment, inspecting incoming construction materials, and verifying site safety.
* Supervise stage-wise progress across priority work zones, including labour rooms, operation theatres, wards, pharmacies, and sanitation blocks.
* Assist in snag identification, report deviations, and verify that defect rectifications are completed prior to stage certification.

3. Biomedical Equipment, Furniture & MGPS Logistics

* Support the Biomedical Engineer in tracking procurement timelines, delivery schedules, and vendor dispatches.
* Conduct physical verification of delivered medical equipment, furniture, and fittings against purchase orders and approved specifications.
* Log serial numbers, model details, warranty cards, service certificates, and operating manuals.
* Coordinate site readiness for specialized installations (including medical oxygen and vacuum pipeline systems at designated facilities).
* Facilitate equipment installation, commissioning, demonstration, and hands-on user orientation conducted by vendor engineers for facility healthcare staff.

4. Handover, Asset Management & Post-Handover Verification

* Prepare facility-wise asset registers, physical inventory trackers, and handover certificates countersigned by the respective Medical Officers.
* Coordinate joint walkthroughs and final handovers with district and taluk health authorities (DHO Kalaburagi / THO Chittapur).
* Conduct 30-day post-handover site checks to verify sustained equipment utilisation, operational functionality, and prompt reporting of any infrastructure defects.

5. Documentation, MIS & Compliance

* Maintain comprehensive facility-wise project documentation files (approved BoQs, work orders, measurement sheets, delivery challans, inspection notes, warranty files, and signed handover certificates).
* Maintain a systematic audit trail of high-resolution, dated, and geotagged photographs documenting before, during, and after conditions of every renovated area.
* Coordinate the installation of approved wayfinding signage, department boards, and digital health information (IEC) screens.
* Provide weekly progress updates and monthly facility MIS inputs to the Programme Manager for project progress reporting and expenditure tracking.
* Facilitate site preparations, registers, and logistics for periodic donor review visits and official audits.

Qualifications & ExperienceEssential

* Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Healthcare Administration, Social Work (MSW), Public Health, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in field coordination, project supervision, rural community interventions, or infrastructure refurbishment projects.
* Fluency in spoken and written Kannada (essential for local facility and stakeholder coordination).
* Working knowledge of English and Hindi.

Preferred

* Prior experience coordinating public healthcare infrastructure upgrades, CSR health initiatives, or government health programmes (PHCs/CHCs).
* Familiarity with basic civil/electrical/plumbing terminology, BoQ tracking, and equipment asset registers.
* Direct experience working with district health administration systems (DHO/THO/PHC) in Karnataka.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills to work collaboratively with doctors, nurses, local health staff, and executing contractors.
* Ability to read simple BoQs, architectural layouts, and equipment schedules.
* Proficiency in digital reporting tools, including MS Excel, MS Word, email, and smartphone-based geotagged photo documentation.
* High discipline in administrative record-keeping, billing verification, and audit-ready filing.
* Problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage simultaneous work packages across rural locations.

Professional Requirements

* Willingness to travel extensively and daily across project facilities in Chittapur Taluk (CHC Hebbal, Nalwar PHC, Karwar PHC, and Tengli PHC).
* Valid two-wheeler driving licence and personal two-wheeler for regular field mobility.
* Residence in or willingness to relocate to Chittapur, Kalaburagi, or adjacent project vicinity.
* Strict adherence to patient privacy, clinical decorum, and organisation code of conduct in government health settings.

title: GeoSpatial Lead Analyst MAP
description:
**Job Summary**
GeoSpatial Lead Analyst MAP role focuses on designing and optimizing geospatial solutions that integrate Generative AI PL SQL and Blue Yonder WMS for a global client base in a hybrid work model. The position requires ten to fourteen years of experience to drive complex warehouse optimization initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and deliver measurable value for customers and society.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with cross functional teams to analyze geospatial data and design optimized warehouse network solutions that improve delivery efficiency and reduce operational bottlenecks
* Develop advanced analytical models that combine geospatial intelligence with Generative AI techniques to predict demand patterns and optimize inventory placement strategies
* Implement PL SQL based data pipelines that ensure accurate extraction transformation and loading of logistics and warehouse data into enterprise databases for reliable reporting
* Configure and enhance Blue Yonder WMS functionalities to support complex distribution scenarios ensuring high system availability and consistent operational performance
* Validate integration between Blue Yonder WMS and upstream as well as downstream applications by conducting thorough functional testing and resolving identified defects promptly
* Document solution architectures process flows and configuration decisions in a clear and structured manner to support long term maintainability and knowledge sharing across the team
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather detailed requirements translate them into functional specifications and align geospatial and warehouse solutions with strategic objectives
* Mentor junior analysts by reviewing their design artifacts code deliverables and analytical outputs while fostering a culture of quality accountability and continuous learning
* Perform detailed root cause analysis of production issues related to data quality system integration or configuration in order to restore services quickly and prevent recurrence
* Optimize query performance within PL SQL driven environments by fine tuning indexes partition strategies and execution plans to support high volume transactional workloads
* Apply Generative AI models responsibly to generate scenarios for route planning labor allocation and storage optimization while ensuring transparency and ethical use of data
* Prepare and deliver concise presentations dashboards and reports that communicate complex geospatial and warehouse analytical insights to non technical stakeholders in an actionable format
* Align daily activities with sustainability goals by identifying opportunities to reduce transportation distances energy consumption and waste within warehouse operations using data driven insights

**Qualifications**

* Exhibit professional experience of at least ten years working with geospatial analytics warehouse management systems and enterprise data platforms in complex project environments
* Demonstrate hands on proficiency in PL SQL including stored procedures performance tuning and relational data modeling to support robust analytics and reporting solutions
* Show practical expertise with Blue Yonder WMS modules such as inventory management order fulfillment and labor management including configuration and troubleshooting exposure
* Apply working knowledge of Generative AI techniques and tools to build prototypes experiments and production ready use cases that augment geospatial and warehouse decision processes
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non technical audiences while collaborating effectively in a hybrid work model with distributed teams
* Display familiarity with supply chain logistics and fulfillment concepts including order orchestration transportation flows and warehouse process optimization gained through project experience
* Adapt to evolving client priorities by managing multiple assignments simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality documentation testing and stakeholder satisfaction

**Certifications Required**
Blue Yonder WMS certification preferred and any recognized certification in Generative AI or advanced data analytics such as a cloud provider AI certification

title: Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Job Description — AI OS Architect, Individual Contributor**
Company: Tata Communications
  
  
Function: Solution Engineering
  
  
Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — senior, no people management. An architect embedded with enterprise customers to design and deploy their AI operating system.
  
  
Locations: India (Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram)
  
  

* UK (London)
* USA (New York / New Jersey, Dallas, or remote within the US) — one global requisition

Experience: 8+ years, with a minimum of relevant AI platform architecture experience (Palantir Foundry/AIP or equivalent) — relevant experience is mandatory
  
  
Travel: Up to 40–50% — this is a forward-deployed role; you will live at customer sites during major deployments, both domestic and international
  
  
**About The Role (a Note From The Hiring Head)**
Enterprises no longer buy AI features — they buy an AI operating system: a layer that unifies their data, their decisions, and their AI agents into one governed, auditable machine. Tata Comm AI OS proved the model with Context Graph and AIP — an ontology-first architecture where every data asset, action, and process is modelled once and reused everywhere.
  
  
You are not an internal software architect. You are the AI OS architect on the customer’s floor — who turns their messiest operational reality into a clean ontology, wires their data and systems into it, and orchestrates LLM-driven agents and workflows on top, all within governance, security, and cost discipline. If you have lived this, or built the same discipline with other enterprise AI platforms (Palantir, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS/Azure/GCP AI stacks, or an in-house equivalent), I want to talk.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Ontology & Data Architecture (the core of the role)
  
  

* Lead discovery at customer sites: map the enterprise’s objects (customers, orders, assets, claims, equipment), their relationships, actions, and processes — then model them into a shared, reusable ontology, not a pile of point solutions.
* Architect the data foundation: pipelines from operational systems, ERP/CRM, telemetry, documents and knowledge bases into a governed data layer (zero-copy / lakehouse patterns), with lineage, quality rules, and access controls that hold up to audit.
* Design for reuse: every object, action, and process modelled once — permissioned, versioned, and composable across all downstream AI workflows.

AI Platform & Agent Architecture
  
  

* Design the AI layer on the enterprise OS: RAG over enterprise knowledge, context engineering, LLM/agent orchestration, tool-calling, human-in-the-loop fallbacks, and evaluation loops — using no-code, low-code and pro-code paths as the situation demands.
* Architect agentic workflows (autonomous, supervised, and human-in-the-loop)
* Own model governance: model selection and cost per action, prompt/version control, guardrails, safety and bias checks, drift monitoring, and audit trails.

Forward-Deployed Delivery
  
  

* Be the technical lead embedded in 1–2 major customer engagements at a time: run joint design workshops, build the reference architecture, and stay on-site through launch — wrangling real, messy, production data alongside customer teams.
* Build the thin slice that proves the model early (one decision, one agent, one happy path), then expand — demonstrating value in weeks, not quarters.
* Feed field learnings back: what patterns win in the market becomes input to our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)
  
  

* Relevant AI OS architecture experience — mandatory. You must have architected and shipped an enterprise AI platform deployment in a forward-deployed or equivalent embedded setting: at Palantir, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS/Azure/GCP AI platforms, or a comparable in-house enterprise AI platform. Generic ML/DS experience without enterprise-deployment depth will not clear the bar.
* Ontology-first thinking — demonstrated ability to model an enterprise’s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
* Deep data engineering — pipelines, lakehouse/data-platform architecture, streaming and batch, data quality and lineage, zero-copy patterns; SQL, PySpark or equivalent fluency.
* LLM/agentic AI depth — RAG architectures, context engineering, prompt and agent orchestration, tool use, evals, guardrails, and cost/latency tuning; hands-on with at least one major LLM stack.
* Enterprise governance & security — IAM, row/object-level permissions, model governance, compliance (SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR and India DPDP Act awareness), and speaking that language to CTOs and CISOs.
* Forward-deployed temperament — you are measured by customer outcomes, you travel, you tolerate ambiguity, and you can explain architecture to a COO and run a terminal in the same afternoon. Excellent written documentation and client-facing communication.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
  
  

* Customer engagements that reach production: number of deployments delivered from architecture to go-live at the customer site.
* Time-to-first-value: weeks from kickoff to a production thin slice per engagement.
* Ontology/platform reuse: patterns and assets built once, reused across multiple customers.
* Deal technical win rate and accuracy of BoM/effort estimates versus contracted scope.
* Field feedback that demonstrably shaped product roadmap.

Experience working in enterprise MacBook support, endpoint operations, or managed workplace environments.

Experience with ITIL-based incidents, problem, change, request fulfillment, and escalation processes.

Ability to collaborate with product owners, architects, service managers, security teams, identity teams, infrastructure teams, and vendor support teams.

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

IT Operations Engineer

Humyn Labs

ABOUT HUMYN LABS

Humyn Labs builds the intelligence layer for physical-world AI. We convert human action — sight, sound, movement, touch — into training-grade multimodal data for embodied AI, captured across 20+ countries in the real environments where physical AI actually deploys, not the labs where it is built.

Our egocentric corpus ships to robotics and world-model teams as labeled data: 6-DoF head pose, metric 3D hand keypoints, depth, object tracks. The labels are the product. Their accuracy is the company.

The role

You'll own how Kgen runs internally — our devices, our identities, and our IT assets. This is a hands-on, single-owner role: you set up and run the tooling that keeps every employee productive and every endpoint secure, from the laptop someone unboxes on day one to the access that's cleanly revoked on their last. You'll work closely with the Head of Security, and your work is a direct input into our security posture.

The role

You'll own how Kgen runs internally — our devices, our identities, and our IT assets. This is a hands-on, single-owner role: you set up and run the tooling that keeps every employee productive and every endpoint secure, from the laptop someone unboxes on day one to the access that's cleanly revoked on their last. You'll work closely with the Head of Security, and your work is a direct input into our security posture.

* Take ownership of our device fleet and get Microsoft Intune and SentinelOne fully rolled out and enforcing baseline compliance across all endpoints.

* Run identity and access management: provision, change, and deprovision access across our systems as people join, move teams, and leave.
* Deploy and operate Microsoft Intune — MDM/MAM, device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app management across the fleet. -

* Administer Google Workspace — users, groups, org units, security settings, DLP, and Drive governance.

* Manage SaaS applications, SSO integrations, software licenses, and vendor relationships.

* Working knowledge of identity and access management / SSO (Google, Microsoft Entra ID, or Okta). Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar) — comfortable automating repetitive work rather than doing it by hand each time.
* Strong ownership, clear documentation habits, and comfort being the person the whole company relies on for IT.

Bonus points

**Job Description**
Patch Management – Workstation Patching Engineer
  
  
**Value Proposition**
As a Patch Engineer, this role is integral to leading enterprise-wide patch management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance initiatives. The position leverages advanced expertise in BigFix, MECM and vulnerability scanning tools like Qualys to secure enterprise systems. The patch engineer will play a technical role along with mentoring teams for technical issues and help automate patching processes for improved efficiency and robust compliance.
  
  
**Job Details**
Position Title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Career Level: P3
  
  
Job Category : Manager
  
  
Role Type: Hybrid
  
  
Job Location: Bangalore
  
  
**About The Team**
First Citizens Bank is one of the top financial services providers, recognized and awarded for our customer satisfaction, sustainable profitability, and overall stability and security. Our associates make First Citizens Bank a great place for our clients to do business. Those who grow, achieve and succeed with First Citizens Bank are those who share our core values of integrity, service excellence and stability.
  
  
The patch management team is a cross-functional group focused on maintaining, optimizing, and securing enterprise endpoints. The team collaborates with IT security, infrastructure, and operations teams, working under critical deadlines to ensure uptime and compliance. Members contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence
  
  
**Impact**
This Patch Engineer position is essential for enforcing security standards, ensuring compliance, and protecting the organization from threats. The role is pivotal in setting up automation and best practices in patching, participating in vulnerability remediation, and providing direction and mentorship to junior associates
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Advanced Patch Management: Plan, implement, and manage the deployment of operating system patches, updates, including third party software updates across Windows 10, 11 workstation environments using tools like MECM/MEMCM / BigFix, and PowerShell scripts.
* Complex Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve advanced system and patching issues that L1/L2 members escalate, ensuring developing/providing solution and stability.
* Workstation Administration: Manage and maintain Windows workstation environments, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure systems meet security standards, manage security policies, and maintain OS-level security compliance.
* Automation: Develop and implement automation for routine administrative and patching tasks, often using PowerShell.
* Patch Compliance and Optimization: Proactively monitor system patch health, performance, and availability, and implement enhancements to optimize resource allocation.
* Documentation & Reporting: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for patching procedures, troubleshooting steps, and generate performance reports.
* Collaboration & Mentorship: Working closely with various internal teams and OEM vendor to align with enterprise standards and address security threats and mentor junior members.
* Reporting: Prepare / report patch compliance reports /metrics as needed.
* Process/Standards: Adhere strictly to ITIL change, incident, and problem management for patch-related activities

**Skills And Qualification**

* Must have
* 8+ years of deep exposure in workstation patch management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance using various tools (BigFix, PowerShell scripting and Qualys).
* Strong knowledge of Windows 11 Operating Systems along with patch deployment and troubleshooting skills – Able to understand issues from log files.
* Advanced knowledge of BigFix architecture, deployment, and reporting.
* Strong knowledge over BigFix Baseline for patch deployments of workstation patches.
* Able to serve as the highest escalation point for complex issues that L1 and L2 support teams cannot resolve
* Strong understanding of third-party software updates (include Java) along with third party patching tools like PMPC, Ivanti etc.
* Strong proficiency in PowerShell for automation and system management; Should be able to create, modify, update complex scripts to build solutions.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to address complex technical issues.
* Understanding and exposure to vulnerability management tools (Qualys).
* In-depth understanding of patching best practices, compliance, and IT security standards.
* Identify, understand and collaborate with OEM/Vendors to resolve patch related issues
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and best practices
* Good to have
* Understanding of software package creation and deployments.
* Understanding and exposure to vulnerability management tools (Qualys)
* In-depth understanding of patching best practices, compliance, and IT security standards
* Identify, understand, and collaborate with OEM/Vendors to resolve patch related issues
* Experience working with Microsoft Endpoint Manager Configuration Manager (MEMCM) for device management and patching
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and best practices
* Soft Skills:
* Excellent written and verbal communication along with strong documentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated, with a "can-do" attitude and comfort working with ambiguity.
* Strong customer service skills and a customer-focused mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the banking or financial services industry is a plus.
* Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
* Knowledge of network topology and security principles.
* Experience with enterprise applications specific to the banking industry.
* Knowledge of collaboration tools like Jira, or Confluence.

**Relationships & Collaboration**

* Ensure great Partnership with IT counterparts (India as well as US associates).
* Be available for team connects if any.
* Flexible to adjust work scheduled including evening, weekend, as per Org need.
* Collaborate with Business wherever necessary.

The role sits in the Service Delivery Center and works as part of the wider People Solutions team, with a close dotted-line partnership to People Solutions Systems Management.
  
  
You’ll own a defined set of routine tier 1 and tier 2 operational work across Workday and related People Systems. This includes monitoring support channels and system inboxes, triaging requests, completing repeatable administrative tasks, maintaining documentation, and routing complex issues to the right People Systems owner.
  
  
This is a hands-on operations role. It creates clearer separation between routine support work and the configuration, architecture, governance, and project delivery owned by the People Systems team.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Support queue and request triage
  
  

* Monitor the Salesforce case management queue and Jira requests for People Systems work.
* Triage incoming requests by urgency, business impact, data sensitivity, and defined support process.
* Resolve standard requests using documented procedures, and route exceptions or higher-complexity work to the appropriate People Systems owner. Keep request records accurate and complete, including status updates, required approvals, supporting documentation, and clear handoffs.
* Identify recurring request patterns and flag opportunities to improve documentation, self-service, or system processes.

Workday operations
  
  

* Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.
* Complete routine Workday support tasks, including standard access requests, account maintenance, and operational follow-up.
* Support Salesforce and JIRA run work and respond to common People Systems questions using approved guidance.
* Help with recurring operational tasks such as account monitoring, account resets, and quarterly account reviews.
* Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.
* Assist with release readiness by reviewing assigned Workday updates, completing test steps, documenting results, and escalating issues found during testing.
* Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support
  
  

* Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.
* Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.
* Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.
* Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems
  
  

* Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.
* Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.
* Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.
* Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.
* Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.
* Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.
* Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.
* Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.
* Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.
* Good judgment when working with confidential information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.
* Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.
* Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

What success looks like
  
  
**Within The First Six Months, You Will**

* Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.
* Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.
* Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.
* Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.
* Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Corporate IT Manager
description:
Remote · Full Time · People Manager · +5 Years of Experience · India Only

  
Corporate IT Manager
  

This role is open only to candidates based in India. Applications from outside India will not be considered.

  
Who We Are
  

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. Through a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere. Agnostic by design and connected to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, Yuno optimizes acceptance rates, reduces costs, and strengthens security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction. Global brands including McDonald's, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, and Rappi run their payments on Yuno.

  
About The Role
  

Yuno is looking for a Corporate IT Manager, based in India, to own the internal technology backbone that keeps our fully remote, global team productive and secure. From device management and identity to SaaS administration and compliance, you'll lead Corporate IT, a new area within our Tech Infrastructure team, designing systems and automation that scale as Yuno grows across 190+ countries.

  

This is not a helpdesk role. You'll own the corporate IT stack end to end, drive the roadmap, automate what others still do by hand, and make security and compliance a built-in default rather than an afterthought — which matters when the company runs payments for global brands. You'll work closely with our Security team, taking corporate IT workload off SecOps, and you'll build and lead the Corporate IT team as it grows.

  
How AI Shows Up in This Role
  

  
* You'll build AI-driven automation for IT and helpdesk, turning repetitive requests and lifecycle workflows into self-serve flows, and maintain machine-readable documentation that AI assistants can act on
  
* As an AI-native company, Yuno runs on a growing stack of AI tools — you'll own how they're provisioned, secured, and governed across the org, managing access and OAuth/shadow-AI risk. And you're encouraged to use AI to move faster in your own work
  
  

  
Your Contribution Will Be
  

  
* **Corporate IT ownership and roadmap**
  — own the corporate IT function end to end and drive the corporate IT roadmap as the company scales
  
* **Device and endpoint management**
  — own the MDM platform (Jamf, Intune, or Kandji) for a distributed macOS and Windows fleet: zero-touch provisioning, patching, configuration-as-code, and endpoint security
  
* **Identity and access management**
  — administer the identity provider (Okta or equivalent), SSO, MFA, and SCIM; automate onboarding and offboarding, and enforce least-privilege access across every system
  
* **SaaS administration and governance**
  — manage the SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and more), rein in shadow IT and OAuth risk, and right-size licenses and access
  
* **Security and compliance**
  — build and maintain the controls, access reviews, and audit evidence that keep Yuno compliant (SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), partnering with Security on vendor reviews
  
* **Automation**
  — replace manual work with scripting and workflow automation (Python, Okta Workflows, or similar)
  
* **Team leadership and enablement**
  — act as the senior escalation point for complex IT issues, maintain clear runbooks and documentation, and lead and mentor the Corporate IT team as it grows
  
  

  
What Success Looks Like
  

Within your first 6–12 months, onboarding and offboarding run end to end without manual steps, the device fleet and SaaS access are fully managed and auditable, and SOC 2 and PCI evidence is something the team produces continuously rather than scrambling for at audit time.

  
Skills You Need
  
Minimum Qualifications
  

  
* 5+ years in corporate IT, IT operations, or IT systems engineering, ideally supporting a distributed workforce
  
* Experience managing or mentoring IT team members, or leading corporate IT for a team or company
  
* Based in India, with the right to work in India
  
* MDM expertise — hands-on with Jamf Pro, Intune, or Kandji for macOS and Windows fleet management
  
* Identity and access management — managing an identity provider (Okta strongly preferred), SSO, MFA, and provisioning/deprovisioning
  
* SaaS administration — Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and similar, with an understanding of SaaS and OAuth governance
  
* Security and compliance — hands-on support for frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS (access reviews, audit evidence)
  
* Scripting and automation — Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, or workflow tools to eliminate manual toil
  
* Networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPNs
  
* English — advanced proficiency, written and spoken
  
  

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Building AI-driven IT automation (e.g., Console.com, Risotto, Unthread) or helpdesk and agentic tooling
  
* Hardware lifecycle and asset management (ITAM) at scale
  
* Experience in the payments or fintech industry, where compliance and access controls are stricter
  
* Familiarity with Zero Trust, PAM, and least-privilege access models
  
  

  
Nice to Have
  

  
* Configuration-as-code for endpoints (an infrastructure-as-code mindset for IT)
  
* Experience securing and governing AI tools or agents across an organization
  
  

  
What We Offer at Yuno
  

  
* Competitive Compensation
  
* **Remote Work**
  — work fully remote from anywhere in India
  
* **Home Office Bonus**
  — a one-time allowance to set up your ideal home office
  
* Work Equipment
  
* Stock Options
  
* Health Plan wherever you are
  
* Flexible Days Off
  
* Language, Professional, and Personal Growth courses

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment.
  
Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
  
If you would like more information about how your data is processed or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us at hiring@y.uno.

title: AI Tooling Administrator
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Work Arrangement:**
Hybrid
  
  
**What We Do At Weir**
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet's future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.
  
  
**Make your impact**
As an AI Tooling Administrator, you will play a critical role in enabling and scaling Weir's enterprise AI capabilities. You will be responsible for the administration, governance, security, adoption, and optimisation of AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, and future enterprise AI services.
  
  
Working at the intersection of AI Governance, Cyber Security, FinOps, Enterprise Architecture, and Business teams, you will help ensure that AI delivers measurable business value while remaining secure, compliant, and cost-effective. This role is central to Weir's transition from isolated AI experimentation to a governed enterprise AI operating model.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Tenant & Platform Administration: Configure and administer enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, and future enterprise AI solutions at the tenant and organizational level. Define baseline configurations, establish separation between pilot, testing, and production environments, and maintain platform settings aligned with enterprise standards and architecture.
* Identity, Access & User Lifecycle Management: Integrate AI platforms with enterprise identity providers such as Entra ID, support machine identity implementation, manage role-based access controls (RBAC), and govern joiners, movers, leavers, and periodic access reviews. Enforce segregation of duties and alignment with enterprise security policies.
* Licensing, Token Governance & Cost Optimization: Manage AI platform licensing, entitlements, token consumption, and budget controls across the organization. Optimize license allocation, monitor utilization, reduce waste, prevent duplicate tooling investments, and minimize unmanaged or shadow AI adoption. Partner with FinOps teams to provide transparency of AI spend and maximize value from investment.
* Security & Data Protection: Partner with SecOps and Cyber Security teams to establish and enforce controls for handling personal data, commercially sensitive information, intellectual property, customer information, supplier information, and source code. Configure retention policies, workspace permissions, integration restrictions, and security controls to mitigate risks such as prompt injection and data leakage.
* Compliance, Audit & Responsible AI: Enable audit logging, monitoring, and traceability across enterprise AI platforms. Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, security, privacy, and internal governance requirements. Support AI Governance teams in establishing and maintaining responsible AI standards, policies, and operating procedures.
* Integration Governance & Agentic AI Enablement: Govern integrations, plugins, connectors, and enterprise AI extensions across platforms including SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other enterprise systems. Promote API-led integration patterns and support Agentic AI programmes and cross-system AI initiatives. Maintain an approved catalogue of integrations and usage patterns.
* Adoption, Enablement & Value Realization: Drive AI onboarding, training, education, and adoption across business functions. Develop guidance, playbooks, best practices, and reusable use-case patterns. Monitor adoption, business value, platform performance, and user satisfaction. Identify optimization opportunities and support AI service intake, approval processes, and enterprise AI operating models.
* Stakeholder, Governance & Vendor Collaboration: Work closely with AI Governance, Cyber Security (SecOps), FinOps, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Procurement, and IT teams to ensure AI platforms are operated in accordance with enterprise policies and standards. Manage stakeholder expectations, balance business demand with risk, governance, security, and budget considerations, and facilitate decision-making across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Partner with vendors including Microsoft, Anthropic, GitHub, Google, and other AI providers regarding product roadmaps, licensing, platform capabilities, and support models. Support alignment with Weir's enterprise AI strategy and operating model.
* Strategic AI Governance: Support Group, Enterprise, Architecture, Governance, and Tooling teams in shaping and executing Weir's multi-year AI adoption strategy. Contribute to enterprise AI operating models, governance frameworks, tooling roadmaps, and strategic investment decisions while considering ongoing business transformation programmes and future technology direction.
* Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero-harm behaviours in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

**What You'll Bring**
**Must-Haves**

* Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise/Claude Code, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, or similar enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI/LLM technologies, enterprise AI use cases, AI governance, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience managing AI platform licensing, entitlements, token consumption, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of identity and access management, tenant administration, machine identities, RBAC, and user lifecycle governance.
* Experience implementing governance, security, compliance, and data protection controls within enterprise platforms.
* Experience operating within security-controlled environments and collaborating with SecOps and Cyber Security teams.
* Experience working with AI Governance, Security, Architecture, FinOps, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to balance risk, compliance, cost, and business value.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, influencing, and expectation management skills.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Experience driving adoption, enablement, operational excellence, and governance for enterprise technology services.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals.
* Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900).
* GitHub Administration Certification.
* GitHub Copilot Certification.
* Google Cloud Generative AI Leader.
* Experience with multi-vendor AI ecosystems comprising Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, and Agentic AI platforms.
* Experience with API-led integration architectures, plugins, connectors, and enterprise integration governance.
* Familiarity with Agentic AI, MCP-enabled platforms, machine identity, AI agents, and enterprise automation ecosystems.
* Experience supporting FinOps practices, AI cost governance, and consumption optimisation programmes.
* Experience building AI adoption frameworks, governance processes, and controls to minimise shadow AI usage.
* Familiarity with emerging AI regulations, governance frameworks, and responsible AI standards.

**Why Join Weir?**
We live our values – Safety First, Do the Right Thing, Respect Each Other, Aim High, and Delight Our Customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to help shape Weir's global AI strategy, influence enterprise-wide AI adoption, and work with leading AI platforms and technologies while collaborating with stakeholders across Governance, Security, Architecture, FinOps, and Digital teams.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Career development and learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Wellness support for you and your family
* Sharebuilder scheme
* Collaboration with global teams
* Professional certification support
* Flexible hybrid working arrangements

title: Technical Consultant/Architect - Identity Access Management (IAM), OAuth 2.0, API Gateway Support, Python/Java,  L2/L3 Support
description:
**Scope**

* The BYX Platform provides shared identity, API management, event framework and portal capabilities for enterprise applications and implementation teams.
* We are seeking an astute Platform Application & Integration Support Engineer with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience supporting identity, APIs, event-driven integrations and browser-based applications in production.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Identity and Access: SSO, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, M2M authentication, access and refresh tokens, API keys, service identities, RBAC, roles, entitlements and realm-based configuration.
* API Management: Gravitee/APIM concepts, REST APIs, JSON, API products and subscriptions, gateway routing, policies, rate limits, CORS, HTTP status codes, DNS and TLS.
* Event Framework: Kafka topics, partitions, producers, consumers, broker connectivity, message delivery and EFS API integrations.
* Portal and Diagnostics: Micro-frontend concepts, browser developer tools, HAR and console analysis, client-side routing, caching, feature flags and downstream API integration.
* Operations: Jira, Elastic/Kibana, Linux, SQL, Git, CI/CD diagnostics and scripting using Bash, Python or PowerShell.

**What You’ll Do**

* Review and act on incidents, service requests and access requests logged by implementation teams and platform users.
* Own L2/L3 production issues from initial triage through diagnosis, remediation, validation, communication and closure.
* Troubleshoot SSO, OAuth/OIDC, token, session, M2M identity, service-account and credential-related failures.
* Investigate RBAC, roles, permissions, entitlements, realm configuration, application subscriptions and access-propagation issues.
* Diagnose API gateway routing, backend connectivity, API policies, rate limits, CORS and HTTP 401/403/404/429/5xx responses.
* Use request and response evidence, timestamps and correlation IDs to separate Portal, gateway, downstream service and infrastructure failures.
* Troubleshoot Kafka topic provisioning, partition configuration, producer/consumer delivery, Ack/Nack behavior, authentication and broker connectivity.
* Investigate Event Framework onboarding, EFS API synchronization, security-domain configuration and environment-specific issues.
* Diagnose Portal login, navigation, routing, cache, feature-flag and micro-frontend issues using browser developer tools, HAR files and console logs.
* Perform API testing, log searches and basic data validation using tools such as curl, Postman or equivalent clients, Kibana and SQL tools.
* Coordinate with development, cloud platform, security and networking teams and provide clear, reproducible evidence before escalation.
* Support release validation and verify application, identity and integration behavior following configuration or deployment changes.
* Create and maintain runbooks, known-error records, troubleshooting procedures and knowledge articles for recurring issues.
* Identify repetitive support work suitable for scripting, workflow automation or self-service enablement.
* Participate in incident reviews, root-cause analysis, change reviews and an agreed support or on-call rotation.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Minimum 5-10 years of relevant work experience in production application support, integration support, identity support or platform operations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability in business-critical production environments.
* Hands-on understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON, headers, status codes and API authentication.
* Practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect or comparable SSO and token-based authentication patterns.
* Experience troubleshooting roles, permissions, RBAC, entitlements, service identities or tenant/realm-based access models.
* Experience supporting an API gateway or API management product; Gravitee or comparable platform experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Kafka or a comparable enterprise messaging/event-streaming platform.
* Ability to use browser developer tools, HAR traces, network requests and console logs for client-side diagnosis.
* Working knowledge of Linux, application logs and basic SQL validation.
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Basic understanding of DNS, TLS/certificates, proxies, firewalls and application connectivity.
* Experience with Jira or a similar service-management tool and a practical understanding of Incident, Request, Problem, Change and RCA processes.
* Ability to document reproducible steps, technical findings, customer impact, corrective actions and handover details clearly.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across users, engineering, cloud and security teams.
* Willingness to participate in a scheduled support or on-call rotation and planned out-of-hours changes when required.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

title: Software Configuration Management Engineer – Hardware

This new model - where deep neural networks are trained to recognize patterns from massive amounts of data - has shown to be deeply effective at solving some of the most complex problems in everyday life. NVIDIA runs a very large GitLab environment, supporting 10s of thousands of engineers and massive repositories across the globe. Our Software Configuration Management (SCM) Tools and Infrastructure group is looking for a top SCM architect. * Create new solutions to improve the reliability and performance of our ever-growing infrastructure, and work with automated orchestration tools to deploy those improvements to hundreds of systems worldwide
* Be part of a global team and will evaluate technology alternatives, work closely with other project members to specify solutions, craft schedules, and lead ongoing enhancements and support
* Lead or contribute to GitLab upgrades and migrations, architectural reviews and design docs, root cause analysis and systemic fixes

* Deep understanding of SCM processes and large-scale, multi-site GitLab environments (experience with other SCM tools such as Perforce, Subversion, or ClearCase is a plus).
* You've configured/deployed Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) systems in your past experience
* Excellent interpreted language skills highly desired – Object Oriented Perl or Python preferred and Strong software engineering process skills required
* Strong skills in scripting and object-oriented languages such as Python or Ruby, with solid software engineering practices and familiarity with design patterns.
* Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
* Experience with DevOps or system administration on Linux systems required (Rocky Linux 8, CentOS/RHEL, and Ubuntu preferred)
* Strong experience with automation required, Ansible or Puppet preferred and Excellent
* interpersonal skills, including written and verbal communication
* You are comfortable and enjoy working with dynamic and ever evolving environments

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Meticulous and proactive problem-solver with a positive, can-do attitude.
* Demonstrate use of out-of-box thinking for creative solutions to highly sticky problems

personal, engaging and effective for the next generation.We believe creator-led content can become a powerful distribution engine for the next generation of consumer products. title: Campaign Manager
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
The Marketing Operations team is Kobie’s campaign execution engine — delivering outbound loyalty communications for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Organized into three pillars (Campaign Management, Development, and Quality Assurance), the team builds and deploys high-volume, personalized email campaigns that reach millions of loyalty members. As a Campaign Manager, you’ll work closely with internal and external partners to deliver loyalty marketing campaigns and email marketing for enterprise clients. You’ll ensure the performance, productivity, and efficiency of campaign creation and delivery — and help your clients’ members get the most out of their loyalty experience.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
As a Campaign Manager, you own the end-to-end lifecycle of your assigned campaigns — from intake through post-launch. You’re the day-to-day owner accountable for accurate, on-time delivery and clear client communication.
  
  

* Gather and document client campaign requirements, questioning and challenging as appropriate to ensure exact requirements are understood before build begins
* Validate campaign briefs for completeness — confirming audience, content, offer, and timeline requirements are fully defined before work is handed to Development
* Initiate and lead kick-off meetings with internal teams and external partners, documenting agreed-upon outputs and action items
* Own the marketing calendar for assigned clients — tracking milestones, flagging risks, and ensuring plans stay current throughout the campaign lifecycle
* Serve as the primary point of contact for client communications related to campaign status, delivery, and escalations
* Responsible for day-to-day operational processes including campaign set-up, trafficking, troubleshooting, QA coordination, and campaign optimization
* Manage, create, and coordinate campaign deployment including subscriber data, audience segmentation, email scheduling, and sending on behalf of Kobie’s loyalty clients
* Submit and track campaigns in Workfront/Jira; maintain documentation standards across all assigned work
* Support A/B and multivariate (MVT) test planning by ensuring test structures are defined, documented, and executable
* Identify process inefficiencies and ways to improve operational workflow
* Develop robust campaign and process documentation, including client-specific work instructions
* Escalate risks, blockers, and quality concerns proactively to avoid missed SLAs
* At the end of the first year, success means: campaigns execute accurately and on schedule, the marketing calendar is maintained without prompting, and client communication is proactive and reliable

**What You Need To Be Successful**
**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 2+ years of experience in a campaign management, account management, or project management role
* Knowledge of email marketing best practices, specifically Salesforce Marketing Cloud (formerly ExactTarget) required
* Experience with a new client implementation
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects and client deadlines with minimal oversight
* Strong written, verbal communication, and problem-solving skills with an impeccable eye for detail
* Ability to work directly in a client-facing role
* Agency experience or corporate in-house agency experience

**Additional Skills That Will Help You Stand Out:**

* Experience in SendGrid, Mailchimp, Alterian, Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or other ESPs
* Six Sigma, Lean, or other process framework
* Experience working in workflow management tools such as Workfront or Jira
* Knowledge of email template development and journey orchestration fundamentals preferred
* Knowledge of SQL fundamentals or other database technologies preferred

**How Your Success Will Be Measured**

* Understanding of the client’s operations
* Documentation of processes and procedures
* Oversight of marketing operations end-to-end

**About Kobie**
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.
  
  
As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
  
  
We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
  
  
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
  
  
To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.
  
  
As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
  
  
Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.
