description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Event Intelligence and Digital Engagement professional**
EY Global Delivery Services | Brand, Marketing and Communications | Global Flagship Events and Experiences
  
  
Role focus This role will help make our flagship events more measurable, connected and outcome-led.
  
  
Let us introduce you to the job offer by EY GDS, Brand, Marketing and Communications, India - a member of the global integrated service delivery centre network by EY.
  
  
Global Delivery Services (GDS) comprises 80,000 professionals who deliver strategic support to EY member firms. The team spans all EY geographies, practices, service lines, sectors and competencies to provide deeply integrated services resulting in efficient and world-class solutions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose - building a better working world - to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
  
  
We are looking for an Event Intelligence and Digital Engagement professional to help make flagship events more measurable, connected and outcome-led. This role is for someone who understands that great events do not begin at registration and end with a thank-you mailer. They create communities, content, conversations, insights and measurable influence.
  
  
You will support the Global Flagship Events and Experiences team by bringing a strong data, digital and audience engagement lens to high-impact programmes. You will help measure event effectiveness, improve audience engagement, support content amplification, use digital tools intelligently and convert event activity into clear insight for future decision-making.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a marketing and digital engagement professional with the ability to use data, content, platforms and audience insights to improve the impact of flagship events. You must be able to understand business priorities, measure engagement, identify opportunities for digital amplification and help stakeholders understand what changed because an event happened.
  
  
You should be comfortable with data, digital channels, content performance and stakeholder coordination. As part of the Global Flagship Events and Experiences team, your key responsibilities will include developing measurement approaches, building engagement plans, supporting content amplification, creating insight summaries and identifying opportunities to use AI, automation and event technology effectively.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop measurement approaches for flagship events, including engagement, reach, participation, feedback, content consumption, sentiment indicators and post-event actions.
* Use data and analytics to evaluate event effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve future experiences.
* Support digital engagement strategies across pre-event, live event and post-event phases.
* Work with internal communications, social, content, creative and stakeholder teams to amplify event narratives across relevant channels.
* Create audience engagement plans that help events build momentum before the experience and sustain impact after it.
* Track registrations, participation, engagement patterns, feedback and content performance where data is available.
* Build simple dashboards, reports and insight summaries for stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, event technology, marketing platforms and collaboration tools to make event planning, engagement and reporting more effective.
* Support content repurposing plans, including post-event stories, leadership snippets, digital assets, community updates and internal amplification.
* Partner with the Experience Design and Event Innovation professional to ensure events are both memorable and measurable.
* Collaborate across matrixed teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Bring a test-and-learn mindset to improve event formats, engagement models and reporting.
* Ensure all digital engagement and measurement activities align with EY brand, quality, privacy and stakeholder expectations.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We seek a highly skilled and dynamic professional who can bring a fresh perspective to the Global Flagship Events and Experiences team. In this role, you will be responsible for contributing to flagship experiences that are audience-centric, brand-aligned and outcome-led.
  
  

* Strong comfort with marketing data, event metrics, dashboards and reporting.
* Ability to translate data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Good understanding of digital engagement, content amplification and audience journeys.
* Experience using digital channels to build participation, engagement or community.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to work with internal communications, social media, creative, event and leadership teams.
* Strong writing and presentation skills, especially for insight summaries and stakeholder updates.
* Comfort with Microsoft Office tools and data visualisation or reporting platforms.
* Interest in AI, automation, event technology, marketing technology and emerging digital engagement models.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise effectively and work in a fast-paced global environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality under deadlines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Fluent English skills, written and verbal.
* 3-5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, communications, event marketing, marketing analytics, community engagement, content marketing or related roles.
* Strong stakeholder and project management skills.
* Experience working with campaign or event metrics, dashboards, reports, audience engagement or digital content performance.
* Ability to convert data into insight and communicate it in a simple, useful way.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Previous experience in a large, matrixed organisation.
* Prior experience with a B2B organisation, IT company, consulting firm, digital marketing agency, event technology platform, marketing operations team or analytics-led marketing function.
* Experience with tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, Tableau, PowerAutomate, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
* Exposure to event platforms, webinar platforms, registration tools, social listening, intranet analytics or content performance tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools for content, reporting, automation or audience engagement.
* Interest in measurement frameworks, behavioural insights, community building and integrated campaigns.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Campaign Engineer
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
The Marketing Operations team is Kobie’s campaign execution engine — delivering outbound loyalty communications for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Organized into three pillars (Campaign Management, Development, and Quality Assurance), the team builds and deploys high-volume, personalized email campaigns that reach millions of loyalty members. As a Marketing Ops Developer, you’ll sit at the heart of that delivery — owning the HTML and journey development that brings each campaign to life. You’ll work closely with Campaign Managers, QA Analysts, and client teams to ensure every send is accurate, on-brand, and on time.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
As a Campaign Engineer, you own the technical execution of campaigns from build through deployment. You’ll work across two core areas:
  
  
**HTML Email Development**

* Develop and maintain HTML/CSS email templates — ensuring accurate rendering across devices, email clients, and platforms
* Build reusable modular components and adapt client-specific templates to campaign requirements
* Test email rendering across clients and devices using tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid

**Journey & Campaign Development**

* Build and deploy outbound campaigns (primarily email) in Kobie-hosted platforms and client campaign management systems including Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Configure journey logic, audience segmentation, targeting rules, and suppression lists per campaign specifications
* Implement dynamic content, personalization tokens, and promotional offer logic according to strategy requirements
* Own the final deployment step for all assigned campaigns — ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery

**Execution & Collaboration**

* Execute A/B and multivariate (MVT) test configurations according to defined test plans
* Coordinate asset handoffs with Campaign Managers and content partners; flag dependency gaps proactively
* Document execution best practices and maintain build standards within the Development pillar
* Follow platform tooling standards and governance guidelines established by Campaign Management
* At the end of the first year, success means: campaigns build accurately and on schedule, builds consistently pass QA with minimal rework, and platform standards and SOPs are followed without prompting

**What You Need To Be Successful**
**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:**

* 1–3 years of experience in email development, marketing operations, or digital campaign execution
* Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS for email, including cross-client rendering
* Experience with at least one enterprise campaign platform — Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred
* Foundational understanding of journey orchestration — able to build single and multi-step automated flows, triggered sends, and entry/exit criteria within a campaign platform
* Familiarity with campaign automation concepts: event-based triggers, lifecycle programs, re-engagement flows, and scheduled vs. triggered deployment
* Understanding of A/B and MVT testing mechanics — able to configure test variants, split audiences, and execute test sends according to a defined test plan
* Understanding of audience segmentation, targeting logic, and data-driven personalization
* Strong attention to detail; proactive about catching discrepancies before campaigns go to QA
* Clear communicator — able to flag issues and ask the right questions before builds begin
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

**Additional Skills That Will Help You Stand Out:**

* Experience with Litmus, Email on Acid, or equivalent rendering test tools
* Familiarity with AMPScript, SQL, or other scripting/query languages used in campaign platforms
* Experience with additional ESPs such as Adobe Campaign, Braze, Iterable, or Marketo
* Knowledge of dynamic content and conditional content logic within campaign platforms
* Exposure to multi-channel or cross-channel campaign orchestration (email + SMS, push, or direct mail)
* Experience using project/workflow management tools such as Workfront or Jira

**How Your Success Will Be Measured**

* Understanding of the client’s operations
* Documentation of processes and procedures
* Oversight of marketing operations end-to-end

**About Kobie**
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.
  
  
As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
  
  
We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
  
  
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
  
  
To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.
  
  
As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
  
  
Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Manager - Card Portfolio Optimization Consulting, VCA X
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Summary
  
  
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery.
  
  
**Purpose**

* Primary focus: Own and drive portfolio strategy — lifting acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios.
* Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

**Responsibilities**
Portfolio Strategy and Performance
  
  

* Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI.
* Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage.

Customer Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate).
* Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels.

Campaign Strategy, Design, and Execution
  
  

* Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks.

Insights, Analytics, and Forecasting
  
  

* Drive analytics that size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); own a disciplined test-and-learn roadmap.
* Craft clear documentation and executive-ready presentations that turn findings into decisions for senior stakeholders.

Thought Leadership and Team Contribution
  
  

* Track market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and turn them into portfolio interventions.
* Build the playbooks, benchmarks, and frameworks that become the reference standard for portfolio optimization across every market — not a one-off deliverable, but the thing other markets build on.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 6-8 years in cards/payments, banking, or consulting with hands-on ownership of cards portfolio optimization, lifecycle programs, and campaign management.
* Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant-funded offers, and partnerships.
* Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or another data-intensive industry.
* Experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, prompt-based systems, or AI-assisted analytics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to craft executive-ready presentations and translate complex analytics into clear business decisions.
* Strong project management; ability to run multiple initiatives, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with disciplined documentation.
* Define the methodology, don't just execute one — thrive in a delivery model where the standard for this capability area is still being built, and where your judgment sets it.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Global Macro Content Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
Produce sharp, accurate, on-brand written content that turns StoneX's market expertise and studio output into engaging stories across our channels.
  
  
This is a role for a strong writer and editor who is fluent with modern AI tools and curious about financial markets, and who uses both to produce excellent content quickly. The work spans editing and original writing, with the support and direction of a close-knit content team. The aim is more relevant content from a deep well of experts, published faster, always in StoneX's voice, helping position the firm as a thought-leader in its industry.
  
  
**Technology Ecosystem:**
LLM and AI writing tools with prompt workflows (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT), WordPress / Sitecore, HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, SEMrush / Ahrefs, Grammarly Business, Microsoft 365, Adobe Creative Suite, Jira / Confluence, and basic HTML.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**

* Write and edit crisp, platform-specific copy from studio video output and market developments, across YouTube, social, articles, and white-paper drafts, with quick turnaround.
* Use AI writing tools fluently to accelerate your work, then shape everything into accurate, on-brand copy.
* Handle on-page basics: metadata, titles, tags, and CTAs.
* Publish and maintain content within the company CMS, keeping links, visuals, and accessibility in order.
* Follow the style guide to keep everything on-brand, accurate, and compliant.
* Work closely with the wider content and marketing team, taking direction on messaging, channels, and timing.
* Use performance feedback from the team to keep sharpening your work.

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* A demonstrable 3+ years' track record of editing and writing for digital channels, with a portfolio showing both polished long-form and sharp short-form work. We care about what you can do, not how many years it took to get there.
* Real, hands-on fluency with AI writing tools and prompting. You already use them daily and understand their failure modes.
* Genuine interest in and working understanding of financial markets, enough to spot when content is wrong, thin, or off-key.
* Strong SEO instincts: keyword research, on-page optimization, and the practical habits that go with them.
* Comfortable working in modern CMS platforms (e.g. Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore) and basic HTML.
* Solid editorial standards across grammar and accuracy, plus awareness of compliance requirements in regulated industries.

title: Project Assistant
description:
Project Assistant – Psychology Educational Content

**Organization:**
PsycheMaster

**Role Type:**
Internship

**Work Mode:**
Online / Remote

**Application Email:**
psychemasterindia@gmail.com

About PsycheMaster

PsycheMaster is committed to making psychological knowledge and support more accessible, inclusive, and relevant to people's everyday lives. The organization focuses on developing educational content and resources that promote psychological awareness, emotional well-being, and a deeper understanding of mental health, with particular attention to the Indian social and cultural context.

Through research-driven initiatives and educational projects, PsycheMaster aims to bridge the gap between psychological knowledge and its practical application in everyday life.

Role Description: Project Assistant

PsycheMaster is looking for a motivated and curious
**Project Assistant**
to join its team in developing and supporting psychology-focused educational content.

This role offers an opportunity to collaborate with a team, participate in discussions, conduct research, and contribute to scripting and developing accessible, evidence-informed educational materials.

The selected candidate will work closely with the team to explore psychological concepts, review relevant literature, discuss ideas, and translate research into engaging and understandable content. The project primarily focuses on educational content development, with an emphasis on Social Psychology and its application within the Indian context.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the team in planning and developing psychology-related educational content.
* Participate in discussions, brainstorming sessions, and content review meetings.
* Conduct basic literature reviews and research using relevant academic sources.
* Assist in scripting and structuring educational content for different audiences.
* Help translate psychological theories and research findings into clear, accessible language.
* Explore the application of social psychology within Indian society, culture, religion, and everyday experiences.
* Support content organization, documentation, fact-checking, and revisions.
* Undertake other relevant project-related responsibilities as assigned, in accordance with organizational policies and project requirements.

**Qualifications**
*Required*

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Psychology.
* Interest in psychological research, educational content development, and communicating psychological concepts.
* Willingness to participate in team discussions, receive feedback, and learn collaboratively.
* Basic research, writing, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed deadlines.

**Preferred**

* Students pursuing or interested in counselling psychology.
* Familiarity with academic research, psychological literature, or evidence-based content.
* Interest in Social Psychology and its relevance to the Indian social and cultural context.
* Basic scripting, writing, or educational content development experience.

**Benefits and Perks**

* **Supervision and mentorship:**
  Guidance and feedback from the team to support learning and professional development.
* **Stipend:**
  Up to ₹3,000, subject to the organization's stipend policy and applicable conditions.
* **Certification:**
  A certificate upon successful completion of the internship, subject to organizational requirements.
* **Training:**
  Learning and training opportunities focused on Social Psychology and the Indian context.
* **Collaborative experience:**
  Opportunities to participate in team discussions, research, and educational content development.
* **Practical exposure:**
  Experience in translating psychological knowledge into accessible educational resources.
* **Potential future opportunities:**
  Based on performance, organizational requirements, and available positions, interns may be considered for full-time or part-time opportunities after six months.

Workload and Flexibility

This is an online internship designed to maintain a manageable workload alongside academic commitments.

* **Expected screen-based workload:**
  Approximately 5 hours per week.
* **Additional workload:**
  Up to approximately 3 additional hours per week may occasionally be required, depending on project needs and assigned responsibilities.

Tasks and timelines will be communicated in coordination with the team to support effective planning and completion of project work.

Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview via Google Meet. Interviews are expected to be conducted within
**3–4 days of shortlisting**
, subject to scheduling and organizational requirements.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are requested to apply by sending an email to
**psychemasterindia@gmail.com**
with the following:

* **CV/Resume:**
  Optional.
* **Written responses:**
  Required. Please share your thoughts on the following questions.

**Required Writing Assignment**

**1. Why does Indian psychology need to change?**

Reflect on the current understanding and practice of psychology in India. What changes, if any, do you think are needed to make psychological knowledge and services more relevant to Indian society?

**2. Do you believe Indian culture, religion, and regional diversity are central to understanding psychology in the Indian context? Why or why not?**

Consider how cultural practices, religious beliefs, languages, regional differences, and social environments may influence people's thoughts, emotions, behaviours, and mental well-being.

**3. Short response (approximately 100 words):**

Do you think patriarchy is a major concern affecting the mental well-being of women and children in India? If yes, how might matriarchy or alternative family and social structures influence their mental well-being?

We encourage applicants to think critically about gender, power, family structures, social expectations, and their psychological implications.

There are no strictly right or wrong answers. We are interested in understanding your perspective, critical thinking, cultural awareness, and ability to engage thoughtfully with psychological and social issues. Applicants are encouraged to express their own views and support their reasoning wherever possible.

**Email Instructions**

**Send your application to:**
**psychemasterindia@gmail.com**

**Suggested subject line:**
Application for Project Assistant – PsycheMaster

Please include your responses to all three questions in the body of your email or as an attached document. You may attach your CV/Resume if you wish.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an
**online interview via Google Meet,**
expected to take place within 3–4 days of shortlisting, subject to availability and scheduling.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is suitable for psychology students who are curious about research, enjoy discussing ideas, and want to develop their skills in educational content creation.

Students interested in counselling psychology, Social Psychology, and understanding psychological concepts within the Indian context are especially encouraged to apply.

* At PsycheMaster, this internship is an opportunity to learn, collaborate, and contribute to making psychological knowledge more accessible through meaningful educational content.

This role is about understanding what the customer and business need today, what the ideal store should look like, and what needs to change to get there. You will work across Product, Tech, Marketing, Analytics, Creative and Business teams to identify opportunities, prioritise them and drive them to impact.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can connect customer behaviour, business

performance and digital experience — and turn insights into action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store Ownership — #1 Priority**

● Own the overall quality, effectiveness and evolution of the D2C store experience.

● Ensure the customer journey is seamless, intuitive and commercially effective.

● Stay close to customer behaviour, funnel performance and store experience to identify gaps and friction.

● Proactively identify what is broken, what needs to improve and what the ideal store experience should look like.

● Balance immediate business needs with building a better long-term store experience.

**2. Growth Opportunities**

● Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve Conversion, AOV, Revenue and LTV.

● Use data, customer behaviour and business context to understand where the biggest opportunities lie and why.

● Develop and evaluate new ideas, experiments and experience improvements based on potential business impact.

● Ensure initiatives move from insight → prioritisation → execution → measurement → learning.

● Continuously challenge the status quo and look for ways to make the store more effective.

**3. Cross-functional Leadership**

● Work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, Analytics, Creative and Business teams to

turn priorities into outcomes.

● Create clarity on what needs to happen, why it matters and who needs to deliver it.

● Proactively identify dependencies, risks and gaps and ensure they are addressed.

● Drive initiatives through to closure and measurable impact, without things falling through the cracks.

**What We’re Looking For**

● Exceptional critical thinking and structured problem-solving.

● Strong commercial understanding of digital commerce and customer journeys.

● High ownership and a strong bias for action.

● Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.

● Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring clarity to complex problems.

● Strong customer-first mindset combined with business thinking.

● Data-driven, with the ability to translate insights into actions.

● Experience in D2C, e-commerce, digital product, growth or CRO is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

The person in this role should consistently be able to answer:

What is happening? Why is it happening? What matters most? What should

we do now? And what should the ideal state look like?

**Success means:**

● A seamless and continuously improving store experience.

● Clear identification and prioritization of the highest-impact growth opportunities.

● Faster conversion of insights into meaningful improvements.

● Strong cross-functional execution with clear ownership and closure.

● Measurable improvement in Conversion, AOV, Revenue and LTV.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**JD - Senior Product Analyst**

**About us**

Zemoso is an AI-native product engineering company helping Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises turn complex ideas into production.

We work with enterprise teams to build production-grade AI agents for real business workflows, driving measurable outcomes and ROI. We also help engineering organizations modernize how software is built, applying AI across the SDLC to move from idea to production faster.

Zemoso has contributed to over $10 billion in value creation across healthcare, financial services, logistics, biotech, retail, and e-commerce.

We are a 3x Deloitte Fast 50 company and an O'Reilly Architectural Katas winner. Our technology partnerships include Anthropic, Databricks, Google Cloud and AWS.

**Role overview**

We are hiring a Senior Product Analyst with 5+ years of experience in product analytics, experimentation and causal inference to join our team in Bangalore. You will turn ambiguous product questions into rigorous analytical frameworks, partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to define KPIs, and influence product roadmaps with data-driven insights.

**Location**

Bangalore

**What You will do**

* Play the role of Senior Product Analyst, acting as the primary analytics thought partner to Product, Engineering, and Science teams within cross-functional pod structures.
* Scope ambiguous product questions with stakeholders, define North Star metrics, establish success and guardrail metrics, and deliver unbiased findings that directly inform roadmap decisions.
* Design and execute A/B experiments end-to-end: define target audiences, determine traffic sizing, execute power analysis, implement variance reduction (CUPED), manage multiple-comparison corrections, and monitor metrics post-launch.
* Guide experiment tracking setup by defining event action requirements, dropping proper experiment tags (XT tags), and validating telemetry pipelines before data analysis begins.
* Apply causal inference techniques and Quasi-Experimental Alternatives to measure feature impact where randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are unfeasible or unethical.
* Perform deep-dive product analytics—including multi-step funnel optimization, cohort tracking, and retention analysis—to pinpoint drop-offs and drive feature prioritization.
* Lead strategic analysis beyond standard experiment readouts, including quarterly strategy planning, opportunity sizing, and metric deep dives to uncover customer needs.
* Build dashboards and consolidate findings into executive-ready experiment readouts to drive go/no-go launch decisions in leadership reviews.
* Work with data engineers to design, build, test, and monitor scalable, reusable data pipelines for ongoing experimentation and analytics workflows.

**Basic Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  5+ years.
* Hands-on experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in product analytics, preferably in
  **cross border e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, search domains or logistics**
  .
* Strong experience designing and analyzing A/B experiments: power analysis, hypothesis and significance testing, CUPED, Bonferroni correction.
* Deep expertise in causal inference methods and
  **Quasi-Experimental Alternatives**
  , specifically:
* **Regression Discontinuity (RDD):**
  Exploits administrative cutoffs or scoring rules to mimic local randomization.
* **Propensity Score Matching:**
  Statistically balances confounding covariates between self-selected groups.
* **Difference-in-Differences (DiD):**
  Compares treatment and control trends over time, adjusting for baseline offsets.
* **Synthetic Controls:**
  Constructs a weighted combination of unexposed units to model a perfect counterfactual.
* Advanced SQL and coding experience in Python (PySpark a plus) on large data sets.
* Experience with tracking architecture, validating event telemetry, and defining tracking requirements for engineering teams.
* Experience with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention analysis, KPI design, North Star metrics, and opportunity sizing.
* Experience with data warehouse and pipeline tools such as Snowflake, Databricks and Apache Airflow.
* Experience building dashboards in BI tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, Sigma or Metabase, and with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude.
* Strong communication and conflict management skills, with a track record of driving transparency via tools like Airtable and presenting unbiased insights to cross-functional leadership.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

**Nice to have Qualifications**

* Experience with search analytics, including autocomplete optimization, ranking/relevance model evaluations, or agentic/conversational search experiences.
* Familiarity with recommendation systems: collaborative filtering, content-based and hybrid approaches, applied to personalization use cases.
* Exposure to Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM application development in Python, including vector databases and retrieval pipelines.
* Experience building automated reporting workflows that reduce manual analyst effort.
* Experience with Git/GitHub for version-controlled analytics code.

title: Specialist, Tech capability
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**
Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.
  
  
For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Own requirements and functional analysis for the Digital Commerce capability, translating brand and business needs into delivery-ready specifications for the squad. Apply functional knowledge of digital commerce platforms to challenge, refine, and validate requirements before they enter development.
  
  

* Own requirements and functional analysis for the Shopify capability within the Digital Delivery function, translating business goals into delivery-ready requirements for the squad.
* Ensure business requirements are translated into well-defined features, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and executable delivery outcomes before they enter development.
* Delivered features meet their agreed acceptance criteria at UAT, minimizing defects traced back to unclear or incomplete requirements.
* Produce functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and maintain functional documentation in Confluence covering process flows, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and change history.
* Produce UAT test scenarios, defect closure records, and requirements traceability from business need through to sign-off.
* Provide quality data to support the monthly SLA report presented back to the brands.
* Participate in discovery workshops with functional leads and business stakeholders to shape and clarify requirements.
* Support PI and sprint planning by refining requirements ready for estimation, identifying cross-functional and cross-system dependencies, and clarifying scope before commitment.
* Analyse customer feedback, support tickets, operational issues, and behavioral data using analytics platforms such as GA4 to identify recurring pain points and improvement opportunities, informing business outcomes such as conversion, AOV and adoption.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**

* 6 to 9 years in business or functional analysis within digital commerce.
* Experience analyzing and specifying requirements on SFCC or Shopify or Shopify Plus.
* Strong functional knowledge of capability, able to challenge and shape business requirements rather than only document them.
* Experience producing user stories and acceptance criteria and supporting UAT through to defect closure and sign-off.
* Usage proficiency in Jira and Confluence for backlog management and functional documentation.
* Ability to analyse business, product, and customer data to generate actionable insights,

diagnose KPI performance, identify root causes, and recommend clear next steps to
  
  
improve outcomes across digital commerce journeys.
  
  

* Experience using generative AI tools to support analysis and documentation.
* Certification in business analysis or agile delivery is nice to have.
* Preferred Profile: Retail or e-commerce domain experience. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor. Profiles such as Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or Technical Analyst in digital commerce

**What We Can Offer You**
With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
  
  
We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
  
  
**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
  
  
**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
  
  
We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

* Experience in supporting users and resolving hardware/software issues.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and documentation skills.

title: Service Now Jr. Admin
description:
**Job Title: ServiceNow Senior Administrator**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a ServiceNow Senior Administrator to manage the day‑to‑day health, stability, and configuration of our ServiceNow platform. This role requires strong hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM, solid understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to support enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and guide junior team members. You will work closely with developers, process owners, and platform stakeholders to ensure the system runs smoothly and follows best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily administration of the ServiceNow platform, including user management, roles, groups, and access controls.
* Maintain and improve core modules such as ITSM and CMDB; experience with ITAM, ITOM, HRSD, or SecOps is a plus.
* Configure and manage forms, fields, lists, UI policies, UI actions, and basic workflow or Flow Designer logic.
* Support platform upgrades, patches, regression testing, and general maintenance activities.
* Monitor data quality across key tables, including CMDB, ITSM, SAM/HAM, and ITOM‑related records.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement long‑term fixes.
* Assist with catalog items, record producers, notifications, and workflow automation.
* Work with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into configuration tasks.
* Maintain clear documentation for configuration changes, processes, and platform updates.
* Provide guidance to junior admins and support teams on platform standards and best practices.

**Core Skills & Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, tables, forms, ACLs, and role‑based access.
* Hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM (required).
* Working knowledge of Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Flow Designer.
* Familiarity with Script Includes, Glide APIs, and basic scripting (JavaScript).
* Understanding of integrations, Scripted REST APIs, and data exchange concepts.
* Good awareness of CMDB relationships, data models, and data quality practices.
* Experience with Service Portal or UI customization is helpful.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of hands‑on experience administering or developing in ServiceNow.
* Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience supporting upgrades, maintenance, and platform improvements.
* Background working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* ServiceNow CSA certification required or in progress; additional certifications (ITSM, CMDB, HRSD, ITAM) are a plus.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business teams.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and support platform governance.

*JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.*

title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
**AI DevOps Engineer**
**Let’s be unstoppable together!**
Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.
  
  
At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise infrastructure and application delivery platforms across both on-premises and hyperscaler cloud environments. This role will be responsible for driving DevOps practices, CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform reliability, and operational excellence in hybrid infrastructure landscapes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in cloud and data center technologies, automation, container platforms, and production support. This individual will partner closely with Infrastructure, Application Development, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available technology solutions.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**DevOps, Platform Engineering & Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain enterprise DevOps platforms supporting software development and infrastructure teams.
* Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines utilizing Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Automate application deployment, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, patching, and operational workflows.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on deployment speed, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

**On-Premise Infrastructure Operations**

* Support enterprise data center infrastructure including virtualized environments, compute, storage, networking, and backup solutions.
* Manage Linux-based environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Integrate on-premises systems with cloud platforms to support hybrid operational models.
* Participate in infrastructure lifecycle management, upgrades, patching, disaster recovery testing, and capacity planning.

**AI & Frontier Technology Platform Support**

* Deploy, automate, and support AI/ML infrastructure platforms and services in cloud and on-premises environments.
* Support AI engineering teams with scalable environments for model training, inference, experimentation, and deployment.
* Manage infrastructure supporting generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI copilots, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Establish operational monitoring, security controls, compliance, and reliability standards for AI solutions.

**Hybrid Cloud & Hyperscaler Support**

* Design, deploy, and support workloads across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Manage and optimize hybrid cloud environments integrating on-premises infrastructure with cloud services.
* Support cloud governance, security standards, identity management, cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Partner with cloud vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex platform issues.
* Develop cloud migration, modernization, and platform engineering strategies.
* Design and support containerized application platforms using Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS, EKS, or GKE.
* Manage cluster administration, networking, security, scalability, and operational health.

**Monitoring, Reliability & Production Support**

* Implement and maintain enterprise monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
* Support production systems with a focus on availability, performance, and resiliency.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and on-call support rotations.
* Develop operational runbooks and support procedures for critical platforms.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to improve system availability and reduce operational risk.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and resiliency initiatives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Operations.
* Strong experience supporting both on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based environments.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Jenkins administration, pipeline development, automation, and integration.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins and Azure DevOps
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code Ansible.
* Strong Linux administration experience.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration platforms.
* Experience supporting Azure or GCP environments.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-cloud experience across Azure and GCP.
* Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect or related certifications.
* Experience managing large-scale hybrid cloud transformations.
* Knowledge of platform engineering and self-service infrastructure models.
* Experience supporting retail, distribution, supply chain, or large-scale customer-facing platforms.

**Core Competencies**

* DevOps & Platform Engineering
* Jenkins Administration & CI/CD Automation
* Hybrid Cloud Operations
* Hyperscaler Cloud Support (Azure, GCP)
* On-Premises Infrastructure Management
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes & Container Platforms
* Enterprise Monitoring & Observability

In this role, you will be the sole point of contact and technical leader responsible for the installation, configuration, optimization, security, and migration of our Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).
  
  
You will bring deep technical expertise in administering workloads in AWS Cloud, configuring highly secure Single Sign On (SSO) via Shibboleth, and maintaining high availability through custom Apache Load Balancing topologies.

* End to End Environment Management: Single handedly install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Hyperion EPM (v11.2+), Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).

* Develop and maintain automation scripts (MaxL, CLI, ESSCMD, Windows batch, Python, Unix shell) to automate regular maintenance, data/metadata loads, backups, and environment syncs.
* Manage and tune underlying SQL Server databases and Oracle WebLogic Application Servers hosting the middleware

Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure (AWS)
  
  

* Configure, scale, and optimize AWS resources including EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, VPCs, and Security Groups.
* Use CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible to build, document, and provision environment stacks programmatically.
* Disaster Recovery (DR): Establish multi AZ high availability, backup policies, AMI custom images, snapshots, and rapid recovery strategies

Web Tier, Load Balancing & Security (Apache & Shibboleth)
  
  

* Web Server Customization: Install, configure, and harden Apache HTTP Server / Oracle HTTP Server (OHS) as the entry point reverse proxy.
* Apache Load Balancing: Configure advanced, sticky session based load balancing using Apache module proxies to distribute traffic across clustered WebLogic JVMs.
* Shibboleth SSO Integration: Single handedly implement, configure, and troubleshoot SAML header based Single Sign On (SSO) utilizing Shibboleth Identity Provider (IdP) integration with EPM/OAS/other Third party tools & Applications.
* User & Certificate Governance: Manage SSL/TLS certificates across Apache servers, AWS Load Balancers, and WebLogic keystores.

Special Focus: Vulnerability Monitoring, Tracking & Remediation
  
  

* Review and execute quarterly Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPUs) and monthly Critical Security Patch Updates (CSPUs) for Essbase 21c, WebLogic, Hyperion, and Java SE to address critical remote code execution (RCE) and takeover vulnerabilities (such as historical flaws like CVE 2021 2109 or current high severity targets).
* Monitor and remediate vulnerabilities in our DMZ web layer. Implement secure configurations, update Apache load balancers, enforce TLS protocol standards, and patch server side request.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
Must Have Experience:
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Essbase, and BI middleware infrastructure administration.
* Hands on experience with Essbase 21c, specifically configuring independent/standalone instances on top of Fusion Middleware WebLogic infrastructure.
* Proven history of handling large scale infrastructure projects single handedly, from architecture design through to post go live support.
* Production experience hosting enterprise workloads on AWS Cloud (utilizing EC2, VPC, EFS, and EBS).
* High level of expertise configuring Apache Load Balancing with WebLogic cluster plugins.
* Deep understanding of Shibboleth SSO, SAML protocol, and security certificate (SSL) management.
* Complete familiarity with ODI and OAS console, agent, and repository administration.

description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description And Responsibilities**
The Cyber Security division of Broadcom’s Global Technology Organization (GTO) is a technology forward organization constantly looking for new innovative solutions to implement while making security the base principle, not just the perimeter. This position is based in Bangalore, India, reporting to the Identity Platform Architect & Manager. The role is focused on supporting, administering, and securing Broadcom’s core Identity and Access Management (IAM), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and physical security infrastructure. A degree in Information Technology with a minimum of 5 years IT Support experience is desired. This is a full-time, in-office position (no remote work).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Core Identity & Access Management (IAM) Administration
* SSO & Federated Identity: Ensure high availability, stability, and tier-3 support for enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms, industry leading identity providers, and protocols (SAML, OAuth, SCIMv2).

* Active Directory: Practical knowledge of Active Directory environments. Support, manage, and troubleshoot user, group, and core object management issues.
* Logging & Analytics: Utilize SIEM and logging platforms for real-time audit logging, incident investigation, and parsing rule creation.
* Enterprise Network Security & ZTNA

* Endpoint Agent Health: Monitor agent compliance, resolve edge-case user authentication issues (e.g., blank auth windows, proxy avoidance blocks), and tune alerts to reduce noise.
* Physical Security & Camera Infrastructure (Card & Camera)
* Knowledge of Windows Server: Experience in troubleshooting Windows Server related issues. Able to analyse the logs to identify the root cause (RCA).
* Camera Operations: Oversee technical operations, firmware upgrades, and security baselines for Video Management Systems and camera fleets globally (AMER, EMEA, APAC, INDIA).
* High Availability (HA) & Integrations: Design and execute High Availability (HA) architectures across data centers for management/recording servers. Integrate physical access control systems with central identity platforms and digital badging initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Technical Proficiencies**

* Identity & Access Management: Deep practical knowledge of industry standard identity providers, federation standards (SAML, OAuth, SCIMv2), and large-scale, multi-domain Active Directory environments.
* ZTNA & Network Security: Demonstrated proficiency with ZTNA architectures, Secure Web Gateways, VPNs, and firewall policy management.
* Physical Access & Video Management: Direct operational experience with Video Management Software, IP camera management tools, and Access Control Systems.
* Analytics & ITSM: Experience using SIEM, Log analytics, and ITSM/project tools.
* Scripting & Automation (Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) or workflow automation tools to help streamline repetitive operational tasks is a plus.

**Professional Competencies**

* Proactive Mindset: Highly self-motivated with a deterministic approach to solving complex engineering challenges with minimal supervision.
* Operational Excellence: Strong background in root-cause analysis (RCA), disaster recovery planning, high-availability architecture design, and operationalizing new enterprise services.
* Documentation & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to craft standard operating procedures, architectural blueprints, technical knowledge bases, and executive updates.

title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer — Compute & Storage Deployment
description:

Nava is a neocloud company purpose-built for the AI era. The Compute & Storage Deployment team commissions NVIDIA GPU servers and high-performance storage systems, transforming bare-metal hardware into configured, diagnosed, benchmarked and accepted compute capacity.

* Experience with server OEM tools, BMCs and hardware acceptance tests.

title: CAE Project Leader- Structural
description: Job Title: CAE Project Leader- Structural We are looking for a highly skilled CAE Engineer with strong expertise in structural simulations and virtual validation for automotive connector applications. The candidate will be responsible for driving and validating design features related to structural performance using advanced CAE methods and tools. The role requires deep understanding of nonlinear structural analysis, linear dynamics, material behavior, contact mechanics, and both implicit and explicit simulation methodologies. The ideal candidate should possess strong fundamentals in mechanics and CAE, with the ability to independently execute projects, support product development cycles, and lead virtual validation/TDP activities. Location: Bangalore, India What You Will Do In Your Role • Perform structural CAE simulations for automotive connector applications using industry-standard simulation tools. • Static Linear & nonlinear simulations • Linear dynamics simulations including: - Modal - - Harmonic Random-vibration • Conduct both implicit and explicit simulations for structural performance assessment. • Good knowledge of fatigue and durability simulations, including: - Stress-life (SN) approach - - Strain-life (EN) approach Vibration fatigue • Develop, correlate, and validate FE models against test data and engineering requirements. • Support product development teams with virtual validation activities throughout the design cycle. • Lead and support TDP (Technology Development/Product Development) activities related to structural simulations. • Identify design improvements and optimization opportunities through simulation-driven approaches. • Work closely with design, testing, and cross-functional teams to resolve structural performance issues. • Prepare technical reports, presentations, and simulation documentation for stakeholders. • Contribute to process automation, scripting, and simulation workflow improvements. • Explore and implement optimization techniques and AI/ML-based approaches in CAE workflows where applicable. • Some travel, as necessary; may be required. The Experience You Will Bring Requirements: • 8+ years’ experience to independently lead complex technical projects in context of above physics to deliver high fidelity correlation between simulation & test. • 8+ years’ experience in materials (Metals, Plastics, Elastomers). • 3+ years’ experience with material modeling to capture anisotropy in short fibers reinforced plastics. • 3+ years’ experience on developing CAE processes, statistical analysis & driving correlation between simulation & test. • Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering or Material Science What Will Put You Ahead • Doctorate Degree in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering or Material Science • Published patents or technical papers in areas mentioned above • AI/ML applications in engineering • 2+ years’ experience with tools like Digi-Mat/Converse • 2+ year’s experience with injection molding simulation tools (Moldflow/Moldex3D) • 5+ years’ experience with SIMULIA (ABAQUS, Isight) products • 5+ years’ experience with Altair (Hyperworks, Simlab) family products • 3+ years’ experience with Sealing simulations (Elastomers) • 3+ years’ experience with CAE engineering user support & training. • Proficient with analytical analysis packages (MATLAB, MATHEMATICA, etc.) • Familiar with parametric CAD systems (UG NX, Catia, Solidworks, etc.) • Proficient with basic Microsoft Office products (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) Relocation assistance may be available for the right candidate. Molex, Incorporated is an E-verified employer, and provides visa sponsorship to highly qualified employees. Molex, Incorporated is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

title: Senior Waste Management and Circular Economy Consultant
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Waste Management and Circular Economy Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
  
  
The role focuses on embedding circular economy principles and advancing sustainable waste management strategies across the full project lifecycle. It requires strong technical capability in waste characterisation, systems design, infrastructure planning, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability certification integration.
  
  
Your role
  
  

* Systems and infrastructure design: Design waste systems and infrastructure, including space planning, logistics modelling, operational workflows, collection systems, segregation areas, and processing facilities.
* Circular design integration: Embed material efficiency, design for disassembly, reuse potential, adaptability, lifecycle thinking, and waste minimisation into building and masterplan design.
* Spatial planning and coordination: Assess waste system requirements at building and city scales, ensuring coordination with architecture, Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP), infrastructure, environmental, and cost consultant teams.
* Frameworks and technical guidance: Lead the development of circular economy frameworks, guidance, and toolkits aligned with international best practice, including ISO 20887, ISO 59004/59010, BS 8001, and the Ellen MacArthur Foundation framework.
* Project requirements: Define clear design and technical requirements for circularity and embed them into project briefs, specifications, and delivery documentation.
* Waste audits and characterisation: Prepare and conduct remote waste audits and characterisation studies using industry-standard methodologies, including waste composition analysis, generation forecasting, and infrastructure capacity planning.
* Forecasting and analysis: Develop waste forecasting models to project waste volumes, composition, infrastructure requirements, operational needs, and lifecycle costs.
* Tools, templates, and supplier intelligence: Establish and maintain a Middle East supplier and technology database, and standardise method statements, templates, and technical specifications for consistent deployment across projects.
* Strategy and advisory: Lead the development of waste management and circular economy strategies for buildings, masterplans, and community-scale developments, translating circular economy principles into practical, implementable solutions.
* Integrated waste planning: Develop strategies covering waste minimisation, source segregation, recycling, recovery, and treatment options, aligned with Middle East regional regulations and global best practice.
* Client engagement and thought leadership: Engage with clients and stakeholders, translate technical concepts into clear recommendations, and provide insight on emerging waste and circular economy practices.
* Business development and team leadership: Support proposals, case studies, and client presentations, while providing task leadership, direction, and mentorship to junior team members.

**About You**
*Core Skills*

* 8+ years' proven experience in waste management and circular economy consulting across buildings, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community or masterplan projects.
* Strong understanding of waste collection systems, segregation infrastructure, treatment technologies, and logistics planning for urban developments.
* Familiarity with relevant standards, frameworks, and certifications, including Cradle to Cradle, and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR).
* Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality client service.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences.
* Strong project management capability, including the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives, stakeholders, and timelines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for improved circularity and operational performance.

*Desirable Experience*

* Experience with automated waste collection systems (AWCS) and smart waste management technologies.
* Experience planning and coordinating the sizing and siting of waste facilities, such as waste transfer stations, mini-Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs), and recycling stations within masterplan developments.
* Background in cost-benefit analysis (CBA) and financial modelling for waste infrastructure.

**Qualifications**

* Degree qualification in engineering or a related discipline; a master's degree or professional certification in circular economy, sustainable business, or a similar field is preferred.
* Chartered Institution of Waste Management (CIWM) membership, or equivalent professional body registration, is preferred.

Rewards & benefits
  
  
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
  
  
**This Includes**

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Principal BIM Technician - Land Development & Municipal Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking a Senior BIM Technician to join the Land Development and Municipal Engineering (LDME) team in Bengaluru. Reporting to the Principal BIM Technician, the role involves applying advanced AutoCAD and Civil 3D expertise across the full project lifecycle, from conceptual design to detailed construction documentation.
  
  
The position primarily focuses on delivering lot grading plans for commercial and industrial developments, including stormwater management and municipal service design drawings such as storm, sewer, water, and drainage utilities, along with associated roadway and parking layout designs.
  
  
Key responsibilities include grading design, preparation of high-quality engineering drawings, and development of pipe network models for sanitary, storm, and water systems. The role also ensures compliance with established CAD/BIM standards and quality requirements, producing accurate and efficient deliverables using Civil 3D under senior-level guidance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the preparation of water main and piping layout drawings, including plan and profile drawings, in compliance with established CAD and BIM standards.
* Develop and review drawings ranging from conceptual sketches to detailed construction documentation using Autodesk Civil 3D (pipe networks, profiles, alignments, assemblies, sub-assemblies, 3D feature lines, and grading groups), ensuring high quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Ensure all deliverables comply with client drafting standards, project specifications, and quality assurance requirements.
* Coordinate and execute BIM/CAD activities in collaboration with BIM/CAD Coordinators, engineers, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, supporting skill development and adherence to best practices.
* Manage and prioritize assigned tasks, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Adapt to diverse project standards, client requirements, and international codes, delivering drawings in accordance with specified guidelines.
* Support engineering teams in drafting and modeling for roads, parking lots, storm and sanitary sewer systems, water mains, grading, and 3D modeling deliverables.
* Perform QA/QC reviews of drawings and BIM models to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Continuously enhance technical expertise by staying updated with the latest industry practices, tools, and BIM standards.
* Demonstrate proficiency in Revit MEP; knowledge of HVAC and electrical modeling is considered an added advantage.

Key Competencies / Skills
  
  

* Strong ability to work both independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Proven capability to quickly learn, adapt, and develop required technical skillsets while contributing to high-quality drawing deliverables.
* Highly motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented professional with a strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to coordinate with engineers, technologists, and project stakeholders.
* Proficient in Autodesk Civil 3D and Revit, with expertise in 2D drafting, plan & profile drawings, layouts, key plans, and standard drawings.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.
* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in AutoCAD and Autodesk Civil 3D design and drafting.
* Strong team player with a demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality drawings, including thorough self-checking for accuracy and compliance with standards.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while meeting strict project deadlines.
