title: Test Architect – Automation Testing (100% Automation)
description:
Position Title: Test Architect – Automation Testing (100% Automation)

• Experience Required: 14+ Years

• Work Location & Schedule: Bengaluru (Hybrid — 3 Days/Week On-site)

• Employment Type: Full-Time

• Interview Process: Minimum 4 Technical Rounds (Includes mandatory 1x Face-to-Face round in Bengaluru)

Role Overview As a Test Architect for Automation Testing, you will drive 100% automated test strategy, framework design, and execution for high-performance network switching products and industrial networking hardware. Operating in a hybrid capacity from Bengaluru, you will leverage Python-based automation frameworks, traffic generators, and protocol analyzers to architect comprehensive performance, scale, soak, and robustness testing across embedded Linux environments. Key Responsibilities

• Automation Framework Architecture: Design, build, and scale 100% hands-on Pythonbased test automation frameworks for enterprise and industrial switching platforms.

• Protocol & Network Validation: Architect test suites to validate Ethernet, TCP/IP, and L2/L3 protocols including VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, Link Aggregation, DHCP, IGMP, QoS, ACLs, and Redundancy protocols (VRRP, MRP, HSR/PRP).

• Traffic & Stress Engineering: Utilize advanced traffic generators (IXIA, Spirent, TRex) to execute end-to-end performance, scale, soak, robustness, and stress testing.

• Embedded System Debugging: Perform deep packet-level analysis and debugging using Wireshark and Scapy inside embedded Linux environments.

• Industrial System Testing: Lead test strategies for rugged, high-reliability industrial switches and network appliances. Required Qualification

s • Experience: 14+ years of dedicated hands-on experience testing network switching products with complete focus on automated validation.

• Programming & Tools: Expertise in Python automation development, traffic generation tools (IXIA, Spirent, TRex), and packet inspection tools (Wireshark, Scapy).

• Networking Expertise: In-depth technical domain mastery across L2/L3 networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, QoS, ACLs, Link Aggregation, and Redundancy protocols.

• Embedded Systems: Proven ability to debug, trace, and troubleshoot network firmware issues within embedded Linux environments. Good-to-Have Skills

• Hands-on testing experience with industrial switches (Belden, Hirschmann, Siemens, Cisco IE, Moxa).

• Knowledge of Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), SCADA/IIoT networking, and Industrial Ethernet standards (IEC 61850, EN50155, PROFINET, ETB).

• Exposure to network cybersecurity testing standards (IEC 62443).

• Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or JNCIS.

description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Corporate Reliability Engineering is advancing an engineering-first model focused on reliability, automation, quality, security, and proactive operations.
**This hands-on I5 role will work directly with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and adjacent engineering and operations teams to design, build, test, deploy, and support secure AI, agentic automation, API, and reliability solutions across enterprise Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Network environments.**
The engineer will convert recurring operational issues into maintainable, auditable, and production-ready solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate diagnosis and resolution, strengthen service resilience, and deliver measurable operational outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver AI/ML applications, LLM-enabled solutions, RAG, agentic workflows, automation frameworks, APIs, integrations, and reusable engineering components.
* Build intelligent capabilities for incident triage, knowledge retrieval, service-health analysis, root-cause investigation, remediation recommendations, and approved automated execution.
* Automate workflows across Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database/EBS, and Network operations through scripting, orchestration, event-driven patterns, and secure API integrations.
* Integrate with approved enterprise ticketing, monitoring, CMDB, knowledge, database, collaboration, source-control, and deployment platforms
* Engineer for reliability through testing, exception handling, rollback, observability, telemetry, runbooks, support models, operational handoff, and measurable service outcomes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, architecture, operations, and product teams and communicate technical decisions, risks, controls, and outcomes clearly

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Professional Attributes**

* Work as an embedded engineering partner with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and Reliability Engineering teams to understand operational needs and deliver practical, supportable solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with subject matter experts, product owners, operations teams, and global stakeholders; actively listen, incorporate feedback, and align teams around shared outcomes.
* Demonstrate a team-first mindset by sharing knowledge, documenting solutions, mentoring peers, supporting collective problem-solving, and contributing to a respectful and inclusive engineering culture.
* Combine strong technical depth with professionalism, humility, adaptability, accountability, and sound judgment when leading discussions or responding to operational challenges.
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, design choices, and business impacts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Operate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and balance speed, reliability, security, governance, teamwork, and customer impact.

**Visa Governance, Security & Responsible AI Expectations**

* Follow Visa policies, Key Controls, Technical and Design Security Requirements, approved architecture standards, and the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Apply secure coding and participate in code review, security assessment, dependency and open-source review, vulnerability remediation, security testing, and required release approvals before production promotion.
* Protect Visa information according to its classification and approved handling requirements. Use approved platforms and data sources, enforce least-privilege access, protect credentials and secrets, and prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, retention, or transmission.
* Implement traceability through authenticated access, change records, version control, event logging, monitoring, evidence retention, documented ownership, and support procedures.
* Apply Visa AI governance requirements across the lifecycle, including defined ownership, risk assessment, data-use review, validation, ongoing monitoring, documented limitations, escalation paths, and controlled retirement or material change.
* Design human oversight and approval gates appropriate to risk. Automated actions must remain within approved permissions and guardrails, with safe failure handling, rollback, and manual intervention paths.
* Validate generative and agentic AI solutions for quality, reliability, security, privacy, information integrity, and operational risk; document evaluation methods, acceptance criteria, evidence, limitations, and monitoring.
* Escalate security incidents, privacy concerns, control gaps, model risks, unexpected AI behavior, and policy exceptions through approved Visa processes.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, automation engineering, AI/ML engineering, agentic systems, reliability engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Hands-on experience using Claude Code, GitHub, Copilot, Power automate
* Hands-on experience developing maintainable applications, scripts, APIs, integrations, automations, or workflow-based solutions in enterprise IT environments.
* Proficiency in Python and one or more of PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus experience with Git, testing, debugging, APIs, and CI/CD.
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agent frameworks, tools or function calling, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, technical judgment, ownership, adaptability, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience integrating with ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, monitoring platforms, or enterprise support data.
* Experience in reliability engineering, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, operational automation, release validation, or controlled deployment.
* Ability to define measurable outcomes such as reduced manual effort, higher automation success, faster analysis, fewer repeat issues, stronger traceability, and improved service reliability.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Embedded System - FPGA & SoC Performance Engineer
description:
**About CynLr**

Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).

Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.

CynLr-enabled visual robots
*intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly,*
eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
*modular LEGO-like micro-factories*
that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.

At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
*deeply inspired by neuroscience,*
modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action.

This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.

**About the Role:**

Product Design begins as a hypothetical concept. Transforming that concept into a functional Product is a highly creative and experimental process that requires a strong understanding of system-level fundamentals and application-driven trade-offs.

In FPGA-based embedded systems, the utility and limitations of a product are defined by how effectively the FPGA platform is configured, integrated, and used at the system and application level. Performance, latency, determinism, and I/O capability depend on IP selection, configuration, firmware integration, and system architecture.

You will be responsible for the application-level design, integration, validation, and deployment of FPGA-based embedded systems. The Product Design team will be your internal customer.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Supporting CynLr’s Product Design team with all FPGA application and system-level activities.
* FPGA platform configuration and integration using vendor-provided IP cores and reference designs.
* System bring-up, validation, and debugging of FPGA-based hardware platforms.
* Verification & Validation (V&V)
* Defining test procedures for FPGA-based systems and firmware
* Executing tests and validating manufactured PCBs and assemblies
* Interfacing with vendors (FPGA vendors, IP providers, PCB manufacturers, component suppliers, simulation and service providers) to plan and coordinate successful project execution.
* Acting as the FPGA application and system knowledge base for design engineers and freshers joining the organization.

**Team Structure & Career Path:**

This role resides in the Electronics team and is part of the larger hardware team. The role has touchpoints with other teams most notably the Product Design team. We are a startup and there is a tremendous potential to build your own team or grow into a principal engineer role over time in the space or expand into other areas.

**Job Requirements**

Below are some key requirements. We expect working knowledge in most areas and deep hands-on expertise in either FPGA or SoC

**A. Electronics & System Fundamentals:**

* Strong understanding of digital electronics and system-level architecture.
* Solid understanding of register-based systems and memory architectures (DDR, SRAM, Flash).
* Working knowledge of power distribution and sequencing for FPGA-based systems.
* Understanding of processor and accelerator architectures (ARM-based SoC FPGAs).

**B. FPGA Application & Platform Development:**

* Hands-on experience with FPGA or SoC-FPGA.
* Strong familiarity with FPGA vendor toolchains (Vivado, Quartus, Libero).
* Experience configuring and integrating:
* Vendor-provided IP cores
* Memory controllers
* Communication and data-movement IP Blocks
* Ability to generate FPGA bitstreams using existing IP and reference designs.

**C. Embedded Firmware Design & Development:**

* Strong experience in embedded firmware development using C/C++.
* Experience developing firmware for ARM cores inside FPGA SoCs
* Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems.
* Ability to develop and debug drivers for memory-mapped peripherals.
* Good understanding of boot flows, BSPs, and build systems.

**D. Interfaces & Communication:**

* Strong working knowledge of communication protocols:
* UART, SPI, I2C, AXI
* Ethernet, USB
* Experience debugging data flow, latency, and performance issues at the system level.

**E. Verification and Validation:**

* Adept in using JTAG-based debugging tools.
* Experience with system bring-up and validation of FPGA-based boards.
* Experience using:
* Logic analyzers
* Oscilloscopes
* Vendor-provided tools (Vivado, Quartus, Libero)
* Ability to create and execute test procedures and validation plans.
* Ability to debug data flow and performance bottlenecks at the system level.

**F. Behavioural Tendency:**

Critical Thinking, Available, Responsible, Versatile, Resourceful, Thorough, Attention to Details & “Humble”.

**What Will You Do:**

CynLr’ s vision system is central in the control loop of the vision guided manipulation platform. The stereo vision system is acquiring at 75 FPS and this means processing must also happen at this speed or higher and the processing method based on neural network is computationally intensive as it involves a high level of successive matrix multiplication. For this the processing is split between multiple processing units FPGA, GPU and CPU based on the type of processing that is required. Your focus will be majorly on the FPGA, working closely with the Product Design team to build and deploy FPGA-based embedded systems at the application and system level. This includes configuring FPGA platforms using vendor tools and IP, developing embedded firmware to control and interface with FPGA logic, bringing up and validating hardware, and debugging system-level issues involving interfaces, memory, and peripherals. You will define and execute verification and validation procedures, support prototypes and manufacturing builds, and ensure reliable system behaviour in real-world use. This role focuses on integration, firmware, and system validation

**How Will You Do:**

Though confined to a focused area, the work is pretty much expected to be entrepreneurial with the exact advantages and difficulties of a startup. Since this is a startup and the product will evolve at a rapid pace, the contours of the technology, toolchain & Process will have to constantly adapt to the changes. You will participate in actively contributing in building the process & tool chain too. You will have complete freedom here, but you will be subjected to reviews.

title: Strategy Intern
description:
**About Vedantu and this role**

Vedantu is one of India's leading K-12 learning companies, with offerings across grades 3 to 12, and is at the pre-IPO stage.The CEO's Office sets direction for the whole company. To do that well, it needs a sharp, current view of the market from the outside in: what competitors are building, how they are performing, where funding is flowing, and which new categories are opening up.

This role exists to build that muscle. You will own Vedantu's competitive intelligence, from first-principles research to presenting what it means for Vedantu to the leadership team.

**What you'll do**

* **Map the competitive landscape.**
  Identify the key competitors in each of Vedantu's categories, from grade 3 to grade 12.
* **Build and own a living competitor tracker.**
  For every category, keep current each competitor's topline (revenue), bottomline (profit or burn), core strategy, and latest developments.
* **Do secondary research.**
  Pull numbers and insights from company filings, annual reports, research databases, investor material and the news, and cross-check sources before trusting a figure.
* **Do primary research.**
  Find and cold-reach industry experts, former employees, founders, educators and investors; set up and run interviews; and turn each one into crisp notes.
* **Stay on top of the news.**
  Track ed-tech and Indian startup developments: product launches, regulatory changes, fundraises, M&A, and emerging categories and opportunities.
* **Present to leadership every two weeks.**
  Turn what you've found into a short readout on what changed and what it means for Vedantu.

**What you'll get**

* **A front-row seat in the CEO's Office**
  of a pre-IPO company. See how strategic decisions are actually made.
* **Leadership exposure from week one.**
  Present your work to the leadership team every two weeks.
* **Direct mentorship.**
  Work one-on-one with the Chief of Staff to the CEO.
* **Real ownership.**
  The tracker you build becomes an input to company strategy, not a side project.
* **A competitive stipend**
  of ₹30,000–40,000 per month, with the option to extend the internship based on performance.

**Who we're looking for**

We care more about what you've done than where you study. You're a final-year or pre-final-year undergraduate from any discipline.

**You must have:**

* **Proof of market research.**
  At least one internship, project or piece of work where you researched a market or company, such as a consulting or VC internship, a startup strategy project, an equity research report, or a published sector teardown.
* **Experience running interviews.**
  You have spoken to customers, users or experts and turned those conversations into insight.
* **Confidence with cold outreach.**
  You can get a stranger on a call through LinkedIn, email or your network.
* **Fluency with AI research tools.**
  You use them to research faster, and you know where to double-check what they say.
* **Comfort with numbers.**
  You can read a P&L, find a company's revenue and profit or burn from public filings, and spot when figures don't add up.
* **Sharp synthesis.**
  You can turn 20 data points into the 3 that matter and say clearly why.
* **Ownership and discretion.**
  You keep things current without being chased, and you handle confidential information responsibly.

**Good to have:**

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
* Interest in education or ed-tech
* Writing you've published (a blog, newsletter, or LinkedIn posts)

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Workplace Experience
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Workplace Experience supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Workplace Experience Product Owner, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Workplace Experience Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure compliant product portfolio within WREF
* Support the Workplace Experience Product owner in the deployment and support of Workplace Experience technologies
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace experience technologies such as AppSpace
* Experience onboarding new sites to Workplace technologies and ensuring compliance with design standards.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Management, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Research Intern
description:
**Company Description**

Most hotels in India don't fail on strategy. They fail on the fourth floor at 11pm — when the housekeeping attendant forgets the amenity list, when the F&B intern skips the temperature log, when the night desk closes out a checkout without the deposit note.

Focus Realm is the operating standards platform for Indian hospitality. SOPs, training, and compliance — running on the phones your team already carries, in the languages they actually speak.

**Why we exist**

Standards protect the guest, the brand, the star rating, the FSSAI license. And yet in most Indian hotels they live as PDFs on WhatsApp, day-one classroom sessions that fade inside a week, and a ring-binder audit file nobody wants to open. When 40–60% of the front line rotates in a year, whatever standards you had in January are unrecognisable by August.

We're not here to sell one more LMS. We're building the operating layer that keeps standards alive between audits — for the housekeeper on shift, the GM three properties away, and the corporate trainer trying to keep two hundred rooms in line.

**What Focus Realm does**

One system, three portals — each shaped to the person using it.

→ Employee — mobile-first, multilingual SOPs and training. The right procedure for the task in front of you, and a completion tap that goes on record.

→ Manager — property-level visibility. Where's the drift, who needs a refresher, what will the auditor find on Tuesday.

→ Author — corporate authoring. Write standards once, publish them across the group, version everything, and see who's actually running them.

**Role Description**

Focus Realm | Remote | Unpaid | 3 Months

**About the Role**

title: Product Design Lead, Platform Tools
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business — from HR and payroll to IT and finance — so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity, confidence, and action.
  
  
As Product Design Lead for Tasks & Notifications, you’ll ensure our customers are working on the right thing at the right time. You’ll reimagine how users understand what matters, prioritize their work, and take action. You’ll also shape the platform tools that product teams will use to bring the right information and work to users at the right moment. You’ll also define the principles, templates, and tiering models that maintain quality across approximately 2,500+ templates and 1MM+ daily sends, giving users fewer, more relevant messages instead of more noise.
  
  
You’ll also lead design for Sandbox, a safe testing environment that gives IT administrators a copy of their production instance. You’ll help customers confidently build and validate settings, permissions, integrations, and workflows without affecting live data or employees.
  
  
Success in this role requires a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys partnering closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, and can quickly develop deep expertise in new domains. Designers at Rippling are product builders. AI isn't just something we design, it’s fundamental to how we work from exploration and prototyping to shipping world-class customer experiences.
  
  
**About The Team**
Developer Platform builds the capabilities and experiences that help Rippling’s products work together as one coherent system. The team operates across product boundaries, solving foundational problems that affect how customers configure, understand, and interact with Rippling.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and drive the design vision for Inbox and Notifications, improving today’s experience while shaping how users discover, prioritize, and act on information across in-product, mobile, email, and other surfaces.
* Design systems that handle high volumes of tasks, alerts, approvals, and updates while accounting for prioritization, permissions, deadlines, and diverse user needs.
* Establish the principles, interaction patterns, quality standards, and governance that help teams create consistent notifications while moving quickly and addressing domain-specific needs.
* Lead end-to-end design for Sandbox, helping IT administrators safely configure, test, validate, and learn without introducing risk to their production environment.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows through research, data, customer conversations, and close partnership with customer-facing teams.
* Partner tightly with Product and Engineering to frame ambiguous problems, make high-velocity decisions, and ship with urgency while maintaining a high quality bar.
* Use AI throughout the design process from research synthesis and requirements development to prototyping and exploring intelligent product experiences.

**What You Will Need**

* 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept to launch and iterating based on what you learn.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking and the ability to turn messy, ambiguous problem spaces into simple, intuitive workflows.
* Experience designing complex SaaS, enterprise, platform, productivity, or workflow products across multiple personas, permissions, states, and dependencies.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect functionality into coherent end-to-end journeys, anticipate second-order effects, and balance platform consistency with individual product needs.
* Excellent interaction and visual design craft, including the ability to produce polished work across edge cases and communicate clear, build-ready specifications.
* Relentless customer focus, backed by a habit of studying real behavior, identifying meaningful pain points, and using evidence to guide design decisions.
* Active use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your design workflow whether for research, requirements, copy, or exploration.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async write-ups to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.

title: Research Associate & Study Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**

Masthishkam Foundation is an not-for-profit, independent, non-partisan organisation connecting brain science with health, education, technology, policy and public life. Rooted in India and connected globally, the Foundation brings together science, medicine and the humanities to understand how people think, learn, make decisions and live. Its work includes research, policy briefs, educational resources and practical programmes that strengthen human capability, wellbeing and dignity, with particular attention to the needs and realities of the Global South.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, with a
**consolidated salary of ₹70,000 per month**
.

The Research Associate will coordinate a study examining whether a structured approach inspired by clinical diagnostic reasoning can improve judgement in intelligence analysis. Working directly with Dr Pravin Thomas and research collaborators, the successful candidate will help take a detailed study plan through preparation, pilot testing, data collection and publication.

Responsibilities include developing and editing research cases from published investigation reports; coordinating case writers and independent fact-checkers; preparing ethics submissions and participant materials; and organising participating institutions, recruitment and experimental sessions. The role also involves coordinating the study platform, maintaining datasets and documentation, protecting study blinding and confidentiality, and supporting analysis and manuscript preparation.

Alongside the study, the Research Associate will contribute to Masthishkam Foundation’s wider activities, including research syntheses, policy briefs, proposals, partner communications and programme coordination.

**Qualifications**

* A postgraduate degree in cognitive science, psychology, behavioural science, neuroscience, public health or a related discipline.
* Practical experience conducting human-participant research, preferably behavioural experiments or studies of judgement and decision-making.
* Understanding of experimental design, participant recruitment, research ethics, informed consent and data management.
* Strong analytical skills and familiarity with statistical software such as R, Python or SPSS.
* Excellent written English, with the ability to interpret complex reports, verify sources and develop clear, accurate research materials.
* Ability to implement a study protocol carefully, maintain blinding and confidentiality, and document procedures and deviations.
* Strong organisational skills, including coordinating collaborators, managing timelines and following tasks through to completion.
* Experience with online experimental or survey platforms, ethics applications and academic publications would be an advantage.
* Interest in cognitive security, reasoning under uncertainty and translating research into practical resources.

**Application**

Please send your CV, one research or writing sample, your earliest joining date, and a short description of a study you helped conduct—specifying your own responsibilities—to the Masthishkam Foundation LinkedIn Page by direct message or to connect@indiabrainforum.org.

FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end to end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment.

The role combines the technical rigor of a software engineer with the urgency and ownership needed to deliver measurable business outcomes. FDEs also create reusable architectures, patterns and engineering practices that help the wider FDE practice scale.

Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security.
* Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale.
* Accelerate customer transformation: Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Build reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures for future engagements.
* Raise the bar: Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Feed reusable components and learnings back into products and services.

**Python**
: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems.

**RAG & retrieval**
: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e.g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector).

**Core AWS services**
: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM).

Production engineering: Taking AI systems to production: CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, evaluations and guardrails for AI output.

* LLM evaluation and tracing tools (e.g. Bedrock Guardrails, RAGAS, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry).
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, or other frameworks such as CrewAI or LlamaIndex.

description:

Good to Have

title: Lead Design Engineer - Rail Bridges
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Infrastructure is ageing globally, with a growing pipeline of renewals and bridge upgrade projects. This role sits at the heart of a new Bangalore-based team that will work in close partnership with UK colleagues to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions and help Arup become a market leader in rail renewals. This is an exciting opportunity for you to lead and shape a new rapidly growing team in Arup. You will lead the Railway Bridges and Civil Structures capability within the Arup Bangalore Rail team, acting as the UK-facing single point of contact for bridge renewals and ageing assets work. You will be responsible for technical excellence, quality, efficient project delivery and the development of a high-performing team that supports UK and local rail renewals programmes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the design, assessment, refurbishment and strengthening of railway bridges, culverts, retaining walls and associated civil structures across concept, feasibility, detailed design and construction support stages.
  
  

* Lead the design of bridges and civil structures through optioneering, feasibility, selection of options, preliminary design, outline design, detailed design, delivering construction information and supporting clients and contractors through the construction phase of a project.
* Lead structural assessments of ageing assets, including appraisal of condition information, identification of intervention needs and development of practical renewal or life-extension solutions.
* Oversee the preparation and review of calculations, technical reports, specifications, drawings and BIM-enabled deliverables to a consistently high standard.
* Provide technical leadership on UK rail standards and design governance, including the application of Eurocodes and relevant Network Rail requirements.
* Plan, resource and coordinate delivery across the Bangalore structures team, ensuring work is delivered safely, on programme, to budget and in accordance with project quality requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with UK project managers, discipline leads and bridge renewals teams, ensuring strong communication, effective integration and responsive delivery.
* Lead internal design reviews and checking activities, support robust technical assurance and drive continuous improvement in quality and efficiency.
* Mentor, coach and develop engineers and technicians, creating a strong technical culture and supporting long-term capability growth in Bangalore.
* Support business development through technical input to bids, methodologies, work winning conversations and delivery approaches that improve competitiveness in the renewals market.
* Promote digital delivery, repeatable design approaches and innovation that improve productivity and support blended UK-India delivery.

**If this role right for you?**

* Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering; a master’s degree is advantageous.
* Minimum of 12 years post-graduate experience in the design, assessment and renewal of bridges and civil structures, ideally within rail infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of structural behavior, assessment methodologies, strengthening techniques and the management of existing assets.
* Experience using structural analysis tools such as MIDAS, SOFiSTiK, GSA, Strand7, SAP2000 or similar.
* Working knowledge of Eurocodes and experience applying standards used by Network Rail and/or other comparable rail authorities.
* Good working knowledge of design development tools such as Bentley Microstation is essential.
* Proven track record of leading technical delivery, managing interfaces and mentoring others within multidisciplinary project environments.
* Experience of working with international consultants and, ideally, familiarity with UK rail design workflows namely GRIP governance, leading IDC, IDR workshops, standards and approval expectations.
* Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Chartered status, or equivalent progression toward professional recognition, is strongly preferred.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Monalisa Ginu -Monalisa.Ginu@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
  
  
**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
  
  
**Different people, shared values.**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process
  
  
We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

+ Design policy-based access control frameworks translating business requirements into network policies
+ Architect VN (Virtual Network) designs for multi-tenancy and organizational separation

* Be AmbITious: This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

**What We’re Looking For**

+ Minimum 7+ years of hands-on Cisco SDA design, implementation, and administration

+ Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying large-scale, multi-site SDA fabrics

title: Infrastructure Engineer AVP
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced AVP Infrastructure Engineer who can build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
You will provide L2/L3 support for infrastructure and application stack while driving automation, reliability (SRE), and release excellence across environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, build and support of secure, scalable and high-performing applications.
* Hands-on in infrastructure engineering activities, including IAC, automation, design governance and troubleshooting.
* Define and implement standards, patterns and development best practices.
* Drive adoption of modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security controls and release automation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owner, Solution Architect, Security, Platform and QA teams to deliver integrated digital solutions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, risk, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical leadership across various technologies like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, python, API, docker, containers, ECR, EKS and GitLab.
* Mentor and coach team on career development through feedback, technical assistance performance management and development planning.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and team growth initiatives.
* Champion DevSecOps practices, observability, reliability engineering and operational excellence across the mobile landscape.
* Promote knowledge sharing through code reviews, technical discussions, pairing sessions, and documentation.
* Balance technical excellence with delivery commitments and business outcomes.

**Software Engineering**

* Experience working within large-scale, complex, or long-lived mobile codebases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, maintainability, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong advocate of clean, testable, and maintainable code.
* Experience balancing technical quality, operational stability, performance, and delivery objectives.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Comfortable providing technical guidance, code reviews, and architectural direction.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Experience driving a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive leadership style.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to quality.

**Key Technical Skills And Experience**

* Programming language python or Java
* Technical Skills Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, docker, containers, GitLab, Snyk, Qualys, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and NPM
* AWS cloud computing EC2, ECR, EKS, S3, Cloud Formation, networks
* Database design and SQL
* Operating System knowledge – Windows, Linux and awareness on AIX
* System design and architecture.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, token exchange, policy systems, delegated administration, or identity data modelling
* Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment
* Experience building production services, distributed systems, or shared platform capabilities
* Experience designing and implementing APIs, RESTful services, integration contracts, and data or domain models
* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and identity management
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing
* Familiarity with MCP, agent skills, and other agent integration concepts
* Experience contributing to technical designs and proof of concept work
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes using ITIL-aligned processes and SLAs (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
* Plan and execute OS patching cycles; maintain compliance with security and audit requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Very good understanding and solid hands-on on cloud computing system preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding on containers and hands-on experience in EKS/Docker also ability to write and deploy Helm chart.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus) to improve release velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience in Blue-Green deployments and good understanding of various other deployment strategy.

**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Bridge Engineer - Rails
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Infrastructure is ageing globally, with a growing pipeline of renewals and bridge upgrade projects. This role sits at the heart of a new Bangalore-based team that will work in close partnership with UK colleagues to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions and help Arup become a market leader in rail renewals.You will deliver technical design and assessment work for railway bridges and civil structures, supporting a growing Bangalore team that works closely with UK colleagues on renewals and ageing assets projects. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong fundamentals in bridge engineering with an interest in the challenge of working on existing assets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake structural analysis and design for railway bridges and civil structures, including new interventions, modifications, strengthening and renewals.
* Experience designing bridges and civil structures through optioneering, feasibility, selection of options, preliminary design, outline design, detailed design, delivering construction information and supporting clients and contractors through the construction phase of a project.
* Carry out assessments of existing assets, interpret inspection information and support the development of practical remediation or renewal options.
* Prepare technical calculations, technical reports, specifications, sketches, drawings and digital deliverables in collaboration with engineers and technicians.
* Support coordination with other disciplines including track, stations, telecoms, power and wider rail systems teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Able to work under limited supervision and use initiative and independent judgement.
* Contribute to design reviews, checking processes and quality assurance activities to maintain high technical standards.
* Deliver allocated work packages to programme and budget, proactively managing interfaces, risks and information needs.
* Support site-related queries, construction-stage technical input and responses to design issues as they arise.
* Contribute ideas that improve efficiency, digital delivery and repeatability across bridge renewals and ageing assets work.

**If this role right for you?**

* Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering and progression toward membership of a relevant professional body such as ICE or IStructE.
* Minimum of 8 years post-graduate experience in the design, assessment or construction of bridges and civil structures.
* Good appreciation of structural behavior and confidence developing technical solutions for both new and existing assets.
* Experience with structural analysis software such as MIDAS, GSA, Strand7, SAP2000, LEAP or similar.
* Experience using Projectwise and Bentley Microstation software.
* Ability to produce clear technical reports and robust design calculations.
* Knowledge of Eurocodes and, ideally, familiarity with standards applied by Network Rail and/or other rail clients.
* Strong collaborative skills and experience working within multidisciplinary teams.
* A proactive approach to learning, quality and client service.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Monalisa Ginu -Monalisa.Ginu@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
  
  
**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
  
  
**Different people, shared values.**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process
  
  
We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

title: Study Abroad Consultant – Junior
description:
Company: Clini Launch Research Institute

Location: Bengaluru – Ozone Manay Technology Park, Near Kudlu Gate, HSR Layout, Bengaluru

Experience: 0–1 Year

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary: Hike on previous CTC, based on experience and skills

About Clini Launch Research Institute

Clini Launch Research Institute is committed to empowering students through quality education, career guidance, and professional development. We are looking for an enthusiastic and empathetic Study Abroad Consultant to guide students aspiring to pursue higher education abroad.

Role Overview

The Study Abroad Consultant will be the first point of contact for prospective students and their parents, helping them explore international education opportunities. The role involves student counselling, lead management, university and course selection, application support, and visa documentation assistance.

Freshers and candidates with relevant internships or experience in inside sales, pre-sales, EdTech, or visa processing are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Counselling and Pre-Sales

- Handle inbound enquiries and outbound calls from prospective students.

- Understand students’ academic backgrounds, career goals, and budgets to recommend suitable countries, courses, and universities.

- Explain admission procedures, application timelines, entrance exams, and visa requirements.

- Build strong relationships with students and parents through effective communication.

2. Lead and Pipeline Management

- Maintain accurate records of student interactions, follow-ups, and application status in the CRM.

- Follow up with prospective students through calls, emails, and WhatsApp.

- Convert enquiries into active applicants and achieve assigned targets.

3. Application and Documentation Support

- Assist students with Statements of Purpose (SOPs), Letters of Recommendation (LORs), and resumes.

- Review academic and financial documents for completeness.

- Coordinate with universities and internal teams regarding applications and admission updates.

4. Visa Guidance and Coordination

- Assist senior counsellors with student visa documentation and application preparation.

- Stay updated on university admission requirements, application deadlines, and relevant visa guidelines.

- Ensure timely follow-ups and proper documentation throughout the admission process.

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline.

- 0–1 year of experience in study abroad consulting, inside sales, pre-sales, customer support, or visa processing.

- Freshers with relevant internships and strong communication skills are encouraged to apply.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

- Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Basic knowledge of MS Office and CRM tools.

- Ability to work in a target-driven environment with attention to detail.

What We Offer

- Structured training and mentorship from experienced professionals.

- Career growth opportunities based on performance.

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

- A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes using the contact details below.

Contact Person: Shweta

Phone: 6364897536

Email: shweta.phadtare@clinilaunchresearch.in

Salary: Hike on previous CTC, depending on experience and skills.

Work Location: Ozone Manay Technology Park, Near Kudlu Gate, HSR Layout, Bengaluru.

Join Clini Launch Research Institute and help students take the next step toward their international education goals.
