Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack.
  
  
You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).
* Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
* Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
* Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint.

Container Orchestration
  
  

* Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments.
* Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades.

NVIDIA Platform Administration
  
  

* NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure.
* Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements.

Lab Operations and Smart Hands
  
  

* Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team.
* Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab.
* Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties.

Cross-Site Support and Coordination
  
  

* Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville.
* Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap.
* NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team.

**Required Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment.
* Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments.
* Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
* Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration.

Core Professional Skills
  
  

* Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment.
* Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap.
* Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams.
* Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring).
* InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment.
* GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Develop and maintain infrastructure automation and configuration-as-code solutions using PowerShell and Ansible Automation Platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather user requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Manage project timelines and deliverables to ensure successful implementation.
* Troubleshoot and optimize existing systems and processes.
* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using Ansible Automation Platform for Windows-based infrastructure.
* Create and manage Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, workflows, and job templates to support standardized and scalable operations.
* Integrate Ansible Automation Platform with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and other enterprise tools.
* Automate configuration management, patching, provisioning, compliance tasks, and operational workflows across large-scale Windows server environments.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to implement reliable and reusable automation patterns.
* Ensure automation solutions are properly documented, tested, and aligned with enterprise governance and security standards

**Who You Are**

* You bring proven hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) in enterprise environments, including the development and administration of playbooks, roles, inventories, workflows, job templates, credentials, and execution environments.
* You have strong proficiency in PowerShell and Azure DevOps/Git, with a solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles and experience automating Windows server environments using WinRM/SSH and reusable playbook design.
* You have experience integrating Ansible Automation Platform into enterprise DevOps toolchains and CI/CD pipelines, and you are familiar with automation governance, role-based access control, credential handling, and workflow orchestration in AAP.
* You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience in infrastructure automation and software engineering.
* You are familiar with cloud platforms such as Azure or similar, and have working knowledge of networking concepts, REST APIs, ServiceNow, Active Directory, and configuration management tools such as Terraform.
* You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams in a remote or hybrid working environment; experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies or Event-Driven Ansible is a plus.
* You have experience managing or supporting large-scale Windows server environments (10,000+ servers globally) and are comfortable working with reporting tools such as SQL, Grafana, or similar platforms.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: BUK TESCO Bank - Core Banking Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:
As a Service Engineer at Barclays TESCO Bank, where you will play a key role in the supporting applications end-to-end, enhancing capabilities, and delivery continuous improvement of core banking platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring the resilience, performance, and integrity of critical systems while contributing to strategic change and operational excellence within the technology function.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will need experience in:
  
  
  

* Application Support & Service Delivery Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.
* Driving End to End Automation

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.
  
  
  

* Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.
  
  
  

* Maintenance & Continuous Improvement Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.
* Change, Release & Environment Management Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.
* Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.
* Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.
* Risk, Compliance & Controls Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).
* Environment & Infrastructure Coordination Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
* Business Continuity & Resilience Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.
* Domain Banking & Financial Systems
* Technical Skills AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL
* Good-To-Have: Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You May Also Require The Following Skills And Experience**
Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)
  
  
Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  
  
Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.
  
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills
  
  
Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.
  
  
This role is based in our Bengaluru office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Platform Specialist
description:
**Summary**
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Apple Ads - Platform Specialist with a real passion for customer excellence to join our Search Ads team to help businesses with promotion and discovery across Apple Services. Operating as both a strategic account manager and a consultative seller across the pre- and post- sale lifecycle. Highly adaptable, self-directed, you are an autonomous problem solver who can independently troubleshoot complex campaign performance issues, architect bold growth strategies and constructively challenge clients to rethink their potential. Effectively partners with performance advertisers in the mobile and app developer ecosystem, you have very strong communication and interpersonal skills, you are highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, team-oriented, and can work independently to meet revenue and business objectives. You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in the mobile and app developer space with performance-type advertisers and agencies.
  
  
**Description**
Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space
  
  
Maintain a high level of outreach via email, phone and meetings to ensure a strong business pipeline
  
  
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients & prospects
  
  
Act as a thought leader with both clients and agencies
  
  
Work closely with your Manager & Platform Specialist team to ensure accurate execution and alignment with customer objectives
  
  
Use internal & external data sets to understand how to best help grow your customer's business
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors Degree in a related field or equivalent, MBA a plus
* Experience in performance media sales with at least 4 years experience using a self-serve type platform
* Managed India-based clients with domestic and export business in your previous roles
* Experienced in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.
* Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.
* Excellent communication and presentations skills - both in person and virtually

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Over 5 years in performance account management or sales, with a proven history of expanding existing client portfolios in search and mobile advertising.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the mobile app ecosystem, with specialized background and strong preference for experience within the mobile gaming landscape.
* Rigorous data fluency, with expert command of Excel/Numbers to dissect performance data and build compelling commercial narratives.
* Challenger mindset, skilled at guiding advertisers beyond their comfort zone using proactive, insight-led recommendations.
* Proven agency collaboration, comfortable navigating complex agency hierarchies and direct-advertiser relationships.
* Platform mastery, experienced in self-serve ad operations, campaign optimization, client training, and troubleshooting.
* India market expertise, well-versed in local digital dynamics as well as cross-border import/export business models.
* Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, capable of delivering high-impact business reviews and articulating complex concepts clearly to senior stakeholders.
* High operational rigor, with meticulous attention to detail, proactive prioritization, and the resilience to execute under tight timelines.
* Completion of the official Apple Ads Certification, with a strong foundational understanding of the Apple Ads product suite, campaign structures, and best practices, is strongly preferred

title: Content Manager (Social, influencer and in house content Production)
description:
Content Manager (Social, influencer and in house content Production)

Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Work from office

Employment Type: Full-time

Collaboration: Works closely with the Brand, Creative, Marketing, E-commerce, Influencer

and Monrow Studio teams.

About Monrow

We create stylish, comfortable footwear designed specifically for Indian feet. As we continue

to grow, content is becoming one of the biggest engines through which we build the

Monrow brand.

We are looking for a Content Manager who can take complete ownership of this engine.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will be involved in everything from finding the idea →

planning the shoot → getting the right people → shooting → editing → publishing → analyzing

performance → improving the next piece of content.

If you enjoy creating things rather than just managing people who create them, this role is

for you.

What You Will Own:

1. Social Media - End to End

● Own Monrow's social media content calendar and execution.

● Plan, create, shoot, edit and publish content across Instagram and other relevant

platforms.

● Develop a strong mix of Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories and other social-first

formats.

● Identify trends, formats, hooks, conversations and content opportunities relevant to

Monrow.

● Understand what makes content work on social media and continuously experiment

with new formats.

● Write captions, hooks, scripts and briefs wherever required.

● Monitor content performance and use data and learnings to improve future content.

● Ensure consistent quality, frequency and brand consistency across all social content.

2. Overall Brand Content

Own Monrow's broader content ecosystem beyond social media, including:

● Brand and campaign content

● SEO / GSO content

● Website content

● Influencer and creator content

● Product and launch content

● Fashion and lifestyle content

● Content for marketing campaigns and other brand initiatives

You will be expected to think beyond individual posts and understand how different content

pieces work together to build the Monrow brand.

You should also be able to identify opportunities where one shoot or content idea can be

repurposed across multiple channels and content formats.

3. Monrow Studio - End-to-End Ownership

Monrow Studio is our in-house content studio, and you will be responsible for making it

a high-output content engine for the brand.

You will own the entire studio content cycle, including:

● Planning the studio's content calendar and shooting schedule.

● Identifying what content needs to be produced based on launches, campaigns, social

requirements and brand priorities.

● Scouting and coordinating with models, creators and influencers for shoots.

● Developing shoot concepts, references, shot lists, scripts and content requirements.

● Coordinating with photographers, videographers, stylists, creators and internal teams.

● Being present on shoot days and ensuring that the shoot runs smoothly.

● Ensuring that all required shots and content assets are captured.

● Managing the post-production and editing pipeline.

● Organizing and maintaining the content produced from the studio.

● Ensuring content is delivered on time and is actually deployed across the relevant

channels.

● Continuously improving the studio's output, processes and quality.

You should be comfortable being the person responsible for making things happen on shoot

day, rather than simply handing over a brief and waiting for the output.

4. Content Production

This is a hands-on content role.

You should be comfortable:

● Shooting videos and photographs using a smartphone.

● Creating social-first videos independently.

● Understanding framing, composition, lighting, camera movement and visual

storytelling.

● Editing short-form videos for social media.

● Using tools such as CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro, Canva or equivalent.

● Creating content that feels native to social media rather than simply looking like an

advertisement.

● Directing people on camera and getting the required performance/content from

them.

● Being comfortable appearing on camera yourself when required for content creation.

You don't necessarily need to be a professional photographer or videographer. But you must

have a strong understanding of how good social content is shot and produced.

5. Influencer & Creator Content

● Identify creators and influencers who are relevant to Monrow's target audience.

● Support creator scouting, outreach and coordination.

● Develop content briefs and ensure creators understand the objective and brand

direction.

● Coordinate content production and timelines.

● Review creator content before it goes live.

● Build learnings around what creator formats, personalities and content styles work for

Monrow.

● Maintain a consistent pipeline of creator-led content.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills

● Excellent command of English - written and spoken.

● Strong understanding of social media and what makes content work (at least 1-2 year of experience)

● Ability to independently plan and produce 30–50+ pieces of content every month

across social media, Monrow Studio, influencer content and other content engines.

● Strong visual and creative instinct.

● Good knowledge of shooting and editing videos and photographs on a smartphone.

● Ability to write strong hooks, captions, scripts and content briefs.

● Strong understanding of short-form video and social-first storytelling.

● Comfortable working with models, creators, influencers and other talent.

● Strong project management and coordination skills.

● Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

● Basic understanding of content analytics and the ability to turn performance data

into actionable learnings.

● Strong understanding of fashion, lifestyle, social media and digital culture.

The Most Important Skill: Ownership

We are looking for someone with a Brand Owner mentality.

You should be someone who:

● Doesn't wait to be told what to do.

● Spots content opportunities proactively.

● Takes an idea from thought to execution.

● Figures things out when resources are limited.

● Takes responsibility for the final output, not just their part of the process.

● Cares about whether the content actually works, not just whether it was posted.

● Can look at something and say, "This isn't good enough. Let's make it better."

● Understands that working in a growing brand means sometimes doing things

outside a conventional job description.

Candidate Preference:

Monrow is a women's footwear brand, and this role involves hands-on fashion and lifestyle

content creation, including working with and directing on-camera talent and, where

relevant, appearing in content us.

Being closely connected to the consumer, product and visual world we are creating is

therefore valuable for this role.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a consistent, high-quality and high-output content

engine for Monrow.At the end of every month, we should be able to see:

More content → Better content → Stronger brand presence → Better learnings → Better content

again.

You will ultimately become one of the key owners of how Monrow looks, sounds and shows

up on the internet.

This role is NOT for someone who:

● Only wants to make content calendars.

● Wants to outsource all production.

● Is uncomfortable getting hands-on with shooting and editing.

● Needs detailed instructions for every task.

● Looks at content purely as a checklist of posts.

● Isn't comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

This role is for someone who:

Sees something → Gets an idea → Makes it happen.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Email your resume and answers to the mandatory screening questions to: talent@monrow.in

1 - How do you balance brand voice with creativity when creating content for different

platforms?

2 - What’s your process for generating fresh content ideas that align with business goals?

3 - Suppose we have to make 100 pieces of content per month starting December. What will be your strategy to ensure that we are able to deliver that, while maintaining quality and consistency. Detailed answers would be appreciated.

description:
**About BabyBillion**

BabyBillion is a children’s learning app offering engaging videos and age-appropriate content for kids aged 2–8. We help parents make screen time more meaningful through a safe, ad-free experience that children enjoy and parents can trust.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an

* Understanding of Facebook and Instagram video advertising, including hooks, CTAs, consumer psychology and conversion-focused storytelling.
* Ability to provide clear creative direction and actionable feedback to video editors.
* Familiarity with performance metrics such as CTR, conversion rate and CAC, and the ability to use insights to improve creatives.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with consumer apps, subscription products, EdTech, parenting or children’s brands.
* Familiarity with AI video creation tools and their creative possibilities and limitations.
* Demonstrated success in improving customer acquisition through performance-driven ad creatives.

**What Success Looks Like**

A consistent pipeline of compelling, high-quality Meta ad creatives that convert parents into paying customers while helping BabyBillion acquire customers more efficiently.

**Interested?**
Apply with your resume and portfolio of relevant ad scripts or video creatives.

title: E-commerce Specialist
description:
E-Commerce Specialist – D2C & Online Channels

Company: Flavours of Calicut | DGZ Holdings

Location: bangalore

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: FMCG / Food & Beverages

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

About the Role

We are looking for an E-Commerce Specialist – D2C & Online Channels to take ownership of our digital commerce presence and help drive the next phase of online growth.

The role will primarily focus on strengthening and growing our D2C business through Shopify, while also managing and expanding our presence across e-commerce marketplaces, quick-commerce platforms and other relevant online sales channels.

This is not just a listing or catalogue-management role. We are looking for someone who understands how products get discovered, convert and grow online and can proactively identify opportunities to improve sales and performance.

Key Responsibilities

\* Own and continuously improve our Shopify D2C website, including products, collections, merchandising, offers, bundles and overall customer journey.

\* Identify opportunities to grow D2C traffic, conversion, average order value, repeat purchases and organic sales.

\* Manage, optimise and expand product presence across relevant e-commerce and marketplace channels.

\* Activate or reactivate listings and identify new online channel opportunities for the brands.

\* Manage product catalogues, titles, descriptions, keywords, images, pricing, offers and other product-page elements.

\* Improve product discoverability, search visibility and conversion across online channels.

\* Support and coordinate product listings, availability, promotions and brand presence across quick-commerce platforms.

\* Monitor sales, inventory, pricing, ratings, reviews, returns and overall channel performance.

\* Coordinate with external agencies and platform partners, review their recommendations and ensure opportunities are being properly utilised.

\* Work closely with marketing, design, sales, warehouse and operations teams for campaigns, launches and fulfilment.

\* Track key e-commerce and D2C metrics and provide clear weekly/monthly insights and recommendations.

\* Monitor competitors, category trends and emerging online opportunities and proactively recommend actions.

What We’re Looking For

\* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce, D2C, marketplaces or digital commerce.

\* Strong practical experience with Shopify and marketplace seller platforms.

\* Good understanding of catalogue optimisation, marketplace SEO, product content and conversion.

\* Understanding of e-commerce advertising and performance metrics; hands-on experience is an advantage.

\* Experience or familiarity with quick commerce will be an advantage.

\* Strong working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and ability to analyse sales and performance data.

\* Experience in FMCG, food, consumer brands or other high-SKU businesses is preferred.

\* Strong ownership, attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

\* A commercial mindset — someone who goes beyond managing tasks and actively looks for ways to grow online sales and improve performance.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a stronger D2C business, improving the quality and performance of our online presence, activating new opportunities across e-commerce and quick commerce, and giving the business clear visibility into what is working and what we should do next to grow.

Why Join Us?

Flavours of Calicut is part of DGZ Holdings, a growing food business building consumer brands across India and international markets.

Our e-commerce function is moving from founder-led execution towards a dedicated internal capability. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership, build the function and directly contribute to the next phase of our online growth.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with our People & Culture team.

title: Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration
description:
Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services) is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.
  
  
The Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration will be responsible for providing advanced technical support and leading enterprise server infrastructure operations in a large global client environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Linux, Windows Server, or IBM AIX administration, along with expertise in server migrations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, high availability, clustering, automation, and disaster recovery. The candidate will act as an L3 escalation point, lead complex incident resolution, drive root-cause analysis, and mentor junior administrators.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as the L3 escalation point and technical lead for Linux, Windows or AIX server environments.
* Lead server migrations, OS upgrades and data centre or cloud transitions, including assessment, planning, execution and validation.
* Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions, such as Pacemaker, Windows Failover Clustering or PowerHA.
* Own major incidents end to end, lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
* Define and enforce standards for patching, hardening, monitoring and backup across the estate.
* Build automation frameworks with Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell or Python to reduce manual effort.
* Review and approve technical changes, and represent the team in change advisory meetings.
* Mentor L1/L2 administrators and review their work.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders on incidents, risks and service improvement plans.
* Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

**Skills Required**

* 6+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL), Windows Server or IBM AIX in large production environments.
* Proven experience leading OS migrations, upgrades or virtualization and cloud transitions.
* Strong expertise in VMware vSphere and/or Azure or AWS infrastructure.
* Expertise in high availability, clustering and disaster recovery.
* Advanced scripting and automation using Ansible plus Shell, PowerShell or Python.
* Strong knowledge of storage (SAN/NAS, LVM), networking fundamentals, DNS, Active Directory or LDAP, and security hardening.
* Strong ITIL practices and experience owning major incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills for client-facing work.

**Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, with at least 6 years of relevant system administration experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, AWS SysOps Administrator, and ITIL Foundation.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Willingness to support rotational shifts, on-call escalation and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.

**Good to have**

* Terraform and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
* Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift administration.
* Middleware administration (WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss).
* IBM Power Systems: PowerVM, VIOS, NIM and LPAR management.
* Workload automation tools such as Control-M.

**Benefits At Anovia**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance policy
* Employee Wellness Program with focus on mental health
* Robust reward and recognition programs
* Company incentive programs offered.
* Attractive leave policy: Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off
* Ample growth and learning opportunities.
* Remote work opportunities
* Focus on work/life balance.
* Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Forensic Auditor
description:
**The opportunity**
Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world’s energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future – for today’s generations and those to come.
  
  
At Hitachi Energy, whether you are a pioneer confronting the market, an engineer driving technological innovation, or an enabler enhancing organizational effectiveness – this is where your unique value converges. Your professional expertise will transcend conventional boundaries, making extraordinary contributions to our collective evolution.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* You will work under OSI’s case ownership and direction while applying independent, objective and professionally qualified investigative expertise.
* You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of investigating integrity concerns and/or support OSI in any step in their investigations. This includes the intake process, data collection & analysis, interview and reporting phase.
* You will act as the subject matter expert for finance and forensic accounting. Reconstruct transactions, follow funds, quantify potential loss or exposure, identify control circumvention, and assess indicators of fraud, bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other integrity concerns (‘License to Operate’ concerns).
* You will use data analytics and technology with your knowledge of and experience. Key systems include SAP S/4HANA and related platforms such as Ariba, Concur and other business systems. Use Power BI, Tableau or comparable tools, and use E-Discovery tools (Reveal, Relativity).
* You will coordinate and communicate with stakeholders such as Finance, Legal, HR, Compliance, IT, Security and external experts as appropriate.
* You will support OSI in identifying gaps in the control environment and proposing corrective actions. Analyze individual and aggregated cases to identify recurring schemes, root causes, control weaknesses and opportunities to strengthen policies, procedures and preventive controls.
* You will perform self-service analytics and targeted detection activities based on prior cases, including analyses of expenses, procurement, third parties and other risk areas when investigation demand permits. Develop reusable tests, indicators, and investigative methods that improve early detection and investigation efficiency.
* You will support Internal Audit assignments as agreed when no OSI investigations are ongoing, while remaining fully available for reassignment to investigations at short notice.
* You will maintain high-quality investigation files, contribute to consistent methodologies and templates, share lessons learned, coach colleagues, and continuously develop expertise in investigations, forensic accounting, analytics and relevant legal and professional requirements.
* You will provide timely updates to the Forensic Audit Manager, OSI investigator and other authorized stakeholders. Communicate significant developments, evidence gaps, delays and constraints, and promptly escalate urgent legal, regulatory, financial, safety or reputational matters through the agreed channels.
* You will follow solid-line reporting to the Head of Internal Audit and functional reporting to the Head of OSI.
* You will implement joint governance between Internal Audit and OSI for target setting, performance management, case allocation, availability and capacity management, and competence and career development.
* You will recognize that OSI owns and leads investigations; the forensic audit team performs investigative work under the agreed mandate and case governance.
* You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* You combine sound investigative judgment, strong finance knowledge and analytical curiosity with the ability to communicate sensitive matters clearly and professionally.
* Master's degree, preferably in economics, finance, accounting, business administration, or equivalent discipline.
* Three to five years of demonstrated experience in audit, finance, forensic accounting, data analytics, compliance or investigations, including hands-on support of investigations or forensic reviews.
* Strong knowledge of/ and experience related to investigation policies, methodologies and professional practices, including planning, evidence handling, interviewing, documentation, reporting, confidentiality and case closure.
* Professional certification preferred, such as CFE, CFCS, CCEP, CAMS, CISA or CIA.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, sensitive stakeholders, and demanding due dates.

In a world where you can be anything,
**Be Infoblox**
.
  
  
**Senior Enterprise AI Analyst**
We have an opportunity for a Senior Enterprise AI Analyst to join our IT Cloud Applications team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager of Enterprise AI Practice. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. You will build AI solutions hands-on, translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions, and act as a mentor and lead for the Enterprise AI team. You will help drive prototypes through to production-ready capabilities, manage delivery dependencies, guide best practices, and partner with stakeholders to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable business value. **Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions, agents, automation workflows, and intelligent applications, from discovery and prototyping through production implementation

* Produce high-quality deliverables that move work forward, including working prototypes, technical documentation, dependency plans, process flows, executive-ready presentations, adoption reports, and shared standards

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 8+ years of experience in a hands-on delivery role such as solutions analyst, software engineer, technical lead, ideally in technology, SaaS, Enterprise applications, or consulting environments

* Genuine fluency in LLMs, prompt design, AI agents, agentic workflows, enterprise AI adoption patterns, and responsible AI practices
* Strong Python development experience with the ability to build backend applications, integrations, automation scripts, and AI-enabled services
* Experience designing and integrating RESTful and GraphQL APIs, including asynchronous request handling, performance optimization, error handling, and secure integration patterns
* Solid understanding of backend systems, distributed architectures, microservices, event-driven design, domain-driven design, and cloud-native application principles
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and DevOps practices, including API Gateway, Lambda, S3, ECS, RDS, GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment governance
* Ability to mentor team members, review solution designs, improve delivery practices, manage dependencies, and raise overall execution quality across the Enterprise AI team
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, technical teams, and business users effectively
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

**Be Successful — Your Path**
**First 90 Days:**
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.
  
  
**Six Months:**
Develop and deploy several feature-rich web applications with Python/JavaScript and build applications using AI as a service. Collaborate closely with the team to optimize application performance, ensuring fast load times and smooth user interactions across various devices and browsers.
  
  
**One Year:**
Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our Backend-end development practices, sharing your expertise and insights to elevate the skill set of the team and foster a culture of learning and growth. Own custom a AI application and keep enhancing it to get a feasible product for users.
  
  
**Belong —**
Your Community
  
  
Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops

Ready to

title: Graduate Apprentice Trainee - Supply Chain
description:

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**About The NATS Program**
This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.
  
  
**What do we do?**
Service operations & Technology (SO&T), part of Volvo Group TTI, serves all brands and business areas by managing and optimizing service parts availability and distribution to secure customer uptime. Through our operations, we provide world class service focusing on delivery precision, quality, continuous improvement, cost efficiency and synergies delivering value all the way to our customers. We embrace innovation and new technologies and work with environmental care and sustainability at heart. Our footprint consists of 50 distribution centers worldwide, and we strive for an innovative and diverse workplace, exercising the Volvo Group values with high focus on Customer Success. Every second, one order line is shipped across the globe to serve Volvo Group’s products.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
The Graduate Apprentice – Material Controller role within TTI SO&T DC Bangalore is designed for fresh graduates/newcomers who are keen to build a strong foundation in end-to-end logistics and supply chain operations within the Service Market Supply Chain.
  
  
This role focuses on learning and supporting Planning, Procurement, and Scheduling of Aftermarket Parts for both Group and Non-Group suppliers. The apprentice will gain hands-on exposure to Materials Management, Supplier Coordination, inventory control, and cross-functional collaboration, while contributing to timely parts availability and service excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Actively contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including:

+ Automation of manual material controller processes
+ Standardization of reports and dashboards
+ Use of Power Apps / low-code tools where applicable

* Support the Material Control team in day-to-day activities related to procurement, receipt, storage, and distribution of materials.
* Assist in material planning and replenishment activities to ensure parts availability in line with demand.
* Coordinate with suppliers to follow up on order status, lead times, and delivery schedules under guidance.
* Participate in maintaining accurate material and inventory records in systems and trackers.
* Support material tracking, reporting, and data analysis using digital tools.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Procurement, Logistics, and Warehouse operations to understand end-to-end material flow.
* Learn and follow standard operating procedures, compliance requirements, and safety guidelines.
* Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives and learn Lean / VPS basics.
* Demonstrate a strong learning attitude and gradually take ownership of assigned tasks.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Basic understanding or academic exposure to supply chain or logistics concepts is desirable.

**Skills & Competencies Required**

* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Python, SQL, Power BI etc...
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a dynamic environment.
* Positive attitude, teamwork, and openness to feedback.
* Basic problem-solving skills with guidance

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.
* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.
* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.
* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.
* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.
* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.
* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.
* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.
* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.
* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).
* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.
* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.
* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.
* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.
* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.
* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.
* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.
* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.
* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.
* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.
* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.
* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.
* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.
* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).
* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.
* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).
* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.
* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.
* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.
* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.
* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications And Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
**Company Description**
BigEndian Semiconductors is a fabless semiconductor startup developing secure, high-performance System-on-Chips (SoCs) in India for global markets. The company builds silicon platforms that power next-generation surveillance, telecom, IoT, and enterprise systems, guided by a “security by design” philosophy that tightly integrates hardware and software. With deep expertise in VLSI, system architecture, and embedded software, BigEndian focuses on trusted solutions for both national security and commercial applications. Headquartered in Bengaluru and supported by strategic partnerships in Taiwan and India, the company is backed by leaders with decades of experience at Intel, ARM, Broadcom, and Zenoti, along with government programs and deep-tech investors. BigEndian is committed to helping India become a global hub for semiconductor design, innovation, and manufacturing, starting with fabless and progressing toward full-scale fabrication capabilities.

The Senior System Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the company’s IT and infrastructure systems. This role includes installing, configuring, and monitoring servers, networks, and related hardware and software to ensure high availability, performance, and security. The Senior System Administrator will manage user accounts, access controls, and backup and recovery processes, while proactively identifying and resolving system issues. Daily responsibilities also involve collaborating with engineering and operations teams, implementing security best practices, supporting development environments, and coordinating with vendors and partners for infrastructure-related needs. The individual in this role will document procedures, contribute to process improvements, and help scale systems as the company grows.

* Solid foundation in Information Technology, covering operating systems (Linux/Unix and Windows), virtualization, and cloud or hybrid environments.
* Solid experience in managing the On Prim/local and cloud server
* Experience implementing security controls, patch management, and compliance-related configurations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to script or automate routine tasks using tools such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

description:

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**
Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.
  
  
We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.
  
  
Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ's Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.
  
  
**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**
**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ's systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**
At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.
  
  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.
  
  
We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.
  
  
Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:
  
  
**Work That Matters**
You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.
  
  
**Career Growth That Matters**
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.
  
  
**Flexibility to Thrive**
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.

From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

**Perks you'll appreciate:**

title: IT Administrator (2-3 years exp, IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Job Title : IT Administrator**

  -
*IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security | Bengaluru (On-site)*

 

**Company Description**

 

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kaël” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

 

**Role Description**

 

We are looking for a Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint, and security backbone as Inkers scales. This role goes beyond frontline support — you will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end-to-end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and bring structure to IT security and compliance practices. You will also mentor and support junior IT staff and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues.

 

The candidate should be willing to travel to project sites and work in the field whenever required, including supporting 3D scanning equipment and on-site IT requirements.

 

**This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.**

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Own Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive — including licensing, mail flow, retention policies, and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Lead identity and access management across Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user provisioning/deprovisioning, security groups, MFA, and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro, or equivalent) across Windows, macOS, and iOS — device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment.
* Provide IT support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, and system-related issues, and set up/configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, and other equipment.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers, and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration, and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licenses, and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups, and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control systems, and other office/site IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software, AMC, and other IT services.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding, including system setup and access management.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for the IT function.
* Travel to project sites when required for 3D scanning, scanning equipment setup, and on-site IT support.

**Qualifications**

 

* 2-3 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support, or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, plus computer hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple IT requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.
