title: Specialist - SAP Basis
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
Join Novonesis as an SAP Basis Specialist and help ensure the reliability of the SAP platforms that support our ability to produce and distribute our products. You will become part of an experienced five-person SAP Basis team responsible for two legacy SAP platforms as well as the SAP infrastructure and Basis workstream for our SAP S/4HANA project.
  
  
The role & your impact
  
  
In this role, your primary focus will be operational reliability across our SAP landscape. Alongside day-to-day execution, you will help optimize how we operate through automation, improved monitoring, standardization and lifecycle management. You will also contribute to our SAP S/4HANA project and help establish the future operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Your key responsibilities in this role
  
  
Ensure SAP system availability, stability and performance by administering SAP RISE Private Cloud environments, monitoring system health, managing capacity and resolving incidents and technical problems.
  
  
Manage the technical lifecycle of SAP systems, including configuration, kernel updates, support packages, SAP Notes, upgrades, system copies, refreshes, migrations and technical conversions across environments.
  
  
Coordinate SAP RISE services and operational dependencies, acting as a technical interface between Novonesis, SAP, internal IT teams, application owners and external partners.
  
  
Maintain SAP security, compliance and controlled change management through secure technical configurations, user and certificate administration, vulnerability remediation, documented changes and reliable transport and release processes.
  
  
Drive automation and continuous improvement by enhancing monitoring, alerting, housekeeping, operational reporting, standardization and repeatable cloud-based SAP operating processes.
  
  
What you'll need to be successful in this role
  
  
Solid hands-on experience with SAP Basis and SAP HANA.
  
  
Understanding of SAP RISE with SAP Private Cloud Edition, including the division of responsibilities between SAP and the customer.
  
  
Experience managing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities and operational dependencies in collaboration with SAP.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify root causes and resolve complex SAP Basis, HANA, performance, connectivity and cloud-related issues.
  
  
A structured approach to operational reliability, with the ability to prioritize, take ownership and collaborate effectively with internal teams, business stakeholders and external partners.
  
  
**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
An interest in continuously improving monitoring, documentation, standardization and operational processes.
  
  
A drive to identify repetitive activities that can be automated and establish reliable, repeatable ways of working.
  
  
Interest in cloud-based operating practices, scripting, automation and improved tooling.
  
  
What we offer you
  
  
An opportunity to join an experienced SAP Basis team responsible for business-critical SAP platforms and contribute directly to the SAP S/4HANA project. You will work across SAP, internal IT teams, functional teams, developers, integration specialists, application owners and business stakeholders while helping shape our future SAP operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Working conditions

26 October 2026.

title: Associate Product Sustenance engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**Eurofins Scientific**
is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
  
  
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
  
  
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
  
  
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
  
  
**Eurofins Forensic Services**
, operating in UK, Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium, sits at the core of European criminal justice systems, acting as the trusted scientific partner to police forces and courts, and providing critical evidence that enables fair and accurate outcomes in serious criminal investigations.
  
  
For software engineers, this is a rare opportunity to build systems where code directly impacts real-world justices supporting DNA analysis, Forensic Case Management, and forensic workflows that can identify suspects and strengthen legal decision-making.
  
  
The UK forensic ecosystem remains one of the most advanced globally, combining cutting-edge science, strict regulatory standards, and continuous innovation; advances in data science, AI, and trace analysis are actively transforming how evidence is detected, interpreted, and used in investigations.
  
  
As part of the acquisition of Qualitype, Eurofins’ internal model already emphasises the integration of
**software development, quality engineering, and forensic domain expertise**
, giving engineers direct exposure to highly specialized scientific applications rarely found in traditional tech roles.
  
  
A compelling real-world example is the re‑analysis of cold cases using modern DNA techniques—some decades old—which have led to successful convictions years later, demonstrating how advances in forensic technology can fundamentally change investigative outcomes and deliver long-overdue justice.
  
  
In short, a role at Eurofins Forensics offers a unique combination of
**technical challenge, societal impact, and domain depth**
—where engineers are not just building software but enabling a system that underpins public safety and the pursuit of truth.
  
  
Eurofins Forensic Services is a leading provider of forensic science to police forces and the criminal justice system across the UK and Europe. Our work plays a critical role in delivering justice, supporting investigations, and protecting communities. Through advanced laboratory techniques and innovative digital solutions, we analyse complex evidence that helps solve serious crime and safeguard the public.
  
  
Eurofins Forensic Services combines cutting-edge technology with forensic science to support law enforcement agencies across the UK and Europe. Our systems and platforms underpin the analysis of complex forensic evidence at scale, enabling faster, data-driven investigations. Joining Eurofins means contributing to technology that has a direct, real-world impact on criminal justice and public safety.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

title: Microsoft Fabric Platform Engineer

title: Sr. System Integration Engineer
description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.
  
  
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.
  
  
Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.
  
  
At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Integration Engineering team develops and validates the software solutions that power next-generation AI infrastructure. We work at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, AI platforms, and enterprise software to help customers deploy, operate, and scale AI environments with confidence.
  
  
As a Sr. Systems Integration Engineer, you'll work across Penguin's AI Factory Platform and a broad ecosystem of technologies including Linux, Kubernetes, HPC, networking, storage, GPUs, AI frameworks, and cloud-native infrastructure to build, validate, and operationalize integrated solutions.
  
  
The team works collaboratively with Product Management, Software and Hardware Engineering, Solution Architects, and technology partners to evaluate new technologies, develop automation, solve complex integration challenges, and transform innovative ideas into production-ready capabilities.
  
  
Whether you're an experienced engineer or an early-career technologist with a strong systems background and a passion for learning, this role offers an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced AI infrastructure environments in the industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Build and Validate AI Infrastructure Solutions**

* Develop, integrate, and validate software solutions that enable enterprise AI infrastructure.
* Evaluate interoperability across Penguin software and partner technologies.
* Design and execute proof-of-concepts and technical evaluations.
* Help define best practices for deploying and operating AI infrastructure at scale.

**Automate Everything**

* Build automation using tools such as Ansible, Python, GitLab CI/CD, Helm, and Kubernetes.
* Improve deployment, validation, and operational workflows.
* Create reusable tooling that increases reliability and repeatability.

**Solve Complex Systems Problems**

* Troubleshoot issues that span software, infrastructure, networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI platforms.
* Work alongside engineering teams to identify root causes and drive technical solutions.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Penguin's AI Factory Platform.

**Learn, Experiment, and Innovate**

* Explore emerging technologies across the AI infrastructure ecosystem.
* Evaluate new open-source and commercial technologies.
* Contribute ideas that influence future products and solution architectures.
* Continuously expand your technical expertise across infrastructure and AI technologies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Linux-based production environments.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes in production environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Ansible preferred).
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT) to improve engineering productivity.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
  
  

* Experience with one or more of the following:

+ DevOps or Platform Engineering
+ AI or machine learning infrastructure
+ GPU computing
+ Slurm or HPC environments
+ Enterprise storage
+ Networking
+ Containers and cloud-native technologies
+ Observability platforms
+ CI/CD pipelines

Hybrid – Bangalore, India

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

title: Content Researcher
description:
**Content Researcher**

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
Prior experience in content research, writing or a related field preferred, but not mandatory

**Type:**
Full-time

**Read This Before You Apply**

At ARL, we value curiosity, initiative, clear thinking and the ability to turn research into useful content.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to what is happening in the market, asks thoughtful questions, spots patterns and understands what an audience needs to know. You should enjoy going beyond surface-level trends to understand why a topic matters — and then turn those insights into clear, engaging written content.

Prior experience as a content researcher is a plus, but it isn't a requirement. We care more about your research instincts, analytical ability, writing, and willingness to learn.

**Who We Are & Why ARL**

At AgResearch Labs (ARL), we're building technology and infrastructure for cleaner, more climate-resilient food production.

Over more than a decade of R&D, ARL has developed indigenous aeroponics and farm-automation technologies that power Growize Farms, our commercial platform for building and operating high-performance farms at scale.

Recognised among India's Top 100 deep-tech startups by NASSCOM, ARL is entering its next phase of growth — scaling our business, teams and operating systems.

This creates an opportunity to help shape how we explain our work, engage our audiences and contribute to conversations around agriculture, food production, technology and the markets we operate in.

**The Role**

As a Content Researcher, you will identify relevant topics, investigate what audiences and markets care about, and turn your findings into thoughtful, well-written content.

You'll explore market needs, industry developments, audience questions, emerging conversations and content trends to understand what is worth saying, who it is for and how best to communicate it.

The role is not limited to writing from a brief. We want someone who can help identify the brief in the first place: someone who can research independently, connect ideas, analyse what works across different channels and develop content that is useful, relevant and engaging.

**What You'll Own**

**Market, Audience & Topic Research**

* Stay curious about developments in the market, industry news, customer needs, audience conversations and emerging trends relevant to ARL.
* Research topics using credible sources, reports, articles, interviews, social platforms, search trends and other relevant inputs.
* Identify the questions, challenges, misconceptions and interests that matter to our audiences.
* Separate meaningful signals from passing trends, and explain why a topic is relevant to ARL and its audience.
* Build a pipeline of researched topics, angles and content opportunities.

**Content Ideation & Writing**

* Turn research and insights into clear, engaging written content across formats such as educational explainers, articles, thought pieces, anecdotes, social posts, newsletters and website content.
* Develop strong angles, hooks and narratives rather than simply summarising information.
* Adapt the depth, tone, structure and format of content to the intended audience and channel.
* Translate technical or complex ideas into accessible content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Work with internal subject-matter experts to validate information and uncover useful stories, examples and perspectives.

**Content Analysis & Performance Learning**

* Study content from relevant brands, creators, publications and competitors to understand what earns attention, builds trust and drives engagement.
* Analyse available performance signals — such as reach, engagement, saves, shares, clicks, search visibility or reader feedback — to understand what is working and why.
* Use evidence and audience response to refine topics, formats, distribution choices and future content ideas.
* Develop hypotheses, test different angles and document learnings rather than relying only on intuition.
* Understand that different channels and audiences need different approaches; content that works in one place may not work in another.

**Research Quality & Collaboration**

* Verify facts, check sources and maintain a clear distinction between evidence, interpretation and opinion.
* Keep research organised, with source links, key findings and useful context that others can review.
* Collaborate with the marketing, business and technical teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.
* Manage multiple topics and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and writing quality.
* Use AI and research tools thoughtfully to improve efficiency, while independently verifying claims and adding original judgment.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong curiosity about markets, people, industries and why certain ideas or stories resonate.
* Good research and analytical instincts — the ability to find credible information, connect dots, spot patterns and draw useful conclusions.
* Clear, engaging writing with the ability to explain ideas simply and adapt to different formats.
* An understanding that effective content starts with audience needs and a clear purpose, not just a trending topic.
* The ability to assess what content works, for whom, on which platform and why — using both qualitative judgment and available data.
* Initiative to suggest topics and angles, ask questions and develop ideas without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Attention to detail, factual accuracy and a willingness to revise work based on feedback and evidence.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where content priorities and business needs can evolve.

Prior experience as a content researcher, content writer, journalist, editorial researcher, market researcher or in a related role is good to have, but not mandatory. Strong writing samples, research projects, personal publications or other evidence of your ability to think and communicate well are welcome.

**Good to have:**
Experience with digital content, SEO, social media analytics, audience research, industry publications or content planning; familiarity with agriculture, food systems, sustainability, climate, technology or deep-tech topics; comfort using spreadsheets, analytics dashboards and AI-assisted research tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You consistently identify relevant topics and angles grounded in audience needs and market developments.
* Your content is accurate, clear, engaging and appropriate for its intended audience and channel.
* Research leads to useful insights and original angles, rather than surface-level summaries.
* Content ideas become a consistent pipeline of work that supports ARL's communication and business priorities.
* You learn from performance data and feedback, and use those learnings to improve future content.
* Internal teams can rely on your research, source quality and written output.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to help shape how a growing deep-tech and AgTech business communicates with the world. You'll have room to explore ideas, understand an evolving market, learn from subject-matter experts and turn complex topics into content that informs, engages and builds understanding.

If you're curious about why people pay attention to certain ideas, enjoy getting to the bottom of a topic and can turn what you learn into compelling writing, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role:**

You will own how Refold AI's product feels to use, and build the team that keeps raising that bar. Our users configure AI agents that build and run enterprise integrations, which is powerful, technical work. Your job is to make it feel obvious.

You'll set the product design vision with the founders, stay hands-on from first sketch to shipped pixel, and grow the design function as we scale. You'll define the standard for interaction quality, the design system the product grows on, and how design works with product and engineering. If you want

to define how a new category of software works, and lead the people who build it, this is that seat.

**What you'll do:**

* Set the product design vision and strategy with the founders, and turn it into a roadmap the team can ship against.
* Stay hands-on: own key flows end to end, from research and wireframes to prototypes and production-ready UI.
* Turn complex, technical workflows (agent setup, connector configuration, debugging, monitoring) into interfaces anyone can use.
* Hire, mentor, and grow product designers, setting the craft bar and giving clear, regular feedback.
* Define how design works here: design reviews, critique, hand-off to engineering, and quality checks before launch.
* Partner with product and engineering leads from concept to launch, shaping the roadmap rather than just receiving it.
* Build a research practice: regular user conversations, usability tests, and product metrics that guide decisions.
* Own the product design system so engineering ships consistent UI without design in the loop.
* Lead new interaction patterns for AI: how users instruct, review, and trust what agents build.
* Work with the brand designer so the product and the brand feel like one company.

**What we're looking for:**

* 7+ years designing B2B SaaS, developer, or data products, including 2+ years leading designers or owning design for a product area. Experience band is flexible if the work is exceptional.
* A track record of shipped products you can walk us through, where your design decisions moved real outcomes.
* A systems thinker: you simplify complex, technical problems into clear flows, not just clean screens.
* Strong craft across interaction design, visual design, and prototyping, with deep Figma fluency. You still enjoy doing the work yourself.
* Experience hiring and mentoring designers, and building design processes and systems from scratch.
* Founding-calibre ownership: you set the bar and build from zero, without a playbook.
* Clear verbal and written communication, so you can align founders, engineers, and customers around a design direction.
* A portfolio with case studies that show your process, the trade-offs you made, the outcomes, and how you led others.

**Bonus points:**

* You've designed AI-native products, agent workflows, or integration and automation tools.
* You've built a design team at an early-stage startup, ideally as the first design hire.
* Front-end sensibility (HTML/CSS, React) or comfort prototyping in code.
* Motion and micro-interaction chops.
* You use AI tools to explore, prototype, and ship faster, and help your team do the same.

**How we work:**

* Ship weekly. We move fast and ship often.
* Bold ideas welcome. Creativity and out-of-the-box thinking, celebrated.
* High ownership, low ego. A young, talented team steering the ship together.

title: Design Lead - Bangalore, India
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About**
In 1931, an engineering draughtsman named Harry Beck redrew the map of the London Underground. He ignored geography, distorted distance, and reduced the world's most complicated transit system to something anyone could read. Beck understood that when a system gets complex enough, accuracy isn't the same thing as truth. The designer's job is to make the complex legible — so people can decide where to go.
  
  
**The role**
Bangalore is one of WisdomAI's largest and fastest-growing engineering hubs, and much of our platform is built there. We're hiring a Design Lead to be a core design partner to that team: owning major product areas, setting the craft bar on everything that ships from Bangalore, and growing into the office's design manager as the team grows.
  
  
The work spans our whole platform. Chat on Data, Live Apps, our Slack and Teams apps, MCP, our visualizations, and a major push into agents: always-on teammates for the enterprise, grounded in Wisdom's context engine. Every one of these has to feel like the same product, built by the same hands.
  
  
Design at WisdomAI
  
  
**Craft is the product.**
People make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration here. It's the product working.
  
  
**AI-native by default.**
Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We prototype in code, move fluidly between Claude, Cursor, Paper, and Figma, and aren't precious about toolchain. We optimize for velocity and quality.
  
  
**Small and senior, on purpose.**
With today's AI tools, a handful of exceptional designers can have outsized impact. Everyone here owns real territory, and the team grows only when the bar stays this high. You'll work alongside a designer in Bangalore and the design team in San Mateo, directly with our VP of Design.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Coherence across the platform. Think in systems from the context engine outward, so a definition, an answer, a chart, or an agent behaves the same way in chat, in Slack, in a Live App, and over MCP.
* Agents. Define what a great enterprise agent feels like: how it takes on work, reports back, earns trust, asks before acting, and shows up where people already work.
* Live Apps. Customers build anything here: a daily brief that reads like the New York Times, a pricing simulator with deep sensitivity analysis, a dashboard on steroids, a mobile metric tracker. You'll design the best of them, and the templates and primitives that let everyone else build their own — for apps and for agents.
* The context engine. Make a deep, powerful layer of semantics, definitions, and governance legible to the people who configure it and the people who rely on it.
* Data visualization, occasionally. Our charts are a signature of the product. You'll pick up visualization work from time to time.

What you'll do
  
  

* Own product areas end to end, from customer discovery and problem framing with PMs and engineers through launch and iteration.
* Work side by side with engineers every day. Make design a fast, natural part of how Bangalore builds, not a handoff.
* Prototype early and often with AI tools, building working things rather than static frames, then carry validated concepts through full state coverage and system alignment.
* Set the craft bar in crits and in what ships. Share prompts, patterns, and process with the team.
* Extend our design system so new surfaces arrive coherent by default.
* Partner closely with design leadership in San Mateo across time zones, and help hire and grow the Bangalore design team.

What we're looking for
  
  

* 7+ years designing products, with a body of work in complex B2B, data, analytics, AI, or developer tools.
* A high bar for craft — visual, UI, and interaction. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter.
* Impeccable taste, and opinions you can explain and defend.
* Sharp product thinking and a talent for taming complexity: you find the simple model hiding inside a sprawling system.
* A systems mind. You've driven coherence across many surfaces, not just polished a single flow.
* You work AI-natively today. You design with LLMs and AI prototyping or coding tools daily, and you can show how they've changed your work.
* You've mentored other designers and earned the trust of engineering teams, and you want to grow into leading a team.

Nice to haves
  
  

* You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer.
* An interest in data visualization. Experience is welcome but not required.
* You've designed agentic experiences, or templates and systems that other people build with.
* A background in data visualization or analytics.
* Experience on product teams that work across the US and India.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: AI Search & Growth Specialist (GTM Engineer)
description:
**AI Search & Growth Specialist (GTM) · FactoryJet · Bangalore (Whitefield), on-site**

FactoryJet builds AI agents, e-commerce stores and AI search programs for businesses in the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. More than 500 businesses have worked with us.

Most of our work is in three areas:

* **AI search and SEO:**

**What you’ll do**

* **Research prospects**
  in the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia, and prepare the audit or demo that opens the conversation.

  (light design and web work). Spot what’s off and fix small things yourself.

**You’ll do well here if you**

* Have 1.5 to 3 years in SEO, e-commerce or digital marketing, and have shipped real work you can show us.
* Use Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT or Perplexity every day, and can show us something you built or fixed with them.
* Are curious about AI search and AI agents: how assistants pick their sources, and what an agent can and can’t do reliably.
* Have a good eye for design. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to say why a page looks wrong.
* Write and speak English clearly enough to email a client in New York or London without help.

**Good to have:**
Shopify or WooCommerce admin experience, Google Search Console and GA4, basic HTML.

**Details**

* Location: our office near Kundalahalli, ITPL Road, Whitefield. On-site 5 days a week. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
* Salary: ₹30,000 to ₹35,000 per month, plus a quarterly performance incentive of up to ₹[amount].
* You’ll report directly to the founder.

**How to apply.**

We only accept applications through our website:

https://factoryjet.com/careers/ai-search-growth-specialist?source=linkedin

Applications sent by email, LinkedIn message or Easy Apply are not reviewed. Everyone goes through the same steps, so everyone is judged the same way.

Step 1. Application form (about 10 minutes, required)

Your CV, phone number, three practical questions (office, salary, notice period), and three short tasks:

- Link to one piece of work you are proud of, and what you changed in it.

- Link to something you built or fixed with Claude Code, Codex or a similar tool, and what the AI did versus what you did.

- A 150-word note: ask ChatGPT or Perplexity a question that an online store's buyers would ask, and tell us what the answer got right or wrong about that store.

Applications with any of these missing are not reviewed.

Step 2. Screening

A person reads every application, with an AI tool helping to sort them. You will hear back within 7 days either way.

Step 3. Online assessment (about 45 minutes)

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link. It covers reasoning, English, working with AI tools and a design question.

Step 4. Take-home task, and an interview.

title: Founding growth engineer
description:
**------------------- WHAT WE DO**
-------------------

Slidely AI is a PowerPoint AI assistant built for the way professionals actually make decks. In the last 30 days, users created more than 50,000 slides with Slidely, and 82.5% of them made it into real presentations.

Professionals at Deloitte, Airtel, Axis Bank and ABM Industries use Slidely, and our customers include teams at Fortune 500 companies. We’ve done this with a team of fewer than 10 people.

Now we’re hiring our founding growth engineer. You’ll start by building the systems that power our go-to-market, then grow into building the product itself.

-------------------
**WHY SLIDELY EXISTS**
-------------------

ChatGPT and Claude have made presentations easier for casual users. For professionals, a big gap remains.

**1. Making PowerPoints is nobody’s job but everybody’s problem**

Decks take up 30 to 50% of a consultant’s time, but nobody is paid to make them faster, and the best AI model changes every month. Keeping up is our job, so it doesn’t have to be theirs.

**2. AI has no judgement, and no one has time to teach it**

It doesn’t know which slides a sell-side private equity deck needs, or when a slide is too dense to read. We build what good looks like in each industry into every workflow: 95% best practice, 5% you.

**3. A bad first draft just pushes the work to later**

Without that judgement, ChatGPT and Claude ignore your template and put your speaker notes on the slide. Our plugin starts from your template, your industry’s best practices and your past work, and our PowerPoint add-in handles the iteration.

**4. AI guesses what you want instead of checking with you**

It asks a few generic questions, then disappears on a long job. Slidely confirms the storyline, data and layouts before building your deck, and shows you three options when you redesign a slide.

**5. A sloppy deck comes off as sloppy work**

A deck can decide whether you get the funding, the investment or the approval, and the audience judges the work by the slides. Set up one design kit, and every slide anyone in your company creates follows it.

**6. Making a great deck is hard freaking work, so nobody wants to do it again (and again)**

A great deck takes days, sometimes weeks, so people keep reusing their best old slides. Slidely does that for the whole company, and every deck makes the next one better.

-------------------
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
-------------------

Slidely AI is backed by Y Combinator and supported by prominent founders, operators and executives.

Despite being a team of fewer than 10, we serve demanding enterprise customers and operate at a much larger company's pace.

Our founders, Apoorve and Nikhil, are computer science graduates from IIT Kharagpur with deep backgrounds in AI.

This is an in-person role from our office in HSR Layout, Bengaluru. We work six days a week, typically 9-10 hours a day, together.

-------------------
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
-------------------

You’ll build the systems that help Slidely grow, in our go-to-market and in the product. Working closely with our CEO and our Founding Marketing Lead, you’ll start by setting up the automations, AI agents and workflows that let a team of under 10 market and sell like a much bigger company. From there, you’ll take on more of the product, especially the parts that drive growth.

**In your first few months**

* **Social proof pipelines:**
  build the systems that bring in customer stories, testimonials and reviews.
* **Email workflows:**
  build onboarding, re-engagement and dropped-off user flows using copy from our marketing lead.
* **Technical SEO and AEO:**
  own site structure, web vitals and internal linking, and build the tracking for search rankings and how often Slidely shows up in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
* **Dashboards and alerts:**
  build the dashboards and alerts that show how our content, pages, emails and channels are performing, so the team can act on the numbers quickly.
* **Support founder-led sales:**
  build outreach lists, enrich leads, and surface buying signals (such as live signals from X and LinkedIn into Slack) so our founders spend their time on the right conversations.

**Ongoing**

* **Automate what’s proven:**
  when our marketing lead settles a process, turn it into a workflow that runs with minimal hand-holding.
* **Product-led growth:**
  build the features that turn users into active, paying teams, like onboarding, activation and usage signals that tell us when an enterprise team is ready for a conversation.
* **Ship product:**
  work on Slidely’s core product alongside the founders.

-------------------
**YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU'RE**
-------------------

1. **AI-native.**
   You reach for agents first. You write skills, wire up automations, and get more done by building systems than by doing tasks by hand.
2. **An engineer at heart.**
   You reason from first principles, debug problems logically, and build things that others (and agents) can rely on.
3. **A real engineer.**
   You write production-quality code, not just glue between tools. You’d be as comfortable shipping a product feature as wiring up a pipeline.
4. **Someone with taste.**
   You know when a script beats an agent, when an off-the-shelf tool beats both, and when output isn’t good enough to ship.
5. **Comfortable owning things end to end.**
   As a founding growth engineer, you won’t inherit a playbook; you’ll write it.

-------------------
**BENEFITS**
-------------------

* Total CTC: ₹12-18 LPA + ESOPs
* One-time joining bonus of ₹30k
* Access to leading AI and marketing tools
* Workstation setup and upgrades

title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
  
  
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
  
  
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
  
  
What you’ll work on
  
  
Depending on the week, you might:
  
  
  

* Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
* Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
* Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
* Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
* Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
* Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
* Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
* Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly

Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
  

* You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief
* You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it
* You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters
* You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective
* You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working
* You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving
* You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow

We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
  
  
What you get
  
  
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
  
  
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
  
  
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Field Engineering Technician
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
Instawork’s on-demand labor marketplace is uniquely valuable for robotics and physical AI. We’re working with leading frontier labs to create the highest-quality, highest-diversity datasets for training robotics foundation models. Instawork Robotics is the human advantage in the robotics revolution.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled, Field Engineering Technician to manage the maintenance, calibration, and local deployment of a fleet of 600 custom wearable camera rigs. Unlike standard IT support, this role sits at the intersection of precision electronics, mechanical assembly, and field operations. You will be the primary guardian of our hardware integrity, ensuring that high-stakes egocentric data collection continues without interruption across various deployment sites.
  
  
**About IRL**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
  
  
**Who You Are:**
Field Engineering Technician – Wearable Devices
  
  
Experience: 0–2 years
  
  
Shift: Rotational
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Employment type: 1 year contract
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Hardware Service Technician to install, test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, and deploy Instacore wearable hardware devices.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with electronics or hardware troubleshooting and be comfortable working with cameras, sensors, circuit boards, cables, connectors, and mobile devices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Diagnose and resolve hardware issues affecting Instacore wearable devices.
* Test and repair head, chest, and wrist cameras, IMU sensors, cables, connectors, and related components.
* Troubleshoot power, connectivity, recording, camera-detection, and sensor issues.
* Flash devices, install firmware updates, configure devices, and conduct functional testing.
* Use digital multimeters and basic electronic testing tools to identify faults.
* Inspect motherboards, daughterboards, connectors, cable harnesses, power circuits, and other hardware components.
* Repair or replace damaged and faulty components.
* Conduct quality-control testing before handing devices over to the field operations team.
* Maintain accurate service and repair records for each device and IC number.
* Track repaired, failed, and pending devices in the service tracker.
* Support field teams with remote and on-site hardware troubleshooting when required.
* Coordinate with the engineering and inventory management teams to resolve hardware-related issues.
* Follow electrostatic discharge (ESD) and safe-handling procedures when working with electronic components.
* Assist with managing spare parts, cameras, sensors, cables, connectors, and other hardware inventory.
* Prepare service reports and communicate recurring hardware problems to the engineering team.
* Support the testing and validation of new devices, components, and hardware revisions.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Diploma, ITI certification, or degree in electronics, electrical engineering, hardware maintenance, or a related discipline.
* 0–2 years of experience in electronics repair, hardware service, field service, or technical support. Relevant internship or academic project experience is also acceptable.
* Good understanding of basic electronics and hardware troubleshooting.
* Experience using a digital multimeter and basic electronic tools.
* Familiarity with PCBs, power circuits, cameras, sensors, cables, and connectors.
* Ability to identify hardware faults through systematic troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of firmware installation, device flashing, and hardware configuration.
* Comfortable working with Android and iOS devices and applications.
* Good documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical and operations teams.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts and provide on-site support when required.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience repairing camera-based, wearable, IoT, or embedded devices.
* Familiarity with soldering and component-level repairs.
* Experience following ESD-safe working practices.
* Exposure to inventory or hardware service-tracking systems.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Contractual || Trainer - India
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**Contract Role: This is a 1-year contractual position, with the opportunity to transition to a permanent role based on performance.**
**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” — the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments — kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes — to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more [here]
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and deliver on a learning curriculum for the Operations team that aligns with Instawork’s business objectives and scales with a growing organization; coordinate and administer training
* Develop a comprehensive onboarding program that encourages new team members to provide premier support for Instawork’s customers and internal stakeholders, as well as prepare them for an intensive operational role managing high volume and nuanced customer requests
* Collaborate with management to create training plans, develop training modules, and facilitate real-time training for Operations new hires and continuing education for tenured specialists
* Manage the efficacy of new hire onboarding through continuous process planning, execution, and identifying metrics for the Operations learning curriculum
* Establish methods for measuring and reporting on learner engagement, comprehension, and practical application
* Provide consistent visibility through written status and ongoing reporting, summarizing learner developmen
* Develop learning exercises with specific examples of interactions that promote empathy and obsession with the customer experience
* Create and assist with managing content for the Operations for the internal customer Knowledge Base and external customer Help Center

**Who You Are**

* 6+ months of experience leading and creating support training programs
* 6+ months leading remote or diverse teams, preferably in the technology services industry
* Experience creating content for and publishing within a Content or Learning Management System
* Proven ability to utilize different strategies to engage learners through presentation, facilitation and mentorship, as well as use of online and offline training concepts
* Demonstrated success managing long-term projects and ongoing reporting for deliverables
* Proven ability to motivate, influence and work effectively at all organizational levels using different methods of communication
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones and languages and cultures strongly preferred Learning Management System (LMS) administration experience preferred

**Preferred Languages**

* Fluent in English and at least one of the following regional languages: Marathi, Telugu, or Kannada.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Manager, CRM
description:
**The Role**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, execution-oriented Manager – CRM & Lifecycle Marketing to own CRM marketing strategy and execution end-to-end for the India business.

This is a
**hands-on individual contributor**
ownership role. You will be expected to independently develop the CRM strategy, build and launch campaigns and journeys, write the communication, analyze performance, conduct RCA, and optimize outcomes — from start to finish, without relying on separate teams for day-to-day execution.

You will own CRM across email, WhatsApp, and SMS, using Salesforce Marketing Cloud to build and manage lifecycle programs that nurture newly generated leads, accelerate the sales journey, and reactivate the existing India lead base.

The ideal candidate is someone who can look at a business problem, use data to understand what is happening and why, develop the right strategy, and then personally execute the solution end-to-end

**What You Will Own**

*Own the CRM marketing strategy for the India business end-to-end — from planning and audience strategy to campaign creation, execution, analysis, optimization, and reporting.*

*● Personally execute CRM campaigns and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp, and SMS using Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This is a hands-on role where you will be expected to build and launch campaigns yourself rather than only manage an execution team.*

*● Design, build, and continuously optimize multi-channel lifecycle journeys to nurture monthly-generated leads and support the sales cycle.*

*● Develop and execute reactivation and win-back campaigns yourself to re-engage the existing India lead base and drive program sign-ups.*

*● Own CRM-attributed revenue as a key business metric, working closely with sales and category teams to identify opportunities and improve conversion.*

*● Build and manage audience segmentation and lifecycle journeys based on lead behaviour, intent, engagement, profile, program interest, and funnel stage.*

*● Independently analyze CRM and business data to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities. Conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) yourself, determine what is driving performance changes, and decide what needs to change.*

*● Translate your analysis into action — you will be expected to make data-driven decisions and implement the resulting changes yourself, rather than simply reporting insights to another team.*

*Own A/B testing across messaging, content, audience segments, journeys, offers, and communication frequency — including setting up the tests, executing them, analyzing results, and implementing learnings.*

*● Write and execute CRM communication yourself, creating compelling, high-quality email, WhatsApp, and SMS content tailored to senior tech professionals.*

*● Own campaign performance tracking and reporting on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis, translating data into insights, RCA, recommendations, and concrete actions.*

*● Work closely with sales, category, analytics, and technology teams to ensure CRM programs are aligned with business priorities, while retaining end-to-end ownership of CRM execution.*

*● Partner with the technology team on CRM workflows, integrations, data flows, and campaign infrastructure within Salesforce Marketing Cloud, while independently owning the marketing logic, journey design, campaign setup, and execution.*

*● Continuously identify and execute opportunities to improve CRM processes, automation, segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle marketing effectiveness*

**What We Are Looking For**

*● 4–6 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, or a closely related function.*

*● Mandatory: Hands-on experience running CRM marketing through Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including independently executing campaigns across email, WhatsApp, and SMS.*

*● Demonstrated ability to own CRM strategy and execution end-to-end for a business, category, market, or large customer/lead base.*

**Your Team, Your Impact**
The Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Windows, Active Directory and VDI is responsible for engineering, governing, and continuously improving the organization's Windows infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, Windows Server, VMware Horizon, and Azure Virtual Desktop environments. The role establishes platform standards, drives automation and security initiatives, provides technical direction for infrastructure operations, and partners with managed service providers and cross-functional teams to ensure secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise infrastructure.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Own the enterprise Windows infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, Windows Server, VMware Horizon, and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define and maintain engineering standards, platform architecture, and operational governance for Windows infrastructure services across the organization.
* Administer Active Directory in a global multi-domain environment, including domain controller health, replication, trust relationships, functional level governance, and Group Policy management.
* Manage enterprise DNS, DHCP, Infoblox integration, IP address management (IPAM), and certificate lifecycle through Microsoft Certificate Services (MSCA).
* Lead Windows Server lifecycle initiatives, including build standards, CIS hardening, patch management, operating system upgrades, and migration programs.
* Design and implement privileged access management controls, including JIT administration, Privileged Access Workstations (PAWs), service account governance, and PAM solutions such as BeyondTrust, CyberArk, or Delinea.
* Own VMware Horizon and Azure Virtual Desktop environments, including image lifecycle management, FSLogix, host pool administration, capacity planning, performance optimization, and cost governance.
* Implement Azure Virtual Desktop capabilities including MSIX App Attach, Azure NetApp Files integration, Entra ID access controls, and auto-scaling policies.
* Build and maintain PowerShell automation for Active Directory administration, server provisioning, patch reporting, certificate management, and VDI lifecycle operations.
* Review infrastructure designs, operational procedures, and CAB changes to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, and long-term platform strategy.
* Partner with Cyber Security, Cloud, Networking, and Application teams to implement infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate complex infrastructure projects, vendor engagements, and platform enhancements while ensuring successful delivery and operational readiness.
* Mentor infrastructure engineers and managed service partners by providing technical guidance, promoting engineering best practices, and driving continuous improvement across infrastructure operations.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge repositories to ensure consistent support and platform sustainability.

**What We're Looking For**
**Must Have**

* 7–10 years of enterprise Windows infrastructure experience in an MNC, GCC, or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Strong expertise in Active Directory across multi-domain and multi-forest environments, including replication, trust architecture, Group Policy design, and identity services.
* Hands-on experience with Windows DNS, DHCP, Infoblox, IPAM, and enterprise networking fundamentals.
* Extensive experience managing Windows Server infrastructure, including provisioning, hardening, patching, operating system lifecycle management, and migration programs.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with VMware Horizon and/or Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) in production environments, including FSLogix and image lifecycle management.
* Experience administering Azure Entra ID, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure networking, and hybrid identity environments.
* Strong knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Microsoft Certificate Services (MSCA), and certificate lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions such as BeyondTrust, CyberArk, or Delinea.
* Advanced PowerShell scripting skills for infrastructure automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Experience establishing infrastructure standards, reviewing technical solutions, and collaborating with managed service providers to ensure engineering quality and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across infrastructure initiatives.

**Good to Have**

* VMware Horizon/Omnissa certification (VCP-DM or equivalent).
* Microsoft AZ-104 or Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate certification.
* Experience with AWS WorkSpaces.
* Experience with Qualys or equivalent vulnerability management solutions.
* Experience managing CrowdStrike Falcon across Windows Server and VDI environments.
* Knowledge of secure remote access or browser isolation platforms.
* Experience leading enterprise infrastructure modernization, migration, or platform transformation initiatives.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**
