title: Java Architect - Immediate joiner only & F2F Mandatory
description:
We are seeking an accomplished
**Java Backend Architect**
to lead the design, modernization, and delivery of large-scale, cloud-native platforms. You will define end-to-end backend architecture, establish engineering standards, and guide cross-functional teams in building secure, resilient, and high-performance distributed systems.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in Java, microservices, event-driven design, cloud platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and own the backend solution architecture for complex, mission-critical enterprise applications.
* Design scalable, loosely coupled microservices using Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and modern design patterns.
* Lead high-level and detailed design activities, including architecture decision records, solution documents, API contracts, and integration blueprints.
* Architect event-driven systems using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging and streaming technologies.
* Design RESTful and GraphQL APIs with strong focus on versioning, security, performance, observability, and developer experience.
* Lead modernization of legacy monolithic applications into cloud-native, domain-driven microservices.
* Define data architecture and persistence strategies across relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB.
* Establish caching, resilience, fault-tolerance, and performance-tuning strategies using Redis, Hazelcast, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and asynchronous processing.
* Guide cloud-native deployment and operations on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker, Kubernetes, serverless components, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Drive CI/CD maturity through automated build, test, deployment, and release pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Define observability standards using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, distributed tracing, and application performance monitoring.
* Establish security-by-design practices, including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, IAM, encryption, secrets management, and secure API gateways.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical design reviews, and code reviews; resolve high-impact production issues through root-cause analysis.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, promote engineering best practices, and influence technology adoption across teams.
* Partner with product, infrastructure, security, data, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, and recommend practical adoption aligned with engineering goals.

Required Skills and Experience

* 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5–7 years in backend architecture or technical leadership.
* Expert-level proficiency in Java 11/17/21, including concurrency, multithreading, streams, virtual threads, JVM performance, and functional programming.
* Deep hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* Strong expertise with Apache Kafka, including topic design, consumer groups, partitioning, idempotency, exactly-once considerations, and stream processing.
* Strong understanding of DDD, CQRS, Saga patterns, API-led integration, eventual consistency, and distributed transaction handling.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Solid knowledge of caching strategies, load balancing, horizontal scaling, high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, Git-based workflows, and automated testing strategies.
* Strong understanding of application security, identity and access management, API security, and secure cloud architecture.
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Zipkin, Jaeger, or cloud-native monitoring services.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

title: Senior / Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Cogentiq Platform
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Cogentiq**
**About Cogentiq**
**Cogentiq**
is Fractal's Enterprise AI platform that enables organizations to build, deploy, and govern intelligent AI agents grounded in enterprise context. By connecting AI with enterprise knowledge, business systems, and workflows, Cogentiq empowers enterprises to solve complex business problems with trustworthy, scalable, and production-ready AI.
  
  
Cogentiq is Fractal’s secure, scalable, enterprise agentic AI platform that enables teams to
**build, test, deploy, monitor**
agents and multi‑agent workflows with strong
**observability, evaluation, guardrails and RBAC**
across any cloud or LLM framework. It includes a
**no/low‑code development console**
,
**Agent & MCP Gateways**
, and an enterprise marketplace for reusable
**agents, tools, connections and guardrails**
.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for
**Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)**
to join the founding Cogentiq team. As an FDE, you will work at the intersection of
**software engineering, AI, enterprise integration, and customer success**
.
  
  
You will partner closely with enterprise customers to understand their business challenges, design AI-powered solutions, build production-grade integrations, and deploy Cogentiq into complex enterprise environments. Beyond customer implementations, you'll help shape the evolution of the Cogentiq platform by transforming deployment learnings into reusable platform capabilities, connectors, and best practices.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving ambiguous, real-world problems, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to build the next generation of Enterprise AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and develop production-grade AI applications using the Cogentiq platform.
* Deploy enterprise AI solutions from proof of concept to production.
* Build integrations with enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Snowflake, Databricks, and other business systems.
* Develop reusable connectors, APIs, SDKs, MCP servers, and automation components.
* Design secure, scalable, cloud-native architectures and build reliable backend services and microservices.
* Collaborate directly with customer engineering and business teams to understand requirements, conduct technical workshops, and deliver successful AI solutions.
* Troubleshoot production deployments, optimize system performance, and ensure reliability and security.
* Capture learnings from customer deployments and contribute reusable capabilities back to the Cogentiq platform.
* Work closely with AI engineers, platform engineers, product managers, and solution architects to continuously improve the platform.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong Software Engineering: You have strong software engineering fundamentals and are proficient in Python, with experience in Java or TypeScript being a plus. You have built production-grade backend applications, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, and are comfortable working with databases, Git, and modern software development practices.
* AI Engineering: You have hands-on experience building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation techniques. Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and modern AI orchestration frameworks is highly desirable.
* Enterprise Integration: You have experience integrating enterprise applications and platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Snowflake, Databricks, and other business systems. You understand enterprise integration patterns, API-first architectures, authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, JWT, and SAML, and are comfortable working with SQL, REST, and GraphQL APIs.
* Cloud & Platform Engineering: You have experience building and deploying cloud-native applications on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud using Docker and Kubernetes. You understand CI/CD pipelines, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, observability, monitoring, and security best practices required to build reliable enterprise platforms.
* Customer & Product Mindset: You enjoy working directly with customers to understand their business challenges and translate them into elegant technical solutions. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders, are comfortable leading architecture discussions and technical workshops, and thrive in environments where requirements evolve rapidly. You take ownership of outcomes, learn quickly, prototype rapidly, and continuously look for opportunities to transform customer-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities.

**Why Join Cogentiq?**

* Join the founding engineering team building Fractal's flagship Enterprise AI platform.
* Work on cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, Enterprise Context, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Knowledge Graphs, and AI Governance.
* Solve complex enterprise challenges for some of the world's leading organizations.
* Influence both customer success and the future direction of the Cogentiq platform.
* Build reusable capabilities that will power enterprise AI deployments across industries.
* Collaborate with a team passionate about redefining how enterprises adopt and scale AI.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving
**real customer problems**
, not just implementing predefined tickets. You should be equally comfortable writing production-grade code, designing enterprise integrations, collaborating with customer teams, and shaping the future of the Cogentiq platform. If you're excited about building enterprise-grade AI systems that create meaningful business impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Client Services Representative
description:

Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 6 DAYS( Saturday and Sunday working) -

Full-Time, On-Site

About the Role

We are hiring a polished, customer-oriented and sales-driven
**Client Services & Sales Associate**
for a premium fitness and wellness brand in Bengaluru. This is a front-desk and studio operations role that combines luxury customer service, relationship management, sales and revenue generation.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a professional demeanour and experience catering to high-end customers. The role requires someone who can deliver a seamless customer experience while proactively identifying sales opportunities, recommending suitable membership packages and achieving sales targets.

This is an evergreen hiring requirement, offering an opportunity to grow within the premium fitness, wellness and lifestyle industry.

Key Responsibilities

* **Client Servicing:**
  Manage front-desk operations, welcome clients, handle class check-ins and ensure a premium, personalised customer experience.
* **Sales & Upselling:**
  Promote memberships, class packages, services and retail products while identifying opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.
* **Revenue Generation:**
  Work towards predefined sales targets, contribute to studio revenue and follow up with prospective and existing clients to drive conversions.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Build strong client relationships, understand customer needs and provide appropriate recommendations to improve retention and repeat business.
* **Studio Operations:**
  Maintain the studio's premium look and feel, ensure smooth daily operations and uphold high standards of presentation and service.
* **Team Coordination:**
  Coordinate with fitness instructors and internal teams to ensure seamless studio operations and customer satisfaction.
* **Product Knowledge:**
  Develop a strong understanding of the brand's offerings, membership plans, services and retail products.
* **Problem Resolution:**
  Handle customer queries and concerns professionally while maintaining a positive and solution-oriented approach.
* **Team Support:**
  Assist in onboarding and coaching new team members when required and contribute to a collaborative work environment.

Candidate Requirements

* 0–2 years of experience in customer service, sales, hospitality, luxury retail or a related customer-facing role.
* Excellent verbal communication, active listening and interpersonal skills.
* A polished personality, professional grooming and the ability to carry oneself confidently in a premium customer-facing environment.
* Experience interacting with high-end clientele and delivering personalised customer service.
* A sales-oriented mindset with the ability to achieve targets, upsell services and convert leads into paying customers.
* Strong problem-solving, multitasking and organisational abilities.
* Good computer skills and the ability to manage front-desk systems and customer information.
* A genuine interest in fitness, wellness and lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced studio environment.

**Preferred Industry Background**

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* **Premium Hospitality:**
  Taj Hotels, Marriott and other upscale hotel chains.
* **Aviation:**
  Customer service, guest relations and sales professionals from airlines or premium aviation services.
* **Luxury & Premium Retail:**
  PVH Group brands, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, H&M and comparable premium fashion or lifestyle retailers.
* **Fitness & Wellness:**
  Premium fitness studios, boutique gyms and wellness brands.

Candidates from competing fitness and wellness brands may also be considered, provided they demonstrate strong customer engagement, premium service standards and sales capabilities.

Compensation & Selection Process

* **CTC:**
  ₹4.8–5.4 LPA, plus performance-based incentives.
* **Work Schedule:**
  Six days per week, with weekend working mandatory.
* **Shift:**
  Day shift.
* **Interview Process:**
  Three stages, including a company knowledge assessment, an in-person interview with the reporting manager and a virtual interview.

**Ideal Candidate:**
Someone who combines hospitality-level service, a polished professional presence and a strong sales mindset to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business growth

title: System Support Engineer
description:
**About Curefoods**

Curefoods is a Bangalore-based house of F&B brands, founded in 2020. The company operates 500+ locations across 50 cities in India, offering a diverse range of cuisines. Curefoods brings together brands such as Kitchens of EatFit, CakeZone, Nomad Pizza, Sharief Bhai, Olio Pizza, Frozen Bottle, Krispy Kreme, and Arambam. Each brand offers a distinct culinary experience from healthier meal options to regional cuisines and indulgent desserts. The company operates through cloud kitchens and dine-in formats, focusing on food quality, hygiene, and sustainability. Its operations integrate technology and consumer insights to manage scale and efficiency.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and hands-on L2 IT Support Engineer to ensure maximum tech uptime across our cloud kitchen locations. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving escalated technical issues related to internet connectivity,Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), POS terminals, delivery aggregator integrations and general hardware/software infrastructure. You will play a critical role in

minimizing kitchen operational downtime and managing local vendor/ISP relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

1
**. Network & Internet Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain primary broadband and secondary

(backup 4G/5G/ISP) connections across all kitchen hubs to achieve 99.95%

network uptime.

* Troubleshoot routers, firewalls, switches, access points, and LAN/Wi-Fi

connectivity issues on-site and remotely.

* Perform automated failover testing and monitor network latency to prevent

order ingestion drops.

* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to resolve outages, track

ticket SLAs, and optimize circuit performance.

2.
**Cloud Kitchen IT Operations & Hardware Support**

* Provide L2 escalation support for Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), POS

terminals, thermal barcode/kitchen printers, order tablets, and handheld

scanners.

* Maintain and deploy standardized Standby Hardware Kits at kitchen hubs

for immediate unit swaps during hardware failures.

* Diagnose and resolve integration errors between delivery aggregator

platforms and the internal POS/KDS systems,Lapotps ,Desktops .

* Perform routine preventive maintenance and hardware audits across all

kitchen locations.

3
**. Vendor & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with third-party IT hardware and POS vendors for equipment

repairs, RMAs, warranty claims, and dispatch requests.

* Enforce vendor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure hardware repair

turnarounds within 24 hours.

* Maintain a centralized IT asset database, tracking hardware deployment,

serial numbers, inventory levels, and device health status.

* Assist the IT Manager in tracking monthly ISP billing accounts, internet

service renewals, and vendor invoices.

4.
**Escalation & Team Support**

* Act as the escalation point for L1 Support Engineers and kitchen operational

staff for high-priority technical incidents.

* Document technical troubleshooting procedures, standard operating

procedures (SOPs), and knowledge-base articles.

**Pre Requisites**

* 3+ years of experience as an L2 System/Network Support Engineer, preferably in Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), Cloud Kitchens,Retail, or Hospitality.
* **Networking**
  : Solid understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, Dual-WAN failover routing, and wireless network troubleshooting.
* **Hardware & Systems**
  : Hands-on experience with POS systems, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Laptops ,thermal receipt printers, and Android/iOS tablets ,Mobile devices.
* **Integrations**
  : Basic understanding of API integrations, webhooks, and order sync mechanisms between POS systems and food delivery aggregators.
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication, and the capacity to handle high-pressure outage situations during peak kitchen

title: SharePoint - OneDrive And Power Platform Operations - Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SharePoint ,OneDrive & Power Platform Operations/ Engineer**
In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the Compute Services – SharePoint, OneDrive & Power Platform Operations and engineering team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business change by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* In-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 & SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting & automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ & Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc
* Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc
* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
How your skills and experience will make an impact:
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

**What We Look For**

* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Salesforce Admin/Deployment Specialist (REMOTE)
description:
At Charles River, we are passionate about improving the quality of people’s lives. When you join our global family, you will help create healthier lives for millions of patients and their families.
  
  
Charles River employees are innovative thinkers, who are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement. We will empower you with the resources you need to grow and develop in your career.
  
  
As a Charles River employee, you will be part of an industry-leading, customer-focused company at the forefront of drug development. Your skills will play a key role in bringing life-saving therapies to market faster through simpler, quicker, and more digitalized processes. Whether you are in lab operations, finance, IT, sales, or another area, when you work at Charles River, you will be the difference every day for patients across the globe.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking a skilled
**Salesforce Admin/Deployment Specialist**
with strong Salesforce Developer expertise to manage deployments, configuration, release activities and environment governance across our Salesforce ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient release management across multiple clouds, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud and Apttus CPQ/CLM.
  
  

* This position will work remote from home office, located in India.\*\*

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Deployment & Release Management: Lead and execute deployments across all Salesforce environments using AutoRabit, ensuring accurate and timely releases. Manage sandbox strategy, refresh cycles and data preparation to maintain consistent and reliable environments. Perform detailed impact analysis and manage rollback plans when needed. Oversee version control, metadata alignment and release branching strategies to support parallel development streams. Ensure deployments follow change-management processes, maintain audit trails and comply with IT governance, SOX and GxP regulations.
* Salesforce Development: Build and customize Apex, LWC and Flows across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Apttus CPQ/CLM.
* Automation & Workflows: Implement complex flows, custom objects, validation rules and trigger-based automation.
* Apttus CPQ Customization: Configure and customize Salesforce Apttus CPQ to enhance quoting efficiency and integrate Apttus CPQ with other modules.
* Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve issues related to Salesforce and Apttus, ensuring platform stability.
* Collaboration & Best Practices: Work with Solution Architects and Senior Developers to optimize system functionality.
* Documentation & Agile Development: Maintain technical documentation, process flows, user stories, and contribute to Agile cycles.
* Additional Skills (Preferred): Experience with Salesforce security models, APIs, CI/CD tools (AutoRabit, Github), and data migration techniques.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science is preferred
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration and deployment experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Apttus CPQ/CLM.
* Technical Expertise: Strong experience supporting release processes in a multi-org or multi-cloud Salesforce environment and Proven experience with Apttus CPQ/CLM configurations and troubleshooting.
* Certifications: Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder and Platform Developer I (preferred)
* Development & Troubleshooting: Proficiency in Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, triggers and Salesforce design patterns & testing frameworks, with strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Agile & Collaboration: Experience in Agile environments with excellent communication, teamwork and business acumen to develop effective solutions.

**About Corporate Functions**
The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.
  
  
**About Charles River**
Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.
  
  
With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.
  
  
At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.
  
  
We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. Based on your position these may include: bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.

The role is responsible for application lifecycle management, software license management, deployments, monitoring, reporting, troubleshooting, and continuous service improvement to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient application services for R&D and engineering teams.

Application Management
  
  

* Manage the lifecycle of R&D and Engineering applications, including installation, configuration, deployment, upgrades, patching, maintenance, and retirement.
* Support application packaging, software distribution, migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh activities.
* Monitor application availability, and performance to ensure reliable application services.

* Administer both on-premises and cloud-hosted application environments.

License Management
  
  

* Administer software licenses, license servers, and licensing infrastructure for engineering applications.
* Manage multiple licensing models, including Concurrent, Named User, Subscription, and SaaS licensing.
* Monitor application and license utilization to optimize software consumption, availability, and compliance.
* Maintain license inventories, entitlement records, and compliance documentation.
* Generate operational reports, dashboards, KPIs, and license utilization metrics using reporting tools.
* Analyse usage trends and recommend license optimization opportunities.
* Support software audits, license renewals, entitlement updates, and license allocation activities.
* Troubleshoot licensing issues and coordinate with software vendors for timely resolution.

Process Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve application support processes through standardization, automation, and operational best practices.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, security standards, and operational procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical or a related discipline.

description:
**Product Design Intern | More Retail Pvt. Ltd.**

More Retail Private Limited is one of India’s largest and fastest-growing grocery retailers. We are committed to building India’s most customer-obsessed business with the world’s best omni-channel food and grocery experience, at massive scale.

**About the Internship**

We are looking for a curious, user-focused Product Design Intern to join our product design team. In this role, you will help design digital experiences used by millions of customers and thousands of store and supply chain employees. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and senior designers, and get hands-on experience shipping real products at scale.

**Duration:**
3-6 months

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Design**

* Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI for mobile apps, web apps, and internal tools
* Support the design of customer-facing experiences across our shopping app, website and loyalty programs
* Design internal tools used by store, warehouse and operations teams, such as POS, inventory and workforce apps
* Iterate on designs based on feedback from users, product managers and engineers

**User Research & Testing**

* Assist in conducting user interviews, store visits and usability tests
* Synthesise research findings into insights and design recommendations
* Support competitive analysis and benchmarking of design patterns

**Design Systems**

* Use and contribute to our design system, including components, patterns and guidelines
* Ensure consistency in UI, interaction patterns and visual language across products
* Help document components and design decisions

**Collaboration**

* Work with product managers to understand problems, requirements, and business goals
* Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately
* Present design ideas and rationale to the team and stakeholders
* Stay updated on UX trends, best practices and new design and AI tools

**Eligibility**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interaction Design, Product Design, HCI, Communication Design, or a related field
* A portfolio showcasing UX/UI work, including your problem-solving process (academic or personal projects welcome)

**Skills & Competencies**

* Good understanding of user-centred design principles, information architecture, and interaction design
* Proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout and prototyping
* Understanding of mobile and web UI patterns and platform guidelines
* Basic knowledge of usability testing and research methods
* Knowledge of motion or micro-interaction tools is a plus
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS or how designs are built is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
* Good communication skills and ability to take feedback

**What You’ll Gain**

* Hands-on experience designing products used at scale by customers and frontline employees
* Exposure to the full product lifecycle, from research to launch
* Mentorship from experienced product designers
* Opportunity for a pre-placement offer based on performance

**Monthly Stipend**
: INR 35,000/- per month

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Senior UX Researcher**

**Role Located out of:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**The Overview**

At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.

In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.

**Finer Print**

You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design & Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.

You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.

**What You Will Do**

As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.

* **Own Access Management Research in India:**
  Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).
* **Build an Exclusive User Panel:**
  Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.
* **Pioneer AI-Driven Efficiency:**
  Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.
* **Make Research a "Team Sport":**
  Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.
* **Exercise Methodological Rigor:**
  Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.
* **Drive Global Alignment & Storytelling:**
  Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Technical Research Expertise:**
  Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer-facing domains.
* **Strategic & Autonomous Thinker:**
  Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.
* **AI Tooling & Practice:**
  Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time-to-insight without compromising rigor.
* **Global Collaboration:**
  Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.
* **Systems & Strategic Thinking:**
  Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.
* **Growth Mindset & Empathy:**
  Strong self-awareness, receptiveness to feedback, and passion for solving high-stakes identity and security problems.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  4+ years of product development experience conducting UX research in enterprise/B2B product environments, OR a Master’s degree/PhD in HCI, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, or related field with 2+ years of experience.
* **Portfolio:**
  A digital portfolio or case study deck demonstrating end to end research ownership, complex technical problem spaces, generative and evaluative methodologies, and measurable business/product impact.
* **Platform Knowledge:**
  Experience researching desktop and mobile applications across macOS, Windows, iOS, or Android environments.
* **Security Context:**
  Background in identity, access management, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT admin tools is a strong plus.

team uses data and analytics capabilities to provide strategic insights around customer and competitive landscape to help drive effective market strategy for Lowe’s. The individual will also have to proactively take up initiatives to apply modern tools and techniques to improve efficiency, accuracy and overall quality of insights offered to stakeholders.

* Identifying the appropriate univariate and multivariate analysis to identify key customer trends and insights – Segmentation, Bayesian Networks, Factor analysis etc.
* Synthesize disparate sources of data—primary and secondary to develop cohesive stories, trends and insights that will drive strategic decision making across the enterprise.
* Leverage available information across workstreams to help connect dots and provide holistic insights on Customer Experience trends and Strategy.
* Work with the data operation teams to enhance data capabilities and develop tools to improve ease of access to data and BI for the broader organization

**Years Of Experience**

* 1-3 Years’ Hands on experience with Customer Experience Analytics / Customer Analytics / Customer Insights

**Required Minimum Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in economics / Statistics / Analytics or MBA in Marketing

**Skill Set Required**
**Primary Skills (must have)**

* Hands on experience in Medallia Platform, SQL , Teradata, Hadoop, Python
* Hands-on Analytics Experience of building Statistical / Mathematical models and multivariate analysis like Segmentation, Logistic Regression, Bayesian Networks, Factor analysis, Conjoint analysis, etc.
* Familiarity with experience platforms like Medallia or Qualtrics with understanding of data and functionalities
* Ability to apply Analytical tools and techniques to extract insights from Structured and Unstructured data
* Consulting Skills - Ability to impact business decisions through analytics and research.
* Hands on experience in creating Executive level audience ready presentations to tell impactful stories.
* Excellent communication skill to connect with people from diverse background and experience

**Secondary Skills (desired)**

* Experience on working with text data would be an advantage.
* Experience in working with Customer Experience or Voice of Customer Metrics will be a good to have.
* Familiarity with retail industry and key concepts.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Meta Ads Associate**
who has hands-on experience in planning, executing, and optimizing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns for international markets. The ideal candidate should be data-driven, performance-oriented, and passionate about generating high-quality leads while maximizing campaign ROI.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, launch, and optimize Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns targeting international markets.

* Stay updated with Meta platform updates, advertising policies, and industry best practices.

Qualifications & Skills

* 1–4 years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

* Knowledge of performance marketing metrics including CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, and ROAS.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), UTM tracking, and campaign attribution.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in EdTech, SaaS, or high-growth consumer internet companies.
* Experience running campaigns across regions such as the US, UK, Canada, Australia, MENA, or Southeast Asia.
* Knowledge of landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Experience using tools such as Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other reporting platforms is an added advantage.

What We're Looking For

* Performance-driven mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Passion for experimenting, testing, and scaling successful campaigns.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability for campaign performance.

title: CRM Manager
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a CRM Lead who can write high-converting copy and design automated user journeys across app and web. Your primary focus will be crafting the push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and WhatsApp sequences that guide users through key financial flows. You bring past experience in fintech or digital banking, knowing how to write clear, simple copy for complex steps like KYC, onboarding, and loan applications. You are a high-agency strategist who uses writing to improve retention and solve funnel drop-offs.
  
  
**Focus Area 1: Copywriting & Journey Architecture**

* Core Copywriting: Write all copy for push notifications, in-app banners, SMS, WhatsApp messages, and email sequences.
* Journey Mapping: Structure communication flows across the user lifecycle, adapting message angles based on user behavior and drop-off points.
* Funnel Drop-Off Recovery: Identify friction points in registration and product funnels, writing targeted recovery messaging to bring users back.
* Voice & Clarity: Keep messaging simple, direct, and transparent across all dynamic templates and automated sequences.

**Focus Area 2: Narrative Experimentation & Analytics**

* A/B Copy Testing: Run continuous experiments testing subject lines, hooks, message length, call-to-action buttons, and value propositions.
* Performance Analysis: Track open rates, click-through rates, and conversion metrics to see which messaging variations drive actual transactions.
* Dynamic Messaging: Set up modular content rules so message copy automatically adjusts based on user profiles and past activity.

**Focus Area 3: Product Alignment & Setup**

* Tech Coordination: Work with Product Managers and Tech Leads to trigger the right messages based on specific user events and backend actions.
* Frequency Control: Manage notification schedules to keep messages helpful without annoying users or causing uninstalls.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fintech / Banking Writing Experience: Direct experience writing product copy and lifecycle campaigns for digital banking, lending, payments, or investment apps.
* CRM Stack Fluency: Hands-on experience working with tools like MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, or Braze to set up and send written campaigns.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to read funnel drop-off charts and figure out what copy change will fix the leak.

**Mindset To Succeed**

* Clear Communication: You know how to distill complex financial products into one or two clear sentences.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of retention metrics, rewriting underperforming campaigns without waiting for a nudge.
* Audience Understanding: You understand user hesitation around financial decisions and write a copy that builds trust and prompts action.

**Additional Information**
PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
  
  
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Associate Director - Growth
description:
At Pocket, we’ve experienced rapid growth in both revenue and scale over the past few years, further fueling our ambition. With a long-term vision, we are well-positioned and well-capitalized to drive sustained expansion. Our success will come from bringing in the right leaders to help shape our future.

We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. These roles demand the ability to solve novel, first-of-their-kind problems often without precedent. This position involves leading key functions, including creative teams, production, digital marketing, and user acquisition, as well as managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives. Thriving at Pocket requires a mix of high IQ and EQ, analytical rigor, an entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to influence C-suite decision-making.

We offer ambitious goals, complex problem-solving, and full ownership over execution. Prior experience solving similar problems isn’t required. What matters is adaptability, a willingness to learn and reinvent, and intellectual humility.

***What will you own***

**Building the Social & Creator Economy Layer**

We are evolving from a distribution platform to a creator-led ecosystem.

You will lead:

* Development of a Fanbase Economy where writers actively acquire and engage their own audiences
* Creation of a structured Writer-to-Writer community to drive collaboration, learning, and stickiness
* Redefinition of discovery models to improve visibility and hit velocity for emerging creators Strengthening network effects that improve retention and long-term platform loyalty

The goal is to transition UGC from transactional publishing to community-driven growth

**Global Expansion & Localization**

UGC has scaled meaningfully in Hindi. The next frontier is international growth.

You will:

* Lead UGC expansion into the US, replicate and localize the Conversion-Acquisition-Retention flywheel
* Adapt incentive structures, editorial frameworks, and monetization models to local dynamics
* Build scalable operations across geographies

This is not replication, it is strategic localization at scale.

**AI-First Creator Adoption**

We are building an AI Co-Pilot ecosystem to enable writers to create faster and at higher quality. You will drive the adoption of:

* Writing enhancement agents (outline expansion, draft acceleration)
* Logline-to-story automation tools
* Production-grade SFX, music, and voice modulation systems

The objective is to embed AI into everyday creator workflows and unlock exponential content velocity.

**The foundation you will scale**

You will build on an already established three-pronged strategy:

* Conversion - Turning listeners into writers through contests and incentives (writer activity already up ~50%)
* Acquisition - Targeted onboarding of high-performing writers from competing platforms
* Retention - “Red Carpet” experience for top creators, including ~16% average revenue share and multi-format adaptation pathways (Novel → Series/TV)

Your role is to optimize, scale, and globalize this system.

***Why this role matters***

This role sits at the center of one of the most exciting shifts in global entertainment, the formalization of creator economies in long-form storytelling.

You will shape:

* The earning potential of hundreds of thousands of writers
* The discovery and distribution model of global audio fiction
* The integration of AI into creative workflows

***Here’s what we are looking for:***

* Astute problem-solving skills and ability to break (seemingly) large problems into smaller, practical, solvable pieces, and a data-driven approach to decision-making, with a keen eye for insights and metrics
* Someone who excels at developing and implementing a plan from concept to completion, generating measurable outcomes
* Track record of productive teamwork, starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting their hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* Have an action bias; solve problems, execute, and iterate, if required

title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI
  
  
workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What We Need To See**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

title: Product-led Growth Manager
description:
**About Hevo**

Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, and Groww, to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.

By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what actually matters: generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster decisions.

**What You Will Own**

You own how prospects find Hevo and what happens once they arrive. That spans the organic growth engine, the editorial voice, and AEO strategy that brings technical buyers to the site, plus the trial experience that turns a signup into a paying customer. The two halves are connected: the content you publish sets the intent of the person who signs up, and the trial experience decides whether that intent converts.

This role sits roughly 60% on inbound and organic growth, 40% on trial lifecycle and PLG conversion. You are not a reporter of traffic or a reporter of conversion rate. You are the person who defines what good looks like on both sides of the funnel, instruments it, and ships the work that moves it.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. Inbound, Editorial, and AEO (Primary)**

* Own Hevo's organic growth strategy and editorial voice across inbound, AEO, and content: find opportunities, plan, publish, track results, and improve performance
* Manage the editorial calendar. Plan and prioritize website pages, blogs, guides, ebooks, and FAQs based on business goals
* Set the quality standard for content and make sure everything published follows Hevo's messaging and tone
* Work with writers, subject matter experts, freelancers, and agencies to get content created, edited, and published
* Repurpose content across blogs, AI search engines, sales materials, and social media to extract more value from every piece
* Optimize content to rank on Google and appear in AI search results. Own inbound and AEO, including schema, website structure, and making content accessible to search engines and AI crawlers
* Build and maintain a backlink and digital PR strategy to strengthen domain authority
* Run experiments on content performance, headlines, CTAs, and formats, and iterate based on conversion data rather than traffic alone
* Set up and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio, GA4, GSC) that give a single view of content performance across the full funnel

**2. Trial Lifecycle and Activation**

* Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
* Map the trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, and identify where intent drops
* Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in-app nudges, and re-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
* Act as the internal voice of the trial user in product, GTM, and leadership conversations

**3. Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop-off, in-app events) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
* Design and execute CRO across onboarding flows, high-intent landing pages, and trial touchpoints, with documented methodology and learnings
* Partner with Design on landing page variants for use-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy, Design executes
* Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings

**4. Product and GTM Partnership**

* Surface structured, prioritized insights from organic visitors and trial users into the roadmap process weekly
* Build technically credible collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, and competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
* Create and maintain a weekly product-to-GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from content performance, trials, support tickets, and deal reviews
* Support competitive displacement motions with content and push customers toward a switch decision

**What You Need to Bring**

**Non-Negotiable**

* 5–8 years across Inbound, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling to technical buyers, with direct ownership of organic performance or a self-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
* Strong writing and editing skills. Comfortable across thought leadership, technical content, and competitor comparison pages
* Hands-on data background, or close enough experience alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist to write for that audience without translation
* Working understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha-moment design, in-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
* Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking, plus Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
* Experimentation discipline across both content and product surfaces: A/B tests run with proper statistical methodology, not just a headline swap
* Experience building dashboards or reports that connect content, SEO, and lifecycle metrics to pipeline and business outcomes

**Strong Advantage**

* Experience improving visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and Gemini
* Familiarity with ELT, data pipelines, or other technical products in a fast-growing startup environment
* Familiarity with PLG tools: in-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
* Experience with competitive displacement content at the trial stage
* Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy or CTA edits without filing a ticket

**What Good Looks Like at 6 Months**

**Milestone**

**30 Days**

* Organic content audit and trial funnel audit both complete. Activation milestones defined. Editorial calendar live. First lifecycle experiment shipped.

**90 Days**

* Organic traffic and AI visibility trending up against baseline. 5+ CRO or lifecycle experiments shipped with documented outcomes. Onboarding email sequence live and instrumented.

**180 Days**

* Measurable improvement in organic pipeline contribution and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Competitive trial-stage and comparison content covering top displacement scenarios.
* Lifecycle and content experimentation embedded in sprint cycles.

**This Role Is Not for You If**

* You have only done content marketing or demand gen and have never owned a self-serve conversion funnel with measurable outcomes
* You need a separate analyst to tell you where the funnel is breaking before you can act
* You have never written for a technical audience and are relying on learning it on the job
* You treat content and lifecycle marketing as calendars to fill rather than systems that respond to data

**Job Description**

* Perform competitive analysis and digital landscape assessments to identify visibility opportunities, content gaps, emerging trends, and areas for improving Microchip’s digital presence.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on website, search, and digital performance, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Diagnose website and performance issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions based on data analysis, A/B testing, technical evaluation, and industry best practices.
* Enable and support consistent web and digital optimization practices across the organization through training, documentation, website reviews, and ongoing collaboration with marketing, web, engineering, and content teams.
* Stay current with search technologies, digital trends, generative AI, emerging technologies, algorithm changes, and evolving user behaviors, ensuring Microchip’s digital strategies remain forward-looking and adaptable

**Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or a related discipline
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in technical SEO, supporting complex or large-scale websites, including 8+ years of experience planning and executing successful SEO initiatives
* 8+ years of experience in web analytics and digital marketing, including performance analysis, reporting, and insight generation
* Strong knowledge of technical SEO, including content optimization, XML sitemaps, structured data, robots.txt, schema markup, canonicalization, and other SEO tags
* Solid understanding of core SEO principles, including keyword research, search intent, crawlability, mobile optimization, page speed, and Core Web Vitals
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to review, troubleshoot, and recommend on-page and technical improvements
* Strong proficiency with SEO and analytics tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Raven Tools, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Mouseflow, and similar platforms; hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, and relevant certifications is a strong advantage
* Experience working with enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager) in large, multi-site environments
* Experience with Python or scripting and automation to support SEO audits, web crawling, and large-scale technical analysis is a plus
* Familiarity with AEO and GEO, including structured content and schema for AI-driven search experiences is preferred
* Demonstrated interest in emerging search technologies, AI-driven discovery, and evolving search algorithms
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver projects on time, while translating technical insights into clear, actionable recommendations

No Travel

**Must-Have Skills**

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
**About Us**
A new breed of agency that’s independent, brave, and growth-driven.
  
  
We believe brands and consumers are connected by the internet — a living, breathing bridge of cultural conversations. We operate on this bridge, helping brands stay relevant by sparking meaningful, creative, and measurable interactions.
  
  
Our approach?
**ART x MATH.**
By blending creativity with media intelligence, we deliver ideas that not only inspire but also drive ROI.
  
  
Being an independent agency means we have the freedom to be bold, break convention, and pivot quickly, exactly what it takes to win in today’s ever-changing market.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a social-first
**Strategic Account Manager**
who combines the rigour of a management consultant with deep, practical expertise in digital platforms and the ability to run accounts end to end. This is not a coordination-only client servicing role.
  
  
You will diagnose business and communication problems,challenge briefs constructively, develop social strategies independently, translate them into calendars and lead the team responsible for delivery.
  
  
You will be the strategic and operational owner of a portfolio of up to five social retainers, partnering with a senior creative lead who owns creative craft. You should be equally comfortable discussing a client’s business priorities, analysing audience retention on a reel, presenting a 90-day plan and fixing a delivery bottleneck.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Client and business diagnosis: understand objectives, audiences, category dynamics, competitors, brand constraints and the real problem behind a brief; ask the difficult questions before recommending content.
* Social strategy: independently audit social presence, develop hypotheses, conduct platform/category research, define audience and content strategy, build quarterly roadmaps and recommend channel roles and success measures.
* Platform leadership: bring deep expertise in Instagram first, followed by LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook and
* Reddit; stay current on formats, discovery, audience behaviour, content mechanics and community dynamics.
* Content planning: lead monthly planning, content pillars, platform-specific calendars, briefs, topical opportunities and campaign recommendations; translate strategic choices into work the creative team can execute.
* Performance and experimentation: use advanced platform analytics, audience cohorts, retention, watch time, engagement quality, funnels, attribution limitations, testing and ROI frameworks to recommend improvements.
* Distribution thinking: consider creator collaborations, influencer amplification, community-page seeding, social listening, digital PR and paid amplification when relevant to the business objective.
* Account operations: own scope, milestone plans, calendar lock dates, resourcing requests, approvals,publishing readiness, reporting, client feedback, revisions, escalations and delivery quality.
* Commercial stewardship: understand retainer economics, utilisation, profitability, scope creep and opportunities for expansion; partner with Priyanka on pricing and significant commercial decisions.
* Team leadership: manage, coach and develop Account Executives; delegate tracking without delegating accountability; build a team capable of independent, reliable execution.
* Client advisory: develop trusted relationships, lead routine strategic conversations and constructively challenge weak briefs. Co-lead major reviews, sensitive client conversations and high-stakes presentations with Head of Business and Director of Business Development

**Decision rights and collaboration**

* Own strategic relevance, client understanding and account delivery; the creative counterpart owns creative craft and execution quality.
* Routine BAU work is jointly approved by the Account Manager and Creative Lead under the Social Protocol. Neither party overrides the other unilaterally.
* Where the two disagree, resolve through evidence and discussion; escalate unresolved decisions to BAU Head or the designated senior decision-maker.
* Escalate major client, reputation, commercial or delivery risks at the appropriate time rather than either hiding problems or involving leadership in routine work.
* Work with the broader Pod to maintain day-to-day delivery while ensuring each account has a credible quarterly direction.

**What You Should Bring**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience across digital/social strategy, client leadership, account management or adjacent roles; agency experience is useful but not mandatory.
* Demonstrable social-first expertise and the ability to explain why specific formats, platform choices and distribution approaches work.
* A consulting mindset: structured problem definition, clear hypotheses, research discipline, evidence-led recommendations and persuasive storytelling.
* Experience developing and implementing social plans—not just creating presentations or managing calendars.
* Advanced comfort with analytics and measurement, including the distinction between content performance,distribution performance and business outcomes.
* Strong client communication, relationship-building and constructive challenge; confidence without unnecessary confrontation.
* Commercial awareness and operational discipline across simultaneous accounts, deadlines, creative teams and competing priorities.
* Ability and willingness to train junior colleagues and thrive in the pace, ambiguity and collaboration of agency life.

**How Success Will Be Evaluated**
Performance will be measured against Wirality’s Account Manager KRAs and the Social Protocol, with particular emphasis on:
  
  

* Quality and effectiveness of quarterly strategies and monthly content plans.
* Client satisfaction, retention, relationship quality and strength of recommendations.
* On-time delivery, planning reliability, scope control and account commercial health.
* Measurable platform learning, experimentation and performance improvement.
* Quality of AE development, cross-functional collaboration and reduction in preventable senior escalations.
* Contribution to proactive opportunities and innovation across the account portfolio.

**Growth opportunity**
The intended progression is Cluster Head – Strategy. Promotion is performance-based: the individual should consistently meet the existing Account Manager KRAs with ease and demonstrate performance approximately 20% beyond the expected standard, alongside clear evidence that they can lead others and manage a wider
  
  
strategic remit. This is not a time-bound promotion promise.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
This is not a role for someone whose primary strength is following up with designers, passing on client feedback or producing generic calendars. We need a strategic advisor who also takes ownership of execution—and who can help make the Pod less dependent on senior management for routineSkills: digital,communication,strategy
