**About Us:**

Trail is the context layer AI agents run on. We're building the missing layer between your company's rules, exceptions, and institutional knowledge and the agents trying to act on them. It's a governed graph that lets any agent or platform, including Trail agents, make the right call on your most complex business processes. Agents today fail not because models are weak, but because they're never given the judgment a business builds up over years. We're fixing that.

Visit our Website and Youtube to learn more!

**The role**

This is a builder's role. You'll work closely with the leadership and sales teams to identify high-potential opportunities, run GTM experiments and unlock new channels for growth. From testing a new customer segment to experimenting with account-based marketing or exploring an untapped channel, you'll own initiatives end-to-end and turn what works into repeatable growth engines.

We're looking for someone smart, driven, and entrepreneurial — someone who takes initiative, moves fast, and is comfortable figuring things out without a playbook. Founder experience is a strong plus.

**What you'll do**

**1. Run GTM experiments**

* Identify promising customer segments, use cases, and GTM approaches for Trail and its products.
* Design and execute experiments to test new messaging, ICPs, outreach strategies, and conversion levers.
* Analyse results, identify what works, and rapidly iterate to improve qualified pipeline generation.

**2. Build and scale outbound motions**

* Develop targeted outbound strategies for enterprise accounts across relevant industries.
* Experiment with prospecting approaches, account prioritisation, messaging, and outreach tools.
* Work closely with AEs to turn insights from customer conversations into more effective prospecting and pipeline generation.

**3. Create new GTM channels**

* Identify and test new ways to reach enterprise buyers through conferences, events, account-based marketing, partnerships, communities, content-led acquisition, and emerging GTM tools.
* Take new initiatives from idea to execution, measure outcomes, and scale the channels that demonstrate traction.
* Explore unconventional approaches to reaching decision-makers and generating qualified opportunities.

**4. Own outcomes end-to-end**

* Track funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and use data to make decisions.
* Build lightweight processes and repeatable playbooks around successful experiments.
* Work directly with leadership, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and taking ownership from strategy through execution.

* Curious about new AI and GTM tools and willing to use them to move faster and work smarter.
* Can engage with different stakeholders, articulate ideas clearly, and build conviction around new initiatives.

title: Senior Brand Manager - D2C
description:
We seek a Brand Lead for a personal care D2C brand in Bengaluru.

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

• Continuously define and evolve the brand vision, positioning, and narrative architecture across multiple touchpoints and high creative volume

• Build and own the brand roadmap aligned with business, product, and growth strategy

• Lead consumer education strategy to shape perceptions

• Own the brand bible - positioning, tone of voice, visual identity guidelines - and evolve it as the brand scales

• Develop competitive moat: identify whitespace, track competitor positioning, and sharpen

the brand's differentiation

2. Integrated Campaign & Channel Leadership

• Lead 360° flagship campaigns - from brief to creation to launch - ensuring creative excellence and measurable commercial outcomes

• Drive go-to-market strategy and launch playbooks for new product drops end to end

• Oversee the content calendar: ensure every piece earns its place in the brand narrative across social, digital, packaging, and offline

• Partner with growth and performance teams so brand and performance speak the same language

3. Creator & Community Ecosystem

• Identify, build, and manage a high-volume creator programme - spanning nano, micro, and macro tiers - with clear briefs, feedback loops, and performance benchmarks

• Build and nurture community and collaborator partnerships that feel genuinely native to the brand

• Own the influencer marketing strategy: pipeline, contracting, content direction, and results tracking at scale

• Develop ambassador and long-term creator relationships beyond one-off campaigns

4. CRM, Retention & Lifecycle Marketing

• Own the CRM and lifecycle marketing strategy in partnership with the growth team - from acquisition to retention to reactivation

• Define segmentation, cohort logic, and messaging frameworks across email, WhatsApp, and push channels

• Drive brand-led retention levers: loyalty, community, subscription, and repeat purchase programmes

• Ensure consistent brand voice and experience across every CRM touchpoint

5. Consumer Insights & Market Intelligence

• Build a robust consumer insight engine: qualitative research, surveys, social listening, cohort analysis, and brand health tracking

• Translate insights into brand strategy, messaging, product storytelling, and innovation opportunities

• Track and report on brand health metrics: awareness, consideration, share of voice, NPS, sentiment, and community growth

6. New Product & Launch Leadership

• Lead brand strategy for new product launches, portfolio architecture, and pricing narratives

• Develop launch playbooks that scale - from pre-launch community seeding to retail

activation

• Work closely with product and R&D teams to ensure consumer-centric innovation and

strong storytelling

7. Team, Agency & Budget Leadership

• Build and lead the Brand & Communications team: brand managers, content, community, and creative

• Manage and mentor senior brand talent; establish strong SOPs, playbooks, and workflows

• Own the agency ecosystem - creative, PR, media, influencer - with clear KPIs and governance

• Manage brand budgets independently, including ROI frameworks and quarterly planning

8. Brand Governance & Systems

• Own brand guidelines, tone-of-voice frameworks, visual identity systems, and content governance

• Ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints: D2C, marketplaces, retail, social, packaging, CX

• Create scalable templates and toolkits that enable speed without sacrificing brand integrity

**Job Requirements**

• 8+ years of brand experience, with significant time in a D2C consumer brand - fashion, lifestyle,

wellness, personal care, or intimate care.

•
Equally at home in a strategy deck and a content brief - you write well, think clearly, and present with confidence

• Strong creative instincts: you can spot what’s on-brand in seconds and articulate why

• Deep experience running high-volume creator programmes - you’ve managed large rosters, not just one-off campaigns

• Hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience - you’ve owned the channel, not just briefed it

• Proven track record of end-to-end 360° campaign execution across digital, social, PR, and offline

• Led multiple new product launches with clear playbooks and measurable outcomes

• Data-fluent: you use numbers to pressure-test ideas, not replace them

• A natural collaborator who can lead without a large team behind them

• A genuine consumer of culture - you notice trends before they peak, and know when to ignore them

title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign-  Retail-Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**
The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. You will own customer lifecycle engagement and campaign transformation workstreams for clients across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms, and Life Sciences. This is a workstream ownership role: you carry the client relationship for your track, lead a team of consultants, and are accountable for the commercial outcomes of the campaigns and journeys you design. You translate growth, retention and loyalty ambitions into segmented, decisioning-driven lifecycle interventions and prove the value they create.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Customer Lifecycle Strategy:
* Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle framework - acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, cross-sell, upsell, retention, loyalty, renewal and win-back.
* Define customer segmentation and treatment strategies across lifecycle stage, value tier, behavioural profile, propensity, risk and engagement level.
* Own the campaign calendar and prioritisation across a complex, multi-channel environment, balancing commercial objectives, customer relevance, contact policy and regulatory requirements.
* Next Best Action & Personalisation:
* Translate business objectives into Next Best Action and Next Best Offer strategies - eligibility, suitability, applicability and prioritisation logic.
* Work with decisioning, data and martech teams to define engagement policies, arbitration rules, contact policy and suppression frameworks.
* Drive the shift from batch campaign execution to trigger-based, event-driven, real-time and always-on engagement.
* Industry-Specific Growth & Retention Programmes:
* Retail: Design lifecycle programmes that drive repeat purchase, purchase frequency, basket growth, loyalty participation, category expansion, omnichannel conversion and customer retention.
* Financial Services: Design onboarding, activation, product adoption, cross-sell, wallet-share, servicing, retention and lifetime-value programmes while accounting for consent, suitability and regulatory controls.
* Software & Platforms: Drive onboarding completion, feature adoption, free-to-paid conversion, usage expansion, subscription renewal, churn prevention and reactivation across user and account lifecycles.
* Life Sciences: Shape compliant HCP and patient engagement journeys, including HCP education, patient support programme enrolment, adherence, persistence and omnichannel engagement, in partnership with medical, legal and regulatory stakeholders.
* Journey & Channel Orchestration:
* Design omnichannel journeys across email, SMS, mobile app, push notifications, web, ecommerce, digital media, contact centre, sales and assisted channels.
* Translate customer behaviours, transactions and business events into automated lifecycle journeys and timely interventions.
* Optimise channel mix, cadence, content relevance and customer experience across touchpoints.
* Generative AI in Customer Engagement:
* Identify and land GenAI use cases across campaign planning, brief development, audience intelligence, content generation, personalisation and performance summarisation.
* Define quality, brand, compliance and human-review guardrails for AI-generated customer communication, with controls appropriate to regulated industries.
* Measurement & Optimisation:
* Own lifecycle performance measurement across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, loyalty, renewal and customer lifetime value.
* Lead the test-and-learn agenda - control group design, A/B and multivariate testing, and incremental value attribution.
* Present performance read-outs and optimisation recommendations to client marketing and business leadership.
* Team & Delivery Management:
* Lead and coach a team of consultants and analysts; review and sign off on campaign strategy, journey design, build quality and reporting.
* Manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks and client expectations across marketing, sales, service, data, technology and compliance stakeholders.
* Business Development Support:
* Contribute to business cases, solution shaping and proposals; build reusable lifecycle marketing assets, accelerators and industry playbooks.

title: Information Technology Procurement Manager
description:
Walkin In Drive -15 oct 2026 (Electronic City)

Job Description: IT Procurement Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Procurement Manager to oversee IT procurement activities, strategic sourcing, vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and tendering processes. The role involves managing procurement operations, collaborating with internal stakeholders, ensuring cost-effective purchasing, and leading a team to achieve business objectives.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end IT procurement activities, including sourcing, tendering, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and order tracking.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business requirements and cost-optimisation goals.
* Manage IT vendor relationships, evaluate supplier performance, and negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and service agreements.
* Oversee RFQ, RFP, and tendering processes, including bid evaluation, vendor shortlisting, and supplier selection.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls, contractual obligations, and approval workflows.
* Coordinate with IT teams, business stakeholders, requesters, finance, and legal teams to understand purchasing requirements.
* Monitor procurement spend, identify savings opportunities, and support budgeting and cost-allocation activities.
* Oversee purchase order management, order fulfilment, invoice-related queries, and resolution of procurement issues.
* Manage vendor onboarding, vendor master data, procurement catalogues, and supplier documentation.
* Identify opportunities to streamline procurement workflows, improve turnaround times, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Prepare procurement reports, analyse supplier performance, and provide updates on savings, spend, and key performance indicators.

People Management Responsibilities

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of procurement professionals to achieve operational and business targets.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor workloads, and ensure timely completion of procurement activities.
* Set individual and team performance goals and track KPIs, productivity, accuracy, and SLA adherence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify training and development needs.
* Support team members in resolving complex procurement issues and managing stakeholder escalations.
* Encourage collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and process improvement within the team.
* Manage resource planning, prioritisation, and coordination across multiple procurement activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Strong experience in IT procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing, or vendor management.
* Experience managing RFQs, RFPs, tenders, vendor evaluations, and contract negotiations.
* Good understanding of purchase requisition and purchase order workflows.
* Experience with procurement systems such as SAP MM or other ERP platforms.
* Strong commercial awareness, negotiation, and cost-management skills.
* Knowledge of vendor master data, catalogue management, and procurement controls.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated people-management experience, including team leadership, performance monitoring, and coaching.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel and procurement reporting.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and drive process improvements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in
**IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor negotiations, tender management, and team leadership**
will be preferred. The ideal candidate should combine strong procurement knowledge with the ability to manage stakeholders, lead a team, and improve procurement efficiency.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Manager, Software Engineering**
with 12+ years of experience to lead our Database Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure team. In this role, you will lead a team of high-performing engineers responsible for architecting, scaling, and optimizing multi-cloud relational and in-memory database platforms. You will bridge technical execution, engineering leadership, and strategic infrastructure planning across AWS and Azure environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Lead the architectural design and operations of enterprise-grade, multi-cloud relational databases across AWS (RDS PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora) and Azure (Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance).
* Drive high-availability architecture strategies, including Multi-AZ deployments, auto-failover groups, read replica scaling, and cross-region disaster recovery (DR).
* Oversee zero-downtime operations, including major-version engine upgrades, schema migrations, and blue/green deployment strategies.

**In-Memory Infrastructure & Open-Source Strategy**

* Manage scale operations for in-memory datastores (AWS ElastiCache, Azure Cache for Redis), focusing on cluster mode operations, eviction policies, and persistence tuning.
* Spearhead open-source caching initiatives and migration pathways from Redis to Valkey (e.g., AWS ElastiCache for Valkey) using zero-downtime tools like RedisShake to ensure open-source license compliance and optimize cloud spend.

**Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps**

* Enforce an IaC-first engineering culture using Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation to eliminate manual configuration and console drift.
* Drive automated database provisioning, drift detection, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for database schemas using tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

**FinOps & Performance Optimization**

* Partner with Finance and DevOps to drive FinOps practices: conduct cost allocation, rightsizing exercises, and reserved instance / savings plan management.
* Evaluate and implement optimal architectural tradeoffs between serverless and provisioned computing models (e.g., Aurora Serverless v2, Azure SQL Serverless).
* Monitor performance using AWS Performance Insights and Azure Diagnostics to optimize query performance, indexing, and resource usage.

**Team Management & Operational Excellence**

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of senior database and cloud infrastructure engineers.
* Set operational standards, service level objectives (SLOs), and incident management practices for database availability, security, and scalability.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 12+ years of total software engineering / infrastructure experience, with at least 3–5 years in an engineering management or technical leadership role focused on cloud databases.
* Multi-Cloud Mastery: Deep hands-on experience operating managed relational databases in both AWS and Azure environments at enterprise scale.
* In-Memory & Valkey Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Redis clusters and navigating Redis-to-Valkey migration strategies to reduce operational overhead and licensing costs.
* Automation & IaC: Mastery of Infrastructure as Code principles (Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and database migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase).
* FinOps Expertise: Demonstrated ability to optimize multi-cloud infrastructure costs, manage serverless vs. provisioned workloads, and deliver measurable cloud cost savings (20–30%+).
* Operations & Resiliency: Direct experience implementing automated backups, zero-downtime blue/green deployments, major version upgrades, and multi-region disaster recovery.

title: Customer Intelligence Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and curious
**Customer Intelligence Analyst**
who will help our teams better understand how customers experience our products.
  
  
This role goes beyond traditional reporting and analytics. The successful candidate will act as a
**Customer Reality Champion**
, connecting customer feedback, product usage data, operational signals, UX research insights, and validation findings into a clear and actionable understanding of customer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate is not only skilled at working with data but also passionate about uncovering patterns, identifying meaningful signals, and helping teams make better decisions. They will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Engineers, Customer Success teams, and Experience Validation specialists to surface insights that improve customer outcomes and drive product decisions.
  
  
This role is critical to scaling Product Experience across the organization by transforming fragmented information into reusable intelligence that teams can leverage throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Deliverables**

* Connect customer feedback, product usage data, operational signals, UX research findings, and validation insights into a unified intelligence view
* Design and maintain taxonomies, classifications, and information structures that enable consistent analysis across products and portfolios
* Extract, clean, combine, and analyze data from various sources including APIs, analytics platforms, operational systems, exports, and internal repositories
* Identify trends, patterns, experience gaps, adoption challenges, and opportunities across customer workflows
* Distinguish meaningful customer and product signals from noise, incomplete information, and collection artifacts
* Partner with UX, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Experience Validation teams to support evidence-based decision making
* Create repeatable approaches for organizing and scaling customer intelligence across portfolios
* Translate complex data and findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business and technical stakeholders
* Support experience measurement and validation initiatives through intelligence gathering and analysis
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, definitions, and intelligence assets that improve organizational understanding
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and knowledge synthesis while maintaining appropriate quality controls
* Identify opportunities to improve how customer insights, experience data, and operational signals are captured and leveraged across the organization
* Contribute to post-release analysis and ongoing monitoring of customer experience outcomes

**ORGANIZATIONAL ALIGNMENT**

* Reports to the Senior Manager, User Experience
* Works closely with UX Designers, Product Managers, Engineers, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Experience Validation specialists
* Partners closely with the PXV Enablement Specialist to support scalable validation and customer understanding practices
* Willing to work across time zones

**Qualifications**
**SKILLS & WORK TRAITS**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify meaningful patterns across multiple data sources
* Ability to create structure from ambiguous, incomplete, or inconsistent information
* Experience developing taxonomies, classifications, frameworks, or information models
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate findings into actionable insights
* Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity
* Self-starter who is comfortable working in a greenfield environment with evolving requirements
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, UX, Engineering, Customer Success, and Validation teams
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and independently investigating problems
* Values-driven, curious, and proactive in identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes
* Strong judgment and healthy skepticism when interpreting data and AI-generated outputs

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**
**Required**

* Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data
* Experience using Python for data analysis, transformation, or automation
* Experience gathering and analyzing data from multiple systems and sources
* Ability to work with structured and semi-structured datasets
* Experience documenting findings, insights, and data definitions
* Familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted workflows

**Preferred**

* Experience with Google Analytics, BigQuery, Gong, New Relic, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar platforms
* Experience with customer intelligence, product intelligence, or business intelligence initiatives
* Experience creating taxonomies, metadata models, knowledge structures, or information architectures
* Experience supporting AI, search, retrieval, or knowledge-management initiatives
* Enterprise SaaS experience
* Experience working with highly configurable, multi-tenant software platforms

**Experience Required**

* 4+ years of experience in analytics, customer intelligence, product intelligence, business analysis, research operations, product operations, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of experience and demonstrated capability will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience transforming multiple data sources into actionable business insights
* Experience working directly with product, customer, or operational data
* Experience presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders
* Proven ability to independently investigate complex questions using qualitative and quantitative information
* Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional product organizations

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
**About BiteSpeed**

Hey there! We are a
**Sequoia-backed SaaS startup**
building an AI-native Marketing, Support & Sales suite for e-commerce brands.

We’re currently working with
**2500+ e-commerce brands**
globally across 50+ countries and are fortunate to have
**raised $5.5M+**
along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal & more backing us.

💡
**Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!**

**Check out more about us here**
- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200+ odd 5-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).

**We’ve had some solid investors back us**
(making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway) -

Ecommerce AI startup BiteSpeed raised USD 3.5 million

E-commerce AI start-up BiteSpeed raises $3.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge

BiteSpeed Raises $1.9 Million Seed Funding From Sequoia India's Surge

**About the role**

Some problems at BiteSpeed have a clear owner, a clear process and a clear answer. This role is for the ones that don't.

We're looking for a
**Founder’s Office Intern**
who enjoys figuring things out. You could be working on a market research project in the morning, analysing a business problem in the afternoon and building a simple process or automation by evening. The common thread is that you'll be expected to
**take an ambiguous problem, break it down and make something happen.**

You'll work closely with the founders and leadership team across different parts of the business. This isn't a role where you'll have a neatly defined job description or do the same thing every day. You'll get exposure to
**strategy, operations, product, GTM, AI and whatever else is important to the business at that point in time.**

**What you’ll do**

* Work closely with the founders on
  **high-priority business problems**
  across functions.

* Take ambiguous questions and turn them into
  **structured problems, analyses and actionable next steps**
  .

* Conduct market, customer and competitor research to help the team make better decisions.
* Analyse business data, identify patterns and translate them into insights.

* Build simple processes, systems, dashboards or automations to solve recurring problems.

* Work with different teams across
  **Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success and Operations**
  to get things moving.

* Take ownership of projects from
  **figuring out what needs to be done to actually getting it done**
  .

* Identify bottlenecks and ask, "Why are we doing this manually?" or "Is there a better way to do this?"

* Support strategic projects that could range from
  **new market research to GTM experiments, AI use cases, process improvements and special projects**
  .

* Present your thinking clearly to founders and leadership, including what you found, what you recommend and why.

* Learn fast, switch contexts quickly and get comfortable working on problems where the answer isn't obvious.

**What makes you a good fit**

* You naturally enjoy
  **solving problems**
  . Give you a messy question and your first instinct is to figure out how to break it down.

* You're a
  **generalist at heart**
  . You don't need a perfectly defined function to do good work.

* You're highly curious and enjoy learning about how businesses work.

* You have strong
  **analytical and structured thinking**
  and can work comfortably with numbers and data.

* You have high agency. If something needs to get done, you don't wait around for someone to tell you exactly how.

* You're comfortable saying,
  **"I don't know, but I'll figure it out."**

* You communicate clearly and can put your thoughts into a simple, compelling story.

* You're comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities.

* You care about the quality of your work, but don't get stuck trying to make everything perfect.

* You're excited by startups and would rather have
  **ownership over a problem than a fancy job title**
  .

* Prior experience in startups, consulting, strategy, product, operations, entrepreneurship or similar is a plus, but
  **we care more about how you think than what's on your resume.**

**Salary and Location**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Expected CTC:**
We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

**Our Way Of Life**

Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture - but it ends up becoming more than just that.

It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.

**Our Purpose**

At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create. Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:-

* **Personal Transformation:**
  We like to think of BiteSpeed as being a gym for our careers. It’s where we come to do great work we can be proud of and push ourselves in the pursuit of excellence. Is it comfortable? No. Is it painful? Sometimes. Is it fulfilling? Yes. We were never the company that was supposed to win - We started out of a dorm room, solo founder, early engineers who hadn’t written code in their lives setting out to build a global SaaS company. Our roots are in doing things we are unqualified for and we bet on people who want that journey for themselves. There are stories of people across the company from a 20 year old who’s never done sales closing enterprise deals to a college intern owning an enterprise product lifecycle - these are the stories we are proud of. If someone can look back after 2 years of working at BiteSpeed and say they don’t identify with who they were, we’d call it a success and we want to help them get there.

* **Wealth Creation:**
  Somehow most companies are shy about wanting to make money. It’s looked at as this thing which everyone does but no one really talks about. We’re not ashamed of doing it for the money. Wealth unlocks choice. If life is an amusement park, we think there is value to getting an unlimited rides pass. It's purposeful for us to try to create wealth that allows people to achieve their life's dreams - whether that's owning a house or booking a dream vacation for their parents. We do this by ensuring everyone in the team gets equity and there are generous cash & equity bumps on a frequent basis to reward performance and alignment in values.

* **Winning Together:**
  We’re not here for a participation certificate. We’re playing to win. The keyword here is ‘together’. Winning ‘together’ is about recognising it’s a team sport. We don't care about man of the match awards, either we win the trophy or we don’t. There is a certain camaraderie that comes with winning together that’s hard to explain, but it’s deeply fulfilling and energising. The question we ask ourselves is - can we play the game like it’s never been played before?

**Our Values**

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values. We have 5 core values:-

* **Go Above And Beyond:**
  We value people who care about doing a good job. Going above and beyond is about doing more than the bare minimum that gets the job done and raising the bar each time we have the opportunity to do so

* **Making Things Happen:**
  Each company has an operating rhythm and this is that for us. Making things happen is the opposite of being passive. It’s about high agency, about always believing there is a way to get what we want and either finding the way or making the way

* **Say It Like It Is:**
  We are candid and direct when it comes to sharing feedback, transparent with our numbers and intellectually honest about the realities of any business situation

* **Progress Over Perfection:**
  We’re not building rockets. We care about moving fast and iterating towards perfection. We like to take a minimum viable approach to prioritisation and problem solving and actively look for 80/20 solutions

* **Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously:**
  Great things are built when people can contribute to pursuits beyond themselves. Being low ego, not needing praise to do a good job, taking feedback with humility, being self-critical all add up to this

**Perks & Benefits**

Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning & keep things fun:-

* **Health Insurance**
  - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* **Quarterly Off-sites**
  - Quarterly off-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* **Cult Fitness Membership**
  - All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* **Personal Development**
  - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance**
  - Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

**How to apply?**

If this sounds interesting
**drop a personal note**
with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
**nikita@bitespeed.co**
. Tell us about something you shipped that you’re particularly proud of (could be due to quality or constraints or anything that made it valuable for you).

Know someone who might be a great fit?
**Refer them to us**
, if they end up joining we'll send you an
**Apple Airpods Pro**
as a gesture of thanks!

For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

Run post-launch reviews, track open issues through closure, and update SOPs and launch checklists so that each launch improves on the last.

* Working knowledge of
  **SQL**

  **Excel/Google Sheets**

  **structured problem-solving and RCA skills**
  , with the ability to identify root causes and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong
  **execution and ownership**
  , with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate across teams, and drive tasks to closure.
* Clear
  **written and verbal communication**
  , with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Operations, and leadership teams.
* Strong
  **product curiosity**
  and an interest in understanding how products are built, launched, and used by customers and operators.
* Comfortable working
  **on the ground**
  with kitchen teams, riders, and customers to understand real-world product challenges

**Role Overview**
You will own regional brand storytelling, creator partnerships, and local consumer activations. You will turn deep local market insights into high-impact content, drive brand affinity, and execute regional growth campaigns to make Purplle the go-to beauty destination in the state.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regional Content Strategy: Conceptualize, produce, and execute hyper-local content aligned with regional nuances, local language idioms, and cultural hooks.
* Influencer & Creator Ecosystem: Identify, onboard, and manage relationships with regional influencers and content creators to build authentic trust and drive brand adoption.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: CRM & Retention Manager
description:
**About Us:**

Playo is a leading global sports activity platform with over 5 million users across 5 countries, connecting players, venues, trainers, and brands in one full-stack ecosystem across 50+ sports. We operate at the intersection of consumer technology, social networking, marketplaces and real-world logistics, and are building a scalable, multi-vertical sports-tech venture with a focus on long-term sustainability and global growth.

**The Opportunity:**

Are you a dynamic and results-driven marketer with a passion for leveraging digital strategies to propel business growth? We are seeking a CRM and Retention Manager to spearhead the execution of marketing automation campaigns and journeys to drive user activation and retention. If you excel in data-driven decision-making, thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, and have a proven track record in executing successful CRM initiatives, this is just the place for you!

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Own lifecycle retention metrics
  . Be accountable for activation, repeat-booking rate, and reactivation of lapsed users, with targets agreed each quarter
* Build and run the lifecycle programme
  . Design automated journeys for each stage (onboarding, first booking, habit formation, at-risk, lapsed) across push, WhatsApp, SMS, email and in-app, using CleverTap
* Segment by value and behaviour
  . Build segments on LTV, sport, city, booking frequency and recency, and personalise content and offers for each one
* Prove incrementality
  . Run every major campaign against a holdout or control group, and report lift in bookings and GMV, not just opens and clicks
* Manage channel economics and user experience
  . Optimise cost per incremental booking across paid channels such as WhatsApp and SMS, and enforce frequency caps, quiet hours, and fatigue rules
* Experiment continuously
  . Keep a backlog of tests on timing, channel, copy, offers, and triggers, and turn the winners into default journeys
* Work across teams
  . Partner with product, data, and marketing on event tracking, in-app surfaces, and lifecycle insights that should shape the product roadmap
* Keep the stack and compliance in order
  . Maintain data hygiene, event quality, and DLT/DND compliance, and evaluate tools when the current stack becomes a constraint

**Requirements:**

* 2-4 years in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, at a B2C consumer tech company at a similar or larger scale
* Has owned a retention or engagement metric (activation, repeat rate, churn, or reactivation) and can show measurable impact attributable to their programmes
* Has built and run multi-stage, multi-channel journeys hands-on in CleverTap or similar tools
* Comfortable pulling and analysing data independently with SQL or app analytics tools, and building cohort and segment analyses without relying on an analyst
* Writes sharp, concise copy and can present results and recommendations clearly to leadership

**Next Steps:**

Believe you have what it takes to join us on the playfield? If so, drop us an email indicating
**"CRM & Retention Manager”**

in the subject line with your resume to
**careers@playo.co**

. We would appreciate it if you could briefly articulate why you believe you are best suited for this role.

title: Associate — Social & Search Ops
description:
* **Title**
  : Associate — Social & Search Ops
* **Location**
  : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings**
  : 2-11 pm

**About Joveo**

As the global leader in AI-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.

**About the Role**

* As an Associate in our Social & Search Operations team, you are the engine of your pod. You own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other channels for enterprise clients who use Joveo's platform to hire at scale.
* You work within a pod structure — one Account Manager and one or more Associates. Your AM owns the client relationship. You own everything that keeps the campaigns running: setup, optimisation, pacing, QA, change requests, and the data that goes into reports. When something breaks, you catch it before the client does.
* This role has no client-facing responsibility on day one. You focus on execution quality and ops discipline. As you grow, there is a defined path to AM.

**What You Will Do**

* Build, QA, and launch paid campaigns across Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max) for multiple client accounts simultaneously
* Monitor daily campaign health: budget pacing, CTR, conversion rates, disapprovals, delivery anomalies — and flag or resolve issues without waiting to be asked
* Manage weekly optimisation tasks: search term analysis, negative keyword management, bid strategy reviews, audience adjustments, ad copy testing
* Execute change requests from clients (via AM): budget changes, geo edits, creative swaps, URL changes, new campaign builds — accurately and on time
* Pull performance data and structure report inputs for your AM's client reporting cycle
* Implement and verify tracking: Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, conversion events, UTM parameters
* Maintain organised account structures and naming conventions across all client accounts
* Flag proactively: if you see budget about to exhaust, a campaign underdelivering, creative fatigue, or a platform policy issue — you surface it immediately

**What You Will Own**

* The operational health of all campaigns within your pod — if a campaign is broken, it's your first call of the morning
* Execution accuracy on all change requests — zero errors on budget changes, URL swaps, or targeting edits
* Your AM has everything they need for client calls — clean data, accurate numbers, no surprises
* Your own learning — platform certifications, staying current on algorithm changes, knowing what a QS drop means before being asked

**What You Bring**

* 1–4 years of hands-on paid campaign management experience — you have personally built and optimised campaigns, not just observed them
* Genuine proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads — you know what a disapproval looks like, how smart bidding works, and how to read a search terms report
* Analytical instinct — you can look at a week-on-week performance table and identify what changed and why
* Attention to detail that is almost obsessive — budget errors, wrong URLs, and broken tracking are not acceptable
* Comfort with pace — you can manage 5+ active campaigns across 3 different clients without dropping the ball
* GA4 and basic tracking setup experience — pixel implementation, UTM structure, conversion event verification
* Clear, structured written communication — your Slack messages to your AM are specific and actionable, not vague
* Bangalore-based or willing to relocate — this is a full-time, in-office role

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, or programmatic/DSP platforms
* Exposure to recruitment marketing, employer branding, or job advertising campaigns
* Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certifications
* Looker Studio or similar dashboard experience
* Experience managing campaigns for US, UK, or other international markets
* Familiarity with Joveo's platform or similar programmatic job advertising tools

**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

title: System Administrator
description:
**About OrbitAID**

OrbitAID Aerospace is an on-orbit servicing and refueling startup building the infrastructure to extend satellite life, enable in-space logistics, and support a growing commercial and defense space ecosystem. As we scale our engineering, business development, and policy operations, we're looking for a System Administrator to build and maintain the IT backbone that keeps the company running securely and reliably.

**Role Summary**

The System Administrator will be responsible for managing OrbitAID's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, endpoints, cloud environments, and internal systems. This role is critical to ensuring operational continuity across engineering, BD, policy, and PR teams, while maintaining the security posture expected of a company operating in aerospace and defense-adjacent domains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Software Administration Across Engineering Teams**
  — Deploy, license, and manage engineering software and company-wide systems (Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, CRM, PM tools); coordinate with team leads on tooling needs and licensing.
* **Infrastructure (Server, Cloud & Network)**
  — Build and maintain servers, virtualization, and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), plus LAN/WAN, VLANs, firewalls, and VPNs, including segmented networks for sensitive systems.
* **System Maintenance & Reliability**
  — Manage patching, OS hardening, backups, and disaster recovery; maintain uptime via proactive monitoring and alerting.
* **Cybersecurity**
  — Implement endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and IAM (AD/Entra ID/Okta) with least-privilege segregation across Commercial, Defense, Policy, and PR functions; ensure export-control-sensitive compliance.
* **IT Lifecycle & Documentation**
  — Manage onboarding/offboarding, endpoint provisioning, and access audits; maintain runbooks/SOPs and provide escalation-level technical support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3+ years of system/network administration experience, with strong Windows Server and Linux proficiency
* Practical experience with virtualization and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls) and IAM systems (AD/Entra ID/Okta)
* Scripting/automation skills (Bash, PowerShell, or Python) and strong cross-stack troubleshooting ability

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with export control frameworks (ITAR-adjacent or Indian defense procurement compliance)
* Experience supporting engineering-heavy environments
* Relevant certifications (CCNA, Network+/Security+, Azure/AWS Administrator, or RHCSA)

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build foundational IT infrastructure for a fast-growing space-tech company
* Cross-functional exposure to commercial, defense, and policy operations in the space sector
* Collaborative, mission-driven work environment
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

description:

Growth & MarketingBengaluru, KarnatakaFull-time4–8 years

You will own Helira's demand engine end-to-end: taking lead generation over from the founder and scaling a self-serve funnel where a homeowner gets an instant rooftop quote in the app.

Apply for this role

**About Helira**

Helira Energy Private Limited is a brand + technology company for residential rooftop solar in Bengaluru. Helira-certified installers carry out the physical work; the warranty and accountability stay with Helira. Homeowners get a self-serve quote in minutes, book online, and see live products and pricing rather than waiting on a site visit to learn what a rooftop costs. The organisation is early-stage and building in the open.

**Why this role exists**

Demand currently runs through the founder. This is the first growth hire, joining in September, and the mandate is to turn founder-led lead generation into a repeatable, measurable acquisition engine — organic-first today, paid-ready the moment budget is switched on.

**What you will do**

* Own the qualified-lead line week by week, and report against it.
* Produce and direct local content in Kannada and English — written, social and video.
* Build Helira's Google Business Profile and maps presence, and manage listings and review surfaces.
* Run residential-community engagement sessions with RWAs and apartment associations.
* Design and run the referral programme, from incentive design to tracking.
* Set up funnel measurement inside the app: source tracking, quote-to-booking conversion, drop-off diagnosis.
* Prepare paid search and social campaigns — accounts, creative, tracking, structure — so they can be switched on for approval without a standing start.
* Run experiments across channels and messaging, and kill what does not work.

**Essential requirements**

* 4–8 years in consumer or D2C growth, with personal ownership of a lead or revenue number.
* Hands-on execution ability. This is a doer role with no team initially.
* Data literacy: you read funnels, size opportunities and design experiments yourself.
* Demonstrated organic craft — content, community, search presence, referrals — not just budget deployment.
* Paid-media readiness: you can stand up and optimise search and social campaigns when activated.
* Bengaluru-based, and willing to be in the field at community sessions.

**Preferred**

* Fluency in Kannada.
* Category experience in home services, real estate, fintech lending or solar.
* Performance-marketing certification or demonstrable paid-media results.
* Content and video production skill.

**What we offer**

* Full ownership of the growth engine at ground floor, with the scope to scale it.
* Direct, daily work with the founder.
* A clear path into the marketing-lead role as the organisation grows.

Compensation: competitive for an early-stage startup; finalised at offer.

description:
**Job Title:**

**Location:**

**About Newtrace**
Newtrace is a climate-tech startup crafting next-generation electrolyzers for the wide-scale adoption of affordable green hydrogen. Our vision is simple — to decarbonise our planet and build a greener, more sustainable future.
  
  
We are a fast-growing deep-tech startup with a diverse team of highly specialized researchers, engineers, and industry professionals. Backed by leading investors including Peak XV, Aavishkaar Capital, Axilor Ventures, and Speciale Invest, we are committed to developing innovative technologies that accelerate the green hydrogen transition.
  
  
For more information, visit: www.newtrace.io
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a passionate and technically driven
**Graduate Engineer Trainee – R&D/Product**
to join our team.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of electroplating principles, electrochemical processes, surface treatment, and metal coating techniques.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers and researchers to support the development, optimization, characterization, and quality improvement of electrodes used in electrolyzer applications.
  
  
**This is an engineering-focused role involving process development, experimentation, testing, data analysis, and continuous improvement rather than routine electroplating equipment operation.**
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Assist in the development, optimisation, and standardisation of electroplating processes for metal substrates and electrodes.
* Support electroplating experiments by evaluating plating parameters such as current density, voltage, temperature, plating time, and bath composition.
* Set up and operate the electroplating pilot line according to specifications and work orders.
* Inspect plated products for quality, uniformity, and adherence to specifications.
* Perform maintenance and cleaning of electroplating equipment and work area.
* Study and analyze the effect of process parameters on coating thickness, uniformity, adhesion, surface finish, and overall coating quality.
* Assist in the preparation, surface treatment, and characterisation of metal substrates for electroplating applications.
* Conduct experiments and support the evaluation of electrochemical properties and performance of plated electrodes.
* Monitor plating bath chemistry and support analysis of chemical concentrations, bath stability, and process performance.
* Identify process variations, coating defects, and quality-related issues, and assist in root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with R&D, manufacturing, and quality teams to improve coating consistency, process efficiency, and electrode performance.
* Support the fabrication, characterisation, and testing of electroplated electrodes for electrolyzer applications.
* Collect, analyse, and interpret experimental and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare technical reports, maintain experimental records, and contribute to the documentation of process parameters, SOPs, and test results.
* Follow laboratory and manufacturing safety protocols, including safe handling of chemicals, plating solutions, and electroplating equipment.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process reliability, quality, and cost efficiency.

**Must Have**

* Educational Qualification: MSc/BSc Chemistry, BE/BTech in Chemical Engineering, Electrochemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong fundamental understanding of electroplating processes, electrochemistry, and surface treatment techniques.
* Knowledge of electroplating parameters, including current density, voltage, plating bath composition, temperature, and deposition time.
* Understanding of different metals, plating solutions, and their impact on coating properties.
* Familiarity with coating quality parameters such as thickness, adhesion, uniformity, and surface finish.
* Basic understanding of electrochemical reactions and electrodeposition principles.
* Ability to conduct experiments, operate pilot production lines, interpret technical data, and document findings.
* Awareness of chemical handling, laboratory safety practices, and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

**Should Have**

* Academic project, internship, or industrial exposure to electroplating, electrodeposition, electrochemical processes, or surface coating technologies.
* Understanding of plating bath chemistry, chemical concentrations, and process control.
* Familiarity with coating defects, troubleshooting methods, and root cause analysis.
* Basic knowledge of material characterisation and coating evaluation techniques.
* Exposure to wet chemistry experiments and electrochemical testing.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and process documentation.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and manufacturing teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to electroplated electrodes, electrocatalysts, or electrolyser-related applications.
* Familiarity with electrochemical testing and characterisation methods.
* Understanding of process optimisation, experimental design, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Interest in green hydrogen, advanced materials, and electrochemical technologies.
* Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced startup environment with opportunities for hands-on learning and technical development.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary matching industry standards.
* 12 days of customary national/state holidays, 18 days of paid vacation accrued monthly, and 12 days of sick leave.
* Rotational shift; 6-day, 54-hour work week, including breaks.
* Health insurance for employees, spouses, and children.
* Accident insurance for employees.
* Maternity and paternity leave policies.
* Stocked pantry, company goodies, and team celebrations.
* Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and researchers developing innovative green hydrogen technologies.

**Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply if you have a strong foundation in electroplating or electrochemistry and a passion for learning.**

**Total Exp-7+ Years**

**Client location -Bengaluru. Bengaluru based profiles who can work for 2 days WFO.**

**Notice-Immediate**

**Role Summary**

The Senior SAP SuccessFactors Consultant is responsible for providing expert BAU support, L3 issue resolution, and continuous improvement for SAP SuccessFactors landscape across EMEA, with a primary focus on Employee Central modules. Currently uses SuccessFactors Employee Central Onboarding, Time Off, and Performance & Goals Management, with Compensation planned for implementation across EMEA.

Ideally, we are looking for a consultant with certification in Employee Central plus at least one additional module such as Time Management, Onboarding, Compensation, or Performance & Goals. We welcome candidates with alternative SuccessFactors certifications, provided they demonstrate a strong willingness to grow and expand their skills across other modules.

The consultant will resolve complex support tickets, deliver enhancements and change requests, support quarterly release activities, and work closely with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, the integration expert, external support partner, AMS providers, and other solution and platform architects to ensure platform stability,

**Key Responsibilities**

**L3 Support, BAU Operations & support Platform Stability**

* Act as the functional L3 support consultant for SAP SuccessFactors, with primary ownership of complex Employee Central issues.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents, data issues, configuration defects, integration-related data errors, and process failures within agreed SLAs, working closely with the support partner, integration expert, and relevant solution architects where cross-platform analysis is required.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring tickets and recommend sustainable fixes, configuration improvements, or process changes.
* Support payroll- and benefits-impacting changes with appropriate validation, controls, and stakeholder sign-off.
* Maintain strong operational discipline through accurate ticket updates, evidence capture, knowledge articles, and handover documentation.

**Employee Central Functional Ownership**

* Provide deep functional support across Employee Central foundation objects, organisational structures, position management, employee data, workflows, business rules, MDF objects, event reasons, data models, and permissions.
* Apply strong cross-module Employee Central knowledge to assess upstream and downstream impacts across Onboarding, Time Off, Performance & Goals Management, planned Compensation processes, payroll, benefits, and expense management integrations before changes are implemented.
* Support and enhance Time Off configuration, including absence types, time account types, accrual rules, holiday calendars, workflows, and eligibility rules.
* Support the planned implementation and future BAU operation of Compensation across EMEA, including compensation data dependencies, eligibility, planning cycles, EC alignment, testing, and post-go-live support readiness.
* Provide practical guidance to HR stakeholders on standard functionality, configuration constraints, and recommended ways of working.

**Configuration, Change & Release Management**

* Deliver approved configuration changes, minor enhancements, data corrections, and change requests across Employee Central and related SuccessFactors modules.
* Ensure changes follow a controlled development, test, validation, and production release lifecycle.
* Lead BAU activities for quarterly SuccessFactors releases, including:
* Release note review and impact assessment
* Regression testing coordination and validation
* Business communication and readiness support
* Post-release stabilisation and defect resolution
* Ensure Development, Test, and Production environments remain aligned and appropriately controlled.
* Manage system administration activities, including role-based permissions, security controls, workflow maintenance, and certificate renewals where applicable.

**Integration Data Support, Payroll & Benefits Awareness**

* Provide functional BAU support for SuccessFactors data and configuration issues that may impact integrations with downstream systems, including SAP Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll solutions, benefits platforms, and expense management systems.
* SAP Employee Central Payroll and other regional or third-party payroll providers
* Benefits platforms and external benefits providers
* Finance, ERP, reporting, data warehouse, and expense management platforms
* Identity and access management solutions
* Investigate failed interface records from a functional and data perspective, identify whether incorrect or incomplete Employee Central data has caused the failure, and apply or coordinate the required data correction.
* Where failures are caused by technical integration design, middleware, mapping, connectivity, or development issues, coordinate with the integration expert, support partner, or relevant technical team rather than owning the build or development activity.
* Understand the impact of Employee Central data changes on Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll, benefits, expense management, reporting, security, and downstream processes.
* Support functional regression testing and validation of BAU enhancements and change requests where Employee Central data, configuration, payroll, benefits, or expense management processes may be impacted.
* This role is not responsible for technical integration build, middleware development, interface design, or code-level changes.

**Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure SuccessFactors configuration and support activities adhere to governance, data protection, security, audit, and local regulatory requirements.
* Participate in CAB and formal change governance, providing clear impact assessments, implementation plans, and rollback considerations.
* Maintain accurate configuration, support, process, and integration documentation.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, and regional stakeholders.
* Translate technical and configuration issues into clear business language and provide pragmatic recommendations.
* Work closely with the external support partner, AMS providers, SAP Support, internal technology teams, integration expert, and other team architects to resolve complex functional issues, data-related integration failures, and enhancement requests in line with agreed standards.
* Collaborate with solution architects, integration architects, enterprise architects, and platform owners to ensure proposed functional fixes and changes are technically sound, supportable, scalable, and aligned with the overall SAP and HR technology roadmap.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior analysts within the BAU team.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Essential**

**Desirable**

Strong hands-on experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors in a BAU, support, or application management environment.

SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification is preferred, ideally supported by at least one additional SuccessFactors certification or strong hands-on experience in Time Management, Onboarding, Compensation, or Performance & Goals.

Candidates with alternative SuccessFactors certifications will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong functional capability, adaptability, and a clear willingness to grow and expand their skills across additional SuccessFactors modules.

Deep functional knowledge of Employee Central, including foundation objects, employee data, position management, workflows, business rules, MDF objects, event reasons, data models, and role-based permissions.

Strong experience with Time Off configuration, including accruals, calendars, absence types, time accounts, eligibility, and workflows.

Proven ability to resolve L3-level tickets, perform root cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes for complex functional and data issues.

Experience with Compensation configuration and support, including compensation data dependencies, eligibility, planning cycles, and Employee Central alignment.

Experience delivering enhancements, configuration changes, data corrections, change requests, release testing, and regression testing.

Good awareness of SuccessFactors integrations with SAP Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll, benefits, and expense management systems, with the ability to investigate data-related failures and coordinate technical integration issues with the integration expert or support partner.

Good cross-module understanding across Employee Central, Onboarding, Time Off, Performance & Goals Management, and planned Compensation processes, with the ability to assess downstream impacts.

Experience supporting multi-country SuccessFactors landscapes, ideally across EMEA.

Strong understanding of payroll- and benefits-impacting risk, data quality, security, and governance controls.

Familiarity with ITIL-aligned service management, CAB governance, working with AMS or external vendors, and collaborating effectively with support partners and architecture teams.

Excellent stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and IT stakeholders.

Exposure to Onboarding, Performance & Goals Management, Compensation implementation, reporting, or wider HR technology transformation would be beneficial.

: 1) Pathway Co-ordinator, 2) Life Skills Expert

**About the Project**

N.E.X.T (Navigating Employment & eXploring Transitions) supports youth and women through career guidance, skill enhancement, employability development, employment opportunities, and post-placement support.

**1) Pathway Co-Ordinator (Field)**

**Role Overview**

The Pathway Coordinator (Field) will be responsible for community mobilization, candidate registration, institutional outreach, employer engagement, placement coordination, and post-placement follow-up to support youth and women in accessing suitable employment opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct field visits to communities, colleges, ITIs, polytechnics, and other institutions to mobilize youth and women.
* Create awareness about career guidance, skill development, upskilling, and employment opportunities.
* Identify eligible candidates and facilitate registration with the N.E.X.T Career Centre.
* Build partnerships with educational institutions, NGOs, community leaders, HR teams, companies, hotels, and industries.
* Identify job vacancies and coordinate candidate screening, interviews, recruitment drives, and job melas.
* Follow up on candidate selection, offer letters, joining, and placement confirmation.
* Conduct post-placement follow-ups to support employee retention and address workplace challenges.
* Maintain candidate, employer, vacancy, placement, and retention records in designated MIS platforms.
* Submit field activity plans, daily reports, and periodic progress updates.
* Travel regularly for community mobilization, institutional visits, and employer engagement.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Social Work, Sociology, Rural Development, or Human Resources.
* Experience in field mobilization, recruitment, placement coordination, community engagement, or youth development is desirable.
* Strong communication, networking, coordination, and interpersonal skills.
* Basic computer proficiency in MS Office, Google Sheets, and Google Forms.
* Knowledge of Kannada and English preferred; Hindi is an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
* Commitment to youth development, career guidance, and employment support.
* Ability to work with diverse communities, achieve programme targets, and maintain accurate records.

**2) The Life Skills Expert**

**Role Overview**

The Life Skills Expert will deliver life skills and employability training to improve candidates' communication, interpersonal skills, workplace readiness, and overall employability. The role also involves career guidance, mentoring, assessment, and post-placement support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct life skills and employability training on communication, teamwork, time management, problem-solving, and professional behaviour.
* Deliver sessions on workplace etiquette, grooming, personal hygiene, gender sensitivity, and professional ethics.
* Prepare candidates through resume writing, mock interviews, group discussions, and interview preparation.
* Provide career guidance, mentoring, and individual support to candidates.
* Assess candidates' employability skills and identify training needs.
* Coordinate with the placement team to prepare candidates for available job opportunities.
* Conduct workshops, career readiness programmes, and institutional training sessions.
* Provide post-placement mentoring to support workplace adjustment and employment retention.
* Maintain training records, attendance, assessment reports, and programme MIS.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports as required.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Psychology, Social Work, Education, or Human Resources.
* Experience in life skills training, employability development, counselling, or youth development is desirable.
* Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and mentoring skills.
* Ability to engage, motivate, and train candidates from diverse backgrounds.
* Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in digital reporting tools.

description:

Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Group (Retail), serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%. Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers.

At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture, empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products. Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies, including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.

In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits, we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally. Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a
**Staff SDE – Java Backend**
who will serve as a
**technical leader**
, driving architectural direction, multi-team initiatives, and the development of highly scalable distributed systems. You will partner with Product, Architecture, DevOps and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful technology solutions across a complex digital ecosystem.

You will independently define and deliver large-scale, multi-phase projects, mentor engineers, and shape technical strategy. The role also includes leveraging
**LLMs and GenAI-driven tools**
to enhance engineering productivity, reduce cycle time, and build the next generation of internal developer experience tools.

**Job Location: Bangalore**

**Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* Drive technical strategy and architecture for complex distributed systems and core platform components.
* Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, multi-team engineering initiatives.
* Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, pragmatic technical solutions.
* Define technical roadmaps, sequence projects into phases, and ensure timely execution across teams.

**Software Engineering & System Design**

* Architect, develop, and optimize microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure cloud-native applications using Azure/AWS.
* Lead system design reviews, architecture discussions, and technical deep dives.
* Solve complex cross-system issues through deep debugging, performance tuning, and root cause analysis.
* Build frameworks and shared libraries to accelerate development across squads.

**AI & Engineering Productivity**

* Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices and LLM/GenAI tools across engineering teams to enhance workflows, improve cycle time, and automate routine tasks.
* Define clear guidelines, training, and standards for effective and secure use of AI tools, including prompt engineering, code generation, and review expectations.
* Integrate AI-driven capabilities such as code generation, unit test creation, log analysis, documentation summarization, and code review assistance into the development workflow.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for AI-generated code, including human-in-the-loop reviews, coding standards, test automation, secure coding, and design-first development.
* Measure and optimize engineering productivity using AI-related metrics (cycle time, PR throughput, AI-code adoption, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction) and continuously identify opportunities to reduce bottlenecks with AI.

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact**

* Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, QE, DevOps, and peer engineering teams.
* Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate across teams to resolve dependencies and align on architectural standards.
* Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor engineers across multiple teams, guiding them in design, coding, debugging, and best practices.
* Participate actively in hiring and talent development.
* Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design critiques, and technical leadership.
* Help define and uphold engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural principles.

**Ownership & Operational Excellence**

* Take full ownership of systems from development to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, and security criteria.
* Proactively identify areas for improvement and propose scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Lead incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills and Qualifications**

**Must-Have**

* **10+ years of professional experience in Java Backend Development.**
* **Deep expertise in Java, J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and building microservices-based architectures.**
* **Proven experience
  *shipping scalable, high-availability, high-performance systems*
  in a microservices environment**
  , including load handling, horizontal scaling, observability, and fault-tolerant design.
* Experience with
  **Kafka, JMS**
  , distributed system patterns, caching, asynchronous processing.
* Hands-on experience with
  **Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift**
  , and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of working with databases: Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.
* Experience designing and scaling systems on
  **Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud**
  .
* Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging capabilities, and system-level thinking.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive technical initiatives.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience applying
  **LLMs/GenAI**
  to improve engineering productivity and developer workflows.
* Prompt engineering experience and familiarity with integrating models into applications.
* Experience with Domain-Driven Design, event-driven systems, CQRS, or enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiarity with Linux systems and container-based deployment architectures.
* Experience with application servers such as Tomcat.
* Contributions to internal platforms or open-source projects.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to influence without authority.
* High levels of self-motivation, ownership, and drive.
* Critical thinking abilities and a strong problem-solving mindset.
* Excellent team collaboration skills and a positive, proactive attitude.
* Adaptability, willingness to learn, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
