Working closely with developers, architects, and other stakeholders, you'll play a key role in delivering highly reliable services that support millions of connected vehicles.
  
  
**We offer you**

* High-tech company that offers an exciting working environment
* Involvement with Electric Vehicle services and products that drive sustainability.
* Tech fund where you pick your choice of tech tools.
* Flat organizational culture founded on trust and autonomy; at WirelessCar, you are not just a number.
* Hybrid Work-life balance

**What You'll Do**
As a Service Reliability Engineer, you will:
  
  

* Monitor and maintain production services to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.
* Lead and participate in incident response, including major incidents, with a focus on minimizing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR).
* Coordinate stakeholders during incidents and communicate status updates clearly and effectively.
* Perform root cause analyses (RCA) and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIR) to drive long-term improvements.
* Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures through problem management.
* Support change management activities while ensuring operational stability and service continuity.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, container platforms, distributed systems, databases, APIs, and backend applications.
* Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to improve observability, automation, and operational readiness.
* Continuously improve monitoring, alerting, operational processes, and system reliability.
* Ensure compliance with security requirements, operational standards, and agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
* Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to team schedules.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm.
* Solid understanding of AWS fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry (OTEL).
* Experience troubleshooting Kafka and distributed systems.
* Database troubleshooting experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and/or MongoDB.
* REST API troubleshooting.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Concourse.
* Experience troubleshooting Java backend applications and JVM-based services.

**Nice to Have**

* MQTT experience.
* AWS EKS.
* Infrastructure automation using Ansible or scripting.
* Experience working with connected vehicle platforms or automotive backend systems.

**Operational Experience**
We're looking for someone with experience in,
  
  

* Incident Management.
* Major Incident Management.
* Acting as Incident Commander during critical incidents.
* Problem Management.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Post Incident Reviews (PIR).
* Change Management.
* SLA-driven operations.
* ITIL-based service management.

**Experience with the following is considered an advantage:**

* Service transition and knowledge transfer.
* SAFe or Agile delivery.
* Vendor coordination within multi-supplier environments.

**Who You Are**
You are someone who,
  
  

* Takes ownership and drives issues through to resolution.
* Has a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting.
* Remains calm and focused during high-pressure production incidents.
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Can coordinate multiple teams during critical situations.
* Makes sound decisions, even when information is incomplete.
* Is passionate about continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Enjoys coaching and mentoring colleagues.
* Demonstrates technical leadership and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5–8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Professional working proficiency in English.

**Why Join WirelessCar?**
At WirelessCar, you'll work alongside talented colleagues from around the world in an open, collaborative, and innovative environment. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, explore new technologies, and continuously grow their careers while building solutions that shape the future of connected mobility.
  
  
If you're passionate about reliability, cloud technologies, and solving complex operational challenges at scale, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Please note:**

* Participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation is required for this position.

**Way of Working**
The work location for this role is our office in central Bangalore, India.
  
  
At WirelessCar we operate in a hybrid setup, combining the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work.
  
  
**Recruitment Process:**
Apply now and join our journey!
  
  
Last application date:
**July 31, 2026**
**Note before applying:**
Our company language is English, please submit your application in English, cover letter is not required; instead, you will answer a few short questions to help us understand your experience and ambitions.
  
  
**To join our journey**
WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

title: NOC Team lead
description:
**Company Introduction**
Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
  
  
Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced NOC Operations Manager / Incident Management Lead to lead 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in AWS operations, incident command, stakeholder communication, monitoring platforms, and people leadership to ensure high availability and reliability of critical production systems.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
  
  
**About Availity India**
Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
  
  
Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced NOC Operations Manager / Incident Management Lead to lead 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in AWS operations, incident command, stakeholder communication, monitoring platforms, and people leadership to ensure high availability and reliability of critical production systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage 24x7 NOC operations and support teams.
* Drive Major Incident Management (P1/P2), bridge calls, and escalations.
* Ensure SLA, MTTR, and MTTA targets are met.
* Govern shift handovers, runbooks, SOPs, and operational processes.
* Hands on Experience on Monitoring tool(Splunk)
* Provide executive and stakeholder communications during critical incidents.
* Manage AWS operational environments including EC2, VPC, Route 53, Security Groups, Load Balancers, and CloudWatch.
* Support Azure operations, Linux, Windows Server, and cloud networking.
* Oversee monitoring operations, alert triage, incident lifecycle management, and ITSM processes.
* Drive automation using PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
* Lead RCA reviews, Problem Management, monitoring optimization, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Mentor and develop NOC engineers while promoting operational excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in NOC Operations, Infrastructure Operations, Production Support, or Incident Management.
* Experience leading large-scale 24x7 operations teams.
* Strong hands-on AWS operational experience.
* Expertise in Major Incident Management and stakeholder communication.
* Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows troubleshooting.
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk, CloudWatch, and enterprise monitoring tools.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, Routing, Load Balancing, and Security Controls.
* Experience supporting Kubernetes (EKS), RDS, Azure SQL, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7.
* Knowledge of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, Rundeck, and CI/CD concepts.
* Understanding of IAM, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security incident response.
* Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
* HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
* Knowledge of SRE practices and global follow-the-sun support models.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.

**Why Join Availity India?**

* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

title: Retention Specialist (Renewal & Reactivation)
description:
**Twin Health**
At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.
  
  
We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
  
  
**Working here**
Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
  
  
Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
  
  
With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
  
  
Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.
  
  
**Function:**
Coach Operations | Twin Health India
  
  
**Open Positions:**
3
  
  
**Program:**
Twin Precision Treatment (Reversal)
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Head of Care Operations
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Retention Specialist**
to drive membership renewals and reactivate discharged members, helping them continue or return to their treatment journey. This role involves consultative conversations with members about their health progress, treatment goals, reasons for hesitation, and available retention options.
  
  
You will work closely with members' assigned coaches, Twin Doctors, and support teams. This is a dedicated retention role and does not involve managing a regular coaching panel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Membership Renewals: Manage renewal conversations starting 10 days before the invoice date, following up on pending payments and helping members continue treatment before discharge.
* Member Engagement: Review members' health progress, enrollment goals, and records before each conversation. Understand their concerns, including financial constraints, travel, difficulty following recommendations, self-directed care, or limited health outcomes.
* Retention & Objection Handling: Communicate empathetically, address concerns without pressure, and offer approved retention options such as discounts, term extensions, Twin Doctor consultations, or increased coach follow-ups, where applicable.
* Reactivation: Contact discharged members, understand their reasons for discontinuing treatment, assess whether their concerns have changed, and coordinate their return to care.
* Cross-functional Coordination: Work with coaches, Twin Doctors, Doctor Coordinators, and relevant app, sensor, nutrition, and payment teams to resolve member concerns and facilitate renewals or re-enrolments.
* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate, same-day records of calls, member decisions, payment commitments, root causes, and outcomes in the relevant systems. Keep trackers updated and share recurring churn and discharge trends with the team.

**Eligibility & Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 3–5 years of experience in sales, renewals, retention, collections, or a similar customer-facing role involving calls and chat.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly targets, supported by measurable performance results.
* Experience with subscription-based or long-term services, preferably in healthcare, health technology, insurance, wellness, or education.
* Strong consultative selling, active listening, objection-handling, follow-up, and customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to explain member progress accurately, maintain detailed records, and work within clinical boundaries without overpromising health outcomes.

**Preferred:**
Experience in healthcare or health insurance, winning back lapsed customers, or exposure to nutrition, diabetes care, or life sciences.
  
  
**Performance Expectations**
Performance will be assessed through membership renewal rates, revenue retained, discharged-member reactivation, payment commitments, member reach, contact schedule adherence, documentation accuracy, and call/chat quality.
  
  
We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

title: Lead Data & AI Platform Engineer [T500-30059]
description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.**

**ABOUT UNDER ARMOUR:**

Our story is a classic American entrepreneurial journey, born from a simple, unmet need identified by an athlete. In 1996, founder Kevin Plank, then captain of the University of Maryland football team, set out to solve the problem of sweat-soaked cotton shirts by creating a moisture-wicking synthetic alternative. That innovation – HeatGear – redefined the athletic base layer and laid the foundation for what is today a global leader in performance apparel, footwear, and accessories.

Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, Under Armour is driven by a clear mission – to make all athletes better. This relentless pursuit of better defines who we are, shaping our focus on performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**OUR PURPOSE:**

Building on this global foundation, Under Armour India is purpose-built to access India’s top-tier talent and embed the brand’s culture into scalable, tech-driven solutions. At its core, this is about empowering those who strive for more – a belief reflected in our values: Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes, and Stand for Equality.

These values serve as a shared framework that guides how we think, build, and collaborate. They connect teams across geographies, reinforce our purpose, and ensure that everything we do is aligned to a common goal – enabling better outcomes for athletes and the business.

At Under Armour India, this translates into an environment where individuals have the freedom to go further, regardless of role. Teams are empowered to develop and deliver state-of-the-art products and digital solutions that enhance performance and drive impact at scale.

**VALUES & INNOVATION:**

Across Under Armour globally, our values act as the thread that unites every teammate, shaping a culture grounded in purpose, accountability, and shared ambition. They are not just principles, but active drivers of how we operate, innovate, and grow together.

This culture is deeply anchored in innovation – a continuous pursuit of better that pushes boundaries and challenges convention. Whether through product innovation or digital transformation, teams are enabled to create solutions that elevate performance and redefine possibilities for athletes everywhere.

**PURPOSE OF ROLE:**

The Lead Professional Data & AI Platform Engineer owns the design, development, deployment, and operational excellence of complex data ingestion and transformation domains within the enterprise cloud data platform.

This role builds scalable, high-volume data pipelines while elevating technical standards across development and deployment practices. You are accountable not only for delivering production-ready solutions, but for ensuring they are reliable, secure, performant, and aligned with enterprise governance and AI-readiness requirements.

You serve as a technical leader within the engineering team who guides architectural decisions within your domain, influencing best practices, and mentoring engineers while remaining deeply hands-on in building and optimizing data products that power Analytics, AI, and Automation across global business functions.

You partner closely with Global IT, Business Stakeholders, Data Governance, Security & Privacy, AI & Automation Engineers, Data Analysts, Marketing Technology, and FinOps to translate evolving business needs into scalable, compliant, and cost-efficient platform capabilities.

You continuously apply modern DevOps and GenAI-assisted engineering practices to enhance solution quality, accelerate delivery, and strengthen the long-term resilience of the platform.

**YOUR IMPACT (Job Responsibilities):**

* Design, build, and optimize scalable ELT pipelines using Snowflake, dbt Cloud, AWS Glue, Airflow, and Five Tran (CDC/log-based replication)
* Own complex ingestion and transformation domains end-to-end, including architectural design, performance tuning, and production reliability
* Write high-performance, production-grade SQL and Python integrated into automated CI/CD pipelines
* Apply advanced data integration techniques to support enterprise analytics, data sharing, AI use cases, and self-service data products
* Demonstrates the ability to effectively leverage approved AI and automation tools to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation while adhering to Under Armour's security, privacy, and responsible AI guidelines.
* Establish and enforce data engineering and data security design patterns, coding standards, and deployment best practices
* Partner with Global IT, Data Governance, Security & Privacy, AI & Automation Engineers, Data Analysts, FinOps, and business stakeholders to influence scalable and secure solution design
* Serve as technical lead during development and deployment cycles, guiding implementation decisions and troubleshooting complex issues
* Act as escalation point for high-impact production incidents within assigned domains and participate in a responsive on-call rotation process to resolve critical production issues as needed upholding data contract SLA’s
* Drive improvements in data quality, observability instrumentation, and reliability engineering practices
* Apply and champion GenAI-assisted engineering workflows to improve development velocity, automated testing, and data product quality
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical coaching
* Continuously improve platform and data pipeline performance, cost efficiency, and scalability

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field with 5+ years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related technical field and 3 years of progressively responsible data and/or software engineering experience OR 9+ years of relevant experience without a degree.
* Strong data engineering and warehousing fundamentals (deployment patterns, data ingestion patterns, database design)
* Experience building high-volume data products and services
* Advanced programming in SQL and Python
* Strong Snowflake expertise
* Demonstrated analytic modeling proficiency
* Experience integrating SAP, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise systems
* Experience working with enterprise data domains (consumer, finance, marketing, supply chain, HR)
* Demonstrated application of security and privacy-by-design frameworks
* Strong experience with AWS services (S3, Glue, IAM)
* Proven successful experience in enabling data replication and cloud data sharing
* Job orchestration tools such as Airflow (i.e. MWAA)
* Understanding of CI/CD and Git workflows
* Proven experience building for or application of GenAI in either RAG workflows, or agentic workflows (i.e., Snowflake Cortex AI Suite)
* Lead the adoption of AI-enabled ways of working, promoting experimentation, responsible use, and continuous capability building across teams.
* Practical work experience utilizing API to build bespoke data pipelines or automation workflows.
* Ability to provide written, visual, and oral interpretation of highly specialized technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Basic understanding of GDPR, CCPA, or data privacy principles preferred
* Experience enabling AI/GenAI workloads at scale preferred
* Experience partnering with FinOps on cost optimization preferred

**WORKPLACE LOCATION:**

**Location:**
This individual must reside within commuting distance from our
office.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring 4 days in-office per week.

title: Senior SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
description:
**Senior SAP SuccessFactors Consultant**

**Total Exp-7+ Years**

**Relevant Exp-5+ Years**

**Location-**
**Client location -Bengaluru. Bengaluru based profiles who can work for 2 days WFO.**

**Notice-Immediate**

**Role Summary**

The Senior SAP SuccessFactors Consultant is responsible for providing expert BAU support, L3 issue resolution, and continuous improvement for SAP SuccessFactors landscape across EMEA, with a primary focus on Employee Central modules. Currently uses SuccessFactors Employee Central Onboarding, Time Off, and Performance & Goals Management, with Compensation planned for implementation across EMEA.

Ideally, we are looking for a consultant with certification in Employee Central plus at least one additional module such as Time Management, Onboarding, Compensation, or Performance & Goals. We welcome candidates with alternative SuccessFactors certifications, provided they demonstrate a strong willingness to grow and expand their skills across other modules.

The consultant will resolve complex support tickets, deliver enhancements and change requests, support quarterly release activities, and work closely with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, the integration expert, external support partner, AMS providers, and other solution and platform architects to ensure platform stability,

**Key Responsibilities**

**L3 Support, BAU Operations & support Platform Stability**

* Act as the functional L3 support consultant for SAP SuccessFactors, with primary ownership of complex Employee Central issues.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents, data issues, configuration defects, integration-related data errors, and process failures within agreed SLAs, working closely with the support partner, integration expert, and relevant solution architects where cross-platform analysis is required.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring tickets and recommend sustainable fixes, configuration improvements, or process changes.
* Support payroll- and benefits-impacting changes with appropriate validation, controls, and stakeholder sign-off.
* Maintain strong operational discipline through accurate ticket updates, evidence capture, knowledge articles, and handover documentation.

**Employee Central Functional Ownership**

* Provide deep functional support across Employee Central foundation objects, organisational structures, position management, employee data, workflows, business rules, MDF objects, event reasons, data models, and permissions.
* Apply strong cross-module Employee Central knowledge to assess upstream and downstream impacts across Onboarding, Time Off, Performance & Goals Management, planned Compensation processes, payroll, benefits, and expense management integrations before changes are implemented.
* Support and enhance Time Off configuration, including absence types, time account types, accrual rules, holiday calendars, workflows, and eligibility rules.
* Support the planned implementation and future BAU operation of Compensation across EMEA, including compensation data dependencies, eligibility, planning cycles, EC alignment, testing, and post-go-live support readiness.
* Provide practical guidance to HR stakeholders on standard functionality, configuration constraints, and recommended ways of working.

**Configuration, Change & Release Management**

* Deliver approved configuration changes, minor enhancements, data corrections, and change requests across Employee Central and related SuccessFactors modules.
* Ensure changes follow a controlled development, test, validation, and production release lifecycle.
* Lead BAU activities for quarterly SuccessFactors releases, including:
* Release note review and impact assessment
* Regression testing coordination and validation
* Business communication and readiness support
* Post-release stabilisation and defect resolution
* Ensure Development, Test, and Production environments remain aligned and appropriately controlled.
* Manage system administration activities, including role-based permissions, security controls, workflow maintenance, and certificate renewals where applicable.

**Integration Data Support, Payroll & Benefits Awareness**

* Provide functional BAU support for SuccessFactors data and configuration issues that may impact integrations with downstream systems, including SAP Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll solutions, benefits platforms, and expense management systems.
* SAP Employee Central Payroll and other regional or third-party payroll providers
* Benefits platforms and external benefits providers
* Finance, ERP, reporting, data warehouse, and expense management platforms
* Identity and access management solutions
* Investigate failed interface records from a functional and data perspective, identify whether incorrect or incomplete Employee Central data has caused the failure, and apply or coordinate the required data correction.
* Where failures are caused by technical integration design, middleware, mapping, connectivity, or development issues, coordinate with the integration expert, support partner, or relevant technical team rather than owning the build or development activity.
* Understand the impact of Employee Central data changes on Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll, benefits, expense management, reporting, security, and downstream processes.
* Support functional regression testing and validation of BAU enhancements and change requests where Employee Central data, configuration, payroll, benefits, or expense management processes may be impacted.
* This role is not responsible for technical integration build, middleware development, interface design, or code-level changes.

**Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure SuccessFactors configuration and support activities adhere to governance, data protection, security, audit, and local regulatory requirements.
* Participate in CAB and formal change governance, providing clear impact assessments, implementation plans, and rollback considerations.
* Maintain accurate configuration, support, process, and integration documentation.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, and regional stakeholders.
* Translate technical and configuration issues into clear business language and provide pragmatic recommendations.
* Work closely with the external support partner, AMS providers, SAP Support, internal technology teams, integration expert, and other team architects to resolve complex functional issues, data-related integration failures, and enhancement requests in line with agreed standards.
* Collaborate with solution architects, integration architects, enterprise architects, and platform owners to ensure proposed functional fixes and changes are technically sound, supportable, scalable, and aligned with the overall SAP and HR technology roadmap.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior analysts within the BAU team.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Essential**

**Desirable**

Strong hands-on experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors in a BAU, support, or application management environment.

SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification is preferred, ideally supported by at least one additional SuccessFactors certification or strong hands-on experience in Time Management, Onboarding, Compensation, or Performance & Goals.

Candidates with alternative SuccessFactors certifications will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong functional capability, adaptability, and a clear willingness to grow and expand their skills across additional SuccessFactors modules.

Deep functional knowledge of Employee Central, including foundation objects, employee data, position management, workflows, business rules, MDF objects, event reasons, data models, and role-based permissions.

Strong experience with Time Off configuration, including accruals, calendars, absence types, time accounts, eligibility, and workflows.

Proven ability to resolve L3-level tickets, perform root cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes for complex functional and data issues.

Experience with Compensation configuration and support, including compensation data dependencies, eligibility, planning cycles, and Employee Central alignment.

Experience delivering enhancements, configuration changes, data corrections, change requests, release testing, and regression testing.

Good awareness of SuccessFactors integrations with SAP Employee Central Payroll, regional payroll, benefits, and expense management systems, with the ability to investigate data-related failures and coordinate technical integration issues with the integration expert or support partner.

Good cross-module understanding across Employee Central, Onboarding, Time Off, Performance & Goals Management, and planned Compensation processes, with the ability to assess downstream impacts.

Experience supporting multi-country SuccessFactors landscapes, ideally across EMEA.

Strong understanding of payroll- and benefits-impacting risk, data quality, security, and governance controls.

Familiarity with ITIL-aligned service management, CAB governance, working with AMS or external vendors, and collaborating effectively with support partners and architecture teams.

Excellent stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and IT stakeholders.

Exposure to Onboarding, Performance & Goals Management, Compensation implementation, reporting, or wider HR technology transformation would be beneficial.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.
  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.
* Complete assigned routine Workday transactions and employee data updates across the employee lifecycle, according to established procedures, approval requirements, and role-based access.
* Review source documentation and validate key information, including employee names, dates, organizations, positions, statuses, and other relevant data, before completing Workday transactions.
* Perform post-transaction quality checks and follow documented validation steps to confirm that changes were processed accurately, escalating unexpected results or potential downstream impacts.
* Research employee and HRIS data discrepancies, reconcile information between source documentation and Workday, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when necessary.
* Support Workday testing for system updates, enhancements, fixes, and configuration changes, including executing test scripts, validating expected results, documenting defects, and tracking issues through resolution.
* Assist with documenting and maintaining HRIS workflows and process maps, including process steps, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process guides, job aids, user instructions, FAQs, and HRIS knowledge articles to improve consistency and reduce repeat questions.
* Review existing workflows and documentation periodically to ensure they remain accurate and aligned with current Workday functionality and business processes.
* Identify recurring tickets, data issues, bottlenecks, or manual processes and share observations and potential improvement opportunities with the HRIS team.
* Support routine data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Prepare, send, track, and validate manual HR notifications, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, and sent to the appropriate recipients.
* Partner collaboratively with Talent & Culture (HR), Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, IT, and other stakeholders as necessary to investigate and resolve HRIS requests.
* Handle employee and organizational data in accordance with established privacy, confidentiality, and information-security requirements.

**What You Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday within HR, HRIS, People Operations, Shared Services, or a similar environment.
* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting Workday Core HCM and one or more related areas such as Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Absence, or other employee lifecycle functionality.
* Experience with JIRA-based HRIS support operations, including queue management, ticket prioritization, escalation, and reporting.
* Experience creating process maps and end-to-end workflow documentation.
* Experience conducting employee data audits, reconciliations, or validation activities.
* Familiarity with system-testing practices, including executing Workday test scripts, validating results, documenting defects, and supporting issue resolution.
* Ability to identify patterns across support tickets and recommend improvements through documentation, process changes, training, automation, or system enhancements.
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative: actively monitoring the queue, recognizing what needs attention, following up on stalled requests, surfacing risks, and communicating when escalation is required.

* WSO2 Certified Professional
* IAM/CIAM Certifications

**About Netradyne:**
 Netradyne provides AI\-powered technologies for fleet management and safer roads. An award\-winning industry leader in fleet safety and video telematics solutions, Netradyne empowers thousands of commercial fleet customers across North America, Europe, and Asia to enhance their driver performance, reduce risk, and optimize operations.
   

  

 Netradyne sets the standard among transportation technology companies for enhancing and sustaining road safety, with an industry\-leading 25\+ billion miles vision\-analyzed for risk and an industry\-first driver scoring system that reinforces safe behaviors. Founded in 2015, Netradyne is headquartered in San Diego with offices in San Francisco, Nashville, the UK and Bangalore.

 Netradyne is looking for talented engineers to join our Analytics team comprised of graduates from IITs, IISC, Stanford, UIUC, UCSD etc. As a Senior Staff Research Engineer at Netradyne, you will lead the development of cutting edge AI solutions to enable drivers and fleets realize unsafe driving scenarios in real\-time to prevent accidents from happening and reduce fatalities/injuries. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build and deploy scalable and reliable AI solutions in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 You will help design, implement and commercialize driver monitoring and driver assistance algorithms. You will have access to very large datasets and will get to deploy new algorithms/models into thousands of vehicles. As a machine learning research engineer, you may
   

  

* Design and commercialize algorithms characterizing driving behavior.
* Design, implement and track key metrics; and architect data\-driven solutions.
* Improve machine learning infrastructure for scalable training and inference.
* Innovate and develop proof of concept solutions showcasing novel capabilities.


**Mandatory Skills:**
* B Tech, M. Tech or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering or a related area.
* In\-depth understanding of Machine learning (Deep learning \& Classic ML) and computer vision concepts
* Excellent programming skills – Python (required) and C\+\+ (desired).
* 9\+ yrs with Research or industry experience within computer vision and machine learning models.
* Ability to take abstract product concepts and turn them into reality.
* Ability to innovate on cutting\-edge problems without documented solutions.
* Hands\-on experience in handling edge deployments targeting various HW platforms.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience with time\-series data
* Experience with Camera calibration, multi\-view geometry, 3D reconstruction, SLAM.
* Experience with road scene understanding (objects, lanes, intersections, signs etc.)
* Experience with successfully applying machine learning to solve a real\-world problem.
* Experience with conducting successful statistical experiments.


 We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.
   

  

 If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.

* Strong interpersonal skills, ethical work practices, and a learner\-centric mindset.

title: Senior Robotics Software Usecases Validation Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
 At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
 **Together, we advance your career.**
**Robotics Software Usecases Validation Engineer**
**About The Role**
 Join AMD’s PAVS team as a Robotics Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real\-world deployments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Validation Strategy \& Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems.
* Automation \& Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2\), and fleet APIs using Python/C\+\+, pytest, gtest/gmock.
* Simulation \& Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi\-robot coordination.
* SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software\-in\-the\-Loop and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging.
* Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions.
* Navigation \& Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance).
* Safety \& Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691\-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15\.06\.
* Performance \& Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high\-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors.
* CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage.
* Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4 to 7 years in QA/Validation, with 4\+ years in robotics or AMR systems.
* Strong Python for automation and C\+\+ for ROS2 integration.
* Hands\-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).
* Expertise in LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, odometry, and sensor calibration.
* Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol.
* CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker\-based test environments.
* Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691\-4, ISO 13849\).


**Preferred Skills**
* Multi\-robot coordination, dynamic obstacle handling, and SLAM algorithms.
* Robotics AMR safety PLCs, zone scanners, and emergency stop circuits.
* Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC\-UA.
* Performance benchmarking, reliability testing, and telemetry dashboards.


**Success Metrics**
* Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios.
* Reduction in field defect escape rate.
* Stability and reliability under multi\-robot deployments.
* Compliance with safety standards and successful audits.

description:

 is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
   

  

 We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
   

  

 We are proud to be part of an ever\-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee\-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

The key role is to continually improve the quality and value of IT Security Operations to the business by analyzing and acting on alerts and incidents from the Security Operations Centre. The role will involve the use of “playbooks” and “knowledge base articles” around incident response. You will play a vital part in supporting day\-to\-day continuity for a dynamic workforce. description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About Wisdom AI**
 Wisdom AI is the generative AI data analyst for the enterprise. We help organizations turn their data warehouses into conversational interfaces. Our users expect high\-precision answers from our AI, and our Technical Support team ensures that the infrastructure, data connections, and prompt logic supporting those answers are flawless.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Technical Support Engineer** 
 , you are the first responder for our most important customers. You won’t just be answering "how\-to" questions; you will be debugging complex data schemas, investigating API integrations, and translating customer business logic into technical configurations.
   

  

 You will live in
 **Slack** 
 and
 **Pylon** 
 , providing real\-time, white\-glove support that feels like an extension of the customer’s own team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Slack\-First Support: Manage real\-time customer interactions via dedicated Slack channels using Pylon. You will be responsible for triaging issues, maintaining fast response times, and ensuring no "ping" goes unanswered.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Deep\-dive into the Wisdom AI platform to resolve issues related to:
+ Data Connectivity: Troubleshooting Snowflake/BigQuery permissions and connection strings.
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Helping customers refine their "Context Modeling" and domain\-specific knowledge.
+ API \& Integrations: Assisting with GraphQL API implementation and Slack integration setups.

* Case Management: Use Pylon to track bugs, enhancement requests, and documentation gaps. You will own the lifecycle of a ticket from initial Slack message to engineering resolution.
* Live Consultations: Hop on video calls with customers to walk through complex "How\-To" scenarios, such as creating custom metrics or configuring Row Level Access Control (RLAC).
* Voice of the Customer: Aggregate common friction points and missing features to provide structured feedback to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Documentation: Contribute to the Wisdom AI Docs by turning common support resolutions into self\-service guides.


**Technical Requirements**
**Stack focus:** 
 SQL, APIs, AI/LLMs, Pylon
   

  

* Data \& SQL: Strong ability to write and read SQL. You must be able to look at a query generated by Wisdom AI and understand why it might be returning a specific result based on the customer’s schema.
* The Wisdom Stack: Proficiency in (or ability to quickly learn) the technical pillars defined in our documentation:
+ Building and managing Knowledge/Context Models.
+ Setting up Evaluations Sets and Runs to test AI accuracy.
+ Managing Workspaces, Organizations, and User Permissions.
+ Working with Deep Analysis functionality and visualization properties.

* API Familiarity: Comfortable using tools like Postman or cURL to test GraphQL endpoints.
* Tooling: Experience with modern support stacks—specifically Pylon for Slack\-based support—is a significant advantage.


**Qualifications**
* The "Support Engineer" DNA: You are naturally curious and won't stop until you understand the root cause of a problem.
* Communication: You can explain a complex RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) concept to a non\-technical business user without losing them.
* Agility: You thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment where the product evolves weekly.
* Empathy: You understand that when a data tool isn't working, it impacts a customer's ability to do their job. You handle high\-pressure situations with a calm, helpful demeanor.


**Why Join Wisdom AI?**
* Direct Impact: You are the face of the company to our customers and the eyes and ears for our engineers.
* Growth: You will gain deep expertise in the "Modern Data Stack" and the emerging field of Enterprise AI.
* Culture: Join a team of high\-performers who value clear communication, technical excellence, and winning together.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Principal Engineer  (Warehouse Engineering)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
 Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
   

  

 What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
   

  

**OUR CULTURE**
 Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
   

  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


 If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
**Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering**
 We’re looking for a
 **Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering** 
 to define the technical vision and architecture for Quince’s warehouse technology ecosystem. You will build the platforms that power inventory movement, fulfillment execution, warehouse operations, and returns across a rapidly scaling supply chain network.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the architecture of Quince’s warehouse integration platform, proprietary Warehouse Management System (WMS), and returns platform. You will solve complex problems across warehouse operations, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment while establishing scalable technical foundations for the future.
   

  

 This role requires a strong combination of distributed systems expertise, operational platform experience, and technical leadership. You will influence architecture across multiple engineering teams, mentor senior engineers, partner with business and operations leaders, and help shape how Quince builds technology for a highly complex and rapidly evolving supply chain.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Warehouse Integration Platform**
* Architect and build a standardized integration platform connecting Quince with third\-party warehouse operators and WMS platforms.
* Define integration contracts, APIs, data models, and engineering standards that minimize bespoke development for new warehouse partners.
* Build scalable mechanisms for monitoring, reconciliation, error handling, and operational visibility across warehouse integrations.
* Establish platform capabilities that simplify warehouse onboarding and improve reliability across the warehouse network.


**Warehouse Management System**
* Define the architecture and technical strategy for Quince’s proprietary Warehouse Management System.
* Build systems supporting inbound, outbound, inventory, fulfillment, and warehouse execution workflows.
* Design the platform to support both Quince\-operated facilities and third\-party warehouse operators.
* Establish scalable multi\-tenant architecture, including data isolation, configuration management, access controls, and extensibility.
* Define architectural patterns that allow the WMS to evolve into a scalable platform for external warehouse operators.


**Returns \& Reverse Logistics**
* Drive the architecture and evolution of Quince’s end\-to\-end returns platform.
* Design systems supporting return intake, inventory reconciliation, restocking, refurbishment, replenishment, and disposition.
* Build operational capabilities that provide visibility into reverse logistics workflows and enable efficient throughput.
* Ensure returns systems meet high standards for reliability, scalability, observability, and data integrity.


**AI\-Native Engineering**
* Drive the adoption of AI\-native engineering practices across warehouse technology.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI to exception management, warehouse operations, workflow automation, and operational decision\-making.
* Partner with Data Science and Operations Research teams to productionize AI and optimization models within warehouse systems.
* Establish reliable architecture patterns for integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while maintaining correctness and reliability.


**Technical Leadership**
* Define the long\-term technical vision, architecture principles, and roadmap for warehouse engineering.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction across warehouse, logistics, supply chain, and platform teams.
* Establish engineering standards around scalability, reliability, observability, data integrity, and operational excellence.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic opportunities across warehouse technology.
* Make high\-impact technical decisions while balancing immediate business needs with long\-term platform scalability.


**Organizational Impact**
* Mentor senior and staff engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization.
* Partner closely with warehouse operations, logistics, product, and business stakeholders to translate operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple teams and domains without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Contribute to hiring, talent development, and building a high\-performing engineering organization.
* Represent warehouse engineering in broader technical and organizational initiatives.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience building large\-scale operational, supply chain, logistics, warehouse, or similar systems.
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems and event\-driven architectures in production.
* Deep expertise in designing highly reliable systems where data integrity, consistency, and operational correctness are critical.
* Experience designing integration platforms and replacing bespoke integrations with standardized, scalable frameworks.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tenant architecture, data isolation, API design, configuration management, and platform extensibility.
* Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineering teams or business domains.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, fulfillment workflows, and operational system design.
* Experience balancing scalability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational complexity.
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to influence senior engineering and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and drive engineering excellence across teams.
* Experience working with AI\-enabled development workflows and/or integrating AI capabilities into production systems.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant ambiguity and ownership.


**Preferred:**
* Direct experience designing or building Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) at scale.
* Experience working with commercial WMS platforms and understanding the trade\-offs between vendor solutions and custom\-built systems.
* Experience with reverse logistics, inventory condition management, refurbishment, and disposition workflows.
* Experience in e\-commerce fulfillment, 3PL operations, retail, logistics, or large\-scale warehouse networks.
* Strong understanding of warehouse automation, inventory accuracy, fulfillment optimization, or operational planning systems.
* Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS platforms serving external customers, operators, or partners.
* Experience partnering with Data Science or Operations Research teams to productionize optimization and decision\-making models.
* Experience in high\-growth, technology\-first organizations with highly autonomous engineering teams.


**WHY QUINCE?**
 Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
   

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**
 Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
 At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.
