title: Senior Engineering Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**About The Team**
 The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org\-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands\-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI\-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity.
   

  

 We are standing up a new India\-based team to expand capacity, enable follow\-the\-sun coverage, and take first\-class ownership of high\-impact platform initiatives. As one of the founding members, you'll help shape a brand\-new engineering site while working on infrastructure that multiplies the productivity of the entire engineering organization.
   

  

 What the team works on
   

  

 GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo): operate the central source\-control and CI/CD platform and enable secure, AI\-assisted SDLC workflows.
   

  

 CI/CD runners: modernize Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android runner fleets improving isolation, queueing, and cost attribution.
   

  

 Progressive Delivery: scale canary, health\-gated, rollback\-aware deployment patterns.
   

  

 Artifactory and supply chain: operate a Tier\-0 artifact platform and improve upgrade, backup, retention, and lifecycle practices.
   

  

 Migration and modernization: retire legacy CI/CD (Concrete) using dashboards, partner engagement, and agentic migration.
   

  

 Mobile build/release and Mobile DevOps: sustain a high release cadence while modernizing build tooling.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 About the role
   

  

 As the Engineering Manager for the new India\-based Delivery Engineering team, you'll build and lead a founding, general\-purpose platform team responsible for high\-impact work across CI/CD and build infrastructure, Progressive Delivery, migration and deprecation programs, GitLab/Artifactory operations, and mobile release/build tooling.
   

  

 You'll own hiring, people management, performance, and career development while bringing enough technical depth to earn credibility, engage in design reviews, and represent India\-owned areas in engineering leadership forums. This is a founding leadership role: the standards you set and the first engineers you hire will define the long\-term success of Delivery Engineering in India.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build and grow a high\-impact founding team that owns platform, Progressive Delivery, migration, and mobile\-release work as first\-class contributors.
* Establish a follow\-the\-sun operating model with defined overlap, handoff practices, async\-first documentation, and a phased India on\-call rotation.
* Hire a senior founding team and set and hold a high hiring bar.
* Partner with US area leads and the TPM to allocate capacity, limit work in progress, reduce context switching, and drive predictable delivery.
* Raise the bar on operational excellence: on\-call practices, incident response, post\-incident reviews, SLOs, runbooks, and toil reduction.
* Champion AI\-first delivery across the SDLC, including agentic migration, AI code review, rollout analysis, and platform operations.
* Create a healthy engineering culture across time zones with clear goals, feedback, performance management, development plans, and technical\-leadership growth.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

****What you'll bring****
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years managing engineering teams that build backend, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or developer\-productivity services.
* Staff\+ technical depth and sound judgment: able to align business goals with platform capabilities and guide architecture beyond the immediate team.
* Strong operating experience: production ownership, on\-call, incident response, observability, runbooks, and improving reliability over time.
* A proven hiring and talent\-development bar: able to recruit, assess, onboard, mentor, and manage performance with clarity and empathy.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication across seniority levels and geographies; comfortable with async\-first decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust with distributed stakeholders and represent India engineering as a peer ownership function.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building or scaling a new site or distributed engineering team, especially across US–India.
* Experience in DevEx, platform, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, release engineering, or SRE organizations supporting many internal customers.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab, CI/CD runners, observability tooling, and modern incident management.
* Experience applying AI to engineering workflows with a quality, governance, and developer\-trust mindset.


 Why join
   

  

* Founding role: shape a new India engineering site and help set the technical and cultural bar from day one.
* High leverage: work on the platform used by every Zillow engineer and every major product surface.
* Modernization agenda: GitLab Dedicated, runner rearchitecture, Progressive Delivery, Artifactory modernization, and legacy retirement.
* AI\-first work: real production use cases across code review, migrations, incident analysis, and deployment safety.
* Global collaboration: partner directly with US engineering leaders while building durable India ownership.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

title: Accounts Receivable Manager – EMEA & North America
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 We are seeking a commercially astute, detail\-driven Accounts Receivable Manager to own the full order\-to\-cash cycle for Demand AI Group’s EMEA and North America entities. A hands\-on individual contributor, this role is the single point of accountability for turning signed client commitments into accurate, compliant invoices and cash in the bank, working across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, regional tax advisors and Finance. Every invoice, collection and reconciliation flows directly into the Group’s cash position, statutory filings and management accounts, so the role demands independent operation across multiple entities, currencies and time zones, sound judgement on escalation, and the ability to hold internal and external stakeholders to account.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Insertion Order (IO) Review \& Billing Determination** 



* Use the global campaign tracker maintained by Customer Success (CS) and Operations to identify all IOs, SOWs and contracts across EMEA and North America due for billing in the period
* Confirm for each IO the correct legal entity, billing contact, PO requirements, currency, payment terms and billing model (upfront on signature, monthly against actualised leads/deliverables, or on contract completion)
* Test\-check billing requirements against the IO/SOW, delivery data and agreed pricing before raising any invoice; flag gaps, inconsistencies or missing documentation
* Raise and resolve queries with CS and Sales promptly, escalating where IO terms, delivery evidence or entity details are unclear or conflicting



  





**Invoicing \& E\-Invoicing Compliance** 



* Issue accurate, timely invoices for all EMEA and North America entities with the correct PO, amounts, taxes, due date and remittance details, sent to the agreed client contact
* Route each invoice through the correct channel – direct from the Group’s accounting software, the client’s procurement/supplier portal, or via local advisors onto government e\-invoicing portals in mandated jurisdictions
* Track portal and advisor\-routed submissions through to customer acceptance, resolving rejections and resubmitting as needed
* Log every invoice in the credit control tracker immediately, with billing model, agreed payment date and portal/advisor status populated



  





**Credit Control \& Collections** 



* Own the end\-to\-end credit control process for EMEA and North America, from customer onboarding and credit checks through to final demand and account hold
* Complete client vendor/supplier onboarding forms and registration requests, providing entity, banking, tax and remittance details; route to the relevant business owners only where forms require detailed operational, data or business\-process information
* Follow the agreed escalation order and maintain the credit control tracker
* Identify and resolve disputes and short payments early, coordinating with CS and Sales to protect account health while securing payment
* Recommend third\-party collection, legal action or credit\-limit reviews to management where accounts remain unpaid



  





**Cash Application \& Bank Reconciliation** 



* Allocate customer receipts to invoices daily across multiple currencies and entities, resolving unidentified or partial receipts
* Complete daily bank reconciliations for all EMEA and North America accounts, clearing reconciling items and escalating anomalies
* Provide daily visibility of cash received and expected receipts to support Treasury and cash\-flow forecasting



  





**Compliance, Controls \& Audit** 



* Ensure invoices and processes meet local statutory and indirect tax requirements (VAT, GST, sales tax, withholding and invoicing rules) in every jurisdiction served
* Maintain strong order\-to\-cash controls aligned with company policy and audit standards, including segregation of duties and approval evidence
* Maintain a complete, auditable trail from each IO through delivery evidence, invoice(s), portal/advisor confirmations, correspondence and receipt to the revenue recognized, so any audit can be supported without rework
* Support internal and external audits, statutory filings and tax inspections across the regions, preparing schedules and answering auditor queries



  





**Month\-End Close \& Management Accounting** 



* Prepare and post month\-end AR, accrual and prepayment journals for the EMEA and North America entities – including accrued/deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, bad\-debt provisions and FX revaluations – with full supporting schedules
* Deliver the AR close to the agreed timetable and contribute to accurate regional management accounts



  





**Process Improvement \& Systems** 



* Standardise AR, billing and credit control processes across EMEA and North America while accommodating local requirements
* Identify and implement automation across IO review, invoicing, portal submission, cash application and collections
* Operate and optimise the Group’s ERP/accounting and AR tools (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Zoho) and ensure disciplined system usage
* Support system upgrades, integrations and data governance initiatives affecting order\-to\-cash



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Part\- or fully\-qualified accountant (CA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) strongly preferred
* 8\+ years in accounts receivable, billing and credit control, including ownership of order\-to\-cash – multi\-currency invoicing, cash application and daily bank reconciliation – across multiple countries, entities and currencies, ideally EMEA and North America
* Hands\-on experience with client procurement portals and government\-mandated e\-invoicing regimes, including working through local advisors
* Experience in multinational, fast\-growing or shared\-services environments strongly preferred



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* Working knowledge of international indirect tax (VAT, sales tax, withholding) as it applies to invoicing across EMEA and North America
* Sound management accounting skills: confident preparing and posting accruals, prepayments, deferred revenue, commission accruals and reconciliations
* Proficient in ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel; comfortable working from trackers and delivery data prepared by other teams



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Self\-starter able to own a full regional cycle independently without day\-to\-day supervision
* Strong stakeholder management: challenges Sales and CS constructively, holds clients to committed payment dates and escalates at the right moment
* Exceptional attention to detail with a test\-and\-check mindset and strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Clear written and verbal English suited to client\-facing collections correspondence; highly organised in maintaining trackers, documentation and audit trails
* Effective across EMEA and North America time zones from Bangalore in a fast\-paced, global environment



  





**Preferred Attributes** 



* B2B demand generation, media, advertising or SaaS experience billing against insertion orders, campaigns or delivered leads
* Exposure to US GAAP and/or IFRS, including revenue recognition
* Process transformation or system implementation experience in an order\-to\-cash function



  





**What We Offer** 




 Competitive compensation and benefits; full ownership of order\-to\-cash for two of the Group’s most significant regions; exposure to international operations, regional advisors and senior finance leadership; and career growth in a fast\-scaling global AI organisation.

**Role Summary:** 




  





 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
 



 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**Network Security Ownership** 



* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.



  





**Threat Detection \& Incident Response** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.



  





**Security Operations Engineering** 



* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.



  





**Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation** 



* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Assurance** 



* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.



  





**Architecture \& Strategic Hardening** 



* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.



  





**Required Experience:** 




  




* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




  




* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




  




* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.

* Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT processes using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) to extract, transform, and load data across heterogeneous source and target systems.

* Implement and manage ODI Topology, including data servers, physical/logical schemas, contexts, and agents.

* Design and build data pipelines using OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms for serverless, auto\-scaling ELT into Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud Service, and non\-Oracle targets.

* Fix performance and reporting issues arising from migration to cloud\-based integration platforms.
* Produce high\-quality code resulting from knowledge of the tool, code peer review, and automated unit test scripts.
* Perform system analysis, follow technical design, and work on development activities.
* Collaborate with other developers, DBAs, and cross\-functional team members.
* Participate in design meetings, daily standups, and backlog grooming.
* Develop and document unit tests.
* Identify, document, and mitigate risks.
* Monitor the health and performance of ODI/data integration services and cloud jobs.
* Document all processes, mappings, and procedures in assigned areas of responsibility.
* Update job knowledge by studying relevant tools and techniques, participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, and participating in professional organizations.
* Protect operations by keeping information confidential.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Participate in Scrum team meetings, including all Agile and Scrum\-related activities.
* Optimize ODI mappings, interfaces, Knowledge Modules, and SQL performance to improve execution efficiency.
* Perform repository migration, version upgrades, and deployment across Development, Test, and Production environments.

**Technical Requirements**

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including KM development and topology configuration.
* Experience with Oracle Data Integrator 11g/12c/ODI Marketplace Edition.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with experience on one or more relational databases on Oracle.
* Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling.
* Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for real\-time replication and Change Data Capture (CDC).
* Exposure to OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms and cloud\-native, serverless integration patterns.
* Experience migrating on\-premise ETL workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service as integration targets.
* Exposure to Big Data connectivity (Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka) within ODI or GoldenGate for Big Data.
* Experience with job scheduling, load plans, and ODI agent (Standalone/JEE/Colocated) administration.

title: Sr. Mrg/Assoc Dir - Category (F&O - Acquisition)
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear – to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together – it begins with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Futures New Volume Charter is the growth engine for CoinDCX’s F\&O business. This charter owns the entire top\-of\-funnel and early lifecycle journey – from acquiring new F\&O users through Brand and Performance Marketing, to activating them in M0 (first month) and building trading habit in M1 (second month).
   

  

 As Senior Manager, you will be the single owner of new user volume for Futures. Your job is to ensure that the right users enter the funnel, activate quickly, and ramp their trading volumes within the first two months. You’ll work across Marketing, Product, Growth, and Data to build scalable acquisition\-to\-activation systems – not one\-off campaigns.
   

  

 This is a high\-stakes, high\-autonomy charter. You’ll think like a GM for the “new user” segment – owning the numbers, diagnosing problems from first principles, and driving cross\-functional execution with urgency. If the situation demands, you will also build and manage a small team to scale this charter.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the New Volume Number: Be the DRI for new user MTUs and AVPUs across M0 and M1\. Build a deep, decomposed view of what drives new user volume and own each lever with full accountability.
* Drive Acquisition Strategy (Brand \+ Performance): Partner with Marketing Team to shape the acquisition funnel for F\&O. Influence Brand and Performance Marketing spend, targeting, and messaging to ensure the right trader profiles enter the funnel. Own the business case for acquisition budgets and hold Marketing accountable for funnel quality, not just top\-line leads.
* M0 Activation: Design and execute the activation playbook for new F\&O users. Ensure users who sign up place their first trade quickly and with meaningful volume. Diagnose activation drop\-offs, run experiments, and build repeatable onboarding\-to\-first\-trade systems.
* M1 Volume Ramp: Own the transition from “trial” to “habit.” Build programs that increase trading frequency and volume in the user’s second month. Work with Product and Growth to create nudges, incentives, and feature experiences that deepen engagement before users reach the retention stage.
* Revenue Decomposition \& Diagnosis: Break down new user revenue into its constituent drivers (acquisition volume, activation rate, trades per user, volume per trade). Identify which levers to pull, diagnose underperformance, and design interventions grounded in data.
* Cross\-Functional Execution: Work daily with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Data teams. Influence without authority – align stakeholders around the new volume charter, unblock execution bottlenecks, and ensure launches happen on time and on target.
* Experimentation \& Iteration: Build a culture of rapid experimentation. Run A/B tests across onboarding flows, incentive structures, and engagement hooks. Use data to iterate fast and scale what works.
* Strategic Communication: Present charter performance, insights, and recommendations to the Category Head and leadership. Translate funnel metrics into clear business narratives that drive resource allocation decisions.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think in Funnels and Cohorts: You naturally decompose a growth problem into funnel stages and cohort behaviours. You know the difference between an acquisition problem and an activation problem and solve accordingly.
* Have Acquisition DNA: You’ve worked closely with or within marketing/growth teams. You understand CAC, payback periods, channel mix, and how to hold acquisition spend accountable to downstream volume, not just sign\-ups.
* Solve from First Principles: You don’t copy playbooks. You diagnose the root cause, build a hypothesis, test it, and iterate. You ask “why” five times before asking “how.”
* Are Data\-Obsessed: You live in dashboards but don’t wait for them. You write your own SQL, pull raw data, and form hypotheses before the weekly review.
* Influence Across Functions: You get things done through Product, Marketing, and Tech without positional authority. You build trust through clarity and follow\-through.
* Move Fast with Rigour: You bias for action but never skip the “why.” You can run a sprint and a strategy session in the same week.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**
* 5–8 years of experience in business, category management, growth, or revenue roles at high\-growth companies.
* Prior experience owning acquisition, activation, or early\-lifecycle metrics for a product or category.
* Strong understanding of revenue decomposition, funnel analysis, and cohort\-based thinking.
* Demonstrated ability to work with and influence Marketing, Product, and Growth teams.
* First\-principles, business\-first problem\-solving orientation.
* Proficiency in SQL – ability to write queries, build analyses, and extract insights independently.
* Excellent communication – can translate data into business narratives for leadership.


**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifiers**
* MBA from a Tier\-1 institute.
* Prior category or P\&L ownership experience.
* Experience at Tier\-1 startups or high\-growth B2C platforms.
* Familiarity with crypto, trading, or financial products.
* Experience managing performance marketing budgets or working closely with performance teams.


**Metric Ownership**
* New User MTUs (M0 \+ M1\)


 Unique new users actively trading Futures in their first and second month. The primary measure of acquisition effectiveness and early activation.
   

  

* New User AVPUs (M0 \+ M1\)


 Average trading volume per new user in M0 and M1\. Measures depth of early engagement and quality of acquired users.
   

  

* Acquisition Funnel Quality


 Conversion from sign\-up to first F\&O trade (activation rate), segmented by acquisition channel (Brand vs Performance). Ensures marketing spend translates to real trading users.
   

  

* M0 → M1 Carry\-Over Rate


 Percentage of M0 users who return and trade in M1\. The bridge metric between acquisition and retention.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving.
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space. This role is based out of our
 **Bengaluru office,** 
 where energy, alignment, and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle.
   

  

 Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need.
   

  

 Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
   

  

 Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities.

title: Account Strategist, Google Customer Solutions
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with stakeholder management, business, sales industry or customer engagement.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Knowledge of the local market with excellent investigative skills.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy and tactics, and products across all digital advertising.
* Ability to lead and manage multiple projects with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to think about issues and develop recommendations and action plans.


**About The Job**
 Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleledadvertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
   

  

 In this role, you will work with the advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen relationships. You will drive product adoption and business growth. You will anticipate how decisions are made at C\-Level and you will explore and uncover the business needs of customers, and understand how the range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users.Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small\- and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage a portfolio of customers alongside account managers to deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering a quality sales experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and serve as a trusted consultant to optimize and expand their advertising investment by understanding business drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks and creating multi\-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, partnerships, business planning and strategy, review, and education for customers.
* Coach peers in the organization to create skill lift that drives customer growth and contributes to team success.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enable customer growth.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Lead Analyst**
**Location: Bengaluru**
****What you’ll do****
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As part of the DnA team, this will be an individual contributor role where you will be responsible for leading various aspects of analytics execution and project ownership. You will lead custom initiatives around project development, client QBRs and strategy discussions, KPI improvement and new project ideation. As Lead Analyst, you will also be required to ideate on initiatives for business development and propagate MiQ culture and values within the team.
   

  

* Own entire delivery for Flagship/Sustain accounts: Maintain regular communication with all stakeholders and ensure high quality advanced insights with top notch campaign performance.
* Focus on impactful storytelling and recommendations in QBR and SBR to ensure client stickiness.
* Be the business growth advisor and drive long term strategic conversations: Develop in\-depth understanding of the account, define client business problem, identify key questions and outcomes.
* Build market leading custom POCs, activation and measurement solutions with the aim of growing the account.
* Active involvement in building Presales/Pre\-Campaign decks and support on big RFP pitches to address client challenges.
* Keep the account playbooks up to date.
* Accountable for upskilling market on new analytical applications
* Identify automation opportunities to enhance operational efficiencies and guide Analyst, Senior Analyst on execution.
* Project leadership on central initiatives and new data/API explorations
* Provide technical expertise to the team in Python/R, Spark, Databricks, SQL, data mining, data visualization etc. and ensure tech best practices through code optimizations.
* Provide subject matter guidance on specialised analytical skillsets and new\-age technology ideation \& implementation.
* Lead Product stakeholders on new feature testing or feature development to help shape the MiQ product roadmap.
* Responsible for mentoring and guiding Analyst and Senior Analyst while functioning as a role model for all analysts.
* Active participation in hiring and onboarding initiatives for analyst, senior analyst and Interns.
* Represent MiQ in external events and industry forums.


****Who are your stakeholders?****
 As a Lead Analyst you are required to work with different stakeholders across the MiQ ecosystem:
   

  

 Programmatic Traders: As an analyst, you collaborate with traders to optimize campaigns. By leveraging your data analysis skills \& understanding of the data landscape, you provide insights on audience targeting, ad performance, and bidding strategies. This helps traders make data\-driven decisions, optimize their advertising campaigns, and improve overall campaign effectiveness and ROI.
   

  

 Account Managers: You work closely with account managers to leverage the power of data partnerships. Through your analysis, you help uncover valuable insights about customer behavior, market trends, and campaign performance. This information allows account managers to create a compelling narrative, enhance engagement with advertisers, and showcase the effectiveness of MiQ's advertising solutions.
   

  

 Sales Representatives: You will also be helping the sales team by creating insights based on the key market trends and events. Your analysis helps identify potential opportunities and develop a gripping sales narrative. Additionally, you assist in responding to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by providing data\-driven insights and recommendations that help us in increasing the revenue streams.
   

  

 Agencies \& Clients: Your expertise in data analytics and data sciences is invaluable for agency and advertiser clients. By providing detailed analysis reports \& solutions, you empower them to make informed decisions regarding their marketing strategies. Your insights will help clients optimize their advertising budgets, target the right audience, and maximize the effectiveness of their campaigns. Additionally, you promote MiQ's internal solutions and capabilities, showcasing MiQ's unique value proposition in the programmatic landscape.
   

  

 In summary, as a lead analyst, you add value by providing data\-driven insights and recommendations to traders, account managers, sales teams, and agency/advertiser clients that empowers MiQ and its stakeholders to reach the right audience with right content at the right time. You are someone who can turn data into actionable decisions while guiding a team and influencing stakeholders
   

  

****What you’ll bring****
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent quantitative field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics)
* 3\-5 years’ experience in the analytics domain
* Proficient in advanced Python/R, SQL/Hive/Presto, advanced Excel, MS PowerPoint
* Knowledge of Big Data processing tools like Qubole/Databricks/Spark
* Proven experience in data and business analysis \> Exposure on Descriptive and Inquisitive analysis
* Successful history of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large, discrete datasets
* Strong Visualization and Storytelling skills
* Programmatic Media / Ad\-Tech domain knowledge
* API integrations
* Experience automating manual and redundant tasks.
* Knowledge of Tableau/PowerBI/Google Data Studio
* Knowledge of Basic ML techniques : supervised and unsupervised learning
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to interact with global stakeholders.
* Established experience of working with clients \> Highly self\-driven and motivated individual
* Team\-player with an appetite for learning, sharing and leading.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to multi\-task and prioritize.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Mentoring and guiding skillset
* Continuous learning mindset to keep up with the fast pace of innovation in the field.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience, and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

****What impact will you create?****
 As a Lead Analyst, your role will create value for MiQ in the following ways:
   

  

* Driving client stickiness: With your ability to analyze and interpret data, you will help our stakeholders make informed decisions. By providing accurate and actionable insights, you contribute to improving campaign performance and identifying new opportunities thereby improving customer stickiness.
* Driving Profitability: By leveraging the power of data you are expected to identify areas where we can optimize costs \& improve performance of campaigns, while maintaining a competitive edge \& profitability in our spends.
* MiQ Growth: Being on top of market trends \& developments to suggest strategic measures that can help support MiQ's business \& tap into new revenue streams to drive growth
* Support Key Decision Making: Your expertise in data analysis and reporting provides decision\-makers with the necessary information to make informed choices. Your reports, dashboards, and presentations help guide agencies, advertisers \& internal stakeholders in making strategic and tactical decisions that align with the MiQ's or client's objectives.
* Analyst Best Practices: As a lead analyst, you are expected to introduce analytics \& data best practices within the team, helping in setting up structures and quality frameworks within the team \& internal stakeholders
* Developing Custom Analytics Solutions: Leveraging your experience in data science \& advanced analytics, you will be expected to provide recommendations \& assist in development of MiQ products \& assist in enhancing their consumption within the target market


****What’s in it for you?****
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

****Values****
 Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage

title: Backlink Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Paradigm Media Networks is a social media\-focused organization dedicated to helping brands craft meaningful conversations and build strong digital identities. The company partners with clients to shape their social media story through strategic content, audience engagement, and data\-driven campaigns. By combining creativity with analytics, Paradigm Media Networks works to elevate brand visibility and trust across online channels. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment where innovative ideas and measurable results are valued.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Backlink Specialist is responsible for planning and executing backlink acquisition strategies to improve clients’ search engine rankings and online authority. Day\-to\-day tasks include identifying and evaluating link\-building opportunities, conducting outreach to relevant websites, monitoring backlink profiles, and ensuring compliance with search engine guidelines. The specialist will collaborate with SEO and content teams to align backlink efforts with overall digital marketing goals and report on performance metrics regularly. This is a contract, on\-site role based in Bengaluru, requiring close coordination with internal stakeholders and adherence to project timelines.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Demonstrated experience in backlink building, off\-page SEO, and link prospecting, with a strong understanding of search engine ranking factors.
* Proficiency in using SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console, Google Analytics) to analyze backlink profiles and identify opportunities.
* Strong research and communication skills for outreach, relationship building with web publishers, and evaluating site relevance and authority.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with SEO, content, and marketing teams.
* Familiarity with digital marketing principles, including content marketing and social media, and understanding of safe, white\-hat link\-building practices.
* Relevant education or certifications in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field are beneficial; prior agency or in\-house SEO experience is a plus.

title: Growth & Operation Intern
description:
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time, in\-office \+ field
 



**Language:** 
 Kannada speaking is mandatory
 



  




 What we’re building:
 
  





 CrewUp is building an
 **on\-demand blue\-collar workforce platform for businesses** 
 .
 



 Consumers today have on\-demand food, groceries, mobility and services. But businesses still struggle with a fundamental problem:
 **workforce unpredictability** 
 .
 



  





 A restaurant may need three extra people for the evening. A store may suddenly be short\-staffed. Someone may not show up for a shift. Traditional hiring is too slow for these situations.
 



 CrewUp is solving this by helping businesses access
 **reliable, trained workers on demand — for a few hours, a day, a week or longer.** 




  





 Our goal is to bring predictability to workforce management for businesses, while giving workers more flexible earning opportunities.
 



  




 The role
 
  





 We’re looking for an
 **Operations \& AI Intern** 
 who will work directly with both founders and help build CrewUp’s operations from the ground up. This is a high\-ownership role. You’ll work across business operations, workforce management, training, customer experience, growth and process building.
 



 This is also not a desk\-only internship. You should be comfortable being on the ground, speaking to business owners and workers, and solving problems as they happen.
 



  




 Business \& stakeholder management
 
  





 You’ll work closely with the businesses we onboard and make sure they have a consistently strong experience.
 



  





 This will include:
 


* Onboarding restaurants, cafés, stores and other business partners
* Understanding their workforce requirements
* Coordinating shifts and workforce requirements
* Building relationships with business owners and managers
* Handling feedback, issues and escalations
* Ensuring high client satisfaction and repeat usage



  




 Workforce operations
 
  





 A major part of the role will involve building and managing a reliable workforce.
 



 You’ll help with:
 


* Recruiting and onboarding new workers
* Understanding worker availability and preferences
* Training workers for different roles
* Maintaining quality and reliability benchmarks
* Tracking attendance, performance and feedback
* Improving worker engagement and retention
* Helping build training processes and training centres as we scale



  




 Live operations \& problem solving
 
  





 This is a real\-world operations business, so things will not always go according to plan.
 



 Workers may cancel. Clients may change requirements at the last minute. A shift may need to be filled immediately. You should be comfortable stepping in, understanding the problem and finding the fastest practical solution. We’re looking for someone who is resourceful, calm under pressure and naturally thinks in terms of
 **“how do we get this done?”** 




  




 Processes \& SOPs
 
  





 A big part of the role is turning what we learn on the ground into scalable systems.
 



 You’ll help:
 


* Identify recurring operational problems
* Understand their root causes
* Build SOPs around onboarding, training, fulfilment and quality
* Ensure these processes are actually followed
* Continuously improve them based on real\-world feedback



 The goal is to gradually convert messy manual operations into repeatable systems.
   




 Growth
 
  





 You’ll also help us figure out how to grow both sides of the marketplace.
 



 This could include:
 


* Building worker communities
* Running referral programs
* Working with local colleges and institutes
* Testing WhatsApp and social media channels
* Running hyperlocal and field acquisition experiments
* Finding creative ways to acquire workers digitally and offline



 We want someone who enjoys testing ideas and figuring out what actually works rather than simply following existing playbooks.
 



  




 AI \& automation
 
  





 We believe many operational processes that are manual today can eventually be automated.
 



 You’ll work with the founders to identify these opportunities and use AI tools to make operations faster and more scalable.
 



 This could include AI for:
 


* Recruitment and screening
* Training
* Worker communication
* Customer support
* SOP creation
* Internal workflows
* Data and operational analysis



 You don’t need to be technical, but you should be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and learning quickly.
 



  




 How we work
 
  





 We’re a small team and strongly believe in
 **first\-principles thinking** 
 .
 



 Instead of asking,
 *“How is this usually done?”* 
 , we prefer asking:
 



**What is the actual problem? Why does it exist? What is the simplest way to solve it?** 




 You’ll work closely with both founders throughout this journey and get direct exposure to how an early\-stage company is built.
 



 You should be comfortable doing
 **anything and everything reasonably required to help the business grow.** 




  




 Who we’re looking for
 
  





 You should be:
 


* High\-agency and comfortable taking ownership
* Smart, resourceful and good at figuring things out
* Strong at communicating with different kinds of people
* Fluent/conversational in
 **Kannada**
* Comfortable travelling across Bengaluru for field work
* Comfortable managing both businesses and blue\-collar workers
* Structured enough to turn problems into processes
* Comfortable working in ambiguity
* Interested in startups, operations, growth and AI



  





 Bonus if you’ve previously worked in an early\-stage startup, operations, growth, founder’s office, recruitment or community building.
 



  





 More than your degree or previous job title, we care about
 **how you think, how quickly you learn and whether you can get things done.**

title: Campus Ambassador
description:
Campus Ambassador – Online Degree Programs
 
  





**Company:** 
 RiseUpp.com
 



  





**Location:** 
 Remote \| Pan India
 



  





**Opportunity Type:** 
 Performance\-Based Campus Ambassador Program
 



  





**Earnings:** 
 ₹5,000 per successful enrolment (No fixed stipend)
 



  




 About RiseUpp
 
 RiseUpp is an AI\-powered platform for online higher education, upskilling and career growth, offering 12,000\+ programmes from 500\+ universities and institutions.
 



 We help students and working professionals explore educational opportunities, compare programmes and make informed career decisions.
 



  




 About the Opportunity
 
 We are looking for enthusiastic college students and recent graduates to join the RiseUpp Campus Ambassador Program.
 



 As a Campus Ambassador, you will introduce students and working professionals to RiseUpp and help them explore suitable online degree programmes.
 



 This is a flexible, performance\-based opportunity that you can pursue alongside your studies or other commitments.
 



  




 What You Can Earn
 
**Earn ₹5,000 for every successful enrolment through your referral!** 



* 1 successful enrolment \= ₹5,000
* 5 successful enrolments \= ₹25,000
* 10 successful enrolments \= ₹50,000



  





**Eligible programmes include:** 



* Online BBA, BCA, BCom and BA
* Online MBA, MCom and MA
* Other approved online degree programmes
* Eligible professional and executive certificate programmes priced at ₹1 lakh or above



 There is no fixed stipend, no guaranteed monthly income and no limit on potential earnings. Incentives are subject to verified, eligible enrolments and programme terms.
 



  




 Your Responsibilities
 * Introduce RiseUpp to students and working professionals interested in pursuing online higher education.
* Share approved programme information and your unique referral link with your personal network and relevant student communities.
* Connect interested learners with RiseUpp's admissions counselling team.
* Promote awareness of online degree and certificate programmes through digital channels and relevant student communities.



 Our professional counselling team will handle programme comparisons, eligibility checks, applications and admissions support.
 



  




 Who Can Apply?
 * Current college students and recent graduates aged 18 or above.
* Students pursuing BBA, BCA, BCom, BA, BTech, MBA or any other degree.
* Individuals with good communication and networking skills.
* Students interested in marketing, business development, entrepreneurship and education.



 No prior work experience is required.
 



  




 What You Get
 * ₹5,000 for every eligible successful enrolment through your referral.
* Flexible participation with no fixed working hours or monthly sales targets.
* Practical exposure to marketing, business development and student outreach.
* Access to RiseUpp's training and promotional resources.
* A Campus Ambassador Certificate upon meeting the program's completion requirements.
* Opportunities for recognition and future career opportunities based on performance.



  




 How to Apply
 
 Click
 **Apply** 
 on LinkedIn to join the RiseUpp Campus Ambassador Program.
 



 Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online orientation and assigned to relevant programme\-specific ambassador groups.
 



  





**Join RiseUpp and help students make informed higher education decisions while building your own professional experience!** 




  





*This is a performance\-based referral opportunity with no fixed stipend. Incentives are payable on verified, eligible enrolments as per the program's terms and conditions.*

title: Sr. Public Relations & Communications Executive
description:
**Trivium Public Relations is hiring!** 




  





 We’re looking for a Sr. PR \& Communications Executive who understands the media landscape, enjoys building strong journalist relationships, and knows how to turn a good story into meaningful visibility for brands.
 



  





 Position: Sr. Public Relations \& Communications Executive
 



 Location: Bengaluru
 



 Experience: 2–4 years
 



 Employment: Full\-Time \| Day Shift
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday \| Weekend availability as required
 



  





 About Trivium Public Relations:\-
 



 Trivium Public Relations is a leading communications and PR consultancy with offices in Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Dubai. We partner with brands across Technology, Fashion, Retail, Lifestyle, Real Estate, Hospitality, and Luxury, helping them build stronger brand visibility, reputation, and engagement through strategic communications, media relations and thought leadership to content, brand storytelling, and integrated communication, we work closely with clients to create communication that delivers impact.
 



  





 The Opportunity:\-
 



  





 As a PR Executive at Trivium PR, you will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day PR mandates, developing communication opportunities, driving media outreach, and working closely with clients and internal teams.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone who can take ownership, think creatively, communicate confidently, and build relationships that create results.
 



  





 What You’ll Do:\-
 



  





 Develop and execute PR strategies and communication plans based on client objectives.
 



  





 Drive proactive media outreach and generate relevant coverage across print, digital, television, and online platforms.
 



  





 Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, influencers, and other key media stakeholders.
 



  





 Develop compelling media pitches, press releases, articles, thought\-leadership pieces, blogs, speeches, and other communication content.
 



  





 Identify timely news jacking, feature, interview, and thought\-leadership opportunities for clients.
 



  





 Coordinate media interactions, press conferences, briefings, launches, and other PR initiatives.
 



  





 Monitor coverage, maintain media reports, and evaluate campaign outcomes.
 



  





 Identify opportunities for partnerships, collaborations, sponsorships, and brand visibility.
 



  





 Work closely with digital and content teams to create integrated communication opportunities.
 



  





 Stay on top of industry developments, media trends, and relevant news cycles to create proactive opportunities for clients.
 



  





 Manage day\-to\-day client communication and contribute strategic inputs to client mandates.
 



  





 Support and mentor junior team members where required.
 



  





 What You Bring:\-
 



  





 2–4 years of relevant experience in Public Relations, preferably with a PR agency or media organization.
 



  





 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Relations, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
 



  





 Strong understanding of PR strategy, media relations, pitching, and client servicing.
 



  





 Established media relationships across relevant publications and platforms.
 



  





 Excellent written and spoken English with strong storytelling and communication skills.
 



  





 Ability to identify newsworthy angles and develop compelling pitches.
 



  





 Familiarity with digital PR, social media, and media monitoring platforms.
 



  





 Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 



  





 A proactive, detail\-oriented, and collaborative approach to work.
 



  





 Ability to work independently while taking ownership of deliverables and deadlines.
 



  





 Why Trivium PR...
 



  





 At Trivium, you’ll work across multiple industries, brands, and communication mandates, giving you the opportunity to build a strong understanding of the PR ecosystem. You’ll gain hands\-on exposure to global media relations, strategic communications, client management, brand positioning, and integrated PR campaigns, while working alongside a team that values ideas, initiative, and meaningful communication

title: Senior Manager (Strategic PR & Communications)
description:
**🚀 About Joveo** 




 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.
 



 You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.
 



 Reporting directly to the
 **Chief of Strategic Initiatives \& Global Supply Officer** 
 , you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.
 



  





**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.** 
 Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned\-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.
 



 There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

title: Strategist Experimentation
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 The Experimentation Strategist is a lead individual contributor who shapes experimentation strategy and drives high\-impact analytical initiatives across teams. This role applies deep technical expertise and strategic thinking to influence business direction.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Shape experimentation strategy to support business and growth objectives.
* Lead high\-impact, cross\-functional experimentation initiatives.
* Leads advanced, multi\-source Empower analyses to anticipate customer trends and influence strategic decisions.
* Apply advanced analytical and modeling techniques to complex business problems.
* Advise leaders on experimentation design, interpretation, and trade\-offs.
* Influence prioritization and decision\-making through strategic insights.
* Contribute to the development of experimentation frameworks and best practices.
* Represent experimentation expertise in cross\-functional forums.
* Communicate strategic insights to senior leadership.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Master’s preferred).
* 10\+ years of experience in experimentation, analytics, or optimization.
* Deep expertise in experimentation design and statistical modeling.
* Demonstrated ability to influence strategy without formal authority.
* Strong executive communication skills.
* Deep understanding of the Empower business model, product and service offerings, and customer and prospect needs, applying this insight to guide strategy, influence stakeholders, and drive outcomes across teams or initiatives.


 This job operates in a professional office environment.
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. title: Product Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Product Engineer, Gaming
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (Full\-Time In\-Office)
 



  





**About:** 




 We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
 **data\-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership** 
 , and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.
 



 We are looking for
 **high\-IQ, product\-minded engineers** 
 who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end\-to\-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 You’ll be the person who
 **collapses the gap between idea and evidence** 
 .
 



 From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end\-to\-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
 **hypotheses → prototypes → production systems** 
 .
 



 This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.
 



 It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* **Ideation \& Concept Testing** 
 : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping \& 0→1 Ownership** 
 : Own prototype lifecycle end\-to\-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development \& System Ownership** 
 : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems** 
 : Build scalable, config\-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation \& Data** 
 : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking** 
 : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first\-principles thinking.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 




***Must\-Haves:***



* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
 **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well\-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.



  





***Nice\-to\-Haves:***



* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live\-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands\-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems



  





**Why You'll Love It Here:** 



* **Impact:** 
 You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:** 
 You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high\-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:** 
 You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting\-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:** 
 You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data\-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:** 
 We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

description:

 Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next\-generation experiences for the connected world.  Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
   

  

****Experience****
* 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
* Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
* Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
* International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
* Proven track record of delivering innovative, market\-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.

****Leadership \& Soft Skills****
* Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.

****ABOUT US****
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Content Strategist
description:
**The Mandate** 




 Your job is to treat digital attention as a repeatable engineering problem. The role spans four phases:
 


* **Analyze:** 
 Pinpoint the client’s business goal, identify exactly who the target audience is, and map where they spend time online and what they consume.
* **Blueprint:** 
 Turn those insights into a concrete content strategy. Break down exactly what hooks, pacing, and formats will capture and hold their attention.
* **Execute:** 
 Project\-manage the production pipeline. Orchestrate internal teams and external creators, serving as the final quality check before anything goes live.
* **Optimize:** 
 Track real business results. Run continuous feedback loops to fix underperforming content and improve the strategy until milestones are hit.



  





**The Persona** 




 You treat human attention and platform recommendation engines like an engineered puzzle. Compulsively analytical yet culturally fluent, you don’t rely on guesswork. You possess the creative intuition to know what makes a human being stop scrolling, and the rigor to break that down into structural variables like retention curves and pacing hooks.
 



 You have high agency, demand absolute ownership over results, and have the communication muscle to orchestrate internal and external stakeholders to execute your vision.
   





**The Bar** 




 Our criteria are unapologetically narrow. We are looking for professionals with 1–3 years of experience and absolute functional competence.
 


* **Social Media Native:** 
 You have spent 10,000\+ hours on a social media platform, breaking down why a specific posts go viral.
* **Systemic thinking:** 
 You look past the aesthetics of content to see the math beneath it. You treat platform algorithms as non\-linear systems to be mapped, deconstructing media into raw data to isolate the exact retention curves, pacing metrics, and behavioral triggers that force people to stop scrolling.
* **Communication muscle:** 
 You take absolute ownership over data\-backed results and have the interpersonal maturity to project\-manage both internal technical teams and external global creator networks.



  





**Why Join** 



* Master how public perception and global attention are manufactured. This is the single most valuable, future\-proof skill set in today’s world. Learn it, and you can distribute any product or idea for the rest of your career

title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer - AI, ML

 Staff Platform Engineer

 Bangalore

 Retail Technology

 As a Staff Platform Engineer – SAP, you will be a senior technical leader within the Core Banking Platform Crew part of Retail Technology, responsible for shaping the future of the SAP Core Banking platform. You will provide deep expertise across SAP Basis, SAP HANA, AWS Cloud and Platform Engineering practices while leading critical upgrade, migration, resilience and operational initiatives. This role combines hands\-on engineering, technical leadership, platform ownership and people leadership to ensure one of Australia's most critical banking workloads remains secure, resilient and fit for the future.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Provide technical leadership and ownership of SAP Platform Engineering, SAP Basis, SAP HANA, and AWS\-hosted SAP environments, driving platform strategy, modernization, resilience, cloud transformation, and operational excellence.
* Lead the design, implementation, upgrade, migration, and ongoing management of enterprise SAP landscapes, including SAP upgrades, enhancement packs, support packs, kernel upgrades, add\-on installations, SSL certificate management, system refreshes, and migrations using SUM, DMO, and ZDO.
* Drive SAP HANA engineering and database administration initiatives, including installations, SPS/revision and Cockpit upgrades, HANA System Replication (HSR), high availability and disaster recovery solutions, Scale\-Up/Scale\-Out deployments, performance tuning, capacity planning, backup and recovery, and database optimization.
* Manage and optimize SAP workloads on AWS Cloud and Red Hat Linux platforms, leveraging services such as EC2, EBS, EFS, FSx, Cloud Storage, BACKINT, and Pacemaker clusters, while enhancing scalability, resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
* Provide leadership for L3 production support and service management, overseeing incident, major incident, problem, change, release, and service transition activities, while driving root cause analysis, platform recovery, and SLA compliance.
* Champion reliability engineering, observability, and automation practices, implementing monitoring, telemetry, alerting, dashboards, predictive monitoring, self\-healing capabilities, and continuous improvements to enhance platform stability and performance.
* Drive DevOps, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and platform standardization initiatives, utilizing technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, GitHub, and cloud\-native automation frameworks to reduce operational effort and improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, vendors, and managed service providers, leading technical reviews, architecture discussions, governance forums, and mentoring geographically distributed teams to deliver reliable and scalable platform outcomes.


**Essential Skills:**
* 12\+ years of hands\-on SAP Basis and SAP HANA experience supporting large\-scale enterprise SAP environments.
* Strong leadership experience across Engineering, Operations and DevOps functions.
* Deep expertise in:
+ SAP Basis Administration
+ SAP HANA Administration
+ Scale\-Up \& Scale\-Out Architectures
+ High Availability \& Disaster Recovery
+ SAP Upgrades and Migrations
+ AWS Cloud Operations
+ Linux Administration (RHEL \& SUSE)

* Proven experience managing production support and critical business platforms.
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Incident Management
+ Major Incident Management
+ Problem Management
+ Change \& Release Management
+ Service Transition
+ Operational Readiness
