title: Integrated CX Strategy - Experienced Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Integrated CX Strategy \- Experienced Associate, you will engage in providing consulting services focused on customer\-related strategies and initiatives. You will analyze client needs, develop customer\-centric solutions, and offer guidance to help clients enhance their customer experience and drive business growth. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will specialize in enhancing the overall customer experience within our Commercial \& Service Excellence practice. You will analyze customer touchpoints, design customer journey maps, and offer guidance to help clients create seamless and personalized experiences that drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy. This position offers a dynamic environment where you will be encouraged to take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for clients and success for the team. Embrace the opportunity to build your brand and open doors to more opportunities as you navigate through the firm.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for customer\-focused, business\-first professionals who can operate across strategy, design, operations, product, and technology. This is a hands\-on consulting role for individuals who can structure ambiguous problems, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and convert experience opportunities into implementation\-ready business and functional requirements. Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

 Relevant experience in customer experience strategy, service design, digital transformation, product delivery, or business analysis within consulting or a global delivery environment.
   

  

 Understanding customer experience frameworks, human\-centered design, journey mapping, service blueprinting, operating models, governance, and experience measurement.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience conducting discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, qualitative or quantitative research, and current\-state assessments.
   

  

 Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements of elicitation, process decomposition, functional analysis, traceability, prioritization, and solution validation.
   

  

 Experience translating research, business objectives, operational needs, and technology constraints into clear experience concepts and actionable requirements.
   

  

 Familiarity with digital experience ecosystems, including CRM, customer portals, commerce, marketing technology, contact centers, service management, identity, data, analytics, and integration platforms.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and release prioritization.
   

  

 Ability to connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, roles, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.
   

  

 Strong analytical thinking, synthesis, problem\-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
   

  

 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's and/or MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B\-School
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required
* Lead CX strategy and/or business analysis workstreams, from discovery and experience definition through requirements, prioritization, implementation support, and business readiness.
* Structure complex customer and business problems into clear insights, strategic recommendations, experience concepts, requirements, process models, and implementation priorities.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions, workshops, and decision\-making sessions.
* Own the quality, completeness, and consistency of key client deliverables.
* Drive requirements clarification, prioritization, scope, and MVP decisions.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, assumptions, and cross\-functional issues.
* Coordinate effectively across business, product, design, architecture, data, technology, and delivery teams.
* Guide implementation and business\-readiness activities through testing, release, adoption, and optimization.
* Guide Associates and peers in strategy methods and deliverables, providing direction and review across research, synthesis, journey mapping, service blueprinting, strategic frameworks, and storytelling.
* Maintain accountability for workstream outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality.
* Lead defined CX strategy workstreams, independently planning and driving research, current\-state assessment, persona and journey development, service blueprinting, market analysis, future\-state experience definition, and opportunity identification.
* Structure ambiguous customer and business problems into a clear strategic approach, determining the questions to answer, inputs required, analyses needed, and experience frameworks to apply.
* Synthesize customer research, market insights, business priorities, operational realities, and data into a clear point of view, identifying the implications and recommendations that matter most to the client.
* Shape future\-state experience strategies and transformation roadmaps, connecting customer needs and experience opportunities to business value, capabilities, operating model implications, technology needs, and implementation priorities.
* Lead CX\-focused client workshops and working sessions, including discovery, journey mapping, co\-creation, prioritization, and future\-state visioning, and drive stakeholders toward decisions and alignment.
* Own the strategic storyline and quality of CX deliverables, translating complex findings into clear executive\-level narratives and confidently presenting recommendations to client stakeholders.


**Skills Preferred**
 Candidates should be able to demonstrate customer transformation consulting capabilities across the following areas:
   

  

**CX Strategy, Research \& Experience Design**
* Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, customer research, and co\-creation sessions to understand customer expectations, pain points, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Synthesize research and workshop outputs into insights, personas, journey maps, experience principles, opportunity areas, and measurable experience outcomes.
* Define future\-state customer and employee experiences across web, mobile, portals, contact centers, sales, service, marketing, and other assisted or digital channels.
* Create journey maps, service blueprints, experience blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions.
* Develop CX strategies, capability roadmaps, MVP recommendations, and phased transformation plans that balance customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery risk.
* Apply market research, customer insights, analytics, and emerging experience trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic recommendations.
* Ability to work with clients to understand detailed requirements define end\-to\-end CX strategies that meet client needs and vision.
* Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile\-first and responsive design.
* A solid grasp of user\-centered design (UCD), planning and conducting design research, user testing.
* Experience in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, journey mapping \& workshops.
* Strong analytical and synthesis skills: ability to translate complex, ambiguous research data into clear strategic frameworks, insights, and recommendations.
* Experience creating service blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions that connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage operations and systems.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in fast\-paced, cross\-functional, and client\-facing environments.
* Passion for customer experience strategy, innovation, and solving complex user and business challenges.
* Be passionate about all things CX Strategy, experience innovation. UX and other areas of design and innovation.
* Research and showcase knowledge in the industry’s latest trends and technologies.
* Ability to communicate ideas visually through low\-fidelity wireframes, workflows, sketches, or conceptual prototypes.
* Ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, insight generation, persona development, and strategic storytelling.
* Familiar with AI\-assisted workflows to optimize strategic and design outputs.


**Business Process, Experience \& Requirements Design**
* Lead engagement with senior client stakeholders across business, product, customer experience, design, architecture, data, operations, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, customer needs, operational challenges, and solution requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, requirements elicitation sessions, process walkthroughs, and collaborative design sessions.
* Conduct current\-state assessments across people, process, technology, data, and governance, and define future\-state processes, operating models, experience improvements, and capability roadmaps.
* Develop customer journeys, service blueprints, experience flows, process maps, ecosystem maps, use cases, personas, and other artifacts that connect customer interactions with supporting business processes and systems.
* Document business processes, business rules, functional requirements, non\-functional considerations, data needs, assumptions, dependencies, risks, controls, and decision points.
* Translate customer insights, experience concepts, and business needs into structured epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and solution notes.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis, impact assessments, option analysis, and prioritization exercises to support solution decisions, MVP definition, roadmap development, and scope management.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and reporting requirements to evaluate customer experience, process performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Maintain traceability from customer insights and business objectives through requirements, design, development, testing, and release.
* Create reusable documentation, frameworks, playbooks, templates, and quality standards to promote consistency, scalability, and effective knowledge transfer.


**Implementation \& Business Delivery Support**
* Perform Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Product Owner, or Project Management responsibilities across customer experience, CRM, service, commerce, portal, and digital transformation implementations.
* Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, developers, data teams, platform specialists, testing teams, and delivery leads to translate approved requirements into implementation\-ready deliverables.
* Review wireframes, prototypes, workflows, data requirements, integration considerations, and functional designs to confirm alignment with customer journeys, business requirements, accessibility expectations, and operational processes.
* Refine and prioritize product backlogs, clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, define MVP boundaries, and prepare user stories for sprint execution.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, requirements validation, and stakeholder review sessions within Agile delivery environments.
* Support the implementation of customer\-facing platforms and enterprise applications, including Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Oracle, CRM, customer service, commerce, content management, data, and analytics solutions.
* Identify cross\-functional dependencies, integrations, data requirements, risks, controls, and change impacts early in the implementation lifecycle.
* Support data mapping, data quality, access, governance, migration, integration, and reporting requirements across platforms and supporting systems.
* Define expected outcomes and business scenarios for system integration testing and user acceptance testing.
* Review test results and defects, support defect triage, clarify expected system behavior, and validate that delivered functionality meets agreed business and customer needs.
* Use generative AI responsibly to accelerate requirements elicitation, process analysis, documentation, traceability, test\-scenario development, quality reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Support adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities by translating new functionality into process changes, role impacts, training needs, operating procedures, and change\-management requirements.
* Support release readiness, business validation, training, stakeholder communications, adoption planning, and post\-implementation optimization.


**Client, Change \& Practice Contribution**
* Contribute to customer experience and business transformation engagements, including implementation roadmaps, operating model changes, adoption planning, and change management.
* Develop stakeholder communications, training materials, process guidance, and enablement content to support solution adoption.
* Coordinate across business, product, design, technology, and delivery teams to manage dependencies, risks, decisions, and implementation readiness.
* Develop high\-quality client\-facing presentations, executive summaries, proposals, and recommendations.
* Participate in business development activities, including proposal development, solution design, capability demonstrations, and creation of reusable assets.


**Tools \& System**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Suite and strategic storytelling tools is a must. Working knowledge of Miro or equivalent workshop facilitation tools is required. Familiarity with UX tools like Figma, Guidewire is a must.
* Experience with AI\-assisted research and design tools.
* Business Analyst \- Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud, Google Analytics, and other leading tools.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Engineering, Information CyberSecurity, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Applications
* Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and adaptability in fast\-paced environments
* Utilizing customer journey analysis to enhance client engagement strategies
* Applying customer experience (CX) design principles to drive value propositions
* Excelling in communication and active listening to foster client relationships
* Developing business process improvement strategies for customer satisfaction
* Leveraging customer segmentation techniques to optimize service delivery

 Building an

title: Intern – Venture Development - EdTech
description:
**Full\-time internship for 3 months based in Bengaluru in the Healthcare\-EdTech space** 




**Job Description**




 In the newly formed Mount Judi Incubation setup, we are looking for a dynamic and creative Intern to work directly with a Pre\-Seed startup in its "Founder's Office". The intern will work directly alongside the entrepreneur on whatever moves the needle across functional areas of Product, Market Analysis and Funding – building the concept from idea to reality. This will be typically an on\-site position working full\-time 5 days of the week working with the woman entrepreneur in Bengaluru.
 **This is a limited duration 3 month opportunity (October to December 2026\) which could develop into a long\-term role based on the performance of the individual and the outcome of the efforts.** 
 From this internship, the candidate will walk away with integrated and comprehensive experience including MVP testing, platform setup, and operational model building translating an EdTech concept into a fully functional start\-up.
 



**Scope of Work** 




**1\. Market Analysis (Strategy \& Pilot Pipeline)**




**Market Intelligence:** 
 Benchmark \~Indian Healthcare EdTech models — map their content formats, pricing (B2B vs. B2C), and learner engagement tactics. Build a TAM\-SAM\-SOM model with a bottom\-up view of allied healthcare colleges and hospital chains.
 



**Pilot Lead Generation:** 
 Identify and prioritize 10\+ potential pilot clients; Draft personalized cold outreach scripts and manage follow\-ups to secure \~3 signed MoUs for MVP testing.
 



**Feedback Synthesis:** 
 Design standardized feedback forms for students/ faculty, conduct post\-pilot interviews, and synthesize qualitative/ quantitative insights into a short "Pivot\-or\-Persevere" recommendation for the founder.
 



**2\. Learning Platform \& Product Execution (MVP Setup \& Pedagogy)**




**Platform Configuration:** 
 Assist in defining user journeys and features for 4 user cohorts (students, faculty, institution, product admin), oversee content uploads (videos /PDFs / quizzes), manage learner enrolments via batch imports, and conduct UAT (User Acceptance Testing) to flag bugs before launch.
 



**Product Roadmap Inputs:** 
 Research trending healthcare skills and 2–3 gamification/ pedagogical frameworks; translate findings into a prioritized feature backlog (using RICE scoring) for the post\-MVP sprint (Jan 2027 onwards).
 



**3\. Growth \& Community Building (Demand Generation)**




**Content \& Social Strategy:** 
 Design a monthly content calendar for LinkedIn/ Instagram/ YouTube — create engaging short\-form reels, case\-study snippets, and career\-hack posts targeting students and young professionals.
 



**Community Management:** 
 Set up and moderate dedicated WhatsApp/Telegram groups for pilot cohorts; host weekly doubt\-clearing or AMA sessions to boost retention. Design a simple "refer\-a\-friend" incentive to drive organic enrolments for the next cohort.
 



**Outreach Enablement:** 
 Build email/LinkedIn templates for B2B (Deans/HODs) and B2C (students) to maximize pilot registrations with minimal paid ad spend.
 



**4\. Fundraising \& Investor Relations (Capital Readiness)**




**Investor Deck \& Data Room:** 
 Refine the pitch deck—sourcing real pilot data, polishing financial estimates (CAC/ LTV assumptions), and creating clean, narrative\-driven layouts. Organize a virtual data room with legal, financial, and product folders for due diligence.
 



**Investor \& Grant Mapping:** 
 Build a ranked database of \~50 relevant incubators, accelerators, angel syndicates, and family offices active in Indian EdTech/HealthTech. Additionally, identify 3–5 government grants (e.g., BIRAC, Startup India) and draft application summaries for the founder.
 



**Competitive Benchmarking:** 
 Analyze 5 recent Seed\-stage funding rounds in the space to benchmark valuation ranges, ticket sizes, and dilution norms—supporting the founder's negotiation prep.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ·        
 **Education** 
 : The candidate should be a graduate. A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
 



 ·        
 **Oral and Writing Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with an ability to write clear, concise, and engaging content.
 



 ·        
 **Analytical and Organizational Skills:** 
 Strong project management and coordination skills to manage multiple tasks and liaise with external partners.
 



 ·        
 **Prior experience and Interest in startups:** 
 Prior experience interning at a startup or working in a venture/incubator environment is a significant advantage.
 



 ·        
 **Domain Interest:** 
 A demonstrable passion for the EdTech, Healthcare, or AI space is crucial for sustained motivation and contextual understanding
 



**Valuable Attributes:** 




 ·        Extreme Ownership \& Adaptability (The "Founder's Mindset")
 



 ·        Operational Rigor \& Digital Tool Proficiency
 



 ·        User\-Centric Curiosity \& Growth Instinct
 



**Compensation:**




 ·        A fixed stipend of Rs 12,000 per month will be paid for the internship period.

title: Sr Product Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Senior Product Analyst
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Analyst in our DnA Capabilities function, you’ll have the chance to:
   

  

* Be actively involved in and take ownership of critical aspects of product development, with a stronger emphasis on ambiguous problem\-framing, research, analysis, documentation, and end\-to\-end product execution for AI\-assisted and analytics\-heavy workflows.
* Partner closely with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams to shape roadmap decisions, define success metrics, influence prioritisation, and drive adoption through evidence\-led recommendations.
* Help design workflow and product experiences where AI is embedded meaningfully into the user journey, including AI\-assisted insight generation, narrative support, contextual recommendations, and quality\-controlled outputs.
* Work across structured and unstructured data sources to surface actionable signals, connect fragmented knowledge, and turn them into product features or analyst workflows that reduce manual effort and improve decision quality.
* Contribute to the design of robust handoffs, APIs, and system integrations that allow product workflows to move seamlessly across tools, users, and contexts.
* Ensure outputs are decision\-grade by applying analytical rigour, factchecking, confidence\-based thinking, experimentation, and human\-in\-the\-loop quality control where needed.
* Mentor junior analysts, raise the quality bar on analysis and product thinking, and contribute to a collaborative, growth\-oriented team environment.
* Stay close to emerging AI tooling, AI\-based IDEs, copilots, and knowledge/retrieval systems such as Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Replit, Claude, Retool, Claude Skills, and similar platforms, and identify where they can improve team productivity, product usability, or output quality.


**Who are your stakeholders?**
**The Senior Product Analyst’s Internal Customers/stakeholders Include**
* Product Managers / Consultants / Traders / Data Scientists / Analysts / Engineers: the Senior Product Analyst builds solutions and workflows used by these stakeholders and works with them to translate business needs into scalable product or workflow improvements.
* Product Management: the Senior Product Analyst works closely with Product to define impact frameworks, influence roadmap choices, monitor adoption, and recommend next steps for feature development.
* Cross\-functional platform and data teams: the role requires leading conversations across Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, Sales, and Trading to move product execution forward in ambiguous environments.


**What You’ll Bring**
* 2–4 years of experience in translating business problems into scalable and insightful products through descriptive and inquisitive analytics, with strong product\-thinking and execution ability.
* Strong experience in Python for analysis and prototyping, plus comfort working with large\-scale data environments such as Databricks, Spark, and AWS.
* Strong grounding in product analytics, experimentation, and causal thinking, including designing tests, defining guardrails, and translating readouts into product decisions.
* Ability to work with APIs, system integrations, and workflow orchestration patterns, with a practical understanding of authentication, data movement, and scalable product architecture, including familiarity with LLM and agent integrations such as OpenAI APIs, Claude APIs, and tool\-driven workflow patterns.
* Practical familiarity with AI\-enabled ways of working, including prompt\-based tooling and hands\-on exposure to tools such as Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Replit, Claude, Retool, Claude Skills, OpenAI APIs, and similar LLM\-assisted, retrieval\-augmented, and human\-review\-driven workflows.
* Ability to evaluate where AI adds value versus where deterministic logic, analytics, or human review should remain primary.
* Strong storytelling and visualisation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in statistical modelling and advanced analytics, with the ability to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies that shape strategy and product development.
* High degree of organisation and comfort managing multiple competing priorities across product, data, and stakeholder tracks.
* Experience mentoring junior analysts and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and working styles quickly, especially in fast\-evolving AI environments.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any engineering discipline / MBA.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
* You will help scope, build, test, and improve data\-driven product capabilities that strengthen MiQ’s product and analytics advantage.
* You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to build generalised features and intelligent workflows that help internal stakeholders discover insights, make better decisions, and execute faster.
* You will play a key role in feature testing, adoption monitoring, feedback loops, and business impact measurement so that high\-quality products are released and improved iteratively.
* You will bring strong analytical judgment to product development, especially where AI, automation, knowledge retrieval, and quality control need to work together in a practical and trustworthy way.
* You will help build MiQ’s brand in data science and product innovation by contributing ideas, research, experimentation, and thought leadership internally and externally.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact on our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements
 **.** 
 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office has specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job\-specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.
* Employee resource groups are designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities.


*Apply today!*
*Equal Opportunity Employer*

description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Admin and Support Specialist to provide hands\-on IT support and administration for our growing Bangalore office.
   

  

 As our IT Admin and Support Specialist, you will be the primary on\-site IT presence in Bangalore, ensuring that employees, devices and local infrastructure are properly supported and ready to operate. You will take ownership of everything from hardware lifecycle management and employee onboarding to access controls, device management and local IT troubleshooting.
   

  

 You will work closely with ReOrbit's IT Infrastructure, Operations \& Support teams, particularly HQ in Helsinki, helping to implement global standards, policies and security requirements locally. You will also play an important role in establishing Bangalore as part of ReOrbit's follow\-the\-sun support model, providing remote support to colleagues across other locations when required.
   

  

 It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start\-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the local hardware inventory for the Bangalore office, including device setup, repair, replacement, lifecycle management and shipment coordination.
* Provide hands\-on support for regional IT projects, technology rollouts and infrastructure initiatives in Bangalore.
* Own the onboarding and offboarding process for Bangalore employees, including device provisioning, account setup, security requirements and access controls.
* Manage and support local physical security systems, including CCTV and access\-related infrastructure.
* Support the implementation of HQ\-driven security policies, processes and IT standards at the Bangalore location.
* Support Microsoft Active Directory design and administration, including Group Policy management and cloud or hybrid server environments.
* Manage software licences and subscriptions for Bangalore\-based users and devices.
* Deploy and maintain standardised laptop and mobile device configurations.
* Troubleshoot local server, infrastructure and end\-user technology issues.
* Manage Windows support tickets and provide timely resolution or escalation where required.
* Administer MDM enrolment and device lifecycle processes for Bangalore devices.
* Provide remote support to other ReOrbit locations as part of the follow\-the\-sun IT support model.
* Coordinate with the global IT team and escalate infrastructure, security or service issues to Helsinki when required.
* Maintain accurate documentation of local IT assets, configurations, procedures and support activities.


**Skills And Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration and end\-user support, ideally supporting a regional, satellite or multi\-site office.
* Hands\-on experience with hardware inventory management, device repair and replacement, and end\-to\-end device lifecycle management.
* Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, security and physical access controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy and cloud or hybrid server administration.
* Experience with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools for device management and onboarding or offboarding.
* Strong Windows end\-user support and troubleshooting skills.
* Comfortable working as the primary on\-site IT presence and independently managing local priorities while escalating to global teams when needed.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support and implement globally defined policies and processes locally.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.


**What does ReOrbit do?**
 ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software\-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
   

  

 ReOrbit’s top\-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in\-house software, procure hardware from the best\-in\-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Working at ReOrbit**
 At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
   

  

 We offer
   

  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance \- but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society.


 Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications
   

  

 and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era.
   

  

 The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies

All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

title: Senior Consultant -Financial Modelling and Economics (Transactions) Advisory
description:
**Job Description**
 At WSP, we are driven by a shared purpose: to create positive, long\-lasting impacts on the world around us. As a global leader in strategic advisory services, we are proud to have been named
 **\#1 Advisor by Deal Value in 2024** 
 by Infranews . Our Investment and Transaction Advisory team are at the forefront of shaping the future of infrastructure, energy, and transport \- supporting clients such as DESNZ as Technical Advisor to their CCUS programme \- through complex investment decisions and delivering insight that drives sustainable growth.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior Consultant** 
 with expertise in
 **financial modelling and economic analysis** 
 to support high\-profile advisory and transaction assignments across a broad range of real asset sectors.
   

  

 The role involves working at the intersection of financial analysis, commercial insight, and operational understanding, supporting clients in evaluating investment opportunities, assessing risks, and developing robust forward\-looking projections, while also providing exposure to a broader range of infrastructure sectors, including energy, transport and social infrastructure, across high\-profile investment transactions and strategic advisory mandates
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Financial Modelling \& Analysis**
* Developing, reviewing, and maintaining robust, auditable financial models (project finance, asset\-level, and portfolio models).
* Analysing key value drivers, including:
* Revenue, demand, and utilisation dynamics
* Capex (initial, expansion, lifecycle) and cost phasing
* Operating cost structures and performance benchmarks
* Performing investment appraisal and returns analysis (IRR, NPV, payback, and where relevant lender metrics such as DSCR).
* Designing and executing scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess downside resilience and upside potential.


**Economic \& Market Analysis**
* Undertaking macro, sectoral, and market analysis, including:
* Demand drivers (economic growth, demographics, industry trends)
* Competitive positioning and benchmarking
* Regulatory and policy considerations (as applicable)
* Translating economic and demand insights into quantitative modelling assumptions.


**Transaction \& Strategic Advisory**
* Supporting the delivery of technical and commercial due diligence assignments from a financial and economic perspective.
* Reviewing business plans and financial projections prepared by sponsors or operators, including:
* Revenue and demand assumptions
* Capex programmes and lifecycle requirements
* Operating strategies and cost forecasts
* Identifying key risks, gaps, and inconsistencies, and providing independent views on the robustness of underlying assumptions.
* Providing technical and commercial input into bids and pursuits, shaping competitive proposals through robust asset and demand insights to strengthen proposals.
* Supporting development and refinement of investment cases, financial projections, and strategic plans.
* Reviewing data room materials and financial models, ensuring consistency between technical, commercial, and financial inputs.
* Preparing clear, client\-ready outputs, articulating key risks, sensitivities, and value drivers to support decision\-making.
* Working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment between technical assumptions and financial outputs.


**OUR TEAM**
 The Investment and Transaction Advisory team has a strong track record of supporting clients at the early stage of projects such as feasibility plans, market forecasts as well as technical assessment of complex projects. As part of the GCC delivery team, the role supports opportunities and projects across Europe, Asia and North America. Our key clients cover a wide range of different organisations in the private and public sectors. Key clients include financial institutions (pension funds, investors and financiers), operators (utilities, ports, rail and mobility) and energy industry.
   

  

 We are expanding from a strong transport base into new sectors, including industrial clients, major government programmes (e.g. Port Infrastructure Fund, UK Freeports), mobility, and energy infrastructure. WSP has a global network of over 10,500 advisory professionals and 80,000 employees across technical, sustainability and advisory disciplines, enabling our front\-end consultancy to draw on deep expertise across transaction advisory (including PPP), investment advisory, market studies, demand forecasting, feasibility studies, and management consultancy.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE**
* Relevant experience in:
* Infrastructure / investment advisory
* Project finance / financial advisory
* Consulting or transaction environments
+ Strong expertise in financial modelling, including:

* Project finance / cash flow models
* Model review and validation
+ Experience in reviewing and challenging financial projections and underlying assumptions.
+ Exposure to multiple sectors / asset classes (sector\-agnostic profile preferred).
+ Strong understanding of:

* Revenue and cost drivers
* Lifecycle capex and operating models
* Investment appraisal methodologies
+ Experience in economic and market analysis supporting investment decisions.
+ Advanced Excel capability with strong focus on model transparency, auditability, and flexibility.
+ Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and deliver under tight timelines.
+ Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear insights for investors and lenders.

description:
**About The Team**
 The Senior Specialist, Frontline Support, Enablement empowers Zillow’s sales teams by designing and delivering enablement programs, training, and resources that drive seller effectiveness and business results. This role leads cross\-functional initiatives to streamline onboarding, continuous learning, and sales playbooks, ensuring sellers have the tools and knowledge needed to excel. Operating with high autonomy, the Senior Specialist partners across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify gaps, optimize processes, and enhance the adoption and impact of enablement strategies.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of sales enablement programs—including playbooks, tools, and resources—to support effective prospecting, pipeline management, and deal execution. \- Develop and maintain sales training content (live, virtual, and asynchronous), ensuring materials are accurate, scalable, and aligned to product updates and go\-to\-market priorities. \- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Analytics to identify seller needs, friction points, and translate insights into enablement strategies and assets that improve productivity and conversion. \- Analyze enablement program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics; diagnose capability gaps and recommend enhancements to content, processes, and delivery channels. \- Act as a subject matter expert on enablement tools and systems, supporting configuration, usage best practices, and change management to ensure easy access and adoption by sales teams. \- Coordinate and facilitate cross\-functional efforts for major sales initiatives (e.g., new product launches, campaign rollouts, sales kickoffs), ensuring timely, cohesive messaging, training, and supporting collateral. \- Mentor and coach less experienced enablement and sales support team members on best practices in content design, training facilitation, and data\-informed decision\-making. \- Document and refine standard operating procedures for enablement programs, including governance for content updates, intake and prioritization of requests, and communication plans to the sales organization.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or a related field. \- 8\+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, revenue programs, or a closely related sales support function, including experience designing and delivering sales training and content for quota\-carrying teams. \- Proven experience using data and sales performance metrics to evaluate enablement impact and inform program improvements. \- Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to support go\-to\-market initiatives and drive seller adoption of tools and processes. \- Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

* The Physical Network Inventory team are reliable for maintaining the GIS inventory systems that are used to plan and build the Openreach network.
* These systems have been central in helping the Openreach rollout of full fibre to the UK.
* The role also involves futureproofing these critical systems to ensure they remain available, operational and well helped into the future.


**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As a hands\-on Backend Engineer with deep PostgreSQL expertise you will be reliable for application development with strong database engineering skills, including performance tuning, security (RLS), and DBA responsibilities. The role will contribute across backend development, database design, and DevOps\-enabled delivery.
   

  

 Backend Development
   

  

* Design and develop scalable backend services using Java (Spring Boot) or equivalent frameworks
* Build and optimize data\-intensive APIs and services
* Collaborate with frontend and cross\-functional teams to integrate backend systems.
* Ensure clean code, modular architecture, and maintainability
* Implement best practices for error handling, logging, and observability.


 PostgreSQL Database Expertise (Primary Responsibility)

* Write highly optimized complex SQL , functions and stored procedures (PL/pgSQL)
* Perform query tuning, execution plan analysis and performance optimization
* Should have worked on postGIS.

 DBA \& Database Operations

* Configure and maintain replication, high availability (HA), and failover mechanisms.

* Manage role\-based access control (RBAC) and fine\-grained privilege.
* Ensure data protection standards (masking, encryption, auditing)

 DevOps \& Platform Contributions

* Automate database deployments and monitoring

* Advanced knowledge of SQL, PL/pgSQL, postGIS and query optimization

* Strong understanding of RLS, RBAC, and data base security principles

* Experience working in Linux environments

description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Principal Escalation Engineer (Customer Engineering)
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
   

  

 We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
   

  

 Disruption is at the core of our technology and on our way of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. We’re changing the nature of work from benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
   

  

 Your Career
   

  

 This is a highly visible, senior level position in the customer engineering team that will benefit from out of box thinking and technical insight. The ideal Principal Escalation Engineer has a mix and background of customer management and broad and deep technical skills related to telecommunication equipment and Internet traffic. This Customer Engineering role is positioned to intercept and assist or drive technical escalations that come to the engineering for helping triage and drive towards resolution . Escalations of this type are extremely critical and are driven by the account teams in the field. In this role you will engage executive levels at customers, delivering get well plans, explaining the root cause or progress and addressing technical questions during customer interactions. Focal point to provide status to internal stakeholders and drive product improvements through serviceability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Requirements Typically Include**
* Incident Management: Leading "war rooms" and managing Sev1/Sev2 incidents to resolve complex technical blockers across cloud infrastructures, distributed systems, and networks.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Triaging escalated issues and performing deep\-dive diagnostics, log tracing, and code\-level investigations to eliminate recurring problems
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Acting as the primary liaison between customers and internal product/engineering teams to validate permanent bug fixes and improve overall product quality.
* Technical Requirements: requires 7\+ years of industry experience and deep domain knowledge, such as Layer 1\-7 OSI networking, packet capture analysis, dynamic routing (BGP/OSPF), Cybersecurity solutions including firewall/vpn technologies and advanced troubleshooting via tools like Wireshark
* Mentorship: Advising and mentoring junior engineers while promoting best practices in problem resolution and incident management.


 Your Impact
   

  

* Understand escalation process, identify areas of gaps and work on improvements in existing processes
* You will work with internal support teams, service delivery teams and account teams to provide solutions to critical customer situations
* Support \& drive customer get well plans
* Support, debug, and break fix any issues collaborating with internal engineering teams
* Coordinate day\-to\-day problem, issue resolution and ensure timely resolution of issues
* Co\-dev any innovative tools helping in problem troubleshooting and resolution

title: Staff Platform Engineer — Infra & Common Layer — Swym
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job Remote\-first
   

  

* Full\-time
* Bengaluru\-based team. Sits within Platform Engineering, working closely with swym\-integration, SRE, and the AI/automation function. What Swym is and why this role exists Every day, millions of shoppers save products they want but are not ready to buy. Most brands never know it happened. Swym fixes that. We capture what shoppers want at the earliest and most specific point in their journey, and we make that signal usable across every channel a brand has, until the purchase completes. 48,000\+ brands use Swym today. Building the feature is rarely the hard part anymore. With AI doing first\-draft engineering, most features move from idea to working prototype fast. What doesn't move on its own is adoption: whether a merchant who has access to a capability actually turns it on, uses it, and keeps using it. That gap, between shipped and adopted, is what this role exists to close. Every restock or price\-drop event on a merchant's store fans out to thousands of alerts—email, SMS, push—across Wishlist Plus, Back in Stock, and Price Drop. As our footprint has scaled to tens of thousands of Shopify merchants, our high\-fan\-out pipelines—originally built on Redis—are reaching the limits of their original architecture. To support our next phase of enterprise growth, we are modernizing this foundation: introducing strict multi\-tenant isolation, guaranteed message SLAs, and high\-signal, actionable observability that eliminates operational noise. Building a new queue architecture is straightforward. The real engineering craft lies in executing a zero\-downtime migration of a live, high\-throughput system without merchant disruption, while establishing the SLA discipline and observability that makes the next five years of this pipeline predictable and resilient. Moving our infrastructure from "handles current volume" to "provably reliable per message, per merchant" is what this role exists to achieve. How we actually work We are a lean team that runs on AI and GitHub. No wiki. If it matters, it is in the repo or it does not exist. When a merchant workflow needs instrumenting, AI drafts the event schema. When a channel needs a first\-pass message, AI writes it. When we need to know which merchants are underusing a feature, AI pulls the query. Humans decide what the data actually means, which channel earns the spend or the send, and what gets shipped to a merchant's inbox or in\-app surface. That model runs across this role specifically: positioning is not this role's job, activation is. What you will own In your first 90 days — Master the pipeline and map the architecture Get fluent in the swym\-integration layer end\-to\-end: how a webhook becomes an alert, where Redis operates in that path, and where structural bottlenecks occur under peak load. Identify the highest\-impact queue to migrate first and defend that strategy with real traffic data. Ship the first feature\-toggled queue migration off Redis—live in production, with a thoroughly tested, zero\-risk rollback path. At six months — Scalable event architecture in motion At least 5 core queues are live on the new pipeline behind feature toggles, with automated DLQ and replay mechanisms fully active in production. Achieve rock\-solid queue stability across migrated pathways, maintaining 99\.99%\+ uptime even during high\-volume peak sale events. Ship OpenTelemetry tracing from enqueue to completion for migrated paths, backed by per\-merchant SLA dashboards that flag potential bottlenecks before they impact delivery. At twelve months — Enterprise\-grade reliability and legibility Queue migration off Redis is complete or strictly scoped to deliberate edge\-case workloads. A structured P1–P4 severity framework is live, complete with clear ownership and actionable runbooks that allow engineers across the organization to act with total confidence. Telemetry and trace data are exposed as queryable interfaces for both engineers and LLM agents. Implement service\-to\-service SLAs, noisy\-neighbor isolation, and dedicated priority lanes for enterprise merchants. The success metric at twelve months isn't just migrated queues—it's an operating environment so resilient and legible that on\-call duty becomes completely calm. Who you are Proven Migration Experience: You have deep distributed systems experience and have led at least one zero\-downtime architecture migration at real production scale. You know how to safely evolve live systems without dropping events or interrupting service. SLA \& System Reliability Mindset: You think in failure modes, multi\-tenant isolation, and explicit performance guarantees. When reviewing observability, your goal is high signal\-to\-noise ratio and immediate actionability. AI\-First Workflow: You leverage AI to draft instrumentation, scaffold migration tools, and query traces—while keeping critical judgment on cutover risks, system boundaries, and architecture squarely in your hands. Background: 7\+ years in Platform, SRE, or Distributed Infrastructure roles (as a guideline). Clojure experience and familiarity with high\-fan\-out notification systems are a strong plus, but engineering judgment and migration experience matter most. What is in it for you Most infrastructure modernizations are scoped as background "maintenance" bolted onto someone's existing workload without the authority to change core architecture. Here, you own the entire path: from evolving legacy queueing patterns to establishing the SLA and telemetry standards for our core messaging engine. If your idea of a great career win is: "I took a foundational high\-throughput system, modernized it live without dropping a single merchant event, and turned a complex pipeline into a bulletproof enterprise platform," you'll thrive here. Logistics Compensation: Competitive cash and meaningful equity. We will talk specifics early. How to apply Please apply directly through this LinkedIn job post or send your resume across to rishin.babu@swymcorp.com or sakshi.gupta@swymcorp.com

****In\-Office at ThoughtSpot****
 Spotters are expected in\-office 3\+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem\-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in\-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
   

  

**About ThoughtSpot**
 The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI\-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C\-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
   

  

 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
   

  

**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.

 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.

****ThoughtSpot for All****
 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****

When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. title: GenAI QA / AI Test Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Gen AI QA Engineer
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (On\-site)
 



**Experience Level:** 
 5–8 Years
 



  




**Role Summary** 

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Gen AI QA Engineer** 
 to lead the quality assurance lifecycle for next\-generation generative AI and agentic AI systems. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, functional accuracy, and performance of large language model (LLM) applications across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). You will bridge traditional automation and non\-deterministic AI validation, building robust test pipelines that safeguard model outputs against bias, hallucinations, and safety violations.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* **AI Test Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end test strategies tailored to GenAI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and agentic workflows.
* **LLM \& Agentic Output Validation:** 
 Perform rigorous evaluation of model responses to detect and mitigate hallucinations, bias, toxicity, alignment issues, and non\-deterministic drift.
* **Prompt \& Model Regression Testing:** 
 Systematically evaluate prompt iterations, model fine\-tuning impact, and version changes to prevent regression across software releases.
* **Automation \& CI/CD Integration:** 
 Build and maintain scalable test automation suites using modern frameworks (Playwright, Selenium) and integrate automated AI quality gates directly into CI/CD pipelines.
* **API \& Integration Testing:** 
 Validate end\-to\-end data flows, tool bindings, and REST/gRPC API interfaces connecting front\-end applications, orchestrators (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex), and backend AI services.
* **Dataset Management:** 
 Curate, synthetic\-generate, and maintain golden evaluation datasets to measure baseline AI precision, recall, and safety metrics across varied user edge cases.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with AI/ML developers, prompt engineers, and product managers to define clear acceptance criteria, benchmark safety thresholds, and enforce quality gates.



  




**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 
* **Core QA Expertise:** 
 5 to 8 years of hands\-on software testing experience spanning both manual exploratory techniques and automated testing paradigms.
* **GenAI / LLM Testing:** 
 Proven track record of evaluating LLM\-powered applications, prompt behavior, non\-deterministic outputs, and responsible AI safety boundaries.
* **Automation Frameworks:** 
 Proficient in automated UI and workflow testing using
 **Playwright** 
 ,
 **Selenium** 
 , or modern JavaScript/Python\-based automation frameworks.
* **API Testing:** 
 Demonstrated experience testing microservices and APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or PyTest.
* **CI/CD \& DevOps:** 
 Practical experience embedding automated quality gates into CI/CD workflows (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI).
* **Scripting Skills:** 
 Strong coding ability in
 **Python** 
 or
 **JavaScript/TypeScript** 
 for writing test automation scripts and data validation routines.



  




**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 
* Familiarity with specialized LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens, or Promptfoo).
* Hands\-on exposure to RAG pipeline evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Recall).
* Basic understanding of security testing for LLMs (e.g., prompt injection prevention, jailbreak testing).

title: Service Engineer
description:
Twara Robotics is an Indian industrial robot manufacturer and part of the ACE Micromatic Group. We design and build articulated robot arms and turnkey robotic welding systems, with both hardware and software developed in\-house in Bengaluru.
 



 Our focus is on making automation accessible to Indian manufacturers. Our welding robots are lightweight, work with the welding power sources customers already own, and can be set up by welders and shop\-floor engineers without a dedicated robot programmer. Systems are deployed across heavy engineering and auto component plants, and are backed by service support through the ACE Micromatic network of 70\+ offices nationwide.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Service Engineer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad area. The Service Engineer will perform installation, commissioning, and preventive maintenance of robotic arms and related systems at customer locations. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing technical issues, executing repairs, and providing hands\-on technical support to ensure high system uptime and safety. The role involves field visits, responding to service requests, documenting service activities, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to relay feedback from customers. The Service Engineer will also train customer personnel on proper operation and basic maintenance, support demonstrations and trials, and contribute to continuous improvement of service processes and documentation.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related engineering fields.
* Familiarity with industrial robots, sensors, and safety standards.
* Experience with Industrial Robot welding application is benificial.
* Candidates should possess strong Troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support capabilities, including remote assistance and issue escalation.
* Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, and schematics, and to use diagnostic tools and basic test equipment.
* Comfort with travel within the region, a customer\-service mindset, and the ability to work independently on\-site.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Plum** 




  





 Welcome to Plum, where we take a step towards building the most trusted \& loved insurance \& healthcare provider for people \& companies, one step at a time, one person at a time. We got into this space when the founders, Saurabh \& Abhishek, felt that this industry was a unique combination of a large industry (100k Cr\+ Premiums), growing fast (20%\+ CAGR over past 20 years), where the customer experience was not close to what we could deliver using technology.
 



  





 Over the past 5 years, we have done what no one could expect to \- innovate, raise the customer experience bar while onboarding more than 4000 companies, 700,000 lives, 20 of India’s unicorns while delivering great value to our customers (our NPS is more than double the industry average).
 



  





 We are on a mission to provide the highest quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030 through companies that care and are backed in our mission by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.
 



  





**About the team** 




  





 Plum’s Account Managers operate with 4 core principles:\-
 


1. **We exist to disrupt the insurance industry by raising the bar on customer experience.**


* The insurance world has a lot of ‘hairy problems’ \- over\-complicated systems, too much paperwork, low trust, too much fine print, too many hiding features
* We want to be the company that is a friendly insurance \& health partner not just a service provider, who just takes over, who are super easy to use and super smooth to work with


1. **We will learn from our customers \- We handle more diverse customers than you can imagine and from them our AMs learn and become rock\-stars.** 
 Our customers range from Large Global Capability Centres, Fast Growing Start Ups, niche enterprises like Aerospace\-focused companies, etc.
2. **We are a team which keeps trying to raise the bar in everything \- from quality of work, people growth to a culture of promoting from within**


* All our current team leaders started off as ICs in the past 2\-3 years and are now leading businesses of \> 20 Cr of Premiums’
* We aim to be the first insurance broker in India to manage 10,000 customers and want folks who build systems//processes to achieve this.



  





**About the role** 




  





 Having found product/market fit, we’re in the midst of transitioning from 'start\-up' to ‘scale\-up’. We are looking for builders, hackers and straight\-up hustlers to help us build something memorable. We’re looking for outstanding account managers who have consistently delivered high customer satisfaction, thrive in taking full ownership of delivering delight to customers and folks who are hungry to smash targets. We want people who want a run a mini business of your own
 



  





***Note: This role will be based in Bangalore for the first 6 months for training, after which it will transition to Mumbai as the full\-time base location.***




  





**Responsibilities** 



* You will manage a set of diverse accounts in an end\-to\-end manner, having 100% accountability of all the outcomes of that account \- from escalations to relationship building to retention and revenue.
* To get started, you would develop a good understanding of the product and work with different teams to make internal processes more efficient
* Once you build some credibility, you will also be responsible for cross\-selling and getting customer referrals to build your own book.



**Role Requirements** 



* Ideally 3\-5 years of experience in B2B sales and a customer\-facing role
* Very strong written and verbal communication and high numeric ability
* High customer empathy and extreme ownership
* Strong problem solver, can hustle to unblock customers
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams to resolve issues
* Strong adherence to SLAs and processes

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**About Runable** 




 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. We ship fast, own our work end to end, and measure success by what our customers actually get done.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring an Engineering Lead who is a backend\-heavy full stack builder. You will own services end to end: data model, API, business logic, background jobs, and the React screens that sit on top of them. Roughly 70% of your time is backend and systems work, 30% frontend.
 



 This is a builder role, not a ticket\-taking role. You will be given a problem and the context around it, and you are expected to come back with a design, ship it, and stand behind it in production.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, build, and operate backend services and REST/JSON APIs that power customer\-facing products.
* Own data modeling and database work in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.
* Build asynchronous and event\-driven flows: background jobs, queues, retries, idempotency, and scheduled work.
* Integrate third\-party systems (payments, email, CRM, messaging, LLM providers) with sane error handling and rate\-limit behavior.
* Build the frontend for the features you own in React and TypeScript — clean, fast, accessible screens, not throwaway UI.
* Instrument what you ship: logging, metrics, alerts, and dashboards, so failures are visible before customers report them.
* Improve reliability and performance — find the slow query, the N\+1, the memory leak, the cache that should exist, and fix it.
* Review peers' code, write the design docs that matter, and keep the codebase something the next engineer can work in.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for the services you own, and drive incident follow\-ups to closure.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5–9 years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it on backend systems.
* Strong command of at least one backend language used in production at scale — TypeScript/Node.js preferred; strong Python, Go, or Java experience with willingness to work primarily in TypeScript is welcome.
* Deep, practical PostgreSQL (or comparable relational database) experience: you can explain a query plan, design a schema for a real product, and migrate it safely with live traffic.
* Proven experience designing and shipping APIs consumed by real clients — versioning, pagination, auth, error contracts.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend fundamentals: component structure, state management, forms, and API integration.
* Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), containers, CI/CD, and deploying your own code.
* Solid grasp of caching, queues, and background processing (Redis, SQS/Kafka/BullMQ or equivalents).
* Testing discipline — unit and integration tests, and a clear view of what is worth testing.
* Strong debugging skills in production environments and the judgment to know when to patch versus when to fix properly.
* Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a non\-engineer.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a startup or on a small team where you owned a service end to end.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS experience — tenancy models, per\-tenant limits, billing, and usage metering.
* Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or workflow automation in production.
* Payments and subscription billing (Stripe or similar).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry, Datadog).
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Timeframe** 




**Expected outcome** 




 First 30 days
 



 Environment set up, first features shipped to production, familiar with the core data model and services.
 



 First 60 days
 



 Owning a service or product area end to end, contributing to design reviews, closing reliability gaps you found yourself.
 



 First 90 days
 



 Leading delivery of a significant backend project, measurably improving performance or reliability of the area you own, and raising the bar in code review.
 



  





**Our Stack** 




 TypeScript across the stack, Node.js/Bun services, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud\-hosted infrastructure with CI/CD. We are pragmatic about tools — the right choice is the one the team can operate at 3am.
 



  





**Why Runable** 



* Real ownership: you pick the design, ship it, and see the customer impact within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — your work reaches SMB customers who feel the difference immediately.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

**Job Description**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them.
