 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements Or Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

* Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, firmware, OS, driver, and software teams to investigate system\-level performance and power issues across Linux and bare\-metal environments.
* Develop C/C\+\+ and Python\-based automation, profiling, and data\-analysis tools to improve performance characterization, debug efficiency, and guide SoC/platform optimization.



**Skills Required:**




 Strong expertise in
 **SoC performance architecture and pre\-silicon performance analysis** 
 , including:
 


* Hands\-on experience with simulation and hardware emulation platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu, or equivalent
* Performance analysis using cycle\-accurate, transaction\-level, and emulation\-based environments
* Waveform\-based debug and signal\-level performance analysis
* Latency, bandwidth, throughput, QoS, and utilization characterization
* Transaction\-level tracing and protocol debug across CHI, AXI, PCIe, CXL, or equivalent system protocols
* Identification of system\-level bottlenecks across compute, interconnect, memory, and IO subsystems
* Architectural tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, bandwidth, and implementation complexity



 Strong experience with

 , including:
 


* Development and use of

 **performance, power, latency, bandwidth, utilization, and efficiency analysis**

 , including alignment of pre\-silicon projections, emulation results, and post\-silicon measurements
* Early\-stage architecture exploration to evaluate
 **performance, power, area, thermal, TDP, and efficiency tradeoffs**
* Using models to guide
 **SoC architecture decisions, IP configuration, memory/interconnect sizing, QoS strategy, and platform\-level optimization**
* Ability to translate modeling insights into clear architectural recommendations and measurable product improvements



 Extensive experience in
 **post\-silicon performance and power characterization** 
 , including:
 


* Silicon bring\-up support from a performance and PnP perspective
* Performance counter, PMU, telemetry, and trace\-driven investigations
* Correlation of pre\-silicon projections, architectural models, and silicon measurements
* Root\-cause analysis of performance gaps, power inefficiencies, and workload\-level bottlenecks
* System\-level performance tuning under real silicon constraints
* Analysis of workload behavior under power, thermal, voltage, frequency, and TDP limits



 Strong understanding of
 **SoC system infrastructure and platform\-level PnP behavior** 
 , including:
 


* Coherent interconnect fabrics and cache\-coherency protocols
* DDR memory subsystems, memory controller behavior, scheduling, QoS, and bandwidth efficiency
* IO subsystems including PCIe, CXL
* Power management architecture, DVFS, clocking, voltage domains, power states, and throttling mechanisms



 Proven experience working in both

 , including:

* Ability to debug issues across hardware, firmware, OS, driver, and workload layers



 Strong background in
 **computer architecture and microarchitecture** 
 , including:
 


* CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP or accelerator performance behavior

* System\-level performance interactions across compute, memory, IO, and power\-management blocks
* Workload characterization and mapping of application behavior to architectural bottlenecks



 Proficiency in
 **C/C\+\+ and Python** 
 for developing:
 


* Performance and power analysis tools
* Automation frameworks
* Profiling and telemetry infrastructure
* Data analysis and visualization dashboards
* Correlation flows across model, emulation, and silicon data



 Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to:
 


* Clearly present complex performance and power findings to architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and leadership teams

* Lead investigations across multiple teams and convert debug findings into architectural improvements, tuning proposals, or product guidance

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead strategic planning and execution of selection expansion initiatives by analyzing market trends and identifying growth opportunities
* Create and implement marketing strategies to drive brand awareness and customer engagement on Amazon
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with brands to optimize their catalog quality and product content
* Analyze performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve brand performance
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure product availability and supply chain efficiency

 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll start your day reviewing key performance metrics for your brand portfolio, followed by strategy sessions with brand partners. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with marketing, catalog, and operations teams to drive improvements across various business levers. You'll analyze data to identify growth opportunities and develop action plans to capitalize on them

 Strategic Brand Services is a new initiative at Amazon India focused on providing dedicated support to premium brands. Our team combines analytical rigor with creative problem\-solving to help brands achieve their full potential on Amazon.

title: Associate Director - Growth & Retention
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth \& Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P\&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function\-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth \& Retention in leadership forums.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Full Lifecycle P\&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
 



 ● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout\-origin) into first\-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time\-to\-first\-purchase.
 



 ● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross\-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi\-product adoption.
 



 ● Retention \& Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.
 



 ● Rewards \& Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.
 



 ● Team \& Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● 7\+ years of experience, with 4\+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
 



 ● 3\+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high\-growth phases.
 



 ● Proven P\&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.
 



 ● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi\-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).
 



 ● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
 



 ● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross\-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.

title: Assistant Manager- Events
description:
**About Swiggy**




  





 Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
 



 From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
 



  





**Events Team Overview** 
 \- The Events team is a crucial team within the Revenue \& Growth function which manages and controls all Events on the Food Delivery BU’s calendar. This includes planning for future events, executing current events and performing analysis of past events to learn from Hits/ Misses and incorporate into future events.
 



  





 This role offers the opportunity to do (a) work on building events which are consumer backward (elevating needs, build new use\-cases) and engaging and (b) data deep\-dive into consumer trends to identifying new opportunities/events and (c) manage multi\-objective problems (growth/ consumer delight/ monetization) and also (d) get things done by coordinating with multiple stakeholders. The program is responsible for overall planning \& execution of high quality events to drive app\-traffic, move consideration to Swiggy and deliver Order\-volume goals.
 



  





 At Swiggy, we take pride in the impact we create in millions of people’s lives. We value honesty, ownership and a keep\-pushing boundaries attitude. We promise you’ll be challenged daily with better and interesting problems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




  





 1\. Plan, strategize, anchor and execute all marketing events for the Food BU on the platform
 



  





 2\. Use AI to analyse user behaviour, ordering patterns, cuisine/category trends, regional nuances and seasonality to build relevant event strategies.
 



  





 3
 
 . Stakeholder Management \& Cross Functional Collaboration :
 
 Solve complex cross\-functional business problems \- Work closely with Product, Business, Design, Category, Supply, Monetisation and Marketing teams to identify levers, evaluate trade\-offs and unlock event growth.
 



  





 3\.
 
 Performance Tracking, Reporting \& Optimization
 
 : Establish clear success metrics and measurement frameworks for every initiative; identify drivers and leakages, and optimize interventions in real time.
 



  





 4\.
 
 Business insighting
 
 : Drive structured reporting and insighting with stakeholders \& leaders, identify growth opportunities, evaluate initiative effectiveness and enable faster, data\-backed decision\-making.
 



  





**Desirable Skills \-** 




  




* Undergrad with \~2 years of high\-paced experience in consulting/ start ups / ecommerce
* Sound analytical reasoning \& abilities
* Competent in SQL, Google Sheets and MS Excel along with an ability to pick up new tools as required
* Strong understanding of
 **business metrics and growth funnels** 
 , including traffic, conversion, retention and incremental impact.
* Experience with
 **experimentation, performance measurement and hypothesis\-driven problem solving** 
 would be an advantage.
* Understand tech and product building (would be an added advantage)
* Very high on consumer backward thinking



  





 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

title: Content Marketer
description:
At Murf AI, we are simplifying voice integration and creation for builders and creators. Our Text\-to\-Speech platforms help developers build natural, responsive voice agents and enable enterprise teams to produce high\-quality voiceovers and multilingual dubs with ease.
 



  





**Some interesting facts about Murf AI:** 




 ●Customers in 100\+ countries
 



 ● 8Mn\+ registered users
 



 ● 200\+ voices in 35\+ languages offered by Murf Studio
 



 ● Rated by G2 as Top 10 Fastest Growing Products in 2024 \& 2025
 



 ● We are working on bleeding\-edge research problems, in synthetic speech, and dubbing
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We're looking for a Content Marketer to write, edit, and scale content across Murf's organic channels. You'll be part of the organic growth team to turn keywords/topics/customer queries into original blogs, landing pages, product teardowns, and product\-led content — and you'll do it at a volume and quality bar that's only possible with AI\-native workflows.
 



 This is not a "write three blogs a month" role. We want someone who treats content production as a system: building briefs, running AI\-assisted drafting pipelines, editing for accuracy and voice, and using data to decide what gets written next. We are looking for someone who can write genuinely helpful content that’s not a summary of a few articles from the internet.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Content Production \& Scale** 




 Write and edit content across Murf's organic channels — long\-form blogs, landing pages, use\-case and comparison pages, glossary and help content — aligned to search, customer queries and search\-intent strategy.
 



 Own the throughput and quality of the content pipeline: briefs in, publish\-ready pages out, with clear turnaround times and quality gates
 



 Operate and improve AI\-native content workflows (LLM\-assisted research, brief generation, drafting, humanizing, and pre\-publish audits)
 



 Refresh and consolidate existing content based on decay, cannibalization, and ranking data
 



  





**SEO Collaboration** 




 Partner with the SEO team on keyword research, SERP analysis, and content gap identification
 



 Structure content for search — headings, entities, internal links, human\-friendly formatting — and for AI search surfaces (AI Overviews, LLM citations)
 



 Track performance in Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and analytics dashboards; use the data to prioritize what to write, update, or retire
 



  





**Product \& Brand Accuracy** 




 Work closely with product, design, and customer\-facing teams so content accurately reflects Murf's features, use cases, and positioning
 



 Maintain Murf's tone of voice and editorial standards across every piece, whether written by a human, an AI, or both
 



 Contribute to content guidelines, style rules, and QC checklists that keep quality consistent as volume grows
 



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of experience in content marketing, with a strong focus on SEO and organic growth
* Must have: prior experience at a B2B SaaS company, writing for technical or semi\-technical buyers
* Well versed in AI\-native content workflows — you've used LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in a real production setting, not just for one\-off drafts, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it hurts
* Genuine comfort with AI and technology as subject matter — you can explain how AI agents, voice AI and LLMs work to a non\-expert reader without getting it wrong
* Working knowledge of SEO tools (Google Search Console, Analytics, Ahrefs or SEMrush) and the ability to analyze data
* Strong portfolio of published content with demonstrable ranking or traffic results
* Excellent editorial judgment: you can tell a good draft from a mediocre one and know exactly what to fix
* Structured, systems\-minded approach to production — you think in briefs, templates, and repeatable processes



  





**Good to Have** 



* Computer science or engineering background, or equivalent technical fluency
* Hands\-on experience with content automation (e.g., multi\-step LLM pipelines, MCP\-connected tools, no\-code/low\-code automation)
* Familiarity with CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, headless CMS) and basic HTML/Markdown
* Experience writing for developer or API audience



  





**Why Murf.ai?** 




 Murf AI is revolutionizing creative workflows for businesses through the utilization of our cutting\-edge AI technology. Recognized as a consistent Leader and Momentum Leader on G2 in 2022 and 2023, we empower L\&D and creative teams to evolve into dynamic creative powerhouses. With a focus on cutting\-edge research and innovation, a positive work culture, and real impact in the AI\-driven space, Murf.ai is one of the fastest\-growing companies in the AI voice space. Join us at this pivotal moment, where your ideas matter, and your leadership can leave a lasting impact. If you're ready for a challenge and have the vision to lead from the front, Murf.ai is where your journey into the next chapter of AI innovation begins.

title: Associate Director - Category
description:
At Pocket, we’ve experienced rapid growth in both revenue and scale over the past few years, further fueling our ambition. With a long\-term vision, we are well\-positioned and well\-capitalized to drive sustained expansion.
 



  





 We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. These roles demand the ability to solve novel, first\-of\-their\-kind problems—often without precedent. Thriving at Pocket requires a mix of high IQ and EQ, analytical rigor, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
 



  





 We offer ambitious goals, complex problem\-solving, and full ownership over execution. Prior experience solving similar problems isn’t required. What matters is adaptability, a willingness to learn and reinvent, and intellectual humility.
 



  





**You’ll be solving for one of these problem statements:** 




  




* **Customer Lifecycle Growth \& Retention** 
 : Drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle with a deep focus on building scalable retention loops and improving lifetime value
* **Content\-Led Growth \& Expansion** 
 : Drive the content charter for retention, scaling high\-performing content to reach new audience segments while supporting launches in new markets
* **Data\-Driven Experimentation** 
 : Move beyond traditional acquisition experiments to test, iterate, and scale initiatives that deepen user engagement, taking inspiration from gaming industry retention models
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership** 
 : Partner with content, product, and analytics teams to design and execute experiments that drive sustainable growth, leveraging insights to inform scalable strategies across diverse genres
* **Scaling** 
 : Leverage AI\-native workflows to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions, enhancing retention and monetization at scale



  





**Here’s what we are looking for:** 




  




* Astute problem\-solving skills and the ability to break (seemingly) large problems into smaller, practical, solvable pieces with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making
* Someone who excels at developing and implementing a plan from concept to completion, generating measurable outcomes across retention, engagement, and monetization
* Track record of productive teamwork—starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* A deep understanding of user needs, preferably gained in consumer\-first companies
* Comfort working with AI automation tools and exposure to LLM\-based workflows to drive scalable growth initiatives
* Action bias: solves problems, executes, and iterates as needed

title: Video Editing and AI Content Intern (Short-Form)
description:
Company Description
 



 AbhyasX is India's AI\-powered exam preparation platform for UPSC and state civil services aspirants. The platform offers AI\-curated daily current affairs, a 17,000\+ question PYQ bank spanning 31 years, AI\-driven Mains answer evaluation, and structured mind maps, along with bilingual (Kannada\-English) content for KPSC aspirants. Trusted by 1,000\+ learners across Karnataka, AbhyasX combines deep civil services expertise with cutting\-edge AI to help aspirants study smarter.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 This is an on\-site Video Editing and AI Content Intern role based in Bengaluru. You will create short\-form videos for two streams: marketing content for AbhyasX, and short\-form content for our AI courses. You will get hands\-on experience with AI video tools like Higgsfield alongside traditional editing software, and work directly with the founder on content that reaches thousands of aspirants.
 



  





 Duration: 3 months
 



 Possibility of a full\-time offer based on performance
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 \- Create short\-form marketing videos for AbhyasX: product demos, feature highlights, exam tips, and current affairs hooks
 



 \- Produce short\-form content for AI courses: concept explainers, tool walkthroughs, and bite\-sized lessons
 



 \- Use AI video tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar) to generate visuals, B\-roll, avatars, and effects
 



 \- Edit footage into 15 to 90 second videos with strong hooks, captions, music, and transitions
 



 \- Adapt content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn
 



 \- Keep up with content trends and new AI tools, and experiment with new formats
 



 \- Help maintain a consistent AbhyasX visual style
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 \- Students or recent graduates with a passion for video and social media content
 



 \- Basic to intermediate skills in any editing tool (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar)
 



 \- Curiosity about AI tools; prior use of Higgsfield, Runway, or similar is a big plus
 



 \- A good sense of what makes short\-form content engaging
 



 \- Willingness to learn fast, take feedback, and work on multiple videos a week
 



 \- Kannada or Hindi proficiency is a plus
 



 \- Interest in edtech, AI, or civil services is an advantage
 



  





 What You Will Gain
 



 \- Real\-world experience building content for an AI startup
 



 \- Hands\-on work with the latest AI video and content tools
 



 \- Direct mentorship from the founder
 



 \- Published work for your portfolio
 



 \- Certificate of internship and letter of recommendation for strong performers
 



  





 To apply, share a few samples of videos you have edited or created (personal projects, college work, or social media content all count).

title: Visual & Creative Design Intern
description:
**Social Media, Website, Product \& Brand Design** 




  





**“We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just make things look good, but someone who can take an idea, turn it into a strong visual, and own the design from concept to final execution.”** 




  





**About the company** 




**Leadzo (** 
 www.leadzo.co.in) is building a modern lead generation and service marketplace platform designed to connect customers with verified service professionals across service industries, from Marketing \& Technology, Legal \& Business, Home Services, Health \& Wellbeing, Construction \& Trades, Lessons \& Training, Events \& Creative, and more.
 



 Our mission: to make it easier, faster, and more transparent for people to discover and hire trusted professionals online, while helping businesses grow through qualified, high\-intent leads.
 



 Our platform is live pan\-India, with active buyers and sellers across the country. We are now in a crucial scale and stabilization phase, improving the product, strengthening our brand, and building a stronger digital presence across our website, product, marketing channels, and social media.
 



 Design plays a major role in that. From a social media post and website banner to a product screen or campaign creative, we want every visual interaction with Leadzo to feel clear, modern, consistent, and purposeful.
 



  





**About the role** 




**We are looking for a** 
**Visual \& Creative Design Intern** 
 who wants to work across different areas of digital design rather than being restricted to one type of creative work.
 



 You will work on
 **social media creatives, website banners, marketing campaigns, presentations, product visuals, website screens, mobile app screens, and other digital assets** 
 .
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You won’t just receive a brief, create one design, and move on. You’ll be expected to understand the objective, explore different creative directions, execute the design, take feedback, and improve it.
 



 You will work closely with the
 **Marketing, Product, and Development teams** 
 , giving you exposure to how design is actually used inside a growing technology company.
 



 We’re looking for someone with strong creative instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the willingness to learn quickly.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create
 **social media posts, carousels, infographics, promotional creatives, and campaign visuals** 
 for platforms such as Instagram and LinkedIn.
* Design
 **website banners, landing page creatives, promotional sections, pop\-ups, and other website assets** 
 .
* Create visual creatives for performance marketing and promotional campaigns.
* Work on
 **website and mobile app screens** 
 when required.
* Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and polished digital designs.
* Develop creative concepts and visual directions for campaigns and new initiatives.
* Maintain consistency in Leadzo’s visual identity across different platforms.
* Adapt designs into different sizes and formats for various digital channels.
* Create presentations and other marketing/design collateral when required.
* Work with the marketing team to turn campaign ideas into compelling visual communication.
* Work with the product and development teams to create clean, practical digital interfaces.
* Take feedback positively and iterate quickly.
* Maintain organised Figma files, components, templates, and design assets.
* Research current design trends and bring fresh creative ideas to the team.
* Continuously improve the quality and consistency of Leadzo's visual communication.



  





**Tools \& Skills** 




**Must have:** 



* Good working knowledge of
 **Figma**
* **Strong understanding of basic design principles**
* **Good eye for typography, spacing, composition, colours, and visual hierarchy**
* **Ability to create clean and modern digital creatives**
* **Basic understanding of responsive design**
* **Ability to work across multiple creative formats**
* **Strong attention to detail**



  





**Good to have:** 



* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva
* Basic motion graphics/video editing
* After Effects
* Premiere Pro
* Basic understanding of UI/UX
* Experience designing websites or mobile apps
* Experience creating social media creatives



 You do not need to know every tool listed above.
 **Strong design fundamentals and a good portfolio matter more than the number of tools you know.** 




  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**We’re looking for someone who:** 



* Thinks creatively instead of simply following templates.
* Can take a rough idea and turn it into a polished visual.
* Has a strong eye for detail.
* Understands that good design is both
 **visually appealing and purposeful** 
 .
* Is comfortable receiving feedback and improving their work.
* Can manage multiple design requirements.
* Is curious about how websites, apps, products, and marketing work.
* Takes ownership of their work instead of waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.
* Wants to build a strong portfolio through real\-world projects.



**Portfolio Is Important** 




  





**Your portfolio matters more than your degree.** 




**You can share:** 



* College projects
* Personal design projects
* Social media creatives
* Website designs
* App designs
* Branding projects
* Posters
* Illustrations
* Freelance work
* Concept designs
* Any other digital design work



 Even if you don't have professional experience, we want to see
 **how you think and what you can create** 
 .
 



  





**What Will Get You Rejected** 



* You only know how to edit existing Canva templates.
* You cannot explain the thinking behind your designs.
* You copy designs without understanding the visual structure.
* You are unwilling to take feedback or make iterations.
* You have no interest in learning beyond social media posts.
* You need detailed instructions for every small design task.
* You prioritise making something flashy over making it clear and useful.
* You have no portfolio or design samples to show.



  





**What You Get** 



* **₹20,000/month internship stipend**
* **Hands\-on experience working on a live technology platform.**
* **Exposure to** 
**social media, marketing, website, product, mobile app, and brand design** 
 .
* Opportunity to work directly with marketing, product, and development teams.
* Real\-world projects that can become part of your professional portfolio.
* Opportunity to learn how design connects with marketing, product, and business objectives.
* A fast\-paced environment where you can experiment, learn, and take ownership.
* Potential opportunity to continue with the company based on performance and business requirements.



  





**Office Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Bangalore, India
 



**Internship Type:** 
 Full\-time, Work From Office
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹20,000 per month

title: Sr Manager | Director - Media Planning
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Sr Manager \| Director \- Implementation Planning, GOC**
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end planning operations across multiple campaigns, brands, or markets while ensuring consistency in quality, timelines, and strategic output.
* Support Associate Directors and market stakeholders in developing integrated media planning recommendations aligned with business and campaign objectives.
* Act as a key escalation point for operational and planning\-related challenges across the team.
* Drive excellence in campaign planning deliverables, including audience strategy, channel allocation, forecasting, reporting frameworks, and post\-campaign analysis.
* Collaborate closely with Activation, Ad Operations, Analytics, and Client Servicing teams to ensure seamless execution of media plans.
* Ensure planning best practices, governance standards, and documentation processes are consistently followed across the team.
* Support implementation and adoption of planning tools, automation solutions, and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor team productivity, delivery quality, and workload allocation to ensure optimal operational performance.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental guidance to Managers, Senior Executives, and Executives.
* Contribute to capability\-building initiatives, knowledge\-sharing forums, and process improvement projects.
* Foster a collaborative and high\-performing team culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.


****Skills And Experience****
* Media Planning teams are experts on the digital media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross\-channel budget allocation, in\-flight cross\-channel optimization \& reporting and post\-campaign analysis. **Job Title: Senior Analyst \- Social listening \& Consumer Insights

The role involves engaging with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translating them into structured, platform\-specific queries that monitor social conversations around internal brands, competitors, products, marketing campaigns, and key events.
   

  

 The Analyst will be responsible for conducting in\-depth analysis of unstructured social media data, identifying key themes and sentiment drivers, and synthesizing findings into concise, insight\-driven narratives. The ability to differentiate meaningful signals from noise and communicate insights in a business\-relevant context is critical.
   

  

 This role requires a high degree of independence, as assignments may lack predefined templates or processes. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem\-solving capabilities, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to manage cross\-functional collaboration effectively. Additionally, the role includes working with multilingual content, requiring the Analyst to derive culturally contextualized insights from non\-English sources.

* Visualize findings through charts, tables, and infographics to clearly communicate insights to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Maintain a recurring and ad\-hoc reporting calendar, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of outputs.
* Demonstrate high attention to detail and data accuracy in all reports, with strong written communication and data storytelling skills.
* Proactively refine and optimize social listening queries to ensure data relevance, minimize noise, and enhance the quality of insights.
* Monitor and share industry best practices and case studies to support capability building within the insights function.
* Adhere to global social listening collaboration protocols, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and processes.
* Apply a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and interpersonal skills to interpret data and influence key stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality and consistency across deliverables.
* Contribute to identifying earned consumer engagement patterns, as well as analyzing campaign\-related performance across platforms.
* QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in social listening, consumer insights or social media marketing roles.
* Proven experience with social listening and analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Cision, Emplifi, or equivalent tools.
* Experience in Consumer Insights tools such as GWI, CreatorIQ, MeltWater or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and ecosystems, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), YouTube, blogs, forums, and emerging channels.
* Demonstrated analytical skills with experience in data gathering, interpretation, and the development of actionable, insight\-driven recommendations.
* Experience building Boolean queries and refining search logic for accuracy and relevance.
* Basic understanding of sentiment analysis and natural language processing.
* Ability to identify emerging trends within the beverage industry and broader social media landscape; culturally aware and informed on global digital conversations.
* Skilled at distilling complex datasets into clear, concise, and business\-relevant insights.
* Strong multitasking and time management abilities with a consistent track record of delivering high\-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Naturally curious and detail\-oriented, with a deep interest in uncovering the “why” behind social trends and behavioral shifts.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional, fast\-paced environment.


**Mandatory Skills:** 
 Digital Marketing, Social Listening, Expertise in PPT and Advanced Excel
   

  

**Preferred Skills:** 
 Power BI, Stakeholder Management
   

  

*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!
   

  

 We dream big to create future with more cheers.*

title: Product Experience Lead
description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. Our customers are mid\-market companies, many in regulated industries.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated product experience hire. You'll own how both products feel, from the first click to the hundredth workflow.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why
* Use Claude Design, Figma and code prototypes to explore quickly, then spend your time choosing and refining
* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools



  





 Bonus points if you've designed AI or agent products, worked in a regulated industry, or can prototype in code.
 



  





 This role probably isn't for you if your best work is Dribbble shots rather than outcomes, or if you'd rather hand off mockups and move on.

title: Associate Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Associate Consultant
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a part of the DnA local products team, you will independently work with local product managers in the market to\-
   

  

* Build their product plan.
* Support in backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Own the complete development of a product: scoping, prototyping, development, testing and release management.
* Manage the development squad: Form the squads and guide them.
* Work in partnership with all the other CoE teams such as RIS, SI, Hub, Lab etc as per the needs of the product.
* Collect feedback on product usage, gather new requirements and manage the post release lifecycle of the product.
* Support in enabling the sales, AM, Trading teams with operationalising the product for new client opportunities and existing client projects.
* Maintain product Wiki


**Who are your stakeholders?**
 As an Associate Consultant, you are required to work with different stakeholders across the MiQ ecosystem:
   

  

**Programmatic Traders:** 
 As an Associate Consultant, you collaborate with traders to test out the activation solutions to help them optimize campaigns. By leveraging your solution\-developing skills \& understanding of the programmatic landscape, you provide actionable activation segments on audience targeting, ad performance, and bidding strategies. This helps traders make data\-driven decisions, optimize their advertising campaigns, and improve overall campaign effectiveness and ROI.
   

  

**Product Managers:** 
 You work closely with the Product managers to leverage the power of data partnerships and through your EDA skills you help uncover valuable insights about customer behavior, market trends, and campaign performance. This information allows Product managers to create a product requirement \& scoping document with all the necessary details about the product's USP, capabilities thus outlining the course of product development
 **Sales Representatives:** 
 You will also be helping the sales team by creating a pitch document/presentation of the Local Product \& Solution for the clients. Your deck/doc helps identify potential opportunities and develop a gripping sales narrative. Additionally, you assist in responding to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by providing data\-driven pre\-campaign insights / white\-labeled case studies out of the products created under various verticals that help us in increasing the revenue streams.
   

  

**Agencies \& Clients:** 
 Your expertise in data analytics, statistics, data sciences \& solution development skills are invaluable for agency and advertiser clients. By providing them with planning, activation \& performance measurement solutions, you empower them to make informed decisions regarding their marketing strategies. Your final recommendations out of the solutions will help clients optimize their advertising budgets, target the right audience, and maximize the effectiveness of their campaigns. You are required to promote MiQ's internal solutions and capabilities, showcasing MiQ's unique value proposition in the programmatic landscape.
   

  

**DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists:** 
 You are required to work with the DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists to form a team with all the expertise in place for robust product development. The product developed under local products will be a collaborative effort of all the 3 experts. You will also have to train all other DnA Analyst on how to use a product, help them pitch to the client, and how to measure the impact of the solution.
   

  

 In summary, as an Associate Consultant, you add value by providing data\-driven planning, activation \& reporting solutions to traders, product managers, sales teams, and agency/advertiser clients that empower MiQ and its stakeholders to reach the right audience with the right content at the right time.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
**Must Haves**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent quantitative field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics)
* 3\.5\+ years’ experience in the analytics domain
* Proficient with either R or Python and PySpark
* Expertise in Excel and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of big data processing tools/frameworks like Qubole /Databricks/Spark, AWS
* Descriptive and Inquisitive Analytics, Statistical modelling and Advanced analytics
* Should have developed and implemented at least 3 analytics solutions end to end.
* Able to translate problems into business\-ready deliverables.
* Excellent Storytelling and visualization skills
* Exposure on Machine learning and Deep Learning
* Sound knowledge of Tableau/ PowerBI /Google Data Studio \> Design and analysis of experiments


**Good to Have**
* Exposure on API Integrations
* Programmatic Media / Ad\-Tech domain knowledge
* Knowledge of Agile methodology, Scrum framework, Sprint planning
* Exposure to project management tools such as JIRA, Trello, Monday.com etc.
* Experience applying AI/ML and Generative AI to build practical analytics solutions, including predictive models, LLM\-based tools, AI agents, automated insights and workflow automation.
* Understanding of AI\-powered product development, including translating business problems into scalable AI/data products, validating model outputs, and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams to take solutions from proof of concept to production.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience, and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
 As an Associate Consultant, your role will create value for MiQ in the following ways:
   

  

* Driving client stickiness: With your ability to leverage different datasets in the MiQ ecosystem and develop solutions out of it, you will help the team in gathering requirements for vertical\-specific products, collecting \& incorporating feedback from the market and the clients, managing the post\-release lifecycle of the product and further identifying enhancement opportunities leading to improved client stickiness
* Driving Profitability: By leveraging the power of data you are expected to identify areas where we can create automated targeting solutions or optimization strategies that optimize costs \& enhance performance of campaigns thus improving profitability and providing competitive edge
* MiQ Growth: Being on top of the key product trends that are leading the industry \& the ability to leverage data within MiQ ecosystem to create competitive or improved solutions to help support MiQ's current business \& tap into new revenue streams to drive growth
* Support Key Decision Making: Your expertise in data analysis and solution development approach provides decision\-makers with the necessary information to make informed choices. Your products help guide agency, advertisers \& internal stakeholders in making strategic and tactical decisions that align with MiQ or client's objectives.
* Analytics Best Practices: As an Associate Consultant, you are expected to introduce analytics, statistics \& solutions best practices within the team, helping in setting up products and quality frameworks within the team \& internal stakeholders
* Developing Custom Analytics Solutions: Leveraging your experience in product development in conjunction with statistics \& advanced analytics, you will be expected to provide solutions to the vertical level problems \& lead the development of MiQ local products technically \& assist in enhancing their adoption within the target market


**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements
 **.** 
 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.
* Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities.


*Apply today!*
*Equal Opportunity Employer*

title: Windows Administrator
description:
**Role Responsibilities**
* Manage and maintain Windows Active Directory (AD DS) environments, including user/group/computer object administration, Group Policy Object (GPO) implementation, and troubleshooting AD replication, FSMO roles, and forest/domain functional levels.
* Configure and support DNS (public/private zones, records, conditional forwarding) and DHCP (scope management, reservations, options) services to ensure reliable network connectivity, name resolution, and TCP/IP infrastructure stability.

* Monitor system health and performance using Azure Monitor, System Center Operations Manager (SCOM), Prometheus/Grafana, or third\-party tools, and proactively resolve issues to ensure high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) readiness.
* Follow ITIL v4 best practices for incident management, problem management, change enablement, and service request fulfillment to ensure service delivery aligns with business continuity and SLA requirements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Security, Network, DevOps, End\-User Computing) and external vendors to resolve complex hybrid infrastructure, cloud migration, and identity governance challenges.
* Document configurations, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and system changes using Confluence, SharePoint, or ServiceNow to support knowledge sharing, audit readiness, and operational continuity.


**Must\-Have**

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high\-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault\-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Optimizes code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing in large\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
   

  

 –Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
   

  

 –Implements performance and load testing.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:
   

  

 –Collaborates with team to build fault\-tolerant components capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
   

  

 –Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
   

  

 –Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:
   

  

 –Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
   

  

 –Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
   

  

 –Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:
   

  

 –Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
   

  

 –Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness.
   

  

 –Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
   

  

 Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:
   

  

 –Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
   

  

 –Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
   

  

 –Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
   

  

 –Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
   

  

 Compliance \& Security:
   

  

 –Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
   

  

 –Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
   

  

 –Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up\-to\-date
   

  

 Automation \& Change Management:
   

  

 –Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 –Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Planning \& Execution:
   

  

 –Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
   

  

 –Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
   

  

 Collaboration \& Partnership:
   

  

 –Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
   

  

 Problem Solving:
   

  

 –Independently identifies and addresses standard and non\-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non\-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
   

  

 Continuous Learning:
   

  

 –Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
   

  

 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

 –Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas: the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the "network," which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
   

  

 Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real\-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
   

  

 In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full\-Stack Observability ("FSO") business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet\-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering Support team who is now part of Cisco TAC is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
   

  

 If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking\-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. This role will resolve customer technical challenges, collaborate directly with engineering to drive product quality, and leverage TAC AI capabilities, automation, and tools to deliver fast, scalable solutions. At senior levels, you will tackle complex, integrated cross\-product architectures and mentor peers across the team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high\-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective critical issues, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Use advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross\-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online\-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model
* Adopts and encourages adoption of AI and automation tools to improve resolution speed and accuracy, productivity, and quality
* Develops and disseminates intellectual capital (e.g., advanced diagnostics, automation workflows, and AI\-assisted troubleshooting guides) that supports global reuse across internal teams, Global Delivery Partners, and customers


**Qualifications**
* A standout "customer first" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5\-8 \+ years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer\-facing role
* Expert\-level certifications (e.g. CCIE) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles \- TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Experienced knowledge of virtualization technology \- containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Experience in security \- authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks are desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize \& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non\-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross\-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
   

  

**Disclaimer**
**About**
 To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
   

  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

 Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. description:

 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.

* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry

**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

The SAP FI\-CA Consultant will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting the FI\-CA module, ensuring seamless end\-to\-end financial process integration — from billing and revenue management through to general ledger and financial controlling. The ideal candidate brings deep FI\-CA expertise, a solid understanding of adjacent SAP Finance modules(BRIM and FI\-CO), and a forward\-looking interest in Agentic AI tools for the intelligent automation of financial processes.
   

  

**CHALLENGE**
**Implementation and Configuration**
* Lead the implementation and configuration of SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounting) solutions based on
* stakeholder and business requirements
* Represent the FI\-CA standard design in the requirement definition process, advocating for minimal
* deviations from the SAP standard
* Configure and maintain FI\-CA integration points with upstream SAP BRIM modules (Subscription Order
* Management, Convergent Invoicing, Convergent Charging) and downstream SAP FI\-CO modules
* (General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Cost Controlling)
* Ensure seamless data flow and reconciliation between billing transactions in BRIM and accounting
* postings in FI\-CO via FI\-CA
* When necessary, customize FI\-CA to align with specific business processes and integration requirements


**Technical Expertise**
* Provide expert guidance on SAP FI\-CA functionalities, including:
* Business Partner and Contract Account management
* Posting and clearing processes for mass volume billing transactions
* Dunning, collections, and dispute management
* Reconciliation key management and FI\-CA to FI\-GL transfer processes
* Payment processing, returns, and refunds
* Act as the go\-to technical authority bridging BRIM billing processes and FI\-CO accounting and general
* ledger requirements
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to FI\-CA implementations and integrations
* Perform system testing and assist in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) processes
* Leverage knowledge of SAP Fiori to support and enhance user\-facing financial process applications and
* launchpad configurations


**Innovation \& AI\-Driven Automation**
* Explore, evaluate, and champion the adoption of Agentic AI tools applicable to the automation of financial
* processes within the FI\-CA landscape (e.g., automated clearing, intelligent dunning, anomaly detection in
* postings, AI\-assisted reconciliation)
* Collaborate with technology and innovation teams to pilot and implement AI\-driven process automation
* solutions within the Order\-to\-Cash and Finance ecosystem
* Stay current with SAP's AI and Business AI roadmap, including tools such as SAP Joule and embedded AI
* capabilities within SAP S/4HANA Finance


**Project Management**
* Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, SAP BRIM consultants, and SAP FI\-CO consultants
* to define project scope, goals, and deliverables
* Manage timelines and deliverables related to FI\-CA implementations and integration workstreams
* Provide regular updates and progress reports to stakeholders across Finance and IT


**Training and Support**
* Conduct training sessions for end\-users, finance teams, and technical teams on SAP FI\-CA functionalities
* and best practices
* Provide ongoing post\-implementation support and maintenance for FI\-CA solutions
* Act as the escalation point for cross\-functional issues spanning BRIM, FI\-CA, and FI\-CO
* Address and resolve user queries related to contract accounting, billing reconciliation, and financial postings


**Documentation and Best Practices**
* Create comprehensive documentation including functional specifications, configuration guides, integration
* design documents, and user manuals
* Promote and embed best practices for FI\-CA implementation, configuration, and usage across the
* organisation
* Maintain clear documentation of integration architecture between BRIM, FI\-CA, and FI\-CO \[1]


**FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH...**
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting or a related field
* Proven minimum 5 years of experience in SAP FI\-CA implementation and configuration, with a minimum
* of 3 full\-cycle S/4HANA implementations
* In\-depth knowledge of SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounting), including:
* Business Partner and Contract Account structures
* Mass posting, clearing, and reconciliation processes
* Dunning and collections management
* Payment runs, returns, and financial close processes
* Strong understanding of SAP BRIM modules (SOM – Subscription Order Management, CC – Convergent
* Charging, CI – Convergent Invoicing) and their integration with FI\-CA
* Solid understanding of SAP FI\-CO (Financial Accounting and Controlling), including General Ledger,
* Accounts Receivable, and Cost Centre Accounting
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash and billing\-to\-accounting process chain
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with Finance, IT, and business
* stakeholders
* Preferred / Desirable
+ SAP FI\-CA certification (strongly preferred)
+ SAP BRIM or SAP FI\-CO certification (advantageous)
+ Hands\-on experience or demonstrable interest in Agentic AI tools for financial process automation (e.g.,
+ intelligent document processing, AI\-driven reconciliation, automated collections workflows)
+ Familiarity with SAP Fiori applications relevant to finance and billing, including launchpad configuration
+ and Fiori\-based reporting
+ Experience working in cross\-functional SAP teams, collaborating across BRIM, FI\-CA, and FI\-CO
+ workstreams
+ Exposure to SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) or integration middleware
+ Additional Requirements

* Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with SAP FI\-CA, BRIM, FI\-CO, and broader SAP
* S/4HANA Finance advancements
* A proactive, innovation\-oriented mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for intelligent automation
* within financial processes
* Willingness to act as a knowledge\-sharing resource across BRIM and FI\-CO consultant teams


**PERSPECTIVE**
* The SAP FI\-CA Solution Consultant role offers a unique and strategically important position within our SAP
* Centre of Excellence. You will serve as the connective layer between our billing and financial accounting
* worlds — ensuring transactional integrity from the first billing event to the final general ledger posting — while
* helping to shape the future of AI\-assisted financial operations.
