**Founder's Office – Offline Sales \& Business Growth** 

  
 



**Lumov \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time \| In\-office** 




  




**About Lumov** 

 Lumov is a venture\-backed healthcare startup building India's leading pain management and orthopaedic solutions brand. Our portfolio spans orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation products, mobility aids and everyday wellness solutions, serving consumers through hospitals, distributors, retail and leading e\-commerce platforms.
 



 Founded by
 **Harvard Business School** 
 and
 **IIT Kharagpur** 
 alumni with deep investing experience in Indian healthcare, Lumov offers an opportunity to build a category\-defining healthcare company from the ground up in a fast\-paced, ownership\-driven environment.
 


**About the Role** 

 This is a Founder's Office position built around one core mandate:
 **own and build Lumov's offline sales business end\-to\-end, working directly alongside the founder.** 




 You won't be handed a playbook \- you'll help write it. This role is for someone who wants to learn what it actually takes to build a business: not just execute a function, but sit close enough to the decisions to understand
 *why* 
 they're made. Over time, expect exposure across hiring, planning, forecasting, and the broader strategic and operating questions that come with growing a company.
 



 Having a, analytical problem solving mindset is extremely critical with a zeal to execute and delivery results.
 



  




**What You'll Do** 

  
 



**Offline Sales – Build \& Run** 



* Design and stand up the offline sales function from scratch: territory approach, channel mix, distribution/retail partnerships
* Hire, train, and manage the on\-ground sales team as it's built out
* Visit distributors, channel partners, customers PAN India to build the business out
* Work on holistic business from hiring to tracking, performance management, sales \& business operations, etc.
* Negotiate with distributors, hospitals, vendors, across the value chain and close deals to deliver results.
* Set and own targets \- business planning, forecasting, and performance tracking
* Run a regular review cadence (yourself and with the founder) \- what's working, what's not, and why
* Troubleshoot in the field when needed \- this is a build role, not a spreadsheet\-only role



**Founder's Office – Broader Scope** 



* Partner with the founder on overall business decisions beyond your core sales mandate
* Get exposure to hiring, org design, fundraising conversations, and cross\-functional problem\-solving
* Take on ambiguous, high\-leverage projects as they come up \- the role will evolve with the business


**Who You Are** 
* 2\+ years of experience, ideally in a startup \- operating roles, growth, sales, or general management
* OR a founder whose venture didn't work out, but who learned from building something of their own
* From a strong college/institute (open to newer\-tier IIMs / IITs and equivalent programs)
* High ownership, low ego \- comfortable being told "figure it out" and actually figuring it out
* Genuinely hungry to learn entrepreneurship from the inside, not just draw a title
* Comfortable with ambiguity, fieldwork, and being measured on outcomes, not hours


**Compensation** 
* Competitive CTC
* Super\-normal performance\-linked bonus on top of fixed, tied to sales targets achieved
* ESOPs, vesting tied to tenure and performance (eligible after probation)


**Why Join** 

 You'll be one of the first people building Lumov's offline business, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founder rather than several layers removed. If you do this well, you're not just running a function \- you're learning how to build a company, with a real stake (via ESOPs) in the outcome.

**hr@acontor.in**

title: Mechanical Engineer - Simulations
description:
**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots
 *intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly,* 
 eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories* 
 that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role places
 **simulation at the centre of mechanical decision\-making** 
 . You will work on
 **mechanical simulations and physical modelling** 
 that directly shape product architecture, performance limits, and risk reduction before hardware is built. The work begins with
 **deep understanding of real\-world problems** 
 , translating them into
 **physical and mathematical models** 
 that guide design choices, experiments, and validation.
 



 We believe strong engineering lives in the balance between
 **analysis, simulation, and physical reality** 
 . This role focuses on using simulations grounded in
 **first principles** 
 to identify unknowns, explore trade\-offs, and design targeted experiments that close the loop with real hardware.
 



 You will own models across the full engineering cycle, from abstraction and simulation\-driven design to validation and iteration, ensuring alignment with
 **manufacturing constraints, testability, and real operating conditions** 
 . The goal is not impressive plots, but
 **robust, manufacturable, and scalable products** 
 whose behaviour is understood in both models and hardware.
 



 This role suits engineers who
 **think in simulations** 
 , enjoy bridging models and real systems, and want their analytical work to directly influence real products
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Build and use
 **simulations as primary thinking too** 
 l
 **s** 
 , including
* Structural, strength, fatigue, material, vibration, and thermal simulations
* Tolerance, stack\-up, and robustness analysis for real\-world variation
* Analyse
 **statics, dynamics, kinematics, and kinetics** 
 of single\-body and multi\-body systems
* Develop
 **system\-level simulations** 
 for: Robotic motion and interaction, Path planning and motion behaviour, including ML and reinforcement\-learning\-assisted workflows, Grasp, contact, friction, compliance, and vision–action coupling physics
* Use simulations to
 **inform design decisions and reduce risk** 
 , not to justify poor designs
* Lead
 **thermal behaviour analysis** 
 under real operating and environmental constraints
* Work closely with
 **design, manufacturing, electronics, algorithms, and application teams**
* Support
 **validation, testing, and correlation** 
 of simulation results with hardware behaviour



  





**What We Look For** 




 This role spans
 **broad mechanical ownership with a simulation\-first lens** 
 , without expecting universal expertise. We look for engineers with
 **deep strength in mechanical simulation and analysis** 
 , supported by enough system\-level understanding to influence real designs
 



**Core Strengths** 



* Strong grounding
 **in mechanical fundamentals and physical intuition**
* Deep expertise in: Structural, strength, fatigue, and vibration analysis, Thermal and Multiphysics behaviour of mechanical systems, Tolerance, stack\-up, and robustness analysis, Statics, dynamics, kinematics, and multi\-body system behaviour



**Mindset** 



* Ability to treat
 **simulations as thinking tools** 
 , not post\-hoc validation
* Comfort translating
 **uncertainty into models, assumptions, and testable hypotheses.**
* Systems thinking that connects simulation results to
 **design, manufacturing, and use cases**
* Strong inclination toward
 **validation, documentation, and closing the loop with hardware**
* Ability to interpret
 **control, algorithm, or motion\-planning concepts** 
 as mechanical constraints



**Tools** 



* Proficiency with
 **CAD and 3D modelling tools** 
 (Fusion 360 preferred)
* Working familiarity with
 **simulation and Multiphysics tools**
* Exposure to
 **motion systems, actuators, sensors, and basic electronics**
* Experience with
 **scripting or programming for analysis and automation** 
 is a plus



*Specific tools are not the primary filter. First\-principles thinking and the ability to build useful models matter most* 




  





**Team Structure \& Growth** 




 The mechanical team includes
 **simulation\-focused engineers, design engineers, solutions engineers, and general mechanical engineers** 
 , working together to build complete physical systems. You will work in a
 **highly cross\-functional environment** 
 , collaborating closely with
 **electronics, algorithms, software, manufacturing, and applications** 
 teams. Even in a simulation\-focused role, your work remains tightly connected
 
 to
 **design decisions, hardware behaviour, and deployment realities** 
 . As CynLr grows, there are opportunities
 
 to
 **specialise de** 
 e
 **ply** 
 , lead simulation\-driven subsystems, or expand into
 **system architecture, product design, or application engineering.** 




  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Object manipulation in robotics remains unsolved because
 **traditional assumptions and tools fall short** 
 . Here, simulations are not an academic exercise; they are how
 **we understand reality before building** 
 it. Your work will directly
 **shape how robots interact with the physical world** 
 , and in the process, redefine
 **what simulation\-driven mechanical engineering** 
 looks like in robotics.
 



  





**Detailed JD Here: Mechanical Engineer \- Simulations**

title: Member of Technical Staff - Research
description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 Robotics is an industry that has been gestating for 70 years yet it has never arrived.
 



  





 Every time, its perceived moment arrived, it was always an "Use\-Case" for some other technology, including now \- an Use\-Case for \#LLM/VLA. Intelligence is a Slave of Data\-\> Slave of Signal \-\> Slave of Sensor. Not Action. Robotics is Formfactor and action obsessed, but autonomy begins from Sensing.
 



  





 Robotics is often mistaken for a problem that's just lacks Savvy Engineering to put together current technology in a meaningful way. In reality \- Robotics lacks \& needs foundational and fundamental technology \& tools needed to Build it. This is a Foundational research problem.
 



  





 Robotics has a problem of Building a Car with Cycle Wheels. None of the technology or the components that we use for robotics were developed for Robotic Manipulation.
 



  





 Beyond the dancing mannequins, Robotics is a Foundational \#Research problem, and it begins from Sensing by Action to Force Controlled Motion than just Position Control to Multi\-Arm Action Planning to Foundations of \#ML that Mirrors \#Neuroscience of Cognition \& Motion.
 



  





 𝐑𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧! 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐨𝐧𝐞.
 



  





 If you are a researcher, a PHD student, Post doc or a Research scientist/ Faculty and if you connect with the Constraints of Current Approach to Intelligence, Sensors, Compute and Robotics and is eager to dive deep into the Rabit hole \- Apply.
 



  





 https://lnkd.in/gDCNtJnw
 



  





  





**Research Topics \& Domains:** 




  





***Vision and Algorithms***



* Dynamic Vision \- Vergence, Motion Imaging \& Dynamic depth – Hierarchical Depth Construction, Imaging, Optics \& sensors – Building intelligence into Sensing
* Exploring primitive Neural layers/ Pathway of Human vision
* Object Composition – Texture, contours, grasp mapping, force field – process of learning an object \- Primitive Visual Patterns and stitching of contours into an object
* Process of Colour Construction
* Understanding Reflections, Attention \& Priority of Feature Selection
* Visual Models \- breaking down scenes into Action models
* Involuntary \& Voluntary Imaging



  





***Manipulation \& Sensing***




  




* Skin Transducers for Touch – RF, Capacitive, etc \- Modular Tactile Design for the shape and format of Fingers \& Arms
* Convergent Camera Design \& Image sensor design , Autofocus Liquid Lens Optics Design
* Neuromorphic Image Sensor pipeline \- FPGA
* Sensing Primitives\- Creating Sensor Physics in Simulation Environment to map Sensor’s signal response for different object interactions
* Alternate Modes of Actuation for Robots \& Motion Control – Tendon, Tendon \+ Joint Actuation
* Motor \& motion Design for Wrist and Ball joints



  





**Machine Learning** 



* Neuromorphic NN designs \- Neural morphology \- Breaking down neural patterns and their Functions
* MPC \& RL Design
* On\-the\- Fly Learning process \& Live weight modelling
* Signals to senses, closed loop architectures in Neurons
* Adaptive Learning Architectures – Dynamic Weights, Static \& dynamic neural patterns
* Neural memory \& temporal neurons
* Dimensionality of physical actions encoding into neural pathways
* Auto Object learning Setup for Robots



  





**Robot Control** 



* Multi arm Kinematics Multi Arm\- task Scheduling and Task sequencing
* Grasp Models And Force Modelled Grasping Algorithm Library for
* Gripper Design \& Construction
* Multi\-Finger Trajectory \& Grasp Planning
* Action primitives – Action models
* Data (Signal) Model of Objects
* Dynamic Collision planning
* Energy Optimized path Planning and motion breakdown between Arms Force\- Primacy Control
* Breaking down tasks into Micro Actions and Building Micro RL models for Grasp, Task



  





**Requirements:** 




  





**What do you need to thrive in this Job?** 



1. **Business empathy** 
 \- Most important mistake that Engineers and Researchers make is Not including the constraints of business as a factor of the problem we solve. From Money, volatility of customer interest, Runway, resource availability, Supply chain bottlenecks, Manufacturability, Scalability, Serviceability, Team Alignment, tool, Skill \& infra bottlenecks – all of these dictate the relevance of what one builds more than the principles and tech. A research that doesn’t track its relevance to these metrics most often ends up unviable. Miss one, the whole approach goes unusable or unviable.
2. **Outcome oriented Research** 
 – Key factor that differentiates Academic research from Industrial Research. Have developed structured methods to accelerate open ended problems
3. **Customer/User focus** 
 – This is the north star and gives purpose. The greatest joy is in seeing someone benefit from your work. Even greater joy is in they getting addicted to your work. Not Paper focused.
4. **Discipline \& Consistency** 
 \- Research is an unobjective business and its easy to hide behind its subjectivity and justify delay/ mood swings. When system lacks objectivity, Its self\-discipline that gets you to the goal. Timelines Matter – Simply because money runs out. Easiest hack – Learn to carve out usable outcomes our of every step of progress in Research, even if the entire research is yet to materialize.
5. As part of the Job you will be responsible for
 **joint research efforts with Research institutions** 
 including IISC \& EPFL. You will be responsible to coordinate the research activities between CynLr \& the Partner Research Institutions. And manage outcomes out of the engagements.



  





**Who should Apply?** 



* If you are a Post\-Docs, Phds, Research faculties, Research scientist looking to further your research into materialized real\-world outcomes
* You are in your UG/PG, but beyond the romance of research \& titles, if you have understood the grind of research and is keen on building technology that needs solving a foundational problem for customers/industry that requires research, please apply.
* Driven Not by Papers, Not Patents, Not titles – just utility, Please apply. Understand the difference between experimental research and paper research.
* If you have realized the limitations of current approach to Intelligence and Robotics technologies and recognize the need for deeper research.
* Structured research mindset – Not Jugaad.



  





**Technical Skill :** 



* Very strong fundamentals understanding in respective subjects.
* For
 **Algo \& Compute** 
 – HPC/GPU role, you need to have exceptional understanding of Computer Architecture, Compliers \& OS.
* For
 **Computational Neuroscience \& Vision** 
 \- Proficient with Computer Vision, Physics of Light \& Optics, Fundamentals of Neurons/Neuroscience.
* For
 **Optics, Sensors \& HW** 
 \- Proficient with Electronic Design, Materials, Optics, Signals \& Systems. Savy with instrumentation.
* For
 **Robotics \& Motion Contro** 
 l – Strong with Controls Theory, MPC \& Adaptive control, working experience with Motion Control Design, Proficiency in Robot Control \& Kinematics, Machine learning Fundamentals.
* For
 **ML/RL research** 
 – Proficient with ML Architecture design, Temporal NN design, Designing Reinforcement Learning , Foundations of NN and neuron design, Learning Design.
* **Fundamentals of Systems and Control theory**
* Strong
 **penchant for Instrumentation** 
 (designing measurement tools/methods \& sensors), analytics and designing experiments
* Proficiency with programming– You don’t have to be tool/Language experts.



  





**What This Role is NOT** 



* Pure academic paper driven research.



  





**Team Structure** 




 The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
 



 While the TPM works closely with the founder(s), the role interfaces continuously with:
 



 • Engineering leads
 



 • HR and Talent, for performance programs and people\-related interventions
 



 • Finance and Operations, for resource planning and project budgeting
 



 • External vendors and tooling partners, where applicable
 



 The TPM owns process design and delivery hygiene across all engineering streams — acting as the connective layer that keeps multi\-disciplinary teams aligned without creating dependency on a single coordination point.
 



  





**About CynLr** 




  





 As a foundational technology building company in Robotics \& AI,
 
 CynLr
 
 builds visual robots \- Cynoid \& CyRo that
 
 can intuitively learn to pick \& handle even unknown objects without requiring any prior training
 
 , just like a human baby fiddles with objects. CynLr calls this stack as Object Intelligence (OI).
 



  





 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries. CynLr builds a stack of Micro RL blocks called Sensing \& Action Primitives, using which a High Level Task can be composed.
 



  





 With OI's ability to learn on the fly, CynLr’s focus is to universally automate factories and eliminate the need for complicated custom machines to manufacture products. Thereby simplifying manufacturing into
 
 Universal Factories
 
 , which can be programmatically repurposed to produce wide varieties of Products.
 



  





 CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



  





 We are a deep\-tech robotics company at the intersection of computer vision, real\-time control systems, and precision hardware, headquartered in Bengaluru with a Swiss entity. Our engineering spans optics, embedded systems, firmware, real\-time software, mechanical design, and applied research.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Overview**
**Technical Lead Engineer**
**About HealthEdge**
 HealthEdge is a leading healthcare technology innovator powering the next generation of healthcare payment solutions. Our enterprise software platforms enable health plans to manage billions of dollars in medical claims, reduce improper payments, and deliver superior member experiences. We serve millions of healthcare consumers across the United States through partnerships with forward\-thinking payers.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are at an inflection point of rapid growth and technical transformation. As we migrate our infrastructure to AWS and modernize our technology stack, we're building exceptional engineering teams in Bangalore to work alongside our global organization. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the technical direction of critical healthcare platforms while growing into a leadership role.
   

  

 As a Technical Lead, you'll bridge the gap between individual contribution and management, driving technical excellence while mentoring engineers and guiding architectural decisions. You'll work on systems that process millions of healthcare transactions, prevent fraud and abuse, and ultimately make healthcare more affordable and accessible for everyday Americans.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Technical Lead Engineer is a hands\-on technical leadership role combining deep software engineering expertise with mentorship responsibilities. You will lead by example in writing high\-quality code, architecting solutions, and establishing engineering best practices while guiding junior and mid\-level engineers in their technical growth. This position requires strong technical depth, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Product Owners, architects, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications, make key architectural decisions, and ensure delivery of robust, scalable solutions. This role is ideal for a senior engineer ready to expand their impact through technical leadership and mentorship.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership:**
* Lead the technical design and architecture of complex features and systems, making decisions that balance immediate needs with long\-term maintainability
* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and implementation plans
* Conduct thorough code reviews ensuring adherence to coding standards, design patterns, and architectural principles
* Provide technical oversight across the software development lifecycle from requirements gathering through production deployment
* Identify and drive resolution of technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural improvements
* Establish and champion engineering best practices including code quality, testing strategies, and deployment processes


**Hands\-on Development:**
* Design and develop complex application features using .NET, C\#, and modern JavaScript frameworks
* Build and optimize RESTful APIs and microservices architectures for high\-performance, distributed systems
* Develop sophisticated database solutions including stored procedures, optimization strategies, and data access patterns
* Create responsive user interfaces using AngularJS, Angular, and React (supporting our ongoing framework migration)
* Write comprehensive unit tests and implement test automation strategies to ensure code quality
* Debug complex production issues and implement root cause solutions to prevent recurrence


**Mentorship \& Collaboration:**
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance
* Help team members clarify requirements, break down complex problems, and develop technical skills
* Collaborate with architects, product managers, and other technical leads to align technical strategy
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing within the team
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery


**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience
* 9\+ years of professional software development experience with progressively increasing responsibility
* Demonstrated experience in technical leadership or lead developer roles


**Technical Expertise:**
* Expert\-level proficiency in .NET (Framework and Core/5\+) with advanced C\# programming skills
* Strong experience with multiple JavaScript frameworks: AngularJS, Angular, and React (critical for supporting our technology evolution)
* Advanced SQL Server expertise including complex query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design
* Deep understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems patterns
* Experience with message\-based architectures using Kafka protocol systems ( RedPanda , Kafka, or equivalent)
* Comprehensive knowledge of design patterns, SOLID principles, and enterprise application architecture
* Proficiency with unit testing frameworks ( xUnit , NUnit ) and test\-driven development methodologies
* Strong experience with version control systems (Git, Azure DevOps) and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with modern web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, XML, JSON, and Web APIs


**Preferred Skills \& Technologies**
* AWS cloud services and architecture (EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, ECS, CloudWatch) \- highly valuable for our ongoing migration
* Microsoft Fabric and Azure data platform experience
* Power BI for analytics and data visualization
* Elasticsearch for search functionality and log aggregation
* Playwright or similar automated testing frameworks
* Redis caching strategies and distributed caching patterns
* Microsoft Rules Engine or other business rules management systems
* Container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Entity Framework, Dapper, or other ORM/data access frameworks
* Performance profiling, application monitoring, and observability tools
* Healthcare domain knowledge, HIPAA compliance, or experience in regulated industries


**Leadership Qualities We Seek**
* Strong architectural thinking with ability to design scalable, maintainable systems
* Excellent mentorship skills and passion for developing other engineers
* Outstanding communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Proven ability to drive consensus and make decisions in ambiguous situations
* Self\-motivated with strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Growth mindset with enthusiasm for learning new technologies and emerging best practices
* Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across teams and time zones
* Attention to quality with commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement


**Leadership Scope**
 While this is not a people management role with direct reports, Technical Leads are expected to provide technical leadership throughout the software development lifecycle. You will serve as a technical mentor to team members, help define and clarify requirements, provide architectural guidance, conduct thorough code reviews, and make technical decisions that impact team success. This role is ideal for engineers who want to increase their technical leadership impact while maintaining hands\-on coding responsibilities.
   

  

**Why Join HealthEdge**

* Technical Leadership: Shape architectural decisions and technical strategy during a period of significant transformation
* Modern Tech Stack: Work with cutting\-edge cloud technologies, modern frameworks, and enterprise\-scale systems
* Career Growth: Join during expansion phase with clear pathways to architect and management roles
* Mentorship Opportunities: Develop your leadership skills by mentoring talented engineers
* Innovation Culture: We encourage experimentation, value technical excellence, and reward creative problem\-solving
* Global Collaboration: Work with world\-class engineering teams across multiple locations

description:
**Level Up Your Career with Zynga!**
 At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take\-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175\+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.
   

  

 From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind\-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan\-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires \& Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles \& Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!
   

  

 Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
   

  

 Join us and be part of the play!
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The User Acquisition team at Zynga is looking for an experienced and accomplished User Acquisition performance marketer who will be responsible for managing large\-scale advertising campaigns. This person is an analytical and business\-savvy number\-cruncher who will acquire users for Zynga’s growing mobile portfolio. This individual will focus on leveraging Paid Social Channels, Ad Networks, and DSPs to scale our current marketing efforts. You will be responsible for helping the team identify and develop mobile acquisition strategies, and work closely with engineering and machine learning engineers to further improve our internal tools. You are an experienced quantitative online marketer who can manage multiple priorities while delivering outstanding execution. This role is well suited for those who are analytically strong and want to make a direct impact on the growth of the business.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Create and manage new user acquisition, and retargeting campaigns on paid social (i.e. Facebook, Google, TikTok) and ad network platforms (i.e. Unity, Applovin, Liftoff)
* Lead the optimization efforts across creative, geo, platform, and channel to maximize returns and scale products and deliver performance at scale.
* Have understanding of ad attribution and tracking with mobile measurement partners(i.e. Appsflyer, Adjust)
* Collaborate with the Game, Creative, and Product Marketing teams to make decisions that increase LTV and lower acquisition cost.
* Daily, weekly, and quarterly budget forecasting and reporting of results


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years experience in a performance marketing role.
* Demonstrated experience with campaign management on paid social and DSP channels.
* Strong problem solving and analytical thinking skills, and experience working in a metrics\-based environment.
* Experience with Tableau, advanced Excel, and mobile measurement partners (i.e. Adjust, Appsflyer, Kochava).
* Outstanding stakeholder communication skills – both written and spoken – to work effectively with our external and internal partners.


**What We Offer You**
 Zynga offers a world\-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.
   

  

 As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at accommodationrequest@zynga.com to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.
   

  

 Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third\-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage. Zynga’s in\-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).

 Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.
 



  





 The Opportunity:
 



 We are seeking a GenAI Architect / Sr Consultant, Software Engineer (L6\.5\) who is both a hands\-on full\-stack engineer and a team leader capable of designing, developing, and deploying GenAI‑powered applications. You will manage and mentor an engineering team while delivering scalable AI systems that integrate with Visa’s product ecosystem, developer platforms, and internal operational tools.
 



  





 This role blends architecture, leadership, full\-stack development, cloud engineering, and GenAI frameworks. As a Visa Lead Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi\-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions.
 



 The Work itself:
 


* Global Operations holds the responsibility of ensuring Visa’s diverse portfolio of commercial services are performing optimally, meeting stringent availability targets and exceeding our clients’ expectations.
* By architecting automation and GenAI into our operational DNA, and deeply embedding AIOps into our strategic foundation, Global Operations, the engine room of production operations, is well positioned to think big, act quickly and innovate with intention.
* Working with highly integrated, high\-throughput systems, an equally high importance must be placed on robust observability, intelligent event detection and incident management.
* Global Operations sets the operational standards to support the business demands of today and the operational needs of tomorrow as technologies continue to evolve and adjust the way we work to support the business.
* Through blame free post mortems, intellectual curiosity and problem solving we turn reactive into proactive and create an environment that provides the support and mentorship for our team members to learn and grow.



 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
 


* Qualifications



 Qualifications
 



 Basic Qualifications:
 



 8\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11\+ years of relevant work experience.
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications:
 



 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
 



 Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.
 



 8\+ years of software engineering experience; 2\+ years leading or mentoring engineers.
 



 Worked with Agile SDLC process and SAFE agile environment in distributed teams
 



 Hands\-on experience with:
 



 LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, Haystack, AWS Bedrock GenAI tools)
 



 Python backend development (FastAPI strongly preferred)
 



 Frontend development (React \+ TypeScript)
 



 Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, etc.)
 



 Agile Frameworks like SAFE, GitHub / Bitbucket, Jira, ServiceNow, Wiki, CI/CD automation pipelines involving Jenkins
 



 Proven experience shipping products on AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway, Bedrock, SageMaker).
 



 Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and API design.
 



 Experience implementing RAG at scale using internal or cloud\-based vector stores.
 



 Experience with Databricks/Spark pipelines, MLFlow, or modern MLOps tools.
 



 Familiarity with event\-driven messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis).
 



 Background in payments, risk, fraud analytics, or regulated financial systems.
 



 Experience creating developer tooling or reusable frameworks for broader engineering teams.
 



 The Skills You Bring:
 



 GenAI Architecture \& Framework Development
 



 Architect and deliver GenAI\-enabled applications leveraging:
 



 LangGraph, LangChain, Haystack, or similar agent frameworks
 



 AWS GenAI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, “Strands”\-style agent pipelines, embeddings, vector stores)
 



 RAG architectures, custom LLM orchestration, model evaluation, LLMOps workflows
 



 Build reusable GenAI components, SDKs, pipelines, and abstraction layers for engineering teams.
 



 Define best practices for:
 



 Prompt engineering and evaluation
 



 LLM safety, guardrails, and content filtering
 



 Embedding generation and vector database integrations
 



 Model lifecycle governance and deployment optimization
 



 Full‑Stack Engineering (Hands\-on Development)
 



 Develop end‑to‑end AI applications using:
 



 Backend: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js
 



 Frontend: React \+ TypeScript, UI component frameworks, REST/GraphQL integration
 



 Build secure APIs, microservices, event\-driven components, and backend integrations for AI systems.
 



 Design intuitive, responsive, production\-grade user interfaces for GenAI\-powered tools.
 



 Data Pipelines \& CI/CD Engineering
 



 Design and build data workflows supporting AI systems, including:
 



 ETL/ELT pipelines
 



 Data preparation for LLM training/fine\-tuning
 



 Embedding pipelines and retrieval data stores
 



 Implement CI/CD automation leveraging:
 



 Jenkins, GitHub/Bitbucket, Jira, Wiki, GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Artifactory or similar systems
 



 Automated testing, containerization, deployment, quality gates
 



 Infrastructure\-as\-code (CloudFormation, Terraform)
 



 Ensure automated monitoring, logging, observability, and rollback strategies.
 



 Governance, Security \& Responsible AI
 



 Apply Visa’s standards for:
 



 Model explainability
 



 Data governance and redaction
 



 Security boundaries, access control, encryption
 



 Responsible AI guidelines and compliance expectations
 



 Work with cybersecurity teams to ensure secure production deployments.
 



 Soft Skills
 



 Excellent communication, ability to simplify complex AI concepts.
 



 Leadership presence with hands\-on technical credibility.
 



 Ability to collaborate in a matrixed global organization.
 



 Passion for innovation and continuous exploration of emerging GenAI capabilities.
 



 We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa

title: Participant Recruitment Team Lead
description:
**Job Title: Participant Recruitment Manager – Clinical Studies** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



**Department:** 
 Clinical Operations / Participant Recruitment
 



**Team Size:** 
 5 Recruiters
 



**Experience:** 
 1–6 years
 



**Education:** 
 MBA/PGDM preferred; candidates with relevant experience in clinical study participant recruitment will also be considered.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and highly communicative
 **Participant Recruitment Manager** 
 to lead and manage a team of 5 participant recruiters involved in clinical studies.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for both
 **hands\-on participant recruitment and team management** 
 . The role involves identifying potential participants, making calls, explaining study requirements clearly, addressing queries, motivating eligible participants to enroll, and ensuring timely follow\-up for scheduled study visits.
 



 The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and persuasion skills, strong people\-management abilities, and the confidence to interact with participants from diverse backgrounds.
 **Fluency in Kannada is mandatory.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Participant Recruitment \& Engagement
 


* Identify and connect with potential participants for ongoing clinical studies through available recruitment channels.
* Make outbound calls and communicate with prospective participants to understand their interest and suitability.
* Explain the clinical study, visit requirements, timelines, procedures, and other relevant information in a clear and participant\-friendly manner.
* Build rapport with participants and address their queries and concerns professionally.
* Motivate and guide interested participants through the recruitment and enrollment process while maintaining ethical recruitment practices.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with participants regarding upcoming visits and appointments.
* Maintain regular communication with enrolled participants to support visit adherence and reduce dropouts.
* Maintain accurate records of participant interactions, follow\-ups, and recruitment status.



 Team Management
 


* Lead, supervise, and manage a team of 5 Participant Recruiters.
* Allocate recruitment targets and responsibilities among team members.
* Monitor daily recruitment calls, leads, conversions, follow\-ups, and enrollment numbers.
* Track individual and team performance and provide regular feedback and coaching.
* Train recruiters on participant communication, study explanation, follow\-up techniques, and handling participant queries.
* Support team members in resolving difficult participant situations and improving conversion rates.
* Ensure the team follows approved study recruitment processes and communication guidelines.



 Study Coordination
 


* Coordinate closely with
 **Study Managers, Clinical Operations teams, and other stakeholders** 
 regarding participant recruitment and visit schedules.
* Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, participant status, and challenges.
* Coordinate participant visits with the study team and ensure timely communication of changes or cancellations.
* Escalate participant\-related issues or concerns to the appropriate study team.
* Support the study team in achieving recruitment and retention targets.



  





 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* **Fluency in Kannada is mandatory.**
* Strong interpersonal and persuasion skills.
* Excellent telephone communication and participant engagement skills.
* Strong people\-management and leadership abilities.
* Ability to motivate and manage a team.
* Good follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Ability to handle multiple participants and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced clinical research environment.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and basic reporting tools.



  





 Educational Qualification
 


* **MBA/PGDM graduates** 
 from HR, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or related disciplines are preferred.
* Candidates without an MBA may also be considered if they have strong, relevant experience in clinical study participant recruitment or participant engagement.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:
 


* Clinical trial / clinical study participant recruitment
* Patient recruitment or patient engagement
* Healthcare recruitment
* Telecalling / inside sales with strong conversion experience
* Clinical research coordination
* Team handling in recruitment, healthcare, or clinical research environments



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who can
 **personally drive participant recruitment while effectively managing a team** 
 . They should be confident speaking with participants, capable of explaining information in simple terms, comfortable with frequent follow\-ups, and able to motivate their team to achieve recruitment targets.
 



**Strong Kannada communication skills are essential for this role.**

title: Quality Testing Associate Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a diversity of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
   

  

 The Impact You'll Make in this Role
   

  

 As a Quality Testing Associate Analyst, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative People Around The World. Here, You Will Make An Impact By
   

  

* Support QA/Test Management in planning and executing testing across SAP and integrated applications.
* Perform manual, functional, regression, retesting, and UAT support based on requirements, scenarios, and test cases.
* Prepare, review, maintain, and execute test cases while documenting test evidence and results.
* Identify, log, track, retest, and close defects using Jira with proper descriptions, screenshots, severity, and priority.
* Use qTest to manage test cases, track execution, maintain defect status, and support requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability.
* Prepare test status reports and metrics in Excel, coordinate with SAP/business teams, follow QA standards, and escalate risks or blockers on time.


 Your Skills and Expertise
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in Software Testing, QA, SAP Testing, or a related area.
* Basic understanding of SDLC, STLC, manual testing concepts, defect lifecycle, Excel, and clear documentation of test results and defects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with willingness to learn SAP applications, testing tools, and enterprise testing processes.


**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**
* Basic exposure to qTest for test management and Jira for defect logging, tracking, and workflow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for test tracking, reporting, data analysis, and basic formulas.
* Basic understanding of SAP Testing / Quality \& Test Management and overview of SAP modules such as MM, SD, OTC, and MTD.

title: Community Executive
description:
**POSITION DESCRIPTION** 




 We are looking for a Community Executive to manage and engage with our online community across social media, live chat, Google Business Profile (GMB), review platforms and other digital touchpoints. The role will be responsible for ensuring timely and meaningful responses to customers, automating online conversations and reviews, monitoring brand sentiment, supporting automated communication journeys, and preparing regular reports and insights to track community engagement and online reputation.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Monitor and manage conversations, comments, mentions and direct messages across social media platforms.
* Respond to customer queries, feedback and comments in a timely, helpful and brand appropriate manner.
* Escalate sensitive, complex or service\-related issues to the relevant internal teams.
* Monitor reviews and ratings across Google Business Profile (GMB) and other relevant review platforms.
* Setting up automations for social media comments, identifying issues, and finding resolutions.
* Manage customer interactions through live chat and other digital communication channels.
* Handling sentiment analysis and training bots for live chat, social media comments, and DMs.
* Prepare monthly reports covering social media engagement, community interactions, response volumes, response times and sentiment.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 1–3 years of experience in social media, community management, ORM, customer experience or a similar digital role.
* Experience with Google Business Profile (GMB) and online review platforms.
* Experience handling live chat or other digital customer communication channels.
* Experience with automation tools/workflows is a must have.
* Strong reporting and analytical skills with the ability to work with different types of reports and dashboards.

title: Product Support Specialist, Education Team  (Full time, 1-year contract)
description:
**Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Ready to make meaningful impact? You're in the right place.
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Every role supporting Canva contributes to something bigger. Here's what this contract opportunity involves and what we're looking for.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 This is a
 **12\-month** 
 independent contractor opportunity, where you'll provide services within a defined scope, with the flexibility to shape how you deliver your impact.
   

  

 Designed for a hybrid way of working, this opportunity is remote and open to candidates based anywhere in India, so you can align on key touchpoints with our internal team and our education partners across the country. While it'd be up to you to manage your time, the expected time commitment to deliver these services is approximately
 **40 hours per week.**
**About The Team**
 We're the Canva Education team in India, working to bring creativity, collaboration, and visual communication into classrooms across the country. We partner with state governments, national education bodies, and large school networks to make Canva a safe, inclusive platform for teaching and learning — from rural districts to city schools — always aligned with India's priorities like NEP 2020, foundational learning, and digital equity. AI is an accelerant to our mission to empower the world to design. We're embracing it as a powerful tool to help us move faster, spark ideas, streamline work, and unlock creativity.
   

  

 We're genuinely curious about how people are thinking about and experimenting with new technologies to amplify impact, so you can expect it to come up in conversation during the interview process.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be working on**
 As Canva Education continues to grow, change is part of how we move forward. That means the services you'll provide may evolve, and we'd discuss that with you from time to time.
   

  

 Right now, most schools and school systems find the technical side of getting started harder than it should be — Single Sign\-On, domain verification, and connecting their Google or Microsoft backends can take far longer than anyone would like, and State partnerships often run across several different authentication pathways at once. You'll be the person who makes all of that smooth.
   

  

 You'll be engaged to provide services aimed at:
   

  

* Guiding school systems and Education Depts through SSO setup, domain verification, and account provisioning, so teachers and students can get into Canva Education quickly and securely.
* Supporting integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft (Entra ID / Microsoft 365\) backends, and troubleshooting authentication, provisioning, and directory\-sync issues end to end.
* Acting as the technical point of contact for State partnership rollouts that run across different authentication pathways, making sure each one lands cleanly.
* Diagnosing and resolving onboarding blockers alongside school IT admins, DIETs, and district teams, and escalating product issues to internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Engineering) when needed.
* Creating clear, localized setup guides and self\-serve resources so schools can onboard with less hand\-holding over time.
* Tracking common support issues and integration patterns, and feeding them back internally to reduce friction at scale.
* Supporting training and enablement for administrators and master trainers on account setup, access management, and everyday troubleshooting.


**Qualifications**
**You're probably a match if**
* You've supported SSO, SAML/OAuth, or identity and access setups before, and you can explain how they work to non\-technical people without losing them.
* You know your way around Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration, including domain verification, provisioning, and directory sync.
* You've spent at least 3 years in technical support, implementation, or solutions roles — ideally supporting schools, government systems, or large organizations.
* You stay calm and methodical when an integration breaks, and you're happy owning a problem until it's genuinely fixed.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi, both in writing and on calls.

**Why Ema?**

title: Strategy Analyst
description:
**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 Most internships have you fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. This is not one of them. At Joveo, the Strategic Initiatives team operates like a startup within a scale\-up. We research, build, and scale new global supply channels and revenue streams from zero. We are looking for a
 **Growth \& Strategy Intern** 
 to work directly with leadership to solve complex business problems, optimize go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies, and drive real revenue impact.
 



 If you are a first\-principle thinker who is relentlessly curious, highly analytical, and communicates exceptionally well, this is the place to accelerate your career.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do:** 



* **Market Intelligence \& GTM:** 
 Conduct deep\-dive research into new markets, HR tech trends, and competitor landscapes to identify white\-space opportunities for Joveo.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Audit our existing supply and partnership workflows. Find the bottlenecks, propose data\-backed solutions, and help build the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to fix them.
* **Data Storytelling:** 
 Analyze performance dashboards to find hidden patterns. You won't just pull data; you will translate it into actionable business insights for the leadership team.
* **Cross\-Functional Execution:** 
 Collaborate daily with global supply, product, and sales teams. You will need to influence stakeholders and manage moving parts to get projects across the finish line.
* **Pitch \& Asset Creation:** 
 Help draft strategic partnership decks, executive summaries, and internal memos that are sharp, persuasive, and clear.



  





**Who We Are Looking For:** 



* **You are "Smart" (Analytical):** 
 You don't just accept things as they are. You break problems down to their fundamental truths (first\-principle thinking) and build solutions from there.
* **You are a Great Communicator:** 
 You can take a complex, 10\-page concept and distill it into a punchy, 3\-bullet Slack message. You are comfortable speaking up in a room full of senior leaders.
* **High Agency:** 
 You don't wait to be told what to do. If you see a problem, you research it, propose a solution, and ask for permission to execute.
* **Tech Fluency:** 
 You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentation tools, and quickly learning new SaaS platforms. (Bonus points if you know your way around basic data visualization).



  





**What’s In It For You:** 



* **Direct Mentorship:** 
 Work directly under the Chief Strategic Initiatives Officer and learn how to scale businesses from $0 to multi\-million dollar ARR.
* **Real Impact:** 
 Your work will directly influence Joveo’s global expansion and bottom line.
* **Fast\-Tracked Learning:** 
 Get a crash course in B2B SaaS, Ad\-Tech, strategic partnerships, and global supply chains.

**Location:** 
 Work from office \- Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-2 Years
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a sharp, analytical marketer to own our inbound and performance marketing channels end\-to\-end. This isn't a "run the ads and report the numbers" role. You'll be the one diagnosing
 *why* 
 a metric moved, tracing it back through the funnel, and fixing it before it becomes a bigger problem.
 



 You'll work across website, SEO platforms, Google Search Ads and Meta Ads, constantly asking "why" at every drop\-off point in the funnel, and using AI tools to speed up how fast you can find and fix issues. You'll also partner with our design team to iterate on creative (headlines, ad copy, content) based on what the data tells you, and pick up the connected systems: CRM, ad platforms, analytics; quickly enough to see how a change in one shows up in another.
 



 Alongside this, you'll contribute to a growing area of the role: improving how often we're mentioned by AI/LLM tools (AU mention rate) and growing organic/inbound traffic \- identifying the right initiatives, building repeatable playbooks, and supporting SEO and content efforts.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Performance Channel Ownership:** 
 Run Google Search Ads and Meta Ads day\-to\-day, driving the funnel consistently against pipeline/lead targets.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** 
 For every dip or spike in a campaign metric, dig into
 *why* 
 it happened. Don't just report the number, explain and act on it.
* **AI\-Leveraged Optimization:** 
 Use AI tools to surface issues across campaigns faster (underperforming ad sets, budget leaks, audience fatigue, etc.) and fix them on an ongoing basis to maximize ROI.
* **Creative Problem\-Solving:** 
 Diagnose when creative (headlines, ad copy, landing content) is the bottleneck, brief the design team clearly, and see changes through to accurate implementation.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 Understand how performance channels connect to the CRM and other tools in the stack, so you can trace a lead from ad click to conversion and troubleshoot across the whole chain, not just one platform.
* **LLM Visibility \& Organic Growth:** 
 Identify and prioritize initiatives that improve our visibility in AI/LLM\-driven search and recommendations; support efficiency playbooks and SEO/content efforts that grow organic traffic and conversions.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 1\-2 years in a high\-pace environment: startups or similarly demanding settings / teams. Prior performance marketing experience is a plus but not mandatory if the problem\-solving chops are strong.
* **Education:** 
 Graduate from a top\-tier college; IIT/NIT strongly preferred.



  





**Core Qualities We're Looking For** 



* **Analytical Ability:** 
 You rely on data, not opinions, to make decisions.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 When a metric drops, you don't just report it \- you find out why and fix it.
* **First\-Principles Thinking:** 
 You figure things out from the basics instead of copying what worked elsewhere.
* **Fast Learner:** 
 You can pick up a new tool or platform on your own, without much guidance.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 You understand how the CRM, ad platforms, and analytics connect, so you can trace an issue back to its source.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves (Bonus Points)** 



* Prior exposure to SEO fundamentals or content strategy.
* Experience building or improving marketing playbooks/SOPs.
* Familiarity with LLM/AI\-search visibility as an emerging marketing lever.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* **Ownership:** 
 You treat the channels like they're your own budget. You will be required to coordinate with design/web/content teams, but the buck stops at you; you need to do whatever it takes to get the job done
* **Communicator:** 
 You can explain a technical or data\-driven decision to non\-marketing stakeholders in plain English.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* 5\+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
  
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
  
* Hands\-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
  
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
  
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
  
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
  
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English
  
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
  


  


**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit** 



  

  
* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
  
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
  
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
  


  


**First 90 days** 



  

  
* **Days 1 to 30:** 
 Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
  
* **Days 31 to 60:** 
 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
  
* **Days 61 to 90:** 
 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* **Shape a function from the ground up** 
 – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go\-to\-market.
  
* **Work with cutting\-edge AI** 
 – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise\-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
  
* **Global exposure** 
 – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
  
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** 
 – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
  
* **Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives** 
 – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
  


  


 This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

 We are looking for a Creative Strategist dedicated to Instagram Reels and short\-form video formats. Your goal is to capture immediate attention, drive organic reach, and build brand affinity through rapid, high\-impact creative concepts. You understand short\-form visual grammar, trend dynamics, audio triggers, and how to hold attention in a scroll\-heavy feed. You bridge the gap between creative storytelling and growth, giving our production team precise blueprints to execute.
   

  

 Focus Area 1: Short\-Form Concepting \& Trend Capture
   

  

* Rapid Trend Hunting: Monitor social feeds, audio trends, visual formats, and financial commentary to spot viral concepts as they emerge.
* Concept Architecture: Design high\-performing Reel formats, visual hooks, and text\-on\-screen structures tailored specifically for short attention spans.
* Hook Strategy: Craft the visual, textual, and audio hooks for the first 3 seconds of every short\-form piece to maximize view completion rates.
* Batch Strategy: Build repeatable content frameworks and series formats that can be produced at scale without losing creative quality.


 Focus Area 2: Visual Storytelling \& Messaging
   

  

* Script \& Beat Sheets: Write snappy, concise beat sheets and script outlines for creators, on\-camera talent, and video editors.

* Performance Analysis: Review reach, saves, shares, and watch time metrics to constantly refine narrative hooks and visual execution.


**Qualifications**
 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Short\-Form Mastery: Track record of concepting high\-reach Instagram Reels or short\-form video content that drives high engagement and shares.

description:
**About The Role**
 Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales\-led motion and a product\-led self\-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We’re hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.
   

  

 We are seeking a Systems Administrator, Billing Systems to serve as the senior platform expert across our billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role will own day\-to\-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual\-motion SaaS environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Billing Systems Administration
   

  

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our PLG self\-serve motion and enterprise\-grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
* Serve as the primary Stripe and BillingPlatform platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly


 Quote\-to\-Cash Integrations
   

  

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote\-to\-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
* Support CPQ\-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract\-to\-subscription linkages
* Configure and test PLG self\-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self\-serve subscription management


 Provisioning Connectivity
   

  

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff across both PLG self\-serve and SLG enterprise motions.
* Maintain the billing\-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and BillingPlatform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
* Monitor the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side


 Data Quality \& Reconciliation
   

  

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
* Support billing reconciliation across BillingPlatform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
* Support month\-end and quarter\-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self\-serve customers
* Deep hands\-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
* Hands\-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform such as BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, or Chargebee
* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote\-to\-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
* Familiarity with billing\-to\-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales\-led and product\-led revenue motions


**Preferred**
* Stripe certification such as Stripe Associate
* Experience with usage\-based pricing models, including metered billing, freemium conversion, and monthly self\-serve
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or hands\-on CPQ experience
